slob dpon so ma shrīs mdzad/rgya gar rmi mkhas pa chen po paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā tshwa na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu 'od kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1131) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1136)1526 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod nga /re spyad/kye(ba par/bobasdo /) ཿdza bka 1137slob dpon so ma shrīs mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā dz+nyā na dang /lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu 'od kyis bsgyur zhing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1163) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1166)1527 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa/ 1167slob dpon so ma shrīs mdzad/rgya gar kyi mkhan po ma hā tshwa na dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu 'od kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan//(1170) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1171)1528 can/nyapar /ma/re ཿcho sgyun 1172bsdur mchan/(1175) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1175)1529 dpal thams cad gsang ba'i bshad sbyar gsang ba'i sgron 22

ma 1140(5slo ba dngo/na rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad/rgya gar kyi mkhan ngo/ pradz+nyā khre ra warma dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slo nga rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(12rga) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1255)1530 ngan song spyong ba'i don gyi 'bru 'grel zhes bya ba/ 1256dbang po rab 'bring gnyis kyi don ched du tan+t+ra'i mtshan don gyi dbye ba mdor bsdus te bstan pa/ 1256dbang po tha ma tshig sprur len pas go ba rnams la rgyud kyi don gsal bar bya ba'i phyir bstan pa/ 1261/bre/ra thab/ga/ 1261——/ra /babyas/ngatshab/ 1273rgyud kyi dazas po bshad pa/ 1277rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1277gtsug tor chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1350tshe dpa ga med las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa 'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa— 173617rgyal po chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1367phyogs skyong bcu'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1369gza' chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1371klu chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 137623

lha chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1385tshe dpag med gshin rje 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1387rigs bzhi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1394khro bo rdo rje nyi ma me'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1412mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa bye nas bshad pa/ 1429rgyud kyi don 'ji gzung ba ston pa/ 1443rgyud 'di don bsdus nas bstan pa dang 'khor rnams dga' bar byestecad /pa/ 1443slob dngo/na sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1447) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1466)1531 'phags pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po chen mdu:re sbyo1 byebyezang paraXs(ba pa// ༷ 1467dbang po rjon po dag la rgyu dang 'azas bu dang thabs kyi rgyud kyi mtshan tsam zhig bstan pa/ 1467dbang po 'bring gi don du bsdus pa'i don rnam par dbye ba dang dbang po tha ma'i don du rgyud kyi don rnam par spros (sto /bab rjod/pa/ 1zheg7zhes/bre/ra rdo //rna/ 1zhes7zhes byes/ra /ba/sa/nga/ba/ 1513rgyud kyi da——tha pobastan pa/ 1521rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 152124

sbyo/da 4) skya/lnga/ nga)spu)'ab pa 74zab bshad pa/ 1679dang po/ gtsug tor gyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1679gnyis pa/ tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1682gsum pa/ rgyal po chen po'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1686bzhi pa/ phyogs skyong gi dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1688lnga pa/ gza' chen po'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1690drug pa/ klu chen po'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1691bdun pa/ lha chen po'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1697brgyad pa/ 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1699dgu pa/ tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis pa bshad pa/ 1701rgyud phyi ma'i yang phyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1708dang po/ rigs bzhi'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1708gnyis pa/ khro bo rdo rje nyi ma me'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa/ 1722ma 'byen brgya byu1 brgyad kyi sgo nas bstod pa/ 1731dzā larnya ra'i rdo rje slob dngo/na/ kā ma dhe nu pa zhes bya ba'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad/ā tsār+ya bi na ya tsan+d+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1734) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1761)tshedakar chag gi zur mchan/ chos tshan (1478)dang (1go8)gnyis 'gyur mi 'dra ba tsam las don du chos tshan gcig tu snang /yang chos tshan(1516)dang (1528)gnyis tshig re zung mi 'dra ba tsam dang mdzad byang dang 'gyur byang yod med kyi khyad par las bskyar zlos su 'khod 'dug25

༄/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga nam mkha' dṛ med ces bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā ma sadhī ti ༄snye.ā kā sha bi ma la nā ma/ bod skad du/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga nam mkha' rdudri med ces bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde gshegs shes rab ngo bo can/ /ma rig mun nang sems can nyam thag la/ /ye shes nyi zer sbyin mdzad thugs rje'i bdag /'jam dpal de la btud de phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgyu 'phrul rgya chen nam mkha' lta bu nas/ /dbugs dbyung drug bsdus zab pa yang dag ni/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga dge ba 'di phyogs tsam/ /bsdus la mos pa'i don du bshad par bya/ /de la 'dir rdo rje slob dpon sdom pa dang ldan zhing dbang thob pa gzhan la phan pa'i blo can zhig gis/ nyon mongs pa rags pa'i gang zag la ma smin pa smin par bya ba'am/sems can thams cad bde ba la dgod par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas thams 33—3

cad mnyes par bya ste/ gza' dang nyi ma dang skar ma bzang po la/ mkho ba'i yo byad ci 'byor pa bsogs la/ nags tshal lam/ ri bo'am/ chu klung ngam/tshang tshing la sogs pa nyams dga' ba'i gnas su gnas par byas la stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang gi sgo dag par byas nas mos pa'i slob ma ma rungs pa 'dul ba'i rgyal por gnas par bya ste/ t+t+waṃ gi mtshan ma las byung ba'i khro bo ①gshin rje gshed du skad cig gis bdag nyid gyur te/ sku mdog mthing nag ha la pa/zhal brgya ljags 'dril zhing ha ha ti hi'i gad rgyangs phyogs bcur sgrogs 3/pa/spyan mig dmar bo rdo rje'i mig can/ lag pa brgya po kun bskyod mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa/ gom pa'i stabs kyis gdug pa mnan pa/ thod pa dang sbrul dang stag lpags kyis brgyan pa/ zhing chen dang glang chen gyi ko rlon gyon pa/gshin rje gshed po bgegs thams cad kyi rgyal por bskyed la/ mig tu ma dang ka bhe bkod de/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil kyi rdo rje sngon po mig 'bras su bsams la / khro bo'i sdang mig g.yon nas bskor ④bas bgegs thams cad skrag par bya'o / /g.yas nas bskor bas rdo rje'i ⑤ra ba'o/ /'og tu bltas pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi'o/ /steng du bltas pas rdo rje'i gur du bya'o/ /de'i rjes la gnas der phyag dar dang skyong spyonul bya zhing / a ka ru nag pos kyang phyogs bcur bdugs la sa gzhi tsan+dan la sogs pa'i dris byugs te/ de'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal khru gang pa gsum bya ste/ sa de la rin po che bdar ⑦zhing 'thas par byas la—/ rdo rgyus kyis dkar por bya zhing 'o ma dang tsan+dan dang gur gum kyel sogs pa srog chags la gnod pa ma byas pa las byung ba'i dris byugs la/ yi ge swā las byung ba'i rin po che bkram pa ni/ bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhis 33—4

brgyan pa bkod la/ rang nyid dkon mchog gsum la rin po che sna bdun gyi me tog gi ①tshom bu dgod pa dang / yi dam lha'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dkyil 'khor lha thugrangs dang mnyam pa'i me tog gi tshom bu bkod la/ rang nyid yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyi snying ga nas sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba bkug la maṇ+ḍal la bcug ste/ bzhugs pa'i rten dang / mkho ba'i yon du byin gyis brlab bo/ /de'i rjes la mchod pa lnga dang / yan lag gi mchod pa g.yas dang g.yon du bkram la/ gtsang zhing dag par bshams te/ tshul bzhin du byin gyis brlabs la gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas tshogs bsags 5 pa'i yul dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor lo mdun du mngon par sprul te maṇ+ḍal phul la mchod par bya'o/ /'jam dpal rdo rje la sogs pa/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la/ /lus dang ngag yid gus ldan nas/ /kun nas btud de phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas zhing du gang bsngags dang / /'jig rten dag pa mchog gyur pa5/ /rin chen me tog bdug spos sogs/ /kun nas sprul te mchod par bgyi/ /bdag gis sngon chad byas pa'i sdig /kun nas bsags par gang gyur la/ /rang bzhin med dang yod tshul gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi spyan sngar bshags/ /'gro ba gang gis bsod nams gang / /dman pa'i dge ba thams cad la/ /de bzhin mthun pa'i lhag sems kyis/ /dad pas rjes su yi rang ngo bde gshegs byang chub mchog bskyed nas/ /'gro ba thugs rjes gdul slad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la/ /tshangs pa bzhin du gsol ba 'debs/ /yongs su mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/ /'gro kun yun du bde ba'i phyir/ /ji srid 'tsho ba de srid du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /ji srid 33—5

'khor ba gnas par du/ /bdag gi dge ba de bzhin du/ /kun nas zad par ma gyur par/ /sems can yongs su smin par shog /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung ①/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /'go la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la②/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te ④/gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang / /rdo rje slob dpon dam pa dag /yang dag nyid du gzung ④bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnams ni rab tu sbyin/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /sangs rgyas zhal nas gsungs pa la⑤ phyi nang gsang ba'i jeg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ci nus gzung ⑥/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /mchod pa'i las rnams bya ba dang / /sdom pa rgya mtsho ma lus pa/ /shin tu dam pa bdag gis gzung / /de ltar sdom pa ma lus pa / /dam pa bdag gis gzung bgyis nas/ /byang chub mchog sems bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can ma rig ldongs pa rnams/ /bdag gis yang dag dge la gzung / /sems can nyon mongs bcings pa yi/ /ma grol ba rnams 33—6

grol bar bgyi/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /sdug bsngal chen po'i nang sems can/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /'khor ba dag na gnas pa yi/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgodahu/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /'jam mgon 'bangs su bdag 'bul lags/ /thugs rjes yongs su gzung ldubar mdzod/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /bder gshegs khyed kyi bka' bzhin du/ /sems can don du bsgrub lags kyis/ /byin gyis brlab par ④mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas/ byams pa chen po dang / snying rje dang dga' ba dang /btang rngusnyoms tshad med pa bzhi rjes su dran nas/ sems bskyed cing sdom pa bzung nas/ da ni ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa stong pa nyid la blo gtad la/ de sgrub par byed pa'i tshig 'di ⑥brjod de sgra'i don la mos par bya'o/ /rnam par mi rtog dbyings mi zad/ /yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid/ /yang dag mtha' la yi ge med/ /chos dbyings dam pa zad mi shes/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā tsudz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba a kolhahaṃ/ zhes brjod pas phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med par gyur te/ye shes kyis ④sbyangs nas/ chos thams cad nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur sherang gi sems kyi snang ba shar ba las ā li dang / kā li'i phreng ba bsams la/ ā li las ni pad+ma dkar po'i steng / kā li las chos kyi 'byung gnas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ de'i tha ma 'od zer gyi phreng ba lngas bskor ba'i nang du 'od zer gyi phreng ba lnga 'phros shing 'dus pa las/ 'od ljang gu las rlung gi 33—7

dkyil 'khor rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa/ 'od dmar po las me'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma dmar pos mtshan pa/ 'od dkar po las chu'i dkyil 'khor rin po ches mtshan pa/ 'od ser po las gser kyi sa gzhi 'khor los mtshan pa/'od sngon po las ri rab rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de yang shar shel/ lho bai ḍūr+ya/nub pad+ma rā ga /byang gser rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du 'od zer gyi phreng ba lnga ka 3ril gyis 'dus pa las/ lha'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa sgo khyud rin po che'i pa tras bye snamadzes par brgyan pa/ phyi rol na mu tig gi za ra tshags dang dril bu g.yer kha grwa bzhi nas 'phyang ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi chun 'phyang kyang rta babs kyi ka ba la 'phyang ba/ rta babs kyang twa ra ṇa la sogs pas brgyan cing / ri dwags dang chos kyi 'khor lo dang / 'phan dang rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs dang rin po che 'od du 'bar ba'i tog gis mdzes par byas te/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du seng ge dang glang po che dang /rta mchog dang / rma bya dang / nam mkha' lding gi steng du pad+ma dang zla ba dang zhu /nyi ma'i gdan mdzes par bkram pa dang / 'khor rnams kyang go rims su pad+ma dang / zla ba'i gdan bkram par bsams la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi gdan thog tu rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul las ā li kā li'i phreng ba byung ba las/de'i spro bsnyu'i byin rlabs las zla ba dang nyi ma la de dang des mtshan par gyur/de'i nang du a las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po as mtshan par gyur/ de rnams spro zhing bsdus nas 'od 'bar ba las/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po zhal bzhi pa zhal dang po shar du gzigs pa/ gnyis pa lho/ gsum pa nub / bzhi pa byang ngo / /phyogs bzhi ka khyan phyag gnyis gnyis pa/ byang 33—8

chub mchog gi phyag rgya'i steng na rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa skyes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar yi ge dhīḥlas/ dang po'i sangs rgyas zhal lnga pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ g.yas bzhi na shes rab kyi ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti yod pa/ zhal bzhi phyogs dang mthun pa/ dbus dmar ser ro/ /de'i thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa la/ gsang sngags rgyal po drug gis mtshan pa/ de'i dkyil du 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' zhal drug phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri g.yon po ti 'dzin pa/ de'i steng du zla ba dang / a bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar na de ni sbyor ba dang po'i ting nge 'dzin to / /shāde nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo drug bskyed par 'dod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba 'di a las spro bar bya'o—/ /a ā i yī u spru e i o au e aḥ sbri to z-i k+ṣedi dz+nyā na mūbye ra haṃ/busgo busgye rngumāṃ/ rgya dh+wa brte māṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ṭīkyā ya te na maḥ oṃ duḥkhats+tsha da ya te na maḥ/ oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūr+ha ye ya te na maḥ/ oṃ dz+nyā na kā yā ya te na maḥ.oṃ wā thugī shwa rā ya te na maḥkhye/ oṃ a ra pa tsa nā ya te na maḥ/ oṃ sarba dhan+d+ra a bhā ba/ swa bhā jewa bi shudha/ tsagru badz+ra/ a ā saṃ aḥ pra snyekṛ ti/ pa ri shudha༄⑩/ sarba dhas+thā ya du ta/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ dz+nyā na kā ya/ mañju shrī/pa ri shurnyi tā/ mu pā dā ye ta kyi/ oṃ a āḥnyute/ sarba ta thā ga tā z-i da ya/ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ 6hrīḥbha ga wān chedz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ/ wā 8gī shwa ra/ ma hā bā getsa/sarba dharma ⑫ga ga na/ a ma la su pa ri shudhe/ dhadz+re nyusredhā tu dz+nyā na gasgo a /zhes brjod pas yi ge'i phreng ba de rnams 'od zer dang bcas nas dkyil 'khor 33—9

gyi sgo bzhi nas phar 'phros pas/ rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i zhing khams su sangs rgyas mchod nas/ slar 'od zer du 'dus te dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas metshur 'dus pa las/ gdan rnams kyi steng du yi ge a 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa de gnas pa las/ de rnams las byung ba'i sangs rgyas 'di lta ste/ shar phyogs kyi gling gi nyi ma la 2sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sa gnon gyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /mdun du rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bstod pa/ g.yon dril bu dku la gtad pa'o/ /g.yas ngos su rdo rje rgyal po mdog ser po tho ba thogs pa'o/ /rgyab tu rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' 'gengs pa'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje legs pa ljang gu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ se gol gyis legs pa choster ba'o/ /lho phyogs kyi gling gi nyi ma la/ sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ mchog bye sbyin rin po che bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o / /mdun du rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas rin po che rdo rje dpral bar bstod pa g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa'o/ /g.yas su rdo rje nyi ma sngon po nyi ma 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyab tu rdo rje dbang po dmar po rgyal mtshan bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po so shing gi phreng ba thogs pa'o/ /nub phyogs kyi gling gi nyi ma la sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa / mnyam gzhag gi thog na pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /mdun du rdo rje chos dmar po pad+ma'i sdong bu snying gar kha bye ⑥ ba 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas su rdo rje rnon po sngon po ral gri thogs pa'o/ /rgyab tu rdo rje rgyu ser po 'khor lo can no/ /g.yon du rdo rje smra ba sngon po lce thogs pa'o/ /33—10

byang phyogs kyi gling gi nyi ma la sangs rgyas don yod grub pa ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa skyabs sbyin mdzad cing rgya gram can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /mdun du rdo rje las ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu thogs pa'o/ /g.yas su rdo rje srung ba ser po rdo rje'i skyekhrab thogs pa'o/ /rgyab tu rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po mche ba thogs pa'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje khu tshur ser po rdo rje thogs pa'o/ /de nas gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams bzhi nas rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rin chen sems dpa' dang / pad+ma sems dpa' dang / las kyi sems dpa' dang /rigs bzhi'i sems dpa' bsgom mothu / /de'i phyi rol mtshams bzhi na sgeg mo dkar mo rdo rje nyi ma 'dzin pa dang / phreng ba ma ser mo rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dang / glu ma sngon mo pi bang 'dzin pa dang / gar ma ljang gu rdo rje rtse gsum 'dzin pa dang / de rnams shar lho nas brtsams te bsgom mo/ /gru chad bzhi la spos me ma dkar mo spos phor thogs pa dang / me tog rdumathing ga me tog 'dzin pa dang / mar me ma dmar mo mar me thogs pa dang / dri chab ma ljang gu dri'i lde gu thogs pa dang / de rnams kyang shar lho mtshams nas rim bzhin no/ /de'i phyi rol gyi khyams rnams su byams pa dang / mthong ba don yod dang / ngan song kun 'dren dang / mya ngan kun 'joms rnams mdog dkar po rdo rje thogs pa rnams ni shar du'o/ /spos kyi blo gros dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' mdzod dang / ye shes tog 5dang / de rnams tremadog ser po rin po che'i snye ma thogs pa rnams ni lho ru'o/ /'od dpag med dang zla ba'i 'od dang / bzang skyong dang / dra ba can gyi 'od rnams thumadog dmar po pad+ma'i sdong bu thogs pa rnams ni nub tu'o/ /rdo rje 33—11

snying po dang blo gros mi zad pa dang / spobs pa brtsegs pa dang / kun du bzang po rnams ①mdog ljang gu rgya gram thogs pa rnams ni ②byang du'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rgyan ④thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /shar gyi sgor ni rdo rje lcags kyu sngon po lcags kyu thogs pa'o/ /lho'i sgor ni rdo rje zhags pa ser po zhags pa thogs pa'o/ /nub kyi sgor ni rdo rje ④lcags sgrog dmar po lcags sgog thogs pa'o/ /byang gi sgor ni ⑤rdo rje 'be+ebs pa ljang nag dril bu thogs pa'o/ /sgo ba de rnams kyang cung zad khro ba/ zhal mche ba lhag ge ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor drug pa 6kun du bsgoms pa la mchod pa'i lha mo dang bskal bzang cha mthun pa'i 'khor la dbus kyi rnam snang chen po'i dkyil 'khor la rnam snang dang byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje zhes pa gnas pa'i tshul lo/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bskyed la ye shes kyi dkyil me'akhor gyi lha tshogs bar snang la bsdus pa spyan drang bar bya ④ste/oṃ a āḥshesarba ta thā ga tā z-i ⑩da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ tweḥ/ bha ga wān dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ 11bā gī shwa ra/ ma hā pā ⑩tsa sarba dhadz+re ⑫ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shudha/ dhan+d+ra khye ñjatu dz+nyā na gar+bha che.āḥ/ maṇ+ḍa la/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing / sngags mjug badz+ra dṛ ⑩sh+ya zhes bya bas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor legs par blta bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la phyag btsal te/ sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad kyis mchod de/ yid kyis sgo phye la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes brjod cing sgo bzhi nas tshur spyan drangs ⑫la bgegs bskrad cing ⑪/yid kyis sgo bcad la/rdo rje'i go chas bsrung nyu9la lha so so la bstems te du )dbang bskur ba thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rigs kyi yum bzhi kyenam mkha' la bsdu bar bya'o/ /ye shes kyi 33—12

bdud rtsis dbang bskur te dbang rtags spyi bor mtshan pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab pa ni shar du brtan skyepar bsgoms la bdag nyid lus gnyis kyi tshul du bzung (miste/ lha snam la gnas te rdzas ne+emachod pa lnga phul la sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad kyis mchod de/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa 4 na—/ /rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /rdo rje chos kyi glu blangs pa/ /rdo rje las kun mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra ha zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags dang gar dang glu dang bcas pas dbul lo/ /byang chub yan lag me tog spos/ /mar me snang ba byug pa dri/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la dbul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe dhu(1/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pu/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke ā ཿoṃ badz+ra gadhe gan zhes pas mchod do/ /gzhan yang gsang ba'i yum bzhis mchod de/ mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar byed/ /mchod pa chen po zhe sdang che/ /nyon mongs kun gyi dgra che ba/ /mchod pa chen po khro ba che/ /khro ba chen po dgra che ba/ /mchod pa chen po chags pa che/ /chags pa thams cad sel bar byed/ /'dod pa chen po bde ba che/ /dga' ba chen bo mgu ba che/ /satwa badz+ra hūṃ/ raṇ+ḍa 3 badz+ra hūṃ/ dhan+d+ra 5badz+ra t+t+waṃ/ karma badz+ra hūṃ(/ zhes mchod la bstod de/mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /ces pa nas/ ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud / /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod pa'i rgyal po des bstod la/ shes rab kyi 'khor lo la sems gtad pa'i yid kyis gsang sngags rgyal po 'di drug bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tīkyā duḥkhats+tsha da pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta tsoye/ dz+nyā na kā ya/ wā gī shwa ra a ra pa tsa nā ya te na maḥ/ zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /de ltar lha bskyed 33—13

cing gsol ba btab la gnas pa de dkyil 'khor rgyal ba mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to / /⑫da ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa gdon par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bstod la 'gro ba'i don du phrin las la sbyar te/ dkyil 'khor chen po drug 'jig rten du spro ste phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs bskyed rju nas nyon mongs pa drug sbyangs 'gro ba drug dbugs phyung dkyil 'khor drug gis 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas slar snga ma nyid la bsdu zhing spros nas 'go ba'i don bya'o/ /de tsam gyis ni las rgyal po mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de lta bu'i cho ga rdzogs nas mchod cing bstod de lhag pa dang ma tshang ba bshags nas dam tshig gi 'khor lo bsdu zhing chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rgyas gdab cing bde ba'i spyod pa bya'o/ /de lta bu'i sbyor bas mtshan ma brtan po byung ba de srid kyi bar du bya ste/ de yang sems rtse gcig tu bsgom zhing zlos pa de la ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'dus te gshegs nas chos kyi sgo thams cad ston par mdzad de sku yang ston to zhes gsungs pas( / zhal mthong ba'am rmi lam du lung bstan pa la sogs pa ma byung gi bar du bde bar gshegs pa rnams bsnyen pa ni bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gnang ba thob nas gzhan gyi don du dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ ri dang chu klung dang nags tshal la sogs pa'i gnas su slob dpon la slob mas dkyil 'khor 33—14

'dri ba'i don du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bya ba'i go skabs phye ste/ dang po sa'i cho gar yang de bzhin du mnyam pa yin na dbus mtho ༄ —byang shar gzhol te dma' ba/ sa gzhi 'jam pa nyams dga' ba'i gnas su ngam grog dang bya skyibs dang / bong ba ④la sogs pa med pa 'jam zhing lhun stug pa der dkyil 'khor brtsig pa'am bri ba'i don du sa'i bdag po la gnang ba thob par byas la/ sa'i lha mo la gtor ma phul la/ dngos grub rab 'bring thob pas brkos nas ltas brtags ④la mi shis pa yin na bar chad byung ④bas dor bar bya'o/ /shis pa yin na de'i phyogs thams cad byi dor bya ste spos chus chag chag btab la shin tu ba lang gi lci bas byugs la 'thas par bcags te mnyam par ⑤me long gi ngos ltar byas la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas sa la gtugs te/oṃ badz+ra me di nī rjobadz+rī bha ba ma hā badz+ra hūṃ/ zhes pas rdo rje'i sa gzhir byin kyis brlab po/ /de'i phyogs kun kyang a ga ⑨ru nag po 3gtul zhing du bas bdug go—/ /de ltar na lhag par gnas pa'i yan lag sa'i cho ga bstan to/ /de nas dkyil 'khor brtsigs la/ bsrung rnguba'i 'khor lo sngon du 'gro bas tshogs bsags la/ ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par bsgoms te rngo/ mchod pa rgyas par phul nas bzlas pa bya ste/ mchod pa'am bstod pa'i rgyal pos bstod ⑪ la/ de nas mdun du maṇ+ḍal bya ste/ me tog bkram nas sa'i lha mo la mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa bshams te gtor ma yang bshams ⑩dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan te/ 'di skad bsgo'o/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi—/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi⑫/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha 33—15

mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /ji ltar shākya seng ge yis/ /bdud kyi sde rnams bcom pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par byas te dkyil 'khor 'dri①/ /zhes brjod de/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma phul la ye shes pa gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas sgrub pa'i grogs pos bstod pa'i rgyal bos bstod la/ slob dpon kyis phur bu bcu gshin rje gshed du bskyed la/ dar gyi cod pan gyis ⑤dbang bsgur la oṃ badz+ra kri li kri la ④hūṃ phaṭa ces gzi brjid bskyed la gzhag ④go/ /de'i rjes la dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams rang gi snying gar bcug la langs te/ rdo rje gsor shing phyedril bu dkrol la 'di skad ces bsgo'o/ /hūṃ ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha byad za byed rngam pa'i stabs/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba yis/ /khams ④gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /khro bo'i rgyal po brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi ④sdang mig gis/ /bgegs kun sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings las thugs rje chen por sprul/ /skye med ngang las 'jigs byed chen po'i skur kyebastan te/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir thugs dam mi 'gyur zhing / /khro rgyal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod//hūṃ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /gnas 'dir bde gshegs dkyil 'khor pho brang brikye / /bgegs kyi rigs tshogs gang yin byer bar gyis/ /gal te nga yis bsgo ba las 'das nas/ /ye shes can kyi rdo rje rab 'bar bas/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing / /rnam par 'jig par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /he 33—16

sa phyogs bgegs gnas che ge mo 'di ru/ bdag rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya bas/ slob ma che ge mo zhes bya ba ①rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / sems can thams cad bde ba la dgod ④par bya ba'i phyir nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i rigs thams cad bsdus pa zhig bdag gis bri ④bas/ dus de ring bgegs kyi tshogs su gyur pa lha'i gdon dang klu'i gdon dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon dang / gnod sbyin dang / nam mkha' lding rgan po dang rgan mo la sogs pa thams cad dengs shig /byer shig song shig④ /gang mi 'gro ba de ni rdo rje ye shes rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ rdo rje hūṃ ste hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes pa dang /byāḥbyephyeḥ—/ bi kṛ ⑥tā na na sarba bispyo uts+tsha ṭā ⑦ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bgegs bskrad do//spyan mig bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis kyang bsreg par bya'o/ /khro bo'i stangs ⑧stabs gom ④pa'i stabs kyis gar byed pas kyang bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ /de bzhin du 7rdo rje 'gros kyis ⑩dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' ⑫ma lan gsum bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i sa gzhi 3dang / ra ba dang gur dang /dra ba rnams byas la phur bus btab la gzhag ④go/ /de nas tsan+dan dang ba'i rnam lngas dkyil 'khor byugs la/ lha rnams kyi rten dri'i thig le dang / me tog gi tshom bu rnams bkod la/ rnam snang gi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i snying ga nas dkyil 'khor bton la mdun du dgod par bya'o/ /de rnams la ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la mchod pa dang / sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad kyis mchod la gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i 33—17

phyir lha mo bzhis bsdus la dbang bskur te/ rgyas btab la mchod pa byas te/bsgom bzlas brtsam mo/ /de ltar rdzogs pa dang mchod pa dang bstod pa rgyas par byas la/ snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das//rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can dag 'di zhes pas/ /nang par dkyil 'khor bzang po'i mtshan/ /'di zhes bya ba bri dhi lags na/ /rjes su brtse bas thu nyer dgongs nas/ /kun gyis gabyin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lha lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas bum pa bzang po nag nog med pa'i tshul dang mthun pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ yang na bum pa bdun gu gul gyis thu bdug cing / bgegs bskrad cing bsangs te/ dri'i thig le dang mtshan ma bkod la/ rin po che lnga dang / sman lnga dang / 'bru lnga dang / snying po lnga dang / spos lnga dang /ba dmar ser gyi 'o ma dang / srog chags med pa'i chus bkang la/ ras kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul bcings te/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan la bzhag ste/ nang du lha thams cad bskyed pa dang / las thams cad par gshin rje gshed po bskyed cing ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ mchod cing dbang bskur la phreng sngags dang / gsang sngags rgyal po drug bzlas la gzhag ⑤go / /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas sgrub pa po'i g.yas ngos su gzhung dang mthun pa'i thab khung byas la/33—18

las dang mthun pa'i shing dang rdzas bsags te/ me lha sngon du mchod la de'i snying gar dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams spyan drangs mchod rdzas phul la thun mong du mchod nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams sngar gyi gnas su gshegs te/ brtan par byas la/ sngar me lha la rdzas lhag mas mchod larmye / 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab nas me lha gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas ci 'byor pa'i gtor mas chos skyong rnams la tshim par byas la/ 'dod pa'i don la phrin las bcol la slar gnas su btang rngungo / /gtor ma dang sbyin sreg lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas snod du rung ba'i slob mas maṇ+ḍal byas la/ me tog bkram nas me tog gis snyim pa bkang nas/ slob dpon la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de ni sprul du gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsolarngu/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol5 / /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes brjod do/ /slob dpon gyis de la 'di skad ces bsgo ste/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad phyedang / /de bzhin gang du ma byon dang / /da ltar bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs rnamasaskye༄/ /de dag kun gyis ⑦gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med nyid/ /gsang sngags spyod pa bla med de/ /skyob pa rnam 33—19

par snang mdzad kyis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ / bu yis 7 blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod do/ /de nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa kun bya ba dang / sems bskyed cing sdom pa srung 3du bcug la/ yi dam gang 'dod lhar bskyed la byin gyis brlabs te ke mchod pa lngas mchod la/ so shing dor ba dang / srung skud bcing ba dang / byams pa'i go cha bskon la/dbu'i gtsug tor bskyed de/ rmi lam brtag pa'i phyir ku sha byin la/ zab cing rgya che ba'i chos bshad la/ slob dpon gyi 3las rnams rdzogs par bya'o/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsdus te/ go bskon la bye bsrungs te ci bder gnas par bya'o/ /de nas nang par nyi ma 'char khar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor byed par 'dod pas/ ba'i rnam lngas dkyil 'khor byugs te/ tsan+dan gyi lde gu dri dang ldan par byas la/ thig skud sar pa nyis 'gyur tshad sgo'i nyi shu cha kha dog lnga pa rin po che'i snod du bcug la/ byin gyis brlabs byel mchod la/ sna slob ma'i lag tu gtad la bsgril nas/ 'jig rten khams 'di ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas la sogs 'gro mgon gyi/ /khyed kyi dus ni 'di lags kyis/ /bcom ldan rdo rje'i thig gdab gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ bdag dang slob ma g.yas nas bskor 5bas thig gdab par bya'o/ /tshangs thig dang po shar nas nub tu gdab/gnyis pa byang nas lho ru gdab/ slob dpon me lhar gnas slob ma dbang ldan du gnas te/ shar gyi thig dang de bzhin du logs 1gsum du gdab/ de 33—20

rjes tshangs thig dang / zur thig dang thig chen dang / thig phran gyi bye brag ༅sna man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi gling ngam lngar thig gdab po/ /de yang steng du ye shes kyi thig dang / 'og tu dam tshig gi thig ste/ sa thig rlan kyis sbangs la tshul ji lta ba bzhin du mkhas pas dpyad la gdab par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la gser las byas pa'i rin po che lnga'i phye ma ji ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod pa phul la bstems rngute/ tshon dgye ba ni dkar bo chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ sngon po me long lta bu'i ye shes nyid/ /ser po so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la/ /dmar po mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes nyid/ /ljang gu bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor 'grub/ /ces brjod la/ sngon la slob dpon gyis byang shar mtshams kyi rtsig pa brtsigs la/phyi nas slob mas bskor —phyogs ma log pa'i ci bde bar tshon dgye bar bya'o/ /de la dang po gtso bo'i gnas rnams ni/ nyi ma'i 'od la zla bas brgyan pa'o/ /gzhan dag ni phyogs kyi kha dog go/ /'dod yon pad+ma rā ④ga'i sa gzhi/ rin chen pha gu gser las byas pah+ye/ rin po che'i phreng ba bkye kyeb la/ dra ba dra phyed nam mkha'i mdog can mu tig gi ha ra 'phyang ba/ de'i phyi rol du nam mkha'i mdog la ka ba dang rta babs dang ri dwags dang / chos kyi 'khor lo dang /gdugs dang / rgyan rnams ci mdzes par bri bar bya'o/ /de dag gi rgyab tu rdo rje dang / me 'od kyi phreng ba bri bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor lnga'i bar bar ni/gser gyi sa gzhi la rin po che gcal du bkram par bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol gru bzhir byas la grwa bzhi la dpag bsam gyi shing dang / bum pa bzang po mdzes pa bri bar bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor legs par bris zin nas/ lhag pa dang 33—21

chad pa bskang ba'i phyir dril bu dkrol zhing yi ge brgya pa bzlas la/ tha ma lan gsum bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas dpal dang 'byor ba phun sum tshogs par byas la mchod pa'i bye brag me tog gi snod dang / spos phor dang dri'i snod dang mar me'i phreng ba dang /zhal zas kyi snod stong ngam brgya'am bcu la sogs pa ci 'byor ba dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa ci 'byor ba bsags nas/slob dbon dkyil 'khor gyi shar du stan bde ba la gnas te/ cod pan la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad bsags kyete/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i phreng ba'i sngags kyis lhag par gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor snying ga nas sprul nas/ rdul tshon kyi dkyil 'khor dang bsres nas tshogs bsags pa sngon du 'gro bas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i skabs su phur pa dang / mda' dang ral gri la sogs pa'i ra bas bskor te/ sngon du gsungs pa'i tshal ①du rgyas par bsgoms nas mchod de/ bum pa yang bkod la dbang bskur zhing rgyas ④btab la / rdzas kyi mchod pa lnga dang / phyi nang gi mchod pa lnga dang / gsang ba'i yum bzhis kyang legs par mchod la/ gzhan yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rol mo'i bye brag thams cad kyang dbul bar bya ste/ dbugs 'byin chen po dga' ston che/ /dga' chen rol mo chen po ste/ /bkur ste rim gro phun sum tshogs/ /mchog tu dga' ba grags pa'i dpal/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la dbul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i phreng sngags dang /o dang hūṃ bzlas pa'am/ lha re re zhing re re dbul bar bya'o/ /bsam gtan chen po'i ting 4'dzin gnas/ /shes rab chen po'i lus 'chang ba/ /stobs 33—22

po che la thabs che ba/ /smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho 'di/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la dbul/ /bdug pa'i snod du ma dang / me tog gi snod du ma dang //byug pa'i snod du ma dang / mar me'i phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas so so'i sngags dang / gar dang bcas pas dbul lo/ /yid bzhin nor bu chen po dang / /khyab bdag rin chen kun gyi bdag /dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa dang / /bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la dbul / /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ dang hūṃ bzlas te/ so so'i ming spel te/ oṃ rat+na ye hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas rin po che dang nor bu'i bye brag mang po dang / dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs pa mang po dang /bum pa bzang po 'bras bu can gyi shing gis brgyan rmyepa la sogs pa rin po che'i bye brag thams cad kyang lha re re zhing dbul lo/ /sman rnams ma lus ljon pa'i shing //nad do cog gi dgra che ba/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs pa yi/ /zug rngu 'byin pa bla na med/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la dbul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ hūṃ zhes zlos shing 'bras bu gsum dang / tsan+dan dang / gur gum ldu dang / ga pur dang / dzā ti la sogs pa srog chags las ma byung ba'i sman ji snyed yod pa de rnams lha re re zhing so so'i ming dang spel la dbul bar bya'o/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar zhuthug pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan btsugs pa dang / /khyab bdag chen po rin chen gdugs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid 'di/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la dbulashe/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /zhes brjod cing / rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang / 'phan dang gdugs la sogs pa ras sam 'phan gyi lda ldi bsam 33—23

gyis mi khyab pa lhalha re re zhing dbul lo/ /lag pa brgya po kun bskyod cing / /gom pa'i stabs kyis gar byed pa/ /dpal ldan lag pa brgyas gang la/ /nam mkha' khyab par gar byed pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la dbul1// /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /zhes brjod cing gar kyi rnam pa glog ltar bsgyur cing gzugs brgya stong du ma snyed du sprul la/ gar byed cing dkyil 'khor la dbul lo/ /de'i rjes la sbyin sreg gi cho gas mchod cing / mchod pas kyang lha tshogs mnyes par bya bar gsungs so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor la gnang ba thob pa'i slob dpon gyis slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug par bya ste/ sngar sdom pa blangs pa'i slob ma des slob dpon la gsol ba btab nas/ de nas slob ma de la bgegs bskrad nas/ a ga 3ru nag pos bdug cel/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes pa'i don bzlas pa'i stod g.yogs dang / oṃ badz+ra lak+ṣa hūṃ zhes bzlas pas gdong pa bkab la/ sgo bzhi'i phyogs nas rigs lnga la phyag 'tshal du gzhug go/ /de'i rjes la lag na me tog thogs pa'i slob mas phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas rgyun bshags bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon la gsol ba 'di skad gdab par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sgu/ /slob dpon la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i grong khyer mchog /'jam dpal dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /slob dpon bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces bya'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pas/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin pa ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 33—24

'dod dam/ /des kyang 'tshal lo zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de la slob dpon gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa rig pa'i dbang lnga'i rten du rung bar bya ba'i phyir phog la/gzhan yang mi dge ba bcu dang / nye ba'i las kyang spang ba'i sdom pa sbyin no/ /des kyang slob dpon gyis sdom pa gsungs pa ltar/ kho bo yang bsrung zhing sdom par bkyid do zhes khas blangs ladzo// de dang mthun par sngar gsungs pa ltar khas blang bar bya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i gsol ba slob mas gdab pa ni/rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya bas ni/ /slob dbon dpang du gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba/ /mi ldog 'u'akhor lo sbyin par ldan/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs nas kyang / /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur te/ /skal ba chen po bdag la sprularter/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis rgyas gdab cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sgu ni yid 'ong ba/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol④/ /zhes gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /slob dpon gyis kyang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ che ge zhes bya 'di nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing / /dam tshig sdom dang gsang ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir yang 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas lha la gnang ba thob pa dang / snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ sarba yo ga bo byebye tsit+ta ut+pā 'ud yā mi/ su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ 7badz+ra sid+dhi ya thā su khaṃ zhes snying gar zla ba rdo rje bsams la/ lag pa nas khrid de/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya bas sgo rebazhi nas gzhug go / /kyede nas shar gyi sgor phyogs par bzhag la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces brjod 33—25

par bya'o/ /deng khrod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ngas khyod la ye shes gang yin gyi dzobhede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du yang 'grub pa thob na bludangos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos rngo de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig /dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re zhes brjod de/ de nas slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khrod kyi/ /snying la yang dag gzhug par mdzad/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs / /oṃ badzo da ka ṭha hūṃ/ 'di de khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub rgo/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis rgya'agrub/ /oṃ a mṛ ta hūṃ badz+ra a gat+ta hri tha hūṃ/ de nas slob dpon gyis dam tshig bsgrags te/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi rdo rje slob dpon nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo 6ba gang yin pa de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /mi bde ba ma spangs par khyod dus byas nas dmyal bar gyur ta re/ de nas ye shes sems dpa' dbab par bya ste/'di skad brjod du gzhug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bdag la dbab hūṃpar gyur cig ces smros shig pa'o/ /rdo rje dris bsgos 7pa snying gar bzhag la/ 'di de rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /'jam dpal rdo rje yin par grags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med ni/ /deng 'dir khyod la 'bab par shog /oṃ mañju shrī badz+ra ā be sha ya a a a a zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod do/ /rdo rje dmar po mtshon gang pa char ltar du 'be+ebs par bsam mo/ /gal te 'bab par ma gyur na sdig pa byang ba'i cho 33—26

gas ①dbab par bya'o/ /de nas bab ④pa dang yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas me tog gi ①phreng ba dor te/ pra ṭīts+tsha badz+ra ho zhes pas dkyil 'khor la gtor la gang du babs pa'i lha de yi dam du dbog go/ /oṃ pra ti kṛṇ+ḍi two i oṃ satwa ma hā ba le stizhes bya bas phreng ba de mgo la bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol te mig lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas dbye zhing sngags 'di brjod do//oṃ 'jam dpal rdo rje deng khyod kyisakhye7/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad//mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /de ring nyid du 'byed par shog /he badz+ra pa sh+ya hūṃ zhes brjod la/ mig g.yogs kyang dgrol ⑥te 'di skad brjod do/ /legs par ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /me tog gang la phog pa ni/ /'di de khyod kyi rigs kyi lha/ /rang gi lha ru shes par gyis/ /zhes brjod la rdo rje lcags kyu nas brtsams te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i bar du dkyil 'khor drug bstan par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar ngos su maṇ+ḍal la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris la/yi dam lha'i gzugs su bsams la dbang bskur bar bya ste/ de yang dang por re zhig chu'i dbang bskur bar bya ste/ ji ltar bltams ñjupa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis lha yi chu/ /dag pa yis ni sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga zuta badz+ra a bye ⑪ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ⑫ye hūṃ—/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms nas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kolhahaṃ kye/ rnam shes phung po rnam dag 33—27

pa'i / /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi/ /zhe sdang chen po mi bskyod pa'ikye7/ /dpal ldan chu yis (5dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga zuta badz+ra a bye ṣiñca hūṃ/de nas cod pan gyi dbang bskur te/ phal ba'i sa ni gzhom pa dang / /yon tan gzi brjid bskyed pa'i phyir/ /nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan gyikhyo / /cod pan gyis sre ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta byumu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/zhes brjod pa dang / dpal ldan rin chen cod pan dbang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms nas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje rin chen mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na swa bhā ba āt+ma kophohaṃkhye / tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi/ /nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan gyi/ /cod pan gyis zhe ni dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rdo rje'i dbang bskur te/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya—/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ⑪rab grub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis bye long / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a bhe ṣilnga nyubyemi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ chos kyi gsung rab dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms nas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung du mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bāka 7badz+ra swa bhā rmyeb āt+ma kophohaṃ(mu/ 'du shes phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi7/ /'dod chags snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /rdo rje yis ⑫ni dbang bskur ro/ /de nas dril bu'i dbang bsgur te/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchog tu bshad/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bye ba ti s+t+waṃ a bye ṣispya 7mi tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje dril bu 'chang / /33—28

rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms nas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje las su mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha badz+ra swa bhā tshob yi kolhahaṃrngo / 'du byed phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes/ kyi/ /phrag dog don yod grub pa yi/ /dril bu yis geni dbang bskur ro/ /de nas ming gi dbang bskur te/ /srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po bsal ba'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /rnam par snang mdzad rtag tu bskyed/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi.ā+oṃ 54mi che ge mo nā ma a rnyi ṣe ka ta hūṃ/dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms nas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /rdo rje sku ni mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kolhahaṃ⑤/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyiphyo/ /gti mug rnam par snang mdzad kyi/ /dpal ldan mi bskyod dbang bskur ro/ /de dang ldan na de lnga ni rig pa'i dbang lnga ste/phung po lnga dag nas nyon mongs pa lnga spangs nas/ ye shes lnga dang ldan te/ma rig pa rig pas na rig pa'i dbang lnga zhes bya'o/ /de nas brtul zhugs spukyi dbang zhes bya ba ni/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i lag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /'jam dpal rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mañju shrī tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha a nyi ṣe ka ta ya mi hūṃ ha ha ha nyi hi hi/ de nas phreng ba sbyin te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ③mi phyed pa'i/ /gsang sngags bla na med pa yi/ /snying po yid bzhin nor bu 'di / /skyob nyu pa sngags kyis ( byedabang bsgur ro/ /de nas phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bsgur bar bya ba'i phyir/ yon bdag gis yon gyi mchog phul la gsol 33—29

ba btab la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod stsol bgyis pa ltar—/ /bdag kyang bsrung ba'i don kyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la stsol / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /'go ba bskyab pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsol/ /slob dpon chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba rgo bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir—/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol—/ /de ltar gsol ba btab rjes la sdom pa sbyin te/ ji bzhin don ldan dam tshig ni/ /rtsa ba yan lag bcas pa kun/ /phas pham par ni rab tu grags—/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i thong bar shes par bya/ /srog gcod rku dang 'phrog pa dang / /brdzun ①dang chang ni cung zad spang / /mi dge ba ni bcu po dag /khrod kyis ④nam yang ma spyod cig /theg pa dman la mos pa dang / /sems can 'khor ba mi spang zhing / /mya ngan 'das la ma chags a+yoshing / /lha dang lha min brnyas ④mi bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya rnams/ /'gom par bya ba ma yin te/ /dam tshig 'di dag nyams pa na/ /rdo rje dmyal bar 'tshed par 'gyur④/ /de bas dam tshig bsrung bar gyis/ /des kyang slob dpon gyi bka' bzhin bgyid par 'tshal lo zhes khas blangs so⑥/ /de nas slob ma dam pa de'i lus la lha bkod la/ rnam rgyal bum pa thogs te/khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung / /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ya/ pa ra ti ga a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ de nas gser la sogs pa las byas pa'i mig thur thogs la/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal 33—30

po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ne+e tra a pa ha ra ba ṭa lo tri zhes nyon mongs pa spong ba'i dbang ngo / /de nas me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /ngo bo med cing ①gnas med par/ /de ltar chos 'di shes nas su/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ /ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /de nas mda' gzhu blangs la mi'i drung du 'phen ②bcug la/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med de/ / bskal pa'i ④cho 'phrul cir yang ston/ /bdud kyi rigs rnams pham byed pa'i/ /ye shes kyi ni mda' 'phongs shig /ho zhes mda' 'jig rten gyi khams drug tu 'phen du gzhug go/ /sku'i dbang ngo / /de nas dril bu blangs la dkrol te/ chos rnams nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /mkha' dang mnyam par sbyor ba yis sku mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal④/ /āḥ/ zhes gsung gi dbang ngo / /me long blangs la/ 'jam dbyangs rdo rje me long bzhin/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa byemed/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin ni/ /bu khyod kyi ⑥ni snying la zhugs/ /mañju shrī tsit+ta a/ thugs kyi dbang ngo / /de nas rkang pa'i bar du chos kyi 'khor lo gzhag) /lag par dung dang lce la po ti shegatad/ /mgo la gdugs gtad de/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskoraspu/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pas/ /kun du ma lus gang bar 33—31

gyis / /som nyi yid gnyis mi bya zhing / /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul gyi mchog /'jig rten 'di la rab tu sgogs/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang / /kun du khyod la srung bar byed/ /ces brjod do/ /yang / 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas thams cad gzengs bstod de/ /kun bdag sangs rgyas sgom sna/pa po/ /rdo rje'i ming dbang bskur bas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs par lung bstan nyid/ /oṃ 'di de ngas khyod lung bstan yin/ /'jam dpal rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa kun du bsgrub phyepa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye de bzhin gshegs pa che ge mo zhes bya ba/ sidhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur bhu ba swaḥ/ de nas gnang ba sbyin pa/ ngo bo nyid kyis sems can rnams / /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de lta de ltar chags la sogs/ /gtsang mas sems can don bya'o/ /de nas dbugs dbyung ba/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor bye'adir/ /de ring phan chad khyed zhugs kyis/ /sdig pa kun las nges gro' bar/ /khyed rnams deng rnguni legs par gnas/ /bde chen thob pa 'di las ni/ /slar khyod 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi smod pa/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar kyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i snyug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /khyed rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /de nyid the tshom med par 'thob/ /de nas bdag nyid thar bsams la/ /chos gos bzung ste/ oṃ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan thupar/ /33—32

mgrin gcig tu ni rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /byang chub tu ni lung bstan mdzad/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pas/ /kun gyis deng khyod dbang bsgur bas/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal po che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag po ston pa yin/ /deng ni bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ /khyed rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /deng nyid the tshom med par 'thob/ /de ltar gzengs bstod pa dang / dbugs dbyung ba dang / lung bstan pa'o/ /de nas slob ma de la mchod pa lnga dang / sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad kyis yang dag par mchod de/khyed rnams kyis kyang dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa rnams yang dag par mchod cig par bka' bsgo'o/ /de nas de rnams kyis yo byad kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha mchod la/ lhag mas der tshogs tshim par byas la dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bstod de / sgeg mo la sogs pas mchod la bstod do/ /de nas slob dpon la yon kyis mnyes par byas la/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab po/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ste/ dkyil 'khor la bskor 1ba byas la lha gshegs su gsol te/dam tshig bsdus la ci bde ba'i spyod lam bya'o/ /slob ma rnams kyi donagyi phyir/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga byas pa la/ /dge ba bsags pa gang gyur pa/ /thams cad sdogs pa'i byang chub thobage/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal kyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga nam mkha' dri ma med pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po su badz+ra ba —dang / bod kyi lo tsā 4ba chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //33—33

༄7/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal jes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs —1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma sā dha natso/ bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam dpal zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'jam pa'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad mkhyen cing thugs su chud/ /smra ba'i skyes ༄ mchog smra ba'i rgyal/ /smra ba'i seng ge tshugs pa med/ /rnam kun mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyod dang ldan pa shes pa po/ / /'jam pa'i mgon la dga' ba dang / /de yi don du sgrub khyepa'i thabs/ /mdo ru bsdus te bshad par bya/ /rnam par smin pa'i lus dag la/ /lha yi nga rgyal dran byas te/ /mdun du 'jam mgon bsams nas su/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa dang / /bshags dang rjes su yi rang ba/ /bsngo dang skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /sems bskyed de ni yid kyis bya/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥzhwasarba dhas+thāḥ7swa bhā ba shusgolhahaṃ8 /brjod pas chos kun dmigs med par/ /stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya/ /33—37

sems nyid a ru gyur nas su/ /zla dkyil dhīḥru bsgom par bya/ /de las 'phro 'dus mtshan mar gyur/ /mtshan hūṃm 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i sku/ /sgu gser me tog zur phud can/ /shes rab ral gri po tis mtshan/ /zhi ba'i tshul 'chang gzhon nu bsgom/ /lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcings nas su/ /e bye nyi mañju shrī ku mā ra/ ā kasgo ā be+e sha ya a a/ spyan drang zhemadun du bsam par bya/ /de nas mchod pa dbul byas te/ /mañju shrī gan+dhe pū dza swā hā/ oṃ mañju shrī puṣ+pe pū dza swā hā/ oṃ mañju shrī dhū pe pū dza swā hā/ oṃ mañju shrī ā lo ke pū dza byeswā hā/ oṃ mañju shrī be+e bi bye 4pū dza moswā hā/ oṃ mañju shrī gasgo swā hā/ de nas bstod pa'i tshig 'di brjod/ /shes rab chen po gyeskad cig gis/ /chos kun khong du chud par mkhyen/ /mi shes g.yul ngo thams cad sel/ /sems can kun la byams thugs ldan/ /'jam mgon byams thugs ldan la 'dud/ /mi shes g.yul sel ral gri dang / /shes rab po ti thugs rtags can/ /chos rnams thams cad ston pa po/ /skye mched dbyings ston zug rngu spangs/ /'jam mgon chos sgu nyid la bstod/ /yang na 'dod yon lnga sogs kyis/ /mngon par mchod nas bstod pa bya/ /yang na mtshan nyid bstod par bya/ /yon tan mtshan gyis thubastod ce'o/ /de nas lus las 8bsdus byas nas/ bzlas pa dag ni bya bar bshad / /gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka ru/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' bsamasarngu/ /de yi snying du ting 'dzin sems/ /nyi ma'i maṇ+ḍal steng du ni / /ral gri dhīḥyis mtshan par bsam/ de la bzlas pa'i sngags kyis bskor/ /oṃ badz+ra ṭīkyā duḥkhats+tsha da/ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na sprut+t+waṃ ⑫ye/ dz+nyā na kā ya wā gī shwa ra a ra pa tsa nā ya te na maḥswā hā/ mi skyo'i shā1sems kyis bzlas par tshubya/ /skyo ba dag ni 33—38

byung ba na/ /'dzin pa med pa bsgom 1 par bya/ /thun bzhi dag tu nyams su blang / /yang 2na nyid mtshan re re'o/ /tha mar gshegs su gsol ba bya/ /rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gnas/ /'jam mgon sgrub — thabs legs sbyar bas/ /bdag gis dge ba gang bsags pa/ /des ni khams gsum sems can kun/ /'jam mgon go 'phang thob par shog /4slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/37 3mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i ma/tshan bod skad du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉skoraphags pa 'jam dpal zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ ṭa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 / —〈〈snar 〉〉skye/ nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉sgrubs—/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhasma/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7rnyo haṃ/38 hūṃ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phron/ tre 〈〈snar 〉〉dran/ 〈〈snar 〉ra pū dzi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byā/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉dzā/sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge 'i/ shesna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ ḍa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thasam/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉rta/ hu1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskyod pa'i/ /2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra//39 3sna〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamang / 〈〈snar 〉〉sgru bas/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉// //33—39

༄/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma sadhī ti bi bye maṇ+ḍa la nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal kyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bag chags skyon gye 3dri ma'i tha ba la/ /shes rab bdud rtsi'i char pa 'be+ebs mdzad pa'i/ /a ra pa tsa na la gus btud de/ /byang sems rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad/ /de la 'dir dus gsum cha mnyam pa bcom ldan 'das byang sems rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor byed par 'dod pas/ bla ma gsang sngags la mkhas pa/ theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas pas/ slob ma ji skad smras pa 4de bzhin byed pa ma smin pa smin par bya ba'i phyir ri bo la sogs pa dgon pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal byas te/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste 5mchod pa bshams nas/ bdag nyid drag po chen po drag shul che ba bdud la sogs pa 33—41

'jigs pa chen po yang 'jigs par byed par bsams la/ rdzu 'phrul chen po'i stobs dang ldan pas bgegs thams cad bskrad de/ srid pa'i ri bo'i bgegs thams cad bcom la mkhregs shing rdo rje chen po'i ri bos bskor te/ rdzu 'phrul chen po'i lha tshogs su snasprul te mchod pa chen po phul la bsam gtan chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas/ nam mkha'i khams su yi ge'i phreng ba snang ba chen pos gsal bar byas la/ mkhas pa byang sems rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas 'grub par bya ba'i dang po'i sbyor ba dang / de'i byin rlabs 3las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sprul pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / sgyu 'phrul chen po'i lha tshogs kyi kedon grub par bya ba'i phyir las rgyal mchog dang de rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar lha nye bar gyur nas dkyil 'khor byar rung ba'i sa'i cho ga dang / slob ma snod dang ldan pa la sdom pa phog la dkyil 'khor bris te rgyan rnams dgram byaste/ lha dgod pa ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das byang sems rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu can/ mdun du rdo rje sems dpa'/ g.yas su rdo rje rin chen/ nub tu rdo rje chos/ byang du rdo rje las rnams briphya/ sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad dang / khyams rnams 67su bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ⑦dang / sgo rnams su rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa gzhag khyego/ /dkyil 'khor de la mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod la skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma bcug la de la dbang rnams 9 bskur bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu de las 0yon gyi mchog blangs te lha dang slob dpon la mchod nas dkyil 'khor la bzod par gsol nas gshegs par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la dkyil 'khor bsdus la ci bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /byang sems rdo 33—42

rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun/ /srid pa'i dgon pa las brgal nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' thob par shog /byang sems rdo rje dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/41 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gcu 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs so// /ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)sa/ ri ༷〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dug ces〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de skad cig smra ba/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nis/42 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wasu/ khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nya)sa/ (ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkram/tshorgya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byes/ ⑥⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/rnams/ ༷nye〈〈co 〉〉bzhag tu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉warnams/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyung/ (1375)33wa 43

1449༄7/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga jes bya ba/༄ 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma sadhī ti maṇ+ḍa la bi dhi nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nur sku sprul me tog thod/ /sgu mdog gser can shes rab ri2 lha / /mi shes rgyun gcod ral gri 'dzin/ /shes rab 4ye shes phyag 'tshal te/ /'jam dpal rang bzhin chos sku ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa la / /gdul bya'i dbang gis dkyil 'khor drug /bde gshegs rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bshad/ /de la 'dir sems can thugati mug can tre'adul ba'i gnyen por bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs pa yin te/ de yang gza' skar bzang po la bsnyen pa'i khang pa bkra shis par 'jug par bya ste/ dpal ldan 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par byas la/ sgrub 33byed44

pa'i gnas de yang byi dor legs par byas te spos bzang po yang phyogs bzhir btul —1nas maṇ+ḍal la tshul dang mthun pa'i me tog bkod de mchod pa bkram nas bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs rnams kyang bkram la stan 'bol ba'i steng du sems can la phan pa'i blos 'dug ste/ ma rungs pa 'dul ba'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed po ni skad cig gis rdzogs par byas la/ khro bo'i rgyal po 7gdong drug pa phyag bcu gnyis pa/ 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / ral gri dang /mda' dang / dgra sta dang / lcags kyu rnams —/g.yas pa'i phyag na thogs pa'o/ /thod pa dang / sdigs mdzub dang / zhags pa dang / gzhu dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / dbyug to rnams g.yon du thogs pa'o/ /spyan dmar ba bco brgyad sdang mig bgrad pa/ ljags drug glog ltar 'gyu ba'i zhal nas hūṃ hūṃ d+nghasgogs pa/zhabs drug gis 'gro ba rigs drug brdzis pa/ char sprin gyi mdog lta bur bsams la bgegs thams cad bskrad la ji ltar 'dod pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bya'o—/ /de nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par byas la bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad du gyur pa ni dang po'i spyor ba'o/ /gzhi'i sangs rgyas a las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ de'i thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas/ de'i thugs kar shes rab 'khor lo 5rtsibs bcu gnyis pa as mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las bcom ldan 'das shes rab ye shes dkar po g.yon 'khor lo g.yas ral gri thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng na a/ sangs rgyas de'i thugs ka nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams spro bar bzhed pas sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ a ā sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya/ ha ra ha ra/oṃ hūṃ byeḥ/ bha ga wān dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ6/ wā gī shwa ra ma hā pā 7tsa sarba dharmā ga ga 33—45

na a ma la su pa ri shudha dharma dhā tu ①dz+nyā na gar+bha u/ zhes brjod pas/ de 'phros shing 'dus pa las lha rnams kyi gnas su yi ge a sha stag tu gyur to/ /a de las rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams bskyed pa ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go/ /de'i rjes la mtshan brjod cing bstod de sprul pa'i sku dpag tu med pas gti mug gi gnas sbyong ba'i thuphrin las mdzad pa ni las rgyal mchog go/ /de lta bu'i bsnyen pa byas nas dkyil 'khor brtsam ste( —/ legs par bris nas lha / dgod pa ni dbus su rnam par snang mdzad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ shar du sems ma rdo rje/ lho ru rin chen sems ma/ nub tu pad+ma sems ma/ byang du las kyi sems ma'o/ /gru chad bzhi 5la sgeg mo la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /khyams kyi gru bzhir skurgo bdug pa ma la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /de nyid du bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' yang tshul dang mthun par ngadagod do/ /sgo bzhir ni sgo ma bzhi gzhag 8go/ /de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor mdzes pa bris te/ sems can skal ba can dag kyang der gzhug rtepar byas la dbang bskur ba thob pa dang nyu sna slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la yang ci 'byor ba'i yon phul la slob dpon gyis kyang dbugs dbyung ba dang / gzengs bstod de lung bstan par bya'o/ /bde 11gshegs rigs /rtamachog dam pa ni/ /gti mug rnam par snang mdzad dpal / /dkyil 'khor cho ga gsungs pa yis/ /dge bas 3rdzogs pa'i byang chub shog /slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rnam par snang mdzad dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdzogs so// //33—46

1450༄7/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga jes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma sadhī ti maṇ+ḍa la bi bye nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /sdug bsngal tsha bas gdungs pa'i sems can la/ /thugs rjes zla ltar bsel mdzad 'jam dbyangs mgon/ /rdo rje ral gri 'dzin pa'i sangs rgyas la2/ /de la btud de mi bskyod dkyil 'khor bshad/ /de la 'dir zhe sdang gi gnyen por mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ dbang bskur thob cing sdom pa dang ldan pas/ yo byad phun sum tshogs par byas la/ dus bzang po la dgon pa'am nags 'dabs su bde bar gshegs pa bsnyen par bya ste / sa phyogs der maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa bshams la/ sgo dag pa sngon du 'gro bas gshin rje gshed por bskyed la bgegs thams cad tshar bcad la/33—48

srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa byang chub sems dpa' dang bcas pa spyan drang zhing mnyes par byas la/ de'i mdun du sdig pa'i dri ma bkru ba la sogs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba cher bskyed do/ /de nas sdom pa ma lus pa bzung la tsho—stong zhing bdag med pa la mos shing khang pa yang gzhal zhing brjod du med pa las ye shes kyi phreng ba 'khrug napa las grub pa'i nang du gzhi haṃ las dang po'i sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' snying gar rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis spyor ba dang po dang rigs mthun pa'i sems dpa' thams cad dang / a las byung ba'i sangs rgyas 'khor du bltas te/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug pa rnams dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ces bya ba dang / de dang mthun pa'i mtshan brjod pa'i byin rlabs kyis de'i dkyil 'khor dang mthun pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba dpag tu med pas 'jig rten gsum po kun bkang ste/rang gi las la sbyar bas las rgyal mchog bsgom pa ni bsnyen pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar lha nye bar gyur nas dkyil 'khor bris te lha dgod pa ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa/ de la rigs dang mthun pa'i 4sems dpa' bzhi ni rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pas bskor bar bkod nas/ de'i phyi rol du sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad dang / khyams su yang 5byams pa dang / mthong ba don yod dang / ngan song kun 'dren dang / mya ngan dang mun ngas 6par 'joms pa'i blo gros la sogs pa rnams bri'o/ /sgo bzhir ni sgo srung gi 7tshul dang mthun par gzhag go/ /de ltar legs par bris la mchod pa'i bye brag gis yang dag par mchod nas skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma gzhug cing dbang yang sbyin par bya'o/ /de'i slar yang nges par mchod nas rigs de nyid kyi 33—49

mtshan nas brjod pas yang dag par bstod la/ dkyil 'khor la bskor lta༄ba byas nas lha rnams la bzod par gsol te dkyil 'khor bsdu bar bya'o/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhe sdang gnyen por gyur nas kyang / /'di la gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /mngon dga'i zhing du skye bar shog /mi bskyod pa dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga /slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/49 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /'phags pa 'jam dang la gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/ da 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadab du/5༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / k+ṣe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorakhrugs/ sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhi'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang rigs ma/thun pa / pe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7yang / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha nges/ klu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wāngs dang /51 7sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma ra/33—50
bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (1377)

༄ / /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga jes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma sadhī ti bi bye maṇ+ḍa la nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /ma chags spyan mnga' chos kyi dbyings la mkhas/ /chags med don rtogs 'dod chags gnas nas dag /'jam dpal rnon po de la gus btud de//'dod chags pad+ma'i 2rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bshad/ /de la 'dod chags kyi gnyen por sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi dkyil 'khor byed par 'dod pas/snying rje chen po'i na blo dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ slob ma ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed pa dze+egs par bya ba'i phyir grong khyer la sogs pa'i gnas su nyam nga ba dang bag tsha ba 4spangs te 5the tshom dang dogs pa thams cad spangs nas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa bshams nas srung ba'i 'khor lo 33—52

sngon du 'gro bas tshogs bsags la chos thams cad nam mkha'i dkyil 1ltar bltas te/ sems kyi snang ba ā li dang kā li'i phreng ba skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i 'od zer lnga yang glog bzhin 'gyu ba las 'byung ba chen po bzhis btegs pa'i khang pa'i nang na rang gi gdan yang rma bya las grub pa'i steng du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas nges par dhīḥlas byung ba'i spyor ba ye shes sems dpa'i bar du dze+egs pa dang / de'i byin kyis rlabs 4kyis dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ces bya ba rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor sdogs pa dang 'dod chags can gyi gdul bya'i 5ngor gang la sangs rgyas kyi sgu phra mo mang po yang mtshan brjod pa'i byin rlabs las byung ba'i las rgyal mchog bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar pad+ma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor dang 6nye bar gyur nas 'dod chags can gyi sems can rnams dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor yang rtsig pa'am rdul tshon las bris te/ lha dgod pa ni dbus su sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas de la rigs mthun pa'i sems dpa' bzhi dgod/ gzhan yang sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad kyang mdzes par dgram 7mo/ /khyams su yang bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dgram mo/ /sgo bzhir sgo ma bzhi gzhag go/ /de ltar legs par bris nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la snang ba thob pa dang / skal ba dang mthun pa'i me tog gis snyim pa bkang ba'i slob ma der bcug la lha rnams bstan cing dbang bskur nas/ de nas yon gyi mchog blangs te dkyil 'khor la phul la lhag ma rdo rje slob dpon gyis longs spyad par bya'o/ /'dod chags snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bsdus pa las9/ /dge ba bsags par gyur pa des/ /snang ba mtha' yas nyid du shog /snang ba mtha' yas 33—53

1452༄༅/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma sadhī ti maṇ+ḍa la bi bye nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /nyon mongs nad kyis gzir ba'i 'gro ba la/ /zug rngu 'byin mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po mchog /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' de btud nas/ /rin chen rigs kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad/ /de la 'dir ser sna'i gnyen por sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan kyi dkyil 'khor byed par 'dod pas/ ji ltar smras pa de bzhin byed pa'i skyes bu dbang bskur ba thob pas ri bo'am chu klung du 'byor pa dang ldan par byas te/ dus tshod bzang po la bsnyen pa'i khang par zhugs la shes rab dang snying rje dang ldan pa'i blo bskyed de/ gdan 'bol ba la 'dug cing mdun gyi 2bya ba byas nas de thag tu ma rungs pa 'dul ba'i rgyal bo 33—55

dran par byas la bar chod bsal te/ nam mkha'i dbyings su dkyil 'khor la bltas la/ de'i mdun du lus ngag gi dri ma bsal la sems bskyed cing sdom pa blangs nas stong pa nyid dran pa'i dbyengs su skar ma lta bu'i yi ge'i phreng ba bltas te / de las byung ba'i khang pa dang / gzhi'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan bskyed pa dang / sbyor ba dang po dang / de dang cha 1mthun pa'i sems dpas bskor ba 2ni a las nges par byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang /de rnams kyi mtshan brjod pa'i byin rlabs las byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sku spro ba'i las rgyal mchog bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor nye bar gyur nas gzhan gyi 4don du thugs rje shar te/ dkyil 'khor bar chad med pa'i gnas su byas la/ rdul tshon ye shes kyi rang bzhin du mos la/ lha dgod pa ni gzhi'i sangs rgyas gtso bo rin chen 'byung ldan las5/ de dang cha mthun pa'i sems dpa' bzhi dang / sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad kyis bskor ba bkod la/khyams su 6bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dgod/ sgo ma bzhi sgo bzhir bris te/ legs par zin pa dang mchod pa yang rgyas par phul te/ bstod pas 7bstod nas bum pa gzhug cing lha rnams dbang bsgur bas bdag nyid bsgrubs la/ gzhan gyi don du slob ma me tog thogs pas sdom pa 'dzin par nus pa la dkyil 'khor bstan te/ de nas dbang bskur nas slar yang dkyil 'khor la mchod de/ bzod par gsol zhing bshags pa bya ba dang /lha rnams bsdu zhing spyod lam ci bder bya'o/ /ser sna rnam dag rin chen 'byung //dkyil 'khor cho ga bsdus pa las/ /dge ba bsags par gang gyur parwa/ /rin chen 'byung ldan nyid thob shog /slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes 33——36

1453༄7/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga jes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma sadhī ti bi bye maṇ+ḍa la nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /dug 2gsum zhen pa'i 'khor ba'i gcong rnying la/ /'tsho byed sman pa'i rgyal po las kyi mchog /ye shes sku can 'jam dpal de btud nas/ /las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad/ /de la spyir phrag dog gi gnyen por sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ ji ltar 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis srid pa'i grong khyer las brgal ba'i dgon pa'i gnas su rdzas dang mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par byas la / stan bde ba la byams pa'i go bgos la 'dug ste/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa bshams nas snying rje'i ya lad bgos 4te/ bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa bsal nas bdud kyi 33—58

dpung rnams pham par byas nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgron 1 du spyan drangs la / phyag bya ba dang / mchod pa dang / lus dbul 2ba dang / bstod pa byas la rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i rgyu ba thams cad snang ba med par mos pa las/ nam mkha'i khams su yi ge spro zhing 'dus pa las byung ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i nang du/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gdon mi za bar grub pa'i ye shes sems dpa' dang / rdzogs par byung ba'i dang po'i spyor ba dang / de dang cha mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / mtshan gyi byin rlabs las byung ba'i phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed pa'i las rgyal mchog bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor byed par 'dod pas/ brtsig 4pa'am bris te/ lha dgod pa ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa'o/ /de la sems dpa' rigs dang mthun pa bzhis bskor ba/ sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad dang / bskal pa bzang po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang /sgo ba rnams mdzes par bris la/ de rnams la yang dag par mchod de/ lha'i snang ba thob pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma skal ba dang ldan pa bcug la 5dbang bsgur te/ yon gyi mchog blangs nas tshul dang mthun pa'i gnang ba byin 6te / dkyil 'khor lha la yang dag par mchod nas gshegs su gsol te/ dkyil 'khor bsdu'o/ /phrag dog don yod grub pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bris pa las / /bsags pa'i dge des 'gro ba kun/ /don yod grub pa nyid 'grub shog /don yod grub pa dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gye cho ga /slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po su badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā 7ba chos kyi shes rab 33—59

kyis btā/ra ba'o// //bsdur mchan/58 141mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉toraphags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ rin〈〈co 〉〉dus/ ༷ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉than lag bsgoms/59 kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toragro don/ 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradul/ ci ger〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 47〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtseg a+yokyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyen/ 47〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1380)33wa 60

༄7/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i khrus gyi cho ga1༄go/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i khrus kyi cho ga ni dang por bum pa rja 2las ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang du bsams la/ de'i nang du baṃ las 'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho bsams te/ de'i steng du byāḥlas pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma dang bcas par bsams la/ de'i steng du phroṃ bsam/ de 'od du zhu bar 4gyur pa las ut+pa la dkar po cig bsam5/ de zhu ba las 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ g.yas na ut+pal sngon po ral gris mtshan pa / g.yon na ut+pal sngon po po tis mtshan pa bsgom/ de'i snying gar zla ba la 6sum̐ bsam/ de'i 'od zer gyis de dang 'dra ba spyan drangs la bstim/ sngags 'di brjod pas ye shes kyi chur zhu bar bsam/ oṃ sarba dhadrwa a bhā ba swa bhā ba bi shud+dhā badz+ra tsak+ṣu a ā saṃ aḥ/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi chus khrus byas nga/sa rang 33—6/

༄ / /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i chu sbyin/ 1༄spro/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i chu sbyin bya bar 'dod pas/ khrus chu'i lhag ma de la rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyi snang bas 3 dag par byas te/ mos pa bsgyur la ye shes sems dpa'i sgu'i phreng sngags brjod la/ de'i rjes la 'di skad du chu sbyin no/ /oṃ dz+wa la mi rda sarba bye te zhebh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes yi dwags rnams la sbyin pas 'thungs te / nyon mongs pa byang bar gyur cig ces brjod do/ /dge ba sems can thams cad dang thun mong du bya'o/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i chu sbyin slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa sdogs so// //33—63
