bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (14༷6)

༄ / /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i ngan sngags byad kyi 'gor los gsad pa/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma saṃ gī ti tsakra ma ra mā ra ya man+t+ra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i ngan sngags byad kyi 'khor los gsad pa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug po/ /bco brgyad spyan dmar gnyis kyis mdzes/ /gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal te/ /'jam dpal mgon gyis mi 'dul tshe/ /ngan sngags byad kyi 'khor lo brtsam/ /de la dur khrod chen po rab 'jigs par/ /ma rungs 'dul ba'i blon 2mchog gis/ /dpal ldan 'byor pa drug rdzas bsog /srid pa'i ri bo pham byas te/ /sems can ngan song rnam par sbyangs/ /don yod 'gro ba'i don byas te/ /gtso bo dkon mchog lhur blang zhing / /bla ma phyag byar 'os pa la/ /tshogs gnyis tshogs ni 'bad de bsags/ /srid pa'i 33—/pya3

'dod chags rnam spangs te/ /stong pa nyid dga' stong pa'i blos/ /yang dag bdag rnged de bzhin nyid/ /yang dag mtha' ste 1yi ge bral/ /shes rab chen po'i skad cig gis/ /chos kun ngo bo nyid med bya/ /'on kyang snang ba ma bkag pas/ /chos kun nam mkha'i mtshan nyid la/ /ye shes skar ma lam me pa//rang sems nyams su myong ba de/ /dgag 2tu btub pa ma yin pas/ /rang rig sems kyi cho 'phrul du/ /yi ge'i phreng bas — 7nye bar mdzes/ /'od kyi phung po'i 'phro 'du yis/ /'byung ba chen po rgyu gcig po/ /rim pa bzhi yis 4 dkyil 'khor brtsegs5/ /'byung ba 'dus pa'i 'bras bu la/ /mthun 'jug spyod yul bya ba'i phyir/ /ri rab gzhal yas khang yang brtsegs— / /'khor lo rtsibs drug 'bar ba 7ste/ /dbus su glang chen 8bsnol ba'i khri/ /nyi zla pad+ma 9 mdangs bskyed de/ /rang rig sems kyi cho 'phrul 'dus/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon byang chub/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sgu 7yi mchog /dang po'i sangs rgyas zhal mnga' ba1 / /rgyan rnams kun gyis spras pa ni/ /dung dang kun da'i 'od 'phro ba/ /nyi ma'i snying po'am snyegaser gyi mdog /phyag bzhi pa la zhi ba'i thusgu/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu bsams 7/ /de yi thugs kar 'khor lo dang / /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bsgom/ /zla ba sa.a yi 'phro 'du yis/ /'og min gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /rnam snang chen po la sogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor chen po drug byon te/ /thugs ka'i zla steng bzhugs pa la/ /bkur ste rim gros 7mnyes par bya/ /shes rab 'khor lo la blo gtad / /ye shes phreng sngags bzlas pa brtsam1 / /ye shes lnga yi sgo nas bstod/ /gal te zhi bas ma 'dul zhing 1 / /de rnams gzhi dang bcas 33—154

pa kun/ /chos kyi kledabyings su thim 'gyur sate/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa'i( —/ /ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /chos kyi dbyings las 4 drag por bzhengs(5)/ /yi ge drug po ye shes 6sgras/ /'jam dbyangs chen po sgra che ba / /rdo rje hūṃ ste hūṃ zhes sgog /nam mkha'i mtha' yas sgra sgrogs pasape/ /t+t+waṃ las drag por skyes 3pa ni/ /gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal/ /khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs/ /spyan dmar bco brgyad phyag bcu gnyis/ /thurdo rje 'khor lo rdo rje dang / /pad+ma rin chen rgya gram bsnams/ /g.yas pa'i ⑩phyag na legs par bsnams/ /mtshon du rdo rje'i mda' thogs pa/ /g.yon pa'i /1phyag rgya dang po ni⑫/ /rdo rje ral gri ma lus gcod/ /g.yon pa'i phyag rgya (12pha rol bsdigs/ /lhag pa'i phyag rgya gzhan rnams na ④/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs/ /ha la ha la 8dug ltar bzhadadza/ /keng rus mche ba gcigs pa po/ /ral pa gyen brdzes thod phreng la/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan 'dzin / /sprul dang thod rlon phreng bas klubs/ /dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba 'phro/ / /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po ni/ /rngam pa chen por bdag nyid gyur/ /shā7/thugs kar nyi ma'i steng na hūṃ/ /de yi byin rlabs snaya mtshan ni/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na ya mān+ta 1ka hūṃ/ o pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta ༄ 2ye ya mān+ta /ka hūṃ/ oṃ duḥ pya kha ts+tsha da ya mān+ta ༄5 ka hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tīkyā ya mān+ta ༄ mika hūṃ/ oṃ wā gī shwa ra ya mān+ta 2 ka hūṃ/ oṃ dz+nyā na kā ya ya mān+ta 8ka hūṃ/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i du da ya ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ dīḥ( bha ga bān dz+nyā na mūrti 1/ bā gī shwa ri rtam hā pā tsa sarba dharmā ga ga na/ a ma la su ba ri shudha dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha hūṃ/khro bo'i 5rgyal po hūṃ las byung / /'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs drug las snya/ /33—155

rim pa 1'di ltar khros pas 2gnas/ /mnar med zugashin rje gshed po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje 'dzin/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed bo ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'khor lo 'dzin/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags gshin rje gshed po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma 'dzin/ /nga rgyal gshin rje gshed po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin chen 'dzin/ /phrag dog gshin rje gshed po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'khor lo 4'dzin/ /g.yon pas 3 kun kyang 'khor lo bskor/ /sbrul dang thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan/ /dus mtha'i me dpung nang na bzhugs/ /brkyang bsgum zhabs kyis gshin rje badze+es/ /re re'i sku la khro bo'i tshogs/ /khro gnyer rim par ldan la sogs/ /grangs med mtha' yas pa yis bskor/ /lag na rdo rje mtha' yas pa/ /de ltar gsal ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /ye shes khro bo nye bar bsdu/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ hūṃ badz+ra kro dha sa pa ri wā re badz+ra sa man+ta e bye hi dṛ sh+ya 6dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams/khro bor byon 7nas nye bar byon/ /rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes byas te/ /bdag dang gnyis su med par bzhugs/ /gsang sngags rgyal pos gzi ma/dngas bskyed//'jam dpal mtshan ni khros pas brjod/ /gsang sngags rgyal po khros pas bzlas//sangs rgyas kun gyi khro bo'i sku/ /dbye 8ba dpag med skye ba 9 yis/ /khams gsum khro bos bkang byas te/ /rdo rje khro bo'i dmag tshogs kyis/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams pham byas te/ /gsad cing mnan pa kho nar zad/ /sprul pa nye bar bsdu bya ste/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs kyis bstod/ /de ltar brtan pa stobs su 'gyur/ /gal te ting 'dzin mi gsal na/ /dmigs pa rtse gcig cho 33—/t+ya6

ga bya/ /dus mtha'i dgra bo gsad 1pa ni/ /ma rungs 'dul ba'i sems kyis su / /dur khrod thod pa mi srun 2gshags/ /nang du gshin rje'i rgyal po bri/ /kha gdangs bar ni shin tu gsal/ /'og ma gshin rje'i khang par bcad 1/ /ya gnag bcu bdun mun pa'i smag /sgo med sgo nga lta bu'i nang / /yid kyis pyagazugs brnyan rdzu 'phrul ldan/ /dgra bo'i rnam shes rlung 'dra ba/ /srog dang 'grogs te chud gyur na/ /slar ni thon pa'i skal med do/ /gshin rjes zin pas mi 'chor ro/ /gang dmigs bsgrub gebya'i snying gi dkyil/ /srog pa rtsa yi rang bzhin las/ /ngan sngags byad kyi 'khor lo bca' rtsibs drug la sogs gsang sngags bcas/ /kun la 'chi rkyen spel te bri'o/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa sha t+t+waṃ che ge mo mā ra ya/ o pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ 6ya/ sha zlo mā ra ya/ oṃ duḥkhats+tsha da sha t+t+waṃ mā ra ya/ oṃ badz+ra tre+ekyā sha t+t+waṃ mā ra ya/ oṃ bā gī shwa ra sha zlo mā 7ra ya/ oṃ dz+nyā 8na kā ya sha t+t+waṃ mā ra ya/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i 9da ya ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ twerkaḥbha ga wān dz+nya 11na mūbye 1ne+ebā gī shwa ra ma hā pā /tsa sarba dhadz+re ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shudha/ dhadz+re dh+wa tu dz+nyā na gar+bha hūṃ/ sha t+t+waṃ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces/ gsang sngags rgyal po 'di dran pas/ /gang dmigs gdug pa nye bar 'jig /rang rgyud gnas nas gshin rje bkug /thod pa rang byung de la bstim / /gdug pa'i gnas nas dgra bo dgug /mthun pa'i gzugs brnyan de la bstem/ /bdag nyid snying ga'i sngags 'od kyis/ /dgra bo'i snying ga'i 'khor lo bskor/ /lte ba 'khor zhing rtsibs kyis 5gcod/ /gang dmigs bsgrub sabya'i tshe srog phralal/ /lung stong me mar me ltar 'gyur/ /gzugs de 'khor los dum bur gtub/ / drag po'i 7gtor mar bcug byas te/ /33—/57

thod nang gshin rje de la sbyin/ /chos skyong srung mar bsgo bya ste/ /rang gi gnas su ci bder btang / /gtor ma dag kyang lho phyogs bskyal/ /de nas rang nyid brtan byas te/ /cho ga ma lus rdzogs par bya/ /spyi dang khyad par rim pa yis/ /bsdus rgyas bye brag shes par bya/ /tha ma'i rgyud drag ngang thung che—1 / /'gro ba log lta 'khrul gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas sgrub la bar gcod cing / /byang chub tshe srog 'phrog byed la/ /'khor lo 'di yis gcod gyur cig /de yi nus pa bskyed nas ni/ /bdud dgra thams cad pham byas nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba nyer zhi ste/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 3shog /'phags pa 'jam dpal kyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i ngan sngags kyi byad kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so//da //rgya gar gyi mkhan po su badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā thub chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa༄5 // //33—158

1481༄ / /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sdeg pa sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ri1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma saṃ gī ti sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha na bi bye maṇ+ḍa la nā la/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gye mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sdig pa spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa'i dra ba rnam bcom nas/ /ma sne rig sgo nga'i sbubs 'byed de/ /sems can ngan song rnam sbyong ba'i/ /'jam dbyangs de la gus btud nas/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral ba'i/ /phan pa'i cho ga bzang po zhig /gzhan gyi don du bri bar bya/ /de la sems can rnams ni gti mug gi mun khung du ye shes kyi snang ba ma shar ba'i dbang gis nying sha nying gis za zhing nying srog nying gis gcod pa las de'i rnam par smin pa tshe 'pho ba lta bu ri yang nas yang du 'byung ste / nyon mongs pa'i 'bras bu ngan song rnams su smin pa rnams la re zhig 33byed/61

byedaphan pa'i sems kyis ma rig pa'i rgya dral te/ nyon mongs pa'i mdud pa las bkrol 1nas yang dag pa'i thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bstan te/tshe 'phos pa lta bu de yang de'i gzugs sam rus sam ming ngam/ stod g.yogs la sogs pa sta gon byas la/ dang po kho nar zhe sdang gi gnyen po mi bskyod pa'i bsnyen pa byas la/ rang nyid grumi bskyod pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi ༄nabaskor ba'i snying ga'i zla ba'i rdo rje dang phreng sngags kyi 'od zer gyis 5byin rlabs dang 6/ rang mi bskyod pa rdo rje rigs kyi lha tshogs kyi mtshan brjod pa'i byin rlabs las sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku bye ba dpag tu rnged pa sems can dmyal ba'i gnas su skye na/ sems can dmyal ba de rnams thams cad kyis kyang skad byug gis chos thams cad mngon par rtogs nas/ sems can dmyal ba de dag gi las kyi khams zad par byas nas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho de las bton 7te/ nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i bag chags dang bcas pa gtan spangs nas sems can de'i yid kyi yul dang sangs rgyas kyi thugs rig pa 8lam mtshon pa'i a dkar po thung ngu lta bur byas te/ sems can de'i gzugs kyi phung po la yid gnas par byas nas/ de dag gi sngar gyi she gzugs de'i sems dang mthun par bcug la de la bdag nyid gtso bo dang lha rnams kyi thugs/ ka'i sngags kyi 'od zer kyis de'i bag chags dag par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la bum pa'i chus kyang dri ma bkru ba'i phyir ye shes sems dpa'i phreng sngags dang / rig sngags dang / sarba nā 1 ra dang / sarba pā paṃ/ sarba kasgro ā pa ra ṇa bi sho dha ni bi sho dha ne+e swā hā/ zhes pas bkru'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa rdzogs pa dang mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen por bcug ste/33—/62

sems can dmyal ba las grol bar byas te dbang bsgur bar bya'o/ / de dang rjes su mthun pa rin po che'i rigs kyi lha nye bar byas la/ ser sna'i gnyen po rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dkyil 'khor du bcug ste/ yi dwags kyi gnas ngan las bsgral te dbang bskur bar bya'o/ / 1de nas 2yang de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo skal ba dang ldan pa de byol song gi gnas nas thar bar bya ba'i phyir gti mug gi gnyen por rnam par snang mdzad kyis sbyang ste / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mtshan brjod nas rnam snang gi dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas yang de dang rjes su mthun par phrag dog gi gnyen por don thams cad grub pa'i dkyil 'khor bris te/lha ma yin gyi gnas nas thar bar byas la rigs kyi bu de la dbang bsgur bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la 'dod chags kyi gnyen po snang ba mtha' yas kyis 4sbyang ste/ lha rnams kyi gnas las thar bar byas nas tshe 'das pa rigs kyi bu de pad+ma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor chen por bcug nas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la dug gsum cha mnyam pa'i gnyen pos sbyang ste/ tshe las 'das pa mi'i gnas su byang chub sems dpa' 5rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur 6te nyon mongs pa de las thar bar bya'o/ /de ltar nyon mongs pa lnga dang bral nas khams gsum gyi 'gro ba 7rigs drug gi gnas nas thar ba de rigs thams cad bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug ste/ dbang rnams yang dag par bsgur nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la rigs ranges pa can du bya'o/ /de ltar na 'di 9gzhan gyi don du gsungs pa'i cho ga yin no/ /sems can ngan song rnam spyong ba / /cho ga myur du byas pa las/ /bsags pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /'khor 33—163

1482༄7/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sdeg pa sbyong ba'i sprun sreg gi cho ga jes bya ba/tshosngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma saṃ gī ti bi dhi ho ma pā baṃ sho dha ya nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sdig pa spyong ba'i spyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi shes dri ma sel mdzad cing / /shes rab ye shes spyan 'byed pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /sems can ngan song rnam sbyong ba'i/ /cho ga tshe 'das la phan pa/ /gzhan gyi don du bshad par bya/ /de la 'dir gza' dang skar ma bzang po bkra shis pa'i nyi ma la tshul dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel pa'am ma 'brel kyang rung ste / phyogs dang mthun pa'i gnas bzang por sa bslang ba la sogs pa sngon du 'go bas sa'i rgyar khru bcu drug pa la gru bzhir byas te/ dbus su de'i phyed kyi tshad kyis zlum por bskor la khru gang gyen du mtho 2ba dang / de'i kha khyer yang 33—/66

de'i tshad du byas la/ de nas nang du khru phyed kyi bar du zabs su rgyar chud par byas la nang gi zabs su yang khru gang thab khung bya'o/ /de la rdo rje dkar po dang /'khor lo dkar po dang / rdo rje sngon po dang / rin po che ser po dang /pad+ma dmar po dang / rgya gram ljang gus bskor bar bya'o/ /de la tsan+dan dang rgya shug /2la sogs pa dug gi rgyu las ma byung ma skyes pa'i shing sogs te/ de'i nang gang yin pa der sems can gang dag 2tshe 'phos pa de'i gzugs kyi phung po khrus byas la dris bsgos te/ rgyan btags la skyil mo krung gi tshul du kha nub tu bye phyogs par bzhag la/ steng dang 4phyogs mtshams su ku shas g.yogs la 5gzhag go / /de nas g.yon du bsang chu dang / mchod yon gzhag cing mchod pa lnga bkram nas/ mdun du yam shing dang / til dang / yungs kar dang /mar dang ba'i phya'o ma dang / zho dang /7 'bras chan dang / ku sha dang drur /sheb dang / nas dang /9sna gro dang /tso so ba dang / sran ma dang / sran ma sha dang / 'bras so ba dang / 1 bil ba dang / star ga ༄ rtadang /dzā ti dang / 'bras bu gsum 1/dang / u dum bā ra'i shing dang / nags kyi lcug ⑪ma rlan dang bcas pa dang / 'bras ma grugs pa dang / spang spos dang / mngar gsum dang / zas kyi rnam pa srog chags las ma labyung ba dang /mchog tu dri dang bcas pa'i sreg rdzas rnams 3 ku sha gcal du bkram pa'i steng du shing lo 5bzang po'am ras sar ba'i steng du gzhag go/ /mdun du dgang gzar blugs gzar gzhag go/ /de ltar rdzas rnams tshogs par byas la/ bdag rdo rje slob dpon gyi rgyan rnams bgo ste/ rdo rje dril bu bzung la ma rungs pa 'dul ba'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed po dran pa'i byin rlabs kyis log 'dren gyi tshogs 33—167

gang yin pa de rnams pham par byas nas cis kyang mi tshugs pa'i gur du bsam mo/ /de nas sdig pa byang zhing dge ba la 'dun pa bzang po bskyed de/ skal ba dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir nges par byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /de'i rjes la bdag nyid shin tu sbyangs pa dang ldan pas 1sgyu 'phrul dra ba mngon par byang chub pa'i snying rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin 2la snyoms par zhugs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon par sprul nas sems can thams cad kyi ngan song yongs su sbyang bar bya'o/ /de nas 'byung ba bzhi las nges par byung ba'i dkyil 'khor brtseg go/ /gzugs kyi khog pa gang yin pa las nges par 'byung ba'i me thab kyi 'khor lo/ de'i nang du me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa dbus su ram̐ gyis mtshan cing zur gsum la 4khams gsum gyi las dang nyon mongs pa zhal du gsol ba'i rtags oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum 5yid kyis bris te/ bram ze shin tu sbyangs pa'i khyim nas me blangs la/ badz+ra dz+wa la re zhes brjod cing rlung yab kyis g.yabs te/ku sha la me sbar nas de'i byin rlabs kyis gong gi yi ge gang yin pa las bskyed pa'i me lha'i rgyal po bha ba ka dung dang kun da lta bu bskyed de/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la nges par rdzogs pa dang / zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ gubye khudang dbyug pa dang / bgrang phreng dang me thab bsnams pa bsgom mo/ /de nas sngags pas me lha bha ba ka spyan drangs te/ oṃ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg 7blugs zhal zas 'di bzhes la—/ /'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ e bye hi ma hā bhū ta de ba ṛ 8ṣi rā dza satwa ma hā kro dhi ā 9hūṃ/ ma hā yā ma na ni ti to zhebha ba oṃ/ bha ba ka asna ye swā hā/ zhes srun drangs la mchod yon dbul ba ni/ oṃ bha ba ka 33—168

agha ye ga ga na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ bha ba ka —1abyā dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/zhes bya bas dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba dang /dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan cing / oṃ badz+ra asna ye ma hā byu ta dz+wa la sarba bhasmi 2ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭhan kro dha dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a 4hūṃ zhes brjod pas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab cing / de la dbang bskur sbyin no/ /yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ bha ba ka badz+ra asna ye badz+ra puṣ+pe zhes bya ba la sogs pas mchod pa lnga dang / mchod yon dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas thog mar me'i gzi brjid bskyed pa'i phyir mar gyi dgang blugs bdun nam lnga dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā byu ta dz+wa la 5sarba bhasmi 6ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭhan dz+wahūṃ phaṭa ces brjod la me'i mdog byelegs par brtags 9te/ dkar ser 'khyel zhing 'bar ba dang / /ma chad ma bye mi 'phro dang / /sgra dang du ba kun du spangs/ /'jam la rdo zhing gsal na 6bzang / /gnag cing rtsub pa ngan pa dang / /chad cing 11 'ur 'ur me stag 'phro/ /mi gsal mi 'bar du bas 'khrigs/ /ngan na de'i bar 15chad zhi bar byas la1 / de nas yam shing dbul te/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā byu thuta dz+wa la sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba duṭ+wān/ bha ba ka asna ye badz+ra ma ta ye swā hā/yi shing gi'o/ /de bzhin du kun la sbyar bar bya'o/ /tshe las sa'adas pa che ge mo sarba pā paṃ da ha na ya swā hā til gyi'o/ /tshe las 'das pa che ge mo sarba pā paṃ dz+wa la ram̐ swā hā/ yungs kar gyi'o/ /mar dang 'o ma dang zho la sogs pa sazhu ba'i rdzas rnams ni me nyid kyi sngags kyis so/ /sarba saṃ ba de swā hā/ 'bras chan gyi'o—/ / ā yu 4 ṣe swā hā/ drur ba'i myu gu'i 'o/ / shā.oṃ a pra ti ha ta ye swā hā / ku sha'i —'o/ /oṃ ma hā be+e ga ye swā hā/ nas kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri 33—sde69

ye swā hā/ gro'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā/ so ba'i 'o/ /o ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ sran ma'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra mu ta ye swā hā/ sran ma ma sha'i 'o/ /oṃ sarba puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras so ba'i 'o/ /oṃ ma hā sho pa ye swā hā/ bil sheb dang / star ga dang / sman thams cad kyi'o/ /yam shing me 'od la'o/ /mar khu zhal du'o/ /'bru'i rnam pa dang sman gyi rnam pa zhal du'o/ /ku sha dang drur ba dbu'i gtsug tor du'o/ /mchod pa lnga'i tshul ji lta bu 2bzhin du'o/ /gnas gang dang gang yin pa der dbul lo/ /tha ma yang mchod pa lnga phul nas bstod pas bstod de/ hūṃ ri 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po yongs kyis dbang bskur bas/ /shes rab me yis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces bstod do/ /de nas 'dod pa'i don bsgrub pa ni/ me molha'i rgyal po drang srong khyod / /byon pa legs kyis don sgrubs 6shig /sbyin sreg las kyi dngos grub sprul — / /mngon par phyogs pa de srid du/ /ji srid dgongs pa mdzad nas kyang / / byin kyis brlab par 3mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ me 'bar ba la bsnyim mo/ /de nas me 'bar ba'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na tshe 'das 9 dbang po shin tu gsal ba cig tu 1 bsams te/ rang gi gnas la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis tshe las 1'das pa'i shes pa bstem zhing dzaḥdh+ri 1 baṃ hoḥ/ zhes pa'i sngags brjod la rigs drug gi gnas nas rnam par shes pa rlung dang 'khyams pa de snying ga'i a thung ngu la nges par bcug nas / sdig pa thams cad dang bral bar bya ste/15 oṃ a ā ⑫sarba ta thā ga ta zhes pa dang / oṃ sarba na ra ga te he tu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pre ta ga te he tu dh+ri sa33—170

phaṭa—/ oṃ sarba tir ya ga te he tu hūṃ 〉phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na pa tsa 2ga te te tu t+t+waṃ kyiphaṭa tra ṭa 4zhes brjod la/ tshogs bsags 5 pa'i thabs la mos pa bskyed par bsams la sems bskyed de/ de'i snying gar zla ba la rdo rje bsams la rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo tshe 'das pa de'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i ༅rnam par smin pa thams cad bum pa'i chus bkru bar bya ste7/ oṃ a ā sarba ta thā ga ta zhes bya bas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sgu'i phreng sngags dang /sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā 8ya/ arta te bh+yaḥ 9/ samyak+shi budhe 4 bh+yaḥ/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne+e sho dha ne+e/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/sna/ shudhe bhi shur+bhe/ sarba kan+d+ra ā ba ra ṇa bi shudhe swā hā/ zhes bya bas nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dang las kyi sdig pa thams cad bkrus te/ / dag par bsams la de'i gzugs kyi phung po de yang stong zhing bdag med par bsam mo/ /de'i shes pa a dkar por gnas par bsams la/ de la dkyil 'khor rnams sprul par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes 'khor bo bar snang la bsdus te/ yang dag par bltas te mchod nas dam tshig gi 'khor lo la gzhug cing mnyes par byas nas dbang bskur zhing mi 'da' ba'i rgyas gdab //par bya'o/ /de'i de ma thag tu dgang blugs bdun nam gsum phul la yam shing sngon du 'go bas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin sreg rdzas rnams dbul bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sngar gyi lha gang yin pa de'i snying gar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams gnas par byas la thun mong du sreg rdzas rnams kyis mchod par byas la/ o badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū 7ta dz+wa la sarba bhasmi 5ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭan sa hūṃ phaṭa o bha ba ka asna ye/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dṛ 7da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ dhī 8ཿ/ bha ga bān dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ (bā gī shwa 33—171

ra ma hā pā 1tsa sarba dhas+thā ( ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shudhe dharma dhā / ༄ datu dz+nyā na gar+bha āḥtshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas dbul lo/ /mthar yang dgang blugs phul la yang dag par mchod nas bstod par bya'o/ /de nas 'di skad ces brjod de/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa'i gtso la mnga' mdzad pa5/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba yi/ /sems can ngan song spyong mdzad pa/ /bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces brjod la/ ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol bar bya'o//dam tshig rnams gtso bo la bsdu zhing gtso bo nyid kyang a'i mthar thug pa la bsdu ste/rang gi shes pa a'i rnam pa de chos kyi za ma tog gi nang du bzhag /choste/ ye shes chen po bzhi'i shing rta'i khar bzhag /hūṃ la rnam snang chen po'i ye shes kyi 'od zer rlung lta bus bskyod de/ 'og min gyi gnas su rigs nges pa'i sangs rgyas su byas la gzhag go/ /de'i rjes la sreg rdzas lhag mas me lha nyid mchod la bstod pa byas te/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sdig pa thams cad sreg )pa'i phyir/ / thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ /narigs kyi sgrub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs sreg 9pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar rab tu 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i jeg pa bcibasanyu / /bgrang phreng 'dzin cing rig sngags bsrung / /bdud rtsi bcud ldan gubye bsnams11/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la smin/ /mi shes skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /zhi bas mnyes shing thugs rje che/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /de la mnyes shing phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces brjod la gshegs su gsol te/ /sems can ngan 33—/72

bsdur 'azas re'u migabyud/ (14༷ 9)

༄/ /ngan song sprung ba 'gro ba rigs drug gi cho ga bzhugs/dwa1 ༄go/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan song sbyong ba 'gro ba rigs drug gi cho ga /ngan song thams cad rnam sbyong ba/ /tshe 'das las su bya ba ni/ /'gro drug so so'i maṇ+ḍal bri/ /dri ma maṇ+ḍal steng du gzhag2/lan chags gtor ma cha gcig bsham/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga kun zin nas/ /gtor ma cha gsum gtang bar bya/ /de nas tshe las 'das pa yang 'gro ba rigs drug dag nas dgug /dri ma dag la bstem par bya/ /hūṃ ltos shig ltos shig rigs kyi bu/ /las kyi dbang gis tshe 'das te/ /'gro drug kun du 'khyams pa la/ /las dang thugs rje'i dam tshig gis/ /ye shes lcags kyus 4drang zhing 'gug /a dṛ 5su du pre dza e ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ/ zhes brjod pas/ tshe las 'das pa'i shes pa de 'gro ba rigs drug gang na gnas kyang lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas rab tu bkug la dri ma dang mtshan la bstems la dngos su gnas par bsam 33—sde76

mo / /de nas sdig sgrib thams cad dral te/ hūṃ nyustong gsum mun gnag 'khyams pa la/ /'jam dpal shes rab rnon po yis/ /log rtog rgyun gcod ral gri 'dis—/ /ting 'dzin shugs ldan phyag rgyas (na)/dral/ /oṃ mañju shrī mut+thata ka tra tha phaṭa ces pas sdig pa thams cad bcad par bsam mo/ /de nas las dang nyon mongs pa'i bag chags thams cad bkru ste/ hūṃ tsa)gsum rig gtsang ma dag pa ste/ /'jam dpal ye shes chu rgyun gyis/ /tshe 'das khyod la khrus byas pas/ /nyon mongs bag chags dag gyur cig /ces phreng sngags kyis khrus bya'o/ /de nas bar 'dir bcu gcig rnam par dag pas tshogs bsags 4par bya'o/ /de nas me tog dor ba ni/ /'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /'jam dpal rdo rje yin par grags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med 'di/ /de ring nyid du 'bab par shog /oṃ badz+ra pra tre+ets+tsha ho/ zhes me tog dor bar bya'o/ /de nas mig dbye ba ni/ 'jam dpal rdo rje deng khyod kyis/ /mig dbye bar ni brtson par mdzod//rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /da lta nyid du phyed par shog /he badz+ra pā sh+ya hūṃ de zhes dbye'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur te/ hūṃ 6rnam shes phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /zhe sdang rnam dag mi bskyod pa'i/ /bum pa'i chu yis dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhe ṣiñca hūṃ7/ tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag pa'i / /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis/ /nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan gyis/ /dbu rgyan cod pan dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra mu ku ṭa rat+na t+t+waṃ8/ 'du byed phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes kyis/ /phrag dog don yod grub pa yi/ /rdo rje yi ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra kadz+re po tsha na badz+ra badz+ra 33—177

hūṃ1 / 'du shes phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis/ /'dod chags snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /shes rab dril bus dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a hūṃ a/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /gti mug rnam par snang mdzad kyi/ /dpal ldan ming gi dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣe ka hūṃ37/ de nas lan chags kyi gtor ma btang la lam bstan cing smon lam gdab pa ni/ he rigs kyi bu rdo rje che ge mo khyod/ /gye ba gar skyes gar gnas kyang / /cis kyang 'pho ba med pa yis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lnga la/ /longs spyod pa yi skal ldan nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gral 'khod gyur cig /skye gnas gzhan gyis bar du ma chod par/ /gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa ston pa yis/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa dang phrad nas / /des bstan pa yi gsang sngags ma nor bar/ /rtogs nas yang dag par ni sangs rgyas te/ /sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las /sgrol ba'i ded dpon chen po byed gyur cig /ces brjod la lam bstan cing smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /tshe las 'das pa'i sgrib pa spyong ba'i cho ga 'gro ba rigs drug nas 'don dpa dang / dkyil 'khor drug tu gzhug cing dbang bsgur ba dang / lam bstan byung smon lam gdab pa/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po su badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā 4ba chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //
