par brjod pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma saṃ gī ti no pi ka /bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub pa'i pa thabs/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang 'di sku gsung thugs ldan pa'i/ /'jam dpal de la spyi bo yis/ /kun nas lus ngag dang ba'i yid/ /de la bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab cing rgya che'i mtshan bstan pa/ /rnal 'byor rgyud rgyal dag la ste/ /snying rje dga' ba'i sems kyis su / /kun la phan phyir bshad par bya —/ /thig le bcu drug mi shigs dbus/ /yan lag med cing rtsis las 'das/ /de nyid ldan zhing mi rtog 4'das/ /nges 'byung kun gyi lam gang yin/ /don gsum the tshom med pa'i blos5 / /lus kyi mtha' ni nges rtog 6bya/ /byang chub bla na med pa ngo// /gsang sngags don kun bskyed 7pa bo/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku kun gyi mchog /sangs rgyas 33—220

sprul pa'i rgyud 'chang ba/ /mchod 'os bstod 'os rim gro'i gnas/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul ldan/ /lag na rdo rje mthu bo ches/ /nyid la snyan pa'i tshig dag gis/ /bstod nas mtshan gyi rim pa zhus/ /blo gzhan /skyedon phyir rim par gsungs/ /dang por snyerdo rje 'chang chen pos/ /slob dpon cha lugs ldan byas te/ /bsam gtan dang ni rjes mthun ③pa'i/ /ri yi phug gam chu yi 'gram/ /rdzing ngam rang dga'i gnas dag gam/ /lha khang mchod rten la sogs par/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug byas te/ /grogs bzang btsal nas bsnyen thupa brtsam/ /bdag dang sa gzhi yongs bsrung phyir/ /dra ba ra ba mtshams bcad dang / /phyogs dang steng 'og bcings 5 sogs pa/ /rab tu 'bad pas khye bsgom par bya/ /de nas shin tu brtser ldan pas/ /sbyin sreg gis ni mnyes par bya/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rab 'bad de/ /dgyes pa bskyed cing 'khor lo ni/ /nam mkhar bsgom par bya ba ni/ /mkha' la 'dus pa tsu'akhor dang bcas/ /lag pa'i 'du byed bsgom cing bya/ /'bru lngar ldan pa'i sor mo la/ /mdzub mo chung ngu mdud byas pa/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ste / / thams cad 8'du ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /lnga dang gcig dang drug dang gsum / /'khor lo'i gsang sngags las bskyed pa/ /bla ma dang mnyam sbyor bsdus pas/ /mnyam pa shin tu bstod par bya/ /e ma ho thuyan lag 'dus pa yi/ /sbyor ba 'di ni gsum las byung / /de ltar mkha' la gsal bkod de//dbang po'i mngon sum 'dra mthong nas/ /dga' ba mchod pa glu yis bstod/ /dang por mchod cing rjes yi rang / /bshags dang gsol gdab phyag 'tshal sogs / /bcu yi yan lag kun 'dus pa/ /bdag nyid rung bar gyur pa na//33—221

tshigs bcad glu yis bstod par labya/ /dgyes nas bdag la kyelha rnams kyis/ /snyan pa'i tshig gis bstod par bsam/ /drin gyi tshul gyis slar bstod pa/ /byang chub sems ni rang byung ba'i/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad de/ /gti mug blo ste gti mug sel/ /mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste/ /rdo rje chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs ༄ par byed/ /gdong drug mig thudrug lag drug po/ /mche gcigs gdong brgya kun 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid/ /stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /'dod pa'i don grub ngan song sbyong / /mgon po nyon mongs dra ba 'joms/ /sa gzhi tshangs nas rkang pas gnon/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 1rtogs bya ba/ /thig le chen po yi ge med/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku kun gyi rgyal//sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ /sems ma rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /a ni 'byung ba 'gog pa ste/ /tshig tu brjod pa rnam spangs pa/ /rin chen 'byung ba khrod la 'dud/ /so sor kun rtog ngo bo nyid/ /a ni brjod pa'i rgyu yin te/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /chos kyi rdo rje 'dzum spyod 'dud/ /bya ba nan tan ngo bo nyid/ /a ni tshig 'byung gsal bar byed/ /tshig kun gsal bar byed pa yi⑪/ /rdo rje dra ba las khyod 'dud/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin 'dod chags che/ /sangs rgyas 33—222

'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyi nyid ma grub bde ba che/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gnyi ga med pas dga' ba che/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /bstod pa'i don ldan mgu ba che/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /gzugs chen lus kyang lha che ba ste/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud—/ /kha dog che la gzi byin ldan/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ming che mtshan bzang rngurgya che ba/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bzhad /lcecing dkyil 'khor yongs khyab pa/ /sangs rgyas bzhad pa khyod la 'dud/ /chos kyi shes rab mtshan 'chang ba/ /sangs rgyas gsung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /nyon mongs dra ba gcod pa'i mchog /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /grags pa rdo rje rgyu yi bdag /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /snang ba chen po gsal ba che/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /mkhas shing sprul 'chang rdo rje las/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po go cha sra/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul bdag nyid gnod sbyin gtso/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul khu tshur bstan zhing sdud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sbyin bdag chen po gtso bo ste/ /rdo rje sgeg mo khyod la 'dud/ /tshul khrims chen po 'chang ba'i mchog /rdo rje dpal phreng spyod la 'dud/ /bzod chen 'chang ba brtan pa po④/ /rdo rje dbyangs mkhan khyod la 'dud/ /brtson 'grus chen po brtul ba yi/ /rdo rje gar mkhan khrod la 'dud/ /bsam gtan chen po ting 'dzin gnas rngu / /rdo rje me tog khrod la 'dud—/ /shes rab chen po lus 'chang ba/ /rdo rje bdug pa khyod la 'dud/ /smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /rdo rje mar me gsal la 'dud/ /stobs po che la 33—223

thabs che ba/ /rdo rje dag byed khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje lcags kyu 'dren pa che/ /rdo rje 'gugs byed khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje zhags pa rnam par rgyal/ /rdo rje 'dren byed khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin pa che/ /rdo rje sdom byed khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'bebs pa rnam rgyal zhags/ /rdo rje 'be+ebs pa khyod la 'dud/ /byams chen rang bzhin dpag tu med/ /snying rje chen po blo yi mchog /shes rab chen po blo chen ldan/ /mkhas pa chen po thabs che ba/ /ye shes cha grub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /stong pa nyid kyi sgor gnas pa/ /bag la nyal ba byang sems ldan / /shes rab snying rjer ldan la 'dud/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs dang ldan / /shugs chen mgyogs pa chen po ste/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po cher grags pa/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa po/ /stobs bcu rdzu 'phrul bzhir ldan pa'i/ /goms shugs ye shes bzhir grags pa/ /stobs po che la bdud dpung 'joms /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa khyod la 'dud/ /srid pa'i ri bo chen po 'joms /mkhregs shing rdo rje chen po 'joms/ /drag po chen po mun pa 'joms /'jigs chen 'jigs par byed pa po/ /phung po lnga dag lha chen 'dul/ /mi shes ri 'joms sra ba po/ /mya ngan kun sel drag po ste/ /che bas che ba khyod la 'dud/ /mgon po rigs mchog chen po chetsa/ /bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog /jeg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas/ /theg pa chen po'i tshul gyi mchog /'khor ba mya ngan skyob pa'i mchog /jeg pa tshul mchog lam gnas pa'i/ /phyag rgya mchog tu grub byed pa'i/ /pha rol sa bcu gtso la 'dud/ /de ltar bstod 2par byed pa de'i1/ /'khor lo 'dus pa'i gtso mchog grub/ /de dag mchog gi rgyal po'i spyor ba'i 'khor lo dang po'i ting nge 'dzin to / / 733—221

de nas rim pa 'dir ldan pas/ /thams cad nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i tshogs—/ /ma lus mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ /phyag lngas tshom bu lnga mnyes bya/ /de ltar mnyes byas 'og tu ni/ /yes shes sems dpa' mngon 'dod pas/ /sems can yongs bsgral bsam pa dang / /byang chub dam par smon par bya/ /de nas 'di dag tshig tu brjod/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /ji tsam du ni gzung thunas su/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /nam zhig byang chub snying po la/ /yongs su gnas gyi bar dag tu/ /bdag gis byang chub mchog gi sems/ /ma lus par ni bskyed par bya/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa'i/ /dam pa bdag thugis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung ④bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spong sgengo / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yis/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re zhing du 6dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po yi/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid 33—225

du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung la/ /ma grol ba ni dgrol ⑤bar bgyi / /ma bsgral ba ni bsgral bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung rdu zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod / /④de ltar sdom pa 'dzin byed pa/ /kun rdzogs rim par dbang bskur nas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med par/ /spyi gtsug don dam lha bsnyen bya/ /de nas nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /ma lus bdag la bsdu bar bya/ /bdag gi snying ga'i dkyil nyid du/ /thim pa'i eye shes me 'bar te/ /rnam min phung po bsregs ⑥byas nas/ /be+er sos ye shes lus su bya/ /de nas byang chub lnga bsgom pa/ /ji ltar yongs su dag pa yi/ /me long gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /yul dang dngos bo'i rig 7rnams kun/ /ma lus so sor snang ba bzhin/ /thams cad yongs su dag pa yi 5/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes la/ /'dris par de la blta bar bya/ /de nas snying rje bskyed bya ba/ /sems can rnams ni mgon skyabs bral/ /dpung gnyen med cing sdug bsngal ba/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba yi/ /sems can rnams kyi don dag tu/ /thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral bsam/ /ji ltar chos rnams stong pa dang / /mnyam pa nyid du rab sbyor bas/ /bdag kyang stong pa bdag med cing / /sems can rnams kyang de 'dra bar/ /chos rnams kun kyang rab tu shes/ /chos la dmigs pa'i snyeng rje yang / /bdag med rang bzhin rig pa las/ /mnyam nyid ye shes bskyed par bya / /de nas sngags 'di ched du brjod/ /o a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā 1rde/33—226

byeda.ār+ya tshonuta pan+da twata/ sngags 'di tshig tu brjod byas nas/ /sngags pas sngags don bsgoms nas su/ /lhan cig dmigs pa med pa dang / /gnyis med chos la rab gzung phyir/ /de nyid yul du bya ba'i phyir/ /chos bdag med pa bsgom par bya/ /dmigs med snying rje so sor brtag /de nas snying rje'i rjes 'gro ba/ /gzung 'dzin kun dang yongs bral ba'i/ /ngo bo nyid kyis 'od gsal ba'i/ /yan lag kun dang yongs bral ba'i/ /rang bzhin yongs su dag pa yitsosna/ /chos dbyings rgyu mthun 1dngos bral don/ /stong nyid ngang la de gnas nas/ /chos dbyings ye shes bsgom par bya/ /de ltar sems can thams cad kyi/ /don byed bral ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sngon gyi smon lam dbang thob cing / /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang sgyur bas/ /sems can don ni rab rdzogs phyir/ /khams gsum 'byung gnas khyad par gyis/ /don dam kun rdzob mya ngan 'das/ /nan tan ye shes mngon gsal bya/ /de ltar rnam lnga'i ngo bo yirge/ /snying rje nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyis/ /thams cad rang bzhin med shes nas/ /'gro ba'i don la 'jug brtson bya/ /de dag ni yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas de la dngos 'byung gzugs/ /'phrul pa'i tshul kyis nam mkha' las / /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba'i/ /skar ma'i tshogs ni rab bsgoms te—/ /de las byung ba'i khro phreng tshogs/ /sngon po'i mdog can 'od zer ni/ /brgya phrag stong gis yongs bskor ba'i/ /hūṃ phyazhes grags pa bsgom par bya/ /de las 'od zer rab byung bas/ /'od kyi rtse lnga sangs rgyas sogs/ /rdul snyed grangs ni rab sprul nas/ /sprul pa de dag thams cad kyis/ /sangs rgyas 33—227

zhing du rab gshegs te/ /sems can khams rnams dag byas shing / /byang chub sems ni rab bskyed dang / /sdom pa gzung rtedang rjes yi rang / /gsol btab bsgul ba sogs byas nas/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul rab bstan te/ /phyir la dh+ri 2der 'du byas nas/ /k+shi de nyid la zhugs par bsam/ /de las yongs 'gyur kha dog ni/ /sngon po la sogs drug ldan zhing / /de yi 'od kyis ④ zhing khams drug /khyab par byas nas 'bar ba yis/ /bdud 'jigs mi thub zhal drug pa/ /ye shes rdo rje rtse lnga bsgom/ /ye shes rdo rje'i /zhebum nang du//dkar po'i yi ge rja 6bsams te/ /de las gyur pas rin po che'i/ /stong gsum tsam gyi mchod rten bsgom/ /de nang tweḥyi yi ge las/ /gru gsum chos 'byung bsam par bya/ /de nang yi ge rdzogs pa las/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /de las yang ni zlo 3las ni/ /sdogs pa'i gzhal yas rnam par bsgom / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /twa ra rnam bzhis rnam brgyan cing / /dril bu dar dang 'phan 8la sogs/ /me tog phreng dang rnga yab klubs/ /grwa rnams dang ni thams cad dang / /sgo rnams dang ni khyams su yang / /rdo rje rin chen rnams dang ni/ /zla gam chun 'phyang rnams kyis brgyan/ /dra ba dra phyed bkod pa la/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis klubs pa'o/ /rdul tshon kha dog rnam lnga yis/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor de dang 'dra ba 9ru/ /zhugs nas nang gi gzhal yas khang / /'khor lo'i tshogs zhes rab bstan cing //phreng ba bzhi dang ldan pa yi/ /rdo rje dbyings zhes brjod pa ni/ /de nas phyi rol dgod par bya/ /rdo rje phreng bas yongs bskor ba/ /ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa la/ /rdul tshon lnga po nyid kyis ni/ /dra ba dra phyed nyid kyis klubs/ /33—228

dkyil 'khor kyi ni phyi rol du/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i rtags thams cad/ /khyad par du ni mdor gsungs nas/ /de yi de yis thams cad bya/ /sgo yi mtshams dang twa ra na/ /shin tu gcig nyid mi bya'o/ /de phyir de yi sgo rnams ni / /twa ra na rnams gdags pa yin/ /go rims bzhin du lha rnams kyi1/ /gdan ni phyi nas dgod par bya/ /de nas dbus su dgod pa nyid/ /gtso bo yi ni gdan yin no/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs kun tu/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i gdan/ /rang gi sa bon gyis bskyed pa/ /de ni spyor bas rig par bya/ /gdan gyi ngo bo bsam pa ni/ /dbus su saṃ las seng ge'o/ /haṃ las shar du glang po che / /lho ru rta ni i las so/ /rma bya nub tu yi las bsam tso/ /khaṃ las mkha' lding byang du bsgom/ /de steng paṃ las pad+ma dang / /dar gyi glod stan dag dang ldan—/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nas brtsams te/ /rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i mthar thug par/ /gdan ni a las bskyed pa yi/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yi/ /steng na sems dpa'i stabs su zhugs —/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i bya ba ni/ /yid kyi yul te goms par bya/ /de dag ni gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas rkyen gyis slong ba ni/ /de dbus 'khor lo'i bdag po ste/ /pad+ma seng ge'i zla steng du/ /a las bskyed pa'i rtag 4pa ni/ /gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad che/ /rnam thar bzhir ldan kun du zhal/ /mdog dkar ral pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyar ldan/ /byis pa'i rgyan gyis mi bzhugs shing / /'khor lo bskyed pa chorgyu bsgom mo/ /rtag pa'i sangs rgyas bsgom gyepa ni/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni mchog tu'o/ /de nas snang mdzad chen po yi / /thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dkyil du yi ge dhīḥdakar las/ /33—229

dang po'i sangs rgyas zhal lnga pa/ /byis pa'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan tshosnacing / /rin chen sna tshogs na bza' can/ /phyag brgyad mnga' ba'i phyag mtshan ni/ /g.yas pa bzhi ni go rims bzhin/ /shes rab kyi ni ral gri bsnams/ /de bzhin g.yon pa'i phyag bzhi na/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi/ /po ti re re bsnams pa'o/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin no / / 3 dang po'i sangs rgyas thugs ka ru/ /shes rab 'khor lo rnam bsgom pa/ /sa mchog bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i/ /'khor lo lte ba'i rtsibs dang ldan/ /rtsibs rnams lte ba la gnas pa/ /rten cing 'byel par 'byung sbyor bas/ /bcu gnyis pa 1dang ldan pa yin/ /'khor lo 'dir ④ni gyur pa'o/ /de yang 'khor lo bsgom bya ba/ /yi ge a las yongs bskyed pa'ithu/ /lce drug kha dog drug dang ldan/ /mu khyud bzhi yis bskor ba yi/ /'khor lo de yi dbus nyid du / /yi ge a dkar bsam bya ste/ /de nyid 'phros tshipas phyogs bcu yi/ /don byas slar 'dus gzhi la thim/ /thim pa'i byin brlabs las bsam (gyepa/ /bcom ldan 7ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /rtsa ba'i sngags sogs 'khor lo yi/ /mu khyud bzhi la gsal bar bsgom/ /dang bo'i mu khyud la bsam pa oṃ sarba dhan+d+ra mu.a bha ba swa bha sngab/ bi shudha badz+ra a ā saṃ aḥ/ de yi phyi rim mu khyud ni//gnyis pa la ni bsam bya ba/ /sa mchog bcu gnyis rdzogs rtags su/ /sgra yig bcu gnyis dgod pa ni/ /a ā i yī u u e e o au saṃ aḥ/ 'khor lo lce la bsam skyepa ni/ /dang po lce nas bsam skye byas te/ /sngags ni ji tsam bkod pa ni/ /rigs kyi mdog dang sbyar bar bya/ /dang po lce la bsam bya ba//oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣa 0 ya te na maḥ/ gnyis pa la ni dgod bya ba/ /oṃ duḥkhats+tsha da ya te 33—230

na maḥ/ gsum pa ⑨ nges par dgod pa ni/ /oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na sprurta ye ta 2na maḥ/bzhi pa rtag tu rig bya ba/ /oṃ dz+nyā na kā yā ya te na maḥ/ lnga pa la ni nges bsgom pa/ /oṃ bā gī shwa ra ya te na maḥ/ drug la mtha' ste bsam pa ni/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na ya te na maḥ/ 'khor lo mu khyud gsum pa la/ /bcom ldan bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /ye shes sems dpa' sku yi sngags/ /phreng ba dgod pa 'di dag go/ /a ā sat+tha ta thā ga ta z-i da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ thu s+thāḥbha ga bān/ dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ5/ bā gī shwa ra ma hā pā /6tsa/ sat+tha dhadz+re 3ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shudha/ dhan+d+ra kyedhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āḥ/ phyi rol mu khyud tha ma la/ /yi ge ka sogs ha yi mthar/ /thug pa'i yi ge rnams bkod 1 pa/ /'khor lo sngags kyi rim pa'o/ /'khor lo de dag thams cad kyang / /bri'am bsam pa byas na ni/ /nyes par mi 'gyur legs pa 'thob/ /de ni shes rab 'khor lo'o//shes rab kyi 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin to / /ri de nas 'khor lo 1)de dbus su/ /a las bskyed pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /ye shes sems dpa' zhal drug pa/ /ston ka'i zla ba ltar gsal zhing / /in+d+ra d+dhi la'i gtsug phud can/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od 'dras bskor/ /zhi ba'i ngang tshul dang ldan zhing / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis/ /at+pal dmar po g.yas pa ni/ /g.yon pa na ni sngon po nyid/ /at+pal de gnyis steng nyid na//shes rab po tis bla mdzes pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba bsam/ /de dbus thams cad kun ngo bo/ /yi ge a ni gsal bkod de/ /de nas 'khor lo la gnas sngags/ /ji ltar bstan pa'i kha dog dang / /de bzhin ldan par rnam bsam ste/ /mi shes ri 'joms 'od dang ldan/ /'od des rang gi lus nyid la//33—231

snang ba byed pa bsgom par bya/ /snang bar gyur ma thag tu ni/ /zhal bzhi'i sgo nas dbyung bya ste/ /'jig rten khams kun snang bar byas/ /de nas rdo rje sgo drug nas/ /kha dog drug ldan 'od phyung tshoste/ /nam mkha'i khams kun khyab byas nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams gsal bar 'gyur/ /las gnyis byas nas slar 'dus pas/ /ye shes rdo rje de nyid la/ /lan gsum bskor nas khar zhugs te/ /shes rab ye shes de bkug nas/ /bdag med ma la rab bcug nas/ /snying ga tsozla ba la gnas pa'i/ /sngags dang gcig tu 'dres gyur — nas/ /de nyid brtan par bdag gis bsgom/ /de ltar spyod pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /ye shes sku yi rnam pa dang / /zla ba'i sgo 5 nas gzugs bsams nas5/ /a yi rnam pas gzugs bsgom pa/ /gsum pa ⑦sprul pa'i gzugs kyi sku/ /ring por mi thogs 'dul dbang gis/ /nye bar bzung nas mngon snang ngo / /de dag gis /7ni byang chub pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dang po sbyor ba'i 8ting nge 'dzin to / /shesnade nas rigs kyi 'khor lo drug /rim pa bzhin du bshad byas te/ /gtso bo'i gnas su s+thāḥlas ni/ /mtha' yas dmar po'i mdog ldan pa/ /ting 'dzin spyor ba la gnas te/ /de yi snying gar dang po yi/ /sangs rgyas gong dang mthun par bsgom/ /de'i thugs kar 'khor lo ni/ /lce brgyad mu khyud bzhir ldan pa/ /sngags dang ldan par bsgom par bya/ /brgyad dang ldan pa'i sa bon ni/ /oṃ badz+ra t+t+waṃkyā 1 ya te na maḥ/ zhes pa'i sngags ni 11dgod byas nas/ /'khor lo'i lte ba'i dbus nyid du/ /yi ge dhīḥlas yongs gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje rgon po mdog dmar po/ /gtsug phud lnga yi dbu rgyan can/ /gzhon pa'i rgyan 33—232

dang ldan pa yi/ /sna tshogs dar gyi gos dang ldan/ /g.yas na shes rab ral gri bsnams/ /de bzhin g.yon na pad+ma 'dzin/ /de'i snying ga zla stengs na/ /yi ge dhīḥni rnam bsgoms te/ /spro dang 37bsdu ba sngon bzhin bya/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor de dbus su/ /hūṃ 2gi yi ge las bskyed pa'i/ /mi bskyod sa gnon phyag rgya can/ /sngon po'i kyemadog can de bzhin bsgom/ /de yi snying gar dang po yi/ /sangs rgyas bsgom pa sngon bzhin bya/ /de yi snying gar sngon bzhin du/ /lce brgyad pa yi 'khor lo bsgom/ /sngon bzhin de bzhin sngags dgod bya/ /rim pa bzhin du lce la bsgom/ /oṃ duḥkhats+tsha da ya na maḥ/ zhes pa'i sngags ni dgod bya ste/ /lte ba'i dbus su bsgom bya ba/ /yi ge hūṃ ltalas bskyed bya ba/ /rdo rje ral gri zhes kyang bya/ /sngon po gzhon nu'i gzugs dang ldan—/ /zur phud lnga la cod pan can/ /g.yas g.yon rdo rje ral gri 'dzin/ /de yi snying ga zla steng na/ /yi ge hūṃ 57bsgom sngon bzhin du/ /spro dang 7bsdu ba sngon bzhin bya/ /de nas sngon gyi sbyor ldan pas/ /de bzhin 'khor lo'i dbus nyid du/ /a las bskyed pa'i rnam snang mdzad/ /dkar po'i mdog ldan phyaphyag rgya ni/ /byang chub mchog dang rab ldan pa'i/ /'khor lo bsgoms te de snying gar/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bsgom bya ste/ /snying gar lce bcur ldan par bsam / /oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ ya kyen maḥ/ zhes pa'i sngags ni dgod byas te/ /de yi lte ba la bsgom pa/ /yi ge a las yongs gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan shes rab ye shes can/ /mdog dkar sngon gyi cha lugs can/ /g.yon na 'khor lo rab 'dzin cing / /g.yas na ral gri de bzhin no/ /de yi snying gang rta zla dkyil bsgom/ /de steng geyi ge a bsgoms te/ /spro dang bsdu ba sngon bzhin bya//33—233

de bzhin dkyil 'khor dbus nyid du/ /yi ge a las rab byung ba/ /mdog ljang don grub mi 'jigs pa/ /phyag rgyar ldan pa bsgom byas te/ /de yi snying gar dang po yi/ /sangs rgyas bsgom pa sngon bzhin te/ /de yi thugs kar snalce brgyad pa'i/ /'khor lo bsgom pa sngon bzhin bsgom/ /de yi thugs kar dgod bya yis/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'di dag go/ /oṃ dz+nyā na kā ya ya te na maḥ—/ zhes pa'i sngags ni dgod bya ste/ /'khor lo lte ba'i dbus nyid du/ /a las gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /ye shes sku can mdog ljang ba/ /gzhon nu'i gzugs can zur phud ni/ /lnga pas rab brgyan dar gyis klubs/ /g.yon gyis rīsna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /g.yas kyis shes rab ral gri 'dzin/ /de yi thugs kar zla ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /yi ge a ni rnam bsgoms te/ /sngon bzhin spro dang — bsdu ba bya/ /de nas sngon bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dbus su i thulas byung ba yi/ /rin chen 'byung ldan mdog ser po / /mchod sbyin phyag rgya ldan par bsgom/ /de yi thugs kar dang bo yi/ /sangs 5rgyas de bzhin bsgom byas te/ /sngon bzhin lce brgyad rnams la ni/ /sngags dang ldan par rnam bsgom pa/ /oṃ bā gī shwa ra ya te na maḥ/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams dgod byas te/ /'khor lo de yi lte ba la/ /oṃ las bskyed pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /ngag gi dbang phyug ces bya ba/ /sku mdog ser po rgyan dang ldan/ /zud phud lnga pa sna tshogs kyitre/ /na bza' rnams kyis rab klubs pa / /g.yon gyi phyag na rin po che/ /g.yas na shes rab ral gri 'dzin/ /de bzhin de yi thugs ka ru/ /zla ba'i steng na yi ge oṃ/ /zhes ni bya ba bsgom byas te/ /'jo sgeg ldan par rab mdzes pa/ /yi ge 'bru dang ldan pa dedzo/ /33—234

sngon bzhin spro dang bsdu ba'o/ /de nas sngon bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dbus nas yi ge las gyur pa/ /skye med ma byung a bsgoms te/ /de las gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /byang sems rdo rje zhes grags pa/ /sku mdog dkar po gzhon tshul can/ /rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dag dang ldan/ /rgyan ni sku 1 dang rab ldan zhing / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gnyis na/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bu 'dzin—/ /de yi snying gar bcom ldan 'das/ /dang po sangs rgyas bsgom byas te/ /de yi thugs kar 'khor lo ni/ /lce brgyad pa ni bsgom par bya/ /sngags dgu gcig la gnyis dgod bya/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na /—ya te na — maḥ/ zhes pa'i sngags ni dgod byas te/ /de yi lte ba'i dbus nyid du/ /a las bskyed pa'i bcom ldan 'das—/ /a ra pa tsa zhes bya ba/ /mdog dkar byis pa'i rgyan gyis klubs/ /zur phud lnga dang rab ldan zhing / /sna tshogs dar gyi na bzas 4brgyan/ /g.yas dang g.yon na bsnams pa ni/ /bo ti dang ni ral gri bsnams/ /de yi snying gar bsam bya ba/ /zla ba'i steng na yi ge a/ /sngon bzhin spyo dang basbu byas te/ /gnas su brtan par der phya'agyur nas/ /bzlas dang bsgom pa gtang bar bya/ /rigs phye ba'i 'khor lo'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin no // //6de dag ni rigs kyi dbang gis 'khor lo'i rim pa bstan pa yin no/ /de nas da ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha dag gi ngo bo gsang sngags kyi sgo nas de dag gi rim pa bskyed par bya ste/ dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan pa yi/ /bdag nyid gsal ba'i thugs ka ru/ /ye shes zla steng a gnas las/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i bye brag gis) / /gsang sngags 'di ni ched brjod bya/ /a ā sathru ta thā ga ta z-i //da ya/ha ra ha ra/ o hūṃ twe9ཿ/ bha ga bān/ dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃti/ bā gī shwa ra/ ma 33—235

hā pā tsa/ sarba ①dharmā/ ga ga na/ a ma la/ su pa ri/ shudha dhadz+re dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āḥ/ zhes pa'i gsang sngags brjod byas pas/ /so so'i sku rnams gsal (2༄bar bsgom/ /gsang sngags de yi 'og ④nyid du/ a yi 'phro 'du gnas skabs su/ /bcu gnyis mdzad pa rdzogs byas te/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa rdzogs nas su/ /slar log yi ge'i mtshan ma kun/ /rang gi mdog ltar gsal 'gyur te/ /so so'i gnas su bkod pa las/ /zla ba la gnas cho ga gsum / /sku rdzogs shar la sogs pa ru/ /go rims bzhin du bzhugs par bsgom / /de dag ni lha bsgom zhing 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas lha rnams so so yi/ /mtshan ma'i bye brag bstan par bya/ /dang po shar gyi 4'khor lo yi/ /lce la zla gnas de nyid du/ /yi ge hūṃ ⑤las gyur pa yi—/ /mi bskyod pa ni bsgom par bya/ /rab tu dkar ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /'jigs byed 67bdud gnon skyil krung bzhugs/ /lho ru t+t+waṃ kyelas yongs bskyed pa'i / /rin chen 'byung ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /shin tu ser ba markata 'dra//cod pan dang ldan mchog sbyin mdzad/ /nub tu tweḥlas bskyed pa yi/ /bskyed pa bde gshegs snang mtha' yas/ /rā ga'i mdog 'dra ting 'dzin rgyal(she/ /dbu rgyan dang ldan ye shes ldan/ /byang du mtshan rdzogs don yod grub/ /bhā la'i mdog 'dra skyabs dang ldan/ /dbu rgyan mnyam pa'i stabs ⑨kyis bzhugs//sangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyang / /spyi dang khyad par rgyan rnams kun/ /'khor lo'i skabs las shes par bya/ /shar lho zla ba'i gdan stengs su/ /sems ma rdo rje zhes pa dkar/ /a las byung ste rdo rje'o/ /lho nub zla steng ⑩ bsam bya ba/ /a las bskyed pa'i rin chen ma/ /sngo bsangs nyuspre/mdzes ma'i 33—236

thabs tshul can/ /rang gi rigs kyi mtshan ma 'dzin/ /nub byang zla dkyil steng bsgom pa/ /mos pa i lalas byung ba ste/ /dmar po'i mdog ldan pad+ma 'dzin—/ /brjod 3༄pa'i tshul can bsgom par bya/ /byang shar zla steng bsgom bya ba / /las mchog ma ste mdog ljang mo/ /gsal ba'i bdag nyid chen mo zu ste/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /sems ma rdo rje la sogs kyang / /rang gi rigs kyi mtshan ma yis/ /dbu rgyan sku la sna tshogs pa'i/ /byis pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan ④pa po/ /de yi phyi rim 'khor lo ni/ /lce steng zla ba bsgom bya ba/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bye brag las/ /so so'i sems dpa' bcu drug bskyed/ /dang po'i 'khor lo nas brtsams te/ /de la thug pa'i zla stengs su/ /rigs kyi sems dpar chen po ni/ /rigs las skyes te rim bzhin brtag /dang po'i 'dod pa sems dpa' che/ /gnyis pa rgyal po bde ba che/ /gsum pa chags pa dga' ba che/ /bzhi pa legs la mgu ba che/ /yi ge dhīḥlas de dag bskyed/ /a ā i yī/ stong bzhi bdag nyid chen pos 'joms/ /rim bzhin rdo rje mda' gzhu dang / /lcags kyu tog par ldan pa ste/ /'gying dang ldan zhing rigs kyis brgyan/ /shar steng snyezla ba la gnas bsgom/ /lho yi 'khor lo'i steng bsam pa/ /gzugs che lus che rin chen dpal/ /kha dog che gsal nyi ma'i dpal/ /ming yang che la tog gi dpal/ /dkyil yangs rdo rje bzhad pa'i dpal / /gsal de don ldan 'di las skyes/ /u u e i/ de ltar stong ldan dpal mchog rnams/ /rin chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan tshems/ /rim 6bzhin thogs nas tsogatso la blta/ /nub kyi 'khor lo'i steng nyid du/ /sems dpa' rim 8bzhin bsam bya ba/ /shes rab mtshon can ma chags chos/ /nyon 33—237

mongs che ba sems dpa' gcod/ /grags ldan sems dpa' kun gyi rgyudasti/ /snang gsal sems dpa' ④gsal bar smra/ /'dod ldan tshogs pa de dag kyang /chags pa 'joms rnams 'di las skyes/ /o ausaṃ aḥ/ bdag nyid de dag stong pa'i dpal/ /'dzin tshul pad+ma ral gri dang / /'khor lo lce dag so so yi /phyag char 'dzin pa zur la blta/ /byang phyogs 'khor lo'i steng bsgom pa/ /sgyu ma mkhas pa rdo rje las/ /don grub pa ni sems dpa' bsrung / /dga' ba la dga' gnod sbyin te/ /mi bu'aphrul kun ldan sdud pa po/ /rim ④ bzhin gsang sngags 'di las skyes/ /a ā e e/ 'di las rim bzhin bskyed pa ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje go cha dang / /mche ba khu tshur rnam bzung nas/ /las dag yin te gtso la 'dud/ /de dag ma lus sems dpa' yang / /ji ltar gsung rab las byung ba/ /a la 3byung ste mtshan gyi sngags/ /tshig dang yan lag kun ldan nas / /'khor lo de yi phyi nyid du/ /mchod pa'i tshogs dag bsgom bya ba/ /sbyin pa tshim byed rdo rje 'gying / /sdom pa srung ṭub tshul khrims phreng / /bzod pa 'dzin pa dbyangs 3 len ma/ /dge ba la brtson gar mdzad ma/ /lha mo'i tshul ni 'di bzhi yang / /ming gi yi ge dang pos bskyed/ /lā mā gīr tsadang byār tsolas te/ /'gying dang phreng thogs 'dzin pa dang / /dbyangs dang gar dag byed pa yi/ /tshul dang ldan te byis pa'i tshul/ /de 'og phyi yi lha mo bzhi/ /rim par 'thon te gzhung tshig ldan/ /shes rab lus can bdug pa ma/ /bsam gtan dang can me tog 'dzin/ /smon lam ldan pa gsal ba me/ /thabs ldan lha mo dag pa'i 1rtachu/ /ye shes stobs dang ldan pa yi/ /dad brtson dran dang ting 'dzin ldan/ /'di yang ming las bskyed par bya/ /spos 33—238

dang me tog gzhong pa dang / /gsal byed dag pa'i chu 'dzin pa'i/ /tshul ldan 'gying mdzes bsgom par bya/ /de yi phyi rim bsgom bya ba/ /byams pa 'jam dpal spos glang po/ /ye shes tog zhes grags pa bzhi/ /byams pa dpag med snying rje che/ /shes rab che zhing thabs che ba/ /so so'i rigs las skyes pa ste/ /rim bzhin yi ge a las r+shab/ /phyi lta nang lta sems dpa'i stabs/ /de nas de 'og bsgom bya ba/ /bzang skyong blo yi rgya mtsho dang / /blo gros mi zad spobs pa brtsegs⑤/ /rim pa 'di bzhin bsgom par bya/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs dang shugs dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing stobs kyis gnon/ /'di dag kyang ni a las te/ /rim pas rgyan khyeyod sems dpa'i gzhung / /de yi 'og tu bsgom bya ba/ /mthu chen thob dang ngan song 'dren/ /mya ngan 'joms pa dra ba'i 'od/ /rim pa bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /phung po 'joms shing nyon mongs 'dren/ /khro bo'i tshul ston drag shul che/ /lha chen 'jigs byed la sogs pa'o/ /a las de dag rim bzhin bskyed/ /'jo sgeg khro tshul ldan pa'o/ /de yi 'og tu bsgom bya ba/ /zla 'od gzhon nu 'od dpag med/ /nam mkha'i mdzod dang sgrib kun sel/ /rim bzhin a las bskyed par bya/ /de dag bye brag rigs kyi mdog /sngags chen theg pa'i tshul la gnas/ /theg pa kun gyi nang na mchog /lha byed la sogs ldan pa'i mchog /rim gyis rta babs khyams nang du/ /mkhas pas rtag par rim bzhin bsgom/ /sgo nas sngags pas dgod bya ba/ /'gugs dang 'dren pa 'ching ba dang / /mnyes pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /rim bzhin thogs nas tshad med ldan/ /a las bskyed de sgo bzhir gnas/ /de dag ni rgyal ba 33—239

mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin no// //de nas las kyi khyad par yang / /bskyed pa'i zhar la byung bas te/ /sgra las 'phel te rgyas bshad pas/ /'di ru bdag gis ①ma bshad do/ /las kyi khyad par gyi ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas spos kyi chu dag la/ /sngags bzlas pa yis bsangs dzu/byas te/ /phung po bsdus pa'i mchod pa lngas/ /rim bzhin byin rlabs mdun lagazhag nas/ /'di dag rim pa'i go rims kyis/ /se gol rim par ldan byas pas/ /rim bzhin bsdu ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /dzaḥhūṃ /④/baṃ hoḥldan byas te/ /mdun na mngon sum bzhin mthong nas/ /sa mā dzaḥkhyezhes brjod bya zhing / /'khor lo'i tshogs mchog de dag la/ /mnyam med la sogs bstod pa bya/ /de nas gtso bo'i sngags rings la/ /dṛ 'ush+ya zhes kyang brjod bya zhing / /a haṃ zhes dang ldan pa ni/ /bzhi yis rgyas btab don mchog 'grub/ /de nas mchod pa'i bye brag gis/ /mchod nas phyag bzhi bya ba ni/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i/ /gnas su bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /de dag ni sngon du bya ba'i cho ga'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas rang dga'i gnas nyid du/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor bri bar bya / /sa de gzhung bzhin spyong ba dang / /gzhung dang ldan par gzhung bzhin du / /bya ba'i bye brag gzhan na'o// //de nas mchod pa'i bye brag rnams/ /sngon du bstan pa bzhin byas te/ /spro ba'i sems ni rab bskyed de/ /tshig ldan phyag byas spos thogs la/ /tshig tu brjod pa'i sngags ldan pas/ /bstod de langs la 'akying bcas pas/ /bgegs bsal ṭ+wāṃdon du rab tu bskor/ /de nas phur bus gdab par bya/ /33—240

de nas phyag rgya bzhi bkug la/ /mchod de sbyin sreg ming rus la/ /bzlas te bya ba bstan pa yin/ /de la gzugs brnyan bshad pa ni/ /'khor lo rim gsum ldan pa la/ /snam bu mu khyud rnams kyis brgyan/ /rta babs dang ni twa ra na/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /ba dan gdugs dang rnga mas ༅brgyan/ /dril bu ras 'phan rgyal mtshan tshogs/ /de la sogs pa'i rgyan rnams ni/ /shin tu mdzes pas brgyan pa'o/ /zhes pa la sogs rgyan mchog ni/ /'di yi skabs su rim pas bstan/ /de dag ni gzugs brnyan gyi ting nge 'dzin to / /zhugazhan yang sbyin sreg byed pa na/ /las bshad de dag gzhan du med/ /bdag gi las dang gzhan dag ste/ /gshin dang gson pa'i las su bstan/ /de la bdag gis las bstan pa/ /shin tu dge ba'i shing bu ni/ /tsan+dan shug pa la sogs te/ /dri zhim ngad ldan mdzes pa'i shing / /khru gang khru do zhi ba la/ /rgyas dang dbang dang zu dgug pa dang / /drag shul spyod pa la sogs kyi/ /shing ni rim pas shes par bya/ /zlum pre'i dbyibs ④su brtsigs byas la/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas de yi thugs ka ru/ /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid gtso/ /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /thugs la gnas te zla steng thu bsam/ /de yi thugs kyi zla ba la/ /a las byung ba'i 'od 'phros pas/ /phyogs bcu'i gdug pa btul 6 byas te/ /slar bsdus bdag nyid bsreg ⑦byas la/ /zhu ba de las bskyed pa ni/ /thabs shes rang bzhin med pa'i gzugs/ /kha dog las dang mthun pa la/ /shin tu ring ba brang rus can—/ /dbu la ye shes sems dpas brgyan/ /de yi thugs kar zla steng dunu//33—241

a las bskyed pa'i yi ge zlo①/ /shin tu legs pa'i gzhal yas khang / /gong du bstan dang mthun pa la/ /shin tu legs pa sgo bzhi pa/ /shar phyogs gre ba'i ༄2sgo yin te/ /de dbus gsum las lha rnams bskyed/ /de la a yis byin rlabs te/ /sku gsung thugs dang ldan par bstan/ /de la sreg blugs dbul ba ni/ /mar dang til dang yam shing dang / /mngar gsum lde gu dkar gsum ni/ /zhi ba'i rdzas la bshad pa'o/ /rgyas dang dbang dang drag dang dgug /'di las gsungs pa'i dzas rnams ni/ /'di las ma gsungs gzhan dag la/ /rgyas par bstan te der shes bya/ /de nas gang dag zhi 'dod la/ /spyi bor zla stengs a bsgoms te/ /de nyid zhu bar gyur pa la/ /bya ba de nyid zhu 'gyur la/ /slar sos gzhon nu'i gzugs byas la/ /de la lhag par gnas par bya/ /de ni bdag gi don bya ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /gzhan don bya ba'i rim pa yang / /na dang shi ba gnyis yin te/ /de la 1 na ba'i las bya na/ /gang dag yid ni mi dran pa'i/ /bgegs kyi sbyor ba yod pa na/ /ting 'dzin 'di dag dran par bya/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bdag bsgoms te/ /de'i snying la zla ba bsam/ /de stengs a dang sum̐ dang ram̐/ /de las gyur te rab 'phros pas/ /phyogs bcu'i gdug 4pa kun btul te/ /mdzad pa'i las ni dran par byas/ /slar log bzhi yi 5gnas su thim/ /thim pas ye shes me 'bar te/ /gnod pa'i bgegs ni dran pa las/ /yungs kar brgya rtsa brgyad du bsreg /des kyang sos par ma gyur na/ /srin bus zos pa'i shing bu la/ /'bar ba'i me ni bus byas te/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du mar las ni/ /spyin sreg 'bum mam stong du bya/ /des ni nad las thar bar 'gyur/ /na ba 33—242

las thar pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas shi la phan gdags na/ /dang por gnod pa'i bgegs bsal nas//ro la phan pa'i cho ga ni/ /a yig 1 kun khyab spyi steng bsam/ /lhar 2gyur lha ni sngon bzhin bsam/ /a las ye shes lnga yis gang / /phan pa'i gnod sbyin chus btab pas/ /dang por bkru ba'i las yin no/ /de nas a yi 'phro 'du bya / /de ni sngon gyi cho ga'o/ /de nas gnas pa'i cho ga bshad/ /shi ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus bzhag ste//zhag gsum slob dpon smyung pyaganas la/ /bgegs bskrad la sogs byas nas ni/ /'khor los lha rnams mdun bsam ste/ /phyag 'tshal byespro bskyed la sogs bya/ /de nas tshig 'di ched brjod bya/ /tshe 'di dang por thu'abras bu ni/ /bdag gi gson 'di 'bras bur gcig /dam tshig lha dang mnyam par ni/ /bdag nyid gyur par som nyi med/ /byang chub sems dang sems gabyug par/ /phyir mi ldog par bdag 'gyur te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dze+erigs su ni/ / deng bdag —skye bar the tshom med/ /'di ni bdag nyid dam pa ste/ /mchod sbyin 'di ni bla na med/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spyan 'dren pas/ /ding 'di bdag 'dus mchog yin no/ /de nas phyag byas spos thogs la/ /spyan drang tshig 'di brjod par bya 6/ /kye dbang ni nges te bla na med/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/ /'di la phan gdags don ched du/ /gnas 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /'di la dbang ni stsal du gsol / /7de nas sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /rgyal mchog la sogs bsgom byas te/ /sgo 33—243

dbye la sogs gnas 'dir bshad/ /de rjes gsang sngags 'di brjod bya/ /a ā sarba ta thā ga ta z-i she/da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ byāḥbha ga bān/ dz+nyā na mūsnephya / bā gī shwa ra ma hā pā rngutsa/ sarba dhadz+re dze+eg ga na/ a ma la su pa ri shudha dhan+d+ra dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha ā3 ཿ/ zhes ni skyebarjod pa'i sngags bzlas so/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas nga rgyal dang / /ldan pas dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir/ /tshigs bcad 'di yis bstod par bya—/ /sangs rgyas kun la bstod bya ba/ /rang la bstod de nges pa'i mchog /'bras bu 'byin pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /shi la phan gdags zudon ched du/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mtha' rngu gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhad pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /de nas gsol ba btab byas nas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas nam mkha' la/ /mngon sum 'dra bar gang bar bsgom/ /de nas gang shi de nyid la/ /dmigs la a ā zhes bkod de/ /de la phyogs bcu rgyal ba dang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa/ /nam mkha' gang 33—244

bar 'dir gshegs pa/ /deng 'dir 'dus par bde gshegs te/ /deng tshobadag 'dus pa'i mchog yin no/ /de nas rnam rgyal chus bkang ba'i/ /bum pas bkrus te bgegs bskrad la/ /de nas de la bsrung bar bya/ /de nas til gyis 5zhe de la ni/ /bskor te sbyin sreg dbul bar bya/ /shi ba sta gon la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas sngon gyi spyor ba yis/ /cho ga rnams ni spyad par bya/ /dang po'i cho ga rim pa nas/ /'khor lo'i rim pa 'di gsungs te/ /phyi rol byung ste gtor ma sbyin/ /de nas khrus byas mchod pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus par ni 'dir bshad do/ /de nas phyi yi rim ldan pas/ /sngags pas chas gos ldan pa yicho//shin tu 'gying bas brgyan byas te/ /zhag bdun nang par sbyin sreg bya/ /mi nyid shi ba'i gnas byas te/ /shi la phan pa'i dkyil 'khor ldan/ /gzhal yas khang pa de 'dra ba/ /'di las gsungs te gzhan du min/ /'di ltar gsungs pa'i cho ga ni/ /bdag gis rang bzor byas min te/ /'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / /cho ga 'dus pa'i rgyud las te/ /de nas 'dir ni 'os pa yin/ /'di ni shi ba'i cho ga'o/ /shi ba la phan gdags pa'i ting nge 'dzin to // // skyode nas de la lam bstan bya/ /tshogs bsags 3dge ba'i don la sbyor/ /de mthar de nyid rtag bsgom dang / /de nyid mnyam shes ci mi tshugs/ /de la rtag gnas bde ldan te/ /rim pas a yi ngang nyid do/ /de yang bdag lus as khyab ste/ /de nyid a yis byin brlabs pas/ /a nyid dbyings kyi ngang nyid du/ /thams cad nam mkha' dang 'dra'o/ /rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin to // //533—245

de nas 'khor lo bstan par bya/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can/ /yan lag med pa'i rtsis las 'das/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo can/ /zhes pa 'di yi don bshad na/ /lus la 'khor lo bzhi gnas te/ /lte bar shes rab 'khor lo ste/ /bcu gnyis rtsibs dang ldan pa la/ /a ā saṃ āmiḥrim bzhin dgod/ /dbus na yi ge a mchog go/ /snying gar shes rab 'khor lo ste/ /bcu gnyis rtsibs dang yang dag ldan/ /de la sngags rnams dgod pa ni / /a ā/ i d+mā/ u spru/ e i/ o chag i bye.aḥzhes pa 'di dag rim bzhin du/ /'khor lo'i lce la dgod par byakye/ /mgrin par shes rab 'khor lo ni/ /bcu gnyis ldan pa'i rtsibs ldan 5 la/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na/bā gī shwa ra pradz+nyā na maḥzhes pa rnams/ /rim bzhin yang dag dgod par bya/ /de nas mtshog ltamar bsam pa ni/ /bcu gnyis ldan pa'i lce can la/ /sku yi sngags kyi phreng ba dgod/ /oṃ ༅ā sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ bye3 ཿbha ga bān dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ hūṃbā gī shwa ra/ ma hā pā 97 tsa sarba dhas+thā 4 ga ga na/ a ma la su pa ri shudhe dhas+thā hūṃdhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha s+dza/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba 'di/ /shes rab 'khor lo grags pa yin/ /'di ltar rtag tu gang bsgom pa/ /gzhon nu gzugs can bde ba 'thobarkye/ /grags 'dzin lus dang bde ldan lus/ /de dag spangs nas gzhan don du/ /rab dga'i lus su bskyed par nges/ /de ni bcu gnyis sa rdzogs te/ /kun tu 'od kyi sa chen po/ /de ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /bdud rtsi 'od ni gnyis pa ste/ /shin tu 'od gsal zla ba 'dra/ /nam mkha'i 'od ni gsum pa ste/ /nam mkha'i bzhi sngo1bzhin so sor gsal/ /rdo rje'i 'od ni bzhi pa ste/ /sa de nyid ni bzhi pa'o/ /bsam pa nang gi brtan 33—246

spyor bas/ /rdo rje zhes ni yongs su brtag /lnga pa rin chen 'od ces pas/ /dbang bskur ba la rab tu gnas/ /pad+ma'i 'od ni drug pa ste/ /pad+ma bzhin du rab tu skye/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos nyid phyir/ /dri ma med pas yongs su bzung / /bdun pa las kyi 'od ces pas/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las byed par 'dod/ /brgyad pa dpe med byed pa ni/ /de la dpe ni yod ma yin/ /dpe ldan zhes pa dgu pa ste/ /thams cad dpe ni so sor gcig /bcu pa shes rab 'od ces pas/ /sangs rgyas sa ni bla na med/ /bcu gcig thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ /sa chen rab tu 'od gsal ba/ /bcu gnyis so so rang rig pa/ /rnal 'byor ye shes rab tu rdzogs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rang rig pa'o/ /'khor lo rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de dag ni shes rab kyi 'khor lo bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas 'dir dbang dam pa gsungs/ /dbang bskur med na 'grub pa med / /yon tan ldan pa'i sngags pa yis/ /de la dbang byin yon tan grub//dang por khrus gsol brgyan pa ste/ /rgyal ba'i cha lugs 'dra ba dang / /bud med lta bu'i tshul ldan pakye / /slob dpon bla mar gyur pa la/ /dbang rnams nod pa rab tu gsungs/ /dang por sdig pa bsreg ༄nabyas nas/ /de la dbang dang dral bar bya/ /de dag kun gyi rim pa yang / /rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa ltar/ /'dir yang de dag bya ba yin/ /mchod pa'i las dang sbyin pa dang //rim par ldan pas dbang bskur te/ /de nas de la chu dbang bskur/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya'i dbang dang ni/ /cod pan dar dpyang bye/rdo rje dang / /bdag po'i ming la sogs pa dang / /dbang rnams rdzogs par spyin pa dang / /33—247

gsang ba'i dbang dang nges pa'i dbang / /rim pa bzhin du rab tu bsgur/ /de nas bkra shis gdon bya zhing / /rgyal po bzhin du 'gying 1bcas pasakhya/ /g.yog dang ldan pa'i slob dpon la/ /lan gsum bskor ba tshigs bcad kyis/ /bla ma de ni gzengs bstod bya/ /kye bdag ci rim pas dbugs phyung ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam la dgod/ /sa la nges pa'i dbang bskur te/ /shin tu gzi ldan bkra shis mchog /ces ni brjod la gshegs su gsol/ /de nas rang yang khyim du 'gro/ /khyim du phyin nas 'khor dag la/ /slob dpon 'dis ni dam tshig pas/ /bdag kyang dam tshig mchog dang ldan/ /'di la rim gro phun sum tshogs/ /rta dang glang po nor dang 'bru/ /rin po che dang ci bzhed pa / /khyed kyis nga la ma 'dri bar/ /slob dpon 'di la de phyir dbul/ /sangs rgyas kun dang thabs cig pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /shākya thub pa sangs rgyas la/ /rim pas gsungs pa'i bka' lung ni/ /mtshan brjod pa yi gsung rab 'di/ /shin tu rtogs dka' mngon sum min/ /rang rgyud tsam gyi rim pa dang / /theg pa chen po mngon rtogs pa'i/ /kun la thugs rje ma ༄ldan pas/ /brtse bar ldan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /yengs med gus pa'i sems kyis bris/ /'jam mgon dpal ldan ye shes sems dpa'i gnas/ /thugs rje ldan pa sku gsung thugs ldan pa/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud dang ldan pa ni / /mi dpya dang gtsug sems dang ldan par shog / 'phags pa zhematshan yang dag par brjod pa'i gsang ba dang ldan pa'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon chen po dpal ldan byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dz+nyā na shīrtis bsgyur zhing zhus te nyagatan la 33—248

༄ga /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i bklag pa'i bsgom gog1༄gro/ /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsgom pa 'di ni slob dpon gyi man ngag tu byas pa yin te/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dang por 'jug pa byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya ste/ de la zhugs te 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' mngon sum du byas nas kyang / sems can skyabs dang dpung gnyen med pa srid par lhung zhing ma grol ba rnams kyi don bya bar bsam mo/ /de ltar sems can gyi don )bya ba'i thabs kyang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis byas te de ni mdo sde'o//de nas bsod nams kyi tshogs yan lag bcu bsgoms te/ phyag btsal ba dang /mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / lam bstan 4pa dang /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / bcu bsgom mo / /sgo 33byed253

de la phyag btsal 1ba ni rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge a dkar po bsgom/ /a de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu nas sngon lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad srun drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs su gsol la/ rang gi rdo rje slob dpon gang yin yang de dag dang lhan cig tu zhugs par bsams la/ de dag gi mdun du thal mo sbyar la phyag 'tshal ldebar bya'o/ /de ltar phyag btsal nas mchod pa dbul te/ rnal 'byor pa dag gi thugs kar yi ge a bsgoms la de las kyang 'od zer spros te/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga me tog gi gdugs dang / ba dan dang / rgyan dang phreng ba la sogs pa dang /spos kyang —rang bzhin gyis dri zhim por 4sbyar ba'i dri mar thugyur pa'i dri dang spos rgya dang / mar me'i phreng ba dang / dri chab dang lha bshos dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa nam mkha' sprin phung tsam rgya mtsho ltar gtibs pas mchod par bsgom/de nas sangs rgyas de dag gi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags te/ dus gsum du bdag gis tresdig pa byas pa dang kye/ gzhan byed du sprul pa dang / byed pa la dga' bar spyor ba dang / dngos 67gzhi dang 'jug pa dang bcas pa thams cad bshags te/ dran pa ni khas blangs ma dran pa ni bsdus te/ 'gyod pa skyes nas phyis mi bya bar sdom pa blangs nas bshags pa'o/ /de yang bshags pa'i gnas 'phags pa dang / bshags bya dang / bshags pa po rnams mi dmigs par bsgom mo/ /33—254

de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / rnal 'byor pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gsum gyis ma 'dres pa la/ phrag dog med pa'i dga' ba dang / spro ba ni rjes su yi rang bar bsgom pa'o/ /de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig par bsngos la bsgom mo/ /de nas gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bsgom stermye/ sangs rgyas ni 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bsnyen te du skyabs su 'gro ba bsgom mo/ /chos ni chos bsgom pa bdag zumed pa'i chos la brten cing bsgoms la skyabs su 'gro'o/ /dge 'dun yang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi dge 'dun la skyabs su mi 'gro ste/ sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la brten cing bsgoms te skyabs su 'gro ba bsgom mo / /④de la lam bstan 'u pa ni/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas grub pa'i lam rdo rje theg pa'i don 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing mtshan brjod pa ni lam bstan ⑥ pa'o/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni bdag gis mesems can thams cad la bskyab pa'i don du sangs rgyas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi don bya'o bar bsgom par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas nas kyang sems can rnams ma rgal ba rnams 37bsgral ba dang / ma krol ba rnams dgrol ba dang / dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bya'o zhes rmye de 33—255

ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs yan lag bcu bsgoms nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol zhes bya'o/ /de nas dam bca' bar bya ste/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya bas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi 51sems de ring phyin chad bskyed par bgyi'o/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon rnams kyisathu / /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa bzhin/ /de bzhin bla med byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /bslab pa yi ni tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud ③pa dang / /sems can don gyi tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por so sor gzung 5ge / /de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ste/ 'di ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sdom pa sangs rgyas spyor bskyed pa/ /'di ni bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs kyi sdom pa gzung tre/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya gsum/ /bdag gis mi satong gzung 7bar bkyi/ / slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /3 rin po che'i sdom pa gzung 9/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi dus drug tu/ /brtan po nyid du sbyin par bya/ /pad+ma rigs kyi sdom pa gzung / /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba gsum/ /dam chos so sor gzung 11bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs kyi sdom pa gzung 1rta/ / bdag gis mi gtong gzung bar bgyi/ /nyu2gong du ma byung ba'i lhag ma kun 'di sems can gyi don bya ba dang / mi dge ba bcu spang ba dang / 'khor ba mi spang ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa dang du mi len pa dang / jeg pa chung ba dang 'jigs pa'i sa spangs pa dang / lha dang lha ma yin dang / gdon la sogs pa'i phyag rgya mi smad pa dang / de ring phan chad bla na med 33—256

pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi bar du gzung bar bya'o zhes dam bca'o // //tsho de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ ma rgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang / ma grol ba rnams gol ba dang / dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung (2ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o zhes sems bskyed do/ /de yan chod bsod nams kyi tshogs bsgom pa'o// //don dam pa byang chub kyi sems ye shes kyi tshogs bsgom pa ni/ dang po mngon par byang chub pa lnga bsgom pa yin la/ de ni ye shes lnga bsgom pa yin te/dang po chos thams cad mi dmigs la mi rtog rtepa/ rang bzhin med pa nam mkha' dang 'dra ba tha snyad tsam du yod la/ don dam par rang bzhin med pa de bzhin nyid rang bzhin gyes 'od gsal bar bsgom/ de nas me long lta bu'i ye shes bsgom ste/ dper na me long g.ya' dag pa'i nang du/ gzugs brnyan snang zhing gsal ba ltar rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ de las chos kyi dbyings rgyu /sasnamathun pa'i rnam par smin pa'i ye shes de las/ 'jig rten gyi rang bzhin gye sems can gyi gang zag phung po dang / chos thams cad ji ltar yin pa'i chos nyid kyi lge ngang de la phyin ci ma log par snang ba dang / sems rnam par dag pa log rtog glo bur gyi dri ma dang 'dra bas bsgribs pa tsam yin la/ sems can gyi sems chos kyi rang bzhin du gsal bar bsgom mo/ /sems can gyis de ltar mi 7 rtogs te/ 'gro ba las mi thar ba la snying rje chen po bskyed de/ 'gro ba las thar bar bya'o zhes bsgom mo/ /de nas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes chos thams cad bdag med par bsgom ste/ chos ni phung po dang / khams dang skye mched la bya/mu stegs pas brtags pa'i gang zag tu lta ba med8/ nyan thos pa'i chos rdul 33—257

tsam du yod par lta ba'i bdag med par lta ba dang / sems tsam pa'i sems yod par lta ba de yang bdag med par ltarmye/ chos thams cad la bdag med par bsgom/ de yang bdag tu 'dzin pa med pa dang / gzhan med pa dang /bdag gzhan med pa dang / chos thams cad bdag med par mnyam pa'o/ /mdor na rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum du bsgom mo/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ byesarba dhas+thā zlo ār+ya nut+pan+da /4tāta/ ces pas byin gyis brlab po/ /de la a ni a a nut+pan+da 5tāta/ ces pa ste/ chos thams cad ma skyes pa stong pa nyid ces bya ste/bdag gzhan stong pa nyid du mnyam par bsgom mo/ /de'i 'og tu so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes bsgom ste/ de ni bdag dang gzhan du phye ste/ gang zhe na/gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par 9dag pa'i mi rtog pa'i ngang las bdag dang gzhan du yang dag pa'i kun sdob tu 7phye ste/ rang gi mtshan nyid du bdag don bya ba'i gnas sems can gzhan mtshan ma med pa'i sgo nas/ so sor phye zhing brtag par byas te bsgoms nas/ spyi'i mtshan nyid don dam par mtshan ma med par shes pa'i so sor kun du rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de'i ngang las shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes bsgom ste/ gzung rngub dang 'dzin pa las 'das pa gcig dang du ma dang shin tu bral ba rnam par dag pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes stong pa nyid bco brgyad kyi rang bzhin nam/ rnam par thar pa bzhi'i rang gi ngo bo mi dmigs par bsgom mo/ /de'i ngang las smon lam dang thugs rje'i dbang gis/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis 'gro ba'i don bya ba'i phyir/ bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes bsgom ste/ dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes 'gro ba'i don bya ba'i rgyu bdag dang gzhan ⑩mtshan ma 33—258

med bzhin du so sor dmigs nas/ mi dmigs pa'i snying rje chen pos 'gro ba'i 7 don bya bar dran te/ sprul pa sna tshogs pas sprul cing spros nas sems can srid pa las bsgral te/ 'od zer gyis ngan song gsum la khyab nas sdug bsngal nye bar zhi bar byas nas/ sems can rnam par grol nas lha dang mi la bkod de/ de nas so so'i dbang po rim pa bzhin du dam pa'i chos kyi phyag rgya ste/ jeg pa gsum gyi chos kyis grol bar byas nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba dang /nyan thos rnams sems can gyi don la bcug nas/ jeg pa chen po la bkod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams srid pa la chags pa la stong pa nyid kyi don bstan nas sangs rgyas par bya'o bar bsgom pa ni bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes bsgom pa'o/ /de ltar 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems dang / smon pa byang chub kyi sems kun rdzob ste/ des ni bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / don dam byang chub kyi sems ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa — gnyis bsgom pa bstan nas / / da ni dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes bzhi'i thuting nge 'dzin bsgoms te/bdag gi sems gzung 'dzin rnam par dag pa'i ye shes las/ khro bo'i sa bon hūṃ tre7 sngo nag sangs rgyas kyi zhing drug khyab pa tsam cig 7bsgom mo/ /de'i 'phro 'dus sangs rgyas kyi zhing du khyab nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar t+t+waṃ bhel thim pa las khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing drug khyab pa ste/ de ni nyon mongs pa can gyi 'jig rten pa de 'dul ba'i don du bum pa la khro bo zhal drug ste/shar gye dbu sngo/ g.yas g.yon dkar/ lho ser nub dmar byang ljang gu'o/ /rtse mo lnga yar lta ba ye shes lnga/ mar lta ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin no/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / rdo rje'i ra ba dang / rdo rje'i dra ba'i sbubs su gyur pa nang stong 33—259

par bsgom mo/ /de'i nang du rja 1dkar po las rin po che'i mchod rten kha dog bzhi dang ldan pa/ tshad stong gsum byu 'jig rten khyab pa cig —bsgom mo/ /de'i bum pa'i nang du yi ge hri las chos kyi 'byung gnas dbyibs zur gsum du bsgom mo/ /de'i nang du yi ge a las kha dog sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram bsgom mo/ /de'i dbus su yi ge d+dhi /dkar po las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa twa ra ṇa dang bcas par bsgom mo/ /de yang sangs rgyas dang sems can chos nyid du mnyam pas gru bzhi'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i rang bzhin gyis shar gyi sgo'o/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi'i don gyis lho'i sgo'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i don gyis nub kyi sgo'o/ /dbang po lnga'i rang bzhin gyis byang gi sgo'o/ /stobs lnga'i rang bzhin gyis sgo srung cho bzhi'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyis dra ba dang dra ba 5phyed pa'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas rngogadugs dang me tog gi phreng ba'o/ /me long 7lta bu'i saye shes kyi rang bzhin gyis me long dang rin po che'o/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyis sems can rnams kyel chos ston pas/ 'dul bas 'dul ba'i rang bzhin dril bu dang dar gyi cod pan no/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bsams pas sum brtsegs su ⑫gyur pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi dbu rtse'i gtsug tor tu gyur pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi rang bzhin gyis twa ra ṇa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin mu ma chod skyepa bsgoms pas mu khyud ma chad pa'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rtags skyerdo rje phreng ba'o/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi — shā'od lnga'i kha dog gis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i nang du re mig dgu snam bu dang ldan pa la dbus su seng ge'i khri mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i rang bzhin no/ /stobs bcu dang ldan pa'i rtags su shar du glang po 33—260

che'o / /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i rang bzhin gyis lhor rta'o/ /dbang bcu'i rang bzhin gyis nub tu rma bya'o/ /phrin las rnam pa bzhis 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i rang bzhin gyis byang du nam mkha' lding gi khri'o/ /de dag gi steng du rin po che'i khri dang pad+ma'i gdan dang zla ba'i gdan brtsegs 1pa'o/ /de dag gi phyogs bzhi thams cad dang / mtshams kyi re mig dang snam bu dang gru chad 2la zla ba'i gdan bsgom mo/ /de la pad+ma ni thabs sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'o/ /zla ba ni dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub kyi myu gu bskyed pa'o / / de nas dbus su seng ge dang zla ba'i gdan la bdag gi sems gzung 'dzin dag pa'i ye shes de nyid yi ge a dkar po cig tu bsgoms la/ de'i 'phro 'du las rnam par snang mdzad chen po byang chub sems dang rang bzhin gcig pa/zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa zhal phyogs bzhir gzigs pa/ rgyan mi mnga' ba zhi ba'i rang bzhin dbu la ral pa gyen du 'khyel ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang dbyer med pa'i don sku mdog dkar po chos nyid la nyon mongs pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i rtags/ phyag brgyad thugs ka na byang chub kyi mchog gi phyag rgya bcas pa la snying rje dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin du bsgom mo/ /de'i thugs kar yi ge tweḥ las dang po'i sangs rgyas sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa dbu lnga la gtsug gi dbu sarta mgo dkar po ste/ khams gsum thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'am dbang du sdud pa'i rang bzhin no/ /zhal shar phyogs su gzigs pa sngo/ lho ser nub dmar/ byang ljang ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin no / /phyag g.yas pa bzhi na ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon pa bzhi na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa dum pa re re bsnams pa'o/ /nyon mongs 33—261

pa gcod pa'i rtags rteral gri dam pa'i chos ston pa'i rang bzhin dang ldan pas po ti bsnams pa/ chos kyi sgu'i rang bzhin yin pas sku mdog dkar po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang ldan pasnye / sna tshogs kyi na bzas brgyan pa/ phud bu lnga dang ldan par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo bsgom/ rtsibs drug la shar gyi rtsibs ni sngo g.yas g.yon ni dkar lho ser nub dmar/ byang ljang / mu khyud bzhi yang dkar/ rigs drug gi rang bzhin yin pas rtsibs drug go/ /rten cing 'brel pa'i rang bzhin yin pas 'khor lo mu khyud dang po la/oṃ sarba dhasgro rngu.a bha ba swa bhā ba bi shudha badz+ra a ā saṃ aḥ/ zhes pa bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa las sangs rgyas kyi sa bcu gnyis kyi sa bon/ a ā i yī u ā e i o au e aḥ/ bcu gnyis dgod/ rtsibs drug la shar gyi rtsibs la oṃ duḥkhats+tsha dā ya te na maḥ/ lho'i rtsibs la oṃ bā gī shwa rā ya te na maḥ/ nub kyi rtsibs la oṃ badz+ra ṭīṣ+ṭha ceya te na maḥ/ byang gi rtsibs la oṃ dz+nyā na kā yā /byete na maḥ/shar stod khukyi rtsibs la/ oṃ pradz+nyā 3dz+nyā na rūt+t+waṃ 37ye na maḥ/ shar smad du/ oṃ a ra pa tsa nā ya te na maḥ/ de'i phyi rol rtsibs mchan gyi mu khyud la sngags kyi phreng ba/ a ā sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya zhes pa dgod/ mu khyud phyi ma la ka kha sum cu rtsa gnyis dgod/ des mtshan bzang po ⑨ sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi sa bon yin no/ /'khor lo'i ste ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du yi ge aXhūṃ las bskyed pa'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcigahūṃ /phyag gnyis pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa byis pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/gtsug phud lnga dang ldan pa phyag gnyis na a la bsnams pa ste/mu / gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin dang ldan pa'i don to/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba'i 33—262

dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge a dkar po bsgoms te/ thams cad mkhyen pa dang 7sna lam mkhyen pa dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / gsum gyi rang bzhin can nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i gnas/byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskyed pa / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin bsgom pa'o/ /a de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/dang por bskyed pa'i rim pa las phyir 'phros pa'i mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang nas phyir 'phros pas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su sems can nyon mongs pa lnga dang / tshul khrims 'chal pa la sogs pa dag par byas te/ sangs rgyas par byas nas/ de las kyang phyir 'phros nas rdo rje khro bo'i zhal nas byung ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du khyab nas sems can gyi don byas te ④slar 'dus pas rim par yi ge a la thim par byas/ rdo rje dbyings kyi lha rnams su sprul la/ sangs rgyas mchod pa dang / sems can gyi don byas nas—/ yang be+er 'dus pas sems ma rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi ni dbus kyi gtso bo la bskor/ rigs lnga de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs ni gtso bo la thim par bya'o/ /rigs bzhi ni glang po che'i khri la mi bskyod pa la 'khor sems dpa' bzhis bskor ba/ rta'i khri la rin chen 'byung ldan la 'khor sems dpa' bzhis bskor ba/ rma bya'i khri la snang ba mtha' yas la 'khor sems dpa' bzhis bskor ba/ nam mkha' lding gi khri la don yod grub pa la 'khor sems dpa' bzhis bskor bar bsgom mo/ /mtshams kyi re mig bzhi la sgeg mo la sogs pa bzhi'o / /snam bu la mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang / byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug go/ /sgo bzhi'i gnas su sgo ba bzhis bskor bar bsgoms la/5 de 33—263

nas / 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa nas/ theg pa chen po'i tshul gyi mchog /ces pa yan chad bklag par bya'o/ /de nas mtshan gyi yig 'bru 'od zer dkar po spros te 'od zer gyis pi/sems can gyi nyon mongs pa gti mug la sogs pa dag par byas nas yang dag pa'i don dang ldan par byas te / slar 'dus pas mtshan gyi sngags brgyad cu rtsa drug yod pa rigs lngar phyes 2te phyogs bzhi nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la thim par bya'o/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad chen po mi snang bar byas nas④/ dbus kyi gdan la yi ge a las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar poshe/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dbu la ral pa gyen du 'khyil ba rgyan mi mnga' ba phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyar mdzad pa bsgom mo/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge dhīḥlas dang po'i sangs rgyas sku mdog dkar la phyag mtshan gong dang mthun pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa la mu khyud bzhi lte ba dang bcas par bsgom mo/ /rtsibs dkar po bcu la/ oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na muṭ+wā 6ya te na maḥ / zhes pa rim par dgod do/ /gzhan ma gong ma dang mthun no/ /dbus kyi lte ba la zla ba'i steng du yi ge a las 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' ye shes spyi gzugs zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' 7dkar po phyag g.yas na ral gri g.yon na 'khor lo bsnams pa zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ gzhon du rgyan kyis brgyan par bsgom mo/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge a dkar po bsgom/ de la 'od 'phros pas gong ma'i rim pa dang 'dra ba rnam par snang mdzad 'phros pas sems can gyi nyon mongs pa'i gnyi mug dag par byas te/ slar rim par 33—264

'dus pas yi ge a la thim ste/ mtshan gyi sngags ni sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /zhes pa nas/ rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che/ /zhes pa'i bar du bklag par bya'o/ /de nas sngags brjod pa 1tsam na sngags las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas 3rnam par snang mdzad mang po 1spros pas sems can kun de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su sangs rgyas par byas te / slar 'dus pa las mtshan gyi sngags brgyad cu rtsa gcig yod pa rigs lngar phye ste/ sum cu rtsa bdun de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la thim/ rigs bzhi'i sku phyag rgya sum cu rtsa drug be+em par bya'o/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad bsdus te shar du bkod nas/dbus kyi yi ge hūṃ ltalas mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rgyan mi mnga' ba ral pa'i dbu rgyan can phyag g.yas pas sa gnon pa bdud dang bgegs kyis 6mi bskyod pa'i rtagasakye/ phyag g.yon thugs kar ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du yi ge dhīḥlas dang po'i sangs rgyas sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gong ma dang mthun/ de'i thugs kar shes rab 'khor lo/ de'i rtsibs brgyad la kha dog sngon po mu khyud ni dkar po/ rtsibs brgyad la/ oṃ duḥkhastso dā ya te na maḥ zhes pa'i reyig 'bru re re dgod/ phyi ma gong ma dang mthun par bya/ dbus kyi lte ba'i yi ge hūṃ las bskyed pa'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' sdug bsngal gcod pa zhes bya ba sku mdog sngon po rgyan gong dang 'dra ba/ phyag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon rdo rje bsnams pa/ thugs kar zla ba la hūṃ 9sngon po bsgom mo/ /de las 'od zer rim par phyir 'phros pas mi bskyod pa khro bo'i rigs kyi 'od 'phros te/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dag par byas te/ slar 'dus pa las yi ge hūṃ la 733—265

thim par byas la mtshan gyi sngags ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /ces pa nas/ sgra dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog /ces pa'i bar du bklag par bya'o / /'od zer sngon po khro bor spros nas sems can gyi don byasarmye/ slar 'dus pa las mtshan gyi sngags bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod pa rigs lngar bsgoms la /phyogs bzhi nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la thim par bya'o/ /de nas mi bskyod pa slar bsdus te/ rang gi gdan la bkod nas rnam par snang mdzad nub kyi gdan la bkod de/ dbus gyi gtso bo la tweḥ1las snang ba mtha' yas bskyed/ sku mdog dmar po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin las mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can bsgom mo/ /de'i thugs kar dhīḥlas dang po'i sangs rgyas bsgom/ de'i thugs kar shes rab 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa kha dog dmar po/ oṃ badz+ra tī1 57ya te na maḥ/ yig 'bru brgyad dgodakye/ gzhan 'dra / dbus su zla ba'i gdan la yi ge dīḥdz+walas 'jam dpal rdo rje rgon po/sgu mdog dkar po phyag g.yas na ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon tsapad+ma thugs kar bsnams pa/ thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la dī—/ ཿbsgom/ de las 'od zer snang ba mtha' yas spro/ sems can gyi 'dod chags zhi bar byas te/ slar 'dus pas yi ge dīskyeḥl thim par byas/ yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid/ /ces pa nas/ ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal/ /yan chad 7brjod/ 'od zer dmar po spro bar bya'o/ /slar 'dus pa las mtshan gyi sngags ni nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa lngar bgos laphya/ dkyil 'khor la thim par byas te/ de nas snang ba mtha' yas rang gi gnas la bzhugs nas/ rnam snang lhor bkod de/dbus kyi gtso bo yi ge a las bskyed pa rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po 33—266

phyag rgyan /shemachog sbyin mdzad par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas—/ de'i thugs kar shes rab 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ oṃ bā gī shwa rā ya te na maḥyi ge 'bru brgyad dgod 3༄/ gzhan gong ma dang mthun/ de'i lte ba la zla ba'i steng du yi ge oṃ las 'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug sku mdog ser po phyag g.yon rin po che ༄ thugs kar bsnams pa/ g.yas pa ral gri 'phyar ba/de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge oṃ/ de las rin chen 'byung ldan spro / /be+er 'dus yi ge oṃ la thim/ /mtshan kyi sngags/ 'dod pa'i don grub dam pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ nor bu chen po rin chen tog /ces pa'i bar gyis (5)sngags brjod nas/ 'od zer ser po 'phros te sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pas mtshan gyi sngags brgya rtsa lnga rigs lngar bgos te/dkyil 'khor gyi lha la thim par bya'o/ /de nas rin chen 'byung ldan rang gi gnas su bkod nas/ rnam par snang mdzad byang gi gdan la bkod de/dbus su gtso bo yi ge a las bskyed pa/ don yod grub pa sgu mdog sna tshogs te ljang gu/ phyag gnyis skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de'i thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas/ de'i thugs kar shes rab 'khor lo ljang gu rtsibs brgyad pa / oṃ dz+nyā na kā yā ya te na maḥzhes 'bru brgyad dgod do/ /gzhan gong dang mthun/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i steng du gdan la yi ge a las bskyed pa'i 'jam dpal ye shes kyi spyi gtsug ces bya ba/ sku mdog ljang gu phyag g.yon pa na rdo rje 6rgya gram/ 3g.yas ral gri thugs kar 'phyar ba/ de'i thugs ka na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge a de las don yod grub pa spro sems can gyi don —byas / slar rim par 'dus pas yi ge a la thim par bya'o 1/ /de nas 33—267

—mtshan gyi sngags/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rtogs bya ba/ /zhes pa nas/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /ces pa yan chad bklag go/ /yig 'bru las 'od ljang gu 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus pa las mtshan gyi sngags dgu bcu rtsa lnga rigs lngar bgos te/ dkyil 'khor la thim par bya'o/ /de nas don yod grub pa rang gi gnas su bkod 1 de/ rnam par snang mdzad mi snang bar gyur nas/ dbus kyi gtso bo yi ge a las byang rtesems rdo rje bskyed de/sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can bsgom/de'i thugs kar gong ma bzhin du dang po'i sangs rgyas/ de'i thugs kar shes rab 'khor lo rtsibs dgu pa/ oṃ a ra pa tsa nā ya te na maḥyi ge 'bru re re dgod do/ /mu khyud gong ma dang mthun no/ /lte ba'i zla ba'i gdan la yi ge a las bskyed pa'i 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na zhes bya ba/ sgu mdog dkar po g.yon pas glegs bam bsnams nas thugs kar bzhag pa/ g.yas pa ral gri 'phyar ba/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge a bsgoms nas/de las rdo rje sems dpa' spro bar bya/ sems can gyi nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi bar byas te4/ slar 'dus pas thugs ka'i a la 5thim par byas nas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 6tshigs bcad brjod pa yin te/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rnam par snang mdzad chen po dbyer med pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni spyi'i rnal 'byor yin pas 'di ltar brjod par bya'o/ /rigs drug lha )rang gi yi dam byed pa'i tshe bsgoms nas brjod par bya'o/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i bklag pa'i bsgom 8khog /slob dpon dpal ldan byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //23—268
