che chung ni khru gang du bya'o/ /zabs su khru phyed brkos la/ kha khyer sor bzhis bskor bar bya ste/ dbus kyi kha khyer la rdo rje phreng ba gtang tsho7ngo / / de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo gtang ngo / //tre de nas rgyas pa'i thab khung ni kha dog ser po/rgyar khru do pa/ khru bzhi pa khru gang zabs su brko/ kha la sor bzhi bcu yod pas gru bzhir bskor ro/ /dbus kyi kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng ba btang /nang du pad+ma'i 'bras bu phyi rol gyi sor bzhi la pad+mas bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas dbang gi thab khung ni dbyibs zla gam la/ zla gam gyi kha la sor nyi shu tham pa yod pa/ rgya la sor bzhi bcu yod pa/ zabs su sor bcu bskor bar bya ste/kha dog ni dmar po'o/ /kha khyer la sor gsum kyis bskor/ dbus kyi kha khyer la mda' gzhu dang lcags kyu btang / de'i phyi rol du zhags pas brgyan pa'o/ /de nas mngon spyod kyi thab khung ni kha dog nag po/ dbyibs zur gsum pa/ngos re la sor zinyi shu'o/ /zabs su sor bcu brko'o/ /sor gsum phyir bkyed la kha khyer sor gsum gyis bskor/ dbus kyi kha khyer la rdo rje rtse gsum pas bskor/de'i phyi rgyab tu mda' gzhu dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dang dgra sta dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga spel la gtang ngo / /de la rang rang gi mtshan ma yang bri'o/ /de nas me sbar ba ni zhi ba'i me ni dgon pa'am/ 'on te gtsub shing las skyebaton la dngul la sogs pa'i snod dkar po'i nang du rlung yab kyis sbar la/ legs par 'bar ba dang / gzod bud shing gi nang du blugs so/ /rgyas pa'i me ni rgyal po'am/'on te bu mang po'i khyim nas blangs te/ gser ram ser po'i snod sar par sbar ro/ /dbang gi me ni smad 'tshong ma'i khyim nas blangs la zangs kyi kong dzibu sar par sbar ro/ /mngon spyod kyi me ni shan pa nag po'i khyem nas blangs la 33— 32

lcags kong /①sar pa'i nang du rlung yab kyis sbar la/ legs par 'bar ba dang / gzod bud shing gi nang du blugs so/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ zhes brjod cing mar gyi dgang blugs gsum gyis me gso bar bya'o/ /de nas thab khung de bsangs la/ dam tshig gi me lha bskyed par bya ba'i phyir thab khung du me tog gtor la/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan bskyed la/ de nas/dang po'i sangs rgyas bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa nas/ dbu la ye shes sems dpas phyebargyan/ /zhes pa'i bar ni dkyus nyid gsal lo/ /de nas ye shes kyi me lha shar lho mtshams nas spyan drang ste/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /asna ye re re pra be+e sha ya gephaṭa/ ā ④be sha ya aḥkhuzhes dam tshig dang gnyis su med par bstem mo/ /de la mchod pas mchod nas gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas dam tshig gi me lha'i thugs kar lha tshogs khyebaskyed de/ de yi thugs kar a las zla stengs su/ /zhes pa nas/ sku gsung thugs dang ldan par bsam/ /zhes pa'i bar kyis bstan te go sla'o/ /de nas rdzas kyi rim pa bstan pa'i phyir/de la sreg blugs dbul ba ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ni tsogong du bskyed nga/'i lha tshogs de la 'og nas 'byung ba'i rdzas rnams dbul bar bya'o zhes pa'i don to/ /mar dang til dang yam shing dang / /mngar gsum lde ldugu dkar gsum ni/ /zhi ba'i rdzas la bshad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni zhi ba'i rdzas so/ /rgyas dang dbang dang drag po dgug /de las gsungs pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /'di las ma gsungs gzhan dag las/ /rgyas par bstan te der shes bya/ /zhes 33—433

gsungs pa'i don ni 'di yin te/ zho zan dang / til dang / drurlu 37dang /'bras so ba dang / ku sha dang / 'bras kyi lag pan dang / nas chan dang /kro chan rnams bsog go zhes pa'i don to/ /de yang kha dog dang ro dang yam shing gi skabs su gsungs pa ltar 'dir yang ngo / /rdzas thams cad ni rnal 'byor pa'i g.yas su bsgrig par bya'o/ /mchod rdzas thams cad ni g.yon du bsgrig par bya'o/ /de nas dgang gzar blugs gzar kha sbyar zhing dbul ba ni zhi ba la mar/ rgyas pa la zho/ dbang la me tog at+pal/ mngon spyod la tsher ma dbul te sna drang ba'o/ /dbul ba ni sngags rings kyi zhabs la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ shādhi ku ru ye sdig pa la sogs pa zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par gyur cig swā hā/ pa shaṃ ku ru ye thams cad dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ mā ra ya phaṭa thams cad brlag par gyis shig /ā kar+ṣa ya thams cad khugs par gyur cig hūṃ dzaḥzhes brjod cing sreg rdzas rnams rim par dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas spyi bor yi ge a dkar po cig bsams la de'i 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang / 'thibs pa dang / rmugs pa dang / ma rig pa dang / zhe sdang la sogs pa rnams la phog pas ye shes kyi chus bkrus nas yang dag pa'i ye shes dang ldan par byas te/bkug nas bzhi zi po'i a la thim pas 'od du zhu ste/ lus mgo gzhug tu thim pas bag chags kyi lus sbyangs te/ slar gsos nas mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan par gyur te/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bde la mi rtog pa de la lhag par gnas pas lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /de nas rgyas pa'i ting nge 'dzin (snye spyi bo'i a las 'od zer 6ser po 'phros pas tshangs pa la sogs pa'i yang tshe bcud 33— 34

basbus nas bdag gi tshe'i gnas su thim zhing rgyas par bya'o/ /longs spyod 'phel bar 'dod na 'jig rten gyi khams khengs pa'i nor phyugs bkug cing rang gi nor phyugs la bsnyims te rgyas par bya'o/ /bu tsha 'phel bar 'dod na tshangs ris man chad kyi pho'i mtshan kun bkug ste/ pho mo'i skye gnas la bsnyims pas bu tsha 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dbang gi ting nge 'dzin ni yang a las 'od dmar po 'phros pas gang dbang du bya ba de 'od zer gyis bkug ste/ bdag gi mdun du mngon sum du 'ongs shing dbang du 'dus par bsams na rgyal po'i btsun mo lta bu yang dbang du 'dus par 'gyur ro/ /de nas drag po mngon spyod kyi ting nge 'dzin ni a de las 'od zer nag po 'phros pas bdag gis tshodagra bgegs la sogs pa'i gdug pa can rnams bkug ste bsgral nas phung po mchod yon du phul te brlag par bsam pa de'i phyir/ spyi bo zla stengs a bsgoms la/ /de nyid zhu bar gyur pa las/ /zhi bya de nyid zhu 'gyur te/ /slar gsos gzhon nu'i gzugs byas la/ /de la lhag par gnas par bya/ /zhes de la de skad ces bya'o/ /de yan chad ni bdag gi don gyi rim pa'o/ /de nas na ba la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ de la na ba'i las bya ba/ / zhes bya ba gruni gang zhig 'og nas 'byung ba 'di rnams yin no zhes pa'i don to/ /gang dag yid ni mi dran pa'i/ /zhes pa ni/ 'thibs pa dang / rmugs pa dang / smyo ba la sogs pa'o/ /bgegs kyi sbyor ba yod gyur na/ /zhes pa ni bgegs kyi rgyal po bi nā ya ka la sogs pa /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'o / /sbyor ba ni rims dang shu ba dang g.yan pa dang / mdze la sogs pa 33—435

yod na/ 'og nas 'byung lkub 'di ltar bya/ /zhes pa'i skyedon to/ /ting 1'dzin 'di dag dran par bya/ /zhes pa ni bdag stong pa'i ngang las yi ge dhīḥdakar po cig tu bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pa las dang po'i sangs rgyas de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu de'i steng du gzhi'i snying po sum̐ dang / spro byed kyi snying po ram̐ bsam/ re de las 'od 'phros pas chond la sogs pa rnam pa thams cad dang / de gtong bar byed pa'i bgegs dang / de'i rkyen la sogs pa rnams shin tu 'od zer kyis bzhu btul byas la slar nad la thim pas nad kyi dngos po thams cad zhu bar byas te phya be+er 'dus pa las 'bru nag po las skyebagegs kyi gzugs byas la/ gang gnod pa'i ming shog bu la bris te/ glan la de la nad kyi dngos po bstems la/ thim pa dang gzod zhi ba'i skabs su ji ltar gsungs pa ltar me sbar te/ sngags rings zhabs la bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi bar gyur cig swā hā zhes bzlas te yungs kar dang / til nag gis brgya rtsa brgyad du bsreg par byas na sos par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dang po'i 3sangs rgyas bsgom bya ste / /zhes pa nas/ yungs kar brgya rtsa brgyad du bsreg /ces pa'i bar du gsungs so/ /gal te sems snyepar ma gyur na/ /srin bus zos pa'i shing gdug pa can khru gang pa la tsha ba gsum gyis bskus te de la me sbar la gong ma lta bur bgegs dang nad 9dgug gzhug byas la bsreg par bya ste/ lhag ma ni dkyus gsal lo/ /na ba la phan gdags pa'i rim pa'o /de nas shi ba la phan gdags pa bstan pa'i phyir/ de nas shi 7la phan 33—436

gdags na/ /zhes pa ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba 'di rnams so/ /dang po gnod pa'i bgegs bsal nyute/ /zhes pa ni/ rigs kyi bu pho mo don dang ldan pa gang rung cig tshe'i 'du byed du khyegyur na/ phung bo de drod dang ma bral bar bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas ro la gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug la/ sha chang dang sgog btsong dang / la phug dang / 'bras chan dang / khur ba la sogs pa'i gtor ma cha gcig gis byen gyis brlabs la bdud rtsi sbyin pa'i sngags kyis byin la rdo rje'i —tshig tu 'di skad brjod/ su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /gshin rje srin po gang yang rung / /sngon gyi lan chags ded pa rnams / /mthun pa'i gtor ma 'di long la/ /tshe 'das 'di la ma mnar cig /ces byas la gtang ngo / /de nas yungs kar gyi rgyal pos brab cing sngags rings bzlas la mtshams bcad do/ / de ni jephyi rol la phan pa'i cho ga zhes pa'o/ /de nas ro de'i spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du yi ge a dkar po cig bsams la de 'od du zhu ba las lus thams cad khyab par byas te/spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba smin mtshams dang lngar rim par rnam snang dang /'od dpag med dang / mi bskyod pa dang / don thams cad grub pa dang /rin chen 'byung ldan rnams 'khor dang bcas par gyur par bsam/ lha re re'i spyi bo na yang a dkar po re re yod par bsam pa de'i phyir/ a yis kun khyab spyi steng sa7bsam/ /lhar gyur lha ni sngon bzhin bsam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rang rang gi spyi bo'i a las 'od 'phros pas dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi bcud bsdus te kha dog lnga dang ldan par byas te/ rang 33—437

rang gi spyi bor thim pa las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang ldan par byas te/ lus thams cad ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gnas pa'o/ /de'i phyir/ a las ye shes lngas gang nas/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /phan pa'i gnod sbyin chus btab hūṃl/ /zhes pa ni chu gtsang la oṃ ldubadz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la / phung po lnga'i rnam par rtog pa sbyang ba'i phyir sngon du gsungs pa'i lha tshogs byel sku khrus gsol bar bya'o/ /de'i phyir/ dang po bkru ba las yin te//zhes gsungs so/ /de nas a yi 'phro 'du las/ /zhes pa ni bdag gi thugs kar a dkar po bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'gro drug gi bag chags sbyangs / tshe las ④'das pa'i shes pa bkug la phya/ ro la bcug la/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa la thim par bsam mo/ /de ni sngon gyi cho ga'o zhes pa ni de ltar gong du gsungs nas ni ro'i sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga yin no zhes pa'o/ /de nas zhes pa ni gong du 'gro ba byas pa'i de ma thag pa nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga 'di bshad do zhes pa'i don to/ /shi ba dkyil 'khor dbus bzhag kyeste/ /zhes pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa'i ro de maṇ+ḍal kyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la gzhag go/ /zhag gsum slob dpon sgyung gnas pa/ /zhes pa/ zhag gsum kha zas kyi tshod bzung ④la/ dkar gsum la sogs pa bza' zhing / nyin re la thun gsum gsum lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya'o zhes pa'i don to/ /bgegs bskrad la sogs byas nas ni/ /zhes pa/ thun re re la lho sgo'i cho ga re re la'o/ /de yang rgyud nyid las/ sems can kun gyi ngan song gsum/ /sbyong bar byed pa'i 'dzum bstan nas/ /zhes pa dang / ngan song thams cad 33—438

rnam sbyong ba/ /mgon po sems can kun gyi mchog /ces gsungs so/ /'khor lo lha rnams mdun bsam ste/ /zhes pa ni de ltar zhag gsum du byas pa'i nang par 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcings te/ oṃ mañju shrī badz+ra tsakra hūṃ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' la bsams la/ de la mchod pa'i phyir/ phyag btsal rdo rje bskyed snasogs bya/ /zhes pa bcu yongs su dag pa dang sdom pa gzung bar thu byas la de nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i/ tshe 'dir dang por 'bras bu yod/ /ces pa nas/ 'di la dbang ni sprul du gsol—/ /zhes pa yan chad brjod par bya'o/ /de nas sbyor ba dang po dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin bya'o/ /de nas sgo dbye ba thubya ste/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni rab tu brkyang / /mthe chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ /sgo dbye ba yi phyag rgya ste/ /oṃ mañju shrī badz+ra dha rot+ta ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod de/ gzhal yas khang sgo dbye bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rjer sgrub pa dang / tshogs bsags 4pa yan chad 'dir shes par bya'o/ /de nas sngags rings kyis lha thams cad gsal bar byas la/ thun gsum gyi rnal 'byor zhag bzhi ru bya'o/ /de nas gang zhig de nyid la/ /zhes pa nas/ shi ba sta gon la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes pa yan chad kyis don la gnas par bya ste/ dkyus nyid gsal lo/ /de nas/dkyil 'khor chen po 'dri ba'i tshe/ /dang po sangs rgyas nga rgyal dang / /zhes pa nas/ mngon sum 'dra bar gang bar bsgom/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gsol ba gdab pa ste/ dkyus gsal lo/ /de nas bri ba bstan pa'i phyir/ /shi la phan gdags dkyil 'khor ldan/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni rdo rje 33—439

dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lta bu la dbus kyi pho brang me thab tu byas la/ gzhal yas khang pa de 'dra ba/ /zhes pa ro sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor yin no zhes pa'i don to/ /'di las gsungs te gzhan du zhes pa ni gong du gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor de lta bu ni ro spyong ba'i don du yin gyi dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i don du ni ma yin no zhes pa'i don to/ /zhag bdun nang par sbyin sreg bya/ /zhes pa ni/ de ltar ro la bsnyen pa zhag bdun du byas nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i tshe sbyin sreg bya'o zhes pa'i don to/ /de yang ji ltar bya zhe na/de nas phyi yi rim ldan pas/ /zhes k+ṣegasungs te/ phyi'i rim ldan ni dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du 7ṭ+wābagegs bskrad pa dang / gar la sogs pa'i rol mos mchod pa dang phung po la sogs pa drang bar bya'o zhes pa'i don to/ /de yang ji ltar 4zhe na/ sngags pa chas dzugos ldan pa yis/ /shin tu bsgyings pa ldan byas te/ /zhes gsungs te/ chas gos ldan pa ni dbu rgyan dang / rna rgyan dang /6 mgul rgyan dang / do shal dang / mgur chu dang / dpung rgyan dang / gdu bu dang / sor gdub dang / rkang rgyan dang / gos ni stod g.yogs dang / smad g.yogs so/ /ldan pa ni de rnams 'dzom pa'o/ /bsgyings pa ni shin tu 'gying bag dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' kyem bskor bar bya zhes pa'i don to/ /de nas sngon gyi sbyor ba yis/ / cho ga rurnams ni dpyad par bya/ /dang po'i cho ga'i rim pa nas/ /'khor lo'i rim pa 'di gsungs te/ /zhes pa ni/ lce lag byin gyis brlab pa nas/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa yan chad bya ste/ de nas gzod ro de me thab tu bzhag ste/dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / las rgyal mchog dang / phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 33—440

gdab pa yan chad byas te/ gzod me sbar bar bya'o/ /de yang ji ltar sbar zhe na/sngon du zhi ba'i skabs su ji ltar 'dir yang rgyas par byas la gzod bsreg pa'i las byas te/ de la yang gsum ste/ ro mchod gnas su bsreg pa dang / ro ltar bsreg hūṃpa dang / ro sreg rdzas su bsreg pa dang gsum du shes par byas la bsreg go/ /rdzas dbul la sogs pa'i rim pa sngon du shes par bya'o/ /de'i phyir—/ me nyid shi ba'i gnas sbyangs te/ /zhes gsungs pa kho na'o/ /de nas khrus byas mchod pa'i tshogs/ /zhes pa ni/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams la rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi chus bsangs la/ me tog la sogs pa lnga dang lha mo brgyad dang / de las gzhan pa'i mchod pa dang / mchod pa nyi shu pas kyang mchod pa2 /bstod pa rnams kyis dzu bstod do/ /de'i phyir/ ma lus par ni 'dir bshad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa las gsungs pa ltar phyogs skyong la gtor ma sbyin no/ /de nas de la lam bstan bya/ /tshogs bsag dge ba'i don la sbyar/ /zhes pa'i don ni lho sgo'i cho ga las shes par bya'o//de mthar bdag nyid rtogs sgom dang / /zhes pa ni de ltar byas pa'i rjes la bdag nyid mi dmigs par bya'o zhes pa'i don to/ /de nyid mnyam shes pa ni bdag nyid yang dag pa'i thugs dang / tshe las 4'das pa'i shes pa gnyis mnyam zhing dbyer med par shes par bya'o zhes pa'i don to/ /cis mi tshugs zhes pa ni de ltar rtogs na nyon mongs pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs so zhes pa'i don to/ /de la rtag gnas bde ldan dang / /zhes pa ni/ thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi don de la rtag par gnas na yang dag pa'i ye shes phyin ci ma log pa'i don bde ba dang ldan no zhes pa'i don to/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i don 33—7/41

bstan nas skabs 'dir ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol ba la sogs pa bya ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i skabs su lkuji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni rim pas/ a'i ngang nyid du zhes gsungs te/ rim pa ni ye shes kyi rdo rje mchod rten la thim/ mchod rten chos 'byung la thim/ byerdo rje rgya gram la de gzhal yas khang la/ de lha tshogs la/de gzhi'i sangs rgyas la/ de dang po'i sangs rgyas la/ de shes rab 'khor lo la / de ye shes sems dpa' la/ de zla ba la/ de a la thim mo de nyid la a'i ngang nyid du/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar bdag gi ngo bo yi ge a dkar po'i ngang nyid du gnas pas gru/ de yang bdag lus as khyab pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de nas a de'i byin gyi rlabs 7kyis bdag gi shes pa 'od du zhu nas thig le byang chub kyi sems skye ba med pa'i ngang du rtogs te/ nye ba'i dpes mtshon na 'dus ma byas pa'i nam mkha' dang 'dra bar gnas te/ de kho na la/ de nyid a yi byin rlabs las / /a nyid dbyings kyi ngang nyid du/ /thams cad nam mkha' dang 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas ji ltar gsungs pa'i don kyi rnal 'byor pa'o/ /de yan chad shi ba la phan gdags pa'i rim pa'o// //de nas 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi'i don bstan pa'i phyir/ de nas 'khor lo bstan pa zhes pa'i don ni 'og nas 'byung ba 'di nyid yin no/ /de yang / bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can/ /yan lag med pa'i rtsis las 'das/ /bsam gtan bzhi yi rtse mo can/ /zhes gsungs te/ lus la 'khor lo bzhi gnas te/ /33—442

lte ba shes rab 'khor lo ste/ /rtsibs ni bcu gnyis yang dag ldan/ /dang po'i rtsibs nas brtsams te dgod pa ni/ a ā saṃ āḥ.a ā saṃ āḥ.a ā saṃ āḥganas so/ /rtag pa shes rab yig 'bru'i 'khor lo'o/ /pho brang lha'i 'khor lo ni lte ba la mi bskyod pa/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'/ rgyal po chags pa legs pa/ sems ma rdo rje ma sgeg mo dang / bdug spos ma dang / sgo ba lcags kyu dang / byams ①pa 'jam dpal/ spos kyi glang po ye shes tog kyedang bcu gnyis so/ /lte bar shes rab 'khor lo grags/ /snying gar shes rab 'khor lo ni bcu gnyis rtsibs dang ldan pa la/ rim pa bzhin du dang por a dgod/ a ā—/ i thog u u/ e i/ o ā+o i aḥdagod par bya'o/ /rtag pa shes rab yig 'bru'i 'khor lo'o/ /pho brang lha'i 'khor lo ni lte bar rin chen 'byung ldan/ rdo rje rin chen/ nyi ma/ rgyal mtshan/ bzhad pa/ rin chen sems ma dang / me tog ma dang / phreng ba ma dang / sgo ba zhags pa/bzang skyong / blo gros rgya mtsho/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa dang bcu gnyis so/ /'di ni snying ga'i shes rab 'khor lo'o/ /mgrin pa ( —shes rab 'khor lo ni/ /bcu gnyis rtsibs dang yang dag ldan/ /rim bzhin rtsibs gcig pa la a/ /a ra pa tsa na/ wā gī shwa ra pradz+nyā na maḥdagod/ rtag pa shes rab yig 'bru'i 'khor lo'o/ /pho brang lha'i 'khor lo ni/ /lte ba la snang ba ④mtha' yas/ rdo rje chos rgyu/ smra ba/ rnon po chos kyi sems ma dang /glu ma/ mar me ma/ sgo ba be+egs sgog /mthu chen thob ༄5dang / ngan song kun 'dren dang / mya ngan 'joms dang / dra ba can kyi 'od dang bcu gnyis so6 / /mgrin pa shes rab 'khor lor dzagrags/ /spyi bo shes rab 'khor lo ni//33—443

bcu gnyis rtsibs dang yang dag ldan/ /rtsibs dang por ha ra ha ra/ ta thā ga ta/ oṃ k+shi dz+rīḥbha ga wān dz+nyā na rūrti/ bā gī shwa ra ma hā wā ①tsa sarba dharma ga ga nā ma la su pa ri shudha dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha s+dza/ rtag pa shes rab yig 'bru'i 'khor lo'o/ /pho brang lha'i 'khor lo ni lte ba la don yod grub pa/ rdo rje las dang / srung ba dang / gnod sbyin khu tshur/ las kyi sems ma/ gar ma dri chab ma/ sgo ba dril bu/ zla 'od/ 'od dpag med/ nam mkha' mdzod/sgrib pa sel ba/ mtshog khum shes rab 'khor lor grags/ /ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal/ /zhes pa bzhu btul ni 'khor lo'i gdams ( ༄ngag bla ma las shes par bya'o/ /de ni pho brang lha'i dkyil 'khor dang / lus gnas rtsa'i 'khor lo dang / lhag 4pa shes rab kyi 'khor lo dang gsum gsal bar bstan to/ /de ltar bsgoms pas 'bras bu bstan pa'i phyir/ de ltar rtag tu gang bsgom pa/ /zhes pa ni/ rigs kyi bu gang la la zhig gis de ltar bsgoms na 'og nas 'byung ba'i gzhon nu'i gzugs can bde ba thob ces gsungs pa ste/ gzhon nu ni 'jam dpal lo/ /gzugs can ni de'i sku la mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'o / /bde ba thob pa ni de'i thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes thob pa'o/ /drag 'dzin lus ni 77ngan 'gro'o/ /de dag spangs nas zhes pa ni/ /gong du gsungs pa'i don de ltar bsgoms pas khams gsum kyi nyon mongs pa spangs nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i gzhan gyi don phyin ci ma log pa yang grub ste/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su skye bas na/ /rang dga'i lus su skye bar nges/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas/ des sa bcu la bgrod par bstan pa ni/ dkyus nyid gsal lo/ /de 7ni shes rab 'khor lo bsgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /33—444

de nas lhag par gnas pa'i slob ma de dbang bskur bar bya ba'i phyir/de nas/ 'di ni dbang bskur dam par gsungs/ /zhes pa ni/ sngon du lhag par gnas pa'i slob ma de 'dir dbang bskur bar bya'o zhes pa'i don to/ /de ma bskur na cir 'gyur zhe na/ dbang bskur med na dngos grub med/ /ces gsungs te/ de nas slob dpon gyis bya ba'i rim pa bstan pa'i phyir/yon tan ldan pa'i sngags pa zhes gsungs te/ yon tan ldan pa'i slob ma dbang bsgur ba'i sngon du slob dpon nyid kyis ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs la/ dbang blang ba la sogs pa byas la/ gzod slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug par bya'o zhes pa'i don to/ /des cir 'gyur zhe na/ de la dbang byin ①yon tan grub/ /ces gsungs te/ de nas slob ma gzhug par bstan pa'i phyir/ dang po ⑤khrus byas rgyan gon te/ zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa'i don ni 'di yin te slob dpon du 'os pa'i bla mas las thams cad pa'i chus bsangs la rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlabs te/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan la/ rdo rje gnod sbyin yongs su bzlas pa'i gos dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gyon la/ oṃ badz+ra tīkyā hūṃ phaṭa ces bzlas pa'i gdong g.yogs dmar po bcings la/ yon gyi dam pa dag phul ba yongs su blangs te/de'i snying ga dang / dpral ba dang / lkog ma dang / spyi bo rnams su rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma rtedang / sna tshogs rdo rje zla ba'i steng du de'i sa bon gyi rnam par bkod la phyogs bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byed du bcug la/ de nas sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i 33—445

dam tshig gi phyag rgya 'dzin du gzhug cing de bzhin du phreng ba 'dzin du gzhug go/ /de nas slob dpon kyis ①'di skad ces bsgo ba bya ste/ skal dang ldan pa rigs kyi bu/ /khyod ni ci dang ci la dga'/ /'dod don gang yin khyod kyis smros/ /de nas slob mas 'di skad ces⑤/ /bdag ni gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rab tu blta ④bar bgyi ba dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'i gong mchog tu/ /bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal lags so/ /de gerjes slob dpon dam pas kyang / /'di skad ces ni brjod par bya/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba'i/ /yang gsang dam pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis rngu bu khyod gzhug par bkyi/ /grong khyer la yang grong khyer de/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i gong mchog tu/ /bu khyod rab tu gnas par bgyi/ /skal dang ldan pa khyod kyis kyang / /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshol la⑥/ /sdig pa ma lus sbyang byas nas/ /sdom pa rnams ni legs par zung / /mchog tu sems kyang bskyed par gyis/snga/ /ces brjod do/ /de nas don dang ldan pa'i slob ma 'khor dang bcas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la phyag byas la/ bcu yongs su dag pa nas sdom pa gzung ④ba yan chad byed du gzhug go/ /de nas 'di skad bsgo'o/ /ding khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad grub pa yang thob na gzhan lta smos kyang 1ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par byas kyis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la ma smra shigapya /dam tshig nyam nyu1par gyur ta re/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya kha thur du bstan pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni khyed kyi 33—446

rdo rje dam tshig gis gal te 'ga' zhig la smras na klad ①pa 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dam tshig phyag rgya 'di ⑤nyid dang mna' ①chu'i snying pos sngags ④la slob mas rjo'athung du gzhug go/ /de'i mna'i snying po ni 'di yin te/ hūṃ rdo rje dam tshig deng khyod nyid/ /snying la yang dag zhugs mdzad kyis/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na rjoni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭhaḥ④/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i ④chu 'dis 'grub/ /rdo rje dril bu ⑨ phyag rgya rnams/ /gal te dkyil 'khor ma mthong smras/ /skye bo'i tshogs na 'dug pa 'am/ /dad pa med la bstan mi bya/ /de nas slob ma la 'di skad bsgo'o—/ /deng phan chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de yang bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /mi bde ba ma spangs pas khyod dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re zhes smras la 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur zhes smos shig par bsgo'o⑩—/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis myur ba nyid du rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad brjod do/ /'di ni khrod kyi dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /de ring nyid du 'bab par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā ⑪be+e sha aḥtshu zhes brjod do/ /de nas phyag rgya bcings pa las byung nas de'i snying gar zhugs te rdo rje sems dpa' 'bab par gyur par bsams na 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /yang ho a ha zhes bya ba yang rang gi snying ga la bkod la/ se'u'i me tog dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' rang gi 33—447

dam tshig dang bcas pa rang gi snying gar nges par byung skyel/ badz+ra ban+ta traṭa ces ༄2pas de'i snying ga phye la der bcug ste rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya bcings la sngags brjod la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gang bar gyur par bsams na yang 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po mngon ༄ par rtogs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig gis bdun nam brgyad rdzogs pas kyang 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /slob ma'i gtso bo'i snying gar rdo rje bya/ /yig brgya phyed pas mnyam gzhag brtan byas nas/ /bdag lus gang yin snod kyi sgo phye zhing / /snying la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i dbus su blta—/ /sngags kyi bdag po yi ge a dmar gsungs/ /brjod pas yang dag chags pas g.yo bar blta/ /slob ma'i lus 'di sgo ni dbye byas par/ /zhugs nas rdo rje byas pa'i snying la gnas/ /ma lus lus pa rngu kun du bkang nas su/ /rkang pa g.yon pas g.yas pa mnan nas ni/ /sngags pas slob ma'i snying ga gede la dbab/ /kun du dril bu'i sgra ni yang dag dkrol/ /lag pa pad+ma 'dab ma'i phyag rgya byas/ /mi bskyod rin chen la sogs bde gshegs rnams/ /rang gi phyogs phyogs nas byon 'od phab pas/ /legs babs gyur pas rang gi bu la blta / /gang zhig des kyang 'bab par ma gyur na/ /lag pa g.yas par til gyi sa bon gzhag /dbus su yi ge hūṃ yang rnam bkod de/ /rdo rje 'od 'bar ba ni rnam par bsam6/ /g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub phyag rgyar byas pa yis/ /blang bar byas la me la sbyin sreg bya/ /lus ni thal bar byas la rnam dag pa'i/ /bsod nams lus la'ang sngags kyi 'od kyis dgang / /ye shes bab pa nyid du bsams nas ni/ /rdzas bzhin 'bab pa nyid du rab tu 'gyur/ /la la dag gis legs par bshad pa na/ /mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gcigs pa yis/ /33—448

rtse mo 'od dkar g.yo zhing dgod pa'i zhal/ /smin ma gdengs pas phyogs bcu ma lus pa/ /'brug sgra lta bu hūṃ ni 'jigs pa'i sgra/ /sangs rgyas me tog chun phreng gnyis btags pa/ /'od chen sna tshogs ldan par rang gi lus bsgoms la/ /sngags pas rang gi bu yi mig phye ste/ /'khor lo 'di dag ma lus bstan par bya//gang tshe der ①ni ci yang ma mthong na/ /rang las byung ba'i 'od kyi phreng ba yis/ /de yi snying la snang bar byas la de nas ni/ /'di ni nyis 'gyur mig tu 'gyur bar bsam/ /de yi 'od kyis mig gnyis bskul bas na/ /de tshe cung zad nges par mthong bar 'gyur/ /des kyang de bzhin mtshan ma ma zhumathong na/ /rjes mthun gnas pas bden pa'i byin rlabs bya/ /'gro ba'i don la chags bral ma mdzad ces/ /brtul zhugs can gyis der sogs kyis bsgul zhing / /pus mo gnyis ka sa la btsugs nas ni/ /gzugs mthong phyir ni mchod pa dbul bar bya/ /de babs tekro/ babs ma thag tu lha'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur zhing /ye shes des ni pha rol sems su 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher sbyar ro / /de nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes bya ba la sogs pas de'i snying ga'i phyag rgya dgrol bar bya'o/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'dis bden pa'i byen rlabs gebarjod par bya'o/ /'di ltar bdag gi du slob ma 'di/ /dkyil 'khor du ni legs bcug nas/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag /'di yi bsod nams ci 'dra las/ /de bzhin du ni 'bab par 'gyur/ /'di ni dngos grub gang grub pa/ /rigs ni gang gi snod gyur dang / /bsod nams mthu ni gang yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin 'gyur/ /de nas/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni/ /'gro la phan pa'i gtso chen gyis/ /33—449

sman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /hūṃ pra tre+ets+tsha badz+ra ho zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis phreng ba dkyil 'khor du dor ro/ /de nas dngos grub rab 'bring me tog 'bab pa las brtag par bya ste/ lha rnams kyi khyad par dang gnas kyi khyad par las brtags te/ gang rmye tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das3/ /dbu la me tog 'bab 1 'gyur na/ /de tshe gtsug tor mdzod spu ④dag /'grub par 'gyur bas gdon mi za/ /sbyan la sogs pa rnams kyang ni/ /zhal du babs ⑤par gyur pa na/ /stod du babs khye)na mchog rnams grub/ /rked du babs ⑦na 'bring rnams grub/ /ro smad phyogs su babs kye7 na ni/ /dngos grub tha ma rnams 'grub tsu7'gyur/ /bar gyi sku la babs ⑩na ni/ /snying po la sogs grub par 'gyur/ /smad du babs par gyur na ni/ /mngag gzhug la sogs grub par 'gyur/ /rim pa de dag thams cad ni/ /rim ⑪bzhin rnam par shes par bya/ /de bzhin lha rnams gzhan la yang / /dngos grub rnam pa gsum du bshad / /gal te lha yi gzugs dag la/ /me tog ring du lhung gyur na/ /de yi dngos grub yun rings 'grub/ /nye na dngos grub myur du 'grub/ /gsang sngags rnams kyi mchod pa dag /gang du bkram pa'i tshul can ni/ /de yi sa ris de yin te/ /me tog der lhung de yi rigs/ /lha gnyis kyi ni bar dag tu/ /gal te nges par babs gyur na/ /gang du nye ba de yi rigs/ /gal te la la'i me tog ni/ /dkyil 'khor mang po 'das nas bab/ /de la dngos grub mi 'grub cing / /bsod nams dad pa rab tu chung / /gal te me tog dor ba dag /ra ba'i ri mo la bab ⑫na/ /zhi ba byas nas de dag gdod/ /nan tan bskyed de 'dor du gzhug /de ste the tshom gyur na ni/ /mkhas pas 33—450

bzlas te 'dor mi gzhug /de ni gang yang nye med pas/ /des ni dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /gnyis kyi bar du mnyam pa na/ /don med phyi rol lhung na ni/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byas nas su/ /de nas me tog dor du gzhug /snying por me tog babs pa ni/ /rtag tu don med mi 'gyur bshad/ /srad bu dag ni cho ga bzhin/ /de yi nye 'khor shes par bya/ /de la sogs pa'i rnam pa yis / /me tog rnams ni dor ba las/ /bdag gi mdun du gang lcung ba/ /de la zhi ba brtsam par bya/ /sbyin sreg /rngugis ni zhi byas nas/ /de ni slar yang dor rngu du gzhug /lan gsum spogs te 'dor kyin yang / /gal te legs par ma bab na/ /re thag bcad de slar gtang bya/ /de nas me tog babs pa las//lha yang dag par shes byas nas/ /phreng ba blangs te sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ pra ti kṛṇ+ḍa twa ④mi saṃ satwa ma hā ba la zhes brjod la de'i mgo la bcing ngo ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan ma nye bar mtshon nas/ de la mig gis ji ltar mthong zhes dri'o/ /des ji ltar mthong ba bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gal te kha dog snang bar mthong na/ de la dngos grub thams cad kyi ye shes bslab thupar bya'o zhes rgya cher sbyar ro/ /de nas 'dis gdong g.yogs dgrol te/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /mig gi ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis skyeni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /badz+ra tsak+ṣu he badz+ra pā ④ sha zhes brjod do/ /de nas gdong g.yogs dkrol hūṃnas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po bstan par bya/ /de nas bla ma dga' 'gyur nas1/ /slob ma de la 'di skad bsgo/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ / sngags dang rigs 33—451

pas byin kyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum dngos grub kyang / /thams cad khyod la mngon du gyur/ /dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs/ /gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 1de kho na bshad par bya ste/ mi mnyam med pas zur 5bzhir snyoms/ /dran dang dbang po sgo bzhi ste / /bsam gtan rta babs rnam pa bzhi/ /ting 'dzin khyams su shes par bya / /khyams la brten pa rdo rje'i gdan/ /gzungs rnams lha mos mchod pa yi1 / /rgyan rnams kun gyis bkra ba yang / /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o/ /gdul bya bskyod pa sna tshogs mchog /dar 'phan ④dril bu sgogs pa yis/ /me long ye shes rtag mi rtog /byang chub yan lag me tog phreng / /dra ba dra phyed rin chen mchog /nyi ma zla bar yang dag ldan/ /kun grub mi zad bde ba ste/ /bde ba chen po zhes grags so/ /de yi nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi / /ka ba dkyil 'khor dra pyeb ni/ /dngos grub bde ba kun ster ba'i/ /rnam thar brgyad po de nyid yin/ /theg pa chen po byang chub sems/ /mdo sde'i 'khor lo bskor bas na/ /rdo rje thig gis yongs btab skucing thams cad du yang yongs su rdzogs/ /gang du 'jug pa de tsam kyis/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi log pa/ /bde ba chen po ⑦rab grub phyir/ /de dag dbang por yang dag 'gyur/ /de nas phyag rgya dang snying po yang bshad par bya stebye)/ de nas rdo rje lcags kyu nas brtsams te/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyi bar du bstan par bya'o/ /de nas me long bstan par bya ste/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /gzung rmyedu med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar 33—452

chos 'di shes nas su/ /sems can don ni mnyan tshosnapar byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skyes/ /zhes sgyu ma lta bur bstan to/ /de nas bla ma de la yon gyi ༄2snamachog phul te/ gsol ba gdab rngupar bya ste/ 'di zhes bgyi ba rdo je can/ /byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom pa/ /slob dpon zhabs kyi pad+ma la/ /dbang bskur phyir ni phyag kyang 'tshal/ /slob dpon rab tu rmad byung ba/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis dbang bskur nyid/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob byed pa/ /skal ba chen po bdag la stsol thu/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis hoḥphyezhes bya bas gzhu byin la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyis shig ces brjod de/ phyogs bzhir mda' bzhi 'phen du gzhug cing / steng dang 'og tu yang re re 'phen du gzhug go/ /de nas slob ma dbang bskur bar bya ste/ shar phyogs kyi sgo'i mthar sna tshogs pad+ma bris la gang yang rung ba'i skur bskyed de/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnas par bsams la/ g.yas logs su dar dang me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa'i gdugs dkar po la gtsug tor gdugs dkar bzlas la dbub po/ /g.yon du dar tshon sna tshogs pa bkram pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la oṃ yongs su bzlas pa legs par bzhag byul/ me tog la sogs pas thumachod la sgra sna tshogs pas bsgrags so/ /bkra shis kyi glu len cing phyi nang gi gar sna tshogs pa yang bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i bum pa la sogs pa thams cad gcig tu bsdoms 8te byin gyis brlabs la dbang bskur bar bya ste/ che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs shing / /bdud rtsi'i chu yis rab bkang ba/ /rnam par dag pa'i bum pa 'dis/ /bu khyod la ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhe ṣiñca zhes brjod do/ /slob ma 33—453

rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag tūpas me long lta bu'i ye shes la mi bskyod pa nyango bor gyur to / /de nas de kho na nyid bstan te/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni//rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po thams cad bdag /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces bya ba/ 'di ni 'jam dpal la bya bar bshad de ming thams cad kyi bdag nyid gruyin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas chos bstan te/ srid pa'i thu rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas / /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa'i mchog ni byed par 'gyur/ /de nas dam tshig bsgrag thupar bya ste/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po zhi bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /de bas dam tshig bsrung bar gyis/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lha yi nisbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni/ /mkhas mchog 'dug par gyur pa'i tshe/ /de srid mtshungs med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /gsang ba mchog gi dam tshig thabs/ /bsod nams byin rlob 3sgrub byed pa/ /dngos grub kun gyi dbang phyug grub/ /sems can don ni ston 5par byed/ /yid kyi gzugs ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya dam tshig yin par grags/ /gang gi lus kun bstan pas na/ /des na phyag rgya yin par grags/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas gsang ba bsgrags te/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod pa'i chags bral bar/ /khyed kyis nam yang shem byed cig /ces bya'o/ /de nas / mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /theg pa chen po rtog pa yi/ /tshul 33—454

chen yang ni rgyas par mdzod/ /ces bya'o/ /de nas/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la/ rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig /rdo rje rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor bskor zhes brjod do/ /de nas dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs su bcas pa byin kyis rlobs ①la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi rgyan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /rin po che yi dbu rgyan dang / /dar dpyangs dag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca zhes brjod pas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las//rdo rje rin po cher gyur to/ /de nas de kho na nyid bstanardu / nyi ma 'di ni mchog yin te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong / /nam mkha'i snying po bcom ldan 'das/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ bsam pa thams cad rab grub pas/ /don 'di bsam 'grub bla na med/ /de yang 'dod pa rab grub phyir / /'dod dang thar pa'i bde chen po/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas dam tshig bsgrags te/ sems can kun la phan phyir dang / /sangs rgyas don du sbyor ba yis/ /pha rol nor rnams phrogs kyang ni/ /sdig gis gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas gsang ba bsgrags te/ 'dod dang bde ba thams cad dang / /mi mthun pa yang sbyin bya zhing / /bdag nyid kyang ni pha rol kyi/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par gyis/ /de nas/ rin 5chen khyod la gsol pa ni/ /nor gyi tshogs ni bshad du gsol/ /rang gi rigs ni 5bskyed par mdzod/ /ces brjod de nas/ mdor na 'jig rten 33—455

thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ci ste sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la/ rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig /rin po che'i rigs kyi bdag po rin po che'i rigs kyi 'khor lo bskor cig ces brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje byin gyis brlabs la / sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje dbang / /de ring khyod la dbang bskur dzobya/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab grub phyir/ /bu khyod la ni bskur bar bya/ /badz+ra a bye pa ti a bhe ṣiñca zhes brjod pas/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes las rdo rje chos kyi sems dpar gyur to/ /de nas de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/ 'di nyid sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug ste/ /'dul ba thabs kyis mdzad pa ni/ /dag pa'i rol mor rngurab tu 'jug /ces brjod do/ /de nas chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ ji ltar pad+ma dmar po 'di / /tshon gyi nyes pas ma gos ltar/ /de bzhin gnas pa'i nyes pa 'dis//'gro phan rnams la mi gos so/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas dam tshig bstan te/cho ga 'di dag gang gang gis/ /'gro ba rnams ni 'dul 'gyur ba/ /pad+ma dag par spyor ba'i bdag /de dag der ni sbyor bar bya/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas gsang ba bsgrags te/ 'dod chags 'dra ba'i bde ba med/ /rgyal ba rnams la de phul la/ /sems can don du sbyin med mchog /bsten na bsod nams thob par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas/ dpa' bo khyod la gsol ba ni/ /rang gi rigs rnams bskyed nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa 'di/ /thub pa chen pos bshad du gsol/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas/'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji 33—456

ltar sna chogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /pad+ma'i lku'akhor lo rab tu thubaskor/ /zhes brjod la/ /rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig /pad+ma rigs kyi bdag po chos kyi 'khor lo bskor cig ces brjod do/ /de nas dril bu byin gyis brlabs te / 'di ni shes rab nyid kyi dngos/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro ba'i/ /de ring khyod la 'dir dbang bskur/ /oṃ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā dharma a zhes brjod/bya ba grub pa'i ye shes las sna tshogs rdo rje can du gyur par bsams la de kho na nyid bstan te/ rtag tu 'dod chags las byung 'gro/ /rdo rje me yi phung po'i gzugs / /'bar ba'i rdo rje sbyor ba che/ /mkha' 'gro rnams ni kun du 'bar / /zhes brjod do/ /de nas chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ chos rnams nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam rnal 'byor pas/ /'di kun myur du 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas dam tshig bstan te/ thams cad nam mkha' spyor ba yis / /thams cad nam mkha' zhes smra zhing / /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas zirgyas btab la/ /khams gsum yang ni bza' chobar bya/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas gsang ba bsgrags te/ sems can kun la phan phyir dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don du ni/ /sems can thams cad gsad —6na yang / /de ni sdig pas gos mi 'gyur/ /zhes brjod do/ /mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbang byed cing / /sems can kun don bya ba'i phyir/ /rang gi rigs ni bskyed par mdzod/ /ces brjod do/ /de nas/ mdor na 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la/33—457

rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig /las kyi rigs kyi bdag po chos kyi 'khor bo bskor cig ces brjod do/ /de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i lag pa de rnams lkuspyi bor bzhag la/ khyod ni sangs rgyas dngos yin te/ /rab tu gsang ba gsang ba'i ming / /rdo rje che ge mo zhes pa/ /de ring khyed la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra nā ma a rnyi ṣiñca zhes pa la sogs pa brjod pas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes las rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor gyur tokhu/ /de la de kho na nyid bstan te/ de nyid du ni bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs dang byang chub sems/ /lta ngan rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /mya ngan 'das 'di ston par mdzod/ /sna tshogs 'dul bar brtson pa yi/ /brtan zhing nges pa'i chos nyid can/ /srid pa shin tu gnas mchog tu/ /go cha la sogs nges par gon/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs la sogs/ /dkon mchog gsum po nyid du rtogs/ /srid pa shin tu legs par bsgrub/ /sna tshogs mkhyen pa 1dpal byed mchog /ces brjod do/ /de nas chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam rnal 'byor pas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas dam tshig bstan par bya ste/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci bde bar ni bsten bzhin du/ /dkon mchog gsum yang mchod par bgyi/ /rang nyid dang ni brten 4par bya'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas gsang ba bsgrags te/ ji lta thuji ltar sems can rnams/ /'dul 'gyur de lta de lta bur/ /chags la sogs pa yun rings su/ /de bzhin 'gro ba'i don rnams kyis/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas/ mgon po khyod la gsol 33—458

ba ni/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje chen po bskyed nas kyang / /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas/'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la②/ rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor cig ces brjod de tha ma de rnams ni rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa byin gyis brlabs te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag na rdo rje'i lag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra ya mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi nyi hi hūṃ zhes brjod do / /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro ba//khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub rdo rje rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes brjod la/ dril bu guspyin no/ /de nas chos kyi 'khor lo rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du bzhag ༄ la/ dung lag pa g.yas par sbyin te 'di skad brjod do/ /deng nas brtsams te dbang bskur ba tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor cig /chos kyi dung bus shig /'jig rten kun la zab mo'i ③chos kyi sgra sgrogs shig /de nas gzengs bstod de/ 'di ltar snang ba'i dngos po kun/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi bdag nyid de/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi 5dbang bskur bas/ /de bzhin gshegs par khyod gyur to/ /de nas lung bstan te/ nga yis 'di ltar khyod lung bstan/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu de bzhin gshegs/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas dngos yin kyis/ /som nyi yid gnyis ma za cig༄ /de nas 33—459

dbugs dbyung bar bya ste/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /mthong ba'am ni zhugs pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /khyod ni deng nyid gnas yin te/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /slar khyod 'chi ba yod min te/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /khyod ni mchog tu gyur pa'o / /zhes brjod do/ /de nas phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi ne+emachod pas mchod de bkra shis brjod do/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams dang sgra'i rnam pa mang pos sna drangs la dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor ba snetshobya'o/ /de nas slob ma'i spyi bo nas gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rnams dkyil 'khor la phul te 'di skad bsgo bar bya'o/ /da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyuraḍa 7/ /gsang sngags rgyud kyang 'dzin par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis bkur bar 'gyur/ /sems can kun la snying brtse'i phyir/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /nan tan bskyed de bri bar gyis/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /khyod kyis chos la ser sna dang / /sems can kun la mi phan pa/ /nyam nga chen por gyur kyang ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi bya'o/ /de nas slob ma re re'i lag pa g.yon pas g.yas pa'i mthe chung nas bzung nas zhi ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bzod par gsol ba bya ste ye shes kyi lha gshegs su gsol/ bskyed pa'i mtshan tsho bdag gi thugs kar bsdus la/ rdul tshon phyags te chu bo chen por dor bar bya'o/ /de nas gnas de yang dri sna tshogs kyi chochus legs par byug par bya'o/ /33—460

de nas slob ma dam pa des/ /ci bzhed yon rnams phul nas su/ /gsang dbang nod phyir 'di skad zhu/ /bla ma dam pa bde gshegs gtso/ /khro bo 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /lus ngag yid kyis bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gsang gsum dam pa'i dbang mchog 'di/ /di ring bdag la gnang bar stsol/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas bla ma dam pa des/ /gsang ba'i dbang bsgur brtsam bya ste/ /shin tu dbe+en pa'i gnas rnams su/ /maṇ+ḍal dri zhim bdud rtsis byugs / /me tog bkram ste stan bzangs bting / /de rjes slob mas shes rab ma/ /mchog dang rab dang 'bring dang mtha'/ /bla ma la phul 'di skad brjodalku / /khyod ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje nithu/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis bde ba mdzad / /byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyis/ /yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa/ /ji ltar ji bzhin bdud rtsi yis/ /mchog gi dbang ni bsgur ba bzhin / /de bzhin bdag la 'khor ba yi༄ / /sdug bsngal rnams ni sel bar mdzod / /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /ma rig nges par rab rib rnams / /gang zhig byang chub bla med pa/ /de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod / /ces brjod do/ /de nas bla mas shes rab ma/ /mdangs ldan ma ni rab bskyed la/ /cho ga thams cad sgogs par bya/ /thabs dang shes rab byin rlobs la/ /thugs las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas bsdu/ /dgug gzhug bcing dang bstem par bya/ /chags pa bskyed phyir sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ mañju shrī sarba ta thā ga tā nu rā ga badz+ra swa bhā 4wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ zhes brjod de/bsrub pa dang bsrubs 57pa'i spyor ba mdzad pas bde bar gshegs pa 'od du zhu ste/33—7/61

byang chub kyi sems su phab pas nor bu'i nang du bde ba rnyed pa thabs dang shes rab kyi sgo bkag ste/ slob ma'i kha ru dbab par bya'o/ /de la 'di skad brjod de/ byang chub sems kyi rdo rje 'di/ /sems kyi sdug bsngal rnam bcom ste—/ /gsang ba'i gnas dang dam par bcas/ /de ring khyod la dbab par bya'o / /zhes brjod de slob ma'i kha ru'o/ /slob ma des kyang tshul rnam pa bzhis bdud rtsi sbyang (rmyebar bya'o/ /des ni ngag gnyis ②pa dang rnam par rtog pa dag par byed pas ③gsung gi dbang zhes bya'o/ /de la lung bstan par bya ste/bla mas chos gos gyon la lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi mtha' ma chag par bcug ste—/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams gsal bar byas la/ sngon 'jam pa'i rdo rjes thulung bstan pa bzhin du mgrin gcig tu lung ston par bsams la 'di skad brjod do/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos grub mchog tu bsgrub 5pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las 'ubaton/ /mdzi shrī na maḥ7sarba ta thā ga ta hri sidhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod de she/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis lung ston par mdzad do/ /de nas dbugs dbyung ba ni khams gsum gyi bdag por gyur pa dang / bdud dang mu stegs la sogs pa las rgyal ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa ste/'di nyid las thob par gyur cig /the tshom dang yid gnyis la sogs pa ma byed cig /gzhan yang 1bhebla ma dam pas dbang bskur ba tsam gyis ji ltar bsams pa ltar slob ma rnams kyis grub par 'gyur ro zhes brjod do/ /de ni slob ma gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ste/ dbang rnams rdzogs pas rim par spyin/ /33—462

gsang ba'i dbang dang zhes gsungs pa la de skad ces bshad do/ /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba bstan pa'i phyir/ nges pa'i dbang rim pa bzhin du bskur bar bya zhes gsungs pa'i don ni 'di yin te/ de ltar gsang ba'i dbang thob pa'i slob ma des kyang stibla ma la 'di skad zhu ④ste/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /ji ltar mkhyen cing thugs chud pa/ /de ltar rjes su bdag dad na/ /de ring bdag la dbang bskur stsol④/ /zhes brjod do / /de nas bla ma des shes rab dang ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba brtsam ste④/de yang dang la shes rab kyi dbang ni bu mo rigs ldan mtshan rtags can/ bcu gnyis bcu drug bco brgyad nyi shu lon pa 3bla ma la phul la bsam gtan gyi don drug dang ldan par bya ste/ bla ma des shes rab ma byin gyis brlabs te 'di skad ces bsgo'o/ /sngon kyi rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang / /shes rab 'di la brten par 'grubaspyo/ /rigs kyi bu mchog khyod kyis kyang / /shes rab spang du mi rung ste / /ye shes skye ba'i thabs yin pas/ /khyod kyis hūṃ 'dod chags ma spang zhig/ces brjod do/ /de nas bla mas dri ba 'di yang gsung ngo / /bu tshur shog cig rdo rje can/ /dri chen dri chu za nus sam/ /rak+ta ga pur za nus sam/ /bud med dad pas bsten genus sam/ /pad+mar 'o byed mi rtog gam/ /snod ldan spos shig ngang tshul can/ /de nas slob mas 'di skad brjod/ /shes rab dad pas bdag bsten to/ /dri chen dri chu la sogs bdud rtsi lnga/ /rtag tu dad pas ston 1 par bkyid/ /pad+mar bdag ni 'o bgyid do/ /de nas bla ma dam pa des / /shes rab ma gcer bur phyung la/ lus dri zhim po'i chus bkrus la/me tog gi phreng bas mgo bcings la 'di skad ces bsgo'o/ /ston pa'i rang 33—463

bzhin snying rje'i bdag /khyod kyis sems can don rnams gyis/ /mkha' klong pad+ma bsten snye1 par gyis/ /bu 'di bde ba bskyed par gyis/ /zhes bskul lo/ /de nas shes rab dam pa des lag pa gnyis dril bu bzung nas pad+ma kha phye ste 'di skad brjod do/ /rmad byung nga yi byepad+ma la/ /bde ba thams cad 'di la rnyed/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kun/ /rtag tu 'di dag ①mi 'bral lo/ /pad+ma 'di ni chos dbyings yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'di las byung / /sems can thams cad 'di ru grol/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /pad+ma zhes su rab tu gsungs/ /pad+ma'i nang gi nam mkha' la/ /'byung ba lnga po rang bzhin gnas/ /lte ba la ni ge sar te/ /pad+ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /ze 'bru'i dbus nas 'byung ba yin/ /de nyid bdud rtsi dam pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi snying po'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas bla mas slob ma'i lag pa g.yas pa dang / shes rab ma'i g.yon pa ④'og tu bzhag 3nas 'di skad brjod do / /shes rab dam pa 'di yin te/ /khyed kyi ye shes skyed par byed/ /'di dang khyed nyid ma bral bar/ /dad pas rtag tu rol mo gyis/ /zhes brjod la/ shes rab ma'i lus la dkyil 'khor bkod la slob ma la sbyin no/ /slob ma yol ba nang du shes rab ma dang 'dug nas ye shes kyi dbang nod par bya'o/ /de nas shes rab ma dang slob mas glo g.yas pa phab la nyal lo/ /dga' ba'i gtam sna tshogs bya'o/ /gnas dgu ru ni sen mo gdab/ /g.yon pa glang po'i ༄6sna rtse yis/ /pad+ma bye'u dz+wamago 'dra ba la/ /tshod zin bya ste brud par bya/ /lce yis kyang ni rol mo bya'o/ /des ni rishe pad+ma rgyas par 'gyuratsu/ /gzod nyi ma dang zla ba mnyam par bya ste/ dal nas dal nas bskyod pa las/ /'byung ba 33—464

bzhi'i rkyen gyis bde ba chen po'i dbus na hūṃ/byang chub sems gnas pa la ③ye shes kyi mes bzhu nas 'khor lo bzhi nas rim par thu'abab ste/ bol+la'i dzurtsa bar phyin pa ni dga' ba'o/ /dbus su phyin pa ni mchog dga'o/ /nor bu'i rtse mor sleb pa ni lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o/ /de ji tsam gnas kyi bar du bsgoms pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye ste/ dper na rus sbal lta bu'o/ /gal te bsdams pas ma thems na 'jig rten pa'i gnas su gshegs te bral ba'i dga' ba zhes bya'o/ /don dang bral ba ni bral ba'o/ /gong ma mtshon pas dga' ba'o/ /byang sems de yi rang bzhin ni/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rang bzhin pas/ /dung dang nya phyis dag gis min/ /lag pas kyang ni mi blang ngo //bdud rtsi lce yis blang bar bya'o/ /de zos ye shes dbab cho mchog thob/ /de yi don la rgyun goms pas/ /'di ltar snang ba thams cad kun/ /skad cig gcig la gnyis med pa'o/ /brjod pa'i tha snyad kun dang bral/ /nam mkha'i lam la rab gnas pa'i/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ /mthar phyin gdams ngag ces kyang bya/ /de nas dam par gyur pa de la ni/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhir bsgrag ༅par bya'o/ /de nas bkra shis gdon pa'i don ni 'jam dpal gyi sku gzugs spyi bo'i 3thog tu bzhag la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /thabs dang shes rab yan lag 'dus pa'i rdo rje las byung ba'i/ /byang chub sems kyi 'jam dbyangs byang chub sems dbang bskur/ /rgyal mchog sras bcas rnams kyis legs gsungs bkra shis gang / /des ni khyed kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog༄ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems sogs dkyil 'khor la 'jug cing / /srid pa'i snying por rnam rol sgeg mo la sogs pas/ /bde 33—465

byed rab mchog legs par glur blangs bkra shis gang / /des ni khyed kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /shin tu zhi ba'i ①mdzad pa phul phyung ①ma lus pas / /sems can bde gshegs rtag mdzad bcom ldan dbang bskur la/ /dpag med lha yi mchog gis legs gsungs bkra shis gang / /des ni khyod kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /dpal ldan khams gsum rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor rab mchog la/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal mchog rgyal por dbang bskur bas/ /lha yi mchog gis btud de rab bshad bkra shis gang / /des ni khyod kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /'gro ba sna tshogs 'dul phyir phyag na pad+mo yis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi 3rin chen bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur / /pad+ma'i 'dod chags rnam dag legs gsungs bkra shis gang / /des ni khyed kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /mkha' snying nor bu rin snguchen 'byor pas nyams dga' zhing / /don rnams kun grub bde sbyin dbang bskur chen po la/ /dge ba phun tshogs mdzad pas legs gsungs bkra shis gang / /des ni khyed la 5snadabang bsgur mchog la bkra shis shog /'khor los sgyur dzibhedrug dge ba'i bkra shis glu blangs pas/ /bsod nams rin chen dri med mi mnyam gang thob pa/ /des na kun gson 'byor ba'i dbang bskur chen po la/ /'jam dpal grags pas 'jig rten rnam par legs gyur cig/ces brjod do/ /de nas spyod lam bya ba dang / bla mas gzengs 7bstod pa dang / bkra shis kyis gshegs su gsol bar bya ba dang / bla ma la yon dbul ba rnams ni dkyus nyid gsal lo/ /bla ma dam pa srur+ya sedhashāṅgi gar+bha tsani/dam pa chos kyi mdzod du gyur pa la/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs kyi spyan snga ru/ /33—466

1491༄ga /sgrub thabs gsang ba dang ldan pabe+e thig gi cho ga 1༄4/ /thig gdab pa'i rim pa/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i thig sgud kyis/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i sa gzhi la/ /tshangs thig zur thig logs thig rnams/ /gzhan dang mthun par gdab byas nas/ /phyi dang nang du dbye bar bya/ /phyi la drug drug bcu gnyis te/ /nang du brgyad brgyad bcu drug gdab/ /cha chen nyi shu brgyad du 'gyur/ /so so'i cha ni dbye bar bya/ /nang gi brgyad po gnyis po 2yang / /re re'ang bzhi bzhir bgo bya zhing / /phyi rol dkyil 'khor thig la ni/ /dang po khyams su gzhag par bya/ /gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa dang / /lnga po rnams ni bzhi bzhir bgo/ /drug pa la ni gnyis su bya/ /drug po gzhan yang de bzhin 4bgo/ /'di la/ phreng ba re yang re'u mig ni/ /brgya dang cha chung gnyis su 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i thig gi ngos gnyis las/ /gsum pa de bzhin 33—477

lnga pa dang / /bcu bdun pa dang nyi shu pa/ /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ /cha lngar nang du bgo bar byasna/ /phyi yi gsum pa lnga pa rnams/ /de bzhin du ni bgo bar bya/ /gnyis pa lnga pa brgyad pa rnams/ /cha chung lnga lngar gdab par bya / /phyi sgo sum chas che bar dbyi/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ru/ /ya phugs gebacas pa dbus su dbyi/ /rta babs ya phubs dag la 1ni/ /cha gcig dor ba'i cha chen tshad/ /sgo yi mtshams dang twa ra ṇa/ /shin tu gcig nyid mi bya'o/ /de steng 4'khor lo rdzogs par bya/ /tshangs nas cha chung brgyad la ni/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad thig tu gdab/ /lte ba cha gsum mu khyud gcig /de nas rtsibs brgyad cha phran bzhi/ /man ngag thig la tshod kyis bskor/ /de rgyab cha chung gcig la ni/ /nang gi mu khyud legs par bya/ /cha chung gcig la lte bar snyebya/ /de brten cha chung lnga la ni/ /rtsibs ni bcu drug 'khor lo bya/ /de rgyab cha chung mu khyud 'gyur/ /de rgyab nang sgo cha chen bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol khyams dag la/ /rtsibs bcu drug tu gdab par bya/ /de rjes cha chen bzhi po la/ /phyi yi sgo ni rdzogs par gzhagatre /mtshan nyid gong ma bzhin du dbye / /phyi rol rdo rje phreng gsal ba/ /cha chen gyi ni phyed kyi tshad/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba'ang de yi tshad/ /sgrub thabs gsang ba dang ldan pa'i thig gi cho ga /paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti dz+nyā na tīrtis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //33—478

1492༄7/ /spyan dbye ba'i cho ga ṣ+ṭṛ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ne+e trodha ṭa bi dhiḥ.a+yo/ bod skad du/ spyan dbye ba'i cho ga /ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma 'ongs rnams la phan slad du/ /zab cing rgya che'i mtshan bstan pa'i/ /sku gzugs la sogs rab gnas pa/ /rung bar bya phyir bdag gis bshad/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni ting 'dzin dang / /phyag rgya sngags dang 'dug stangs dang / /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg 4mchod pa dang / /las la sbyar dang slar bsdu rnams/ /slob dpon de nyid bcu shes pas/ /cho ga rnams ni bshad 5par bya/ /lha khang mchod rten lugs ma dang / /dam chos glegs bam ras ris rnams/ /zin cing thams cad rdzogs pa dang / /bde ba'i yon tan kun bskyed 6cing / /bsod nams 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rab tu gnas par byed par 'os/ /sku gzugs la sogs zin nas ni/ /yun rings gnas kyang ma mchod na/ /ji srid mchod 33—480

gnas ma gyur pas/ /de la mi shes skye bar 'gyur/ /de la bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i / /gzhung bzhin bya ba rdzogs bya stekye / /rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud dag la//'bras chan la sogs kyis sbyang bya/ /chu bdun gyis ni bkru byas shing / /rnam lnga 'dag chal gyis kyang bkru/ /drurlus kyang ni brud par bya/ /de nas gang yin lhar bskyed de/ /spyan drangs bstems la mchod pa bya/ /bcug ste dbang rnams bskur ba ni/ /rig pa'i dbang ni bskur —bya ste/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar dag tu/ /sems can don mdzod ces pa brjod/ /na bza' dri zhim rgyan rnams dbul/ /mchod pa'i bye brag rnams kyis mchod/ /thur ma phyag rgyas spyan yang dbye/ /snyan 'bru zhal dbye dbu bshad cing / /phyag zhabs sen mo dreg zucing sgu phyi'o3/ /me long dbul zhing mchod pa kun gyis mchod/ /de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang / /de sras tshangs la sogs pa kun/ /gang zhig cho ga'i bya ba ni/ /nongs gyur de dag bzod mdzad rigs/ /sbyin bdag rnams la zhi ba dang / /bde legs chen po kun mdzad de/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /gang 'di sku gzugs bskal pa'am/ /bskal pa brgya las lhag gnas shing / /sa dang chu dang me dang ni/ /rlung las lha rnams kun gyis bsrungs/ /slob dpon slob mar bcas pa dang / /bu dang tsha bo rnams bsrungs te/ /rang dga' yid bder gyur nas ni/ /rab kyeganas bzang po dag tu bzhedasnga / /de nas dkyil 'khor dag gi lha/ /gshegs gsol gzhung bzhin bya ba'o/ /bdag gis cho ga 'di byas pas/ /'gro ba kun gyi rgyud tshim shog /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ tis bsgrigs 8nas sgra 33—481

rang 'gyur du mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/48༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉dag/ /spyan dbye ba'i cho ga bzhugs so// ༄sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉praṣ+ṭa ṭiṣ+ṭha/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngar/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sreg 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pad/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i/ 481 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byas te/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thakur/ zhu 〈〈snar 〉7dzad/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉breg bhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bye'o/ sgo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngang / klu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhud/ ④/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sdebs/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (1419)33byed482

༄༄/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs jes bya ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros bral bde ba chen po'i ngang / /rtog pa'i rlabs dang bral ba las/ /sems can don du gzugs sgur snang / /cir yang snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje che zhing don mdzad pa/ /'gro ba kun la khyab pa'i mgon/ /de yi bsgrub byel dga' ba la/ /gtso bo dad pas bshad par bya/ /dbang thob dam tshig gnas pa dang / /gtong la dga' zhing 'dzin pa med/ /srog phyir rnal 'byor ngang du byed/ /gsong por smra zhing rtse dang bral//'du 'dzi spangs shing gcig po dga'/ / zla bo med cing dad ldan pas/ /nyams dga' ba yi gnas dag tu/ /bde ba'i stan la gnas par bya/ /lha yi nga rgyal gnas pa yis/ /sa gzhi 4dra ba ra 5bar bslab/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa 33—483

ces brjod pas/ rgyang grags gcig tsam —1bgegs tshar gcad/ /de nas shin tu brtser ldan pas/ /sangs rgyas la sogs mdun bsams la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pas sdig pa sbyang / /yi rang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ /dge ba bsngo ba 2bstod pa gus par bya/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mtha' gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhad pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud//med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam/ mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sdom pa dag ni gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /ji tsam dus nas bzung nas ni/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /nam zhig byang chub snying po la/ /yongs su gnas pa'i bar dag tu/ /bdag gis byang chub mchog gi sems/ /ma lus par ni bskyed par bgyi/ /de nas sangs rgyas la sogs rnams/ /ma lus bdag gi thugs la bsdu/ /thim zhu ye shes me 'bar bas / /nyon mongs phung po bsreg par bsam/ /slar gsos ye shes lus su byas / /byang chub lnga bdag bsgom pa ni/ /yongs dag me long gsal ba 33byed484

dkyil 'khor la/ /yul dngos ༄1 rigs kun ma lus so sor snang / /thams cad yongs dag me long ye shes la/ /'dris par de la yang dag 37blta bar bya / /sems can rnams la snying rje bskyed/ /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dang bral bas//sdug bsngal 'khor ba rgya mtshor bying / /sems can don du sdug bsngal bral / /stong pa mnyam pa thunyid du sbyar༅/ /bdag stong sems can de 'dra yang / /chos rnams kun kyang rab tu shes/ /chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje yang / /bdag med rang bzhin rigs 3pa las/ /mnyam nyid ye shes bskyed par bya/ /de nas gsang sngags brjod pa ni/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā 8rde ār+ya nut+pan+da twatā/sngags don stong par bsgoms nas ni/ /lhan cig gnyis med chos rab gzung tso //de nyid yul du byas pa yis/ /chos bdag med par bsgom par bya/ /dmigs med snying rje so sor brtag /snying rje'i rjes 'gro gzung 'dzin yongs dang bral/ /ngo bo 'od gsal yan lag kun bral ba/ /rang bzhin yongs dag chos nyid rgyu mthun pas/ /dngos bral don stong ngang las de gnas pas/ /chos dbyings ye shes bsgom pa'o/ /de ltar sems can don byed ma 3 bral ba'i/ /rnal 'byor sngon gyi smon lam dbang thob pas/ /sems can kun gyi dbang bsgyur 1bas / /sems kyi don ni rab rdzogs phyir/ /khams gsum 'byung gnas khyab par gyes/ /don dam kun rdzob mya ngan 'das/ /de phyir nan tan ye shes bsgom / /de las dngos po gzugs su byung / /sprul pa'i tshul gyis nam mkha' la/ /a las zla ba'i gzugs bsam pa/ /de 'og pad dkar pad+ma ste/ /sna tshogs 'dab brgyad mdzes pa'o/ /de steng dhīḥser gur gum mdog /spro dang bsnyu las mtshan ma bsam/ /de las dhīḥ —/mtshan 'phro 'du las/ /sgu 33—485

gser mdog las sdem bag can/ /bde gshegs dbu rgyan zur phud ldan/ /rin chen rnam brgyan —1 gzhon nu'i tshul/ /lo brgyad rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /phyag g.yas ral gri puste g.yon/ /bzhin mdzes 'ja' tshon lta bur bsgom/ /gsal bas tha mal phung po spong / /thugs kar zla steng tsodhīḥdakar bsam/ /de las dang po'i sangs rgyas te/ /zhal lnga byis pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rin chen sna tshogs na bza' can/ /zla dkar mdog las skyil krung bzhugs/ /phyag g.yas —shes rab ral gri bsnams/ /g.yon bzhi shes rab po ti bsnams/ /gsal ba dag tu shes par bya/ /de yi thugs la shes rab 'khor lo ste/ /gsal bar yi ge 5a las bskyed/ /lte dbus rtsibs drug mu khyud bzhi/ /lte bar yi ge a dkar bsam/ /rtsibs la yi ge sngags drug dgod/ /oṃ badz+ra tīṣ+ṭha ltaya te na maḥ/ oṃ duḥdzikhats+tsha dā 3ya te na maḥ/ oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta byeya te na maḥ/ oṃ dz+nyā na kā yā 9/ya te na maḥ/ oṃ wā gī shwa rā ⑩ya te na maḥ.oṃ a skyer pa tsa nā 1reya te na maḥ/ dmar sngo dkar dang ljang gu dang / /nyunaser dang dkar te rim bzhin —bsam/ /'khor lo rtsibs kyi rim bzhin no/ /mu khyud dang po dag la ni/ /oṃ sarba dhas+thā bhā snyeb swa bhā ba bi shud+dhi badz+ra/ a ā ྾i aḥmu khyud gnyis po kyodag la ni/ /a ā i yī u u e i o au saṃ aḥmu khyud gsum po dag 1 ni / ye shes sems dpa' sku yi sngags/ /a ā sarba ta thā ga ta z-i 13da ya ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ s+thāḥbha ga wān dz+nyā na mūrti bā gī shwa ra ma hā bā ༄ tsa/ sarba dhadz+re ga ga nā ma la su pa ri shudhe dhasgro dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha ā 1 ཿ/ phyi rol mu khyud tha ma la/ /yi ge ka sogs ha yi mthar/ /thub rtapa'i yi ge rnam bkod pa/ /'khor lo sngags kyi rim pa'o/ /de nas 'khor lo'i lte dbus kyi/ /a dkar yongs su 33—486

gyur pa las/ /bcom ldan ye shes sems dpa' bsgom/ /zhal drug ston ka'i zla ltar dkar/ /in+d+ra byā la'i gtsug phud mdzes/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i lku'od kyis mdzes/ /zhi ba'i tshul 'chang rin chen brgyan(/ /rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs pa ste/ /g.yas g.yon ut+pal sngon po bsnams/ /steng na shes rab po ti bsnams/ /mdzes pa gsal bar dmigs pa'o/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka ru/ /zla mchog gsal bar bsam par bya/ /de yi thugs mchog ngo bo ste/ /de steng yi ge rnams thu/ngo bo/ /a mchog a dkar bsam par bya/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas de las byung / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung yin no/ /de ltar 'khor lo drug brtsegs /④la/ /oṃ a5bheḥhūṃ gi yi ge mchog /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdang ldan pas/ /spyan drangs mdun du gsal bar dmigs/ /mchod pa la sogs dbul bar bya/ /thams cad de nyid gsum ldan pas/ /e hā bi ra hūṃ pubye swā hā/ dhū pe swā hā/ gadhe ñcaswā hā/ ā lo ke swā hā/ nai bi bye 3swā hā/ba lo kha kha/ khā hi khā hi swā hā/ sga ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ yon chab me tog bdug spos dang / /dri chab lha bshos gtor ma dang / /sgra la sogs pa rim bzhin dbul / /'dud la sogs pas bstod par bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs byebastem pa'o//yang na 'od kyis lha mo bkug la dbang bsgur bar bya/she de nas bzlas pa bya ba ste/ /yi ge sbrul mtha' ldan pas na/ /lnga po ya ste na ma bor⑫ yi ge tsheg skye bcad sum cu la/ /ma yengs gtad la bzlas pa gsal/ /ngag gi dngos grub dri ma bral/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyang de la dgyes/ /grangs ni brgya pa dag par bya/ /shes rab 'khor lo goms pa'o/ /de nas mtshan ni brjod par bya/ /yi ge a la sems gtad la/ /ngag gi mtshan ni gsal brjod pa'o/ /33—487

—de yang rang bzhin med shes bya/ /shes nas rtog pa rnams dang bral/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rnams dang / /'jig rten 'das pa'i ṭ+wālha rnams kun/ /ma lus/ thams cad dgyes nas su/ /yon tan thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /dus gsum dag tu brjod pa dang / /yang na dus drug dag tu brjod/ /yang na dus kyi nges med pas/ /nus tshad dag tu brjod pa'o/ /mtshan ni brjod pas/ skyo ba na/ /shes rab 'khor lo sngags drug las/ /sngags dang mthun pa'i 'od byung nas/ /lus snang thams cad gsal bar byas/ /mi shes ri bo thams cad bcom / /phyi rol dag tu 'phros pa las/ /nam mkha'i khams kun khyab rngupar gnas / /sangs rgyas zhing khams gsal gyur nas/ /chos sku ye shes thob pa'i don/ /byas nas slar ni bzlas pa las/ /snying gar zla stengs a la 1 thim//brtan pas yang dang yang du bsgom/ /de ltar spyod pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /ye shes bsgoms na sprul sku dang / /zla ba'i sgo nas longs sku dang / /a yi sgo nas chos sku dang / /ring po mi thogs par 'gyur ba/ /brtan shepas yang dang yang du bsgom/ /de ltar spyod pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis sems can la/ /nye bar bzung bar khye mngon snang ba'o/ /de nas stong nyid la gnas bya/ /a nyid thig le byang chub ste/ /byang sems thams cad de la 'dus/ /bde ba thams cad der gnas na/ /'ja' tshon lta bu'i thig le ste//shes pa bying rgod med pa yis/ /gsal ba 'bad pas dad kyepar bya/ /sems nyid de rang yin zhe na/ /chos nyid ngang la gnas zhes bya/ /thig le je phra shes pa phra/ /rang bzhin med pas gnas pa'o/ /sems nyid btang snyoms gsal ba la/ /gsal ba mi rtog thob pa'o/ /de la brten nas gsal ba de/ /snang 33—488

la rang bzhin rnged pa thob/ /'bras bu chos su thob pa'o/ /de nas skyo ba byung ba ni1sna/ /oṃ 66hūṃ muñchaḥgashegs su gsol/ /thams cad bsdus nas lha nyid gnas / /ngag tu bzlas pa nus tshad bzlas/ /zhi la gnas shing snying rje bskyed / /sems can don la dga' sems bskyed/ /gtor ma rtag tu sbyin par bya/ /stan la zugacig pu 'dug nas su/ /lam lnga nyams su myang bar bya//tshogs lam bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /sbyor lam bzlas par byed pa na5 / /mthong lam mtshan nyid brjod pa ste/ /bsgom lam 'phro 'du dag la gnas/ /mthar phyin stong nyid sems dpa'o5/ /dge mas 7brtsams pa'i sgrub thabs la /'gal 'khrul mchis na mkhas bzod mdzod/ /brtsams pa'i dge rtsa yod srid na//sems can mos dang phrad par shog /dge bsnyen ma snyan grags dge mas mdzad pa / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs dze+egs so// //bsdur mchan/4/3 lkumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaphags pa/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ snye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga 'o/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉razhir/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dra/484 tsho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 gyi/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasngo/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lkem/485 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ma lus/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7yang dag /〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'o/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgral—/ bye 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7mnyamapa/ khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thab tu sbyor/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ag sre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhasma/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉khyed/ 1nya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sh+ya don dbang sgyur/tsha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉na da/ 2〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoradus/486 k+ṣe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉rgyan/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stengs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya g.yas bzhi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉33byed489

sngag /'phags pa 'jam dpal rin po che'i cho gadzo ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī rat+na no bi ka /bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam dpal rin po che'i cho ga /rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo / /bden pa dang ldan 'dzin bral ba/ /'jam dpal snyeyang dag kun mkhyen pa/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ngang gnas pa/ /smra ba'i seng ge phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la gus pas 'dud pa yi/ /dus ni rtag tu bsgom pa dang / /mos pa byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de yi don du bshad par bya/ /stong pa la dga' dbang thob pa/ /dam tshig ldan zhing bsgom pa dga'/ /rnal 'byor srog gtong ge dad pa che/ /sems can don byed byas la drin/ /rtag tu mtshan brjod bzlas la brtson/ /de ltar yon tan bcu ldan pas/ /yid dga' ba yi gnas dag tu//bde ba'i stan la gnas par bya/ /tha mal yi dam dran pa la/ /snying gar yi ge sum̐ ser dgod/ /kha dog lnga yi 'od 'phros nas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras bla 33—491

ma ni/ /spyan drangs mdun du bsams pa la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa sdig pa sbyang / /yi rang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la/ /dge bsngo 'dud la sogs pas bstod / /de nas stong nyid bsam pa ni/ /o a gyokā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā 3rde ār+ya nut+pan na tatā zuswā hā/ sngags don dngos po med pa la/ /yun rings ngang la blo gnas pas/ /de nyid la ni gnas par bya'o/ /de nas nam mkha' stong pa la/ /dngos po thams cad paṃ du gnas/ /de steng yi ge saṃ dkar las//byang chub sems dpa' seng ge / nogasal/ /de steng a las zla bar gsal/ /gdan steng yi ge sum̐ ser las/ /ut+pal sngon po mdzes par bsgom/ /de las 'phro 'du bya ba ste/ /smra ba'i seng ge bsgom par bya/ /ser po gser btso 5'dra ba la/ /g.yas na ut+pal pustes mtshan/ /g.yon pa gzhan la sbyin pa gtong 6/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis 'dzum dang ldan/ /thugs rje che bas nyon mongs spong / /rin chen rnams kyis lus la brgyan/ /dbu la thor tshugs rnams kyis mdzes/ /dbu skra gtsug phud 'khyil pa dang / /stod g.yogs ser po rnams kyis mdzes/ /smad g.yogs dar dpyangs dpyangs 3 pa'o/ /rmugs pa'i rnam pa ma yin pas/ /gsal ba rtag tu bsgom pa'o/ /de nas spyan drangs mchod pa'o/ /oṃ wā gī shwa ra dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mchod yon dbul/oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe s+dzahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhū 3pe s+dzahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe s+dzahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nai bi bye ḍa.āḥhūṃ/ ba lo ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi āḥhūṃ/mchog sbyin rdo rje'i —mchog khyed 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /33—492

sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhad pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud//med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /zhes skyebya bas bstod do/ /gnyis med bdag la bsdu ba'o/ /snying gar pad+ma'i zla ba lazhe / /steng na kyeye shes sems dpa' ste/ /tshon thugang dang 'dra gsal bar bsgom/ /yi ge a mchog zla ba la/ /thugs kar bsam par bya ba yinadze+e/ /ye shes sngags phreng bskor bar bya/ /oṃ sarba dhas+thā bhā 47ba/ swa bhā ba bi shudhe/ badz+ra tsakyu a ā/ e aḥpra kṛ ti pa 3ri shudha sarba dhas+thā 5ya du ta/ sarba ta thā ga tā thudz+nyā na kā ya mañju shrī pa ri shudhi tā mu pā dā ye ta rjo / a ā/ sarba ta thā ga tā dṛ da ya nyulngaha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ tweḥbha ga wān dz+nyā na mūrti bā gī shwa ra ma hā wā yotsa/sarba dhan+d+ra ga ga nā ma la su pa ri shudhe dhas+thā nyu—dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āḥ/ gsang bar phreng ba sngags la gtad/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas par yibya/ /de nas mtshan rnams brjod pa la/ /ye shes sems dpa' dag la ni/ /dmigs pa brtan pa gtad nas su/ /yon tan dag tu brjod pa'o/ /de yang gal te ma brtan na/ /g.yeng bar gyur na nus pa chung / /de la brtan par gyur pa na/ /ye shes gnyis med skye yang srid/ /yon tan dag tu brjod pa yang / /theg pa mtha' chos ston mdzad pas/ /thams cad ngo bo yin shes las/ /thams cad de dang 33—493

ldan par ston/ /de ltar byas shing bstod gyur na/ /chos sku mtha' dag thob par 'gyur/ /bsam pa ci 'dod de las 'byung / /lha srin sde brgyad dga' 'gyur nas/ /'dod pa thams cad 'byung ba'o/ /de nas 'bad pas mtshan brjod 'don pe/ /skyo bar mi 'gyur gus par bya/ /skyo ba dag ni byung ba na/ /rnal 'byor gnyis su med par bya/ /a las stong pa tsam par bya 1/ /gsal bar rtog med bsgom par bya/ /de nas a ni zhu ba las/ /thig le dkar po je chung las/ /ye shes stong pa nyid gsal ba/ /bying rgod med par gsal ba'o/ /yang dang yang du gtad la bsgom/ /snang ba rang bzhin med mthong 'gyur/ /yang na shes rab 'khor lo ste/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can/ /bsam gtan bzhi yi rtse mo can/ /yan lag med pa'i rtsis las 'das/ /zhes gsungs pa las/ bcu drug phyed brgyad de phyed de/ /kyebazhi ni gnas bzhi'i 'khor lo yi/ /lte ba shes rab ④'khor lo ste/ /bcu gnyis rtsibs can 'khor lo la/ /sngags kyi rkyernam par dgod ⑥ pa ni/ /a ā saṃ tso.ā rim par dgod/ /de nas yang dang yang du dgod/ /dbus su a mchog bsam par bya/ /de nas/snying gar shes rab 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs bcu gnyis dang ldan pa la/ / a ā/i ā+o/ u spru/ e e/ o ā+oṃ saṃ aḥ/thu/ dbyangs yig bcu gnyis g.yas na sha(ribaskor nas bkod par bya/ /lte ba la ni a mchog gnas/ /mgrin par shes rab 'khor lo ni/ /bcu gnyis rtsibs mchan gnas pa la/ /lte ba a bsgom rtsibs rnams la/ /a ra pa tsa na/ wā gī shwa ra/ pradz+nyā na mar rim pas dgod par bya'o/ /de nas spyi bo'i 'khor lo la/ /bcu gnyis rtsibs la dgod par bya ba ni/ sgu'i phreng sngags te las sngags so/ / a ā/ sarba ta 33—494

thā ga ta z-i da ya ha ra ha ra oṃ hūṃ tweḥ/ bha ga wān dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ/ wā gī shwa ra ma hā wā tsa/ sarba dharma ga ga na/ a ma la su pa ri shudha/ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha s+dza①dbus su a dkar chen po gnas/ /'og nas haṃ dkar bzlog nas bsam/ /dbus na yi ge yod pa ste/ /bsam gtan bzhi yi rtse mo de la bya/ /'khor lo nang stong 'od ltar 'dug /rjoyi ge rdul thig gang ltar bsam/ /dbus kyi thig le'i rang bzhin yin/ /dga' ba du ma yod pas blta/ /'khor lo bzhi la shes rab ste/ /thig le a wa dhū dzu tī thabs/ /nor bu'i rtse nas hūṃ la thug /dkar po 'od du 'dug pa'o/ /de nas byang chub rgyu ba'o/ /nor gnas tsaṇ+ḍa lī rgeganas pas/ /de la gtad de bsam pa'o/ /'khor lo de ltar gnas pa ni//yan lag bya ba de yin no/ /med pa rtsis las 'das pa ste/ /tshad med bsam gtan byed pa'o/ /de yang tsaṇ+ḍa lbo mel gtad pas so/ /me 'bar drod las brten nas byung / /a wa dhū ṭī lam zhugs nas/ /lte bar me 'bar thams cad bsregs/ /de ltar 'khor lo bzhi ka 'uyi/ /spyi bo'i bde ba ngang gis zhu/ /'o ma ltar dkar thams cad gang / /nor bu phebs nas lte gnas 'dren/ /rlung dang bstun nas yang yang 'dren/ /de stengs lus gso bde ba 'byung / /snang ba dga' ba skye ba'o/ /bcu drug log po lta bu 'byung / /tha mal zag med ye shes skye/ /skyo'am bsam gtan gtong 'dod na/ /spyi bor bsdu bar 'dod pa yi/ /dga' bral song yang nyes mi 'gyur/ /tha mal thabs las ma byung bas//nyes pa chen po 'ong mi 'gyur/ /de yang rlung gi brtan ⑦thob pa/ /bya ba 8rung gi gzhan nas min/ /tha mal zag med thob pa la/ /med pa'i tshig 'das de yin no/ /tha mal gshegs su gsol ba dang / /lha yi nga rgyal gnas par bya/ /33—495

spyod pa dge ba gang mos bya tsho / /dad yod khro med sbyin par bya/ /lus ngag yid kyi tshebya ba kun/ /bde ba che la ngang gnas bya/ /ma brjed pa yi bsam gtan bsten/ /de ltar byas na bla med 'gyur/ /gzhon nu'i sku 'chang thob par 'gyur/ /tshe 'di dag la bde bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis bsags pa'i cho ga yis/ /'gal ba ma mchis lha la bshags/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba yid 'ong kun/ /thams cad 'jam dpal thob par shog /a+yo)'phags pa 'jam dpal rin po che'i sgrub thabs/ dge bsnyen ma grags sbyin mas mdzad pa/ smṛ ti dz+nyā na tīrtis bsgyur ba rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/491 humatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaphags pa 'jam dpa/la rin po che'i cho ga bzhugs so// khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skong /492 —1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhasgro/ ༄ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tāta/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gos/ sre〈〈snar 〉〉gtso—/ 〈〈co 〉thartso/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stong / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyangs/ po〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhu/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉r+ya/ rtsasna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/493 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṭhas/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phros/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7tshon/'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'o/ ṣ+yo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhan+d+ra a bha/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pra/ ne+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhasmra/she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉da ye ti/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〉 ye ti/ lho1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhasmra/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasal/ tsha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/494 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉radon/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7 las/ ri — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ribacu drug phyed brgyad de phyed de/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zom shes/ 57〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ r+sha 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga kod/ dz+wa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas/3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi.a phag i yi u be+e/ e i/ o snyen e aḥ/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉donas/495 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi.a ā/ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya ha ra ha ra oṃ hūṃ s+thāḥ/ bha ga wān dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ/ wā shrī shwa ra ma hā wā tsa/ sarba dharma ga ga na/ a ma la su pa ri shurtse/ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha yi / ke 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 stong 33—496

pa'i nang / ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉dhu/ bu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pi/ 47〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ga⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gtan/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/496 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byas/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ska/ //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1421)33wa 497
