༄/ /nam mkha' dṛ ma smed pa shin tu yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi sgong po zhes bya ba/① ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ga nā ma la su pa ri shusgo dhan+d+ra dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha nā ma/ bod skad du/ nam mkha' dri ma med pa shin tu yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi snying po zhes bya ba/3 dkyil 'khor thams cad bsdus par gyur pa/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun 'jam dpal gyi don thams cad sgrub pa nam mkha' dri ma med pa shin tu yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i don gyi dgongs pa sbas pa phyin ci ma log pa'i man ngag las brgyud pa brjod par bya ste/ de nas yang dag bshad bgyi ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste/ /gru bzhir bgyi zhing sgo bzhi dang / /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /thig bzhi dang ni ldan gyur pa/ /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /grwa yi ④phyogs ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen spras par ni/ /33—498

dkyil 'khor phyi rol thig gdab po/ /de yi rim pa'i nang bzhugs kyel/ /'khor lo 'dra bar rdo rje yi/ /thig gis yongs su bskor bar bya/ /ka ba brgyad kyis mdzes bgyis par/ /rdo rje ka ba'i nang logs su/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lngas brgyan la/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sna tshogs pad+ma yid 'ong ba/ /'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar bcas/ /dag pa thams cad rab tu gnas/ /de yi lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /'od bzang ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /sen mo'i 'od ni shas cher dmar/ /chags bral la sogs chags pa che/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /skra mchog chen po mthon ka'i rtse/ /sangs rgyas rin chen cod pan ldan/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag brgyad pa/ /sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan/ /sna tshogs na bza' yang dag bsnams/ /byis pa'i rgyan kyis yang dag spud/ /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad brgyad cus yang dag brgyan/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ches/ /phyag gnyis dag ni rnam par brgyan/ /ral gri mda' dang rdo rje yis/ /g.yas pa'i phyag mchog rnam par mdzes/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dang gzhu/ /rdo rje dril mchog g.yon pa na/ /dri med dpe bral bsam mi khyab/ /shes rab ye shes dri ma med/ /mgon po sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos—/ /dkyil 'khor mdun gyi gtso gyur la 4/ /rdzogs sangs rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni nges par dgod/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma thams cad la/ /seng ge'i gdan gyi stengs bzhugs shing / /thams cad rin chen bdun bskor bar/ /'khor lo can ni brgyad bri'o③/ /gtsug tor chen po yi ge bdag /shar gyi 'dab mar yang dag bri/ /gtsug tor gdugs ni 33—499

dkar po dag /nub kyi 'dab mar dgod par bya/ /gzi brjid phung po lho phyogs su/ /gtsug tor rnam rgyal byang phyogs su/ /rnam par 'thor ba dbang ldan phyogs/ /me yi phyogs su gyen 'byung dgod/ /gyen 'byung chen po bden bral phyogs/ /rgyal ba rlung gi phyogs su dgod1/ /sngags rnams kun la'ang sgrub pa po2/ /'khor lo can ni de dag bri/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas su/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi po dag tu ni/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgod par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'ang sna tshogs rgyan dang gos 'chang ba/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /go rims ji bzhin bri bar bya/ /de nyid kyi ni mtshams kyi char/ /spyan dang de bzhin mā ma shī/ /gos dkar de bzhin sgrol ma ni/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya / /sgo rnams su yang sgo srung geni/ /rang gi mtshan mas phyag brgyan rngupa/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo ldan pasathu/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /rdo rje shugs kyis byung nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni gnyis pa ru/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo srung sgornams dang yang dag ldan/ /dag pa'i gzugs 7kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /der ni cho ga bzhin bri 37bya/ /shar phyogs su ni sa rnams bri/ /de bzhin lho ni rab 'bar ba'i/ /pha rol phyin pa thams cad bri/ /nub tu dbang rnams bcu po ste/ /byang du gzungs ni thams cad bri/ /de bzhin mtshams su sgeg mo sogs/ /dngos grub bde ba kun sogs pa/ /gsang sngags don dang ldan par bri / /rdo rje shugs kyis byung nas kyesu/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa gsum par ni/ /bskal pa bzang po thams cad dang / /de bzhin sgo srung 7rnams kyang bri/ /rdo rje me tog la sogs pa'ang / /go rims ji bzhin bri bar bya/ /de yi pho brang 1 33—500

phyi rol bri nyu/ /phyi rol rdo rje rigs kyi gnas/ /zlum zhing kun du bzang ba dang / /sgo bzhi shin tu mdzes par yang / /der ni tshangs pa la sogs pa/ /chung ma la sogs tshogs kyis brgyan/ /rgyan dang rang gi mtshan mar ldan/ /kun du rim bzhin legs par bri/ /phyi sgo'i shar gyi cha la ni/ /gshin rje gshed po'i phyag rgya che/ /thams cad bsrungs byel rab brtson pa/ /rnam pa kun du legs par gzhagabye /g.yon brkyang bas ni legs bzhugs shing / /phyag g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar mdzad la/ /phyag g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub bsgreng / /rab tu drag por bri bar bya/ /gzhan gyis mi thub khro bo che / /phyag rgya chen po lho phyogs su/ /khro bo chen po rta mgrin gyi/ /phyag rgya chen po nub phyogs su/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed spyan kyis spuni/ /phyag rgya chen po byang phyogs su/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor phyi rol du/ /bsrung ba'i phyir ni thams cad dgod / /de yi phyi rol khor yug dang / /khor yug chen po de bzhin bri/ /blo ldan yang dag kun rdzogs par/ /sngags zhes pas ni legs par bri/ /da ni sku mdog la sogs pa'i nges pa bshad par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs ni zla ba nya ba'i mdangs can gyi sku la/ rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba dang ldan pa'i cod pan kyi steng du/ sangs rgyas lnga'i rin po che'i rtse bran can du byas te lhag ma ni gsal bas go bar zad do/ /'khor los sgyur ba brgyad ni kun kyang gser gyi mdog can / rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ phyag g.yas na 'khor lo bstod de bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon gyis gdan la mnyes pas brten trepar mdzad pa'o/ /zhe sdang chen po bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa 33—501

ni / ut+pal sngon po'i mdog can zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis glang po'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ zhal dang po khro bo sgeg pa/ zhal g.yas pa gdangs shing drag po/ zhal g.yon pa tshems kyi sgros gnon pa/ zhal rgyab ma mchog tu gdug pa thams cad skrag par mdzad pa/ phyag g.yas pa 1 rnams na ral gri dang / rdo rje dang / mda' dang / lcags kyu bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon rnams ni pya sdogs mdzub bsgreng ba dang / dril bu dang / gzhu dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /chags pa chen po bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan ni gser gyi mdog can rin po che'i dbu rgyan mnga' ba/ zhal ser po dang / nag po dang / dkar po dang /dmar po dang ldan pa phyag brgyad pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis rta'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas rnams na rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / mda' dang /lcags kyu bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon rnams na yid bzhin kyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / dril bu dang / gzhu dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /'dod chags chen po bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa ni sku mdog dmar po rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ rdo rje'i miskyil mo krung gis rma bya'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ zhal sgeg pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa dmar po dang nag po dang / dkar po dang / ser po mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas rnams ni /thurdo rje dang / mda' dang / ral gri dang / lcags kyu bsnams pa/phyag g.yon 5na pad+ma dang / gzhu dang / zhags pa dang / dril bu bsnams pa'o / /khro bo chen po bcom ldan 'das don yod skugrub pa ni sku mdog nag po rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo 33—502

krung gis nam mkha' lding gi khri la bzhugaṭaṭa pa/ zhal dang po mche ba gcigs pa/kha dog nag po g.yas pa zhi ba/ kha dog dkar po rgyab sgeg pa/ kha dog dmar po / g.yon pa zhi ba'i tshul can mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas pa rnams rmyeral gri dang rdo rje dang / mda' dang lcags kyu bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon rnams na dril bu dang / gzhu dang sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba dang / zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyang nyi ma'i 'od mnga' ba/ rang gi gdan gyi steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs 1par bya'o//rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'ang sna tshogs rgyan dang gos 'chang ba/ dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /go rims —ji bzhin bri bar bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid du/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la dbang ldan kyi phyogs su rdo rje sems dpa 'a sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas kyis rang gi thugs kar rdo rje bstod pa'i tshul kyis bsnams pa/ g.yon bsnyems pas dril bu bsnams pa'o 5/ /pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gdan dang // skyil mo krung dang / dbu rgyan gyi nges pa ni rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa dang / thun mong yin la khyad par rnams ni bri bar bya ste/ rdo rje rgyal po sku mdog ser po rdo rje dang khru lcags kyu 'dren zhing bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje chags pa sku mdog dmar po tremada' dang gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje legs pa margad kyi mdog can phyag gnyis kyis legs so zhes bya ba sprul ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dkyil 'khor du/ rdo rje rin chen sgu mdog ser po rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas su/ phyag gnyis kyis dbang bskur ba'i 33—503

phreng ba 'ching zhing bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma sku mdog dmar po/ phyag gnyis kyis rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan sku mdog nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs/ phyag gnyis yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje bzhad pa ni sku mdog pad+ma'i rtsa hultar dkar ba / so'i phreng ba gnyis dang ldan pa'i rdo rje gnyis pa bsnams pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor du rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar skya/phyag g.yon pa bsnyems pas pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin cing phyag g.yas pas pad+ma'i 'dab ma kha 'byed pa'o/ /rdo rje rnon po ni 'dir sku mdog gur gum lta bu phyag g.yas kyis ral gri 'phyar ba/ phyag g.yon pas thugs kar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje rgyu sku mdog gser gyi mdog can chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o/ /rdo rje smra ba sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yas pa 2lce'i phyag dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yon pas ④dung bsnams pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das don yod rngugrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ rdo rje las sku mdog ljang gu phyag gnyis na rdo rje rtse gsum pa bsnams nas spyi bor 'jog cing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod pa'i don du gar mdzad cing bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje srung ba sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje go cha bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po phyag gnyis kyis mche ba gnyis rang gi zhal du 'dzin cing gdug pa thams cad 'jigs par mdzad pas bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje khu tshur bsdams nas bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams rnams su spyan ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang 'dra'o/ /mā ma tī ni mi bskyod pa dang 'dra'o/ /gos dkar mo ni 'od dpag tu med pa dang 'dra'o/ /33—504

sgol ma ni don yod par grub pa dang 'dra'o/ /sems ma bcu drug ni kun du bzang mo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i lcags kyu mo dang / dga' la chags ma dang legs ldan ma ste rdo rje rigs kyi'o/ /rin po che'i gtso mo hūṃ dang / rat+na'i sgrol ma dang / rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan dang / bkod pa dang ldan ma ⑤ dang bzhi ni rat+na'i rigs kyi'o/ /rdo rje sa mo dang kun du 'khor lo ma dang kye rlan 'dzin ma dang / stong du zlos ma bzhi pad+mo rigs kyi'o/ /dngos grub kyi rtse mo dang / thams cad bsrung ④ma dang / mdangs slar 'phrog ma dang /gzungs kyi phyag rgya rnams dang bzhi ni las kyi rigs kyi'o/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan sems dpa' bcu drug dang mthun no/ /'di'i lugs kyis spyan ma la rdo rje rigs kyi sems dpas bskor/ mā ma tī la rin po che'i rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhis bskor/ gzhan gnyis po yang rigs mthun pas bskor ba'o/ /'dir rdo rje thig gi nang logs su ri mo zur bzhi pa byas pa'i brgyad cha'i khyesgo ste rta babs med pa'o/ /lhag ma ni phyi'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i shar gyi sgor rdo rje lcags kyu sku mdog dkar po rdo rje lcags kyu bsnams pa g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa'o/ /lho'i sgor rdo rje zhags pa sku mdog ser po phyag na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa'o/ /nub kyi sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje lu gu rgyud bsnams pa sa ga'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /byang phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje 'be+ebs pa (khusku mdog ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje bsdams pas rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa zlum po'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs par bri bar bya ste nang gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /gnyis pa nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur te gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /gnyis 33—505

pa der yang shar phyogs su sa bcu gnyis bri bar bya ste/ kun kyang sna tshogs pad+ma la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/phyag g.yas na rdo rje bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon na rang gi mtshan ma bsnams pa'o/ /de la mos pas spyod pa'i sa ni sku mdog pad+ma ltar dmar ba phyag g.yon na pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa'o/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa ni rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can / phyag g.yon na yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsnams pa'o/ /dri ma med pa'i sa ni nor bu tshon shel gyi mdog can/ phyag g.yon gyis thams cad dag par so sor rtog pa'i pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa'o/ /'od byed pa'i sa ni nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog can/ phyag g.yon kyis sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa'o/ /'od 'phro ba'i sa ni margad lta bu'i mdog can phyag g.yon na a la bsnams pa'o/ /shin tu sbyangs 1dka' ba'i sa ni sku mdog ser po phyag g.yon pa pang bar bkan nas bzhag pas/ nor bu markata bsnams pa'o/ /mngon du gyur pa'i sa ni gser btso ma lta bu'i mdog can/ phyag g.yon gyis thupad+ma'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa'o/ /ring du song ba'i sa ni nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs phyag g.yon gyis zhusna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba'i sa ni ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/phyag g.yon pa ③bsnyems pas pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du rdo rje thulnga pa mdog dmar po ste/ pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin pa'o/ /legs pa'i blo gros kyi tsani sku mdog dmar skya phyag g.yon gyis a la'i steng du ral gri bsnams pa'o / /chos kyi sprin gyi ⑦ni gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yon gyis chos kyi sprin gyis yongs su bskor ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bsnams 33—506

pa'o—/ /sangs rgyas kyi ①kun du 'od ni nyi ma gung gi mdog can phyag g.yon pas pad+ma'i steng du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ston par byed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bsnams pa'o/ /lho phyogs su pha rol tu phyin pa bcu gnyis sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyan ⑤sna tshogs 'chang ba/ gzhon zhing dar la bab pa zhal gyi pad+ma sgeg pa'i nyams kyis rgyas pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa'i gser gyi gdu bus lag ngar bkang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / rtse bran mnga' ba/phyag g.yas pas sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa'i phyir yid bzhin kyi nor bu rin po che bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pas rang gi mtshan ma bsnams pa rim bzhin du bri bar bya'o/ /de la rin po che gapad+ma'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni pad+ma dmar po ltar sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yon pas pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sku mdog dmar skya/ phyag g.yon pas 'bru dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i snye ma bsnams pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgu mdog dkar po phyag g.yon pas a shwa ka'i me tog gi mgo spyogs 'dab ma dang bcas pa bsnams pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa markata kyi mdog can/ phyag g.yon pas at+pa la bsnams pa'o/ /bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs phyag g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yas kyis su chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o/ /phyag g.yon gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam 33—507

bsnams pa'o/ /thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pri yang ku ltar sku mdog ljang gu phyag g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po'i steng du rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /smon lam kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ut+pa la sngon po lta bu'i mdog can phyag g.yon kyis a la'i steng du ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyi ma'i mdog can phyag g.yon kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa'o/ /ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ①ston ka'i zla ba lta bu'i mdog can phyag g.yon pas rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'bras bus brgyan pa'i byang chub kyi shing gi yal ga bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje las kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sku mdog sna tshogs pa phyag g.yon pas sna tshogs pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /nub phyogs su dbang bcu pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs pa mnga' ba/ gzhon zhing dar la bab pa/ sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa / zhal kyi pad+ma cung zad 'dzum pa dang rjo/ spyan at+pa la sngon po'i 'dab ma 'dra ba/ 'od mtha' yas pa'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ phyag g.yas na pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yon na bsnyems pas rang gi mtshan ma bsnams par rim bzhin du bri bar byarngu/ de la tshe la dbang ba sku mdog dmar skya/ phyag g.yon na pad+ma rā ga'i nor bu'i 'dab ma'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs ④pa'i sku bsnams pa'o/ /sems la dbang ba zla ba'i mdog can phyag g.yon gyis me tog ban+d+ra ka ltar dmar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa'o/ /yo byad la dbang ba sku mdog ser po phyag g.yon na yid bzhin kyi nor bu rin po che'i rgyal mtshan bsnams pa'o/ /las la dbang ba markata lta bu'i mdog can phyag g.yon sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /skye ba la 32—508

dbang ba sku mdog sna tshogs pa/ phyag g.yon kha dog sna tshogs pa dzā ti'i yal ga bsnams pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba sku mdog ljang gu phyag g.yon na pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa'o/ /mos pa la dbang ba pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar mdog dkar ba/ phyag g.yon na me tog pri yang ku'i snye ma bsnams pa'o/ /smon lam la dbang ba gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yon na a la sngon po bsnams pa'o/ /ye shes la dbang ba mthon ka chen po'i mdog can/phyag g.yon na a la sngon po'i steng du ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /chos la dbang ba sku mdog dmar skya/ phyag g.yon na pad+ma'i steng du bum pa bzang po bsnams pa'o//yid bzhin nor bu'i tshon shel gyi mdog can/ phyag g.yas na pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa'o①/ /phyag g.yon na rin po che'i shing gi yal ga bsnams pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi byang chub gser btso ma lta bu'i mdog can phyag g.yas na pad+ma ser po'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i rgyal mtshan kyi steng du 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /'di gnyis kyi gdan dang dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i dbang rnams dang 'dra bar /rngu bya'o/ /byang phyogs su gzugs zu/bcu gnyis sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa'i skyil mo khyokrung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/rin bo che'i dbu rgyan gyi rtse bran can/ phyag g.yas na sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pabye/phyag g.yon gyis phyo dkur brten pas rang gi mtshan ma bsnams par rim bzhin du bri bar bya'o/ /de la nor ldan gyi gzungs tsoni gser gyi mdog can/ phyag g.yon na 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa'o/ /rin chen sgrol nya ma'i gzungs ni pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can/ phyag g.yon na yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bsnams 33—509

pa'o—/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i gzungs ni sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yon na nor bu chu shel gyi bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /'od zer can gyi gzungs ni sku mdog dmar skya/ phyag g.yon na khab dang skud pa bsnams pa'o/ /ri khrod ① lo ma can gyi gzungs ni/ sku mdog ljang gu phyag g.yon na lo ma sbom ⑤pa bsnams pa'o/ /dug sel ma'i gzungs ni sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yon na dug gi me tog gi snye ma bsnams pa'o/ /sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs ni sku mdog pri yang ku ltar ljang ser/ phyag g.yon na pad+ma dmar po'i steng du mi zad pa'i gter chen po'i bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /skul byed ma'i gzungs ni ston ka'i zla ba lta bu'i mdog can/ phyag g.yon na phreng ba 'phyang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /shes rab 'phel ba'i gzungs ni ston ka'i zla ba nya ba thu lta bu'i mdog can phyag g.yon na a la sngon po'i steng du ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs ni nor bu markad /7 lta bu'i mdog can/ phyag g.yon pa na rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i pad+ma dmar skya bsnams pa'o/ /ye shes mi zad pa'i za ma tog gi gzungs ni/ sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yon na rin po che'i za ma tog bsnams pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi mdzod dang ldan pa'i gzungs ni gser btso ma'i mdog can phyag g.yon na pyekha dog sna tshogs pa'i sgom bu bsnams pa'o/ /gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi shar phyogs kyi sgor/ chos so so 6yang dag par rig pa sku mdog dmar skya/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can phyag na rdo rje lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa bri'o/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor don 3so so 8yang dag par rig pa sku mdog markata lta bu phyag na 33—510

rin po che'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /nub phyogs kyi sgor nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa sku mdog dmar skya/ phyag na mtha' gnyis su pad+mas mtshan pa'i lcags sgog bsnams pa/ gdan dang rgyan la sogs pa ni snga ma bzhin no/ /byang phyogs kyi sgor spobs pa so so ①/yang dag par rig pa sku mdog markata ltar ljang gu④/ phyag gnyis kyis a+yordo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dril bu bsnams pa ste lhag ma rnams ni snga ma bzhin no/ /shar lho'i mtshams su lha mo sgeg mo gser gyi mdog can rin po che'i cod pan mnga' ba/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa / phyag gnyis ka rdo rje bsnyems pa'i tshul thu'achang ba'o/ /lho nub mtshams su phreng ba ma sku mdog dmar skya/ phyag na rin po che'i phreng ba bsnams pa/bzhugs tshul la sogs ni sgeg mo dang 'dra'o/ /nub byang mtshams su glu ma sku mdog dmar po pi wang brdung ba la brtson pa ste/ lhag ma ni snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /byang shar mtshams su gar ma sku mdog ljang gu/ phyag gis mchog gi rtsed mo dang gar mdzad pa ste lhag ma ni sgeg mo dang 'dra'o/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor kyi sgo srungs ltarnams ni tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi'i ngo bo nyid do/ /dkyil 'khor bar ma ni so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'o/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo srung ⑥rnams ni bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i rang bzhin yin no/ /rim pa gsum pa'i shar phyogs su kun du bzang po gser gyi mdog can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/rin po che'i dbu rgyan can phyag g.yas kyis mchog stsol ba/ phyag g.yon kyis aX la'i steng du ral gri bsnams pa/ pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa'i 4 skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /blo gros mi zad pa gser gyi 33—511

mdog can phyag g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /phyag g.yon gyis chos ston pa'i tshul gyis pad+ma bsnams pa ste/ rgyan dang / bzhugs tshul la sogs pa ni kun du bzang po dang 'dra'o/ /sa'i snying po gser btso ma'i mdog can phyag g.yas kyis sa gnon/ phyag g.yon pad+ma'i steng na dpag bsam gyi shing bsnams pa'o / /nam mkha'i snying po sku mdog markata ltar ljang thu ser phyag g.yas kyis rin po che 5thams cad kyi char 'be+ebs pa/ phyag g.yon na yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bsnams pa'o/ /lho phyogs su nam mkha' mdzod gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yas na yid bzhin kyi nor bu bsnams pa'o1/ /phyag g.yon na bum pa bzang po las 4'phyang ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing bsnams pa⑤/ phyag na rin po che sku mdog ljang gu phyag g.yas pa rin po che sbyin pa la brtson pa/ phyag g.yon pa na pad+ma'i steng du byang chub kyi zla ba bsnams pa'o/ /rgya mtsho'i blo gros ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ phyag g.yas na dung bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon na ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje snying po sku mdog a la sngon po'i 'dab ma 6lta bu phyag g.yas na rdo rje bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon na sa bcu ston pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa'o/ /nub phyogs su spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug sku mdog dkar ngo/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i cod pan can 3phyag g.yas kyis dam pa sbyin pa/phyag g.yon na pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /mthu chen po thob pa gser gyi mdog can/phyag g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon na pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /zla ba'i 'od pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar ba/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje'i 'khor lo bsnams pa / phyag g.yon gyis pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa8/ dra ba can gyi 'od sku mdog dmar skya phyag g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa/ phyag 33—512

g.yon na pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa'o/ /byang phyogs su 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar ba/ phyag g.yas na sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon na pad+ma'i steng du bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /spobs pa brtsegs ①pa gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yas kyis se gol brdebs kyepar brtson pa phyag g.yon na pad+ma'i steng du ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /mya ngan gyi myun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros gur gum ⑦gyi mdog can phyag g.yas na 'od 'phro ba mang po 'khrugs ④pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon na mdung thung bsnams pa'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba at+pa la sngon po'i 'dab ma'i mdog can phyag g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon na sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ba dan bsnams pa bri bar bya ste/ de dag thams cad kyi bzhugs tshul dang / rgyan dang na bza' dang / dbu rgyan rnams ni kun du bzang po dang 'dra bar shes par bya stephye/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ni 'od dpag tu med pa'i cod pan can te khyad par ni de yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gnas de nyid kyi byang shar mtshams su khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba at+pa la sngon po'i 'dab ma lta bu'i mdog can/ zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa / zhal dang po khro bo ⑥sgeg pa ste/ dmar ba g.yas pa/ drag po g.yon pa/'jigs su rung ba/ rgyab dpa' bo'i ṣ+yozhal dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu dang ldan pa ste/ de gnyis kyi thugs kar hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'chang ba / phyag g.yas rnams na ral gri dang lcags kyu dang / mda' bsnams pa/phyag g.yon rnams na gzhu dang / zhags pa dang / rdo rje bsnams pa/g.yon brkyang bar bzhugs pa'i zhabs g.yon pas dbang phyug chen po'i spyi bor 33—513

gnon pa/ zhabs g.yas pas u ma'i nu ma rgyas pa mnan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi me tog gi phreng ba brgyus pa la sogs pa'i rgyan dang / na bza' sna tshogs mnga' ba / gdug pa can thams cad gdul ①bar bya ba'i phyir nges par gzhag 3 par bya'o/ /shar lho mtshams su khro bo rdo rje me ltar ①'bar ba char sprin gyi mdog can 'od can gyi ④phreng ba 'bar bas kun du 'khrug pa/ zhal bzhi pa/phyag brgyad pa/ zhal sgeg pa dang / dpa' ba dang / 'jigs su rung ba dang /snying rje chen po la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas rnams na rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / mda' dang / 'khor lo bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon rnams ni mudril bu dang / zhags pa dang / gzhu dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga btags pa'i ba dan sna tshogs pa bsnams pa/ me ser skya 'bar ba'i sgra'i spyotshogs shin tu 'jigs su rung ba/ sbrul chen po'i gdu bu dang / dbu rgyan dang ska rags dang / zhabs gdub dang / mgur chu dang / rna rgyan dang / cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen po'i 'khor lo 3dgod pa la mkhas pa las/g.yon brkyang bas khyab 'jug chung ma dang bcas pa gnon pa bri bar bya'o/ /lho nub mtshams su khro bo chen po rdo rje khrag 'thung sku mdog mthing shun ltar sngo ba/zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ zhal dang po drag po/ zhal g.yas pa rab tu rmongs pa rnams sems 8rmongs par byed pa/ zhal g.yon pa sgeg pa dang ldan pa/zhal rgyab baṃ 9snaza bar byed pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar ba bsnams pa/phyag g.yon na dril bu dang ba dan dang bcas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ⑫ga bsnams pa dang gar mdzad pa/ yang gnyis kyis 'jigs byed chen po'i pags pa rlon pa rlung gi 11gos 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis bzung munas bsnams pa/ yang gnyis na mda' dang 33—514

gzhu bsnams pa/ yang phyag g.yas na ma hā rak+tas yongs su bkang ba'i ka pā la'i thod tshal tsa sha ka bsnams pa/ yang phyag g.yon na snying gi pad+ma'i nang na ma hā rmā sas bkang ba'i ka pā la bsnams pa/ sangs rgyas lngas mtshan pa'i thod pa lnga'i dbu rgyan gyis sangs rgyas kyi gtsug gi nor bu can 1cod pan mnga' ba/'od zer sngon po 'bar ba'i rang bzhin mnga' ba/ 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor can zhes bya ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po mnga' ba/g.yon brkyang bas tshangs pa chung ma dang bcas pa mnan nas bzhugs par bri'o//nub byang mtshams su rta mchog sku mdog ljang gu zhal bzhi pa zhabs bzhi pa phyag brgyad pa/ zhal dang po khro bo sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/zhal g.yas drag po/ zhal g.yon tshangs pa'i gdong dang ldan pa/ spyi bo'i zhal ljang gu mchu dang spyi bo'i gtsug rngu nas gyen du 'degs pa/ phyag g.yas kyis ba dan gsum pa lta bu'i 4sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pas 'degs 5pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ phyag g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga tresna tshogs pad+ma bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i gnyis pas ba dan gsum pa lta bus gyen du slong ba'i tshul du mdzad 3pa / phyag g.yon pa'i gnyis pa na mdung thung bsnams pa/ yang phyag g.yas kyi gnyis na ral gri dang mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon kyi phyag gnyis na dbyug pa dang gzhu bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i gnas pas bzhugs pa/ g.yas pa / gcig gis dbang po dang dbang mo mnan pa/ gnyis pas dga' ba mo dang mgu ba mo mnan pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos brgya byin dang khyab 'jug mnan pa/gnyis pas rgyal bar byed pa dang 'dod pa'i lha mnan nas bzhugs par bri'o/ /de nyid kyi shar phyogs kyi sgor khro bo gshin rje gshed char sprin gyi mdog can/33—515

zhal drug pa phyag drug pa zhabs drug pa/ zhal drug po sgeg pa dang / dpa' ba dang / 'jigs su rung ba dang / zhi ba dang / drag po dang rngam pa ste/nyams rnam pa sna tshogs pas yongs su khyab cing rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas na lcags kyu bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba dang /zhags pa bsnams pa/ yang phyag g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang mda' bsnams pa / phyag g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang dril bu bsnams pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can sbrul gyis brgyan pa stag gi ⑩pags pa bsnams 1 pas/ ma te'i steng du rol pa'i stang stabs kyis bzhugs pa bri'o/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor shes rab mthar byed ge sar ser po lta bu'i mdog can/ zhal bzhi pa phyag brgyad pa/zhal dang po sgeg pa/ zhal g.yas pa gdangs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ zhal g.yon pa zhi ba/ zhal rgyab ma shin tu drag cing gtum pa/ phyag g.yas na gzhug par byed pa'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ de las gzhan pas rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pas thugs ka'i phyogs su lcags kyu dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba la brtson pa de las gzhan par dril bu dang mdung thung dang gzhu bsnams pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ rol pa'i stang stabs kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs par bri'o//nub phyogs kyi sgor pad+ma mthar byed sku mdog dmar po/ zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa zhal dang po dang / g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dang / rgyab ma ste bzhi po grangs ji lta ba bzhin du sgeg pa dang / drag po dang zhi ba dang / dgod pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje lcags sgrog bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' bsnams 33—516

pa / phyag g.yon rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang / zhags pa dang gzhu bsnams pa/klu'i rgyal pos brgyan cing stag gi nyepags pa mnabs 2pa/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la brtan par chags shing / 'ching ba dang / pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rol pa'i stang stabs kyis bzhugs par bri bar bya'o/ /byang phyogs kyi sgor khro bo bgegs mthar byed sprin sngon po'i mdog can/ zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa/zhal sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas dang g.yon gnyis kyis rdo rje bcings pas da dril bu bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas rnams na ral gri dang mda' dang lcags kyu bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon rnams na sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang bcas pa dang / gzhu dang dril bu bsnams pa/ sgu la sbrul gyes brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi cod pan can g.yon brkyang bas tshogs kyi bdag po mnan nas bzhugs pa ④bri'o/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams su ri mo bris la dre tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams dgod par bya ste/ me'i phyogs su me tog ma sku mdog ser ba phyag gnyis me tog gis bkang ba'o/ /bden bral gyi phyogs su bdug pa ma sgu mdog sngo ba/ phyag na spos khang bsnams pa'o/ /rlung gi phyogs su mar me ma sku mdog dmar ba phyag na mar me+e'i sdong bu bsnams pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs su byug pa ma sku mdog ljang gu phyag na dung chos bsnams pa'o//shar phyogs kyi sgo'i mtshams su rdo rje gzugs ma sgu mdog ser po phyag g.yas na me long bsnams pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi sgo'i mtshams su rdo rje sgrol ma/ 5nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs⑥/ phyag na rdo rje pi wang bsnams pa'o/ /nub phyogs kyi sgo'i mtshams su rdo rje dri sku mdog ljang gu phyag na dri'i snod bsnams pa'o/ /byang phyogs kyi sgo'i mtshams su rdo rje ro sgu mdog sna tshogs pa phyag na ro'i snod bsnams 33—5/7

pa'o / /rdo rje shugs kyis byung la phyi rol gyi rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang ldan gyi phyogs nas brtsams te/ yongs su bskor bar tshangs pa la sogs pa go rims ji lta ba bzhin du bri bar bya'o/ /de la byang shar mtshams su dbang ldan mdog dkar po ral pa dang cod pan yod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rtse gsum pa /rmyethod pa 'dzin pa/ lag pa gnyis kyis thal mo sbyar nas mgor bzhag khyapa ste/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba/ khyu mchog la zhon pa/ lha mo u ma dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs par bri'o/ /de bzhin du thams cad kyang phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mos rngo 'dud par byed pa la mchog tu gzhol ba/ dkyil 'khor la mngon par phyogs par bri'o/ /de la 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad ni phyogs dang mtshams rnams su bri bar bya ste/ shar du brgya byin mdog ser po rdo rje thogs pa/ glang po che dkar po la zhon pa chung ma dang bcas pa bri'o/ /shar lhor me lha mdog dmar po lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na blugs gzar dang dbyug pa thogs pa/ g.yon gnyis phreng ba dang gudhe ④thogs pa ra skyeskyes la zhon pa chung ma dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo ni thams cad kyi thun mong ma thuyin pas so sor ma smras so/ /lhor gshin rje mdog nag mo )dbyug pa dang mdung thung thogs pa/ ma he la zhon pa chung ma dang bcas pa bri'o / /lho nub tu srin po'i bdag po mdog sngon po lag na ral gri dang phub thogs pa/ mi ro la zhon pa chung ma dang bcas pa bri'o/ /nub tu chu lha mdog dkar po g.yas dang g.yon gnyis na dung dang spu/ sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs pa/chu srin la zhon pa gdengs ka kyebadun pa chung ma dang bcas pa dz+re'o/ /nub byang du rlung lha nam mkha'i mdog can lag pa gnyis na ba dan thogs pa ri dwags la 33—518

zhon pa chung ma dang bcas pa hūṃbri'o/ /byang du lus ngan po gser kyi mdog can g.yas na lcags kyu thogs pa/ g.yon na dbyug pa thogs pa mi la zhon pa chung ma dang bcas par bri'o/ /'di dag gi chung ma rnams kyi mdog la sogs pa ni de rang rang gi khyo dang 'dra bar blta bar bya'o/ /dbang ldan dang nye bar tshangs pa mdog ser po gdong bzhi pa lag pa bzhi pa/ lag pa gnyis na pad+ma dang phreng ba thogs nas phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo sbyar te/ 'jog pa de las gzhan pa gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ngang pa la zhon pa chung ma dang bcas pa'i 'khor gyis bskor bar bri'o/ /de'i 'og tu khyab 'jug mdog nag mo lag pa bzhi pa g.yas dang g.yon gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang mdung thogs nas spyi bor thal mo sbyar te 'jog pa/ de las dzugazhan pa gnyis kyis sha ra'i gzhu dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa nam mkha' lding la zhon pa chung ma dang bcas pa'i 'khor gyis bskor bar bri'o/ /dbang phyug chen po mdog dkar po lag pa gnyis na zuthod pa dang / rtse gsum thogs te thal mo sbyar ba zla ba'i rtse bran thogs pa khyu mchog la zhon pa chung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pas yongs su bskor bar bri'o/ /gzhon nu kārti ka mdog dmar po byis pa'i gzugs can gdong drug pa/ lag pa drug pa lag pa gnyis kyis thal mo sbyar ba byas la/ yang lag pa gnyis na mdung thung dang rdo rje thogs pa/ yang gnyis na khyim bya dang / dril bu thogs pa rma bya la zhon par bri'o/ /nag po chen po mdog nag po mdung rtse gsum pa dang thod pa thogs pa'o/ /dga' byed dbang phyug ni mdog nag po rdza rnga brdung ba la brtson pa rdza rnga la zhon pa'o/ /nyi ma ni mdog dmar po lag pa gnyis na pad+ma la gnas pacho / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor thogs pa rtas drangs pa'i shing rta la zhon pa'o/ /33—519

zla ba ni mdog dkar po lag pa gnyis na pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor thogs pa ngang pa la zhon pa'o/ /mig dmar ni mdog dmar po la lag pa g.yas pa na chu gri thogs pa/ lag pa g.yon pa na mi mgo za bar byed pa glang po che la zhon pa'o/ /gza' lag rmyeni mdog ser po lag na mda' gzhu thogs pa pad+ma la 'dug pa'o/ /phur bu mdog dkar po lag na phreng ba dang spyi blugs thogs pa pad+ma la gnas pa'o/ /pa ba bsangs byemadog dkar po phreng ba dang gudhe chothogs pa bum pa la cho'adug pa'o/ /spen pa mdog nag po dbyug pa thogs pa rus sbal la zhon pa'o/ /sgra gcan mdog dmar nag lag na nyi zla thogs pa'o/ /mjug rings mdog nag po ral gri dang sbrul kyi zhags pa thogs pa'o/ /stobs bzang mdog nag po ral gri dang gshol thogs pa glang po che la zhon pa'o/ /rgyal bar byed pa mdog ljang gu me tog gi phreng ba dang / mda' dang gzhu dang kham phor thogs pa/ ko ki la'i shing rta la zhon pa'o/ /sbrang rtsir byed pa mdog dkar po lag na chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang / mda' dang gzhu dang kham phor thogs pa ne+e tsho'i 5khri la zhon pa'o/ /dpyid kyi lha mdog dkar po lag na mda' dang gzhu dang / kham phor dang ral gri thogs pa sprin la zhon pa'o/ /mtha' yas dang nor rgyas dang / 'jog po dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma chen po dang / dung skyong dang / rigs ldan te klu'i rgyal po brgyad de ༄ gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa/ thal mo sbyar ba byas pa rtsebri'o/ /de la mtha' yas dang / rigs ldan gnyis ni bram ze'i rigs te mdog dmar po me lha'i bu'o/ /nor rgyas dang dung skyong gnyis ni rgyal rigs te/ mdog ser po brgya byin gyi bu'o/ /'jog po dang pad+ma chen po gnyis ni dmangs rigs te 33—520

mdog nag po rlung lha'i bu'o/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma gnyis ni rje'u rigs te/mdog dkar po chu lha'i bu'o/ /de dag kyang 'khor dang bcas pa thubri'o/ / thags bzangs ris 5dang stobs ldan dang / rab dga' dang / rnam par snang byed la sogs pa'i lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnams ni mdog nag bo ral gri dang phub la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa lag na bye go cha gon zhing chas pa 'khor dang bcas pa byebri'o/ /nam mkha' lding gi dbang po rnams ni gshog rgyang 4ring ba kha dog sna tshogs pa pus mo'i lha nga'i bar du kha ba ltar dkar ba/de'i steng du lte ba'i khung bu la thug gi bar du gser gyi mdog can/ de nas lkog ma'i bar du nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog can/ de nas klad pa'i steng gi mthar thug par ma lus par asbyo 3na bcag pa lta bu'i mdog can/ nam mkha' lding du mas yongs su bskor bar bri'o/ /mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa ni mdog dmar skya/ lag na pi wang thogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mi'am sbu'i rgyal po du mas yongs su bskor bar bri'o/ /dri za'i rgyal po gtsug phud lnga pa ni gser kyi mdog can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dri za'i rgyal po du mas yongs su bskor bar bri'o/ /rig byepa 'dzin pa'i dbang po'i rgyal po don thams cad grub pa ni gser btso ma lta bu'i mdog can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po du mas yongs su bskor bar bri'o/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyang lag na pañca pu kyer dang ne+e'u le thogs pa'o/ /de la gang ba bzang po ni mdog sngon po/ nor bu bzang po ni mdog ser po/ nor sbyin ni kyi/mdog dmar po/ rnam thos sras ni mdog ser po pi tsi guṇ+ḍa li mdog dmar po ki li mi li mdog ljang gu/ sgo'i dbang po mdog ser po/ spyod pa'i 33—521

dbang po mdog ser po/ 'phrog ma gser gyi mdog can de la bu dang bcas pa'o / /de dag thams cad kyang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bri'o/ /tha skar sgu mdog dkar po/ bra nye mdog ljang gu/ smin drug mdog ljang ser/snar ma mdog dmar skya/ mgo mdog nag po/ lag mdog dkar po/ nab so mdog dkar po/ rgyal mdog ljang gu/ skag mdog dkar po/ mchu mdog dkar po/ bye mdog pri gru yang ku ltar ljang ser/ dbo mdog ljang gu/me bzhi mdog dkar po/ nag pa mdog ljang gu/ sa ri mdog dkar po/sa ga mdog nag po/ lha mtshams mdog ljang gu/ spyon mdog dkar po/snrubs mdog dkar po/ chu stod mdog nag po/ chu smad mdog skya bo/ gro bzhin mdog dmar 3skya/ byi bzhin mdog ljang gu/ mon gru mdog nag po/mon gre mdog ser po/ khrums stod mdog ljang gu/ khrums smad mdog ser po/nam gru mdog ser skya ste/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad po de dag thams cad kyang rgyan dang ldan zhing gos gyon pa/ thal mo sbyar ba/ bud rnged kyi gzugs su bri'o/ /tshangs pa ma ni tshangs pa dang 'dra bar bri'o/ /drag po ma ni drag po lta bu'o/ /khyab 'jug ma ni khyab 'jug lta bu'o/ /gzhon nu ma ni kārti ka lta bu'o/ /dbang po ma ni brgya byin lta bu'o/ /phag mo ni mdog nag po ste/ yi dwags la zhon pa/ nya rlon pa dang / thod pa lag na thogs pa'o/ /dga' byed ma ni mdog dmar po yi dwags la zhon pa/ kā ti ra dang thod pa lag na thogs pa'o/ /de dang nye ba nyid du z-iṅgi thuri ti bri 6ste/ ma mo bdun z-iṅgi rkyeri ti dang bcas par bri bar bya'o/ /tshogs kyi bdag po ni mdog dkar po lag pa bzhi pa/ glang po che'i mdog bye7can lag pa g.yas dang g.yon pa na la du dang la phug thogs pa/ de las gzhan pa gnyis na 33—522

mdung rtse gsum dang dgra sta thogs pa/ sbrul ser mkhar thogs pa/ byi la 0bhel zhon pa/ tshogs du mas yongs su bskor ba bri bar bya'o/ /lha gzhan dag kyang gzhal yas khang na gnas par bri'o/ /'dir yang sgo srung 2rnams ni rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa de dag nyid yin no/ /de ltar na nam mkha' ltar dri ma med pa shin tu yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po sems can thams cad kyi sangs rgyas nyid la sogs pa'i dngos grub ma lus shing / ma tshang ba med par bsgrub pa la sangs rgyas nyid la sogs pa'i 'bras bu mngon par 'dod pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la sogs pas mngon par 'dod pa'i don sdogs par 'gyur bas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mdor bsdus nas bri bar bya'o/ /de nas sngar ③nam mkha' dri ma med pa shin tu yongs su dag pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur zhing rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i slob dpon gyis gang gi tshe/ slob mas lan gnyis lan gsum du gsol ba btab par gyur na/ de'i tshe 'di ltar yid la bya ste / ngas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis 4basbu bas sems can thams cad bsdu bar bya'o/ /'di la yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sbyin par bya'o zhes bsam mo/ /de nas slob ma de la che ge mo zhes bya ba khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug par 'dod dam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /gal te bdag 'tshal lo zhes zer na/des kyang dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad tshogs sam/ 'on te ma yin zhes dri bar bya'o//33—523

gal te cung zad ni tshogs gyoso zer na/ de nas de'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du 'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng ba kun du 'khrigs pa'i yi ge hūṃ bsam pa dang / snying gar yang las kyi sgrib pa'i ngo bo ④yi ge ka ④nag por bsams la yi ge hūṃ gi 'bar ba'i 'od kyis gyen du 'byin par byed cing sna bug g.yas pa nas nges par 'byung ba ni gcer bu ④gzugs mi sdug pa gsus ⑤pa 'phyang ba/ skra gyen du badze+es pa byung ba dang / yi ge hūṃ yang snying gar phyin pa dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi gzugs kyi sna khung de nyid nas byung nas gsang sngags bye de za bar gyur par bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa khā da ya khā da ya/sarba pā paṃ ā ba ra ṇa ④ ā l+ya hūṃ phaṭa/ yang na hūṃ las byung ba'i ro stod khro bo'i gzugs la ro smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs su gnas pa'i phur bus gsang sngags 'di dang de nyid du phur bus gdab par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya/sarba bispyo ban+ta brnya phyahūṃ phaṭa/ de nas slob ma de spu saṃ las byung ba'i kun du bzang po'i gzugs su bsams la⑫ / de'i spyi bor haṃ phyung ⑪ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje bsrung ba'i don du bsam par bya ste/ de ltar byas na nang gi bdag nyid can gyi bgegs rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yo byad ma tshogs pa rnams kyang bde blag tu tshang bar 'gyur ro/ /slob ma yongs su gzung ⑫ ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sbyor ba dang ldan pas grog mkhar gyis dang / skra dang phub ma la sogs pa las rang rang gi phyogs skyong gi gzugs brnyan bya ste/dkyil 'khor gyi bgegs byed pa rnams sngags 'dis bkug la bcug ste/bcings la phur bus legs par btab ste/ hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i yungs 33—524

kar gyis bsnun la gzhag ①par bya'o/ /khro bo'i khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar ba byas la mthe'u chung gnyis lcags sgrog lta bur mdud de/ mdzub mo g.yas pa lcags kyur byas la bzhag ②pa ni rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgya ste sngags la/ oṃ badz+ra i gu ①sha ma hā kro dha ā kaste ya sarba sa ma yi hūṃ dzaḥ/ de nyid dang mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad nas zhags pa dang 'dra bar bzhag ④pa ni rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya ste/ sngags la oṃ badz+ra pā sha ma hā kro dha pra be+e sha ya sarba sa ma ya hūṃ hūṃ/ de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis lu gu rgyud ltar mdud pa ni rdo rje lcags sgog gi phyag rgya ste/ sngags la/ oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa ma hā kro dha ban+dha ya sarba sa ma ya hūṃ baṃ/ de nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya basbungs la de rnams kyi mgo la yi ge hūṃ bkod de/ snga ma bzhin du rdo rje phur bu bskyed la/ rkang pa'i mthar thug pa'i bar du phur bus gdab par bsams te/bka' bsgo ba'i tshul gyis sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra kri li tī la ya sarba bispyo choban+dha ⑥hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas badz+ra shī li khri la ru ṭa ma ṭa/ zhes ⑦ bya ba lan bdun bzlas pa'i yungs kar yi ge hūṃ 'bar ba lta bus brdeg par bya ste/ cho ga 'di ni ji srid dkyil 'khor zhag gi bar du nyin re zhing nyi ma gung la bya'o/ /pha rol gyi bgegs gzhom pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su spos chu la sogs pas nye bar byugs shing me tog sel ma gtor la bdug spos dri zhim pos bdug pa dang / ci snyed pa'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa dag tu stan nang tshangs can 'jam pa la 'dug ste/ sngags 'di dag gis sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ ka pi ka pi ka pi kye tsi ka ma na so bhu tai rā ga de sha mo ha mā da ma na a bhikhye na 33—525

yarmi tai zubhe tre kā li rka/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba pā pa ①spo ṭa yā 1mi swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ pra ti de sha mi swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta rgo/ at+ma dubha ba na nit+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta pra ti kṛṇ+ḍan ⑤tu saṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pubye dz+nyā na saṃ bha ram̐ a nu mo de yā mi swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa man+ta bha dra ma hā badz+ra sa ma ya ma hā bo dhi cibhot+pā ta mut+pa da ⑥ya mi swā hā/ de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shwan ④si ta sarba sa ta dhā māṃ④/ sarba sidha ya saṃ pa na r+yan lta sarba ta thā ga tash+tsa abyeṣ+ṭha nā tai5 /swa bhā ba shubyeḥ ⑩sarba dharmāskyeḥswa bhā ba shurnyophohaṃ/ zhes bya bas phyi dang nang gi chos thams cad gzod ma nas ma skyes pa rang bzhin kyis yongs su dag pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyis bsgom pa'i sems nyid nam mkha'i ngos kyi dbus su chud pa 'od kyi dra ba chen po dang ldan pa'i pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa la de'i steng du shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid can gyi yi ge mu kha dog dmar skya/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu ⑫med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun 'jam dpal zla ba lta bu'i sku dang ldan pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang / mda' bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon gnyis na shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i glegs bam dang gzhu bsnams pa nyid de/ shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs/ /zhes bya ste/sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can ⑫mnga' ba/ byis pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa—/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / khro bo dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rig pa'i lha mo thams cad spro ba thudang / bsdu ba'i 8bdag nyid can du bdag nyid rnam par bsams la/ snying ga dang smin mtshams dang / sgog ma dang 33—526

spyi bo rnams su rdo rje dang rin po che dang / pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje dag la rdo rje sems ma dang / rin chen sems ma dang / chos kyi sems ma dang / las kyi sems ma'i ngo bo nyid de/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab par bdag nyid rnam par bsams la/ sa ma ya ①s+t+waṃ haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas mdun du yi ge dīḥ⑤las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed la ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje be+egs kyu la sogs pas bkug ①la bcings te/ dbang du bya ba ④nas mchod yon dang zhabs bsel dang / me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang / dri la sogs pas yang dag par mchod la/ lta ba nyid du byas nas de bzhin du mchod cing dbang bskur la rang gi lus la gzhug par bya ste/ ye shes sems dpa' de bltas nas rang gi lus la rnam par bsgom zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas gcig tu gyur pas 3rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang pos brgyan pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sogs pa'i snye'ajig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sprul par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbang bskur bas tshedabang bskur bar bdag nyid shes nas rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcings la/ gan rkyal du khar bzhag ste/ thams cad bskor la sngags 'di lan bdun bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūṃ phyag rgya ni rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ mdzub mo dang maze'u chung gnyis lu gu rgyud ltar byas pa ni rdo rje 'khor lo'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ma lus pa mngon sum bzhin du yang dag par bltas la/ 'og nas bshad pa'i mchod pa'i khyad par rnams kyis legs par mchod de/ rje btsun gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa thun bzhi'i rim gyis ji srid du mthong bar gyur pa de srid du bzla bar bya ba'am/33—527

mtshan ma byung ba'am/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir rmi lam mthong gi bar du/ oṃ badz+ra tīkyā 1zhes bya ba la sogs pa'am/ gsang sngags gzhan dag bzla ba'am/rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa spyo ba dang bsdu ba'i bdag nyid can skad cig ma'i ye shes las byung ba'i rje btsun 'jam dpal du bdag nyid bsams la/dngos po thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid sems tsam gyi sprul pa ⑤khong du chud pas sems kyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor lo yang dag par bltas la ji srid mtshan ma byung bar gyur pa de srid kyi bar du mtshan yang dag par brjod pa bklag par bya'o//sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa'o/ /de'i 'og tu nyin re'am/ zla ba re'am/ lo re nyid du ji ltar dzu mngon par dga' bar bsgrub cing zla ba yar gyi ngo la cho ga bzhin du rtedakyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /de la rgyal pos ni khru brgya'am/ khru lnga bcu'o/ /blon po'am blon po chen po rnams kyis ni khru lnga bcu'am/ nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /ded dpon nam/tshong dpon chen po rnams kyis ni nyi shu rtsa lnga'am/ de'i phyed do/ /sgrub pa po rnams kyis ni khru bcu gnyis sam/ khru drug pa'am/ ci nus par bya'o/ /de la dang por re zhig yo byad thams cad yang dag par ldan pas mngon par 'dod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su mi rus kyi phye ma'i sbyin sreg gis dkyil 'khor gyi bgegs mngon par bsal la/ bdag dang slob ma la sogs pas skuzhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas sa sbyang bar bya ste/ 'dom gang tsam mam khru gang tsam 'og tu brkos la dri zhim po'i chus gtor ba'i sas slar bkang la/ rdo rje rtse mos mngon par bsngags pa'i spos chus chag chag btab ste/ kun du brdungs la 33—528

shin tu mnyam pa khang pa brtsegs pa'i ①nang du chud pa rta babs bzhis mdzes par byas la/ sgo bzhi dang skar khung dra ba can la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba la mtha' ⑤ma rnams su legs par bris shing dril bu btags pa'i rgyal mtshan bzang po 1 gzugs pa dang / bla re dam pa bye ba dang / sangs rgyas rin po che la sogs pa'i ras ris kyis nye bar mdzes par byas pa ba'i lci bas yang dag par sbyangs shing dris nye bar byugs ④pa dang / mtshams bzhir spos khang bzhag phyapa dang / me tog dang gos la sogs pas nye bar mdzes par byas la lag pa sa la bzhag ste/ hūṃ bzhi pa dang / yi ge brgya pa lan bdun yongs su bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas khrus byas shing dris byugs la gos dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang / ze'u ka tredibacings la me tog gi phreng ba gdags shing gdong dri zhim pos byugs la gdu bu dang / rna rgyan la sogs pas bdag nyid legs par brgyan te/ zla ba nya ba nas brtsams nas/ phyi ma'i nya'i bar du dkyil 'khor gyi las byas pa'am⑦/ yar kyi ngo la tshes gcig nas brtsams pa'am/ de bzhin nyid phya tshes brgyad dang / tshes dgu dang / tshes bcu gsum dang tshes bcu bzhi rnams la brtsams nas nya'i bar du'am/ snga dro'i dus su brtsams nas bya'o//de la dang por dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su 'dug la bgegs bsal ba la sogs pa bya ste/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du 'dug nas/ de nyid kyis na rdo rje gzung / /chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /dam tshig gi ni phyag rgya cher/ /byin gyis brlabs nas snying po bzla/ /de ltar mchog tu dam tshig gsum thob pa'i slob dpon gyis rang gi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i cho ga'i bya ba byas teshe/ rtog pa kun la yang dag 'jug /dkyil 33—529

'khor thams cad bsgrub pa ni/ /dam tshig chen po gsum zhes bya/ /rgya 'di gsang sngags bsgrub pa'o/ /dngos grub cho ga thams cad la/ /rdo rje dril bu rab bskul bsaske/ /cho ga lhag gam ma tshang yang / /'grub 'gyur smad par mi bya'o/ /de yang dang po sa'i lha mo yi ge paṃ las byung ba lag na bum pa thogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bsams la/ 'dod pa'i rgyal pos bkug ste/ me tog la sogs pas mchod nas gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de la phyag rgya dang sngags 'di yin te/rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar la mdzub mo dang / mthe'u chung gnyis mdud pa bya ba ni 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya ste/ sngags la ṭak+ki hūṃ dza1/ de nas 'di skad brjod do/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul gyi rngu/khyad par dang //sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis//ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /bcom par byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas de nyid du thim par gyur par bsams la/ de'i steng du rdo rje bcing ba kha thur du bstan te bcings la bzhag ste/ oṃ badz+rī rngu bha ba hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje bcing ba las byung ba'i hūṃ 'bar ba'i tshogs kyi sa gzhi gtan pa la thug gi bar du rdo rjer gagyur par rnam par bsams la 'di skad do/ /dṛ shwe badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha/de nas dang po'i spyor ba dang dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal mchog dang las kyi rgyal 5mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsum bsgom par bya ste/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid can/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i gzugs su 'og min gyi gzhal yas khang na gnas nas mngon par byang 33—530

chub kyemangon sum du byed cing / mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs 2par rim pa 'dis bsam par bya ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ces bya ba'am/ phyin ci ma log par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub pa'i man ngag sbyin par bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par 'dus par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don pre zhes bya ba byang chub kyi snying bor bzhugs pa gang na ba der gshegs te/ byang chub sems dpa' de la ched du bya ba rdzogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bstan nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis gang gis thude bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid ma rtogs par dka' ba spyad pa thams cad la spro ba bskyed cing / ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par bya snyam zhes gsung zhing gan du byon te/ badzod tiṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba'i sngags dang / se gol brdabs pas slong bar mdzad par bsam mo/ /de nas langs nas mchog tu dad pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta badz+ra pra ṇa mya byen badz+ra brnya ༅ā+oṃ ka ro mi zhes brjod la phyag byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to༄pe/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis ma 'tshal na de kho na nyid ji lta bu lags/ de 3ltar na bsgrub par bgyi/ bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas rigs kyi bu rang gi sems la so sor rtog cing mnyam par zhog la/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sngags 'di ci dgar bzlas shing bsgrub par gyis shig /ces gsung zhing 9sems so sor rtogs pa'i man ngag de sprul bar bsam par bya ba ni/ o tsit+ta pra ti be+e ༄ sgo ka ro mi zhes bya ba phung po dang /khams dang skye mched dang / gzung ba dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i rnam par 33—531

rtog pa dang bral ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang gnyis su med pa de kho na nyid kyi ngo bo nyid rtogs hūṃpa de'i bdag nyid kyi sems so sor rtogs pa dang /sems kyi rin po che de nyid snying rje chen pos brgyan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam pa'i mtshan nyid can/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bu rang gi snying gar bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bdag gi snying ga na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur gda' ba bdag gis rtogs so/ /de nas rigs kyi bu sems de ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas na/ de — lta bur sbya/ngas pa de ltar 'gyur te/ dper na ras dkar po la tshon gyis bsgyur ba bzhin no zhes bka' sprul nas/ slar yang byang chub kyi ༄ —sems kyi man ngag ston par mdzad par bsam pa ni/ oṃ bo bye tsit+ta ut+pā da yā snyemi zhes bya'o/ /de nas shin tu 'od gsal ba'i sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par yongs su gyur pa las/ rim gyis nye bar 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ / de nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /khyazla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur mthong ba gang lags pa de ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du mthong zhes bya ba ste/ shin tu rnam par dag cing nam mkha' ltar dri ma med pa la spros pa thams cad par ⑥bral ba me long lta bur rnam par gnas so/ /oṃ dz+nyā na sha dz+waṭī pri si dza hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis rnam par spros te/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gang ba las 'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs par gang zhing byung ste/ byung ba de rnams chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhal yas khang du zhugs nas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang bar bya ste/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi ri bo'i rtse mo bcom ste/ rtogs par byas nas rdo rje 33—532

chen po'i gzugs gcig tu gyur nas byung ste/ rtse lnga pa spyi bo nas thugs kar bzhugs te/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rab tu gnas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po sems bskyed pa kun du bzang po khyod kyis mngon sum du gyur gyis de legs par sgrubs tshoshig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems bskyed pa kun du bzang po de bstan rtepar bya ba'i phyir/ sngags 'dis rang gi snying ga'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i dbyibs su soms shig /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ yang sngags 'dis spro bar bya'o/ /oṃ sga ra badz+ra/ oṃ saṃ ha ra badz+ra / oṃ oṃ dz+nyā na badz+ra/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ/ de nas gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na rdo rjer bdag gis mthong ngo / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi —kun du bzang po'i sems rdo rje 'di/ sngags 'dis brtan par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a kolhahaṃ/ de nas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du mnyam par 'jug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i dbyings ji snyed pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byen gyi rlabs thukyis sems dpa'i rdo rje der zhugs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sa rdo rje'i dbyings zhes rdo rje ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku ni bdag legs par mthong ngo / /sems dpa' chen po de lta bas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems dpa'i rdo rje de rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skur bdag nyid rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sngags 'di ci dgar zlos la sgoms shig /oṃ ya tha sasarba ta thā ga ta sta thā a haṃ/ de nas bdag nyid 33—533

de bzhin gshegs pa ①mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bye bdag la byin gyis zlobs la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa 'di brtan par mdzod cig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje dbyings kyi sems dpa'i rdo rje der zhugs so/ /de nas skad cig de nyid kyi tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i mnyam pa nyid kyi 3ye shes kyi phyag rgya gsang ba'i dam tshig tuce/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje rin po che dbang bskur ba snyemanyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya gsang ba'i dam tshig tu zhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rtogs pas rang bzhin kyis dag go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i ye shes kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i dude bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur to/ /de ltar sems so sor rtogs pa nas brtsams te/ dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyang rang rang gi bdag nyid dang 'dra bar 'byung bar bsam par bya ste/ rang gi sems las tha mi dad pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyi sems dpa'i rdo rje de las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes bskyed de / nam mkha' las byung ba'i nor bu rin po che'i dbang bskur bas dbang bskur / kun du spyan ras gzigs dbang pos chos kyi ye shes bskyed/ de 33—534

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las thams cad la rab tu bzhag shenas/dkyil 'khor pa'i lha rnams kyis phyogs bzhi nas yongs su bskor te/ lhan cig yang dag par gnas so/ /de nas gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i 2snamangon par sdogs par sangs rgyas pa yin pas byams pa dang snying rje'i mig gis sems can thams cad la bltas pa dang mi shes pa las 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gti myug gis dkrugs par shes nas bdag 'dir babs la skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du dkyil 'khor la sogs par sprul pas rjes su gzung bar bya'o zhes yid la nges par byas te/ rim pa 'dis snod kyi 'jig rten bskyed par bya'o/ /hūṃ yi hūṃ/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ chu'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /hūṃ ram̐ hūṃ/ me'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas nam mkha' las yi ge khaṃ las bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad bsams la/ de'i sku'i yan lag thams cad las chu'i rgyun sbom po byung bas snod thams cad yongs su gang bar rnam par bsgoms 'a / bcom ldan 'das kyang de nyid du thim par gyur par rnam par bsams nas/ me dang chu'i bar du hūṃ lam̐ hūṃ zhes bya ba — rnam par bkod la/de bkod pa sngon du 'gro ba las sku rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin brtan par gyur pa las gser gyi dkyil 'khor du bsgom/ de'i steng du hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ zhes bya ba las ri'i rgyal po ri rab bsam mo/ /de'i steng du khaṃ las khang pa brtsegs ma rnam par bsam 5 la / de'i dbus su sa bon 'di rnams las pad+ma la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ba'i lha'i grangs snyed kyi gdan rnam par bsam par bya ste/ yi ge dīḥ— las thams cad du pad+ma bsam/ a si a zhes bya ba 'dis dbus su 'khor lo can gyi 7seng ge'i gdan shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su/ hūṃ shaṃ hūṃ/ tram̐ baṃ tram̐༄ /33—535

hri saṃ hri/ a gi phya.a/ 'di dag las grangs ji lta ba bzhin du glang po che dang /rta dang / rma bya dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdan rnams bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas mi bskyod pa la sogs pa dang lhan cig babs te/ seng ge'i gdan la legs par 'dug ste/ mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhi glang po che'i gdan la sogs pa nye bar gnas par bsams la/ bdag nyid zhal bzhi pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas gnas par bsgom zhing bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i dbyings ni nga yin no zhes bya ba'i nga rgyal teposna / 'di ni dang po sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //rje btsun 'jam dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi tshul gyis mngon par sangs rgyas te/ rdo rje dbyings zhes bya ba ni mtshan tsam gyis gzhan du gyur pa yin pas na log par khong du chud par mi bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor ba rnams rang rang gi gnas mi/su 'og nas bshad pa'i snying pos phyag rgya chen po'i tshul du gzhag par bya ste/ 'di ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byin gyis brlab pa'i /47 rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma yā (snyedza dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod la/sangs rgyas thams cad 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams byon pa dang / zhabs la phyag bya ba sngon du 'gro bas ched du brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod ma thag tu bdag nyid kyi phyag rgya bzhi la zhugs par bsam mo/ /de la phyag 'tshal ba dang / ched du brjod pa ni 'di yin te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā ta ban+da byurgo ka ro mi e ma'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni/ kun du bzang po'i 7spyod pa'i mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo yi/ /dbus 33—536

nas de bzhin gshegs pas mdzes/ /zhes bya ba'o/ /de nas nus pa ma lus pa'i / /shugs kyis byin gyis brlabs te byung nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol na gnas pa'i mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i thugs kar zhugs te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod cing / chu dang 'o ma bzhin du gcig tu 'dres par gyur pas gnas par bsam mo/ /de la ched du brjod pa ni 'di yin te/ e ma 'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rgya chen gdod nas skye ba min/ /rdul phran thams cad grangs rnyed ① kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni gcig tu gyur/ /de nas rnal 'byor pas dkyil 'khor pa'i lha rnams rang gi las la yang dag par sbyar nas/de rnams kyi thugs ka'i zla ba la sngags kyi yi ge'i phreng ba bsams la/ lan bdun nam brgyad kyis bzlas brjod byas nas/ de rnams nyid kyis bdag nyid mchod par gyur par bsams pa'am/ de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje'i dbyings ni nga yin no zhes mchog tu yang nga rgyal bya ste/ 'di ni las kyi rgyal po mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thal mo sbyar nas cung zad btud de / mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bstod pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir gsol ba 'debs par bdag nyid tshigs su bcad pa 'dis brtag par bya'o/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad 'di dag gis/ /bdag cag gis ni bstod pa yis/ /theg pa chen po rtogs tsopa yis/ /tshul chen yang ni rgyas par mdzod—/ /mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor lo che/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa yi/ /cho ga mchog ni bshad du gsol/ /de nas sngags pas yang dag par byin kyis brlabs pa'i mchod yon la sogs pa rang gi 33—537

snying pos mchod yon phul la/ lha rnams kyi 'khor lo phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab par bya ste/ spos la sogs pas yang dag par mchod nas/ snying rje chen pos yongs su gdungs pa'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sbyor bas gnas la/ 'di ltar bdag nyid spro ba bskyed par bya'o/ //deng ni bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /lha dang dam tshig gis mnyam par/ /gyur par bdag ni som ༄ 7nyi med/ /byang chub sems dang sems gcig las④ / /mi ldog par ni bdag gyur te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 5rigs su ni/ /deng bdag skye bar the tshom med/ /deng bdag nyid 6ma dam pa ste/ /bdag gi mchod sbyin bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sbyan 'dren pas/ /deng bdag 'dus pa'i mchog yin no/ /de nas lus thams cad kyis phyag byas la bdug spos phul te/ sangs rgyas thams cad la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yisadz+wa/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor bri/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub 'di ni sprul du gsol/ /zhes brjod la / rang gi dam tshig phyag rgyas bdag nyid lan cig byin gyis brlabs nas/rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya dag gis 'khor lo steng du nam mkha' la gzhag ste/rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor bas rang gi rkang mthil gnyis su a las sna tshogs rdo rje bkod la/ rkang mthil nas yongs su bzung ste/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas brtsams te/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng /chodu rdo rjer gyur par lhag par mos la/dbang ldan gyi phyogs nas brtsams te bskor la/ sna tshogs rdo rje de dag nyid sa la 'bri zhing bgegs thams cad skyod pa la brtson par ('gro bar bya'o/ /33—538

'dir bshad pa/ phyag rgya la gnas de bzhin langs/ /kun du rnam par bltas nas ni/ /badz+ra satwa zhes brjod nas/ /bsgyings pa'i tshul gyis yongs su bskor/ /sngags pas rdo rje sems zlos ①shing / /rdo rje lta bas bltas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sa yi char/ /nyes ldan pa yang dag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi spyor ba dang ldan pas/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi rnguphyag rgyas snying ga dang / dpral ba dang / lkog ma dang spyi bor byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yas pas khro bo'i rdo rje chen po gsor zhing / g.yon pas rdo rje dril bu gsil nas khro bas 'bar ba'i lus dang / bskor ba lan gsum byas la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /slob dpon ming 'di zhes bya bas slob ma che ge ④zhes bya ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang /sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi 'bras bu thob par bya ba'i phyir sa phyogs 'dir nam mkha' ltar dri ma med pa chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nga 'dri —yis/ lha dang lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang srin po dang yi dwags dang / sha za dang / 'byung bo dang brjed 6byed dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang /gnon po dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / rig sngags 7 grub pa rgan po dang / rgan mo g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa gang dag 'khod pa rnams dengs shig /deng 'di ltar rdo rje 'chang gi bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag nga'i ye shes kyi kyerdo rjes mgo bo tshal pa brgyar rnam par 'gas par bya'o zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /de nas lha la sogs pa de rnams sa de spangs nas song bar bsams la/ rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo gnyis mdud pa ltar byas la/ kha'i 33—539

steng du kha spub ste bzhag la/ mthun pa'i rkang stabs la sogs pas mchongs ①la/hūṃ badz+ra baṃ hūṃ zhes brjod la byis pa gzhon nu bzhin du bdag po lnga'i gnas su yongs su bskor/ de nas sna tshogs rdo rje bdag nyid bsams la/ bdag po'i gnas su rkang pa gnyis dang / lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar te/ shar phyogs su bltas nas snying ga ⑤la reg par byas la/ de bzhin du gnas nas lag pa gnyis thad kar brkyang ste/ bdag nyid sna tshogs rdo rje chen po zhig a zhes bya bas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas khro bo'i lta bas dkyil 'khor bcing ba dang / ra ba dang dra ba rnams bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lha hūṃ zhes brjod la g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag nas/ g.yas pas rdo rje gsor te bgegs rnams gzhom par bya'o/ /yang rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas kyang bgegs bsreg pa la sogs pa bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje bcing ba nang du byas pa'i sor mo rnams nang du 'bar ba lta bur byas la/ mthe bo rdo rje ltar bsgreng ba 'di ni rdo rje me'i phyag rgya'o / /oṃ badz+ra ne+e tri brnya bispyon ④zhes bya bas bgegs rnams bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bo gnyis brkyang ste/ mnyam par gzhag / snye pa ni rdo rje spyan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa brkyang bsal bzhag nas 'og phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha ba rak+ṣa sabaṃ swā hā/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas nam mkha' bcing bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ rdo rje thal mo las mthe bo gnyis brkyang la/ mdzub mo gnyis mche bar byas pa 'di ni phyag rgya'o/ /yang na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi spyan gyi steng du nam mkha' bcing bar bya'o/ /oṃ skyehu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la mgal me'i 33—540

'khor lo bzhin du bskor te/ mgo bo'i steng du mdzub mo lcags kyu lta bur bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sbyan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje gtsug tor rdo rje dang ldan pas shar phyogs bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ bye ban+dha hūṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las mthe'u chung gnyis lcags sgrog ltar mdud de/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad la yongs su bzlog ste/ spyi bor gzhag go/ /yang rdo rje zhags pas de nyid bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha byāḥkye / rdo rje khu tshur skye mkhrig ma mdud pa thubya ba ni zhags pa'o/ /rdo rje ba dan gyis nub phyogs bcing bar bya ste/oṃ badz+ra pra ④tai ke pā tai ki ⑤ni ra ṭa/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du bya/ mdzub mo gnyis mnyam par sbyar srin lag phye la mthe'u chung ba dan no/ /rdo rje nag mos byang phyogs bsrung bar bya ste/ hri badz+ra kā li ru ṭa ma ṭa4/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya nyid khar ④bzhag la brtan par byas pas ni rdo rje nag mo'o/ /rdo rje rtse mos lho phyogs bcing bar bya ste—/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha re ru ṭa ma ṭa/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis ri bo 'degs pa'i tshul du byas pa ni rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje las kyi dkyil 'khor bcings la ra ba bya'o/ /hūṃ badz+ra karma/ yang rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyis kyer ba bya ste/ hūṃ rdo rje bcing bas rdo rje ra ba bya'o/ /sngags ni badz+ra ban+dha zhes bya ba'o/ /yang hūṃ a nu rā ga yā khyemi hūṃ zhes bya bas dkyil 'khor bcing ba la sogs pa ni rdo rje gar las byung ba'i phyag rgya rnams kyis bya ste/ de la phyag rgya ni 'di rnams yin no/ /khro bo'i khu tshur gnyis kyi phyogs kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ bskor ba 'di ni dkyil 'khor bcing ba'o/ /khar bskor ba ni mtshams bcing ba'o/ /snying la 'bar ltar zhugs gyur cing / /phyogs kun rdo rje me 'bar bas nga yi'ang 33—541

khro bo chen po yi/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje ra ba bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra tsakra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sibye hūṃ zhes bya ba 'di phyag rgya dang ldan pa yang byin gyis brlab bo/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis 'khor lo bskor ba ni 'di'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal hūṃ dz+dzaḥzhes bya ba 'dis gsang ba'i gzugs can gyi dkyil 'khor bkug la/ phur bu gdab bo/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo gnyis dang / mje bo rdo rjer byas pa ni rdo rje 'khor lo'o/ /'dis dkyil 'khor thams cad 'gugs shing bsgrub par 'gyur la / 'jig rten pa rnams kyang zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /de la phur bu ni 'di yin te sor brgyad pa'i tshad tsam gyis seng ldeng gi phur bu tsan+dan dmar pos byugs la srad bu dmar po dang / me tog dmar pos bcings la①/ stod khro bo'i gzugs la smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs su 'dug pa hūṃ las bskyed do/ /oṃ badz+ra shī li kri la ya sarba birgyu ban+ta ru hūṃ phaṭa ces byebya ba brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung ste/ g.yas pas rdo rje tho ba bzung nas/des dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams bzhir brdung bar bya'o/ /oṃ ha na ha na/ da ma da ma/ sadzismra ya sa11 d+ngha ya/ badz+ra badz+ra muṅga ra hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba rdo rje tho ba la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te me tog dmar po dang / srad bu dmar pos bcings la/ tsan+dan dmar pos byugs te/ des (snyekun du brdung bar bya'o/ /yang / bcing ba'i cho ga'i sbyor ba ni/ /rdo rje khu tshur rab tu brtag /dkyil 'khor bsrung ba thams cad la/ /rdo rje go chas go cha bya/ /de nas badz+ra shi kha re 6ru ṭa ma ṭa zhes bya bas mngon par bsngags pa'i spos chus dkyil 'khor nye bar byugs la gur kum dang / a ka ru dang tsan+dan dang / ga pur dang /33—542

gla rtsi la sogs pa'i dri dang dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams kyi sngags snekyis btab la lha rnams kyi grangs ji snyed pa'i dkyil 'khor bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug la yid kyis dkyil 'khor yongs su brtags te/ dkyil 'khor de rnams su rnam par snang mdzad chen po yongs su gyur pas rje btsun 'jam dpal du gyur pa la sogs ③rang gi snying por ༄ —bzhag la/ mchod pa rnam pa lngas yang dag par mchod do/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i phyir rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa sngags kyis mngon par gdab bo/ /de la cho ga ni 'di yin te/ baṃ las rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi bum pa rtsa ba nag nog med pa/ lto ba che ba mgrin pa ring ba kha dgye ba bskyed la/ de'i dbus su byāḥ④las byung ba'i pad+ma de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ der lha rnams kyi 'khor lo rang gi dam tshig gis gnas pas bzhugs par bsams la/ de las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi chus yongs su bkang 3)bar bsams la6 / sman lnga dang / 'bru lnga dang /rin po che sna tsalnga dang ldan pa me tog gi phreng bas bcings pa'i gsang ba'i //snying po can mgul pa gos gtsang mas dkris la/ a mra'i lo ma la sogs pas kha bkab pa byas la/ dkyil 'khor ba'i sngags kyis mngon par bzla zhing / oṃ badzo da ka hūṃ hūṃ zhes bya ba stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya ste/ spos la sogs pas mchod nas dkyil 'khor bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun 'jam dpal gyi spyan sngar bzhag la dkyil 'khor gyi nyin mo dus gsum du bzlas brjod byas nas dkyil 'khor du yang bzlas brjod bya ste/ de nas dbang bskur bar 33—543

bya'o—/ /sang gri bya 1 krita kaṇi huka ha sa de ba ste/ sman rnams kun zhes bya ba la/ /lnga po 'di dag shes par ④bya ste/ 'bras kyi so ba mon sran gre'u dang tsa/ /nas dang gro dang til dang lnga/ /'bru rnams kun zhes bya ba ni/ /las rnams kun la 'di dag gsungs/ /byi ru gser ni sa le sbram/ /dung dang mu tig nor bu ste/ /rin chen kun zhes bya ba la/ /lnga po 'di dag shes par bya /de nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa la mngon par bsngags la/ de bzhin du me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgor gzhag par byage/ de la sngags dang phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ o sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūṃ/ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ/ kṛrje pa ya kṛrje (5pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya hoḥ⑥ bha ga bān badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo'i khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ /mthe'u chung rtse mo mdud byas la/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni bsgreng ba dag /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad phyag rgya 'di'o zhes bya ba 'di phyag rgya'o/ /gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya ste/ ji srid dkyil 'khor yongs su sdogs pa de srid du 'dir 'dug pa rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis nges par bzlog tu gsol zhes bya'o/ /de nas phyi rol du gtor ma byin la nye reg bya ste/ dad cing gus par 7 phyag 'tshal te/ slob ma rnams lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /de la re zhig slob ma legs par khrus byas shing / gos gtsang ma gon la lag na me tog thogs pas slob dpon la phyag bya ste/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig 33—544

de nyid sprul du gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par bgyi/ /de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma'i snying gar hūṃ las rdo rje bskyed la/ khu tshur g.yas pas bzung nas/ rdo rje de nyusnying gar snying pos bzhag 3ste/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho badz+ra sidha ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas de bzhin du de'i mgo bor lag pa bzhag la rdo rje las kyi snying po brjod nas/ sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas haṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa zhes bya ba las go cha bskyed la/ rkang pa'i mthar thug gi bar tu go cha bskon par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i dris lag par dri sbyin/ me tog gis me tog gtor zhing / bdug pas bdug pa gtul te/ me mar —nye bar bstan la re re zhing 'di skad ces gyebarjod par bya ste/ deng nas brtsams te bde ba thams cad dang ldan par gyur pas nye bar gnas par kyis shig /de nas slob ma'i gtso bo la bos te/ 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyis/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa dag /de dag kun kyis gsang sngags kyisre/ /cho ga mchog bzang 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di 33—545

gyis shig /rtog pa ma lus legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam nga/ bzang po ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogs pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /de nas cho ga 'dis sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byed du gzhug ste/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa thams cad dang /snying ngo dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang rig sngags ①thams cad bdag 'a/ dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang /rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang las kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi lha thams cad kyi spyan sngar sdog pa thams cad bla na med pa'i so sor bshags pas so sor bshags par bgyi'o/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis chos kyi dbyings ma lus par gtogs pa'i bsod nams thams cad mkhyen cing rjes su yi rang bar mdzad pa'i rjes su yi rang bas rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams ④thams cad na chos kyi 'khor lo ma bskor ba de dag la ltubla na med pa'i theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya ba'i phyir bskul ma 'tshal lo/ /gang yang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la nan tan lhur mdzad pa de ④la sems can gyi khams ji gesrid du yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol lo/ /de skad lan gnyis lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma slob dpon du 33—546
