pa'i dbyangs kyi bar du bstan par bya'o/ /de nas yon blangs la gang du me tog babs par gyur pa de'i rigs dang /gzugs su de 1bskyed la/ de'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs te/snying po 'di dang rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i bum pa'i chus dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ de nas de dang rjes su mthun pa'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur la/ gang rtegi mtshan ma'i dbang bskur ba lag tu byin te/mtshan ma dang rjes su mthun par sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab grub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /rang gi mtshan mas bdag po'i dbang / /snying po 'dis sbyin par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra a bye pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhe ṣidzi mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ de nas snying po 'dis dril bu sbyin no/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhazlu 4t+t+waṃ/ ār+ya nut+pan+da tātas/ de nas snying po 'dis rdo rje ming gi dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ 5a rnyi ṣilnga 3mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhe 3ṣe ka ta/ kye rdo rje zhes gang gi ming gang brjod pa de la der skye rmyezhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po'i tshul du bzhag trel/ spos la sogs pa rnams kyis nyunyeyang dag par mchod la/sngags bskul /rteba'i tshig brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i sngags byin la/ phyag rgya bzhi'i ye shes rig pa'i dbang bskur bas/ bslab par bya ba ni rig pa'i dbang bsgur ba'o/ /slob mas kyang rdo rje thal mo bskor ba byas la phyag bya ste/phreng ba bcing ba la sogs pa de dag thams cad gzung bar bya'o/ /rig pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas slob dpon du 'os pa'i slob mas yon bzang po phul la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ oṃ sarba budhe pa ra rat+na saṃ dza ya dhū 33—597

pa dī hūṃpya ma ku ṭa ya nā kyem/ a bhi ṣiñca pra ba ra badz+ra dha ra shrī badz+ra satwa sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes bya ba 'dis bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnal 'byor pas yon gyi mchog blangs la/ slob dpon rje btsun 'jam dpal nyid rnam par snang mdzad chen po nyid du gyur pas/ shar phyogs kyi sgo'i mthar sna tshogs pad+ma bris la/ slob dpon rdo rje 'dzin michen po'i skur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnas par bsams la/ rdo rje sems ma la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs te dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /yang na dkyil 'khor las khru gsum tsam yongs su dor bar dbang bskur ba'i sgo la mngon par byas par nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad tsam la zur bzhi pa sgo nub phyogs su bltas pa'i dkyil 'khor tshon sna lngas bris la/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bri/de'i steng du seng ge'i gdan la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ras kyi thubakab pa dang /seng ge'i gdan 5kyi steng du bla re bye zhing g.yas logs su dar dang me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa'i gdugs rtse mo dkar ba dang / dmar ba la gtsug tor gdugs dkar po zhwayongs su bzlas pa/ g.yon du dar dang ras sna tshogs pas bkra ba'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan oṃ yongs su bzlas pa'i legs par bzhag 7la mchod yon phul te/ me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod nas/ rnga bo che dang / rnga rings dang / ru dud la sogs pa'i rol mo phyag rgyas byin kyis brlabs pa dang / phyi rol du gar dang glu la sogs pa dang / sgeg mo la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod cing / bkra shis kyi glu len cing dril bu dkrol bzhin du rdo rje 'bebs pa la sogs pa'i bum pa'i chu rnams kyis de'i sngags gdon pa sngon du 'gro ba nyid dang / rdo rje slob dpon chen po nyid du dbang 33—598

bskur bar bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra a bye ṣiñca zhes bya ba dang / ji srid rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i bar du 7snadabang bsgur ro/ /de nas de'i mgor yang 'jam pa'i sku gzugs de'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bzung la/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwo dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta s+t+waṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags bzlas la rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i slob dpon du 'gyur ro/ /shes rab yan lag 'dus pa'i rdo rje las byung ba'i/ /byang chub sems kyis 'jam dbyangs byang chub de dbang bskur/ /rgyal mchog sras bcas rnams kyis legs gsungs 5bkra shis gang / /des ni khyed kyi dbang bsgur mchog la bkra shis shog /dpal ldan rdo rje sems tshogs dkyil 'khor la 'jug cing / /srid pa'i snying por rnam rol sgeg mo la sogs pas/ /bde byed rab mchog legs par glur blangs bkra shis gang / /des ni khyed kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /shin tu zhi ba'i mdzad pa phul byung ma lus pas//sems can bde gshegs rtogs mdzad bcom ldan dbang bskur la/ /dpag med lha yi mchog gis legs gsungs bkra shis gang / /des ni khyod 4kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /dpal ldan khams gsum rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor rab mchog la/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal por rgyal mchog dbang bskur ba / /lha yi mchog gis btud de rab bshad bkra shis gang / /des ni khyod 5 kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /'gro ba sna tshogs 'dul phyir phyag na pad+mo yis/ /rdzogs sangs rin chen cod pan bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ /pad+ma'i 'dod chags rnams 6legs pa yi bkra shis gang / /des ni khyod 7kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /nam mkha'i snying po nor bu rin chen 'byor pas nyams dga' zhing / /don rnams kun grub bde sbyin dbang bsgur 33—599

chen po la/ /dge ba phun tshogs mdzad pas legs gsungs bkra shis gang / /des ni khyed kyi dbang bsgur mchog la bkra shis shog /'khor los 1sgyur drug dge ba'i bkra shis glu blangs las/ /bsod nams rin chen dri med mi mnyam gang thob pa/ /des ni kun son 'byor pa'i dbang bskur chen po la/ /'jam dpal grags bcas 'jig rten rnam par dag gyur cig /de nas gos la sogs pas brgyan te/ sangs rgyas kyi cod pan dang dar dpyangs la sogs pa'i dbang bskur bas dbang bskur la/ me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/rdo rje'i dbang bsgur ba byin la de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po thams cad bdag /rdo rje'i snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces bya ba ni 'jam dpal la bya bar bshad de/ ming thams cad kyi bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas nyi zhes brjod la de bzhin du bdag po nyid du dbang bskur ro/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nanut+pan+da tāta ces brjod la dril bu byin te chos bstan par bya'o/ /dngos rnams rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /dam pa'i dngos po byed par 'gyur/ /de nas yi ge dhīḥbarjod la/ /ming gi dbang bskur ba sbyin par bya ste/ phyag rgya chen po'i tshul du bzhag 4la/ dam tshig bsgrag 5par bya'o/ /srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal mang po zhi bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /de bas dam tshig bsrung bar gyis/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dod pa ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lha yi spyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /33—600

ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni/ /mkhas mchog 'dug par gyur pa'i tshe/ /de srid mtshungs med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /gsang ba'i mchog gi dam tshig thabs/ /bsod nams byin zlob sgrub byed pa/ /dngos grub kun gyi dbang phyug grub/ /sems can don ni ston 1par byed/ /ces bya ba dang / yid kyi gzugs ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya dam tshig yin par grags 2/ /gang gis lus kun brtan pas na/ /phyag rgya yin par rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas shrī brjod par bya'o/ /de nas spos la sogs pas yang dag par mchod nas lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas pa byas pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya bzhi'i ye shes bslab par bya'o/ /slob dpon du dbang bsgur ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /rjes su gnang ba'i sbyin brtson pas/ /slob ma rdzogs par shes nas ni/ /go 'phang 'di ni thob par bya/ /shin tu gsang ba'i gzhung 'di nyid/ /rdo rje slob mas gsol byas te / /de nyid la ni yon gyi mchog /dam pa phul nas gsol ba gdab/ /'di zhes bya ba'i rdo rje can/ /byang chub sems ni rnam bsgoms pa/ /slob dpon zhabs kyi pad+ma la/ /dbang bskur phyir ni gsol ba 'tshal/ /slob dpon rab tu rmad byung ba/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dbang bsgur nyid/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob byed pa/ /skal ba chen pos bdag la sprul/ /gang gis sems can thams cad kyi/ /rnyog med don ni bdag bgyid cing / /brtul zhugs bzang khyod drin gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun don mdzad pa'ang bgyid/ /slob dpon phan par 'dod pa yis//dbang bsgur ba ni rdo rje che/ /khams gsum kun kyis 4byas pa/ /sangs rgyas 33—601

kun gyis sbyin par bya/ / dbang bsgur ba ni rdo rje che/ /1khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas shing / /khams gsum ye shes las byung ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi nga yis sbyin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis nam mkha'i khams/ /yongs su gang bar rnam par bsgom/ /phyi rol dri sogs dam tshig gi/ /sprin ltar brtul zhugs can gyis bsgom/ /yang na rdo rje dbyings kyi ni/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis rdo rje bsgom/ /dam tshig mchog gi bum pa yang / /'dzin par mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon bka' drin gyis/ /de tshe de la dbang bskur ba/ /rdzogs sangs rdo rje lha mo rnams/ /rang nyid gsol bar mdzad par 'gyur/ /de nas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung 4nas dbang bskur bar bya ste/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥm hā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhe ṣe ka s+t+waṃ/a bhi ṣispyo 5mi/ sarba badz+ra a bye pa ti s+t+waṃ6/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba sibye na maḥte bha ga wān ma hā badz+ra ha ra su ra ta s+t+waṃdzi/ ma hā badz+ra swā hā/ oṃ bhur bhu ba swaḥzhes bya ba 'dis lag pa gnyis su rdo rje byin la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod de sngags brjod par bya'o/ /me tog ma'i gzugs can gyis me tog gis gtor la/ deng tshun chad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ces 8pas mchod na khyod mchod pa'i yan lag brtsams kyis/skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyis brgyan pa byas pa'i skur mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes brjod do/ /de nas bdug 9pa ma'i gzugs kyis bdug pas bdugs la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /gang gis sems can thams cad tshim par gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad khyed la 'jug par mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /de nas mar me ma'i gzugs su mar me nye bar bstan la 'di 33—602

skad ces brjod par bya ste/ deng nas brtsams te rdo rje chos dang 'dra bar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sbyan yang dag par 'bar bas/ ma rig pas khebs pa'i sems can rnams la ye shes kyi snang bas snang bar byed par 'gyur ro//de nas byug pa ma'i gzugs can gyis byug pas byugs la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ deng tshun chad khyod sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / 'jig rten thams cad du yang tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab la sogs pa'i dri'i rgyun ster bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha mo sgeg mo'i gzugs can gyis me tog cig sgeg pa dang bcas pas 'phangs la 'di skad ces brjod de/ deng nas brtsams te de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dang/'a dang bcas pa thams cad 1sna'adod pas mchod cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i dga' ba dang mgu ba dang rangs pa'i rol pas sngags kyi spyod pa'i rjes su 'gro bas rol bar gyis shig /de nas lha mo phreng ba ma'i gzugs can gyis 2phreng ba bcings la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa' dang bcas pa 'di dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phreng bas rgyun du mchod pa la skyo ba med par gyis shig 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phreng ba 'di ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phreng brgyan rnams kyi mchog ni 'di yin no/ /de nas lha mo glu ma'i gzugs can dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra hata ces bya ba la sogs pa dang / glu blangs la 'di skad /brjod par bya ste/ deng nas brtsams te chos thams cad sgrogs shing / ring por mi thogs par sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par sbud pa nyams su 33—603

myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha mo gar mkhan ma'i gzugs kyi gar gyi lag pas sad par byas la 'di skad ces brjod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gar la rab tu 'jug cing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gar gyi rjes su dgyes par gyis shig /de nas rin po che'am gser gyi thur ma thogs la mdun du 'dug ste 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ṣ+ṭṛb ltar/ /bu khyod kyis 2ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /de nas mig tu pra bkod la me long blangs nas/chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan par bya ste/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes nas su/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ /de nas hoḥ zhes bya bas gzhu byin la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyis shig ces brjod do/ /phyogs bzhir mda' bzhi 'phan du gzhug 4cing / steng dang 'og tu yang re re 'phen du gzhug go/ /de nas sha dha ban dz+dza ka byin la 'dis dngos grub thams cad dang nye bar spyod pa thams cad sprul la nye bar longs spyod cing / gzhan dag la yang byin cig /de nas rgyal mtshan byin la 'dis ni dgra thams cad dang 'thab pa las nye bar rgyal ba 'thob 5par 'gyur ro zhes brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje snyems ma'i 6phyag rgya byen la/ 'dis ma rungs pa thams cad sgrubs shig ces brjod do/ /gzhan yang a badz+ra satwa zhes bya bas me long blangs la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /bu 33—604

khyod kyi 3ni snying la gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid yin/ /zhes bya ba dang / 'di skad ces kyang bsgo ste/ gang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems rdo rje ni 'di nyid yin par rtogs shing 2/de nas chos kyi 'khor lo rkang pa gnyis kyi dbus su bzhag cing / dung yang lag pa g.yas par byin te/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang smra ba gnyis kyi chos kyi yi ge dang lhan cig byin la 'di skad ces brjod de/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa tsam kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor cig /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /skyob pa rnams kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pas/ /kun du ma lus gang bar gyis/ /som nyi yid gnyis mi bya zhing / /dogs pa med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /gsang sngags spyod pa tshul gyi mchog /'jig rten 'di la rab tu sgrogs/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya//rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang / /kun du khyod la srung bar byed/ /rang gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod la/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan nas/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ /khyod kyis kyang ni ma byed cig /gsang ba bsgrags nas thal mo dang bcas pas dang por 'di skad brjod do/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje mgon po rab sgrub 4mdzad/ /rdo rje dbang bsgur rdo rje 'od//rdo rje dpal khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje bzhad pa chos chen po/ /dpal kun gyi ni rgyal po mchog /spyos med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje las dang rdung ba che/ /gnod sbyin gtum po gdon chen po/ /rdo rje khu tshur phyag rgya che/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub che/ /33—60pya

sangs rgyas thams cad de bzhin gshegs/ /rdo rje ye shes ye shes che/ /theg chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don kun gyi ni de nyid don/ /sems can don chen kun rig pa/ /kun mkhyen kun byas thams cad de/ /kun gzigs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje bdag rab rdo rje mchog /rdo rje brtson rab rdo rje 'chang / /dam tshig chen po'i de nyid don/ /sems can khrod la phyag 'tshal lo//rdo rje lcags kyu 'dod pa che/ /rab tu dga' ba 'od chen po/ /rdo rje 'od dang 'od chen po/ /sangs rgyas 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rgyal mchog rdo rje dgu / /rig mchog mchog dang mi yi mchog /rdo rje dam pa mchog chen po/ /rig mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dbyings dang gsal nyub che/ /rdo rje gsang ba rang gsang 'chang / /rdo rje phreng ba bsam gtan che/ /rdo rje dgos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mchog gsang rdo rje mchog /sangs rgyas byang chub mkhas pa che/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sangs rgyas che/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa mchod pa che/ /sems dpa' mchod pa rab mchog pa/ /thabs chen dang ni dngos grub che/ /rdo rje grub khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /ta thā ga ta'i glu chen po/ /ta thā ga ta'i gsung dbyangs te / /ta thā ga ta sems chen po/ /rdo rje rdo rje phyag 'tshal khyod/ /sangs rgyas gtso bo rgyal bka' nyan/ /sangs rgyas bshes gnyen rgyal mchog skyes/ /rnam par snang mdzad che dang khyab/ /zhi khro ston la 37phyag 'tshal lo/ /ta thā ga ta de nyid che/ /yang dag mtha' dang che ba'i tshul/ /pha rol phyin pa'i kun mkhyen pa/ /don dam khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun du bzang dang spyo da pa mchog /bdud dang bdud ni rab 'dul ba/ /kun gyi mchog dang mnyam 33—606

nyid mkhyen/ /kun du 'gro khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas hūṃ ste hūṃ zhes pa/ /rdo rje hūṃ zhes 'dul ba'o hūṃ/ /phyag na rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phyag rgya brjod cing brjod pa dang / /rim gror ta thā ga tas khyab/ /gang phyir rdo rje sems bstan 5pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya khyod/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub khyod rag lus/ /kun gzigs yab ni khyod yin te/ /'byung po dang ni 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /ta thā ga ta khyod kyis bsgrubs/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di yis ni//glu blangs gang zhig stod zubyed cing / /de ni rdo rje 'dzin 'drar 'gyur/ /mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /sems can don kun mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi rigs ni skyed par mdzod/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad 'di dag gis/ /mgon po khyod la bstod bgyis pas/ /theg pa chen po rtogs pa yis/ /tshul chen yang ni rgyas par mdzod/ /de nas/ 'jig rten kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /rdo rje 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /zhes brjod la/ rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig /rdo rje rigs kyi bdag po'i rdo rje 'khor lo bskor cig ces brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje rin chen du bsgoms nas/ de'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs te/ de bzhin du chus dbang bskur la/ rin po che'i 'khor los ④sgyur ba nyid du rdo rje rin po che'i myu gu'i cod pan gyis phyedabang bskur bas dbang bskur te/ rin po che'i rdo rje khu tshur mnyam par bcings la mthe bo dang mdzub mo rtse sbyar ba'i phyag rgyas rin po che byin la/ de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/nyi ma 'di ni mchog yin te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong / /nam mkha'i snying po bcom ldan 'das/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa'o//33—607

—hri de nas bdag po nyid du dbang bskur te/ de bzhin du a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā 1 rde zhes bya bas dril bu byin la de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/ bsam pa thams cad grub pas na/ /don gyi byebasam grub bla na med/ /de yang 'dod pa rab grub phyir/ /'dod dang thar ba'i bde chen po/ /dhīḥ/ de nas ming gi dbang bskur ba byin la/ de bzhin du bzhag nas dam tshig bstan par bya ste/'dod dang bde ba thams cad dang / /mi mthun pa yang sbyin bya zhing / /bdag nyid dang ni pha rol gyi/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par kyis/ /shī4/de nas de bzhin du/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥm hā su kha badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣe ka s+t+waṃ/ a bhe ṣispyo 5mi/ sarba rat+na a bye pa ti s+t+waṃ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ sidhe na ma te6/ bha ga wān / ma hā rat+na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ badz+ra rat+na/ oṃ bhur bhu ba swaḥzhes bya ba 'dis lag pa gnyis kyis rin po che byin la/ de bzhin du yang dag par mchod de / rang gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod la/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya yang nye bar bstan nas/ sems can kun la phan phyir dang / /sangs rgyas don la spyor ba yis/ /pha rol nor rnams phrogs kyang ni/ /sdig gis gos par mi 'gyur zhes/ /gsang ba brjod nas de bzhin du/ /rin chen khyod la gsol ba ni / /nor gyi tshogs ni bshad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang gi mchog /mdor na 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir / /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor//zhes brjod la/ rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig /rin po che'i rigs kyi bdag po rin po che'i 'khor lo bskor cig ces brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje chos su rnam par bsams la/ de'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ de 33—608

bzhin du chus dbang bsgur la dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i dar dpyangs cod pan gyi 3dbang gis dbang bskur te pad+ma byin la de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/ de nyid sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug ste/ /gdul ba'i thabs kyi mdzad pa ni/ /dga' ba'i rol mor rab tu 'jug /hriḥ2de nas bdag po'i dbang bskur ba/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā t+t+waṃ ār+ya 1nut+pan+da tātapya/ces bya bas dril bu byin nas chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan par bya ste/ ji ltar pad+ma dmar po ni/ /tshon gyi nyes pas sa7mi gos ltar/ /de bzhin gnas pa'i nyes pa yis/ /'gro phan rnams la mi gos so/ /d+dhāḥde nas ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ba byin la/ de bzhin gzhan nas dam tshig bstan par bya ste/ cho ga dag ni gang dag gis/ /'gro ba rnams ni 'dul 'gyur ba/ /pad+ma dag par spyor ba'i bdag /de dang des ni sbyar bar bya/ /shrī de nas de bzhin du oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥm hā su khaṃ /6pad+ma ma hā a bhe ṣe ka s+t+waṃ/ a d+ngha ṣizi 7mi/ sarba pad+ma zhe a bye ṣiñca ya ra ha me bha ba/ sed+dhā na ma te 9bha ga wān ma hā pad+ma su ra ta s+t+waṃ/a haṃ badz+ra pad+ma o byur bhu ba swaḥzhes bya bas lag pa gnyis kyis pad+ma byin la/de bzhin du yang dag par mchod de/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bstod nas/dam tshig gi phyag rgya nye bar bstan la/ 'dod chags 'dra ba'i bde ba med/ /rgyal ba rnams la de phul la/ /sems can don phyir gzhan chung ma/ /bsten na bsod nams thob ⑫par 'gyur/ /zhes gsang ba brjod la/ de nas 'di skad ces brjod do/ /dpa' bo khyod la gsol ba ni/ /rang gi rigs rnams bskyed nas kyang / /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa ni/ /thub pa chen pos bshad du 33—609

gsol—/ /de nas/ mdor na 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la/ rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig /pad+ma'i rigs kyi bdag po yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /de la rmyesna tshogs rdo rje can du rnam par bsams la/ de'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la de bzhin du chus dbang bskur te/ las thams cad kyi 'khor lo bskor ba nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje cod pan gyi dbang gis dbang bskur nas/ sna tshogs rdo rje byin la de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/ rtag pa'i 'dod chags las byung khro/ /rdo rje me yi phung po'i gzugs / /'bar ba'i rdo rje spyor ba che/ /mkha' 'gro rnams ni kun du 'bar / / s+thāḥ— de nas bdag po nyid du dbang bskur la/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā 4rde/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas dril bu byin nas chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan par bya ste/ chos rnams nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam rnal 'byor pas/ /'di kun myur du 'dzin par 'gyur/ /dhīḥde nas ming gi dbang bskur ba byin la/ de bzhin du bzhag snyenas dam tshig bstan par bya ste/ thams cad nam mkhar spyor ba yis/ /thams cad nam mkha' zhes smra zhing / /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas rgyas 6btab la/ /khams gsum yang ni bza' bar bya/ /shrī de nas de bzhin du/o dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥm hā su kha badz+ra kan+d+ra a bhi ṣe ka ta s+t+waṃ/ a bhe ṣilnga mi/ sarba badz+ra kan+d+ra a bye pa ti s+t+waṃ/7 dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ sidhe na ma te bha 8ga wān ma hā badz+ra bi shwa/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ badz+ra kan+d+ra oṃ bhur bhu ba swaḥzhes 33byed6/0

bya ba 'dis lag pa gnyis kyis las kyi rdo rje byin la de bzhin du mchod nas rang gi ming brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod de/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya nye bar bstan la/sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don du ni/ /sems can thams cad bsad na yang / /de yi 1sdig pas gos mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsang ba brjod la de nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbang byed cing / /sems can kun don bya ba'i phyir/ /rang gi rigs ni skyed 27par mdzod/ /de nas/ mdor na 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la/rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig /las kyi rigs kyi bdag po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor cig ces brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor pas / slob ma rnam par snang mdzad du rnam par bsams la/ de'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas de bzhin du chus dbang bskur bas dbang bsgur la/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi cod pan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur bas dbang bskur la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje byin nas de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/de nyid du ni bcom ldan 'das/ /de bzhin gshegs dang byang chub sems/ /lta ngan rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /mya ngan 'das 'di ston par 'gyur/ /sna tshogs 'dul bar ston pa ni/ /brtan zhing nges pa'i chos nyid can/ /srid pa shin tu gnas mchog pa'i/ /cho ga la sogs nges par dgos/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs la sogs/ /dkon mchog gsum po nyid du rtogs/ /srid pa 33—611

shin tu legs par grub/ /sna tshogs mkhyen pa dpa' byed mchog /dhīḥde nas bdag po nyid du dbang bsgur la/ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pas dril bu byin te/ chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan par bya'o/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam rnal 'byor pas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /dhīḥde nas ming gi dbang bskur bas tshobaskur ba lkubyas la/ de bzhin du gzhan nas dam tshig bstan par bya ste/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni bstan bzhin du/ /dkon mchog gsum mchog mchod pa ni/ /bkyi'o zhes ni rab tu bsam/ /shrī de nas de bzhin du/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ma hā su khaṃ 5badz+ra dh+wa tu a bye ṣe ka ta s+t+waṃ/ a p+ta ṣilnga khyemi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bye pa ti dṛ bye me bha ba sidhe na ma te 3bha ga wān/ ma hā be+e ro tsa na su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/badz+ra dhā satu oṃ bhur bhu ba swaḥzhes bya bas lag pa gnyis kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje byin la/ de bzhin du yang dag par mchod de/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod nas/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya nye bar bstan la/ ji lta ji ltar sems can rnams/ /'dul gyur 9de lta de lta bur/ /chags la sogs pas yun ring du / /de bzhin 'gro ba'i don rnams kyis/ /zhes gsang ba brjod la/ de nas / mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje chen po bskyed nas kyang / /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas/ mdor na 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la/ rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal 33—612

bar gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor cig ces brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni rjes su gnang zhing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// //de nas slob ma rdo rje sems dpar bsgoms la/ de bzhin bzhag ste/gzengs bstod pas ni dngos po kun/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid de/ /rdo rje ming dbang bskur bas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan to/ /oṃ nga yis 'di ltar khyod lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu 'grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sed+dhā tsho7sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur bhu ba swaḥ—/ de la gzengs bstod pa ni 'di yin te/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag2la/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin par bya ste/ 'dis phyag rgya chen po mchog tu gsang ba'i cho ga lung bstan par bya ste/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad rang gi dam tshig slob dpon dang mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad de/'di lta ste/ 'di nyid kyis gzengs bstod pa'i phyag rgya chen pos mchog tu gsang ba'i dngos grub mchog grub pa'i byin rlabs dang / gsang ba 'di'i stobs la dad par bya'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas ji ltar zhugs pa'i rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdu ba la sogs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba sbyin par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa ji snyed pa de dag 33—613

thams cad rang gi dam tshig la rjes su mnyes par drangs te/ 'dir zhugs nas dbang du byas te/ sgrub pa dang rjes su sgrub pas/ rdo rje dbyings thams cad kyi brtan pas brtan par gyur cig /chos kyi dbyings thams cad dang mnyam par byung la nam mkha'i khams thams cad ltar yangs pa chen po 'dir gnas shing rab tu gnas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rang gi dam tshig gi slob dpon la rag lus shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbus su dmigs la/ de bzhin gshegs hūṃthams cad dang / rang gi slob dpon nyid kyis da ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad do zhes byin gyis brlabs te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rang gi dam tshig gi slob dpon dang 2mnyam par mgrin gcig tu dbugs 'byin par mdzad do zhes dad par gyis shig/mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /mthong ba dang ni zhugs pa yis/ /srid pa kun las rnam grol bar/ /khyod ni deng nyid gnas pa yin/ /bde chen zeg pa 'di las rgo/ /slar khyod 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi sod pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i snyug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ba yin/ /dam tshig sdom pa grub pa 'di//rtag tu khyod kyis bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /dam pa brtag zupa'i bka' yin no/ /byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya/ /phyag na rdo rje gang yin pa'o/ /gang 'di skyes pa tsam gyis su/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs pa med/ /dam pa'i chos ni mi smad cing / /nam yang gtang bar mi bya'o—/ /mi shes pa 'am rmongs pa yis/ /tshul chen bstan par mi bya'o/ /33—614

bdag nyid yongs su /shespangs nas su/ /dka' thub can gyis ma gdungs shig /ci bde bar ni bde bar gzung / /'di ni ma byon sdogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang yongs su mi gtong 2zhing / /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas kun mtshungs bla ma yi/ /slob dpon la ni gang smod pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas smad pas na/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob 'gyur te/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug nang / /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtse ba dang / /gdon dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas sems dmyal ltung bar 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /dge ba rab tu mi spyoms pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis sbyin par bya/ /des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing dbyung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rang gi dam tshig slob dpon ni/ /sbyin min bu dang chung ma dang / /rang srog gis rtag bstan bya na/ /longs spyod g.yo bas smos ci dgos/ /gang phyir bskal pa bye ba ni/ /grangs med par ni rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang brtson ldan la/ /tshe 'di nyid la ster bar 4byed/ /rtag tu khyod kyis 3dam tshig srungs/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /de byen sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byin bsod nams mchog dag gis/ /dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bcas te/ /gang 'dir legs par gnas pas na/ /dam tshig lha rnams kun dang mnyam/ /rang byung du yang der skyes so/ /sangs 33—6/5

byedargyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pa/ /kun gyis deng khyod dbang bsgur bas/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal po che/ /rgyal po'i bdag por bstan pa yin/ /deng ni bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /grong khyed mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ /khyed rnams kyi ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /deng ༄1nyid thob par the tshom med/ /aḥgrede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dbugs dbyung ba phul du byung ba ste / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dpal rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma mchog rnams la/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang bcas pas phyir mi ldog pa'i phyag rgyas sangs rgyas nyid du gyur cig /mchog tu rtag pa yin par khong du chud par bya'o/ /de la gtan tshig ci yod ce na/ gang khyod kyis thams cad kyi bdag nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub chen po'i mchog tu sems bgyed pa tsam gyi mthu nyid kyis/ phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba yin la/ phyir mi ldog pa nyid kyis na/ nges pa'i phung po la gnas te/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges pa'i phyir ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/ dus gsum ni mnyam pa nyid yin pas na/ de 4ltar byung ba nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su mngon par sdogs par sangs rgyas par khong du chud par bya'o zhes bya ba ni mchog tu gsang ba'i dbugs dbyung ba ste/ rdo rje sems dpar bdag spyor zhing / /thams cad spyor ba 5rjes spyor ldan/ /sangs rgyas nyid du shes bya ste / /sangs rgyas dam pa rtag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang ci'i phyir zhe na/ khyod kyi 6bdag nyid thams cad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /rang gi dam tshig yongs su gzung ba ni don yod pas/ de bzhin 33—616

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sdogs par sangs rgyas pa nyid du mngon par rtogs par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpal dang ldan pa'i dam tshig rjes su bsgrubs tshopas mchog tu grub pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid du shes par bya'o/ /de bas na dus thams cad dang / gnas skabs thams cad du yang ci nus pas sbug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba rnams kyi 2len pas khyed rnams kyis —rtag pa nyid du rjes su bsrung bar bya zhing zhig par mi bya'o/ /ji snyed pa'i longs spyod dang nye bar spyod pa thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba bla na med pa'i jeg pa chen po'i dam tshig sbyor bas legs par mchod la bde bar gzung bar bya zhing yang dag par gso bar bya'o/ /bdag nyid ji lta ba de bzhin du gzhan rnams la yang rig par sbyar bar bya'o/ /gang gis na khyod pha rol mu stegs kyi gzhung gis log pa'i lta ba can du mi 'gyur zhing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis thams cad du ltung ba la sogs pa dang / lus 'di shin tu yang mi smra ba nyid dang / sems shin tu yang 'gog par mi 'gyur bar gang gis sku gsung thugs rdo rje thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje dpal gyi rang gi dam tshig gis bla na med pa'i dngos grub mchog tu rtag par 'gyur bar 5yang kyis shig /yang smras pa/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad dang 6/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /sdig pa med kyis mi 7'jigs shig /dam tshig 'da' bar dka' ba'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bka' stsal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa byang chub 33—617

—sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la mchog tu gsang ba 'di bka' stsal pa yin no/ /yid ni rab tu dang ba'i rdo rje yis2/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde la brten/ /bde 5ba'i bde ba chung la sangs rgyas ni/ /kun dang 'dra mnyam rtag par khyod gyur to/ /slob mas gus par bla ma yi/ /rkang pa gnyis la phyag bya ste/ /de nas ji skad gsungs pa kun/ /rjes su bsgrub par khas blang ngo / /de ltar dam bca' byas nas ni/ /cho ga 'di yis rang nyid kyis/ /rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa ni/ /blangs nas kyang ni de la sbyin/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ/ dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ zhes brjod de/ de nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro ba / /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub rdo rje rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes brjod la dril bu sbyin no/ /de ltar dbang bskur byas nas ni/ /de nas sar pa'i gos rnams bskon/ /me tog dri la sogs pas mchod/ /mchod phyir gdu 4bu bcas par bya/ /de nas bla ma bdag nyid kyis/ /de yi spyi bor gdugs kyang gzung / /thal mo spyor 5ba byas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bskor du gzhug /gdugs dang bcas pa sgo phyogs su/ /spyi bor 'dud de phyag 'tshal gzhug /slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags / /gsang sngags rgyud ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /mkhan pos de skad smras nas su/ /gdugs bzhag nas ni slob ma de/ /lag pas legs par blangs nas su/ /de nas 'di skad bsgo bar bya/ /da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon 33—618

'gyur / /gsang sngags rgyud kyang 'dzin par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun kyis bkur bar 'gyur/ /sems can kun la snying brtse'i phyir/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /nan tan bskyed de bri bar bgyitshosna/ /sgrub pa po yang rgyud la spyor/ /khyod kyis chos la ser sna dang / /sems can rnams la mi phan pa/ /nyam nga chen por gyur kyang ni / /bu khyod kyis ni mi bya'o/ /de nas slob ma re re yis 2/ /lag pa g.yon pas g.yas pa yi/ /mje bo nas ni bzung nas su/ /zhi ba yi ni sbyin sreg bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /slob ma gus dang ldan pa dang / /rang gi rigs dang mtshams pa yis / /sdig pa thams cad spyin sreg bya / /de ltar byas nas bdag bsrung ste/ /sngags pas slob ma las yon blang / /slob ma yis kyang de nyid ni/ /ji ltar dga' bar 'gyur bar bya/ /de nas slob mas 'di ni rnam par snang mdzad do zhes ming du byas la/ bskor 4ba lan gsum bya ste/ phyag byas nas bdag nyid dbul bar bya zhing / mchod pa chen pos mchod par bya'o/ /shin tu dga' ba gang dang gang / /khyad par can ni de dang de/ /de nyid mi zad 'dod pa yis/ /de dang de ni bla ma sbyin/ /de ni bsod nams tshogs su 'gyur/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /yang na de ni dgar 'gyur ba/ /de ltar yang dag spyad par bya/ /de ltar yang dag dbang bskur ba/ /slob dpon zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /de yis bstan pa'i gsang sngags rnams/ /grub 5par 'gyur bar je tshom med/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhis mchod de/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta ram̐/ o badz+ra dhadz+re gā 6ya ne/ o badz+ra karma 7ka robhe ba/ zhes bya ba 33—619

rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa brgyad kyis phyi dang nang gi mchod pa byas la/thams cad ci nus pa dang / ci 'byor pa dang / rjes su mthun par mchod pa rnams dang / slob ma rnams mchod pa byed du gzhug go/ /de'i 'og tu bza' ba dang btung ba dang /shā glu dang rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis bdag dang gzhan dga' bar mchod byung ci 'dod pa nye bar longs spyod pa rnams bya'o/ /de nas thams cad su la yang ma smra shigalce /ces mna'i snying po byin la ji ltar zhugs pa rnams gtang bar bya'o/ /de nas me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod la legs par bstod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba gdab cing bzod pa gsol la nyi ma 'char ka'i dus su rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ gyen du bgrol te/ snying po 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ kṛ to 4ba sarba satārja/ sedha ma dat+tha yā nu ga /gats+tsha t+t+waṃ bud+dhā 5bi ṣa yo/bu na ra ga ma na yats+tsha trebadz+ra satwa muḥtso/ mi bskyod pa la sogs pa sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams ni/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya bas rang gi lus la nye bar bsdu bar bya'o/ /de nas snying ga nas byung ba'i rdo rje rin chen gyi phyag rgya rang gi dbang bsgur ba'i gnas na 'dug pas dbang bsgur la/ mdzub mo gnyis kyis phreng ba bcing ba dang / go cha bcing ba snying po 'dis bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca/ sarba mu dra me dṛ bhā ku ru bar ka ba tse na baṃ/ go cha'i mthar phreng ba bcing ba bkrol la thal mo sbyar te bdag nyid mnyam pa'i thal mos dgyes pa'i snying po 'di bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tu 6 ho/ yi ge brgya pa brjod la rdo rje dga' ba legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ legs so rdo rje sems dpa' khyod/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /rdo rje chos khyod legs pa ste/ /rdo rje las ni khyod 33—620

legs so/ /jeg pa chen po bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang //theg pa chen po mngon 'dus pa'i/ /mdo sde 'di ni legs par bshad/ /o badz+ra tī li tī la ya/ sarba bispyo/1/ badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces bya bas phur bu bton la 'o mas bkru'o/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā ṇ+ḍaṃ ār+ya 2 nut+pan+da tāta ༄ ces bya ba 'dis tshon rtsi rnams basbus la 'bad pas chu klung chen por dor bar bya'o/ /de nas gnas kyang ba lang gi lci bas nye bar byugs la/bza' ba dang ni bca' ba rnams/ /ci dga' bar ni sbyin par bya/ /khyi dang bya rog la sogs la/ /cung zad tsam yang mi sbyin no/ /yo byad rdzas rnams thams cad ni/ /slob dpon dag gis bsdus nas ni/ /bdag rang nyid kyis spyad par bya/ /slob ma rnams la bgor mi rung / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni yo byad kun / /slob dpon bdag nyid dbang bar bshad/ /gal te slob mas spyad na ni/ /dam tshig las ni nyams par 'gyur/ /gang zhig spyad par mi 'dod na//de yi cho ga'i rim 'di'o/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi yo byad du/ /de dag cho ga bzhin du dbul/ /gdugs dang rnga yab dri la sogs/ /sangs rgyas nyid la dbul bar bya/ /ba dan gdug 5spos dri la sogs/ /dam pa'i chos la dbul bar bya/ /gos dang yo byad snod la sogs/ /dge 'dun rnams la dbul bar bya / /de dag las ni slob ma yis/ /cung zad tsam yang mi bskur 6ro/ /dge 'dun med na dge slong sbyin/ /yang na dge slong ma la sbyin/ /gal te bdag nyid mi 'dod na/ /bsnyen bkur dag la sbyin par bya/ /de nas de yi phyi de nyin/ /nyes byas lhag ma zhi ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pa yis ni zhi ba yi/ /sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /slob ma sa dag zhi bya'i phyir/ /spyan la sogs 33—62/

pa'i gsang sngags dang / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /byams pa chen po'ang bsgom par bya/ /nyes byas thams cad zhi bya'i phyir/ /de nas zhi ba chen po bya'o/ /dad med dman la 'jug la min/ /'dod la chags dang khro bo'i 1dbang bskur dang / /slob ma bu min blo gros dman rnams la/ /cho ga'i bsgrub —pa 'di ni sbyin mi bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje chen po'i ye shes snang bas de skad ces bka' sprul to / /— snade nas dbang bskur zhing gnang ba thob nas de'i 'og tu bsgrub 4par bya ste/dbang bskur zhing gnang ba thob pas dus mtshams gsum mam bzhir byin gyis brlab pa dang / dbang bsgur nas dngos grub dang rdo rje blang ba'i bar gyi cho ga rnams rjes su bcad pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ma lus par mngon sum bzhin bltas 5la mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 6srid mtshan ma mthong gi bar du tshig gzhan mi smra bar bklag par bya'o/ /de nas dpyid zla ra ba'i zla ba nya ba la dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs las bshad pa'i cho gas dkyil 'khor bris la der bzhugs 7te cho ga thams cad rjes su spyad la/ skyil mo krung ma bshig par ji srid nyi ma shar ba'i dus su rje btsun 'jam dpal las 'od zer rnams nges par byung nas dkyil 'khor snang bar byas te/ sgrub pa po'i spyi bor nub par gyur gyi bar du bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i skra zlum por 'khyel ba/ lus la mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang pos brgyan pa lha'i rgyan thams cad kyis bzhugs pa/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te bag med pas de grub par ma gyur na/33—622

de 3 tshe dpyid zla tha chungs kyi nya la dkyil 'khor de bzhin du byas nas de bzhin du sgrub pa la zhugs na/ de ltar 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /der yang ma grub na ston zla tha chungs kyi 1 zla ba nya ba la de bzhin du sgrub pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /sgrub pa bdun pa la ni mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so/ /dngos grub mchog ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa'o/ /dngos grub 'bring ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / bum pa bzang po dang / dpag bsam gyi shing dang / ral gri'i rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa'o/ /de dag kyang de la lhag par mos pas mtshan yang dag par brjod pa klog cing de'i sgrub pa'i cho gas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub tha ma ni gsad pa dang bskrad pa dang / rnam par dbye ba dang / dbang du bya ba dang /dgug pa dang / rgyas pa'i longs spyod dang / rkang mgyogs la sogs pa'i dngos grub rnams te/ de dag kyang de dang de la mos pas bklags na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub mchog sgrub pa la zhugs pa rnams kyis gal te dngos grub mchog ma grub kyang 'bring ngam ༄ tha ma 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub 'bring sgrub 4pa la zhugs pa rnams kyis kyang de ma grub kyang tha ma grub par 'gyur gyi/ tha ma la sgrub 5par zhugs pa rnams kyi mchog dang 'bring ni ma yin no/ /de bas dngos grub mchog gi phyir 'bad par bya ste/ dngos grub 'bring dang tha ma rnams ni 'bad pa med par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags gzhan dag bsgrubs 6na mtshan gyi don gang yang rung ba'i ngo bo nyid kyi lha'i gzugs kyi rnal 'byor gyis bya ste/ de bas ni 'di ltar dkyil 'khor gyi de 33—623

kho na nyid kyi sgo nas dngos grub thams cad sgrub pas na/ sngags dang phyag rgya'i lha thams cad kyi bdag nyid can gyis sems can thams cad rjes su gzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ rje btsun 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod par gsungs pa yin no/ /de bas na 'di ltar gang ci yang rung ba ma brtags pa dag la sngon dang phyi ma'i don brtag par bya ba'i phyir de kho na nyid bshad par bya'o/ /ji ltar na mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las dkyil 'khor dang sngags dang phyag rgya dang lha rnams rnam par dgod pa'i khyad par gyi shenges par bstan pa bshad pa ni med kyi rang bzor brtags pa lta bur shes so zhe na 'di ltar bshad par bya ste/thams cad ni mtshan yang dag par brjod pa nyid du gnas la de bzhin du bshad pa yin gyi rang bzor byas pa ni ma yin te/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shin tu gsal ba'i 'od zer 'gyed pa'i snang bas dngos po rnams shin tu gsal bar mngon yang / dmus long dang mig med pa rnams kyis ni mi mthong ngo / /de bzhin du shin tu gsal ba'i blo gros kyi mig ma tshang bas gal te rtsod dus 27zin kyang de'i tshe nyes pa yod pa ma yin no/ /de lta mod kyi blo gros dman pa rnams kyis khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir slar yang bshad par bya ste/ sngags mchog mnga' bdag rig sngags rgyal/ /gsang sngags rgyal po don chen byed/ /gtsug tor chen po rmad byung gtsug /ces bya ba la sogs pas ni/ gtsug tor brgyad bshad pa yin no/ /rin chen kun bdag dbang phyug ste/ /'jig rten dbang phyug kun gye bdag /rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rje/ /zhes bya ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bshad pa yin no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje rgyal po bde ba che/ /zhes bya ba la 33—624

sogs pa ni byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug rnams bstan pa yin no/ /'dzin pa chen po rdo rje zhags/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che/ /zhes bya bas ni sgo srung tsornams kyang gsungs pa yin no/ /che ba 2sangs rgyas rig sngags 'chang / /zhes bya bas ni sangs rgyas spyan la sogs pa'i rig pa bzhi bshad pa yin no/ /gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor du yang / /mgon po sa bcu dbang phyug ste/ /sa bcu la ni rab tu gnas/ /zhes bya bas ni sa rnams bshad pa yin no/ /pha rol phyin bcu thob pa ste/ /zhes bya bas ni pha rol tu phyin pa rnams so/ /rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po/ /zhes bya bas ni dbang rnams so/ /de nyid dran pa chen po 'chang / /zhes bya bas ni don gyi gzungs dang tshig gi gzungs dang /mngon par rtogs pa'i gzungs dang / sngags kyi gzungs te dran pa zhes bya ba kyini gzungs la bya'o/ /dbugs 'byin chen po dga' ston che4/ /dga' chen rol mo chen po ste/ /zhes bya bas ni dga' ba'i mchod pa ste/ sgeg mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa yang bshad pa yin no/ /de bzhin du rim pa gsum pa las/kun du bzang po blo gros bzang / /sa yi snying po 'gro ba 'dzin/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas/ kun du bzang po la sogs pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug bshad pa yin no/ /sgor ni/ gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal/ /don yod zhags pa rnam par rgyal/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /ces bya ba la sogs pas ni/ gshin rje mthar byed dang / pad+ma mthar byed dang / bgegs mthar byed rnams de bzhin du bshad pa yin no/ /mtshams rnams 5rdo rje hūṃ ste hūṃ/ zhes sgrogs zhes bya bas ni khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'o / /rdo rje 'bar ba mig ni bzad6/ /ces bya bas ni rdo rje me ltar 'bar 33—623

ba'o / /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /ces bya bas ni rdo rje khrag 'thung ngo / /hi hi zhes sgrogs 'jigs par byed/ /ces bya ba ni rta mchog go//bdug pa ma la sogs 1rnams kyang / /sems can kun yid tshim par byed/ /ces bya ba la sogs pas bstan pa yin te/ de dag thams cad kyang yang dag par spros nas sbyar zhing bshad zin pas/ 'dir zhib tu ma smos so/ /phyi rol du rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du ya nga tshangs pa dang drag po dang / sred med kyi bu la sogs pa rnams kyang rtag tu rjes su 'byel pa yin pas/ 'khor nyid du bstan pa yin no/ /ji ltar na nang du khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba la sogs pas mnan la phyi rol du gzhag ce na/ 'di la brtsad par mi bya ste/ dregs pa bsal 2bar mdzad nas sprul pa'i gzugs kyis mchod pa'i phyir ro — / /bcom ldan 'das kyis 4'khor gyi tshul du gzhag pa yin pas mi mthun pa'i 'gal ba yod pa ma yin no/ /gsang sngags dang phyag rgya rnams ci phyir bzhag5 /ces zer na/ gsang sngags thams cad skyed 6pa po/ /zhes gsungs pas na/gsang sngags thams cad kyi dgos pa'i khyad par nyid yongs su shes pas/ na thams cad rjes su mthun par sbyar ba yin no/ /gsang sngags tshul chen las byung ba/ /gsang sngags tshul chen bdag nyid can/ /zhes gsungs pa 7na/dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags dang /dngos grub sgrub pa 8la sogs pa las rab 'byam 9 thams cad rje btsun 'jam dpal gyis 1 sbyor bas thams cad nas thams cad du sbyor bar bya'o/ /de bas na bshad ma thag pa'i phyag rgya dang / sngags kyi spyor ba la yang 'gal ba yod pa ma yin te/ don dam par de'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phyag rgya bzhi 33—626

yi don ston pa/ /zhes bya ba ni phyag rgya chen po dang dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang /chos kyi phyag rgya dang / las kyi phyag rgya las tha dad pa'i phyag rgya med pas 'di nyid du thams cad bstan pa yin te/ ji ltar bdag gis sbyar ba de bzhin du sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i don la mkhas pa rnams 1kyis nges par brtag par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dus dang sgrub pa'i dus su sbyin sreg gi cho ga bya dgos te/gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub la/ /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin/ /sngags rnams thams cad rab bsgrub phyir/ /sbyin sreg las rnams brtsam par bya / /sbyin sreg med par las rnams la/ /dngos grub 'byung bar mi 'gyur te / /de bas sbyin sreg las rnams la/ /sngags pas 'bad pa chen po bya/ /de la sbyin sreg gi thab khung ni/ sems can kyi dbye bas ni mtha' yas so/ /rigs kyi dbye ba las ni rnam pa lnga'am/ bzhi thab khung rnam par dbye ste/'di ni thab khung gtan la dbab pa'o/ /rgya cher rdo rje khro bo snyoms par 'jug pa'i gsang ba'i rgyud las thab khung gi rnam pa brgya rtsa bcur gsungs so/ /las kyi dbye bas 'di lta ste/ zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / mngon spyod dang / dgug pa dang / dbang du bya ba dang / bskrad pa dang /bcing ba dang / gsad 4pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / tshe 'phel ba dang /nor dang 'bru dgug pa dang / 'dod pa'i gzugs nyid dang / mi snang ba dang / bka' bzhin byed pa dang / spyig pa rab tu gzhig pa dang / rig pa rjes su chags par bya ba dang / nam mkhar 'gro ba 5dang / rig sngags 33—627

gzi byin —1bskyed pa dang / dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub pa'o/ /de la zhi ba la kun nas zlum po'o/ /rgyas pa la ni zur bzhi'o/ /mngon spyod la ni gru gsum mo / /dgug pa la —ni lcags kyu'o/ /dbang du bya ba la ni rdo rje lta bu'o/ /nor dang 'bru dgug pa la ni rin po che lta bu'o/ /'dod pa'i gzugs kyi ni mtshan lta bu'o/ / mi snang bar bya ba ni mda' gzhu lta bu'o/ /bka' bzhin byed pa ni 4ral gri lta bu'o/ /sdig pa rab tu gzhig pa 5ni rta babs dang bcas pa'i rtsig pa'am 'obs lta bu'o/ /rig pa rjes su chags par bya ba ni rang gi rigs kyi phyag rgya lta bu'o/ /nam mkha' la 'gro ba ni nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'o/ /rig sngags kyi gzi byin 6bskyed pa la ni rab tu 'bar ba lta bu'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub pa ni 'khor lo lta bu ji lta ba nyid dam/ de'i dkyil 'khor rnams lta bu yin no/ /de bzhin du thun mong gi brko ba'i cho ga las/sbyin sreg gi cho ga thams cad la phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi zur bzhi pa dang / sgo bzhi par thig btab la shar phyogs su rdo rjes spras pa dang / lhor rin po ches spras pa dang / nub tu pad+mas spras pa dang / byang du pad+ma rdo rjes spras par byas la/ der shar phyogs su pad+ma dang / nags kyi lcug ma dang / bgrang phreng dang / ril ba spyi blugs dang / rigs 7kyi pags pa ste phyag rgya lnga bri'o/ /lho phyogs su mdung rtse gsum pa dang / zla ba kham pa dang / rgyal mtshan dang /thor tshugs dang mig ste phyag rgya lnga bri'o/ /nub phyogs su 'khor lo dang / dung dang / be+e con dang / ral gri dang phub ste phyag rgya lnga bri'o/ /byang phyogs su mdung thung dang / dril bu dang / ba dan dang / rma bya dang / ra skyes te phyag rgya lnga bri bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su thab khung brkos la thab 33—628

kyi nang du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi phyag rgya'am/dkyil 'khor yang dag pa'i spyor bas dgod par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gye cho ga bzhin du bsrung ba la sogs pa thams cad byas nas/ sbyin sreg gis dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams kyi 1khyad par gyi las dang rjes su mthun par tshim par byas la / rang nyid mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub rnams bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhi ba la oṃ sar+bha du kho ba sha mi ne+e swā hā zhes bya ba dang / yungs kar la sogs pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /rgyas pa la oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye 2swā hā/ zhes bya ba dang 'bras la sogs pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /mngon spyod la ni oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ kṛ1 pa ya kṛrje pa ya hūṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bibyā rā dza mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba dang / mi rus kyi phye ma la sogs pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /sdig pa rab tu gzhil ba la/ oṃ sat+tha pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ zhes bya ba dang / til la sogs pa'i sbyin sreg 4bya'o/ /nor dang 'bru la sogs pa dgug pa la ni/ oṃ sarba ā kar+ṣa ya/ dha na dha na/ di shaṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā zhes bya ba dang / 'bras la sogs pa'o/ /bsrung ba'i don du ni/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzā 5ya swā hā zhes bya ba dang / ku sha'i myu gu til mar la btags pa'i 'o/ /tshe 'phel ba la ni/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu 6ṣe swā hā zhes bya ba dang / drur 7wa'i myu gu la sogs pa'i 'o/ /dgug pa la ni/ oṃ badz+ra ā kar+ṣa ya swā hā zhes bya ba dang /kub tsa 8ka'i tsher ma la sogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor bcing ba la ni hūṃ badz+ra bhan+dha 9ya baṃ zhes bya ba dang / lcags kyi phye ma la sogs pa'i 'o/ /gsad pa la ni/oṃ badz+ra mā ra ya hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / dur khrod kyi thal ba la sogs pa'i 'o/ /dbang du bya ba la ni/ oṃ badz+ra ba shi saku ru ye swā hā zhes bya ba dang / me tog 33—629

dmar po la sogs pa'i 'o/ /'dod pa'i gzugs la ni/ oṃ badz+ra kā ma rū pe ne+e saṃ zhes bya ba dang / shing dregs pa'i 'bras bu la sogs pa'i 'o/ /chags par bya ba la ni oṃ badz+ra ā rā ga ṇa ya ho zhes bya ba dang / me skyur po la sogs pa'o / /nam mkhar tsho'agro ba la ni/ oṃ khe 2snatsa ri ṇi ha ha ha zhes bya ba dang / man+d+ra ra ba'i me tog la sogs pa'i 'o/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa la ni/ hūṃ badz+ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje can gyi me tog la sogs pa'i 'o/ /mi snang bar bya ba la ni/ oṃ badz+ra ā dar+sha na yā saṃ zhes bya ba dang / 'bras bu mi snang ba la sogs pa'i 'o/ /rig sngags gzi brjid bskyed pa la/ oṃ badzārja sidhe ye swā hā zhes bya ba dang / mar la sogs pa'i 'o/ /don thams cad grub pa'i cho ga la ni/ oṃ sed+dhi su sid+dhi ye swā hā/ yungs kar la sogs pa'i 'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pa la ni/ oṃ maṇ+ḍa la a dhi pa ta ye snyeswā hā/ oṃ maṇ+ḍa la sid+dhi 6ye swā hā/ oṃ bh+ra swā hā/ oṃ bhu bha swā hā/ oṃ swa swā hā/ oṃ bhur bhu ba swaḥswā hā/ oṃ swaste swā hā zhes bya ba dang / swaste ka'i me tog la sogs pa'i 'o/ /sbyin sreg bya ste/ shin tu rgya cher che 7ba ni ma yin no/ /mdor bsdus na ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha rnam pa bcu gnyis su bstan te/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ ye shes me nyid dang po ste/ de ni dbang chen zhes su bsgrags/ /kha dog ser po'i mdog can la/ /mdog dang rgyas dang stobs kyang ster/ /'bar ba'i phreng chen ting 'dzin gnas/ /ye shes rdzogs byed shes par bya/ /gnyis pa 'dzin pa zhes bya ste/ /ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od dang mnyam/ /dpal ldan gos kyang dkar po gon/ /bgrang phreng dang ni gun+dhe tsuthogs/ /gsum pa rlung zhes bya ba ste/ /kha dog nag po rtsub pa'o/ /bzhi pa dmar po zhes bya ste/ /33—630

nub ka'i mtshams kyi dmar thag 'dra/ /lnga pa mi 'da' zhes bya ba/ /spun la kha dog dam rtesnapa ste/ /mgrin pa ring la gzi brjid che/ /thams cad la ni phan 'dogs pa'o/ /drug pa khro bo zhes bya ste/ /mi — g.yon dud pa'i kha dog can/ /gyen du skra brdzes — sgra chen 'byin/ /ma che ba bzhi pa stobs po che/ /bdun pa lto ba zhes bya ste/ /rno la kha dog kun dang ldan/ /brgyad pa zad byed ces bya ste//glog 'gyu ba yi 'od 'dra ba/ /dgug jepa yid las skyes zhes bya/ /sna tshogs gzugs can stobs po che/ /bcu pa 'jig rten 'byen pa ste/ /sha za'i mi 3ni de las gzhan/ /bcu gcig bar ni shes par bya/ /'dod med dbang gi las can no/ /rmugs byed ces pa bcu gnyis pa/ /sems can rmongs par byed pa'o / /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs las skyes/ /las kyi rjes mthun gsang sngags dang / /phyag rgya'i sbyor bar ldan pa yi/ /kun dang 6las don sgrub byed pa'o / /de nas shin tu bsdus pa ni/ /rnam pa bzhi ru yongs bsgrags pa/ /sems can mos pa'i dbang gis ni/ /cho ga 'di ni bsdus pa yin/ /thab dang lha yi grangs dang ni/ /mdor bsdus 'bring dang rgyas pa ru/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten mgon pos gsungs pa yin/ /de las shin tu bsdus pa zlum po la sogs pa bshad par bya ste/ zlum po dang / zur bzhi dang / gru gsum dang / zla ba phyed pa lta bu la khru gcig pa dang / khru do pa dang / khru bzhi 3dang / khru drug pa dang / khru brgyad pa dang / khru bcu pa dang / sor bcu drug pa dang / mtho gang tsam ste/ las dang rdzas dang rjes su mthun par thab kyi tshad byas pa yin no/ /'dir thab khung rnam pa bzhir rdzas dang las kyi dbye ba las so sor nges pa yin gyi las thams cad pa'i 33—631

thab khung ni mi snang ngo / /ci ltar zhe na/ zhi ba la 7zlum po'o/ /rgyas pa la ni gru bzhi'o/ /dbang ba 2la n-i gru gsum mo/ /mngon spyod la ni gru gsum zla ba phyed pa dang ldan pa'o/ /de la gdon dang nye bar 'tshe ba dang / rims dang bgegs kyis zin pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir dang / mngon par shes pa dang /thar pa bsgrub pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa zhi bar byed pas na/ zhi ba'i las zhes bshad do/ /ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang /rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / gter chen po dang / rgyal srid dang / bcud kyis len dang / gser 'gyur gyi khurtsi la sogs pa grub pa ni rgyas pa'o/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang mi'am ci dang /skyes pa dang bud med la sogs pa dang rgyal po bran g.yog dang bcas pa dbang du byed pas na dbang ngo / /gsad pa dang bskrad pa dang / dbye ba dang /gnon pa dang / rmongs par byas pa dang / yan lag bcad 4pa ni mngon spyod do/ /las kyi tshogs de dag nges/ par shes par byas la las thams cad dgug 5pa'i thab khung du thams cad bya'o/ /de nas yang rdo rje dang rin po che dang / pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang / 'khor los dbus su mtshan pas na/las thams cad pa zhes zer mod kyi de ni mi rigs te/ phyag rgya gang yin pa lha yin la/ lha gang yin pa de nyid phyag rgya yin pas na/ rdo rje ni mi bskyod pa dang / mā ma kri'i ngo bo nyid do/ /rin po che ni rin chen 'byung dang / rin chen sgrol ma'i ngo bo nyid do/ /pad+ma ni rād dpag tu med pa dang / gos dkar mo'i ngo bo nyid do/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ni don yod grub pa 6dang / sgol ma'i ngo bo nyid do/ /'khor lo ni rnam par snang mdzad dang / sangs rgyas spyan 33—632

gyi ngo bo nyid do1/ /rigs pa 'dis na las thams cad pa nyid de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung 2nyid las/ las thams cad pa 'di ci zhig rigs zhes la la dag zer ro/ /de yang rab tu grub par byed pa'i rgyu las ni/ thab gru bzhi pa de nyid las thams cad pa'i thab khung yin par bshad de4/ de nyid dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa'i rgyud las bkag ste/ dze+eng bu'i dbyibs lta bur glu dang gsang ba rnams kyi lus bsreg pa dang / yan lag gzhig pa'i don du ji ltar 'gyur / 5thab khung gru bzhi pa ni rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas rdo rjes/ brgyan pa'i thab khung las thams cad pa'o zhes gsungs te/ de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ zur bzhi pa la khru gang tsam/ zabs su de'i phyed tsam brkos te/ thab khung gi steng du sor bzhi tsam dor bar dpangs dang rgyar sor bzhi pa'i kun du mnyam pa'i kha khyer la/ phyogs rnams su lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang / lcags sgrog dang / dril bu dang /mtshams su zla ba kham pa dang / rtse gsum pa'i rdo rjes mtshan la thab kyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa thab bas cung zad dma' ba 'dab ma brgyad la rdo rje brgyad lte ba'i ge sar la rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed nub phyed bgreng ba ste/ 'di dag ni rdo rjes brgyan pa'i thab khung las thams cad pa'o/ /thab khung de nyid rje btsun rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa 6rgyud chen po dang dam tshig gsum gyi rgyal ba'i 7rgyud chen po dang / kun nas dbang bskur bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po dang / phyag na rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po las gsungs pa ni/ rdo rje brgyad dang ldan pa la/ /dbus su rdo rje chen po bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pas kyang 33—633

rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po las/ dbus su rdo rje rab tu brtag /ces gsungs pas/ thab khung de nyid las thams cad 2yin par bshad do/ /dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa las ni pad+ma lta bu'i dbyebs can gyi thab khung las thams cad pa yin par bshad do/ /bud med dang rgyal po'i bu mo dang / grong dang / grong khyer thob pa dang / don thams cad ni pad+ma'e dbyibs lta bus 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /dpal phyag na pad+mos kyang / pad+ma 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po dang / rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po las pad+ma'i dbyibs can thab khung de nyid las thams cad pa yin par gsungs te/ thab khung 'di ni zlum po la kho ra khor yug khru gang tsam la 'og tu khru phyed par barbos pa dbus kyi 'dab ma la pad+ma brgyad kyis bskor ba/ thab kyi steng du sor bzhi dor ba 4dpangs dang rgyar sor bzhi pa thab khung nas byung ba'i pad+ma kha bye ba lta bu'i kha khyer la/ kha khyer gyi rgyab tu pad+ma'i phreng bas 5bskor ba/ thab kyi dbus kyi phyogs kyi pad+ma rnams la rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i phyag rgya dgod par bya'o/ /mchams kyi pad+ma la mig gnyis dang rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang / pad+ma dang ut+pal dgod do/ /dbus kyi pad+ma la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dgod do/ /thab khung gi nang gi tha mar rdo rje phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i thab khung ni las thams cad pa'i thab bo//gzhan dag gis 6thams cad pa'i thab khung gzhan dag tu yang 'chad do/ /rje btsun gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 'dir ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid bcom ldan 'das rje btsun 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni don thams cad rdzogs pa yin par bshad de/ zhal bzhi pa dang / phyag brgyad pa dang / sku 33—634

mdog dang dbyibs sna tshogs pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir rten 1dang brten pa po'i ngo bo nyid yin no/ /de la shar phyogs kyi zhal ni me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi 2 byang chub kyi sems rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid de dkar po zhi bar mdzad pa'o / /lho'i zhal ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo nyid de/ser po rgyas pa 'phel bar mdzad pa'o/ /nub kyi zhal ni so sor kun du rtog pa'i ye shes 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bo nyid de/ dmar po 'gro ba rnams dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /byang gi zhal ni bya ba sgrub 4pa'i ye shes don yod grub pa'i ngo bo nyid de/ nag po nyon mongs pa'i dgra rnams dang / bdud kyi dgra bo thams cad zad par mdzad pa ste mngon spyod do/ /de ltar zhi ba dang /rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / mngon spyod kyi las rnams rdzogs par byed pas na / thab gcig la las thams cad pa'i thab khung du bshad do/ /de lta na ni thab kyi mtshan nyid dbye ba la don med de/ thab gcig tu las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro zhe na/ don med pa ma yin te/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po nyid kyis legs par 7las byed pas na/ dkyil 'khor thams cad zhi ba'i las la bsgur 6zhing bka'i 'khor lo'i sbyor bas zhi 7zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / mngon spyod bya ste/ de bas na mtshan nyid tha dad pa'am/ dgongs pa'i dbang gis nye bar gzung ba yin no/ /thab khung so so'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya ste/ de la zhi ba la ni sa gzhi dkar po la rgyar khru gang tsam brkos la zabs su sor bcu gnyis pa de'i dbus su pad+ma'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa sor brgyad pa thab kyi steng bar du sor bzhi dor ba dpangs dang rgyar sor bzhi pa'i kha khyer gyis bskor ba la mtshams rnams su rdo rje rtse gsum pas 33—635

mtshan pa/ thab de sa gzhi dkar po dang ba'i phyi bas byugs la/ yang de gnyis ka dri dkar pos nye bar byug cing me tog dka/ra pos gtor ba dus gsum du bya'o/ /rgyas pa la ni sa gzhi ser po la rgyar khru do zabs su khru gang zur bzhi pa'am / rin po che zur brgyad pa dang 'dra bar brkos la de'i steng du sor brgyad pa'i kha khyer dbyibs de dang 'dra bar bskor la khung bur 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba 1rdo rje rin po che sor drug pas mtshan pa/ sa ser po dang dri ser pos thab dang sa gzhi de byugs la/ me tog sna tshogs gtor bar bya'o/ /mngon spyod la ni rtsub cing gas pa dang / shin tu gnag pa'i sa gzhi la gru gsum pa zla gam gnyis mtshan pa dang ldan pa sor nyi shu pa zabs su sor bcu pa/thab kyi mgo byang du blta ba/ 'og tu rtse gsum pa'i steng du khro bo'i rdo rje sor brgyad pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sor gsum dor bar dpangs dang rgyar sor gsum dor ba/ kha phyir bltas pa'i kha khyer gyis bskor ba/ sa nag po dang ro bsregs/ pa'i thal ba dang / bong bu dang rnga mo'i rtug pa la sogs pa ci snyed pas byugs la/ dri mi zhim pa'i dri dang me tog sngon po'am/ dmar po'am/phub mas gtor ro/ /dbang la ni sa gzhi dmar po la thab kyi dbyibs bha ga lta bu rdo rje dang pad+mas mtshan pa'o/ /dgug pa la ni rdo rje rtse gcig lta bus 4dbus su rdo rje dang rin po ches mtshan pa'o/ /de dang 'dra ba'i kha khyer gyis yongs su bskor bas dmar po dang dri dmar pos byugs pa/ me tog dmar pos nye bar mdzes par byas pa'o/ /'di gnyis kyi 5zabs dang rgya'i tshad la sogs pa ni zhi ba'i thab khung dang 'dra ba las thams cad pa'i thab khung kyang 7de bzhin te 'on kyang kha khyer ni pad+ma kha bye ba lta bu la rdo rje phreng bas dbaskor ba 33—636

dbus su rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus su 'khor lo dang ldan pas mtshan pa'o zhes pa 1la la dag brjod do/ /dkyil 'khor ram lha'i khang pa'i shar phyogs su zhi ba'i thab khung / lhor rgyas pa/nub tu dbang du bya ba dang / dgug pa/ byang du mngon spyod kyi thab khung bya zhing / tshon rtsi rnams kyang las dang rjes su mthun par brtag par bya'o2 / /thab kyi mtshan nyid do / /༄/de nas thab khung gi gnas rab tu shis pa'i chu shing lo ma'am/ mtshan dang ldan zhing shin tu sar pa'i gos dang / sā lu'am/pad+ma'i 'dab mas thab kyi mthar thug par g.yogs 4par bya'o/ /de nas ku sha dgram par bya ste/ rtsa ba nas bton zhing ma nyams pa 'bus ma zos pa shin tu gsar zhing sngo ba'i ku shas g.yogs 5par bya'o/ /dang po shar du rtse bstan gzhag /gnyis pa lho phyogs kha bltas pa'o/ /gsum pa'i rtse mo nub tu ste/ /bzhi pa rtse mo byang du'o/ /don kun bsgrub pa'i ku sha yis6/ /thab kyi shar nas dang por g.yogs7/ /'dir ku sha blang ba'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ i do ku sha shu 8bha bye bh+ya pū ta 9prah+ma bi ba tren/ bubye dhasgro rka saṃ gha ti thra zwa sañja ta gar+bha a bismyon ma ma shāṅgi kurban+d+ra 1 swā hā/ gsang sngags 'di ku sha la lan bdun bzlas la sngar bshad pa'i cho gas dgram par bya'o/ /'dab 5dang ku sha'i tshogs dgram pa'i cho ga'o / /sazhi ba la ni pa la sha dang u dum wā 7ra dang /a mra dang / a shwaṅga dang / blak+ka dang / smi r+ya 7dang / sha mi dang /n+ya gro dha 8la sogs pa 3shing 'o ma can las byung ba/ 'dab ma dang bcas pa mnyam por bcad pa/ rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'i mtho gang tsam gyi yam shing la sbrang rtsi dang mar la rtse mo gnyis btags la/ dri dkar po'i spos chus bkrus pa 33—637

rtse mo 'dab ma gnyis dang bcas pa ste/ rtse gcig pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /rnying pa dang lo ma med pa dang / khong stong dang / chag pa dang / shun lpags med pa dang / thung ngu dang yon po dang / rtse mo gas pa dang / ha cang phra ba dang / ha cang sbom pa dang / ring po dang / 'bus zos pa dang /srog chags dang bcas pa rnams ni spang bar bya'o/ /zhi ba la ni nas dang /'o ma dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang / zho dang / 'bras dang /'bras yos dang / ku sha sngon po dang / drur 3wa sngon po dang / a mra'i lo ma dang / tsan+dan dang / pri yang ku'i me tog dang / sā lu'i chan dang /me tog dkar po dang / ge sar dang thang chu dri zhim pa thuci snyed pa las sbyin sreg bya'o/ /rgyas pa la ni yam shing de rnams de — nyid las sgoms su chag gang la srid du khru gang tsam 'o ma dang zho dang / mar la btags te dri zhim po'i spos chu la sbyangs la/ mngar gsum la btags pa'i 'bras chan chobazang po'i bshos dang / zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang bsres pa'i til nag po dang / zho dang 'bras chan mar dang bcas pa dang / sha ta put+pa dang / bil ba'i 'bras bu dang / 'bras sha li dang / nā 5ga ge sar dang / karte ka'i me tog dang /'bru rnams kyis 6sbyin sreg bya'o/ /mngon spyod la ni nim pa dang / seng ldeng dang / ko bi da ra dang / ba la ta ka dang / ma da na'am/ de las gzhan pa'i shing kha ba dang tsher ma can dang / ro bsregs pa'i thal ba can dang /mgal dum gyi yam shing rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba gas pa sor bcu'i tshad tsam/dug dang khrag dang yungs ma 7la btags pa'i rtse mo gnyi ga rno ba dang / yungs nag dang / yungs mar dang / khrag dang / lan tshwa dang / skye tshe dang /33—638

nidza'i lo ma dang / ro bsregs pa'i thal ba dang / rkang rjes kyi sa dang /bong bu dang rnga mo la sogs pa'i rtug pa dang / khyem bya'i zhag dang / bya rog la sogs pa'i gshog pa dang / gcin dang / rtug pa dang / tsher ma dang /mi rus kyi phye ma dang / sbrang rtsi la sogs pa dang / ci rnyed pa'am/ rdzas re re zhing dug dang / khrag dang / lan tshwa dang / skye tshe dang / da du ra'i lo ma'i khu ba la btags pa'i rdzas de rnams thal ba dang / sol ba'am phub ma las dgra bo'i gzugs brnyan byas la/ gtub cing gtub cing spyin sreg bya'o/ /dbang gi las la ni tsam pa ka dang / a shwaṅga tshodang / ba ku la dang / pri yang ku dang / la ku tsa la sogs pa'i 2 yam shing sor lnga pa la 'dab ma dang bcas pa dang / 'bras bu dang / me tog sgyur po rnams dang / gzhan yang rang gi rtog pa las gsungs pa'i rdzas rnams kyis sbyin sreg bya'o/ /dgug pa la ni de nyid dang tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /u dum wā ra pa la sha/be+ek+ka ngasnadang ni n+ya gro dha5/ /seng ldeng dang ni arka dang / /a mra be ta ka ta dang / /a ma r+ya dang sha mi dang / /a pa marka las byung dang / /a shwaṅga 6 dang bcas pa ni/ /yam sreg 3shing ni bcu gnyis bstan/ /gsar zhing drang la mtho gang tsam/ /rtse gnyis dri zhim legs par btags/ /yam shing dag ni rtse gcig tu/ /las rnams kun la bsreg par bya/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sagang cung zad/ /gang yang rgyas pa'i bsreg bya dang / /bdag gi zangs 9te de dag kun / /nyin re swā hā'i co mthar bcas dbul/ /mar la btags pa'i gu gul dang / /sā la'i thang chu la sogs pa/ /gsang sngags lha yi bye brag gis/ /sbyin sreg la ni dbul bar bya/ /dri dang me tog sogs mchod pa/ /las thun 33—639

rang sngags ji bzhin bzla/ /rdzas rnams kyi ni 4 mtshan nyid do / /༄2zhi ba la ni mchod sbyin gyi shing srog chags med pa rnams la thab khung las cung zad dma' ba'am / dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci ba'i bud shing bya'o/ /rgyas pa la ni dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci ba ma gtogs pa ji skad du bshad pa'i bud shing rnams 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o/ /mngon spyod la ni kha ba dang / tsha ba dang / dri mi zhim pa'i bud shing dang dur khrod kyi shing ngam/ bong bu dang rnga mo la sogs pa'i rtug pa'am / shing shin tu skams pa'o/ /dbang du bya ba la ni nidza dang / a mra'i shing dang gzhan yang me tog dang bcas pa'i shing ngo / /dgug pa la ni tsher ma dang bcas pa'o/ /las thams cad pa la ni las dang rjes su mthun pa'i bud shing gis bya'o/ /bud shing gi mtshan nyid do / /ri gser ram dngul lam rdo'am shing ngam/ sa'i rdul /rmelas byas pa'am/ dung chos sam/ nya phyis sam / shel las byas pa'i snod legs par bkrus pa dri zhim pa'i 5spos kyis legs par bdugs 6pa'i mchod yon gyi snod du chu bo'am/ lteng ka'am/rdzing bu'am/ chu mig gam/ khron pa'am/ g.ya' chu'am/ bkod ma la sogs pa'i chu ngogs gtsang ma skye bo mang pos bsten pa ma yin pa/ rgyal po dang nye ba ma yin pa/ ba lang dang / bong bu dang / ra lug dang / rta dang /ma he dang glang po che rnams kyis smos 7par ma byas pa'i chu ngogs las/ chu shin tu dang ba/ snod gzhan kyis ma reg pa/ rigs ngan dang / sme sha can dang bcas pas bsten pa'am/ ngan cing dman pa la 'jug pa dang / mi'u thung dang / zhar ba dang / long ba dang / mdze can dang / sha bkra la sogs pa'i nad kyis yongs su gdungs pa rnams kyis ma mthong zhing ma reg pa'i 33—640

chus mchod yon gyi snod bkang la/ tsan+dam/ dang / ga phur thu gyis bsgos shing / dzā ti dang ma li ka la sogs pa'i me tog gis brgyan pa/ spos dri zhim pos bdugs ༄27 pa'i mchod yon legs por brdungs pa'i gser gyi gdu bu dang /gsang byed la sogs pa btags pa'i lag pa dang / rang gi lha'i sngags sam/rang gi rtog pa las bshad pa'i sngags lan bdun bzlas la g.yon phyogs su gzhag —par bya'o/ /zhi ba la ni dri dkar po la sogs pa dang sbyar ba'i chu rang gi lha'i sngags swā hā'i mtha' dang bcas pas bzlas par bya'o/ /de bzhin du 4 rgyas pa la ni (muser po la sogs pa dang sbyar ba'i chu til dang tho/ ru bcas pa oṃ gyi mtha' dang bcas pas bzlas pa bya'o/ /mngon spyod la ni dri nag po dang sbyar ba'i chu khrag dang / ko tra pa dang / ba gcin dang bcas pa la phaṭa kyi mtha' dang bcas pas bzlas pa bya'o/ /dbang la ni dri dmar po la sogs pa dang sbyar ba'i chu bo'i mtha' dang bcas pas bzlas pa bya'o/ /dgug pa la ni dza' mtha' dang bcas pas bzlas pa bya'o/ /thams cad du yang dri la sogs pa ni las dang rjes su mthun par gzhag par bya'o/ /mchod yon gye mtshan nyid do // de nas zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang du bya ba ni rdo rje gnod spyin dang / rdo rje rtse mo gnyis kyi sngags kyis las thams cad pa'i chu'i snod dang / mchod yon gyi snod la bzlas la rang gi g.yon phyogs su bzhag ḍanas de dag nyid bzlas pa'i chus bsangs pa'i bud shing la sogs pa sbyin sreg gi rdzas rnams rang gi g.yas phyogs su gzhag par bya'o/ /gsad pa dang bskrad pa dang / rnam par dbye ba la sogs pa'i las rnams la ni bsad pa dang / dgod pa go bzlog ste bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ rdo rje gnod sbyin kyi sngags so/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las mje'u 33—641

chung gi rtse mo gnyis mche bar bya ste/ khar gzhag hūṃpa 'di ni 'di'i phyag rgya'o/ /o badz+ra shi kha 3re ru ṭa ma ṭa zhes —snabya ba ni rdo rje rtse mo'i sngags so/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis ri 'degs par rtebya ba ni 'di'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdzas gzhag sgepa'i mtshan nyid do / /6zhi ba la ni rang gi lha'i chos kyi yi ge las thab khung bskyed la de'i dbus su yi ge ram̐ 7sum mdo ris mtshan dang bcas pas oṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma'i steng du gnas pa'i i las byung ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang na chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gnas pa dung dang / kun+da lta bu'i pa pa gī me mig gsum pa ral pa dang cod pan du ldan pa lag pa bzhi g.yas pas dbyug pa dang /mi 'jigs pa sbyin repa/ g.yon na gubye khedang phreng ba thogs pa rgyan dang gos dang / mchod phyir thogs pa dkar po dang ldan pa/ lus kyi yan lag thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer dkar po 'phro bar bsam par bya'o/ /rgyas pa la ni de bzhin du 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang na dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor de'i dbus na rgyas pa'i me dbang chen zhes bya ba ral pa dang cod pan thogs pa mig gsum pa/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas na dbyug pa thogs 2 pa dang /mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa g.yon na phreng ba dang gubye 1 thogs pa rgyan dang gos dang /mchod phyir thogs ser por ldan pa/ 'od zer ser po gtong ba'i tshogs kyis sems can ma lus pa'i khams kyi stobs dang / kha dog dang / dpal rdzogs par byed pa'i ye shes kyi me bsam par bya'o/ /dbang du bya ba la ni de bzhin du 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gye nang na me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng kha dog dmar zhing nyi ma 'char ka lta bur 'od zer dmar po rab tu 'gyed pa/ lag pa bzhi pa g.yas na dbyug pa dang / lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon na zhags pa dang gun+dhe 733—6 42

thogs pa/ rgyan dang gos dang phreng ba dang / dri dang byug pa dang / mchod phyir thogs pa dmar po dang ldan pa mig gsum pa/ ral pa'i tshogs dang /cod pan dang ldan pa'i dbang gi me dbang gi 1las la bsgom par bya'o/ /mngon spyod la ni de bzhin du 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi pa du ba'i mdog can mi g.yo ba/ g.yas na ral gri dang dbyug pa thogs pa/ g.yon na zhags pa dang gudhe 2thogs pa/ skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba shas cher khro zhing mig dmar ba mche ba gcigs pa bzhin rnam par 'gyur ba/ khros shing shas cher 'jigs su rung ba rgyan dang gos dang / mchod phyir thogs la sogs pa nag po dang ldan pa/ 'od zer nag po'i phreng ba rnams kyis srid pa gsum khyad par byed pa'i rlung zhes bya ba'i me gsad pa la sogs pa'i gdug pa'i las rnams la bsgom par bya'o/ /de la zhi ba la ni 'o ma can kyi shing las byung ba'i me'am rgyun bzhag 4gi me'am/ bram ze tha mal pa'i mes bya'o/ /rgyas pa la ni rgyal po'am/rgyal rigs kyi khyim nas byung ba'i me'am/ dgon pa'i me'am nags mched pa'i mes bya'o/ /mngon spyod la ni dur khrod kyi me+e'am/ rus pa'am rdo las byung ba'i me'am/ gdol pa'i khyim las byung ba'i mes bya'o/ /dbang la ni smad 'tshong ma'am/ rje'u rigs kyi khyim las byung ba'i mes bya'o/ /dgug pa la ni gar mkhan dang rol mo pa'am/ lam du bus pa'i mes bya'o/ /me'i mtshan nyid do / /5dgang gzar ni gser ram dngul gyi rgyu las byas pa'am/ mchod sbyin gyi shing las byas pa pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i dbyebs lta bu de'i yu ba skyes bu tshad dang ldan pa'i mthe bo sor sum cu rtsa bzhi rdo rje khu tshur la sogs pas gzung du 33byed613

rung ba/ de'i rtse mo'i char sor bzhi pa/ kha zur sor bzhi pa/ zabs su sor gnyis pa dbus su rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa/ khu ba byung ba'i bu ga sor gcig tsam de'i mchu sor bzhi pa la rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ yu ba'i 'og tu rdo rje dang rin po che sor drug pa bya'o/ /blugs gzar ni yu ba khru gang tsam pad+ma'i dbyebs lta bu la kha'i rgyar sor gnyis pa/ zabs su sor gcig pa dbus su rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa yu ba'i 'og tu rdo rje dang rin po che bya'o/ /dgang gzar med na sor mo lnga gzhibs nas dgang blugs byas la/ srin lag dang gung mo dang mje bo gzhibs pas ni sreg blugs cig shos bya'o/ /dgang gzar dang blugs gzar gyi mtshan nyid do / /snade nas legs par khrus byas 2 shing yan lag dris bsgos la ji skad du bshad pa'i rgyan dang / gos la sogs pa dang ldan pas zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang dang mngon spyod dang /dgug pa dang / dbye ba dang / bskrad pa'i bsam pas sbyin sreg gi las bya ba dang ldan zhing rang gi lha'i spyor ba dang ldan pas las dang rjes su mthun pa'i yid kyis 'jigs pa med par sems can thams cad la phan par brtson pas ji skad du gsungs pa thams cad bya'o/ /de la zhi ba la ni gos dang cod pan dang /rgyan dkar po dang ldan zhing gsang byed dang bcas pa gdu bu dang bcas pas ji skad du bshad pa'i bsrung ba'i cho ga dang bzlas brjod bya zhing byams pa chen po dang ldan pas mi smra bar 'jam zhing bde ba'i stan nang tshangs can la pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug nas/ lag pa'i pad+ma gnyis kyi gru mo'i mthar thug gi bar du dri zhim pos legs par byugs la/ phyi dro'i dus su shar du bltas —/blos bsgrub par bya ba dmigs nas yar gyi ngo'i tshes gcig nas brtsams te/33—6/ /

ji srid bdag gam gzhan zhi bar mngon par 'dod pa zhi bar gyur pa de srid du zhi ba'i las bya'o/ /rgyas pa la ni de bzhin du phreng ba dang / byug pa dang gos ser po dang / rgyan sna tshogs pa dang ldan pas bzang po'i 'dug stangs dang yid rab tu dga' bas zla ba nya nas brtsams te/ phyi ma'i nya'i bar du ji srid du 1mngon par 'dod pa rgyas par gyur pa de srid du byang du kha bltas te/dga' ba dang ldan pas snga dro'i dus su rgyas pa'i las bya'o/ /mngon spyod la ni khros shing rgyan dang gos sngon po'am/ khrag gis sbags pa'i gos bgos la stan sra ba la lho phyogs su kha bltas te/ bsgrub par bya ba'i gzugs brnyan gyi brang la mnan pa'am/ stan med par rkang pas rkang pa mnan zhing / sos so 'cha' ba dang / mig mi 'gul ba dang / gdong gnyer ma bsnyer ba dang / snying je chen pos dkon mchog gsum la gnod par byed pa'i bdud dang dgra rnams bzlog par bya ba'i phyir/ zla ba mar ngo'i nyin zhag gang yang rung ba la khro bo nyid tshad mar bya ste/ nyi ma gung ngam mtshan phyed la mngon spyod kyi las bya'o/ /dbang la ni khro ba med pa dang / mngon pa'i nga rgyal gred par sems can ma lus pa gdon pa la chags pas gos rgyan dmar po dang ldan pas stan bde ba la rdo rje skyil mo krung du 'dug ste/ kha nub bam byang du bltas la dgug pa la sogs pa'i las bya'o/ /las dang rjes su mthun pa'i tshul gyis phyi rol gyi sprul pa'i me lha 2la bod par bya ste/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas sbya/ngas la de bzlas pa'i chu ku sha'i rtse mos blangs bas skor phyogs su lan gsum bsangs la gtsang zhing skam pa'i rtswa dang bcas pa'i bud shing btsug ༄/la rlung yab kyis 4rlung dang / oṃ dz+wa la hūṃ zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis sbar la/ dam tshig 33—645

sems dpa' thab kyi dbus su bsams nas/ phyag rgya 'di sngags dang bcas pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang bar bya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa mi 'jigs par byas la/ mthe bo'i rtse mo srin lag gi tshigs kyi rtsa bar bzhag la dgug pa'i tshul gyis yang dang yang du bskyod la mngon par 'dod pa'i me'i sngags 'don zhing spyan drang bar bya'o/ /e bye hi ma hā bhū hūṃta de ba ṛ ṣi dī dza sa ta ma/ kṛ hi tā hu gruti ma hā ra smin san+ni hi to bha bā/ oṃ pā —pa ka asna ye swā hā zhi ba la'o/ /rgyas pa la ni de bzhin du/ oṃ ma ten+d+ra asna ye swā hā/ dbang la ni/ oṃ ka ma asna ye swā hā/ mngon spyod la ni/ oṃ kro dha asna ye dza ti tro tra ya hūṃ/ che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ me lha 'ongs pa dang / sngar bshad pa'i bsang gtor gyi cho gas bsangs la mchod yon dbul lo/ /i yo ar+ghaṃ mā yo dat+t+waṃ /ngakṛṇ+ḍi sirnyim+me 5pra yats+tsha swā hā zhes brjod la lag pa gnyis kyis mdun du mchod yon phul la6 /zhabs la zhabs bsil dbul lo/ /spyan drang ba la sogs pa'i cho ga'o / /7 de nas ji skad du bshad pa'i bsrung ba sadang mchod pa la sogs pa byas la/rigs thams cad kyi bdag po nyid du gyur pas/ rje btsun 'jam dpal gyi snying po lan bdun bzlas pa'i mar gyis nye bar gsal bar sbar la/ de'i lce dang dgang gzar dang blug 9—gzar gyi kha la de nyid kyi sa bon rnam par bkod de/brla dang / pus mo gnyis kyi bar du lag pa bcug la dang por blugs gzar gyis mar gyi dgang blugs gsum zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang dbang dang dgug pa'i las la zhal cung zad gdangs par dbul lo/ /mngon spyod la shin tu gdangs/ par dug dang bcas pa'i yungs mar dbul lo/ /gnas skabs 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa/ la 33—646
