par bya ba nus pa yang ma yin no/ /de 'ba' zhig brko ba dang yu ba la dpyangs /te bya'o zhe na/ de yang rigs pa ma yin te/ mtshan ma tsam nyid yid kyis dgod par bya'i 'di bris pas ci zhig bya ste/ bri ba'i cho ga 'di yang yid kyis ma yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la bdag cag rnams 'jug pa ni 'bras bu dang 'dra ba yin pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang bri ba'i cho ga ni brgyad po nyid dgod par rjes su gnang bar mdzad pa yin la/ spro ba ni yid kyi yin pas bcu po spro bar rigs pa de bzhin du rjes su spyad par bya'i nye bar mtshon par bshad pa'i lhag par dgos 2pas ci zhig dgod༄ / dkyil 'khor dag ni 'dri 4ba'i tshe/ /gal te bgegs ni byung gyur na/ /de la gtor ma sbyin la sogs/ /'og nas bshad pas bzlog par bya/ /bgegs ni gzhom par ma nus na/ /mchod yon phul te gshegs gsol la/ /nyi ma gzhan la yo byad rnams/ /legs par bsangs te dkyil 'khor bri/ /de nas khrus byas shing lus dris bsgos pa dang / kha dri zhim pos bsgos la/ me tog gi phreng ba btags shing gos gtsang zhing dri zhim pas stod g.yogs dang / smad g.yogs dang gtsug tor byas pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i me tog gi phreng ba thogs te/ hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags zlos 5shing rdo rje shugs kyis dkyil 'khor du zhugs la dril bu dgrol zhing bskor 6ba lan gsum byas la/ lhag pa dang ma tshang ba'i nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor bltas la phreng ba de bcom ldan 'das la phul te/ slar yang de gar gyis sbyor bas blangs la/rang gi mgo la hūṃ bzhis bcing bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du dkyil 'khor kyi bdag 33—760

po'i nga rgyal du dmigs la/ sngar lhag par gnas par byas pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i hūṃyi ge hūṃ bzlas shing / srad bus mgul pa bcings la phyi rol du ri mo bris pa rdo rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa me tog dkar po dang dri dkar po'i chus yongs su gang ba me tog gi phreng bas bcings pa la snga ma bzhin du bdag po'i sngags dang yi ge hūṃ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa/ rdo rje sems ma naphyag rgyas bzung ba'i me tog gi lcug ma'i rdo rje dang bcas pas badzod ka hūṃ zhes bya ba brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ stong rtsa brgyad bzlas shing lha thams cad kyi sngags bdun bdun bzlas pa dang / gnyis pa las thams cad pa'i bum pa bdud rtsi thab sbyor dang yi ge brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing bdud rtsi thab spyor gyi mtshan mas mtshan pa dang 'jug pa'i sgor bltas par bzhag 4la/ chu des bdag nyid dang slob ma 'jug pa'i tshe/ dbang bskur ba phyag rgya babyung ba dang 'ching du gzhug par bya'o/ /de las gzhan pa'i bum pa bzhi la spyan la sogs pa lha mo bzhi'i rang bzhin dam tshig gi phyag rgyas yongs su bzung ba'i me tog gi phreng bas so sor bzlas shing / de'i mtshan mas mtshan par bya'o/ /de yang de las gzhan pa'i bzhi la lha thams cad kyi mtshan ma des mtshan par bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin du bdag po'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa nyid dang / yid kyis 5legs so zhes bya ba'i spyor bas lha thams cad kyi 'khor lo rang gi bdag nyid kyi nang du chud par byas la/de'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas til dang nas dang ku sha dang / dri dkar po dang me tog dri zhim po dang / tsan+dan gyi chu dung chos kyi nang du bcug nas/ bdag po'i sngags lan bdun bzla ba dang / dri la sogs pa'i mchod nga/ rnam pa lnga rang gi sngags sam yi ge hūṃ yongs su bzla bar bya'o/ /de'i dbus su 'dug nas ni/33—761

rdo rje slob dpon mnyam gzhag ste/ /rdo rje'i sgo ni bzhi po dag /yid kyis rnam par dbye bar bya/ /oṃ badzod gha ṭa tshos ma ya pra be+e sha ya tsū zhes bya ba ni sgo dbye ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis mdzub mo gnyis brkyang la rtse sprad de bzlog nas gnyis su bya ste/ bzlas brjod dang por byas la mtshan thog thag bsgrubs nas 'di dang badz+red 2tiṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor gdeg par bstan par bya'o/ /gnas skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor gdeg pa'i phyag rgya bshad de/ phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis kyi mkhrig ma phan tshun bzung la bteg na mkhrig ma bteg par 'gyur te/ 'di ni sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams ni nub la sogs par 'dug ste/ de bzhin du g.yas brkyang ba la sogs pa'i gnas pas rim gyis blos dbye bar bya'o/ /de nas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa dang / bsang gtor gyi bum pa gnas ji lta ba bzhin du gzhag cing de las gzhan pa'i bum pa rnams phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su rim ༄ —bzhin du gzhag go/ /de'i phyi rol du bum pa gang ba bzhag 4la/ yi ge hūṃ zlos pa'am so so'i rang gi sngags dang /cig car ram/ rim gyis dkyil 'khor pa'i lha'i 'khor lo ma lus pa phyung nas/gnas ji lta ba bzhin du phyag rgya'i gzugs su bcug la/ ye shes 5sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa rdo rje khro bo'i lcags kyu la sogs pas snga ma bzhin du spyan drangs la/ lcags kyu la sogs pas dgug pa la sogs pa bya ste/bgegs bsal ba dang / phur bu dang ra ba la sogs pa byas pas gnas bsrung ba byas la/ pad+ma'i gdan dang mchod yon dang zhabs bsil la sogs pa phul nas sku byin gyis brlab pa 6sogs pa'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs te/ rang 23—762

gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya nye bar bstan la rang gi dbang bskur bas dbang bskur te/lag pa gnyis kyis khu tshur byas la mdzub mo brkyang ste/ mdud pa bya ba ni rdo rje bcing ba'i phyag rgyar 'gyur te/ 'di dang badz+ra maṣ+ṭi 1baṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis kyang dkyil 'khor pa'i lha rnams bcings nas rang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi las la zhugs pa la sgeg mo la sogs pas yang dag pas 2mchod la/ yang dri la sogs pas mchod par bya'o/ /de la ras zung 'bum mam stong ngam brgya'am re re zhing zung re'am/ thams cad la ras re re'am/ bla re dang rgyal mtshan dang / bdugs lkudang / ba dan sna tshogs pa'i yi ge t+t+waṃ dang / bdag po'i sngags bzlas pa dang / badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ las bya ba 'dis dbul bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du oṃ sat+tha ta thā ga ta gadhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra be+e ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis sngar sbyar ba'i ga pur dang / a ka ru dang / tu ru ska 5la sogs pa'i dri tsan+dan la sogs pa dang bsres pa dbul lo/ /de bzhin du o sadze+e ta thā ga ta put+pa 6 pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / me tog gi shing brgya'am/ shing bzhi'am/ me tog thams cad dbul lo/ /oṃ sathru ta thā ga ta dhū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba dang spos snod stong ngam brgya dbul bar bya ste/ bcu las nyung bar ni mi bya'o/ /a khar zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang / swaste ka la sogs par bya ba'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dang myang ba dang / gzhib )pa dang / btung ba'i bshos kyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa grangs stong snyed 4dbul lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dī pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra be+e ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / mar gyi mar me la sogs pa 'bum phrag brgya dang mar me chen po'i snod brgya'am/ mar me chen po bzhi dbul lo/ /33—763

rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi lag pa'i sor mo rnams dang / yi ge hūṃ 'don cing rol mo brdung ba'i tshul du byed pa dang / sil snyan stong ngam brgya'am/ pi wang dang / gling bu la sogs pa thu7 dbul ba dang / gar mkhan dang zlos gar mkhan gyi gar dang / gdu bu dang / rna rgyan dang / cod pan la sogs pa dang / rta dang glang po 2dang / ba lang gi khyu shin tu brtags pa rnams dbul bar bya ba dang / rta babs gos bzang po dang / dril bu dang bcas shing rnga yab dang bcas pa dang / rgyal mtshan dkar po dang / le brgan dang ( /nag po dang / dud ka dang / dmar po dang / khra bo dang / ser po dang /ljang gu ste/ brgyad po shar la sogs par rim pa bzhin phyi rol du bsgreng bar bya'o / /gzhan yang yid kyi rang bzhin gyi mchod pa'i khyad par nam mkha'i gtos thams cad khyab pa rnams kyis kyang dag par mchod la thal mo sbyar te/byin gyis brlabs pa'i rig pa lan gsum brjod nas rdo rje glu rnams kyis yang dag par bstod de/ phyag byas la bzod pa gsol nas dngos grub chothams cad kyi don mdzod cig ces gsol ba btab la sgrub pa'i grogs po dkyil 'khor du bzhag 6ste/ phyi rol du byung ba 7gtor ma byin nas nye reg bya ste / dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa bkan te gung mo dang srin lag cung zad bkug la mngon du phyogs par bzhag (ste/ 'di dag mi smra zhing tsog por 'dug la/ pus mo gnyis kyi bar nas sor mo'i rtses kha la mang du reg par byas la/ rna ba'i bu ga dang / mig dang / sna bug dang / kha dang / dpung mgo dang / lte ba'i phyogs dang / spyi bor lan gnyis sam gsum reg par bya ba ni nye reg gi cho ga'o/ /de nas bdag po la ni brgya rtsa 33—767/

brgyad / dkyil 'khor pa gzhan rnams la ni bdun ri1'og nas bshad pa rgyas pa'i cho gas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /yang na bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'khor lo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thab 2kyi dbus su bsams la/ de'i zhal du spyin sreg byas pa 5lha thams cad kyi zhal du 'bab par bsam par bya ste/ de lta bus ni thams cad tshim par byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dkyil 'khor du zhugs la mngon sum bzhin du bsams te mchod la—/ 'og nas bshad pa'i slob ma 'jug pa'i cho gas 'jug pa la sogs pa dang /tshigs su bcad pa lnga pas rjes su gnang ba dang / gzengs bstod pa dang /lung bstan pa dang / sngags gzungachoba'i mthar thug gi bar du bcom ldan 'das dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje sa rdzogs par mdzad pa dang / bdag nyid kyis kyang slar phyag 'tshal te/ blangs par gyur par rdzogs par byas nas dkyil 'khor du slob ma gzhug par bya ba'i phyir/ bden pa'i byin kyi rlabs 6kyis bsgrag par bya ste/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med byung brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes/ /bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor du / /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni/ /kun gyis dri ma med mthong shog /dam tshig gsum gyis 7glu dang mchod pa byas la gsol ba gdab par bya ste / sems can kun gyis de khyab cing / /sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs / /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod mchog dam tshig mchog gyur pa'o/ /bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 33—765

'khor yin/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ /khyed kyi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs shog /de bzhin du rab tu btud de/ mnyam par bzhag pas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yi/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis ༄1slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /de la re zhig slob dpon du dbang bskur bar 'os pa'i slob mas slob dpon gyi rkang pa gnyis la phyag byas te/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang stsal du gsol/ /yang na 3lag na me tog thogs pa'i slob mas bshags pa dang /rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa byas la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa stsol/ /thub pa'i nyi ma ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/ /slob dpon dbang du gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba/ /mi ldog pa yi 'khor lor 'byor / /thar pa'i rang bzhin grong khyer che/ /gsang ba chen por 'jug par bgyi/ /gsang ba thams cad bsnyus par ni/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug mdzod/ /mi ldog pa yis /—dbang bskur ba/ /skal ba chen po bdag la stsol / /mtshan rnams kun gyis rgyas btab cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sgu ni yid 'ong bsang/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur chen po rmad byung la/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 33—766

la stsol/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rigs thams cad la gsol ba gdab par bya ste—/ che ge zhes bya 'di nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin pa/ /dam tshig mchog dang gsang ba yi/ /'khor lo 'dir ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de nas slob dpon gyis ⑫yang 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ gsang ba chen po'i rigs bdag pa/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /des kyang 'tshal zhes brjod par bya'o/ /yang slob dpon gyes 'di skad ces 3bya ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar gyis/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mor lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba jeg pa gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar gyis/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /gzhan yang bcu bzhi 'di dag ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i be+eng ba 2 shes par bya/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re zhing ni bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor 33—767

pa / /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo / /'dod la logs ༄1pas mi spyad cing / /brdzun du smra 2bar mi bya'o/ /phung krol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya / /sems can gdul phyir ma rtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang //dam pa nye bar brten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las be+e rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi rnams dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus bar ni rjes su skyong / /jeg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang yang mi spong 5/ /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba la/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon bya dang / /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /des kyang 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa nas/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod / /ces bya ba'i bar du brjod par bya'o/ /gang zhig sdom pa 'dzin par mi byed pa de la/ deng khyod ces bya ba la sogs pa brjod par mi bya ste/slob dpon du rjes su gnang ba dang dbang bskur bar yang mi bya'i/ 'jug pa tsam zhig byed du gzhug go/ /de nas khrus byas shing dri bzang po la sogs pas kyang brgyan la/ yi ge hūṃ bzlas pa'i gos dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dang / gtsug tor dang / gdong g.yogs byas la/ oṃ sat+tha yo ga 33—768

tsit+ta a da yā mi zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed nas su/ /de yi snying gar snying pos ni/ /rdo rje rab tu gzhag par bya/ /su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsidhe ༄1badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur cigazhe /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba 'di/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen por ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar ma byed cig /dad pa zumi ldan pa rnams la yang ma yin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rab tu yon phul ba'i slob ma de la dri la sogs pas mchod de/ me tog gi phreng ba gdags shing /kha dri zhim pos bsgos pa la phyi rol na gnas pas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur nas/dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rjer byen gyis brlabs la/ oṃ dzi na dzika ces bya ba la sogs pa'i snying po dang / sku la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyag rgya la sogs pas byen kyis brlabs nas/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mdzub mo dkri ba dang /badz+ra ka ba tsa baṃ hūṃ zhes brjod la/ dpral ba dang sgog ma dang / snying ga dang dpung mgo ste/ gnas lngar go cha byas nas rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgyas bzung ba'i me tog dang yi ge hūṃ bzlas pa nyid kyis sgor gnas par byas la/ shar la sogs pa'i sgo nas rdo rje be+egs kyu la sogs pas dgug pa la sogs pa byas nas yang 4phyogs kyi sgo nyid nas tshigs su bcad pa 'dis gzhug par bya'o/ /rdo rje ye shes 'thob lhabyed pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /pho brang dkyil 'khor snying po 'dir6/ /bdag gis sheslob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /ā 8khaṃ bī ra hūṃ zhes bya bas slob ma dkyil 'khor du zhugs par byas nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su 33—769

zhugs kyisna/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du 'grub pa yang 'thob na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par byas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la ma smra shig khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon rang nyid kyis sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya kha thur du bstan pa dang gyen du bstan pa bcings la/ rdo rje slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag thuste/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni khyod kyi rdo rje dam tshig yin kyis/ gal te 'di 'ga' zhig la smras na klad /pa 'gems par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya de nyid dang mna'i snying po 'di lan cig bzlas la slob ma de 'thung du bcug la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa yan te r+ya/ z-i rted ye sa ma basbi ta/ nir bhir+ya/ tata dak+ṣa khaṃ/ ya yād ya di bru yata/ i saṃ na ya 5/ de nas 'thung du gzhug go/ /dam tshig gi chu ga phur kye dang /tsan+dan la sogs pa dang ldan pa rdo rje phra rab kyi rang bzhin bdag po'i sngags dang yi ge hūṃ bzlas pa/ slob ma yang bsam pa brtan por byas te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ste/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung 7shig /oṃ badz+red ka ṭha/ rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /gal te dkyil 'khor ma mthong smra/ /skye bo 'dus pa'i nang gnas sam/ /dad pa med pas bgad par byed/ /deng nas brtsams te khyed kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /mi bde ba ma spangs pas khyed dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ de nas yi ge a 33—770

—dmar po 'od zer dang bcas pa rang gi snying gar bkod la/ slob ma yang yi ge hūṃ gis rmyerdul dang bral zhing dag pa ri'ajam pa'i rdo rje hūṃ t+t+waṃ dhīḥkhaṃ zhes bya bas/snying ga dang mdzod sru dang sgog ma spyi bo rnams su rdo rje dang rin po che dang /pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang ldan pa la/ sgo glegs dbye ba'i phyag rgyas rang gi snying ga dang slob ma'i snying ga phye la/ rang gi snying ga nas yi ge a phyung la/slob ma'i snying gar gnas pa'i rdo rje'i dbus su blos bcug la/ de'i lus kun du gang bar bsams la/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs 4la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig ces smṛs shig /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyes myur du sems ma rdo rje ma'i 3phyag rgya bcings la/ de'i snying gar bzhag 6ste 'di skad ces brjod du gzhug go/ /'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med 'di/ /de ring nyid du 'bab par shog /badz+ra ā be+e sha aḥ7/bcu nyi shu sum cu bzhi bcu/ lnga bcu drug cu bdun cu brgyad cu dgu bcu brgya'i bar du brjod na nges par 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang gal te 'bab par ma gyur na/ de'i tshe rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya khro bo'i khu tshur gyis phye la/rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge a'i mtha' can brgya'i bar du brjod par bya'o/ /gal te de lta na yang 'bab par ma gyur na/ /de'i tshe rdo rje 'bebs pa dril bu dang bcas pa bcings la/ rkang pa g.yon pas slob ma'i rkang pa g.yas pa mnan la/dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i steng du rnam par snang mdzad khros pas de la dbab 8par bya ba'i phyir 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams 'bab par mdzad pa dang / 'og tu yang yi ge hūṃ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis bteg 9par gyur la/ mi bskyod pa 33—771

la sogs pa rim bzhin rang gi phyogs na bzhugs pas/ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hūṃtweḥ.aḥzhes bya ba'i sa bon rnams las 'od zer gyi tshogs yang dag par 'bebs par gyur par bsams la/ badz+ra satwa/ aḥ'e.aḥ.aḥzhes bya ba lan brgya'i bar du brjod par bya'o / /gal te sdig pa chen po dang ldan pas de lta bu byas kyang 'bab par —ma gyur na/ de'i tshe spyig pa dral ba'i phyag rgyas sdig pa dral la hūṃ a zhes bya ba lan mang du bzla'o/ /rdo rje bcing ba bsdam byas te/ /gung mo gnyi ga sbyar nas ni//tha ma bzhi ni rtse mo sbyar/ /sdig pa 'joms par grags pa yin/ /zhes bya ba ni sdig pa 'joms pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi sgo ṭa ya/ sat+tha pā pa ya/ban+dha na ni pra mok+ṣa ya sat+tha pā pa ga ti bh+yaḥsat+tha satā / na sadz+dza ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya traṭa ces bya ba ni sngags so/ /yang na de bzhin du 'bab par gyur zhes brjod la/de'i snying gar yi ge hūṃ dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / haṃ chu'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / yi ge a lus dang ngag la gnas pa dang /rkang pa'i 'og tu yi ge dz+nyo ltasbar bar byed pa rlung dang me la gnas pa rnam par bkod la/ ā be sha ya ste bha ra ra 6tsa la ya tsa la ya hūṃ ha ā dz+nyo 3zhes bskul na 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /yang na yi ge oṃ gyis de'i spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad ji lta ba bzhin du bsam pa dang / yi ge āḥlas sgog mar 'od dpag tu med nga/ hūṃ las snying gar mi bskyod depa yi ge'am9/ rang gi ngo bor skul bar byed pa dang / rkang pa'i 'og tu yang yi ge yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can / mtha' gnyis su ba dan btags pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum de la slob ma skul byed ma'i gzugs su bsams te bzhag sal/ rdo rje 'bar ba rnams kyis kun du bsreg par gyur par bsgoms 33—772

—kyis dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi sbyor ba'am/ dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sbyor ba 1bya'o/ /babs nas mngon par shes pa lnga la sogs pa'i mtshan ma skad cig de nyid la 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i lce sna.a dmar bo bsams la/ bru hi badz+ra zhes brjod na/ dge ba'am mi dge ba thams cad ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas mngon par 'dod pa thams cad dris la dbab pa brtan par bya ba sngon du 'gro bas yang dag par mchod cing / babs pa'i lha ji lta ba bzhin gshegs su gsol lo/ /dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa na khyed kyi mig gis ji ltar mthong zhes dris la/ dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / nag po la sogs pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor snang ba las rim — bzhin du mchog gi don zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / mngon spyod kyi dngos grub kyi snod du gyur par shes nas 'jug pa'i phyag rgya snying gar bcings pa bkrol 7la dbab te 5/tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ rnyo me bha ba/ shā 6shwa to me bha ba/ z-i hūṃd yi me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sadz+dza sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sadze+e kadz+re su tsa rnge/ cit+t+waṃ gre yi ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥzhes brjod pas brtan par byas la/ yi ge hūṃ gi phreng ba de/ yi ge t+t+waṃ (rkegis byin gyis brlabs te/ dkyil 'khor du dor la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥde la gong 1 du babs par gyur pa'i lha de de la 'grub par 'gyur ro / /de nas phreng ba de mgo bor bcings la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /pra ti kṛṇ+ḍa twa mi mo/ satwa ma hā ba la/ de nas snying gar bdag po/ mig tu oṃ dpral ba gebasams la 'dis gdong g.yogs dgrol 15bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa swa yadhe/ tsaṣ+peṅgha ṭa na —snatat+pa ra/ uṅgha ṭa ya da thusadrwa sgo badz+ra tsak+ṣu a nut+ta re/ de ring dad pa'i shugs kyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la blta bar 33—77— 4

kyis / /sangs rgyas gdung gi rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu 'gyur bar byed/ /rdo rje pad mchog rol pa dang / /gsang sngags rnams ni mnyes par kyis/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ dkyil 'khor gdegs 1pa'i phyag rgya dang / /sngags su bcad zu pas dkyil 'khor bteg la/ dkyil 'khor bstan par bya ste/ bsod nams dang / byin gyi rlabs — ji lta ba la dkyil 'khor bteg pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa gshin rje gshegs 3 las brtsams te/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gyi mthar thug pa'i bar gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad bstan par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje 55slob dpon la/ /yon ni mang du phul nas su/ /tshigs su bcad pas phyag byas nas/ /dbang bskur bar khuni gsol ba gdab/ /byang chub rdo rje 3sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba bzhin/ /bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag spyod/ /slob dpon gyis kyang de dbang bskur bar bya ba'i phyir rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du khru gnyis dor bar/ shar sgor mngon par bltas pa dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad la rim pa gnyis pa/ zur bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor bris la/de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze ba dang bcas pa bri/ snam bu'i shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri bris pa/ slob ma lus shin tu khrus byas shing dri dang bdug pa dang / phreng ba la sogs pa dang yang dag par ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa der bzhag 9la/ sbyang ba'i cho ga bya ste/ 'phags pa bdud rtsi thab spyor bzlas pa'am/ yi ge hūṃ 33—775

bzlas pa'i yungs kar khu tshur g.yas dang g.yon gyis bzung bas rim pa bzhin du lan gnyis gnyis dang rang gi logs nas bskor te/ kham phor gyi me'i 1nang du dor la yang khu tshur de gnyis kyis cig car g.yas nas bskor te/ de bzhin du sbyang ba byas la/ yungs kar mer dor ba dang lag pa g.yas dang g.yon gyis de bzhin du chu sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas gnyis ka la yang nye reg bya'o//de nas slob dpon bdag nyid dang slob ma bsrung ba byas la/ rigs kyi gruyum bzlas pa'i dris byugs pa dang / de nyid bzlas pa'i me tog gi phreng bas mgo bo dkris la/ rigs kyi snying pos mchod yon byin te/ mar dang bcas pa'i sa rdza ra sa'i spos la bdud rtsi thab spyor bzlas pa'am/ yi ge hūṃ bzlas pas bdug par bya'o/ /nges par sbyong triba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas 'jam pa'i rdo rjer byas la rang nyid kyis sngags dang phyag rgya dang lha'i 'khor lo ma lus pa gnas ji lta ba bzhin du bkod la rdo rje sems ma la sogs pas byin gyis brlab cing sku la sogs pa 5byin gyis brlabs la phyag rgya chen por rab tu bzhag 6ste/ steng du bla re bre ba dang / g.yas logs su yi ge hūṃ bzlas pa'i me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa'i rin po che'i gdugs dang /g.yon du nam mkha'i mdzod bzlas pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / rnga yab dang ba dan sna tshogs pa dang / me tog la sogs pa dang sgeg mo la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/ mchod yon byin la dung dang rnga bo che dang / rnga rings dang /zangs dung la sogs pa'i sil snyan rnams kyis nam mkha'i ngos rnams kun du gang bar bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol ba dang / phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum 33—776

spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis de ni skye dgu zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yis 1nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin kyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par brtul ba yongs ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dgyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis de ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' 3lha yi/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lhas bskor ba yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis de ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' ludza'i tshal/ /lha mang dag gis brten par mgon po bltams pa na/ /srid pa'i mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis de ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /lhums nas bltams pa ston pa bde gshegs zas gtsang sras/ /myur bskrun 4bdud rtsi'i chus gtor ba yi bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis de 5ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya ba ni/ /rmad du byung ba grags pa che ba'i lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam yas dge bsgrubs bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis de ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /33—777

dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer mchog nas mngon byung ste/ /dka' thub tshal du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis de tshoni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /be+e ḍūr+ya ltar sngo ba'i rtswa rdubating steng bzhugs te/ /skyil mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis de ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /chu bo'i 'gram na tsa sha phreng gis yongs bskor ba/ /shin tu rmad du byung ba srid pa sel mdzad pa/ /klu yi rgyal pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis de ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis zubadud kyi phyogs//mang po btul tshe sa stengs chodang ni nam mkha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/ /bkra shis de phyeni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi tho rangs bdud bzhi po rnam rab thubatul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis de dzini skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer wā rā ṇa sīr 8drang srong mchog bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang / /lha yul dang 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa/ /bkra shis de 9ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag byed pa/ /bsod nams bya byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa / /bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /bkra shis de 7 ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mu stegs byed pa kun gyi kyi nga rgyal gzhom pa dang / /'gro la bde ba skyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag /nye bar ston pa rgyal 33—778

ba'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis de tsho ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir mtho ris nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis de phyani skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba mchog tu nyer gshegs pa/ /man+d+ra ra bas me tog mang 4pos mngon mchod pa/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis de a+yoni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lha dang klu dang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu ldan kyi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis de ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang glu blangs la de seng ge'i gdan nam khri la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dar gyis g.yogs pa yi ge hūṃ bzlas pa la bzhag 'u ste dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /dang por ni rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pas so/ /de nas ni lha mo bzhi'i bum pa dang /lha thams cad kyi bum pas re re zhing rang gi sngags zlos shing dbang bskur ro/ /de ltar phyi'i dbang bskur ba byin nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga las byung ba'i 'od kyi tshogs kyis phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / rig pa'i lha mo rnams slob ma dbang bskur bar bya ba'i phyir yang dag par bsgul la/7/ sngar smras pa'i tshigs su bcad pas 'di la stsal du gsol 8 zhes/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la gsol ba btab pas sngon gyi phan par mdzad pa dang / thugs rje chen po'i shugs kyis nam mkha'i gtos thams cad til gyi gang bu ltar gang bar 9byon nas/33—779

gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gos dang / sil snyan dang rol mo la sogs pa'i dbang bskur ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad dang ldan pa rnams dang / rig pa'i lha mo pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i bum pa phyag na bsnams pa rnams kyis phyag gi rtse mo mchog gis slob ma rnams la/ dbang bsgur ba ni rdo rje che/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / sngags kyis dbang bskur bar gyur par bsam 3༄par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / lha mo de nas rnguslob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga rnams su zhugs pas lus thams cad de'i rang bzhin du byas te/ mi bskyod pa cod pan gyi tshul gyis gnas par bsam ju par bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba lnga po sngar bshad pa nyid kyi sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas bstan ④par bya'o / /de nas go cha bskon la dar dpyangs 'phyang ba dang mnyam pa'i thal mos dgab par sabyas la/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba dang / bdag po'i dbang bskur ba dang / ming gi dbang bskur ba dang / dam tshig gsum yang sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pas sbyin par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dngos grub kyi rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin no/ /slob mas kyang rdo rje thal mo bskor bas slar phyag byas la/dbang bskur ba blang bar bya'o/ /de nas yang dag par bstod ri snal sgeg mo la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas gar sngon du 'gro ba dang / sgeg pa dang bcas pas slob ma de la khā su zhes bya ba dang me tog cig 'phangs la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de'i sras lhan cig rol par kyis/ /rdo rje bsnyems pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dga' ba'i mchod pa bde mchog yin/ /aḥsgeg bcas phreng ba 'phen pa dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad 33—780

mchod par gyis/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin pas/ /'di dang 'bral ba med par gyis/ /oṃ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /yang dag brjod pa glu ru blang / /de ni myur bar bde gshegs de'i/ /bde ba nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ /gī thal mo gar bcas phul ba yis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mnyes par gyis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i las/ /rol mos gar ni byed por 1'gyur/ /hoḥbadug spos phul bas sdogs sangs rgyas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos cher tshim gyis/ /'gro la bde gshegs 'bab pa dang / /ye shes kyis ni tshim par 'gyur—/ /aḥme tog gtor bas sdogs sangs rgyas/ /slar yang byang chub yan lag bsags/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /rgyu 2rdo rje chos ltar rang nyid kyis/ /chos kyi me ni legs sbar la/ /ma rig ldongs byas sems can rnams/ /ye shes snang bas bsal bar gyis/ /sum̐ rgyal ba 4khyod kyis dril phul bas/ /lus can rnams la byang chub bskor/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yin/ /gaḥde nas bdag po'i spyor ba dang ldan pas gser gyi thur ma bzlas pa blangs la/ mdun du 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis 5ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ne+e tra a pa ha ra ti mi ram̐ hriḥslob ma'i mig gnyis su yi ge pra bsams la byug par bya'o/ /de nas mre long bstan la/ chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan par bya'o/ /chos rnams kazugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal 6la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med 33—781

gnas med par/ /de ltar chos 'di shes nas su/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skyes/ /de nas dbyangs kyi yi ge tha ma las byung ba'i dril bu dkrol la byin te/ /chos rnams nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de / /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yis / /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /de nas yi ge hos gzhu byin la/'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyis shig ces brjod de/ phyogs bzhir mda' bzhi 'phang bar bya'o/ /gcig ni steng du'o/ /gcig ni 'og tu'o/ /yang aḥbadz+ra satwa zhes bya ba 'dis me long blangs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag por hūṃbyang chub kyi sems ni 'di yin par shes par gyis shig ces brjod par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra he tu mo zhes bya ba dang / rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du chos kyi 'khor lo gzhag /oṃ badz+ra bha 2ṣa ram̐ zhes bya ba dang / lag pa g.yas su dung dbyangs kyi yi ge dang pos lag pa g.yon du glegs bam dang / dbyangs kyi yi ge tha mas dril bu byin la / de nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 5 cig /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /spyob pa rnams kyis ༅'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pas/ /kun du ma lus gang bar gyis/ /som nyi yid gnyis mi bya zhing / /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ /gsang sngags spyad pa'i tshul gyi mchog /'jig rten 'di la rab tu sgrogs/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan thogs 7drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun 33—782

kyang / /kun du khyod la srung bar byed/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'khor los thu)sgyur ba'i sbyor ba ji lta ba dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du rdo rje dang /khro bo dang / pad+ma dang / nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhes tshigs su bcad pa lngas rjes su gnang ba byin la/ gzengs bstod pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po rgyur gyur pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid kyi spyor bas snying gar g.yon pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur gyis chos gos kyi tha ma 'dzin pa'i tshul du byas la g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa la/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas lung bstan par bya'o—/ /oṃ e sho haṃ/ byā ka ro mi two badz+ra satwa ta thā ga ta bha ba dur ga ti to bye t+yān+ta bha ba sidha ye he badz+ra nā ma lceta thā ga ta sin+ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bhur ju ba swaḥgang la gzengs bstod pa 'di dang / phyag rgya chen pos lung bstan pa mchog tu gsang ba'i cho gas byas pa de la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rang gi dam tshig keslob dpon la mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad do/ /'di lta ste/ gzengs bstod pa 'di nyid dang phyag rgya chen pos mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyi byin gyis brlab chopa 'di dang / gsang sngags kyi stobs la dad par bya'o zhes slob ma rnams la brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor du gsang ba brjod par bya ste/'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod 33—783

la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis kyang ni ma byed cig /ma hā sa ma ya ha na phaṭa/de'i 'og tu rang gi lag pa g.yon pas slob ma'i mthe bo g.yas pa bzung la/ slob ma'i gtso bo la dmigs nas mar gyi sreg 3blugs bya ba dang / sbrang rtsi dang mar dang zho dang bsres pa'i til kyi sreg blugs brgya byas la/ bsang gtor byas te snying gar byugs la las thams cad pa dang / rigs kyi snying po bzlas pa'i srung 2 sgud dang / gdu bu lag ngar du gdags par bya'o/ /de nas de'i mgo bor gdugs bzhag la/ skor ba byed du bcug ste/ thal mo sbyar ba dang bcas par dkyil 'khor gyi sgor gdugs dang bcas par lus phab la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /slob ma 'di ni phul ba lagasatshu/ /gsang sngags rgyud ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /gdugs bzhag nas ni slob dpon gyis/ /snying la 'bab pa de la brjod/ /da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /gsang sngags rgyud kyang 'dzin par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis bkur bar 'gyur/ /sems can kun la snying brtse'i phyir/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /nan tan bskyed de bri bar gyis/ /sgrub pa po yang rgyud la spyor/ /de nas rang nyid kyis lan brgya bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i sngags phyag rgya dang ldan par slob ma la byin la/ bcom ldan kye'adi la stsal lags kyis6/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis7 / /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes rim sabazhin du slob dpon dang slob ma dag gis sngags bsgul la smra bas byin la/ dkyil 'khor du bzlas la lha rnams kyi phyag rgya bzhi yang bslabs la/ khyod kyis gzhan phyag rgya la mi mkhas pa gang la yang phyag rgya rnams ston par ma byed cig /de 33—784

ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can de rnams ni dkyil 'khor ma mthong bar phyag rgya bcing ba la rab tu spyor ba las 'bras bu ma thob pa dang som 1nyir gyur nas ya nga ba ma spangs pas dus byas nas dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyu des na rngu ji ltar zhugs pa rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa la sogs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba sbyin par bya ste/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni / /mthong ba dang ni zhugs gyur pas/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol zhing / /khyed rnams de 1 nyid legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di las ni/ /slar 'chi ba ni yod min te/ /mi shigs pa dang mi sod pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod bton/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /dam tshig sdom pa grub pa 'di/ /rtag tu khyod kyis bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems kyang gtang mi bya/ /phyag rgya rdo rje gang yin pa'o/ /de ring phan chad bu khyod kyis/ /srog dang rus pa la bab kyang / /dam pa'i chos dang byang chub sems/ /slob dpon dag kyang brnyas mi bya/ /gdug la byams dang chags bral bar/ /nam yang bya ba ma yin no/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas kyis/ /khyod ni dmyal ba'i me nang 'dor/ /bdag nyid yongs su spangs nas su/ /dka' thub kyis kyang ma gdungs shig /ci bde bar ni bde bar gzung / /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams / /nam yang yongs su mi dor zhing / /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas kun mtshungs bla ma yi/ /slob 33—785

dpon la ni gang smod tupa/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun smad pas/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob 'gyur te/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug nad/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang / /gdon dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad 3 nas sems can dmyal ltung 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dbon blo gros che/ /dge la — rab tu mi spyom pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis sbyin par bya/ /des na rims sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rang gi dam tshig slob dpon ni/ /sbyin min bu dang chung ma dang / /rang srog gis rtag bsten bya na/ /longs spyod g.yo ba smos ci dgos/ /gang phyir bskal pa bye bar ni/ /grangs med par rnyed dka' ba yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang brtson ldan la/ /tshe 'di nyid la ster bar byed/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung / /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /slob dpon gyi ni yon tan bzung / /skyon rnams nams kyang ma yin no/ /yon tan bzung bas dngos grub cing / /skyon rnams kyis ni dngos grub nyams/ /de yi grib ma 'gom pa ni/ /mchod rten bshig dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i gsang ba pa/ /dam pa thams cad spangs par 'gyur/ /slob dpon smod par byed pa dag /rmi lam du yang mthong mi bya/ /slob dpon smad pa gang yin te/ /bgegs dang log 'dren rnams kyis gzung 4/ /gtum po'i las byed ngan pa'i bdag /mkhas pas 33—786

rtag tu spang bar bya/ /mnar med la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /dmyal ba bstan pa gang yin pa/ /der ni slob dpon smad byed pa/ /gnas par 'gyur zhes rab tu gsungs/ /de phyir kun gyis rab bsgrims te/ /bsam yas 'bras bu sbyin byed pa/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yi/ /sems can dad pas de mchod cig /gang phyir 'di ni legs gnas pas/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /dam tshig lha rnams kun mnyam par/ /deng khyod gyur par the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pa/ /kun gyi deng khyod dbang bskur bas/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal po che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por bstan pa yin/ /deng ni bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ /khyed rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /deng 'dir thob par je tshom med/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad kyis/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /dam tshig 'di ni 'da' dka' ste/ /sdig pa med kyis ma 'jigs shig /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde bskyed bsten par gyes/ /deng ni 'gro la myur bde rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rab tu mnyam zhing rtag pa nyid du rtogs par 'gyur/ /slob ma rab dang mnyes gshin pas/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin bdag ni bkyid ces brjod/ /de ltar na mdor bsdus pa dang bar ma dang rgya che ba'i dbang bskur ba'i dbye ba ni 'dir ma thos te/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i cho ga gcig pu nyid thob 3snapa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na yang mkhan po'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa'i 'phags pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga'i rim pa sarjes su 'brangs nas gsum du bya bar 33—787

'dod par bya'o/ /spyi'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /gzhan yang 1dpon du dbang bskur bar 'os pa'i slob ma la/ de bzhin du khrus dang gos dang rgyan la sogs pas brgyan la dam tshig gsum sbyin pa'i mthar thug pa'i cho ga byas la/ dkyil 'khor du mngon par phyogs par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag grul/ slob dpon gyis 3dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang / lha'i de kho na nyid dang / slob dpon gyi las rnams bshad par bya ste/ de nyid de'i slob dpon gyis thudabang bskur ba'i gnas yin no/ /'di dag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba yin par gsungs so/ /de nas tshigs su bcad pa lnga pas rjes su gnang ba byin la/ gzengs bstod pas lung bstan par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid ni 'di yin te/ mi mnyam med pas zur bzhir mnyam/ /dran dang dbang pos sgo bzhi ste/ /bsam gtan rnams kyis rta babs bzhi/ /ting 'dzin khyams su shes par bya/ /khyams la brten pa'i rdo rje mchog /gzungs rnams lha mos mchod pa yin/ /rgyan rnams kun kyis bkra ba yang / /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o/ /gdul bas bskyod pa sna tshogs mchog /dam chos sgra ni kun 'gro ba/ /rlung gis 5bskyod pa'i sna tshogs mchog /dar 'phan dril bu sgrogs pa yin/ /me long ye shes btags 5me tog /byang chub yan lag me tog phreng / /dra ba me long btags 7me tog /me tog chun 'phyang rgyan gyis bskor/ /kun grub mi zad bde ba ste/ /bde ba chen po zhes bshad de/ /de yi nang gi 'khor lo de/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad pa 'dra ba ni/ /dngos grub bde ba kun ster ba'i/ /rnam thar brgyad po de nyid yin/ /byang chub sems ni theg pa che/ /mdo sde 'khor 33—788

lo rab bskor bas/ /rdo rje'i thig gis yongs bskor ba'i/ /rdo rje 'khor lo yin par bshad/ /'gro la ye shes kyi lkuchags pas/ /tshon ni sgogs sangs rgyas lnga yin/ /dbang po'i don ni rnam dag pa/ /rang gi mtshan nyid rab dbye nyid/ /shes rab ye shes bdud rtsi 'thung / /rdo rje can gyi bum pa de/ /tshogs rdzogs pa yi rgyu mthun zhing / /thugs rje'i rlan ldan bum pa gang / /dkyil 'khor gang du me tog spos/ /mar me ched 2dang drir bshad pa/ /byang chub yan lag yid rab tshim/ /chos kyi snang grags tshogs bsdus yin/ /chos kyi zas ni lha bshos te/ /ngo tsha khrel yod pa yang gos/ /glu dang gar dang rol mo mchog /bde ba chen po'i 'phel byed yin/ /grong khyer thar pa'i grong khyer pas / /dkyil 'khor snying po bsdus pa yin/ /de ltar spros pas mdzes pa ni//pha rol phyin sogs 'bras bu yin/ /lha'i de ༄/kho na nyid kyang dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni shes rab kyi ye shes snang bar mdzad pa'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /slob dpon gyi ni las rnams kyang / /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgya ni/ /cho ga bzhin bcings zhugs nas kyang / /sgo ṭa'i phyag rgyas dbab par bgyi/ /de la thams cad dbab pa'i snying po ni 'di lags so / /aḥbadag la byin gyis brlabs la sogs/ /ji lta bar ni bka' mnod do / /de ltar bgyis nas bdag ming brjod/ /de nas rdo rje bsgrub 5par bgyi / /rdo rje slob dpon sems dpa' yi/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bcings nas ni//se gol mang po brdab bgyis la/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bgyi/ /de tshe sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /rdo rje sems la sogs bcas pa6/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad gang ba rnams/ /dkyil 'khor rnams su 'dus par 'gyur/ /33—789

de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom ① byed cing / /ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /lan cig bar du brjod par bgyi/ /de nas 'dus pa dgyes pas na/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams brtan par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang grub pa/ /grogs po nyid du nye bar gnas/ /de nas sgo rnams thams cad du/ /lcags kyu la sogs las bgyis nas/ /las chen mchog gi phyag rgya yis/ /dam tshig rnams ni bzhag gepar bgyi/ /dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgya dang / /sems dpa'i rdo rje la sogs pas/ /de ltar byang chub —chen po bsgrub④/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod cing / /de nas sangs rgyas la sogs pa//sems dpa' chen po kun bsdu bar/ /spyan drangs nas ni rab tu bzhugs rgya/ /bcings nas de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas ⑥mnyes bgyis la/ /sems can don kun bsgrub pa'i phyir / /thams cad mdzod ces gsol bar bgyi/ /'di ni gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /slob ma gzhan dag ni ji lta ba bzhin du bcug ste/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa rdo rje sems ma la sogs pa dang / rang gi lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas kyang rang gi lhag pa'i lhar byin gyis brlabs la phyag rgya chen pos sngar bshad pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhag kluste/ spos la sogs pas mchod yon sbyin bye/te/dang po kho nar chu/ de nas phyag rgya cod pan dar dpyangs dang / rdo rje dang bdag po dang / ming gi dbang bskur sh+yi la sgeg mo la sogs pas kyang yang dag par mchod de/ sngags byin la rang gi lha'i phyag rgya bzhi snga ma bzhin bstan nas slob ma re re nas bzung ⑫ste/ blugs gzar gyis de rnams kyi spyi bo nas bskor 33—790

—zhing phab ste/ dgang blugs bdun phul la bsang zhing byabs la lag par gdu bu gdags par bya'o/ /'di ni thun mong gi 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dri 2la sogs pa dang / sgeg mo la sogs pas kyang dkyil 'khor pa rnams yang dag par mchod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la ci nus par mchod cig ces slob ma rnams la bsgo la/ mchod pa byed du bcug nas ji ltar zhugs pa rnams /— yang bza' ba dang btung ba spyod pa la sogs pa thams cad dang / mgon po la phul ba rnams kyis kun du tshim par byas nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rdo rje'i brtul zhugs byen la / de rnams dang lhan cig mtshan mo nyal bar bsgom pa dang bzlas pa byas la/yang su la yang smra bar mi ④byed cig thams cad la bsgo la bla mas yon blang bar bya'o / /de nas chung ma sdug pa dang / /rin chen gser ni 'bar ba dang / /nor bu mu tig byu ru dang / /lus kyang sbyin par bya ba yin/ /slob mas bla ma la gus pas/ /ci nas 'di ltar bya ba ste/ /ji ltar bla ma mgu bar bya/ /bla ma mgu bas dngos grub kyi/ /gzhan du min zhes thub pas gsungs/ /de nas bzhin bzangs longs la/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ci rigs pa rdzogs par gyis la/ gang gis ring po mi thogs pa kho nar lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi ston par 'gyur ba de ltar gyis shig ces snying la 'bab pa'i tshig brjod la slob ma gtang 3bar bya'o/ /de nas me thab kyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor chen po'i bdag po dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor lo rnam par bsams la/rgyas pa'i cho gas mar gyi dgang blugs brgya phul la/ zhi ba'i cho gas kyang mar kyi 6dgang blugs brgya phul te/ yang dag par bstod la mchod pa thams cad kyis 33—79/

yang dag par mchod de phyogs kyi gtor ma byin la phyag byas te/ mchod yon phul la dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngos te snga ma bzhin du phyag rgya dgrol tub la sogs pa snyerdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya bcings la dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol la/ ji ltar sprul pa'i tshogs kyang rang gi lus kyi nang du chud par byas la/a kā ro mu khaṃ sathru dhas+thā shā ār+ya bye nut+pan+da tāta ces brjod la/ de'i don la lhag par mos shing yi ge hūṃ dang dkyil 'khor 'phyag par bya'o/ /'bad pas tshon rtsi bsdus nas ni/ /chu chen dag tu dor bar bya/ /dor nas kyang ni sa gzhi de/ /ba yi lci bas byug par bya/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra khri lota shī la ya sadze+e tī dze+e/ bud+dhā sabye na badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā ya hūṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ zhes bya ba'i rdo rje phur pa'i 5sngags kyis bsam gtan las byung ba'i phur bu phyung la seng ldeng las byung ba'i phur bu zhi ba'i rig pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i 'o ma'am spos chus bkrus nas bu ga yang dgang bar bya'o / /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs/ mdzub mo gnyis zlum por byas te/lag ngar brkyang la skam pa lta bur bya ba ni/ phur bu dbyung ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid dang slob ma dang / sa'i bdag po dang / sems can thams cad la dmigs te zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni yo byad rnams / /thams cad slob dpon dbang bar bshad/ /slob mas cung zad bskur 7mi bya/ /gal te khyer na dam tshig nyams/ /slob dpon gyis kyang ci rigs par/ /bdag nyid 'dod pas spyad par trebya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal sgyu 'phrul dra bas gsungs so/ /thams cad du yang dkyil 'khor dang /sbyin sreg la sogs pa rtsom 7pa na/ gang gi tshe slob dpon gyi ༄8phyi rol du 'gro na/33—792

de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa gshin rje gshed sngar bshad pa'i rang gi ngo bor rang gi snying ga nas rang gi sa bon las nges par byung ba/ gdug pa'i bgegs ma lus pa 'dul ba la 'jug pa lha dang mi ma dang ba rnams dang bar mdzad pa/ dang ba rnams slar yang 'phel bar mdzad pa ste/ mdor na de ni sems can thams cad kyi mngon par mi 'dod pa zlog ri1snapar mdzad cing /mngon par 'dod pa rdzogs par mdzad pa/ ma tshang ba'i nyes pa rnams sel bar mdzad pa/ khro bo mtha' yas pas kun du bskor ba hā hā zhes bzhad pas ri bo chen po dang / rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor 'khrugs par mdzad pas/ nam mkha'i gtos thams cad khyab par bsam par bya'o/ /de lta bu ni gang gi tshe slob dpon nang na gnas pa de'i tshe phyi rol na bzhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /bri ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o/ /snga ma bzhin du bdag po'i sbyor ba 'di nyid dang ldan pas sa yongs su gzung ba'i cho ga la sogs pa thams cad nas dbang bskur ba dang / slob ma slar btang ba dang / zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi bar du yid kyis byas te/ yid kyis phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgya cher bya'o/ /yang na de bzhin du bdag po'i rnal 'byor pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bsreg pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / gzhal yas khang bskyed la de'i nang du zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan ci rigs par pad+ma la gnas par bsams la/slob ma me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i 2mes thal bar byas la/ rang gi sngags kyi bdag nyid can du sna bug g.yas pa nas bcug ste/ rang gi sa bon gyi yi ge las bskyed pa/ sna bug cig shos nas phyung ste/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus 33—793

ma la gzhag 1ste/ sku la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs la bdag po'i sbyor bas gnas par 2rang gi phyag rgya'i rig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pa rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje lte ba la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ yongs su gyur pa dang / dkyil 'khor pa'i lha'i 'khor lo ma lus par bsams la mthar rang gi phyag rgya'i bde ba chen po'i mer yang dag par zhugs pas/ de nyid zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs kyis 4phyung la/ gnas ji lta ba na gnas pa'i lha ma lus pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor zhing dkyil 'khor kyi bdag po'i spyor bas gnas pa la snga ma bzhin du yi ge gsum gyis 5brlabs pa dang / hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo bzhi bde ba chen pos byin gyis brlab pa snying po dang / yon blang ba sngon du 'gro bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis til gyi gang bu bzhin du nam mkha'i ngos kun du bkang nas spyan la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams nang du zhugs pas bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyi bum pa phyag na bsnams pa rnams kyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing / dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / snying po brjod cing dbang bskur te/ de'i 'od zer rnams kyis nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing / gos la sogs pas brgyan pa'i cod pan gyi dbang bsgur ba sngon du 'gro ba'i glu rnams kyis yang dag par dga' bar byas la/ snga ma bzhin du dam tshig sbyin pa la sogs pa 6rdzogs par bya'o / /'di ni re zhig gzhan gyi dbang bskur 7bdag nyid kyang bdag po'i sbyor bas rang gi rig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pas 'di lta bu'i dbang bskur ba nyid blang bar bya ste/ 'di yang gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sngags pa dbang bsgur ba thams cad kyi mchog/33—794

dngos grub dam pa thams cad kyi rgyu yin no/ /yid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni 'dir bcom ldan 'das mngon par bzhed pa kho na ste/ ji skad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje gsang ba 'dus par dbang bskur ba'i bcom ldan 'das slob dpon la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis ji ltar blta bar 1bya ba la sogs pa ji skad zhegasungs pa 'di lta bu yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i 'dus pas 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ni 'di tsayid kyi nyid yin te/ so so'i skye bo rnams kyis phyi'i med pa dang / de'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /de bas na 'di ltar dkyil 'khor gyi le'u las til gyi gang bu ltar kun du gang ba'i rgyal ba'i bum pa'i chu dang dbang bskur bar mdzad par bsam 4par bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang 'dra'o zhes ji skad du gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du dpal de kho na nyid bsdus pa las kyang rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs nas / phyag rgya gcig pu'i dkyil 'khor gsungs shing / de nyid ras dang rtsig pa dang / nam mkha'i phyogs su yang bsam 5par bya'o zhes gsungs pas de yang dkyil 'khor chen po la sogs pa thams cad du dbang bskur ba yid kyi nyid rjes su gnang ba kho na yin no/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bshad pa 6khyad par med pa dang / bstan pa des khyad par ci zhig yod de/ gal te phyag rgya gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid yin gye dkyil 'khor chen po la sogs pa ni ma yin no / /de ci'i phyir phyag rgya gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor yid kyi yin gyi/ dkyil 'khor chen po la sogs pa ni ma yin no zhes la la zer ba de ni mi rigs so/ /33—793

bdag cig 7snagi slob dpon rnams kyis kyang gal te 'dul ba'i dbang gis gzhan dag la 'di skad du gsungs kyi yang dag par ma yin te/ ji ltar dbang bskur ba 'di ni mi sems kyis rjes su 'brang ba yin pa de bzhin du cho ga gzhan dag kyang ci'i phyir mi 'dod de/ khyad par med pa yin no/ /yid mngon par 'dus byas pa'i phyir rtsam 2pa 'di dag thams cad de bri pa'i cho ga yang / ji srid yid kyi cho ga rjes su ma spyad pa de srid 'bras bu dang ldan par mi 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na yid kyi cho ga 'di stobs can yin pa'i phyir mchog yin gyi/ phyi'i ni ma yin no/ /yid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //de ltar gnyi gas kyang 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i mchod par bshad pa/ nam mkha' dri ma thumed pa chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid kyis ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /'jig rten gsum la bde phan bsgrub par brtson pa yis/ /bdag gis cho ga 'di bshad dge thob gang yin pa/ /des ni 'gro ba kun dang bdag gis 'di nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mngon sum gyur pa myur thob shog /sems can thams cad la bde ba bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga jordogs skra // // 33—796

༄ga /byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/shā༄7/ /byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med gnyis nyid bde gshegs mi rtog ye shes chos dbyings sku brnyes pa/ /kun gyi rang bzhin zhi ba 'di la gsal zhing bla med lam mchog ste/ /mi ldog sa la sogs te dbang bcu rgyal ba kun dang gcig brnyes pa/ /gnas gsum mnyam nyid de la mtshan med yid kyis rngurab tu dad pas mos/ /ston pa 'jig rten sgron mar gyur pa kun gyis mtshungs par rab bsngags pa/ /chos la chos kyi snying por gyur pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu snying po nyid—/ /bde gshegs ma lus yum du gyur pas rgyal ba kun gyi lam gcig go/ /tshul khrims la sogs pha rol phyin lam spyod pa rgya mtsho'i gzhir gyur pa/ /rnam dag byang chub sems kyi ngang tshul bsgoms dang yon tan khyad par ni/ /blo ldan nam zhig sems kyi dam pa de ni mngon du gyur pa na/ /de la sku gsum mchog tu 33—809

gyur par chos kyi sku zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /shes byed dam par gyur pa shes rab spyan zhes kyang ni de la bya/ /rdo rje rtse mo mchog nyid mi rtog ye shes de yang de nyid do/ /ji snyed 'phags pa'i rnam grol chos su bsnyad hūṃpa de dag thams cad kyang / /byang chub sems nyid rdzogs pas de yi yon tan de dag de las byung / /'phags pa'i rigs chen 'chi med byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang / /de med mi 'byung de phyir de ni rnam grol mchog gi lam nyid do / / de nas 2kun du rdo rje sems dpa' ci 'drar bsgom par bya bar 'gyur//phra zhing shes dka' drang srong 1chen po'i lam 'di mi rtog rtog las 'das/ /brtag par dka' zhing bstan par dka' la brjod pa'i tha snyad rnams dang bral/ /tshig gis mi phebs gzhan dang byis pa kun kyi spyod yul ma yin yang / /ston pa nges pa'i lung dang bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gdams pangag de nyid don 'dir blta/ /mngon sum la sogs rgyu yi dngos po 'jig cing grub pa'i mtha' dpyod 5pa/ /de nyid rtog pa'i rgyun 'brangs dpyod yul tshad mar bzhag nas blo yis 'jig byed de/ /rtog 6mtha' med phyir dpyod mtha' med de snying po med na tshad mar gang / /de phyir 'jig rten brtags 7pa'i tha snyad rnal 'byor lam 'dir mi dgos so/ /dngos po mtha' yi rgyu ni lo rgyus dag las lam 'dir brtag par bya//skye bo kun gyi sems la mngon snang phyi nang grags pa'i chos 'di ni/ /'dzin pa drug gi ji ltar mthong zhing brtags shepa de ltar ma yin 'khrul/ /rang gi rtog pas myos shing gzung ba de bzhin bden gyur na/ /de dag dngos po med rtogs dgra bcom 'dra bar grol 'gyur ba /—yi rigs/ /de dag dus dgras 'joms dang sdug bsngal nyen las des 'khrul mngon par 'gyur/ /gzhan du skye mched 33—8/0

sgo nas rig pa de dag tshad mar gyur na ni/ /de nyid tshad mar gyur pas 'phags pa'i lam de su la dgos mi 'gyur/ /lam de rnam grol lam du bstan cing dbang po'i shes pas mi thar te/ /sdug bsngal 'ga' yang mi 'jil rnam rig shes te nyon mongs 'byung ba'i gnas/ /de phyir skye bos mthong ba de dag 'khrul par mngon zhes kyergyal bas gsungs/ / de na snyede las 'di dag 'khrul pa'i dbang gis ji ltar snang bar 'gyur zhe na/ /kun du rtog can yan lag ma yin kun du rtog pas rtsol med nyams/ /blo gos phyin ci log tu gyur cing ma rig rkyen gyi dbang song bas/ /sems dang sems las byung ba de nyid lus gsum don du snang ba yin/ /'du byed sna tshogs dag gis bag chags bsags las gang goms mthu brtas ( —tshe/ /sems nyid yul dang lus 'drar snang ba rus pas gang ba bzhin du snang / /bag chags bsags pa'i rgyun la dmigs skyes yid la brtags pa'i bdag med pa/ /'du byed mthu yis bsgribs shing phra ba ma mthong de las rnam rig skye/ /rgyun dang bcas pa'i sems kyi mthu ni ma rtogs rtog pa'i rjes 'brangs 4nas/ /de las zag bcas rang bzhin rtog 5 pas bdag dang chos rnams rgyas par byed/ /ldan par 'byung ba shin tu phra bar rgyu ba de ni ma mthong las/ /bdag tu lta la sogs pa mu stegs lta ba sna tshogs skye zhing thar pa rtog /sems 'di las rnams mtha' yas gnas gyur bag chags mtha' med nges pa med/ /bag chags brtas 6shing sad par byed pa'i rkyen yang rnam pa sna tshogs te/ /rkyen 'gas zubag chags 'ga' zhig smin nas mi yi rgyud kyi lus snang ba/ /rkyen gzhan dag gis bag chags gzhan sad byas tshe 'gyur ba'i mthu mthong nas/ /dbang phyug la sogs byed par 'dod de nyes pa 33—811

lam de mi 7— zhi grol mi 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor lam slad the tshom rngu rgyun 'di phra ba ma rtogs skyes/ /bdag tu brtags bye/ pas bsgribs te 'phags pa'i rigs dang rnam par bral/ /chos su btags pas sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'byung zhing ngan song srid par 'gyur/ /rnam shes de yang 'du byed rgyun la mtshan ma tha dad 'dzin pas na/ /las kyi khyad par dag gis brgyad du snang gi rigs 5 la tha dad med—/ /de phyir sems kyi skad cig dang po de la lus dang chos kun gnas/ /de la bsam pa zhen pa'i phyir na phyi ma phyi ma gyede la snang / /rang sems rgyun las 'phags pa skye bo sgochos ni gzhan na yod ma yin/ /rgyud drug rigs las de yang sna tshogs de dang rang gi ting 'dzin notsu/ /sems rgyun de las pya phyogs kyang cung zad med pas gcig la brten med de bye / /de la phyogs med phyir na mtha' yas zhing rnams bdag gi lus/ /bdag gi lus ni mtha' yas zhing dang skye bo'i lus su rab snang yang / /sems dang bag chags gcig min tha dad ma yin brtag 6par rab tu dka'anyu1/ /'di kun rten cing 'brel 'byung tshul te skye dang 'gag par 'gyur zhes pa/ /tshig khupa'i sa bon bzhin du med las med pa mi 'byung rgyu 'bras med/ /dngos por zhen cing rgyu dang 'bras bur rtog pa'i sems nyid ni/ /rgyu dang rkyen du snang ste de gnyis med phyir skye dang 'jig pa med/ /skye 'jig med phyir bdag gzhan med de 'chi 'pho med phyir rtag nyusnyechad med/ /des na 'khrul 'khor med cing mya ngan 'das pa med pa nyid du mngon/ /gnas kyi skad cig nam yang mi 'bras thude tshe mnyam 'gyur 7de med med/ /yang dag ma yin rtog pas bskyed phyir bag chags yod pa ma yin dang / /spyod yul med phyir kun gzhi med cing rnam rig de yang med pa bzhin/ /phyogs rnams med 33—812

cing dmigs dang gnas med rnam par rig pa ji ltar skye/ /de phyir sems 'di yod med mtha' las 'das shing gcig dang du mar hūṃbral/ /bde gshegs byang chub med phyir de yi rdzu 'phrul sgyu 'dra 'khrul la snang / /de bzhin dag pa'i ye shes de dag shin tu dge ba'i rgyun nyid dang / /chos kyi dbyings nyid la ni de dag dmigs shing skye bar brtags thupa yang / /rdo rje'i gnas med phyir na mnyam gnas rang bzhin 'drar zu'agyur dang / /chos dbyengs rdo rje rtse mo de dag phyogs nyid med pas skad cig min/ /dag pa'i dge rtsa gzugs brnyan med pas 'jig rten ye shes yod mi she'agyur/ /de phyir byang chub ma chub mtshan nyid med par gcig pas blang dor med/ /don de'i tshul gyis don dam rnam grangs skye 'gag med dang mnyam nyid dang / /gnyis med bsam 'das 5chos dbyings brjod dang tha snyad bral la sogs/ /bstan pa de kun tha snyad yin te don dam med cing kun sgrib med/ /don dam tshul gyi lam 6'dra zhes pa de nyid kun sgrib yin/ /the tshom yod med chos ni gang la'ang spong zhing gnas par mi byed do/ /sgom pa dang ni chos dbyings med phyir som nyi med la dam par blta ba la yang med/ /de ltar dngos po mtha' rnams rtag 3dang rang bzhin sgyu ma'ang med gyur zhephyir/ /yod la ltos pa'i med pa'ang med de med pa'ang med/ /mtha' rnams med phyir dbus med dbus la'ang gnas par (mi byed la/ /gang la 'jig rten dbang phyug pad+ma kun kyang mi spong 'drar mnyam gnas/ /chos la 'khrul par mthong ba de nyid 'khrul pa yin par rab rtogs te/ /drug gis bstan pa bdud kyi las kyang mi 'dor ngan du mi rtog rtago/ /shes rab thabs kyi spyod la mi gnas phyir na bdud kyi 'dra bar spyod/ /rang gi shes pa dam par 33—813

byas pa ༄lkukun las rgyal te de bsnyems nas/ /'dod chags zhe sdang skyes nas rtsod 'byung gti mug yin te don mi mthong / /ji srid yid kyi g.yo ba de srid bdud kyi yul te phra ba'i lam/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo tha snyad mi gnas gnas pa la yang gnas par mi byed do/ /snang med dbu ma'i lam de byang chub sems zhes bde gshegs gsungasadā/ /gzugs dang mtshan ma smon par 'dzin pa rab tu spangs nas ni/ /rnam thar gsum po bsgom pa'ang bdud kyi las te gzugs nyid stong pa'o/ /'khor ba'i lam gsum spong zhing mya ngan 51'das lam bsgom ge pa'ang bdud nyid de/ /de nyid rang bzhin ma zhi rang bzhin brtsal thuspangs gar mi gnas/ /'phags pa kun gyi yul dang gnas kyang 'das sogs lam nyid gzhan na med/ /ldang dang mi ldang ched du mi spong sems rten mi 'cha' mngon du min/ /'jam dpal ma yin rdul tsam g.yo ba de yin der mi gnas/ /bsgom pa'i sa mi rnyed phyir bsgoms pas rnyed phrad mi 'gyur te/ /sems kyi spyod yul shes pa de dag chos rnams kyi ni chos nyid yin/ /rnam bral gang la mchog dang tha ma med par lam mchog 'di bsgom mo/ /'du byed ma skyes chos kun 'byung med bzhin du chos rnams mya ngan 'das/ /dngos med de tshe kun kyang chos kyi dbyings zhes dgra bcom rab 'byor yin/ /nam mkha' mi 3dmigs ming tsam dge dang mi dger 'byed med skye ba'ang med/ /rtsol ba yid la mi byed gang la'ang sems med shes dang mi shes bral/ /dran dang 'byed med gang la'ang 'ga' dang mtshungs med mi gnas mi dmigs shing / /mnyam nas gnyis su brtag 3med brjod bral bya dang mi bya med de stsogs tsobri med/ /ched du rtsol bar yid la mi byed cis kyang mi 'khrugs mnyam shes dang / /gang la'ang 33—814

chags dang yul kyis myos skrag med de mi 'bral mi gnas shing / /mi 'phrogs mnyam shes bzhi po phyogs dang pha rol phyin rnams der shes te/ /sems kyi dbyings su goms mepas lam 'di gzhan du bsgoms 3pas 'od gsal mi 'gyur ro / /brda can yang dag len pa'ang byang chub chen po sneyin zhes ston pas rab gsungs phyir/ /de la 'di ni byang chub sems nyid bskyed cing bsgom ④ pa'i gnas yin te/ /ting 'dzin gsum bo snyebastan par byas nas rtags kyi phyag rgya gsum bcings nas/ /chos kyi phyag rgya chen por sems nyid skyed de snying po brjod cing bsgom pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms pas lam kun ma nor bsgoms pa yin/ /kun du bzang po'i trespyod pas ma 7zin dge ba'i chos ni gang yang rung / /kun du bzang po'i spyod pa'ang bdud kyi las te zad cing mthar thug 'gyur/ /de dang ldan pa'i las ni bdud kyi las kyang byang chub spyod par gsungs/ /don 'dir mos pa de yang byang chub chen po yin zhes rgyal bas rab tu bsngags7/ /gnas 'dir bskyed pa tsam gyis 'jig rten gsum po / bla mar bcas pa yis6/ /mchod nas nyan thos bdud kyi sde rnams zil gyis gnon zhes sangs rgyas gsungs( / /thabs chen byang chub sems dpa'i gsang ba'i spyod pa 'di nyid do/ /'di med rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad theg pa gsum ston mi srid do/ /skad cig tsam du dad pa'i shugs bskyed de yang myur du 'jam dpal gzhon nur 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor gsang bar zhugs shing jeg chen dam tshig mchog kyang gsungs 6pa yin/ /tshul khrims sdom pa kun kyang srungs shing sbyin gnas dam par rab tu bsngags/ /de phyir byang chub sems kyi bsod nams de la gzugs yod na/ /nam mkha' bar snang de yang snod du chugs 33—815

zhes rgyal bas mtshungs par gsungs/ /skye bo skye ba sna tshogs dag las skyes shing skye 'gyur skye ba'i rgyun gyi ① dbang song ba/ /rtog 3/ mtha' mi shes rtog pas bslus shing rtog pa'i rgyun 'brangs 'khrul pa'i rtog las phyir ldog med gyur pa3 / /sgyu ma'i sgyu shes dag cing sgyu ma'i glang po 'dra bar sgyu mas rmongs pa'i sgyu ma rnams/ /rmi lam gyis bslad jibazhin du rmi lam 3bden pa nyams shing rmi lam dbang du song ba'i rmi lam pa/ /lam 'di spong zhing mtha' dang lam gzhan lam du bltas nas ma nor lam zhes ston pa de/ /de dag rdo la gser bzhin thugs rjer rung zhing thugs rje'i thugs rjes kye ma 'bros rngo 7 pa yin/ /shin tu ma sbyangs dus kyis mnar ba'i skye bo lnga brgya tha ma la/ /gsung rab dri med rtogs dka' dag la sgra bzhin spyod dang tshul bzhin min/ /rang gi blo gros stobs bzhin 'jug pa la sogs 7lta ba sna tshogs dag /mi shes chu bos g.yengs shing gsung gi nying gu 5bdud rtsi rnal 'byor bral/ /de phyir rgyal bas gsungs pa'i thugs kyi gsang ba 'di / /kun du rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs kyi spyod yul thun mong ma yin yang / /goms pa'i mthu yis mi 'gal tshul du tshad ma dag las rab bsgrubs te/ /'gro ba'i don du mi gnyis lam mchog 'di ni rab bgyis pas/ /skye ba'i 9snaskye gnas thams cad du yang skad cig tu/ /mi mthun phyogs kyis mi nyams rgyal ba kun gyi thugs 'di rab rgyas shog /4 1'jam dpal bshes gnyen kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so12// //33—816

༄ / /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i cho ga mdo dang bsreg pa/ tsho ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma saṃ gī —ti bi bye sru tra pidh+ri ta/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal kyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i cho ga mdo dang bsres pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes sku can gtsug gi nor bu mtshan/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyi tshul gnas kun la khyab/ /lam mchog dam pa ston pa sman pa'i mchog /sbug bsngal bdud 'dul 'jam mgon phyag 'tshal te/ /mtshan brjod bdud mdzod shin tu rtogs dka' ba/ /bdag blo mun pas dgrol bar mi nus kyang / /dad pas phyogs bzung thigs pas nor bu gcig /lung dang man ngag dag la brten pa bshad/ /theg pa rnams kyi gzhir 'gyur ba/ /dus gsum rnams kyi lam mchog 'di/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul dang ni/ /slob dpon rnams kyi dgongs pa yis/ /theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /dpag bsam shing 33—819

—chen 'dir phyogs tsam/ /ye shes lus can 'jam dpal gcig pur grub/ /mdo dang bsres pa'i cho ga rim pa ste/ de la dang po sgrub pa po rigs dang ldan pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i phyir yin/ gzhan yang dam tshig ji lta ba bzhin ston zhes tshomatshan nyid dang ldan pa dang / dbang thob par ston to/ /gzhan yang / gsang sngags rig sngags 'chang ba'i rigs/ /zhes pa dang /bden par smra zhing tshig mi 'gyur/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed/ /ces pas bsgrub 〈pa'i snod du rung bar bstan/ yon tan las ri dang / chu klung dang / nags tshang tshing na 'dug kyang rung zhes pa gnas rig pa dang ldan pa'i yid dga' ba ston to/ /bzang ngan shes shing dus shes la/ /zhes pas/bsgrub dus gza' dang rgyu skar dang / nyi ma shis pa la bya ba'i rim pa bstan to/ /dpal ldan 'byor pa phun sum tshogs/ /zhes pas bsgrub pa'i rdzas su don dam rab tu gnas par bya ba dang / maṇ+ḍal gsum dang / me tog dang / dri'i byug pa dang / mchod bya'i khyad par mang po dang / blo brtan dang / yo byad dang / tshogs par bya ba'i rim pa debastan to/ /yon tan las ma rungs pa 'dul ba'i rgyal po zhes pa dang / gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal/ /zhes pas mtshams kyi rim pa/ hūṃ mtshan ma las khro bo'i rgyal bo gshin rje gshed mdog nag pa zhal gcig )phyag gnyis pa/ thod dbyug dang sdigs mdzub byed pa/ sbrul dang thod pas brgyan pa bskyed la/ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ zhes pa dang / mig tu ma dang ṭa bkod de/ 'od zer gyi rdo rje 8ra ba dang / dra bar 1bya bar bstan to/ /snying rje chen po'i blo yi mchog /ces pa dang /phan 'dogs sems can mnyes gshin pa/ /zhes pas/ sems can gyi don 33—820

du bdag gis 'jam dpal thob par bya'o zhes sems bskyed par ston to/ /gnyis med gnyis su med par ston/ zhes pa dang lku/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /ces pas thog ma phyomed pa'i byang chub kyi sems thabs dang shes rab kyi brdar gyur pa'i snying gar —ye shes sems dpa' bsam par bya ba ston to/ /bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog /ces pa dang / mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi ④gnas/ /rtag tu rim gror skyebya ba'i 'os/ /bkur 'os rjed par bya ba'i mchog /phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i bdag /ces pa 'dis 6ston to/ /bdag gi snying gar pe.a dang hūṃ bsams te/ de las 'od 'phros pas bla ma dang /dkon mchog gsum dang / rje btsun 'jam dpal dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams spyan drangs nas/ bdag gis bltas te/ lus kyi bkod pa yan lag gsum bskor ba byas te phyag byas la bstod do/ /bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog /ces pa dang / dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa ste/ /zhes pas mchod pa'i khyad par nam mkha' ltar mnyam par bsgrubs la/ snying ga'i ralha mos dbul lo zhes ston to/ /sbyin bdag chen po'i gtso bo ste/ /tshul khrims chen po 'chang ba'i mchog /bzod chen 'chang ba ston pa po/ /brtson 'grus chen po brtul ba yin (/ /zhes pa 'dis bstan rkute/ sngags dang phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ /bdag gi snying ga bye — nas lha mo bzhi spros te/ gnas pa rnam pa gsum du mchod par bya'o/ /de bas na/ dbugs 'byin chen po dga' ston che / /dga' chen rol mo chen po ste/ /bkur ste rim gro phun sum tshogs/ /zhes pas bstan kyito/ /bsam gtan chen po'i muting 'dzin gnas/ /zhes bya ba nas7/ smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /zhes bya ba dang / byang chub yan 33—821

lag rnge tog spos/ /zhes bya bas/ phyi'i lha mo bzhi ste snying ga lku nas gong gi tshul du sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas gnas su dbul rngu lo/ /mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che/ /zhes pa nas/ dga' ba chen po mgu ba che/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis/ gsang ba bzhi mchog tu gsang ba bzhis bstan to/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ /rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /rdo rje chos kyi glu blangs pas/ /rdo rje las kun byed pa'o/ /zhes bya ba 'di'i rkang pa dang /gsang ba'i mchod pa'i dus su/ sgeg mo la sogs pa dang / rim 1bzhin du rkang pa bzhi dang glu blang bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang mchog tu gsang ba'i mchod pa dang / chags pa la sogs pas dbul lo/ /rgyas pas pyam phye'o zhes bstan to//de nas 'dud nyi shus bstod de/ yang na ni thams cad kyang bstod par shes par bya'o/ /de nas sdom pa bzung ba'i mthar yang de nyid kyis shes par bya'o/ /byams pa dang snying rje ni shin tu gsal bar ston pas/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom 5zhes so/ /rnam par mi rtog dbyings mi zad/ /yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid—/ /yang dag mtha' ste kyeyi ge med/ /chos dbyings dam pa zad min bdag /ces pas de'i don bsgom dz+wapa ni/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sngags brjod do/ /phyi dang nang gi dngos po stong par bsgom zhes ston to/ /stong nyid dam pa 'dod chags blo/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags spangs pa ste/ /zhes pas pad+ma'i steng na dngos gzhi las langs te/ dang po dam tshig sems dpa' bsgom 8pa dang / chos kyi 'byung gnasape/ de'i tha ma 'od zer lngas bskor ba'i nang du/ pad+ma zla ba'i steng du /7 sum̐ dmar skya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i phreng bar 'gyur ba las/ sprin dkar dag pa bzhin du dkar/ /'od bzang 33—822

ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od/ /nyi ma 'char ①ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes/ /sen mo'i 'od ni shin tu dmar/ /cod pan bzang po mthon ka'i 1rtse/ /skra mchog mthon ka chen po can/ /zur phud lnga pa me tog thod/ /rgyan kun kyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /sdu — gu 'jig rten gsum na mdzes/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs/ /rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dpal ldan sgeg dang sgeg zipar ldan/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ /nyon mongs g.yul du gcig dpa' ba/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rnams kyis/ rje btsun kyi sku sprul pa'i cha lugs bstan pa yin no/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi don bstan pa/ /zhes bya bas yul chobazhi'i phyag rgya sku 'phro 'du dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab par bstan to/ /phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /ces pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo dang lha mo rnams thugs kar spyos zhes pa'o/ /de nas mdun du pad+ma dang zla ba la/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ dbang bskur ba dang / mchod pa dang / bstod pa gong bzhin du byas te/ ye shes sems dpa' bltas la dgug cing rang gi lus la bsgoms zhes pas gnyis su med par byas te/4 rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur dpal/ /sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod pan can/ /zhes pas snying ga'i dze+e'od kyis bskul te/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang ldan zhes bstan to/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang / /zhes pas rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas la / sngags dang bcas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du sangs rgyas thams cad sprul la zhes ston tesnye/ de'i don ni 'og nas 'chad do/ /bdag rig gzhan rig tsuthams cad pa —/ /shes dang shes bya'i bdag po mchog /ces 33—823

pa thams cad sems kyi sprul par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar rdzogs pa dang /gsang sngags zlos pa dang / mtshan klog par byas te/ de ltar yon tan brjod pa las kyang / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gsang sngags kyi sgo'i sbyad pa spyod pa gang la la/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes sems dpa' thams cad/ sku gnyis su med pa'i don dam pa'i ming yang dag par brjod pa'i ming hūṃni/ gtsug gi nor bu 'di thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / ma nyams shing lhag chad med par tshigs su bcad pa'i tshig dang / yig 'bru 'di dag nyid kyi/ nyin gcig bzhin dus gsum du 'chang ba'am/ klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la yang dam tshig ji lta ba bzhin du ston pa dang /ming gi don gang yang rung ba re re nas kyang 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sku la dmigs te zhes bya ba dang / sems rtse gcig tu bsgom pa de la ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang yon tan las/ nyin re bzhin du dus gsum du mnyam par yi dam du lan gsum du 5'don tam/ glegs bam du byas pa la klog cing brjod la/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' gzugs la dmigs shing / gzugs dang gnyis su mthun par bsam gtan du byed pa ni/ 'dul ba'i dbang gi phyir ring por mi thogs par de nyid du sprul pa'i gzugs kyi lus mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don 'di yin te/ mtshan nyid kyi cho ga rdzogs shing / dmigs pa la 5yun ring du gnas pa des/ rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas la/ mañju shrī hūṃ oṃ wā gī 6shwa ri sum̐/ maṇ+ḍal tsakra hūṃ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rnam par sprul la/phyag sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa la sogs pas bdag gi lus de dang mnyam par 33—824

sprul te/ mtshan gyi don re re nas bstod na/ yon tan gyi rnam pa 'di ltar smos pas bdag gzhan dpag tu med par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mdor na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ring por mi thogs par dam pas bsngags pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /dam par rgyud hūṃpa'i bla ma bdud rtsi 'thung / /'gro ba sdug bsngal nad kyis zin gyur 3la/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstod tshig 'di/ /sman pa'i rgyal po bzhin du bdag gis bshad/ /'phrod pa'i sman bzhin kun la phan 'gyur nas/ /mi rtog ye shes 'chi med thob par shog /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i mdo'i don mdor bsdus pa'i cho ga /slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud le'u khri drug stong pa las/ rdo rje glur — blangs pa'i le'u'i sgrub thabs mdo dang bsres pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/819 shematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phrotshan yang dag par brjod pa'i cho ga mdo dang bsres pa/ slo ba dpon 'jam dpa/la bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa bzhugs/3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sgroX/82༷ —kyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉des pa/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dang/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa//5〈〈snar 〉7ra/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje'i/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉ra pa// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje'i/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/821 kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉des pa/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thogs pa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kar/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoradi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kar/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skaba'i/9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yon/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ston/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag mu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ston/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉33byed825

sngag /gsang ldan gyi dka' 'grel don bsdus sgon ma bzhugs/༄ste༄na / /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /thugs rje dang ni shes rab gnyis/ /sangs rgyas kun ltar gnyis med pa / /dam pa lam ston lta bu yi/ /sku yi rnam par 'char mdzad pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob mas legs par rtogs phyir dang / /bdag nyid kyis kyang dran bya'i phyir/ /gsang ldan dka' —'grel 'dir brtsam bya / /de nas dkyus nyid la 'jug par bya ste/ gang 'di la sogs pa'i tshig rkang pa bzhis mchod par brjod pa ston te/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgu gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid du bzhugs pa yin la/ de la slob dpon nyid lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal ba bstan pa'o/ /zab cing la sogs pa rkang pa bzhis bshad par dam bca' ba ston / te/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi thuzab cing rgya che ba'i mtshan/ rnal 'byor spyi'i 5 33—827
