rgyud la brten nas/ gzhan dang bdag gi don du 'gyur ba'i phyir bshad pa'o/ /thig le bcu drug mi shig pa snadabus la sogs pa rkang pa bcu drug gis gang la zhus pa dang / gang gis zhus pa dang / gang gi don du zhus pa ston pa las/gang la zhus na sku gsum la zhus pa ston te/ thig le la sogs pa rkang pa bdun gyis chos sku bstan/ gsang sngags la sogs pa rkang pa gnyis kyis longs sgu bstan la/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa rkang pa gnyis kyis sprul sku bstan nas/byang chub la sogs pa rkang pa bzhis gang gis zhus pa ston 3cing / blo zhan don phyir rim pa gsungs/ /zhes pa rkang pa gcig gis gang gi don du zhus pa bstan pa'o / /de ltar glad kyi don bstan nas gzhung la 'jug par bya ste/ gang gis gang du thabs ji ltar bya ba dang gsum du gnas pa las/ de la/ dang por rdo rje 'chang chen por/ /slob dpon cha lugs gnas byas te/ /zhes pa rkang pa gnyis kyis gang zag gang gis bya ba ston te/ slob dpon rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa/ de nyid bcu shes shing 'jigs pa med pas/ cha rkyen lnga dang ldan par bya ste/ phyi nang gi khrus dang / phyi nang gi bsrung ba dang /phyi nang gi gos bgo ba dang / phyi nang gi byug pa dang / gnas dang stan sngags chus bsangs la 'dug pa'o/ /bsam gtan dang ni rjes mthun 4par/ /la sogs pa'i rkang pa drug gis gnas dang bsnyen pa ston pa la/ gnas ni rkang pa lngas ston te/ zlas phye ba gnyis te/ bsnyen pa dang bsgrub 5/pa'i gnas so/ /sogs pa'i sgras ni bsgrub 6pa'i gnas bsdu'o/ /der chag chag skyang nul bya zhing me tog gis nyams dga' bar bya'o/ /gogs bzang btsal la bsnyen 7pa brtsam / /zhes pa rkang pa gcig gis bsnyen pa bya bar dam bca' ba bstan pa'o/ /33—828

bdag dang sa gzhi yongs bsrung tsosnazhing / /la sogs pa rkang pa bzhis tshogs sogs dzu pa'i bar chad thubasrung ba bstan te/ rdo rje 'chang hūṃ mdzad du bsgyur la/g.yas dang g.yon gser gyi rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa khro zhing rngam pa'i thugs kar ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ sngon po bsams la de las 'od byung bas rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang ra ba dang gur dang bla re cho dang dra bar gyur par bsam mo/ /rgyas pa la dga' ba rnams kyis ni/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rjes su 'brang ba'am/ rdo rje rtse mo dag gi rjes su 'brang ba las shes par bya'o/ /'dir ni bla ma'i man ngag bsdus pa'o/ /de nas shin tu brtser 5ldan pas/ /spyin sreg gis ni mnyes par bya/ /zhes pa rkang pa gnyis kyis tshogs sogs 9 pa'i yo byad sprul pa ston te/ de la spyir sbyang zhing bsreg pa dang / so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas tsune+ebyin gyis brlab pa'orngu/ /spyir sbyang zhing bsreg pa ni rdo rje gnod sbyin nam/ rdo rje rtse mo yongs su bzlas pa'i spos chus bsang gtor bya ba ni spyir sbyang ba'o/ /rdo rje me'i sngags dang phyag rgyas 9mi gtsang ba la sogs pa bsregs pa ni bsreg ( pa'o/ /so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ til dang / nas dang / ku sha dang / 'bras yos dang / dri bzang po dang / me tog dkar po dang ldan pa'i mchod yon la sngon du rdo rje'i gar byas la rdo rje'i thal mo kha phye ba'i mchod yon gyi phyag rgya bcas la oṃ a ra pa tsa na ya te na ma 'am/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ lan gsum mam bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gis byin gyis brlab bo/ /de bzhin du me tog dang spos dang mar ske dang dri dang byug pa dang lha bshos dang gtor ma la sogs pa rnams mi'i las 'das nas lha'i mchod rdzas khyad par can du bsam mo/ /de bzhin du sbyin sreg 33—829

la yang bza' ba zas kyi mchod pa zhes bya ste/ gzhung bzhin du bsham zhing byin gyis brlab bo/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rab 'bad de/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rkang pa bco lngas rten gyi zhing sprul par ston te/ de yang sngon du bsnyen pa zhes pa rkang pa bzhis 4rten gyi zhing nam mkha' la sprul par dam bca' bar ston la/lag pa'i 'du byed ces pa rkang pa bcu gcig gis rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid kyi lus ngag yid kyi spyor bas zhing spyan drangs pa ston te/ de yang bdag gi 2g.yas dang g.yon gyi sor mo la oṃ s+dzahūṃ t+t+waṃ twegeḥlnga bkod la/ de nas mdzub mo gnyis mthe chung gnyis so sor mdud la de bkan la/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūṃ zhes brjod cing byon par bsam mo/ /gang byon zhe na rigs lnga 'am gcig gam drug gam rigs gsum mdun kyi nam mkha' la byon pa'o/ /gang gis byon zhe na lus ngag yid kyi spyor bas so/ /de ltar mkha' la zhes pa rkang pa gnyis kyis bdag dang zhing du 'byel par bya ba ston te/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha de rnams yang be+ems 7 po lta bu ma yin te/ rig pa can spyan rtsa rig rig pa snyan cha khrol khrol bar bsam pa'o/ /dga' ba'i mchod pa glu yis bstod/ /ces pa tshigs bcad sum cu rtsa lngas cho ga dag pa yan lag bcu'i sgo nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag 7par bya ba ston te/ de yang dga' bas khyemachod ces pa rkang pa lngas phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / bdag dbul ba dang /dngos grub blang ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang dgu ste/ de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang 7ba dang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rjes su 'brang thub las shes 33—830

par bya ste/ tshigs bcad sngags dang phyag rgyas me tog la sogs pa rnam pa lnga phul la ༄kye/ oṃ badz+ra khā gye pyahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā le t+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti tweḥ⑦/ oṃ badz+ra nirte s+dza④/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra haṃ/ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+yā re/ badz+ra dharmā ka ya ne+e/ badz+ra karma khruka robye be/ oṃ badz+ra dhū ⑥pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe t+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke byāḥ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe 26④/ sgeg mo la sogs pa 3mchod pa brgyad kyis yang dag par mchod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā spumāṃ nit+yā ⑩ta na pū dza be+e ra ṇa karma badzi a/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta āt+pa rgo nit+yā skyeta na pū dza spa ra ṇa karma ā gi ra tshu dza/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā rgo nit+yā ta na a ⑫nu rā ga ṇa pū dza spa ra ṇa karma bā ne+e hūṃ ho/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta āt+pa rgo skyenit+yā ta na sā dhu ka ra pū dza be+e ra ṇa karma tuṣ+ṭi 7a/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ⑩ya a bhi ṣe ka rasne bh+yo ⑪badz+ra ma ni oṃ/ oṃ na ma ⑩ sarba ta thā ga ta srubye bh+yo badz+ra te dza ni dza la tweḥ⑩ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā sha pa ri pū ra ṇa byurnya ma ṇi pya dh+wa dzā gre bh+yo badz+ra dh+wa dzā gri t+t+waṃgye/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pra 3ti pra mor+ya ka re bh+yo badz+ra hā l+ya ha/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā nu ra ta badz+ra dharmā ⑫ta sa ma ti/ bhistu no mi ma hā dharma d+ngha 7shrī bye/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra dz+nyā pā ra mi ta 3ni ra ha ri stu no mi ma hā gho ṣā nu ste t+t+waṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra ak+ṣa ra pa ri bar ta bye sarba sru ⑪trarnya na ye stu no mi sarba maṇ+ḍa le hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta san+dha bha ṣa budha saṃ ghi hi/ bhi yo stu no mi badz+ra badz+re baṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū ⑦pa me gha spa ra ṇa pū dza karma ka ra ka ra/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta put+pa pra sa sga ra ṇa pū dza karme ༄ ceki ri ki ri/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā lo ke dz+wa la spa ra ṇa byu dza karma ba ra ba ra/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dha yes mu dra bye sga ra ṇa pū dza karme ku ru ku ru/ zhes bya ba sems dpa' bcu drug dang 'dra ba'i rig ma las kyi phyag 33—831

rgya dang ldan pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de'i phyag rgya ni 'di rnams te/rdo rje bsdams pa dkur gzhag rngu ste bcings la/ gnyis su byas pa'i khu tshur gnyis / /bsgyings bcas gsor la gnyis ka yis/ /lcags kyu 'dzin ltar gnas pa dang / /mda' 'phangs pa sheyi tshul dang ni/ /legs so zhes pa snying gar gzhagad /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje gnyis/ /snying gar nyi ma bstan par bya/ /g.yon pa la ni gru mo gzugs/ /de bzhin kha phyogs bskor bar bya/ /g.yas pa yis ni g.yon par dbye/ /snying gar g.yon pa ral gri mdung / /mgal me'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /rdo rje gnyis ka kha nas dbyung / /rdo rje gar bskor bkrol ba yi/ /thal mo 'gram pa spyi bor gzhagasnye /go cha mthe chung mche ba dang / /khu tshur gnyis ni mnan pa'o/ /de nas phyogs thams cad nas dkyil 'khor la yan lag lngas phyag btsal bar bsam zhing 'dis phyag bya ba ni / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta bhepra ṇa ṭ+wāṃ me na badz+ra brnya rgo kā 37 ro mi/de nas phyag bzhi bya ste/ 'di ltar shar phyogs nas rdo rje thal mo brkyang khyepa lus thams cad phab ste/ o sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo babe+e 'unā ya āt+ma rgo kyenit+yā ta ya 4 mi / sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satā dhi tiṣ+ṭha swā rmā/ zhes bya ba 'dis phyag bya'o/ /de nas lho phyogs nas de bzhin du gnas pa las rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar te/dpral ba sa la reg par byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta smu dza a bhi ⑩ ṣe ka ya lnga samāṃ rgot+yā ta ya mumi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bye ṣiñca saṃ/ zhes pa 'dis phyag bya'o/ /de nas nub phyogs nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin rdo rje thal mo spyi bor gzhag 7ste kha sa la reg pa dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta nā ya/ āt+ma rgo 7nit+yā ta ya 1/mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharmā skye pra brta ya saṃ/ zhes bya 33—832

ba 'dis phyag bya'o/ /de nas byang phyogs nas de bzhin du gnas pa las rdo rje thal mo spyi bo nas phab ste/ snying gar sbyar la spyi bo sa la reg par byas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇi/ ā rgo 1 nit+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru māṃthu/ zhes bya ba 'dis phyag bya ba'o/sgo/ /de nas me tog gi phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am / gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na/ lha dang mi rnams kyi me tog gi bye brag yid las byung ba'am/ chu las skyes pa'am/thang las skyes pa gang dag yod pa de dag rnams 'di lta ste/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rigs lnga dang bcas par bzhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puste pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye t+t+waṃ/ bdug pa'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod par bya stecho / gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am/phya gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gye khams thams cad na lha dang mi rnams kyi bdug pa'i bye brag lhan cig skyes ༄ pa'am/ yang dag par sbyar ba'am/ yongs su gyur pa gang dag yod pa de rnams 'di lta ste/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir—/ phyogs bcu'i )sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rigs lnga dang bcas par bzhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang /gsang sngags dang / rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad la dbul bar 33—833

bgye'o / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū pe ①pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/mar me'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na lha dang mi rnams kyi snang ba'i bye brag yid las byung ba'am/ rin po che'i 'od dam/ mar me'i snang ba la sogs pa gang dag yod pa de rnams 'di lta ste/ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rigs lnga dang bcas par bzhugs shepa thams cad dang / snying podang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ dri'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na/ lha dang mi rnams kyi dri'i bye brag lhan cig skyes pa'am/ yang dag par sbyar ba'am/ yongs su gyur pa gang dag yod pa de rnams 'di lta ste/ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rigs lnga dang bcas par bzhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad la dbul bar bkyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gadhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas bzhad pa'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'am/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi 33—834

khams thams cad na/ lha dang mi rnams kyi bgad /pa dang / sgeg pa dang /dga' ba dang / rtse 'jo'i bde ba'i bye brag gang dag yod pa de rnams 'di lta ste/ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rigs lnga dang bcas par bzhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang /gsang sngags dang / rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad la dbul bar bgyi'o / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hā su la l+ya kyer ti kri ṭa sau khya a nut+ta ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ bzhad pa'i phyag rgya de nyid thal mo bskor ba spyi bor gzhag ④ la/ yang thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba bcings nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kyi khams thams cad na/ dpag bsam gyi shing ngam/ gos kyi shing gang dag yod pa de rnams 'di lta ste/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rigs lnga dang bcas par bzhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang /rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā nut+ta ra bo dhi a pye lo ka ra bas+t+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ sgeg mo'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ sems can thams cad yo byad thams cad kyis ⑥ yang dag par 'byor cing phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'dod pa tsam la rag ma rkye lus par gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā badz+redzha wa dā na pā ra mi ta — pū dza me gha su tsumu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rdo rje phreng 33—835

ba 2ma'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ sems can thams cad kyi mi dge ba'i lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las kyi mtha' thams cad dang yang dag par bral bar gyur cig /dge ba'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' thams cad dang yang dag par ldan par gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā nut+ta ra ma hā bo bye ha ra shī la pā ra mi ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rdo rje glu mkhan ma'i phyag rgya bcings la 'di skad ces bsgod par bya ste/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad kyis lus la yang dag par brgyan par byas pa dang / rtag tu phan tshun 'jigs pa med pa dang / zhe 'gras pa med par bzhugs shing mig dang yid mngon par dga' ba dang / chos zab mo la bzod pa dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā nut+ta ra ma hā dharma a ba bo bye k+ṣurnyi pā ra mi ta rngo pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ / rdo rje gar mkhan ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la mngon par brtson pa dang ldan pa dang / sangs rgyas nyid du yongs su gzhol zhing 'khor ba yongs su 4spong ba'i brtson 'grus dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta san+ta sa ra a pa re 5t+ya kā nut+ta ra ma hā bīr+ya pā ra mi ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar kyeb bcings la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /gang yang 'jig rten kyi khams 'di'am/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kyi khams thams cad na/ rin po che'i ri bo'am/ rgya mtsho 7rin po che'i tshogs gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad kyang 'di lta ste/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i 33—836

phyir / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rigs lnga dang bcas par bzhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang /gsang sngags dang rig sngags lku kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad la dbul bar bgyi'o//oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bo bye ga rat+na a lo ka ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/de nas gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs pas rnam par bkram pa / brgya stong la sogs pa'i grangs snyed dam/ 'byor pa ci yod pa ltar dbul bar bya ba dang / ro brgya pa'i lha'i zhal zas dang / swa ste ka la sogs pa'i bza' ba rnam pa sna tshogs 'bum mam/ brgya stong snyed dbul bar bya ste/ oṃ a kā ro ma zhukhaṃ sarba dharmā rde/ ār+ya nut+parja tāta/ zhes brjod pa dbul bar bya'o/ /rol mo bcu phrag stong ngam/ rol mo brgya phrag stong ngam/rol mo bcu/ oṃ hūṃ s+thāḥmangon par bzlas 4la dbul bar bya'o/ /rnam pa bcu ni 'di lta ste/ gling bu dang / pi wang dang / dza rnga dang / rdza rnga chung ngu dang / cha lang dang / rnga bo che dang / mṛ dang 5ga dang / rnga rings thu dang / rnga rked nyag ⑩dang / ta mi la zhes bya'o/ /shin tu brtags pa'i rta dang / glang po che dang / ba lang gi khyu rnams kyang / oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/zhes bya bas mngon par bzlas la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam par lhag par mos pa byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu h+ya pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas pus mo'i lha nga gnyis sa la btsugs te/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/sdig pa thams cad bshags par bya ste/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub 33—837

sems dpa' rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa thams cad dang /snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags kyi lha thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming rdo rje 'di zhes bya ba phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang /las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang /gsang sngags dang / rig sngags kyi lha thams cad kyi spyan sngar sdeg pa thams cad bla na med pas shāso sor bshags pas so sor bshags par bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu na 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /'phags pa nyan thos yang dag par song ba dang / yang dag par zhugs pa rnams dang / sems can thams cad kyi tshogs thams cad kyi bsod nams thams cad la rgya cher rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi mdzad pa thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya ba'i phyir bskul bar bkyi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las dzu'ada' bar bzhed pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol bar 'tshal lo/ /de nas bdag nyid dbul bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag nyid dbul gyis/ bdag dus thams cad dang / rnam pa thams cad du so sor bzhes su gsol/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i 33—838

mgon po khyed rnams kyis dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub bdag la stsal du gsol/bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las dgrol/ /zhes bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos la/ de nas bstod pa ni tre1'khrugs bsdeb 4par bya ste/ tshigs bcad glu yis bstod par bya/ /byang chub sems ni rang — 'byung ba'i/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa ④tshigs bcad sum cu rtsa gnyis dang rkang pa gcig gis bstod pa ston pa ni/ tshigs bcad glu yis bstod par bya/ /byang chub sems ni rang 'byung ba'i/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /gti mug blo ste gti mug sel/ /mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste/ /rdo rje chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /gdong drug mig drug lag drug po/ /mche gcigs gdong brgya kun 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid/ /stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /'dod pa'i don grub ngan song spyong / /mgon po nyon mongs dra ba 'joms/ /sa gzhi tshangs gnas rkang pas gnon/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyed la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rtogs trebya ba/ /thig le chen po yi ge med/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku kun kyi rgyal/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /a ni yig 'bru kun kyi mchog /khong nas 'byung khub skye ba med/ /sems ma rdo 33—839

—rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /a ni 'byung ba 'gog pa ste/ /tshig tu brjod pa rnam spangs pa/ /rin chen 'byung ba khyod 'a 'dud—/ /so sor kun rtog ngo bo nyid/ /a ni brjod pa'i rgyu yin te/ /brjod pa kun kyi rgyu yi mchog /chos kyi rdo rje 'dzum khyod 'dud/ /bya ba nan tan ngo bo nyid/ /a ni tshig 'bru gsal bar byed/ /tshig kun gsal bar byed pa yi—1/ /rdo rje dra ba spyod la 'dud/ /stong pa rang bzhin 'dod chags che/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyi nyid ma grub bde ba che/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gnyi ga med par dga' ba che/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /stong pa'i don ldan mgu ba che/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /gzugs che lus kyang che ba ste/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /kha dog che la gzi brjid ldan/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud / /ming che mtshan bzangs 3rgya che ba/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bzhad cing dkyil 'khor yangs khyab pa/ /sangs rgyas bzhad pa khyod la 'dud/ /chos kyi shes rab mtshan 'chang ba/ /sangs rgyas gsung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nyon mongs dra ba gcod pa'i mchog /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /grags pa rdo rje rgyu yi bdag /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /snang ba chen po gsal ba che/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /mkhas shing 'phrul 'chang rdo rje las/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po go cha sra/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul bdag nyid gnod spyin gtso/ /thams cad thams cad khrod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul khu tshur brtan 4zhing sdud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sbyin 33——840

bdag chen po /gtso bo ste/ /rdo rje sgeg mo khyod la 'dud/ /tshul khrims chen po 'chang ba'i mchog /rdo rje dpal phreng 2snakhyod la 'dud/ /bzod chen 'chang ba ston pa po/ /rdo rje dbyangs mkhan khyod la 'dud/ /brtson 'grus chen po brtul ba yi/ /rdo rje gar ma khan khyod la 'dud/ /bsam gtan chen po —ting 'dzin gnas/ /rdo rje me tog khyod la 'dud/ /shes rab chen po lus 'chang ba /rdo rje bdug pa khyod la 'dud/ /smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /rdo rje mar me gsal la 'dud/ /stobs po che la thabs che ba/ /rdo rje dag byed khyod la 'dud / /rdo rje lcags kyu 'dren pa che/ /rdo rje 'gugs byed khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje zhags pa rnam par rgyal/ /rdo rje 'dren byed khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje lcags sgog 'dzin pa che/ /rdo rje sdom byed khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'bebs pa rnam rgyal zhabs( / /rdo rje 'be+ebs pa khyod la 'dud/ /byams chen rang bzhin dpag tu med/ /snying rje chen po blo yi mchog /shes rab chen po blo chen ldan/ /mkhas pa chen po thabs che ba/ /ye shes cha grub sems dpa'i tshogs / /stong pa nyid kyi sgor gnas pa/ /bag la nyal la byams sems can/ /shes rab snying rjer ldan la 'dud/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i chostobs dang ldan/ /shugs chen mgyogs pa chen po ste/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po cher grags pa/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa pokhye/ /stobs chen rdzu 'phrul bzhir ldan pa'i/ /gom tsoshugs ye shes bzhir ldan pa/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing stobs kyis gnon/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa khrod la 'dud/ /srid pa'i ri bo chen po 'joms /mkhrigs shing rdo rje chen po 'dzin/ /drag po chen po mun pa 'joms /'jigs chen 'jigs par byed pa potsu/ /phung po lnga dag lha chen 'dul/ /mi 33—841

shes ri 'joms sra ba po/ /mya ngan kun sel drag po ste/ /che bas che ba khyod la 'dud/ /mgon po rigs mchog chen po ste/ /bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog /theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas/ /jeg pa chen po'i tshul kyi mchog /'khor ba mya ngan skyob pa'i mchog /jeg pa'i tshul mchog lam gnas pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i mchog tu grub byed pa'i/ /pha rol sa bcu gtso la 'dud/ /'dud 1nyi shu dang spyi bstod kyis kyang bstod/ de ltar bstod pa byed pa de/ /'khor lo 'dud pa'i gtso mchog 'grub/ /ces pa rkang pa gnyis kyis bstod pa byas pa'i phan yon ston te/ de ltar bstod pas rigs thams cad kyi thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad dang mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dgyes nas bdag la lha rnams kyis/ /snyan pa'i tshig gis bstod par bsam/ /zhes bya ba rkang pa gnyis kyis lha rnams kyis bdag la bstod par ston tegru/ lha rnams thams cad kyi zhal nas rigs kyi bu bdag gzhan gyi don du lha rnams la bstod pa legs so legs so zhes gsungs par bsam mo/ /drin kyi tshul gyis slar bstod pa/ /zhes pa rkang pa gcig gis slar yang 7lha rnams la bdag gis drin la lan gyi tshul gyis bstod pa thams cad dam/ 'dud nyi shus bstod pa'o/ /de dag ni mchog gi rgyal po spyor ba dang po'i 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes pa 4rkang pa gcig gis spyor ba dang po'i ting nge 'dzin yongs su rdzogs par bstan pa'o / /de nas rim pa 'di ldan pas/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs 5bcad nyi shu rtsa brgyad rkang pa gsum gyis yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ston te/phyag bya zhing smon pa byang chub mchog gi sems bskyed sdom pa gzung 4ba dang /'jug pa byang chub mchog gi sems bskyed pa/ ye shes lnga bsgom pa ston te/33—87/2

go sla ba'i phyir 'dir ma spros so/ /de nas de la mngon 'byung gzugs/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag ni gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes bya ba'i bar gyis gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin ston te/ rdo rje dang mchod rten dang chos 'byung dang rgya gram dang /gzhal yas khang dang gdan rnams bskyed pa ston pa'o/ /de yang / de nas lkuyi ge rdzogs pa las/ /zhes bya bas chos 'byung nang du yi ge a kha dog sna tshogs pa'am kha dog dkar pos sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom par 'byel to/ /de yang slob dpon la la dag rgya gram khong stong 1du 'dod la/ 'dir sa gzhi'i tshul du brtag par bya'o/ /de nas rkyen gyis slong ba ni/ /zhes pa nas dang po'i sangs rgyas bsgom dupa'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes pa'i bar kyis gzhi'i sangs rgyas dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas bskyed pa bstan pa'o/ /de yang / dang po'i sangs rgyas zhal lnga pa/ /zhes pa ni/ shar la sogs pa'i zhal bzhi ni sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu rnams so/ /steng gi zhal thuni lha zhal dkar po'am/ rta zhal dkar po la rngog ma sngon po can no/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas thugs ka ru/ /zhes pa nas de dag ni rigs kyi dbang gis 'khor lo'i rim pa bstan pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar gyis shes rab kyi 'khor lo'i rim pa rnams ston te/ rigs kyi dbang gis 'khor lo bdun 'gyur du shes par bya'o/ /da ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i ngo bo nyid ⑤ gsang sngags kyi sgo nas de dag gi rim pa bskyed par bya ste zhes pa nas/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin to zhes pa'i bar gyis lha bsgom zhing dbyung ba dang /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bskyed hūṃ pa bstan pa ste/ dkyus ma nyid gsal ba'i phyir 'dir ma bgrol 7lo/ /'on kyang sngags don rnam par gzigs pa las 33—843

dkyil 'khor drug tu gsungs pa dang / gsang ldan 'di nyid las sngon du shes rab kyi 'khor lo bdun 'gyur du gsungs pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhag ma gzhan yang bshad par bya ste/ mtshan brjod pa'i gsung rab kyi mtshan brjod pas/dkyil 'khor pa rnams rdzogs par bskyed pa'am/ yang na rdo rje 'khor lo'i sngags dang phyag rgyas cig car du sprul pa'o/ /de yang thabs thun mong ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis dang / thabs khyad par gyi dkyil 'khor lnga dang bdun du shes par bya'o/ /gsang ldan 'di'i dkyil 'khor ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i khongs su bsdu'o/ /khyad par gyi 3snani gzhal yas khang sgo gnyis pa'o/ /de nas las kyi khyad par yang / /bskyed pa'i zhar las byung ba ste/ /sgra las 'phel te rgyas bshad pas/ /'di ru bdag gis ma bshad do/ /las kyi khyad par gyi ting nge 'dzin to zhes pas/ las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin bstan pa ste / de nas las kyi khyad par yang / /bskyed pa'i zhar las 'byung tso7 ba ste/ /zhes bya bas/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bskyed nas las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin bsgom par dam bcas pa'o/ /sgra las 'phel te rgyas bshad pas/ /'di ru bdag gis ma bshad do/ /zhes bya ba las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa bla mas shes par —bya ba'i don to cho/ /bla ma'i man ngag ni bcu'i sgo nas shes par bya ste/ sgo bzhi'i dbye ba dang / rang bzhin gyis sangs rgyas basbu ba dang / mdun gyi nam mkha' la ye shes sems dpa' byon te/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la phyag btsal ba dang / ched du brjod pa dang / spyi'i gtso bo byin kyis brlabs 5nga dang / sgos 6bkur gyi gtso bo byin gyis brlab pa dang / dbang nod pa dang / ye shes bstem pa dang / phyag rgyas gdab 33—8 44

pa dang / lha las sbyar ba'i rim par shes par bya'o/ /de la ri1de yang las mkhan rang byed la/ sgo bzhi dbye ba ni/ dang po sangs rgyas kyi nga rgyal gyis sdigs zumadzub kyi se gol gtogs shing rnyi/ phreng sngags brjod pas/ sgo bzhi dbye bar bsam mo/ /yang na bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug par bsams tethu/ khro bo hūṃ mdzad du bsgoms la khro bo'i khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ mdzub mo gnyis lho sprad la drag tu brdabs 6༄pa ni sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ badz+reṅgha ṭa sa ma ya pra be+e sha ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi dbye bar bsam mo/ /de ni sgo dbye ba'o/ /de nas rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ sgrub pa po'i snying gar a las sna tshogs rdo je bsams te/ mthe bo rtsedang mdzub mo la zla ba'i steng du dzaḥ— 7bsams latsho7/lag ngar gnyis rdo rje rgya gram gyi tshul du bsnol te/ dpung pa gnyis su se gol gtogs shing tso/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i snying po/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ//zhes brjod cing / mtheb mdzub kyi dzaḥ nyu1las ye shes kyi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros te/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dam tshig pa dang 'dra ba byon par bsam mo/ /de yang gzhung las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i spyor bas bdag /lag ngar gnyis ni rdo rjer bcing / /rdo rje se gol brdabs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsnyu bar bya/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /byon te phyag 'tshal ba bstan pa ni/ de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyis dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta rta / pra ṇa me na badz+ra ban+ta 2rgo ka ro m+bi14 /zhes brjod cing dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la phyag btsal bar bsam mo/ /de 33—845

nas ched du brjod pa ni/ /e ma'o kun du bzang po yi/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo yi —bi / /dbus na de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes/ /zhes ched du brjod par bsam mo/ /de nas spyi'i gtso bo byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang bzhin kyi dkyil 'khor nas spyan drangs pa'i lha lnga bcu rtsa gsum po thams cad/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs kar 2zhugs nas/ spyi'i gtso bo rdo rje 'chang chen po lha thams cad kyi rang bzhin du byin kyis brlab par bsam/ de nas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs ka 1nas ye shes kyi zilha tshogs 'thon ltate nam mkha' la gnas so/ /de nas sgos thubakur ba'i gtso bo byin gyis brlab pa ni/ e ma sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /rgya chen gdod nas skye ba ⑦min/ /rdul phran ji snyed thams cad kyi / /sangs rgyas rnams ni gcig tu gyur/ /zhes brjod nas/shar phyogs pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi lha tshogs ni mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar 1zhugs te / mi bskyod pas 7byin gyis brlabs nas/ mi bskyod pa'i thugs ka ⑪nas slar 'thon 7te/ rang rang gi dam tshig gi lha byin gyis brlab shā5 par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du lho phyogs dang nub phyogs dang byang phyogs kyang shes par bya'o/ /de nas dbang nod pa ni gnyis su shes par bya ste/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyis dbang bskur bar bsam pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha la sgrub pa pos dbang nod pa'o/ /dam tshig la ye shes kyis dbang bskur bar bsam pa ni/ rigs lnga la rin po che'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bsgur bar bsam mosko/ /de nas rigs kyi sems dpa' bcu drug mchod pa brgyad yum bzhi sgo ba dang sum cu rtsa gnyis la sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan dang dar 33—846

dbe+engs kyis dbang bskur bar ②bsam/ bskal pa bzang po'i sems dpa' rnams la rin po che'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur bar bsam mo/ /de nas sgrub pa pos dbang nod pa ni/ lugs gnyis te/ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa rnams kyi thugs ka hūṃ 7nas slar 'thon rngute/ gdan re re la snang ba gnyis thukyi tshul du bzhugs pa la/ sgrub pa po'i rig mepa'i dbang lnga'am drug nos nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes brjod de slar thim par bsams pa'am yang na dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chu dang 'o ma ltar gcig tu 'dres nas bzhugs pa la/ sgrub pa pos dbang nos par bsam mo/ /ye shes pa slar 'thon 'ute nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de yang dbang gis 3dbang rtags ni/ sgrub pa po de bzhin gshegs pa'i zlos pa po yin na rin po che'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bsgur bar bsam/sems dpa'i zlos pa po yin na/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur bar bsam mo/ /de nas sgrub pa pos byin gyis brlabs /dupa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zlos pa po yin na/ yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas gnas bzhi byin gyis brlab par bsam mo sems dpa'i zlos pa po yin na/ sems ma rdo rje ma la sogs pa yum bzhis byin gyis brlab par bsam mo/ /de nas ye shes dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dgyes par bya ba ni/ sgo bzhi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas gzhal yas khang gi nang du spyan drang ba ⑩ste/ de yang rdo rje lcags kyu'i sngags dang phyag rgyas so so'i sgo nas nang du bkug par bsamatso/ rdo rje zhags pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas so so'i sgo nas bcug par bsam/ rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sngags dang phyag rgyas so 33—847

so'i sgo nas bcings par 3bsam/ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas so so'i sgo ṭunas mnyes par bsam mo/ /de nas phyag rgyas rgyas gdab rngupa ni gnyis te/ rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa'o/ /rgyas pa ni sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang ba 4༄las shes par bya'o/ /bsdus pa ni/ de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgyas gdab pa/ sgrub pa po'i snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsams la/gtso bo'i sngags rings kyi mjug (5la/ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ / a haṃ mañju shrī/ zhes brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad dam tshig gi phyag rgyas gdab par bsam mo/ /chos kyi phyag rgyas gdab pa ni/dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi thuljags kyi steng du hūṃ dkar po las yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re chu rgyugs su yod par bsam/ de'i lte ba la lha rnams rang rang gi sku skyed tsupa'i yig 'bru bkod la/ chos kyi phyag rgyas rgyas gdab par bsam mo/ /las kyi phyag rgyas rgyas gdab pa ni/ sgrub pa po'i snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje bsams la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ rdo rje'i 8 gar dgu sngon du 'gro ba'i tshul gyis/ phyag mtshan tsusnamed par lha rnams kyi phyag rgya chen po'i khyer thabs bsgom pa ni/ las kyi phyag rgyas rgyas gdab po/ /phyag mtshan med par lha rnams kyi phyag rgya chen po'i khyer thabs kyi phyag rgya bcing ba ni/de nas las kyi phyag rgya bcing ba /1 'byung ste/ rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings te/ /mnyam par gzhag 1 pas gnyis su bya/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas gnyis bcings te/ /de nas bcing ba 1rtarab tu bshad/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje mdzub sbyimo ni/ /g.yas pa'i nang du bsgreng sabar bya/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sbyin byed pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba yis reg pa'o/ /rin chen gyi ni mchog 33—848

sbyin pa'o/ /tshe dpag med kyi ting 'dzin mchog /gdon mi za ba'i 3mi 'jigs sbyin/ /de nas las kyi phyag rgya rnams/ /mdor bsdus rab tu bshad par bya/ /rdo rje sems sogs sems dpa' rnams/ /rdo rje las rnams byed pa ste / /bsgyings 3༄bcas gsor ba gnyis ka yin/ /lcags kyu 'dzin ltar gnas pa dang / /mda' 'phangs pa yi tshul dang ni/ /legs so zhes pa snying gar gzhag ༄ /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje gnyis/ /snying gar nyi ma bstan par bya / /g.yon pa la ni gru mo gzugs/ /de bzhin kha phyogs bskor 4bar bya/ /g.yas pa yis ni g.yon par dbye/ /snying gar g.yon pa ral gri mdud/ /mgal me'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /rdo rje gnyis ka kha nas dbyung / /rdo rje gar ni 5bskor ba yi/ /thal mo 'gram pa spyi bor gzhag tre /go cha mthe chung mche ba dang / /khu tshur gnyis ni mnan pa'o/ /rdo rje bsgyings 3pa'i tshul gyis su / /bsam pa g.yos pas 'dud par rkyebya/ /phreng ba bcings dang ḍa7kha nas dbyung / /rdo rje gar ni bskor ba yin/ /rdo rje khu tshur tshul gyis ni/ /bdug pa la sogs de bzhin sbyin/ /sangs rgyas kun la mchod pa yi1— / /phyag rgya'i mchod pa byed pa po/ /mdzub mos lcags kyu bcings pa ni/ /mthe chung las de lcags kyu che/ /mkhrig trem mdud pa mdzub gnyis mdud/ /rgyab gnyis kyang ni bsnyams te mnan/ /sgo gnyis pa dang / gsum pa la sogs pa lnga'i las kyi phyag rgya bcings pa ni/ so so'i gtso bo bzhin du thabs re sgo re'am/phyogs bzhir bcings pa'o12/ /de rnams ni 'dir mang du spro mi dgos pa'i phyir mang du ma spros pa'o// //de nas phyag rgya chen pos rgyas gdab pa ni/ sgrub pa po'i snying gar rdo rje 33—849

rtse lnga pa bsams la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyi'i snying po/ oṃ hūṃ trīḥ/ zhes yid la zlos shing / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rdo rje gar ma byas par/ rang rang gi phyag mtshan phyag na bsnams par bsgom pa ni/ phyag rgya chen pos 1rgyas btab par bsgom pa'o/ /de las 2 lha las la sbyar ba ni/ gzhung las/ de nas las kyi rgyal mchog ni/ /sgra las 'phel te rgyas bshad pas/ /'dir ni bdag gis ma bshad do/ /zhes 'byung bas/ sgra las 'phel te bshad rngo na/ gsang ldan nam sgo dang po'i lha las la gzhag pa ni/ lha'i dag pa dang mthun par las la gzhag 9ne+este/sngags don rnam par gzigs pa'i lha'i dag pa dang mthun no/ /sgo gnyis pa'i gti mug sel ba ni rnam par snang mdzad doblu/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug sbyongs shig pa'o/ /de bzhin du zhe sdang dang / 'dod chags dang / ser sna dang / phrag dog spyongs shig pa'o/ /yang na sngon gyi lha thams cad kyi spro bsdu dran par byas pa ni las la sbyar ba'o/ /las kyi khyad par gyi ting nge 'dzin to zhes pa ni/mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas spos kyi chu dag la/ /sngags bzlas 7pa yis bsang byas te/ /phung pos bsdu ba'i mchod pa lngas/ /rim bzhin byin brlabs mdun bzhag nas/ /'di dag rim pa'i rim gyi saldu/ /se gol rim pas brdab byas pas/ /rim bzhin bsdu ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥldan byas te/ /mdun na mngon sum bzhin mthong nas/ /sa mā kludzaḥzhes brjod byung 1 / 'khor lo tshogs mchog de dag la/ /mnyam med la sogs bstod par bya/ /de nas gtso bo sngags rings la/ /dṛ sh+ya zhes kyang brjod bya zhing / /33—850

a haṃ 1zhes dang ldan par ni/ /bzhi yis rgyas gdab don mchog sgrub2/ /de nas mchod pa'i bye brag gis/ /mchod nas phyag bzhi bya ba ni/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i/ /gnas su bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /de dag ni yongs su sdogs pa'i chos kyi ting nge 'dzin to zhes bya bas yongs su sdogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin bstan pa ste/ de dag ni zu yang spyi don dgu'i sgo nas shes par bya ste/de nas spos kyi chu dag la/ /sngags bzlas /④pa yis bsang bya ste/ /phung pos bsdus pa'i thumachod pa lngaphya/ /rim bzhin byin brlabs mdun bzhag nas/ /zhes bya bas/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ston te/ spyir sbyang zhing sreg 3 pa dang / sgo sgo'i thusngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs te/ sngon bzhin no / /'di dag rim pa'i go rims kyis/ /se gol rim par tsubardab byas pas/ /rim bzhin bsdu ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥldan byas te/ /mdun na mngon sum bzhin mthong nas/ /zhes bya bsahūṃ/ rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsdu ba ston to nyu1/ /de yang rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas spyan drangs la mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon par bsam mo/ /sa mā tsu5dzaḥzhes brjod bya zhing / /'khor lo tshogs mchog de dag la/ /mnyam med la sogs bstod par bya/ /zhes pas bstod pa ston te1 / sngags sngon du 'gro bas de nas bstod pa ni/ mnyam med mi g.yo'am/'dud nyi shus bstod pa bya'o/ /de nas dgug pa dang bcing ba dang mnyes par bya ba ni/ sgo bzhi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas gzhal yas khang gi nang du sbyan drangs pa la sogs pa ste sngon bzhin no/ /de nas gtso bo'i sngags rings la/ /dṛ nga sh+ya zhes kyang brjod bya zhing / / ā haṃ 'i zhes dang ldan par ni/ /bzhi yis rgyas 33—851

gdab don mchog bsgrub hūṃ/ /ces bya bas/ lha thams cad ni phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab pa sten/ de yang phyag rgyas gdab pa ni/ las mchog gi skabs bzhin shes par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa'i bye brag gis/ /mchod nas zhes bya bas mchod pa dbul ba ston te/ de yang mchod pa dbul ba ni/ /thun mong gi mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang / phyi nang gi lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa dang /bsgrub chos —bcu drug dang / mchod pa gzhan yang ci 'byor tshad du dbul ④lo//phyag bzhi bya ba ni/ dang po sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i/ /gnas su bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /zhes bya bas phyag btsal bar ston te/ de yang phyag bzhi btsal ba ni / /shar phyogs kyi sgo nas rdo rje rigs kyi phyag btsal ba dang / lho phyogs kyi sgo nas rin po che'i 5rigs kyi phyag btsal ba dang / nub phyogs kyi sgo nas pad+ma'i 6rigs kyi phyag btsal ba dang / byang phyogs kyi sgo nas las kyi rigs kyi phyag btsal ba ste/ lus kyi bca' thabs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa dang phyag rgya dang sngags dang phyogs dang lngas shes par bya ste/ sngon bzhin no/ /de'i 'og tu bla ma'i gdams ngag gis mnyam ⑦pa gsum dang bsnyen pa ni bsgom pa dang / mtshan brjod pa'i gsung rab gdon pa dang sngags bzlas pa rnams ston pa ni/ de yang mnyam pa rnam pa gsum gyis mnyam par bsres la/ bsgom bzlas bya ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra ā kophohaṃ/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gye lha thams cad dang bdag sgu gsung thugs rdo rje mnyam pas mnyam pa nyid du bsam8 /oṃ swa bhā wa bi shusgolhahaṃ9/ zhes brjod pas/ lha thams cad dang bdag rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par mnyam pas mnyam pa nyid du bsgom/ oṃ sarba sa molhahaṃ / snazhes brjod pas/ lha thams cad dang bdag med par mnyam pas 33—852

mnyam pa nyid du bsgom 1mo/ /de ltar mnyam pa nyid gsum gyis mnyam par bsres la/ lha thams cad kyi rang bzhin bdag yin no bar bsams la bsgom pa dang / mtshan dang sngags kyi drobazlas pa byed na yang / lha thams cad kyi rang bzhin bdag yin no bar bsams la/ bdag gis mtshan dang sngags kyi ༄ —bzlas pa byas pa'i dus su lha thams cad kyi zhal nas kyang bzlas pa'i sgra 'byung bar bsam/ de ltar byas nas bsnyen jipa lngar 'gyur te/ bsgom pa'i bsnyen pa la dus kyi bsnyen pa dang / mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa gnyis so/ /bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa la/ dus kyi bsnyen pa dang / mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa dang / grangs kyi bsnyen pa dang gsum mo/ /de ltar bsnyen pa rnam pa lnga'o/ /de la sngags rnams 'di yin te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gī 5shwa ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra rat+na ⑥hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dharma hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra karma hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra badzi ṇi hūṃ/oṃ merat+na badz+re ṇi hūṃ/ oṃ 8dharma badz+re ṇi hūṃ/ oṃ 1karma badz+re ṇi dzo 7hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra khā gya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā le hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra m+birti 11hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gabye hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rā dza dza 8/ oṃ badz+ra rā ga ho/ oṃ badz+ra sā dhu sa/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra te dza oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ke tu t+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa zheha/ oṃ badz+ra dharma s+thā④ ཿ/ oṃ badz+ra t+t+waṃkyā dhī 6ཿ/ oṃ badz+ra he tu saṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bhā laṣa ram̐/ oṃ badz+ra karma shaṃ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sarnyi baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā d+ngha7be sha a/khyad par gyi snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta nyu8ye ya 519te na maḥ/oṃ duḥkhats+tsha da ya te na maḥ/ oṃ badz+ra tīkyā ༄ ya te na maḥ/ oṃ wā gī shwa ra ya te 33—853

na maḥ/ oṃ dz+nyā na kā ya ya te na maḥ/ oṃ a ra pa 1snatsa na ya te na maḥ/ thun mong gi sngags te/ go bzlog par shes par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba dharmā a snebhā ba swa bhā ba/ bi shudha/ badz+ra a ā saṃ a༄ / bra kṛ ta krupa ri shudha/ sarba dharmā/ya du ta/ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya/ mañju shrī pa ri shud+dhi ta mu pa da ya (snyeti/a ā/ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ tweḥ/ bha ga bān/dz+nyā na mūrti wā gī shwa ra/ ma hā ba tsa/ sarba dharmā ga ga na/ a ma la khyesu pa ri shudhe 3dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha 5aḥ/ zhes bya ba ni/ lha thams cad kyi spyi'i sku'i sngags dang rtsa ba'i sngags dang phreng sngags so/ /bsnyen pa bstan pa'o // //( de nas sgrub tsopa la 'jug pa ni/ de nas rang dga'i gnas nyid du/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes bya bas/ bsgrub pa'i gnas dang skyebasgrub pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor bya ba 1rtaspyir mdor bstan te/de yang gnas ni nyams dga' zhing yid 'jug pa/ rgyal po dang theg pa dman pa la sogs pas dbe+en par bya bar gsungs so/ /sa de gzhung bzhin sbyang // bya dang / /gzung ⑫dang ldan pa gzhung bzhin du/ /bya ba'i bye brag gzhan na'o / /zhes bya bas/ sa'i cho ga rgyas par bya bar ston te 7 / de yang bla mas gsang ba spyi dang rtsa rgyud chen po la sogs par sa'i cho ga spyi don brgyad kyis sngashes par bya ba ni/ tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du gza' skar bzang po la zhugs te/ slob dpon slob ma'i spyod lam bya ba ni/ za gcig gi smyung ⑫ba dang dkar gsum bza' ba la sogs pa'i spyod lam bya'o/ /grong khyer chen po'am/gtsug lag khang ngam/ lha khang la sogs pa'i shar ram byang phyogs su bri bar bya'o—/ /de nas ji tsam byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sa bcad la sa'i lto 'phye 33—854

brtag par byas la/ lto ba nyunas sa brkos te 2sa'i ro lnga spangs pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /sa'i ro lnga ni/ sa'i ro gseg ma dang / mi'i ro rus pa dang skra shad kyi dum bu dang / rdza'i ro gyo dum dang / shing gi ro mgal dum la sogs pa dang / rtswa'i 1ro phub ma la sogs pa med par bya'o/ /rgyal pos ni dkyil 'khor khru brgya lnga bcu pa la bya'o/ /blon po dang 4blon po chen pos ni khru lnga bcu pa la phya'am de'i phyed la bya'o/ /sgrub pa pos ni khru nibacu gnyis sam drug la bya'o/ /sa brtag pa ni nyis 'gyur tshun du brtag go/ /de nas yul gyi rgyal po dang blon po la sogs pa la bslang ba'o7/ /sa'i lha mo la bslang ba dang /dkon mchog gsum la bslang tsa7ba dang / sa bdag la sogs pa la bslang 7ba'o/ /de nas yid kyis sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can/ lag na gser gyi bum pa thogs pa cig 7 /sa'i 'og nas sku phyed tsam 'thon par bsams la/ spos chus brlan par byas pa'i lag pas sa la lan gsum brdabs 1 /la/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ sa'i 1lhalha mo'i zhal nas khyod ci bde thubar bris shig zer nas sa'i nang du thim par bsam mo /yang na dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su maṇ+ḍal khru gang gru bzhi pa cig mubyas la/ der mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang gtor ma cha gcig bshams la/ dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa rnam pa lnga phul te/ spos kyi snod thogs te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ dgongs shig bdag la sangs rgyas dgongs / /sangs 33—855

rgyas thams cad mchod pa dang / /sems can rnams la sman slad du/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri rtebar 'tshal/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /de skad ces lan gsum brjod pas/ dkon mchog gsum gyis gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /yang gtor ma a kā ro la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs la/dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud las byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pas gtor ma byin la/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te spos thogs te/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i lha klu dang / /gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin/ /yang dag rdzu 'phrul cher ldan pa'i/ /'byung la gnas pa'i 'byung po kun/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang / /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ /ji ltar bsams pa bzhin 'bri 4na/ /khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i gogs po nyid du mdzod/ /da ltar bdag gis khyod la ni/ /bzod par gsol gyis mi choslu bar / /rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma yi/ /legs nyes ltas 6rnams bstan du gsol / /lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ sa bdag la sogs pas dkyil 'khor gyis shig pa'i 7gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /de nas chag chag dang skyang nul legs par bya ste/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags kyis/ yungs kar gtor zhing bgegs bskrad nas/ oṃ hūṃ dhī 7zhes pa'am/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ zhes bya ba lan gsum mam/ bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod par bya'o/ /de nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis bgegs nye bar zhi bar bya'o/ /yang na dang por sa'i pra brtag par bya ba'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rdo rje slob dpon 33—856

bdag nyid kyi pus mo nub tsam mam nyulte ba nub tsam brkos la/ de yang gong gi sa'i lha mo nam mkha' la oṃ badz+ra u zhesnapa ta ya zhes brjod la gdeg1 /de nas dong gi nang du chus bkang ste/ me tog yang bcug la/ oṃ hūṃ dī 4'am/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ zlos shing shar phyogs su gom pa mi drag mi dal ba brgya phyin te/tshur log nas chu de ma skams thun dngos grub yod par ston/ chu skams na gzhan du spo ༅bar bshad/ de nas rdza so ma btang ba zhig tu rin po che sna lnga dang 7'bru lnga dang sman dang snying po dang spos dang lnga blugs ral/ dong gi nang du gzhug go/ /de nas brkos rngupa'i sa de rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags btab pa'i spos chus bral brul du sprus la nang dgang bar bya'o/ /lhag par gyur na dngos grub mchog yod par bstan/ chad nas —gzhan du spo/ de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin bzlas pa'i spos chus chag chag gdab/ 'thas par bcags la me long gi rgyab bzhin du byas pa ni sa las dang bya bas sbyang ba'o/ /rdo rje gnod spyin nam rdo rje rtse mo 7bzlas pa'i spos chus bsang ⑫gtor bya ba dang / zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byas pa'i thal ba dang / yungs kar gyis gtor ba 1nani sngags kyis sbyang ba'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug la/rdo rje chen po nas gzhal yas khang la thug pa'i bar du bsgoms la sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa'i nang du sa chud par bsgom ngapar bya'o/ /sa sbyang ba'o/ /de nas slob dpon lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ sa phyogs 'di nyid du bdag rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya'o zhes bsam pa sngon du btang ba ni/ sems kyi dbang gis sa bzung muba'o/ /de nas slob dpon kyis rdo rje 'chang chen po'i phyag rgya chen por bsgoms nas/ ting nge 33—857

'dzin gsum dang ldan par byas la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug ste/ oṃ badz+ra ṭīṣ+ṭha 1duḥkhastso da/ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na sprurti ༄ / dz+nyā na kā ya/ bā gī 1shwa ra/a ra pa tsa na/ ya te na ma/ zhes zlos shing 'dug pa yan chad ni/ slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas bsgrub pa'i grogs mchog rigs bzhi'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa bzhis/ shar phyogs kyi sgo nas 'dud nyi shus bstod de/mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad 'di dag gis/ /bdag cag gis ni bstod pa yis/ /tshul chen yang ni rgyas par mdzad/ /mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor lo che/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes bya ba rgo/ bgegs tshar gcad par gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /de la mig byin gyis brlab pa ni/ g.yas su ma las nyi ma g.yon du ṭa las zla ba/ de gnyis kyi steng du hūṃ gis mig 'bras tshul du byas pa ni mig byin gyis chobarlab pa'o/ /rkang mthil gnyis su a las sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom pa na thurkang pa brlab pa'o/ /bdag nyid rang nyid 6rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /stobs chen rdo rje can bdag nyid/ /bdag po rdo rje chen por bdag /byin gyis brlabs 7pa mi 'dor ro/ /rdo rje lta bas tshar bcad (pa'i mig g.yon gyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor g.yon phyogs su bskor bas/bgegs thams cad gsal btab 9par bsam/ g.yas kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis 4 g.yas phyogs su bskor bas bgegs thams cad bsreg par bsam mo/ /de ni rdo rje lta bas tshar gcod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas byang shar mtshams su byis pa gzhon nu bzhin du mchongs te phyin la/ kha lho phyogs su bltas la/ dril bu dkur brten la/ rdo rje lan gsum gsor zhing / tshig 33—858

'di skad ces brjod de/ rdo rje slob dpon ming 'di zhes bya bas༄1/ slob ma che ge mo zhes bya bgru/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi 'bras bu thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sa phyogs 'dir rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ngas 'bri yis/ lha dang / lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /yi dwags dang / sha za dang / 'byung po dang / brjed byed dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / rig sngags 'chang grub pa༄ / rgan po dang / rgan mo g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa/ gang dag 'khod pa de dag dengs shig /'di ltar rdo rje 'chang gi bka' thos nas/myur ba nyid du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag nga'i ye shes kyi rdo rjes mgo tshal pa brgyar dgas chopar bya'o zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas rkang pa'i sor mos rdo rje rtse gcig pa sa la 'bri zhing / hūṃ hūṃ zhes brjod byung thudakyil 'khor bskor ba ni rdo rje 'gros kyis tshar gcad pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir rkang stabs bdun hūṃdang / lag stabs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bya ba ni/rdo rje stangs /3stabs kyis thams cad thal kar gcig pu'am/ yang na de bas mang yang rung / /shar gyi 5phyogs su gzugs par bya/ /pog phor tsukham pa las byas pa/ /so ma btang ba dkar po bcu/ /byas nas phyogs dang mtshams su ni/ /brgyad pa de bzhin bdun du dgod7/ /pog phor dag tu ma 'byor na/ /kham pa'i phor bu'i nang nas dbul/ /de dag kyang ni ma 'byor na/ /gcig cig shā1sgor ni gzhag munas dbul/ /me tog phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /rta babs dag kyang phyogs bzhir bya/ /nas dang gro dang 'bru rnams kyi / /myu gu 33—859

legs par skye bar dgod/ /dril bu gdugs dang rnga yab dang / /srad bu dag kyang phyogs bzhir ni/ /rta babs sogs las phyi rol du/ /mdzes par bya phyir mkhas pas gdags/ /'bras yos 'bru dang bcas pa yi/ /me tog sil ma rab tu dgram/ /dkyil 'khor dag gi phyi rol du/ /phyi ma'i ri mo sdu 4༄gu bri//'jig rten 'di na grags pa yi/ /bkra shis la sogs gang yin rnams/ /dkyil 'khor bdag 2gi phyi rol du/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu mkhas pas dgod/ /yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa'i chus dbang ldan gyi phyogs nas brtsams nas phyi dang nang du bcas pa 4bsang gtor bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya kha'i dbus su bzhag phyel/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūṃ/ zhes bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas phyi dro'i dus su/ glu dang rol mo'i mchod pa rnams dang / me tog dang / spos la sogs pa rnams kyis dang po'i 'khor lo ji snyed pa dang / byu 'dod pa de bzhin du mchod cing brtag par bya'o/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig sems dpa'i sku gzugs lugs ma la sogs pa dkar po sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod la/ rang gi snying pos bzhugs su gsol te/ yang na phreng sngags sam/ yang na sangs rgyas kyi snying po oṃ hūṃ hris 6bzhugs su gsol la/ de bzhin du lha gzhan gyi yang sku bzhugs pa'am / mtshan ma rnams btab 7la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po 'bru gsum brjod cing 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas la dkyil 'khor babe+eng byel/de nas ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum sngon bzhin bsgoms la/ de nas nam mkha'i lha bsre bar bya ste/ yi ge phyin ci ma 1log pas kha sbyar gyi sbyor ba bsal 7lo / /bar snang la bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rang gi dam tshig gi phyag 33—860

rgyas bkug pa la sogs pa'i tshul kyis bkug la bcug ste/ bcings nas dbang du byas te/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab pa byas la/ byin gyis rlob cing mnyes par byas nas gzhag thu7par bya ste/ de nas mchod pa rgya chen po mdo klog pa yan chod byas la/ spyi'am so so'i sngags kyi bsnyen pa byas la phyis 'byung ba bzhin du slob dpon rang nyid bzhugs shing dbang lha las byeblang ngo / /de nas dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing dbang bskur bar bya bar bstan pa'i phyir dkyus ma nyid 'khrugs sdeb ste/ de yang / de nas 'dir dbang dam par gsungs / /dbang bskur ③med na 'grub pa med/ /yon tan ldan pa'i sngags pa yis/ /'di la dbang byin yon tan 'grub/ /ces bya bas dbang nod 5pa'i yon tan ston te/ dbang bskur zhing dam tshig dang ldan na/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis 'thob par lung gis bstan pa'o/ /dang por khrus byas gos gyon te/ /rgyal po'i cha lugs 'dra ba dang / /bud med lta bu'i tshul ldan pas/ /slob dpon bla mar gyur pa la/ /dbang rnams nod par rab tu gsungs/ /zhes bya bas/ dbang nod pa'i phyir dbang gi sngon du spyod lam de'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ston te/ de nas bzlas pa dang / bsgom pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rnams byas la/ phyir 'byung 5la slob ma gzhug par bya ste/ slob dbon du 'os pa'i slob ma las thams cad pa'i chus bsangs la/ rdo rje sems dpar byen gyis brlabs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa la/ rdo rje gnod sbyin yongs su bzlas pa'i gos dmar po'i 7 stod g.yogs dang / smad g.yogs bskon la/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces 8mngon par bsngags la/ gos dmar po las byas pa'i gtsug tor dang / sgo srung bzhi'i snying po yongs su bzlas 33—861

pa'i ri17 gos dmar pos gdong bcings la/ yon gyi dam pa dag phul ba yongs su bzung ste de'i snying ga dang dpral ba dang / gog ma dang / spyi bo rnams su 3 rdo rje dang / rin po che ༄ dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje zla ba'i ④steng du de'i sa bon gyi sarnam par dgod pa/ phyogs bzhi nas sngon bzhin phyag 'tshal du bcug la/ des kyang ⑥ de bzhin du rdo rje la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa byed du nus par byin gyis brlab par bsam mo/ /de nas shar phyogs kyi sgor bzhag la/ de bzhin du sdom pa sbyin 7no/ /oṃ bo bye tsistot+pā da yā 5 mi/ zhes brjod do/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed nas su/ /snying pos rab tu gzhag 9par bya/ /de nas su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho/ sibye 7badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes bskul lo/ /de nas sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig gi 11phyag rgya 'ching du gzhug cing / de bzhin du phreng ba 'dzin du gzhug go/ /de nas sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod la slob ma nang du gzhug go/ /de nas 'di skad ces kyang bsgo'o/ /deng khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'grub pa'ang thob na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyi sa dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la ma smra zhig /dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya kha thur du bstan la/ rdo rje slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni khyod kyi trerdo rje dam tshig yin gyis7/ gal te 'ga' zhig la smras na klad pa 'gas par 'gyur 33—862

ro—/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya de nyid dang / mna'i chu'i snying pos lan cig bsngags la/ slob ma 'thung du gzhug go/ /de la mna'i snying po ni 'di yin te/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs mdzad kyis—/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /oṃ badzod ka ṭha⑫ / 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs 1na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rngo chu 'dis 'grub/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya rnams/ /gal te dkyil 'khor ma mthong t+thasathu/ /skye bo'i tshogs na 'dug pa 'am/ /dad pa med par bgad phyepar 'gyur/ /de nas slob ma de la 'di skad bsgo shigathu /deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje ni nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di gyis zhes bsgo ba gang yin pa de yang bya dgos so/ /khyod nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /mi bde ba ma spangs par khyod 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ dmyal bar thong bar gyur ta re zhes smras la 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs ྅ la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig ces spros shig ces bsgo'irkye/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis myur du sems dpa' rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcings la/'di skad du brjod du gzhug go/ /'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med ni/ /de ring nyid du dbab par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā kye be+e sha a/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas phyag rgya bcings pa las byung nas/ de'i snying gar zhugs te/ rdo rje sems dpa' tsobabs par gyur par bsams na/ babs par 'gyur ro/ /yang na ho a ho zhes bya ba rang gi snying ga'i zla ba la bkod de/ se'u'i (7me tog dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems 33—863

dpa' rang gi dam tshig dang bcas pa rang gi snying po las nges par phyung /la/badz+ra badzha traṭa ces tshibya bas de'i snying kha phye la/ der bcug ste/ rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya bcings la/ sngags brjod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gang las gyur par bsams na yang 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /khro bo'i khu tshur bcings la rdo rje sems dpa' phye na yang 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i rdo rje tshig lan bdun nam brgyad brjod pas kyang 'bab par 'gyur ro / /slob ma'i gtso bo'i snying gar rdo rje bya/ /yi ge brgya pas brtan por byas nas ni/ /bdag lus kyis ziyin snod kyi sgo dbye zhing / /snying la gnas nga/'i rdo rje dbus su blta/ /sngags kyi bdag po yi ge a dmar gzugs/ /brjod pas yang dag chags par g.yo bar blta5/ /zhes pas so/ /de nas oṃ pa ra ma su khā sha ya su la li ta/ bi sa la na mi ter/ na ma mi bha ga bān ta 6 dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ hi hi hi hi hiḥ/ pra tits+tsha 3badz+ra ku su ma/ añja li nā tha horu /zhes brjod pa'i sngags 'dis phreng ba de dkyil 'khor du dor ro/ /de nas dngos grub rab 'bring me tog babs pa las brtag par bya ste/ lha rnams kyi khyad par dang / gnas kyi khyad par las brtag par bya ste/ gang tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyi/ /dbu la me tog babs gyur na/ /de tshe gtsug tor mdzod spu dag /'grub par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /zhal du bab rngun 'grub par 'gyur/ /stod du bab tson mchog rnams 'grub/ /rked du bab 1 na 'bring rnams 'grub/ /ro smad phyogs su bab kon ni/ /dngos grub phal rnams 'grub nga ra 'gyur/ /bar gyi sku la bab shā/na ni/ /snying po la sogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /smad du bab ngapar gyur na ni/ /mngag gzhug la sogs 33—864

'grub par 'gyur/ /rim pa de dag thams cad ni/ /rigs bzhi rnams las shes par bya/ /de bzhin lha rnams gzhan la yang / /dngos grub rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /gal te lha yi gzugs dag las/ /me tog ring du lhung gyur na/ /de ni dngos grub yun ring 'gyur/ /nye na dngos grub myur du 'grub//gsang sngags rnams kyi mchod pa dag /gang du 'gram pa tshun chod ni/ /de yi sa yis khyede yin te/ /me tog de ②lhung de yi rigs/ /lha gnyis kyi ni bar dag tu/ /gal te me tog bab gyur na/ /gang du nye bar gyur pa ni/ /de ni de yi rigs su bshad/ /gal te la la'i rnge tog ni/ /dkyil 'khor mang po 'das nas babs/ /de la dngos grub phal 'grub cing / /de ni dad pa'ang rab tu chung / /gal te me tog bor ba dag /ra ba'i ri bo la bab na/ /zhi ba'i bya bas de nas sdod/ /nan tan bskyed de 'dor cho du gzhug /de ste the tshom gyur na ni/ /mkhas pas bzlas ⑤te 'dor mi gzhug /de ni gang yang nges med pas/ /de ni dngos grub 'thob mi 'gyur/ /gnyis kyi bar du mnyam pa dang / /don med phyi rol ltung na ni/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byas nas su/ /de nas me tog 'dor du gzhug /snying por me tog bab na ni/ /rtag tu don med mi 'gyur bshad/ /srad bu 67dag gi cho ga bzhin/ /de yi nye hūṃ'akhor shes par bya/ /de la sogs pa'i rnam pa yi/ /me tog rnams ni bor ba las/ /bdag gi mdun du gang lhung ni/ /de la zhi ba brtsam kyepar bya/ /sbyin sreg gis ni zhi byas nas/ /de ni slar la 'dor tsadu gzhug /lan gsum stsogs kye te bor na yang / /gal te legs par ma babs na/ /re thag gcad tsosprede slar gtang ngo / /de nas me tog bab 7pa las lha yang 12dag par shes par byas nas 33—865

phreng ba blangs te/ oṃ pra ti grit+tha rmyeswa mi baṃ/ satwo ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod nas—/ de'i mgo la bcing ngo / /ye shes babs pa'i mtshan ma las/ /nye bar mtshon nas de la mig gis ci mthong zhes dris te/ des ci ④ltar mthong ba de ༄ snabazhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gal te dkar po snang ba mthong na ni/ /de la dngos grub mchog bslab thubo/ /gal te ser po mthong na ⑤ de la don 'byung ba'i ye shes bslab par bya'o/ /gal te dmar po mthong na de la rjes su chags pa'i ye shes bslab bo/ /'on te nag por mthong ba 4de la mngon spyod kyi ye shes bslab dz+wabo/ /gal te sna tshogs par mthong na/ /de la dngos grub thams cad kyi ye shes bgrol nas lku bslab par bya'o zhes rgya cher sbyar ro/ /de nas snying po 'dis gdong g.yogs bkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra satwa ya yan tet+ya/tsakyu gha ta na pa rota gha 9 ta ma ti/ sarba k+ko badz+ra tsakyu ma nut+ta re/ de nas he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bgrol nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po bstan par bya/ /de nas bla ma dgar gyur nas/ /slob ma de la 'di skad bsgo/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khrod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes khu/ /sngags dang rig pas byin kyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum dngos grub kyang / /thams cad khyod la mngon du 'gyur/ /dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs/ /gsang sngags la yang brtson par kyis/ /de nas dkyil 'khor kyi de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/mi mnyam med par zur bzhi snyoms/ /dran dang dbang po sgo bzhi ste/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi rta babs bzhi/ /ting 'dzin khyams su shes par bya/ /khyams las bden pa'i rdo rje dag /gzungs /nyurnams lha mos mchod pa yin/ /rgyan 33—866

rnams kun gyis bkra ba yang / /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o/ /gdul byas shebaskyod pa sna tshogs mchog /dar 'phan dril bu sgrog pa yin 3/ /me long ye shes rtag mi rtog /byang chub yan lag me tog phreng / /dra ba dra phyed rin chen mchog /nyi ma zla ba yang dag ldan/ /kun 'grub mi zad bde ba ste/ /bde ba chen po zhes grags pa'o/ /de ni nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /ka ba dkyil 'khor brgyad pa yi/ /dngos grub bde ba kun ster ba'i/ /rnam thar brgyad po de nyid yin/ /theg pa chen po byang chub sems/ /mdo sde 'khor lo bskor bas na/ /rdo rje thig gis yongs gdab cing / /thams cad du yang yongs su rdzogs/ /gang dag 'jug pa tsam gyis ni/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi ldog dang / /bde ba chen po rab 'grub phyir/ /de dag dag par yang dag 'gyur—/ /de nas phyag rgya dang snying po yang bshad par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'bebs pa nas brtsams te/ mgon po rnam snang gi bar du byebastan par bya'o ///shu dang po sdeg pa bsreg 4 byas nas/ /de la dbab dang dral ba bya/ /de dag kun gyi rim pa yang / /rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa ltar/ /'dir ni de dag bya ba yin/ /zhes bya bas/ dbang bskur ba'i slob ma rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir sdig pa bsreg klupa ni/ til gyi sreg blugs sdig pa bsreg pa'i sngags dang bcas pa byebargya rtsa brgyad kyis zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byas la/ de nas thal mo dam du bsdams la/ sor mo thams cad bsnol ba ni/ /rdo rje thal mor bka' stsal te/ /rab tu bsdams phyir rdo rje bsdams/ /badz+ra añja li zhes (rdo rje thal mo'i ༄ sngags so/ /badz+ra brnya zhes brjod cing slob ma'i snying gar lan gsum dral bar bya'o/ /de nas ye shes dbab pa ni/ /badz+ra ā 13be+e sha a zhes bya bas 33—867

rdo rje dbab pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings pa la/ a a zhes pa 1a brgyas slob ma la dbab par bya'o/ /mchod pa'i lan dang sbyin pa dang / /zhes bya bas / slob mas slob dpon la mchod pa rnam pa lnga dbul ba bstan pa'o/ /sbyin pa dang zhes bya bas dbang bskur ba'i sngon yon bzhin du slob dpon la dbul bar 3snabastan pa'o/ /rim pa dang ldan pas dbang bskur te/ de nas de la chu dbang bskur/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya'i dbang dang ni/ /cod pan dar dpyangs rdo rje dang / /bdag po ming la sogs pa dang / /zhes bya bas/rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi dbang dang drug bskur bar bstan pa ni/ gang du me tog bab par gyur pa de'i ri rigs dang gzugs su bskyed la/ de'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ snying po 'di dang rdo rjes chobyin gyis brlabs pa'i bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a r+bha ṣiñcatre/ de nas de dang rjes su mthun pa'i cod pan dang / dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur lartse/ rang gi mtshan ma'i dbang bskur ba lag tu byin te/ mtshan ma dang rjes su mthun par sngags 'di 7brjod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje'i kyedabang / /di shesnaring khyod la bskur bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun du dbang bskur phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /rang gi mtshan mas bdag po'i dbang gi snying po 'dis sbyin par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra a bye pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a dzha ṣiñca mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ de nas snying po 'dis dril bu sbyin par bya'o/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde/ ār+ya 1yinut+pan+da tāta/ de nas snying po 'dis lnga5rdo rje ming gi ⑫dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ a 6bhi ṣiñca mi / badz+ra nā ma a bhe thuṣe ka ta/ kye rdo rje zhes gang gis ming gang brjod pa 33—868

der skye zhes brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i kyephyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung 2/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /zhes bya bas lag tu rdo rje byin la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya/ tiṣ+ṭha e ༄ ṣa two dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi t+t+waṃ/ zhes so/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po'i tshul du bzhag la/ spos la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod la sngags kyis bskul ba'i tshig brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i sngags byen la/ phyag rgya bzhi'i ye shes bzlas par bya ba ni/ rig pa'i dbang bsgur ba'o / /slob mas kyang rdo rje thal mo bskor ba byas la phyag bya ste/ phreng ba bcing ba mul sogs thams cad gzung ñcabar bya'o/ /rig pa'i dbang bsgur ba'i cho ga'o / / ༄dz+wadabang rnams sdogs nas dbang byin pa/ /gsang ba'i dbang dang nges pa'i dbang / /rim pa bzhin du rab tu bskur/ /de nas bkra shis brjod bya zhing / /zhes bya bas/ rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba ston te/ de yang de nas slob dpon du 'os pa'i slob mas yon bzang po phul la / gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchog chen sprul cho mdzad pa/ /bdag la bsrung ba'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol(/ /slob dpon rnam par snang mdzad chen po nyid du gyur pas/ shar phyogs kyi sgo'i mthar sna tshogs pad+ma bris la/ slob ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i skur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnas par bsams la/rdo rje sems ma la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs te/ dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /yang na dkyil 'khor las khru gsum tsam yongs su dor bar dbang bsgur ba'i sgo la mngon par phyogs par byas la /rmā/ nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad tsam 33—869

la / zur bzhi pa la/ sgo nub phyogs su bltas pa'i dkyil 'khor tshon sna lngas bris la/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bris/ de'i steng du seng ge'i gdan zla ba'i steng du dkyil 'khor ras kyis bkab pa dang seng ge'i gdan 1gyi steng du bla re bye zhing g.yas logs su (gdar dang / me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa'i gdugs rtse mo dkar ba dang / dmar ba la gtsug tor gdugs dkar pos yongs su bzlas la/ g.yon du dar dang / ras sna tshogs pas bkra ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan oṃ yongs su bzlas pa 1legs par bzhag la mchod yon phul te/ me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod cing ④/rnga bo che dang / rnga rings dang / dung la sogs pa'i rol mo phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs 5pa dang / phyi'i gar dang glu la sogs pa dang / sgeg mo la sogs pas 6mchod cing / bkra shis kyi glu len cing / dril bu dkrol bzhin du rdo rje 'be+ebs pa la sogs pa'i chu rnams kyis/ de'i sngags gdon pa sngon du 'gro ba nyid dang / rdo rje slob dpon chen po nyid du dbang bskur bar bya ste/oṃ badz+ra a bye 3ṣiñca/ zhes bya ba dang / ji srid par rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i bar dang dbang bskur ro/ /de nas de'i mgor yang 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku gzugs de'i dam tshig gi khyephyag rgyas bzung ⑨la/ oṃ ma hā su kha snabadz+ra satwa dzaḥdzaḥtsohūṃ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta s+t+waṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags bzlas la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i slob dpon du 'gyur ro/ /shes rab yan lag 'dus pa'i rdo rje las byung ba'i / /byang chub sems kyis 'jam dbyangs byang chub bde dbang bskur/ /rgyal mchog sras bcas rnams kyis legs gsung tshabakra shis gang / /des beni khyod kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas kun gyis nam 33—870

—mkha'i khams/ /yongs su gang bar rnam par bsgom/ /phyi rol dri sogs dam tshig gis/ /sprin ltar brtul zhugs can gyis bsgom/ /yang na rdo rje dbyings kyi ni/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis kyerdo rje bsgom/ /dam tshig mchog gi 3bum pa yang //'dzin par mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon bka' drin gyis/ /de tshe de la dbang bskur ba/ /rdzogs sangs rdo rje lha mo rnams/ /rang nyid gsol bar mdzad par 'gyur/ /de nas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa rdo rje khu tshur gyes bzung nas dbang bskur bar snabya ste/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ ma hā su kha 4badz+ra satwa a t+ta byeṣe ka na hūṃ/ a bhi ṣidzi tremi/ sarba badz+ra a bye pa ti two dṛ 7ḍho me bha ba/ sidha na ma ste bha ga bānasnye/ ma hā badz+ra dha ra su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ ma hā badz+ra satwa oṃ bhur ju wa swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'dis lag pa gnyis su rdo rje byin la/phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod de sngags brjod par bya'o/ /me tog ma'i gzugs kyis me tog gis gtor la/ deng tshun chad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bzhed 9pas mchod na khyed mchod pa'i — snayan lag rdzogs shing / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang / dpe byad rnams kyis brgyan par nyunyebyas pa'i skur mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes brjod do/ /de nas bdug pa ma'i gzugs kyis bdug pas bdugs la 'di skad ces brjod do/ /gang gis sems can thams cad tshim par 'gyur ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad khyed la bdug par 'tshal bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas mar me ma'i gzugs su mar me nye bar bstan la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ deng nas brtsams te rdo rje chos dang 'dra bar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan la yang dag par 'bar bas/ ma rig pas khebs pa'i sems can rnams la ye shes kyi snang bas 33—871

snang ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byug pa ma'i gzugs can gyis kyebyug pas byugs la/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ deng tshun chad khyod sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / 'jig rten thams cad du yang tshul dzams dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab la sogs pa'i dri'i rgyun ster bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas ho zhes bya bas gzhu byin nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyis shig ces brjod de/ phyogs bzhir mda' bzhi 'phen du gzhug cing steng dang 'og tu yang re re 'phen du gzhug go/ /de nas sha dha bhañja ga byin la/ 'dis dngos grub thams cad dang / nye bar spyod pa thams cad sprul pa nye bar longs spyod cing / gzhan dag la yang byin cig /de nas chos kyi 'khor lo rkang pa gnyis kyi dbus su bzhag cing / dung yang lag pa g.yas par byin te/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang / smra ba gnyis kyi chos kyi yi ge dang lhan cig byen la/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 3cig /di ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /skyob pa rnams kyis —'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pas/ /kun du ma lus gang bar gyis/ /som nyi yid gnyis mi bya zhing / /dogs 4nga/ med pa'i sems kyis su/ /gsang sngags spyod pa tshul gyi 5mchog /'jig rten 'di la rab tu sgrogs/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la / /phan 'dogs drin du gzo 5zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang / /kun du rjod la srung bar byed/ /de nas/ 'jig rten kun la phan pa'i 7phyir//'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /zhes brjod la/ rgyal bar gyur cig /33—872

rgyal bar gyur cig /rdo rje rigs kyi bdag po'i rdo rje'i 2'khor lo bskor cig ces brjod do/ /mdor na 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i ༄ —phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la/ rgyal bar gyur cig /rgyal bar gyur cig /rin po che'i rigs kyi bdag po'i ③rin po che'i 'khor lo bskor cig ces brjod do/ /de nas/ mdor na 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir / /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la/ /rgyal bar gyur cig /rgyal bar gyur cig /pad+ma'i rigs kyi bdag po'i jechos kyi 'khor lo bskor sacig ces brjod do/ /de nas/mdor na 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i 6phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba tsu7sna tshogs pa'i/ /las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la/ rgyal bar gyur cig /rgyal bar gyur cig /las kyi rigs kyi bdag po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor cig ces brjod do/ /de nas/ mdor na 'jig rten thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i 8phyir/ /ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la/rgyal bar gyur cig /rgyal bar gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor rngucig ces brjod par bya'o/ /de nas slob mas rdo rje sems dpar bsgoms la/ de bzhin du bzhag ste/ gzengs bstod pas ni dngos po kun/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid de/ /rdo rje ming dbang bskur bas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs par 1 lung bstan to/ /oṃ/nga yis 'di ltar khyod lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /33—873

dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sidhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur bhu wa swaḥtsho / gzengs bstod pa ni 'di yin te/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying khar bzhag la/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin te/ 'dis phyag rgya chen po mchog tu gsang ba'i cho gas lung bstan par bya ste/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad rang gi dbang gi 1slob dpon dang mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad de/ 'di lta ste / 'di nyid kyang gzengs bstod pa'i phyag rgya chen pos mchog tu gsang ba'i dngos grub mchog 'grub pa'i byin rlabs 4dang / gsang sngags 'di'i stobs la dad par bya'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /mthong ba dang ni zhugs 5pa yis/ /srid pa kun las rnam grol bar/ /khyod ni di ring gnas pa yin/ /bde chen theg pa 'di las ni/ /slar khyod 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi sod 4pas/ /byus kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin//slob ma gus pas bla ma yi/ /rkang pa gnyis la phyag byas te/ /de nas ji skad gsungs pa kun/ /rjes su grub par khas blang ngo / /de ltar dam bcas byas nas ni/ /cho ga 'di yis rang nyid kyis/ /rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa ྅ni/ /blangs nas kyang ni de la sbyin/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcing rirnyi/ /phyag na rdo rje'i 33—874

brtul zhugs brtan she)/ /de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sed+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e rngu ṣa two dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwo hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro ba/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub rdo rje rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes brjod la dril bu sbyin no/ /de ltar dbang bskur byas nas ni/ /de nas sar pa'i gos rnams bskon/ /me tog dri la sogs pas mchod/ /mchod phyir gdu bu bcang bar bya/ /de nas bla ma bdag nyid kyis/ /de yi spyi bor gdugs kyang gzugs/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bskor du gzhug /gdugs dang bcas pa sgo phyogs su/ /spyi bo btud de phyag 'tshal gzhugacho /slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags/ /gsang sngags rgyud ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /mkhan pos de skad smras nas su/ /gdugs bzhag nas ni slob ma de/ /lag par legs par blangs nas su/ /de nas 'di skad bsgo bar bya/ /de ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon 'gyur/ /gsang sngags rgyud kyang 'dzin par 'gyur / /sangs rgyas /phyebyang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis bkur bar 'gyur/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse'i phyir/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /nan tan bskyed 6de bri bar gyis/ /sgrub pa po yang rgyud la sbyor/ /khyod kyis chos la ser sna dang / /sems can rnams la mi phan pa/ /nyams pa chen por 'gyur kyang ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi bya'o/ /de nas bkra shis brjod bya zhing / /zhes bya bas dbang bskur zin nas bkra shis brjod par bya ste/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dra 33—875

ba'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis de ni skye dgu zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos ①pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /rgyal ba bzhin du 'akying snyebacas pas/ /g.yog dang ldan pas slob dpon la/ /lan gsum bskor bas tshigs bcad kyis/ /bla ma de ni gzengs bstod bya/ /kye bdag ni rim pas dbugs phyung ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam la dgod/ /sa la nges par dbang bsgur te/ /shin tu gzi ldan bkra shis mchog /ces brjod pas gshegs su gsol te/thu/ de nas rang yang khyim du 'gro/ /khyim du phyin nas 'khor dag la/ /slob dpon 'di ni dam tshig pas/ /bdag kyang dam tshig mchog dang ldan/ /'di la rim gro phun sum tshogs / /rta dang glang po nor dang 'bru/ /rin po che dang ci bzhed pa/ /khyed cag nga la ma 'dri bar/ /slob dpon 'di la de phyir phul/ /zhes bya bas/bla ma la yon dbul ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha gshegs shing / sprul pa rang la 4bsdu ba dang / tshon phyag cing dkyil 'khor kyi rdzas la sogs pa ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa bstan pa ni/ de nas/ bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis sbyin par bya/ /des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rang gi dam tshig slob dpon ni/ /sbyin min bu dang chung ma dang / /rang srog gis rtag brten byas san/ /longs spyod 33—876
