g.yo bas 7bhesmos ci dgos/ /gang phyir bskal pa bye ba 〈ni/ /grangs med par yang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang ri/rtsod ldan la/ /tshe 'di nyid la ster bar byed/ /rtag tu khyod kyis dam tshig srungs/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu sbyin pa nyid du 'gyur//de byin bsod nams mchog dag gis/ /dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bcas te/ /gang 'dir —legs par gnas pas na/ /dam tshig lha rnams kun dang mnyam/ /rang 'byung sadu yang de skyes so/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pa/ /kun gyis deng khyod dbang bskur bas/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal po che/ /rgyal po'i bdag por bstan pa yin/ /des ni bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab tu bzhugasatre/ /khyed rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas te/ /de nyid thob par the tshom med/ /de nas me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod la legs par bstod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba btab cing bzod par gsol ba rtsel nyi ma 'char ba'i dus su rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ gyen du bkrol te snying po 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ kṛ to pa sarba satwa arjacho/ sid+dhi ma haṃ tsudwa ma thā nu ga ta/ gats+tsha two budha bi shi yo/ su na ra ga ma na ya tu/ badz+ra satwa mu de / mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams ni/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya bas/ rang gi lus la nye bar bsdu bar bya'o/ /de nas snying ga nas byung ba'i rdo rje rin chen gyi phyag rgyas rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas na 'dug pas dbang bskur la/ mdzub mo gnyis kyis phreng ba bcings pa / go cha 33—877

bcing ba snying po 'dis bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a ༄spur+bha ṣiñca/ sarba mu ṭa me dre /sa—ṭaṃ ku ru pa ra ka pa tse na baṃ/ go cha'i mthar phreng ba bcings pa bkrol geb la thal mo sbyar te/ bdag nyid mnyam pa'i thal mos dgyes pa'i snying po 'dis bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tu bye ho/ yi ge brgya pa brjod la/ rdo rje dga' bas legs so zhes bya ba byen te4/ legs so rdo rje sems dpa' khyod/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so / /rdo rje chos khyod legs pa ste/ /rdo rje las ni khyod legs so/ /theg pa chen po bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /theg pa chen po mdor bsnyu ba'i5/ /mdo 'di yang ni legs par bshad/ /oṃ badz+ra kri li tī la 6ya/ badz+ra be+espyo 7badz+ra dhā ra añja ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces 37bya bas phur bu bton 9la 'o mas bkru'o/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde/ ār+ya nut+pan+da twata/zhes pa 'dis/ tshon rtsi rnams shā1bsdus la 'bad pas/ chu klung chen por dor bar bya'o/ /de nas gnas kyang ba glang gi lci bas nye bar byugs la/bza' ba dang ni bca' ba rnams/ /ci dga' bar ni sbyin par bya/ /khyi dang bya rog la sogs la/ /cung zad tsam yang mi sbyin no/ /yo byad rdzas rnams thams cad ni/ /slob dpon dag gis basbus nas ni/ /slob ma rnams la bgor mi rung / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni yo byad kun/ /slob dpon bdag nyid dbang bar bshad/ /gal te slob mas spyad na ni/ /dam tshig las ni nyams par 'gyur/ /gang zhig spyod par mi 'dod na/ /de yi cho ga'i go rims kye 'di'o / /dkon mchog gsum kyi yo byad du/ /de dag cho ga bzhin du dbul//gdugs dang rnga yab dri la sogs/ /sangs rgyas nyid la dbul bar bya/ /gdan dang gdugs 1 spos dri la sogs/ /dam pa'i chos la dbul bar bya/ /33—878

gos dang yo byad snod la sogs/ /dge 'dun rnams la dbul bar bya de dag la ni slob ma yis/ /cung zad tsam yang mi bskur ro/ /dge 'dun med na dge slong sbyin/ /yang na dge slong ma la sbyin/ /gal te bdag nyid mi 'dod na/ /dge bsnyen dag la sbyin par bya/ /de nas de yi phyi de nyin/ /nyes byas lhag ma zhi bya'i phyir/ /mkhas pa yis hūṃni zhi ba yi/ /sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /slob mas bdag zhi bya ba'i phyir/ /spyan la sogs pa'i gsang sngags dang / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /byams pa chen po'ang bsgom 7par bya/ /nyes byas thams cad zhi bya'i phyir/ /de nas zhi ba chen po bya/ /de dag ni gzhug cing dbang bsgur ba'i rim pa'o/ /gzhan yang sbyin sreg byed pa na/ /las gzhan 3de dag gzhan pa ④min/ /bdag gi las dang gzhan dag ste/ /shi dang gson gyi las su bstan/ /zhes bya bas/ bdag thudang gzhan don du sbyin sreg bya ba spyir mdor bstan pa'o/ /de yang / shi dang gson gyi las su bstan/ /zhes bya bas gzhan don bya ba khyad par du mdor bstan pa'o/ /de la bdag gi las bstan pa/ /zhes bya ba nas/ de ni bdag gi don bya ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes bya ba'i bar gyis bdag gi don bya ba'i 'usbyin sreg bstan pa'o/ /de yang / de dbus 7gsum las lha rnams bskyed2 // /ces bya bas yig 'bru dang phyag mtshan dang lha bskyed pa ste cho ga gsum la bya'o/ /de la a yis 1byin brlabs te/ /zhes bya bas lha'i byin gyis brlab pa ste/ dbu la oṃ mgrin par s+dza'am byāḥdang / thugs kar hūṃ bsam pa la bya'o/ /'di las ma gsungs gzhan dag las/ /rgyas par bstan de der shes bya/ /zhes bya bas/ gzhung 'di sbyin sreg ma rgyas pas/ /mtshan 33—879

yang dag par sdogs pa'i sbyin sreg rgyas pa dang / rgyas pa gzhan dang gzhan bzhin 'dir bya bar gsungs pa'o/ /gzhan don bya ba'i rim pa yang / /shi dang na ba gnyis yin te/ /zhes bya bas/ gzhan don bya ba 7mdor bstan pa'o / /de la na ba'i las bya ba zhes bya ba nas/ na ba las thar pa'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes bya ba'i bar gyis/ gang dag bgegs la sogs pa rnams kyis na ba la/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis zhi ba'i las bya la/ gang dag zhi bar ma gyur pa rnams 'a/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gis las bya zhes pa'i don to/ /de nas shi ba la phan gdags pa'i rim pa 'byung ste/ jo'i sngon du 'gro 2snaba'i cho ga dang / ro sta gon la gnas pa dang / ro ༄ sbyin sreg chen pos sbyang ba dang gsum gyi rim pa ston te/ dkyus dkrugs pa'i phyir gsal bar bya ba ni/ de nas shi la phan gdags na/ /dang por gnod pa'i bgegs bsal 4nas/ /ro la phan pa'i cho ga ni/ /phan pa'i gnod sbyin chus btab la/ /dang por bkru ba'i las yin no/ /de nas rnam rgyal chus bkang ba'i/ /bum pas bkrus te bgegs bskrad la/ /de nas de la bsrung bar bya'o/ /a yis kun khyab spyi steng 5bsam/ /lhag 'gyur lha ni sngon bzhin bsam/ /a las 9ye shes lnga yis gang / /de nas a yi spro bsdu bya/ /de nas gang shi de nyid la/ /mig la a a zhes bkod de / /de ni sngon gyi cho ga'o/ /zhes bya bas/ ro'i sngon du bya ba'i rim pa ni/dang por gnod pa'i bgegs bsal te/ gang zhe na/ snang la bden pa bdar ba ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs 7dang / rig sngags dang / gsang sngags dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / ting nge 33—880

—'dzin dang / rig sngags kyi lha thams cad kyi bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs 1kyis/tshe 'das pa 'di la gson gyi dus su brnyas 2byed pa/ gshin gyi dus su gcags byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad skad cig kyang ma gnas par dengs shig ces byas la/ yungs kar brdeg cing /hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis byen gyis brlabs pa'i bum pa'i chus bkrus la bgegs kyis mi tshugs par bsam de nas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i chus bkrus la sgrib pa thams cad dag par bsam / de nas ro'i spyi bo'i steng du a bsams la/ de gyur pa las kho rang gi lhag pa'i lha ru bskyed/ de nas yang snying gar a bsams la/ de las ye shes kyi 'od zer 'phros pas ro ye shes lnga dang ldan par gyur par bsams4/de nas ro'i lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po bsam/ mgrin par zla ba'i steng du dīḥdamar po bsam mo zhesna//snying gar zla ba'i steng hūṃhūṃ nag po bsam/ de nas skye mched drug la dbyangs kyi yi ge 3zung re re shedagod do/ /de ni rten sbyang ba'o/ /de nas shes pa dgug pa ni/ gong gi bden pa bdar 9la/ tshe 'das pa'i ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod/'di nas shi ba'i dus byas nas/ ngan song gsum la sogs pa 'gro ba gang na gnas — /kyang rung / skad cig gis 'dir khugs par gyur cig /de nas sngags brjod pa ni/ oṃ sarba bid sarba pā paṃ ā kaste 11ya hūṃ dza a ṇi sum̐ tsotri pre du dza / zhes brjod cing / snying ga nas 'od 'phros pa las khugs par bsam mo//dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbarjod la yang bstem par bsam mo/ /de nas gcags 1 dang dbral ba ni/ bo/nga gi bden pa bdar mu la/ gong ma ltar 'dir yang bgegs bskrad 33—881

do / /de nas 'gro ba rigs drug nas drang ba rmyeni/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi snying pos 'gro ba rigs 2drug nas ro'i shes pa drangs hūṃ nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bras bu thob par bsam mo/ /de nas gtang bar bya ba ni/ mchod pa'i bye brag ro la dbul ba dang / me tog gi char dbab par bya'obye/ /de dag ni sngon du bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /de nas gnas pa'i cho ga bshad/ /shi ba dkyil 'khor dbus bzhag ste/ /zhag lnga slob dpon smyung 57gnas te/ /bgegs bskrad la sogs byas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i thulha rnams mdun bsams te 7 / /phyag 'tshal spro bskyed la sogs bya/ /de nas tshig 'di ched brjod kyebya/ /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang trebhe'abras bur bcas/ /lha dang dam tshig gis mnyam par/ /gyur par 7 snabadag ni je tshom med/ /byang chub sems dang sems gabyug pas/ /mi ldog par ni bdag gyur te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su ni/ /deng bdag skye bar the tshom med/ /deng bdag nyi ma dam pa ste/ /bdag gi mchod sbyin bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pos/ /deng bdag 'dul ba'i mchog yin no/ /de nas sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /rgyal mchog la sogs bsgom bya ste/ /sgo dbye la sogs gnas 'dir bshad/ /de nas spos thogs la/ sbyan drang tshig 'di brjod par bya/ /kye dbang bskur nges te bla na med/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/ /'di la phan gdags don ched du/ /gnas 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /'di la dbang ni sprul du gsol/ /de rjes gsang sngags 'di brjod bya/ /oṃ nyu1a sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya ha ra ha ra/33—882

oṃ hūṃ tri 1bha ga bānargya/ dz+nyā na mūrti③/ wā gī shwa ra ma hā wa tsa/ sarba dharma/ga ga na a ma ④la su pa ri shudhe/ dharma dhā tu/ dz+nyā na gar+bha ā5ཿ/ zhes ni brjod pa'i sngags bzlas so/ /dang po sangs rgyas nga rgyal dang / /ldan pas dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir/ /tshigs bcad 'di yis bstod par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bstod bya la / /rang dbang rngubastod de nges pa'i mchog /'bras bu 'byin pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /shi la phan gdags don ched du/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /des ni gsol ba gdab byas nas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas nam mkha' la/ /mngon sum 'dra bar gang bar bsgom//de nas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba dang / /dang po'i byesangs rgyas la sogs pa/ /nam mkha' gang bar 'di bzhes la/ /deng bdag 'dus pa'i mchog yin te/ /de nas til gyis de la ni/ /bskor te sbyin sreg dbul bar bya/ /shi ba sta gon la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes bya bas/ ro sta gon la gnas pa bstan te / de yang de nas ro sta gon la gnas pa ni/ shin tu dbe+en pa'i gnas su/dkyil 'khor 'dom gang gru bzhi pa byas la/ lha rnams kyi gnas su me tog gi tshom bu bkod de/ dbus su khri byas la/ ras bzang po yug gcig gis dkros te/ de'i steng du ro bzhag la/ rdo rje slob dpon kyis dkar gsum bza' zhing za gcig pa'i sgyung ba byas la/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gsum dang ldan par bsgoms nas/ de nas yang sngon bzhin ro'i bgegs bskrad la/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje 'khor lo'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la sprul la/ phyag dang mchod pa dang bstod pa yan chad 9sngon bzhin byas la/ de'i 'og tu tshig 'di brjod par bya ste/ deng 33—883

dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /deng dzobadag 'dus pa mchog yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ de ltar zhag lnga'i bar du nyin zhag re la thun snyebazhi'i spyor bas lha la mchod pa dang ro la yungs kar ram bye mas brab cing sngags rings kyi thubazlas pa bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu nam mkha' na bzhugs pa gshegs su gsol la/ de nas zhag lnga'i nang par slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum sngon bzhin bsgoms la/ de nas spos thogs la spyan drangs tshig 'di brjod par bya/ kye dbang bskur nges te bla na med/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/ /'di la phan gdags don ched du/ /gnas 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /'di la dbang ni stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod la ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar bsam mo/ /de nas zhag drug pa la dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su/ zhi ba'i thab 2bcas te til nag bos sdig pa sbyang ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o / /de nas gzugs brnyan kyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir 'dud nyi shus bstod pa bya'o5/ /de dag ni ro sta gon la gnas pa'i cho ga'o / / tsude nas sngon gyi spyor ba yis/ /cho ga rnams ni spyad 7par bya/ /dang po'i cho ga'i rim pa nas/ /'khor lo rim pa 'dir gsungs te/ /phyi zhe rol phyung ste gtor ma sbyin / /de nas khrus byas mchod pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus par ni 'dir bshad do / /de nas phyi yi rim ldan pas/ /sngags pa chas gos ldan pa yis/ /shin tu bsgyings pas brgyan byas te/ /zhag bdun nang par sbyin sreg bya/ /mi nyid shi ba'i gnas byas te/ /shi la phan pa'i dkyil 'khor ldan/ /gzhal yas khang pa 9de 'dra ba/ /'di la gsungs te gzhan du min/ /'di ltar gsungs 33—884

pa'i cho ga ni/ /bdag gis rang bzor 7ma byas te/ /'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / /cho ga 'dus pa'i rgyud las te/ /des na 'dir ni 'os pa yin/ /'di ni shi ba'i cho ga'o/ /shi ba la phan gdags pa'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes bya bas / ro sbyin sreg chen pos sbyang ba ste/ de yang de nas zhag bdun pa la ro dkyil 'khor chen pos 3sbyang ba'i phyir/ slob dpon rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan la/ dang por gtor ma btang la/ de nas sa'i cho ga dang / thig gi cho ga dang / rdul tshon 'bri ba ༄/gzhung bzhin du byas ༄la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bsreg 5khang brtsigs hūṃpa dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor phyag rgyas 7dgod pa dang / rgyan dgod pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad la sogs pa gzhung bzhin du bkug la/ de nas ro bsreg ༄shekhang du drangs te/ bsreg 9 khang la lan gsum bskor la/ shar phyogs nas nang du gzhug /de nas slob dpon gyes—/ dang po'i spyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin nas bzung 7ste/ yongs su dze+egs pa'i ting nge 'dzin yan chad bsgoms la/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa sdogs par byas te/ de nas rlung g.yab kyis nyu1me sbar la me'i pra 5 brtag ste/ dam tshig gi me lha bskyed pa dang / mtshan nyid kyi me lha spyan drang ba dang / mdun gyi nam mkha' la bstod pa dang / dgug gzhug bcing bar bya nyu2ba dang / phyag rgyas gdab pa dang / byin gyis brlab pa dang / dbang bsgur ba dang /mchod pa dang bsreg skrurdzas phul ba yan chod byas pa ni me lha'i samachod pa'o/ /de nas me lha'i thugs kar yi ge rja spyolas pho brang rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang bsgoms la/ thab tu me tog re dor zhing / gzugs brnyan gye dkyil 'khor nas me lha'i thugs kar re mos sam dus gcig tu spyan drangs te/33—885

bsreg nga1rdzas rnams dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas mjug gi cho ga ni/ bzod pa gsol3 / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang / phyag rgya dgrol cing ༄ —ye shes gshegs pa dang / bskyed byepa snying gar bsdu ba dang / phur bu gdon zhing phyogs skyong gso ba dang / mchod rdzas la sogs pa bsdu ba dang / dman thum dang rdul tshon phyags la/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas spyan drangs la / chu bo chen por dor bar bya'o/ /de nas ba'i rnam pa lngas skyang nul byas la / thig 4la sogs pa mi mthong bar byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi thog tu spyan gzigs dang / sder bzangs 7la sogs pa bzhag nas bkra shis brjod la/slob ma mgu bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor du phul ba'i yo byad rnams ni slob dpon bkyer bar bya'o/ /de dag ni ngan song nas drang ba'i cho ga'o/ /byang chub kyi lam la dgod pa ni gnyis su shes par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang /dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas phyi de nang par ram zhag gsum na yang rung ste/rus pa 'o mas bkrus / la/ dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i rgyud chen po'am bye ma la uṭī ṣa'i gzungs rgyud chen po nas byung ba bzhin du tsha tsha btab la/ tsha tsha dang po btab pa dang ming byang la/ yid kyis 9bhedakyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang /dbang bskur bar bya ba'am/ yang na slob ma gson po ji ltar 'jug pa ltar dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang / rig pa'i dbang bskur ba dang / slob dpon du dbang bskur ba dang / rjes su gnang ba'i bhedabang bskur ba'o/ /de nas de la lam bstan bya/ /tshogs bsags 13dge ba'i don la sbyar/ /zhes bya bas shi ba'i lam bstan par bya ba ston te/ rdo rje 6slob dpon gyis me tog gabyug gyen du 'phangs te/ song cig song cig rigs kyi bu/ /tshogs kyi lam 33—886

dang spyor ba'i lam/ /mthong ba'i lam dang bsgom tshopa'i lam/ /byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ /mdor na lam ni de rnams su/ /zhugs nas byang chub thob thugyur cig /ces bya'o/ /de nas shi ba'i don du sbyin gtong rgya chen po bya ste/ tsha tsha gshegs su gzhug go/ /ro sbyin sreg chen pos sbyang ba'o/ /de yang lung las/ rdo rje dril bu lag par sbyin/ /mgo la dbu rgyan bskon nga/ra bya/ /rdo rje sdom pa rnams byin te/ /bum pa'i dbang bskur rnams byin la//mig sogs rdo rje gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /rdo rje thab khung rab sbyor kyis/ /'du byed rab tu bya bar bstan/ /nyi ma gsum rgo lon pa na/ /rus pa'i phreng ba bsdus byas la/ /dri dang 'o mas bran nas ni/ /de yis mchod rten du bya ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de mthar de nyid rtag bsgom dang / /zhes pa nas/ rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes bya ba'i bar gyis ༄ snagong thams cad kyi rim par bya ba'i phyir ting nge 'dzin ston te4/ spyir cho ga'i rim pa mothams cad zin nas/ thun mtshams sam/ thun la mi 'jug kyang rung ste/ ye shes pa gshegs shing / de nas gzhal yas khang lha la bsdu ba dang / lha thams cad kyang ༅gtso bo la bsdus la yig 'brur 7bsgom mo/ /yig 'bru ni thams cad kyi ngo bo a ste/ a stong pa nyid las skad cig mas lhar dran par byas nas/ dge ba'i las rnams bya byebar bstan pa'o/ /de nas 'khor lo bstan 9par bya/ /zhes bya ba nas/ shes rab 'khor lor grags pa yin / /zhes bya ba'i bar gyis shes rab kyi 'khor lo bsgom pa bstan pa ste/dkyus nyid gsal ba'i phyir ma bkrol 1nyelo/ /de yang shin tu zab pa dang / bla ma la rag las pa'i man ngag ston te/ de yang dang por bdag nyid khams dang 33—887

sngal/ /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs kun bdag po 'jam dpal dang / /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog dang thun mong sgrub 'dod pa/ /gang zag rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /bla ma rim pa brgyud pa yibye/ /cho ga'i rim pa brjod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor bdun gyi cho ga la / /bsnyen pa sa dang sta gon dang / /dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga'o/ /bsnyen pa'i las su bya ba la/ /dang po las dang sbyor ba gsum/ /mchod bstod bsnyen pa kyebya ba'o/ /dang po'i las su bya ba la/ /nye reg 'thor 'thung stong par bsgom/ /skur gyur lce dang lag pa brlab/ /bsrung dang tshogs bsags rmyephyag lnga bya/ /sdom bzung lus bsregs ⑤skur ldang ngo / /srung la bdag dang gnas bsrung skye7ste/ /bdag nyid bsrung ④ba bya ba yang / /bskyed brlab dbang dang go bgo'o du/ /gnas bsrung tsa ba yi rim pa la/ /bsnun dang 33—897

bsreg dang bcing ba bya/ /khro bo rdo rje'i ra ba sgomakle/ /tshogs bsags thupa yi rim pa yang / /sbyin sreg bya zhing mchod pa brlab/ /rten sprul bstod de gsal bor sgom / /dga' bar gyur pas bstod pa bya/ /phyag mchod sdeg bshags yi rang bya/ /bsgul dang gsol gdab dge ba bsngoge/ /skyabs 'gro lam bstan 5sems bskyed tredo/ /bstod bya gnang sbyin slar she—bstod bya/ /spyor ba gsum la dang po dang / /rgyal mchog dang rgo las dag go/ /dang po'i spyor ba bya ba la/ /ye shes bzhi dang gtso bo bskyed/ /ye shes me long mnyam nyid dang / /so sor chos dbyings nan tan no/ /gzhi la rdo rje mchod rten dang / /chos 'byung rgya gram bsgom pa dang / /gzhal yas gdan dang bcas pa'o / /gtso bo bskyed pa dag la yang / /cho ga rnam pa gsum las su/ /gzhi yi sangs rgyas bskyed pa dang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas 'khor lo dang / /ye shes sems dang zla ba a'o/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bsgom pa yang / /dang por yig 'bru bskyed pa dang / /de las phyag mtshan sku phra mo/ /thig ler gyur te sgu rnams bskyed/ /las kyi rgyal po mchog la ni/ /sgo dbye bsdu bskrad yon dbul bstod/ /bstims 9la bskrad de sgo yang bcad/ /rgyas gdab dbang bskur las la sbyar/ /mchod cing bstod pa bya ba yang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas bye byas la/ /mchod brlab sgo dbye snyan gsan dbab/ /spyan drang bskrad la yon dbul bstod/ /nang du dgug gzhug bya ba dang / /bskrad cing sgo bcad go yang bgo1rte/ /rgyas gdab dbang dang ldan par bya( — / /mchod dang bstod pa rgyas par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa bya ba'i rim pa yang / /phyag byas thugs zhugs la lkesngags brjod/ /sngags dgod brtan byas bzlas pa 0bya/ /33—898

thun mtshams dag tu rang bya la/ /mchod bstod phyag rgya dge ba bsngo/ /bzod gsol lha bsdus spyod lam bya/ /thun la bab lhan nang zhugs bskrad 5/ /sgo bcad lha dgod mchod pa brlab/ /mchod bstod phyag bya yon chab dbul/ /thugs kar zhugs te gong ltar bya/ /thun gsum dag la de dang 'bar/ /thun bzhi pa yi tha ma ru/ /gong ltar byas la don gsol gdab/ /smon lam btab 1la ye shes gshegs/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus te rang la bsrung / /brgya pa bzlas te spyod lam bya'o/ /de ni bsnyen pa rgyas pa'o/ /bsnyen pa basbus pa bya ba yang / /gtso bo yan chad bsgom zibyas la/ /sbyor ba rnam gnyis gzhag trepa ste/ /phyi ma gong ltar bya ba yin/ /grangs dang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa yang / /bzlas dang bsgom pa'i khyad par ro/ /de ltar byas pa'i 5rjes dag la/ /phran tshegs pa ni ci rigs gdags/ /de rnams sngon du bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas sa yi cho ga ste//brtag dang bslang dang sbyang ba dang / /gzung dang rdo rje'i sgrub pa'o/ /brtag pa phyogs dang mtshan nyid dang / /gnas dang lto 'phye tsobartag pa'o/ /bslang rnyib snang dang mi snang ste/ /mi snang ba la bslang ba yang / /maṇ+ḍal byas la dri tshom dgod/ /bdag nyid lhar bskyed lha tshogs sprul/ /de la mchod bstod rngegator ma sbyin/ /lha mo bskyed la spyan drangs te/ /bskrad bstem rgyas gdab dbang bskur bya/ /mchod dang gtor dbul sa bslang —bya/ /ye shes gshegs la dam tshig bstem/ /sbyang ba las dang bya ba dang / /sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang byas te/ /pra brtag bum gzhug hūṃ1'thas par bcag /rdo rje bsgrub par bya ba ni/ /slob dpon rgyan gyis brgyan byas la/ /stegs bu'i dbus su gnas byas te/ /dang por nye reg bya ba nas/ /bzlas la thug pa 33—899

yan chod bya/ /mchod cing bstod la gsol ba gdab/ /dkyil 'khor bteg la rang yang babs/ /gnas gsum brlabs la spro ba bskyed/ /phyag byas spos thogs rmyespyan yang drang / /bka' bsgo bskor te bsrung ba bya/ /rgyu 1mam khaṃ las dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /khro bo gsang ba bstem byas la/ /phur bus gdab pa'i las bya'o/ /sta gon bya ba'i rim pa ni/ /lha dang bum pa sbyin sreg dang / /lha mo dang ni slob ma'o/ /lha yi sta gon bya ba la/ /gnas su dri dang me tog dgod / /de las lhar bskyed bstems ཿla mchod/ /bum pa mtshan nyid ldan byas byel/ /mtshon ⑤ bya mgul chings ⑥kha rgyan te/ /bskrad bdug bsangs la bcud blug go/ /bum pa baṃ las bskyed byas la/ /nang du lha bskyed spyan yang drang / /bstems ⑦la rgyas gdab dbang ldan bya/ /mchod cing bstod la bzlas pa nyabya'o/ /sbyin sreg shar du thab byas la/ /shing bcer ⑨me sbar me lha bskyed / /de la mchod la thugs kar khyani/ /sum brtsegs skyebaskyed la spyan drangs bstim/ /mchod cing bstod la bsreg rterdzas dbul/ /spyan ma gnod sbyin dag la yang / /sbyin sreg rim bzhin dbul bar bya/ /sa yi lha mo'i sta gon ni/ /gong ltar byas te mi gshegs so/ /de nas slob ma /skyesta gon ni/ /phyi rol gtor ma byin byas la/ /khrus byas gos gon me tog thogs/ /phyag byas gsol gdab sna gtod bskul/ /sdig bshags yi rang skyabs su 'gro/ /sems bskyed lam gnas rdo rje lta bu bya/ /lhar bskyed byin brlabs de la mchod//so shing ku sha srung skud gdags/ /gzengs bstod nyal gzhug spro ba bskyed/ /lha la mchod cing bstod pa bya/ /phyag byas gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ /dge ba bsngo zhing bzod gsol bya/ /gsol cing bkra shis smon lam gdab/ /33—900

sa/ngas rgyas dang por mtshan 'don gnas/ /dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga la/ /thig dang tshon dang bsgrub hūṃbhepa dang / /'jug cing dbang bskur bya ba'o/ /thig la rteralas dang ye shes te/ /ye shes snal ma sar pa la/ /byin brlabs bsgril te snod bcug mchod/ /bzlas te rim pas gdab par bya/ /gdab pa dang po gnam thig ste/ /de nas sa thig gdab pa'o/ /tshon ni byin brlabs bzlas te dgye/ /pan tsa ra ka phyogs tshon dang / /mtshan ma'i bye brag bri bar bya / /bsgrub pa bya ba'i rim pa yang / /dkyil 'khor brgyan te mdo gdon gzhagagru /khrus byas brgyan la shar sgor gnas/ /bsrung dang bsang 5gtor dkyil 'khor bslang / /sgo dbye 6bum dgod lhar bskyed de/ /nam mkha'i lha tshogs phab la bsre/ /bdag nyid dang po'i lhar bskyed de/ /sngags bzlas phar spyo tshur bsdu 3bya/ /lha rnams stong bsgoms slar la bskyed/ /de nas sgo dbye la sogs pa/ /sngon du bstan pa bzhin du bya/ /phyi rol dag tu byung byas la / /'jig rten pa la gtor ma sbyinari8/ /slar la nang du zhugs byas la/ /sbyin sreg dag gis tshim par byas spyo/ /de nas slob ma 'jug pa yang / /lha la gsol gdab gnang bar bsam/ /slob mas khrus byas me tog thogs/ /yol bas bcad la phyi rol dgug /slob mas phyag byas gsol ba gdab/ /gdong dang stod g.yogs /rtasmad g.yogs te/ /nang bkug phyag bya spyig pa bshags/ /yi rang bskul dang gsol ba bdag1rī /slob dpon 'dod phyir yang gsol gdab / /de nas dam tshig dag ni dbog /dam tshig 'dzin par khas len gzhug /sems bskyed pa dang lhar bskyed brlab/ /dam tshig bsgrag cing de la mchod/ /las kyi bum pas dbang yang bsgur/ /sgo bzhir bcug la slar 33—901

yang ni/ /shar sgor bzhag la mna' yang bsgags7/ /mna' chu blud la ye shes dbab/ /mchod cing smrar gzhug phreng ba dor/ /mgo la bcings te snang ba brtag /mig ༷dbye ba dang dkyil 'khor bstan/ /dbang bskur ba yi rim pa yang 1/ /sgrub pa po dang slob dpon ni/ /sgrub pa po ru dbang bsgur na/ /rang gi lhar bskyed de la mchod/ /dang po rig pa'i dbang bskur te/ /bkra shis brjod cing chu dbang bsgur/ /dbu rgyan dang ni rdo rje sbyin/ /dril bu dang ni ming yang gdags/ /gsang ba'i ye shes sngags kyang sbyin/ /phyag rgya bzhi brlab brtul zhugs sbyin/ /slob dpon dag tu dbang bskur na/ /shar sgor jesna tshogs pad+ma bri/ /slob ma sangs rgyas dang por bskyed5/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bar bya/ /dam tshig gsum dang gsang ba dang / /gsang rgyal dang ni nges pa'i dbang / /rim pa bzhin du bsgur bar bya'o/ /dam tshig gsum la rdo rje dang / /dril bu dang ni phyag rgya'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang la dkyil 'khor dang / /lha dang slob dpon las rnams so/ /gsang rgyal dag bi dbang bskur ba/ /de bzhin rigs dang rdo rje dang / /rin po che dang pad+ma dang / /las kyi rigs kyi gsang ba'o/ /nges pa'i dbang la gzhan don dang / /rang don nges pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /gzhan don nges pa'i dbang bsgur na/ /bye brag dag dang spyi dag go/ /bye brag la yang 'di lta ste/ /de bzhin rigs dang rdo rje dang / /rin chen rigs dang pad+ma dang / /las kyi rigs kyi nges pa'o / /rang don nges pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /gsang ba'i ye shes brlab cing sngags kyang sbyin/ /phyag rgya bzhi khubarlab lung yang bstan/ /gzengs bstod pa dang dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /de mthar dbang bstan bya ba'i phyir/ /33—902

༄/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho garte༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma sadhī ti maṇ+ḍa la bi bye/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo ngo bo nyid kyi sgu mnga' zhing / /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin 'byung gnas che/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul pa'i sku/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal te/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad par bya/ /dang por re zhig slob ma ni/ /dad ldan dam tshig brtul zhugs bsrung ci/ /rtog med rgyud gcig bla ma dang / /'jam pa'i dpal la mos pa yis/ /khro med sngags dang rgyud la mkhas/ /thos ldan rgyud 'dir dbang thob pas/ /dam tshig gsum la gnas pa des/ /dang po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi lha rnams sgrub pa'i thabs las 'byung ba bzhin du bsnyen pa bya ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba 'bum du bzlas pa ni sngon du bsnyen pa'o/ /33—905

gzhung las/ bsam gtan dang ni rjes mthun pa'i/ /ri yi phug gam chu yi 'gram / /dze+eng ngam rang dga'i gnas dag gam/ /lha khang mchod rten la sogs par / /zhes 1gsungs pas na/ de lta bu'i gnas der song la byu tsam 'byor pa'i tshad gyis byas la/ sa yongs su brtag pa der/ bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i chus gtor/ dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa byas nas/der mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ sa'i lha mo las bslang rngub ni/skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol 4phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis / /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bdud bcom nas / /bdag gis dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes brjod nas/ thal mo sa la brdabs pas/ sku phyed tsam sa las 'thon byepa dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du dkyil 'khor byed pas bdag la rmebyin zhes brjod pas/khyod kyi 7dkyil 'khor kyi bdag po gyis shig ces brjod nas sa la thim par bsam mo/ /sa slong raba'o/ /de nas drag po'i sbyin sreg gis bgegs bzlog pa9 —/ de nyid du bdag dang blo zhi ba'i phyir sbyin sreg byas la der sa sbyang bar bya ste/ 'dom gang tsam la sogs pa brkos la sa'i ro lnga bsal zhe te/ de ye rin po che lnga dang ldan pa'i bum pa bcug la slar sas dgang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ras ris 1 la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor pa yang bris la dkyil 'khor nyis lo'agyur la spos kyis chag chag btab ste/ lag pa sa la reg par bya'o/ /rje btsun gyi yi ge brgya pa lan bdun bzlas par bya'o/ /sa bzung 'ba'i rim pa'o / /1spyode nas bdag nyid ji snyed pa'i rgyan dang ldan par 1 byas te/33—906

bkra shis pa'i dus su dkyil 'khor kyi dbus su 'dug la/ sgrub pa'i thabs las 'byung ba bzhin du/ bdag bsrung zu)ba nas bgegs gzhom pa la sogs pa bya ba dang / de nas rten sprul pa nas a+yotshogs bsags pa nas/ ye shes par gyur pa'i bar du byas la/ der gong gi dang 'dra ba'i lha mo sta gon byas la/de nas spro ba bskyed de/ deng du bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag ni gson pa 'bras bur bcas/ /lha dang dam tshig mnyam pa ru/ /gyur par bdag ni som nyi med/ /byang chub sems dang sems gcig las/ /mi ldog par ni bdag gyur te/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rigs su ni/ /deng bdag skye bar the tshom med/ /deng / bdag nyi ma dam pa ste/ /mchod sbyin 'di ni bla na med/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spyan 'dren pa/ /deng bdag 'dus pa'i mchog yin no//de nas phyag byas spos thogs la/ /kye dbang ni nges te bla na med/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor bri/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub 'di ni stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod la dang po'i sbyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang las kyi rgyal po mchog rnam par bsgoms la/ yang sgo dbye ba la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba nas bdag nyid ye shes pa'i gnas su 'dug pa'i bar du bya ste/ phreng ba'i sngags zlos pa la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i sgrub pa'i grogs lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir 'dud kyis bstod de/ de nas/ rgyud chen sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /rdo rje 'chang chen gsang sngags 'chang / /dpag med rnams kyi bka' bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /33—907

zhes gsol ba btab la/ de nas langs te/ lha rnams la phyag byas ①nas/bdag ni rang nyid ral gri can/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bdag rang nyid/ /nga ni sangs rgyas rgyal po ste/ /stobs chen ral gri can bdag nyid/ /de nas mig dang rkang pa byin gyis brlabs te/ bsgoms dzupa'i dkyil 'khor steng du bteg la/ byang shar mtshams nas bskor ba byas te/ hūṃ ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang tsham rngam gyi dbyangs brjod la/ hūṃ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /gnas 'dir 'jam dpal dkyil 'khor ngas 'dri 1yis/ /bgegs kyi rigs tshogs gang yin 'byer bar kyis/ /ci ste nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /ye shes can gyi ral gri 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas byed cing / /rnam par 'jig par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /deng sa phyogs nam mkha' ltar dri ma ltamed pa 'di/ deng rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bye zhes bya bas/sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dgod pa'i phyir/ 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor 'dri 3yis/ hūṃ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang / /'byung po sha za srin po'i tshogs/ /'byung po thams cad sar song zhig /'jam dpal bka' thos myur du song / /gang dag mi 'gro de la ni/ /ral gri dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ gas( / /spyi bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas 'gyur/ /lan gsum du brjod do/ /bskal pa me lta bu'i 'og nas byung nas/ gdug pa can thams cad bsreg /tsosnapar bsam mo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar 'dug ste/ bskal pa'i me lta 33—908

bu'i khro bo'i 'byen pas gdug pa can thams cad bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas dag pa yongs su bskor ba'i tshul gyis shar du 'gro bar bya'o/ /de nas g.yon brkyang bas bgegs bskrad do/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi 'gros kyis lhor song la/g.yas brkyang pas bgegs bskrad do/ /de nas rdo rje 'gros kyis nub tu song la/zlum pa'i stangs hūṃstabs byas la bgegs bskrad do/ /de nas byang du rdo rje 'gros kyis song ba 3der sa ga'i 'dug stangs kyis bgegs bskrad la/ de nas 'gying 'gros kyis shar du 'gro bar bya'o/ /yang rdo rje 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor kyi lte ba bskor la phur bu'i 'gros bya'o/ /dbus der hūṃ sgra rgyun mi bcad do/ /der phyed pas 'dug la rdo rje'i /༄/— lta bas bgegs bsnun la/ bsreg pa bcing ba phyogs dang mtshams ra ba dra ba byas la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūṃ/ hūṃ badz+ra a na la 5/ ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa ri6hūṃ/ badz+ra de tri ban+dha sarba bispyo/oṃ dṛ rnyo me bha ba/ rak+ṣa sarba dza swā hā/ oṃ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bye ban+dha hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra pā sha hri8༄ / oṃ badz+ra pā tai ke pā tai ke tsuni ra ṭa/ tri badz+ra ka li ru ṭa ma ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha 4 3 ri ru ṭa ma ṭa/ hūṃ badz+ra karma badz+ra ban+dha baṃ/ sarba maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ dza/ gsang ba 'dug la/ ma hā tsakra maṇ+ḍa si a sati si ta hūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas seng ldeng las lobyas pa'i phur bu la/ tsan+dan dmar pos byugs la/ srad bu dmar po dang me tog dmar pos bcings la stod khro bo la smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs su 'dug la hūṃ las sprin sgra la sogs pa bskyed la/ o badz+ra tī li shī la —ya sarba bispyo ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces 5brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas/ g.yon pa khu tshur gyis bzung ste/ g.yas pa rdo rje tho bas dbus dang gru bzhir brdung ngo / /dha ma dha ma/ da ma da mas na tsun+dha saya tsan 33—909

tsur+ṇa ya badz+ra u shāka ra hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje tho ba lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la brdung bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje 3 go cha bskon/ /rdo rje'i rtse mo bzlas pa'i spos chus byugs la gur gum dang / a ka ru dang / du ruṣ+ka thudang /tsan+dan dang ga bur dang gla rtsi la sogs pa'i dri rnams kyis sngags gdab pa'i lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i dri'i thig le zlum po byas la der me tog gi tshom sabu la sngags bzlas te dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed la/ nam mkha'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dgug pa dang gzhug pa la sogs pa byas la mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pas mchod la/ bstod pa byas gsol ba gdab ste/ hūṃ bcom ldan 6 'jam dpal rdo rje ni/ /rig ṣ+ṭasngags rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod༄ / /snying rje'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor bri bar 'dod/ /de bas phyabyin brlabs mdzad par gsol / /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs/ /gang gzhan sngags kyi lha tshogs dang / /lha rnams bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /dkyil 'khor byin zlob tso dngos grub sprul/ /zhes 11lan gsum du'o/ /de nas dngul lam gser gyi bum pa la kha dog dkar por bsgyur 1 la/ lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'am/yang na rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'am las thams cad pa'i bum pa ste/ las kyi bum pa la sna tshogs 1 rdo rje bri'o/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa la lha ⑩kun gyi mtshan ma dang / gtso bo'i 7mtshan ma bri'o/ /gtso bo'i bum par sman lnga dang 'bru lngas bkang la mgul chings nyis larim du bya'o/ /me tog gi phreng ba dang gdugs dkar po re res g.yogs par 7bya'o/ /yang na bum pa bcu dgod zer te 'thad do/ /gtso bo'i bum par gong gi gsum las lha tshang bar thubaskyed la / dgug gzhug dang mchod bstod dang bzlas pa bya'o/ /las kyi bum par 1(33—9/0

rdo rje gnod sbyin du bskyed pa dang gzhug pa dang / mchod bstod dang bzlas pa bya'o—/ /rnam rgyal bum pa ni bzhu ①bar bya'o/ /las bum ni mi bzhu'o/ /yang na kun mi bzhu zer te/ de nas bum pa rnams gtsang sar sba'o/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyir/ gzhung bzhin du sbyin sreg bya/ de nas phyi rol du gtor ma btang ste/ lha la mchod pa slob ma sta gon du gzhug pa bya ste/shar ngos su maṇ+ḍal byas pa'i rtsar 'dug ste/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ston pa khyod la bdag dga'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid dam tshig rig pa dang / /byang chub sems kyang bdag la gsol④/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par mdzod/ /de nas bla mas/ rtog pa rnams ni legs par bsdus pa yis/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang por ldan pas zhunyon/ /brjed thungs blo la 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs rnams/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis 5byin mi rlob/ /bag med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang / /bgyid stsal rjes su yi rang gang yin pa/ /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni / /spyan sngar ma lus da ltar ⑥so sor bshags/ /bde gshegs sras kyi ⑦tshogs gnyis zab pa dang / /rgya che 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don/ /sgrub par byed pa de las gzhan pa la/ /rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo / /thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur pa/ /blo gros sdig bral gti mug tshogs kun bcom—/ /ma lus pad+ma'i rigs kyi nang bzhugs bye /pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' thur ba ste/ /dman 33—911

pas 'jigs pa rnams kyi skyabs byed 'tshal/ /srid pa'i sbyor ba zil gyis mnan hūṃpa'i mchog /gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags la sogs sbrul gyi dug bcom zhing / /blo gros rnam rgyal thugs rjer ldan pa yi / /brtul zhugs bzang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /srid dang bral ba rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rgyu yi rjes la bdag po'i lus bdag nyid/ /'bras bu'i stobs kyis dag /3las rgyal 'gyur ba/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba zug cing yang dag rtogs/ /mnyam med byang chub bdag gis gzung bar bgyirdu/ /de nas slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri'i thig le byas la/ rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang / o āḥhūṃ gis bskyed de gzhag 4go/ /de nas spos dang me tog la sogs pa re re byin la/ de nas brtsams te bde ba thams cad nye bar gnas par gyis 5shig ces brjod do/ /da 4nas so shing me tog gi phreng bas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas 7te byin la/ slob ma rang gi so brud kyemaṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bor te/ ltas lta ba so shing mdun drang por bor la/ de tshe bdag la lta ba dang / /rtse mo gyen du 'dren gyur na/ /de tshe dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur/ /de tshe shar du kha bltas na/ /de tshe dngos grub 'bring du 'gyur/ /mtshams dang byang du kha bltas na/ /'jig rten pa yi dngos grub thob/ /so shing bor ba rgya 9zhig la/ /thur du bltas na sa 'og go/ /de nas ku sha sar pa la rdo rje rgon po bzlas te/ stan dang sngas ༄ su sbyin no/ /de nas ༄ nyesrung skud la sngags kyi phreng ba de'i dpung pa g.yon par gdags so/ /de brtan /rkipa'i phyir yang rje btsun gyi yi ge brgya pa yang brjod do/ /de nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi gzengs bstod la bzhin bzangs rnams longs shig dang / dkyil 'khor chen 33—9/2

po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /nang par ji lta ba'i rmi lam zlos nyushig brjod la btang ④ngo / /de nas nang par rmi lam dri bar bya'o/ /de nas 'dzem pa med par bzlas te/ rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / /yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin/ /mchod rten dang ni sku gzugs mthong / /de la mchod pa rtsom pa dang / /dge slong dag dang chos nyan rnams/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rmi lam brtags la ngan par gyur na sbyin sreg bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor yang dag mchod pa bzlas pa dang / bsgom pa la sogs pa zu ci nus par mchod bstod la sogs pa byas la/ de nas sngags dang phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor steng du bteg la/de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams dang / shel lta bu'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i nang du zhugs par kha sbyar byas la gzhag ④ go/ /de nas slob ma'i gtso bo dang lhan cig tu bsam gtan la mnyam par nyal bar bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid skya rengs sheshar ba'i dus su lha'i sbyor ba byas la/ nyi ma 'char kar bdag nyid rgyan thams cad dang ldan par byas nas/ dkyil 'khor dris nye bar byugs te/ tshon sna lnga'i skud pa so sor bkal la rim pas bzhag ste/ oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ s+thābhuḥ.a rang gi sa bon rnams la mi bskyod pa la sogs pa/ rang gi phyogs na bzhugs pa rnams kyi gnas su btang dzu la/ 'bar ba'i be+egs kyus drangs te/ lag pa g.yas pa'i srad bu bkal lagye/ a na la sogs pa'i sngags kyis bsgrims la/ tsan+dan la sogs pa bsgos pa'i snod du bzhag la mchod de/ bzlas pa byas la/ de nas rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad du gyur pa'i snying ga nas/ grogs po rdo rje 'dzin la dza dza zhes pa phyung la/ ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba ser po'i snang ba bskyed la / dza zhes pas sgrub pa'i grogs kyi lag tu gtad la/ g.yon khu tshur gyis khya33—913

dbus su dpal rnam par snang mdzad do/ /'khor lo'i /nyuphyogs bzhir bde bar gshegs pa rigs bzhi'o/ /mtshams su yum bzhi'o/ /de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa grwa rngubazhi sgo dang bcas pa'o/ /rtsibs bcu drug la byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug go/ /grwa la lha mo brgyad do/ /sgo la sgo ba bzhi'o/ /de'i phyi rol du 'jig rten pa'i yon tan brjod pa las dgod par bya'o/ /de nas dgongs ka'i dus su bab pa dang / yo byad dang dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan rnams dgram par ③bya ste/ mchod pa lnga dang rgyan thams cad dang / de bzhin du phur pa dang thumada' dang / tshon skud kyi dra ba dang / ral gri la sogs pa dang me long la sogs pas dkyil 'khor brgyan pa/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i glegs bam bzhi yang phyogs bzhir gzhag thugo/ /phyogs mtshams su spos snod brgyad la sogs pas bdug par bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan cha zin nas/ de nas rje btsun kyi yi ge brgya pa zlos treshing /dkyil 'khor de dbang ldan nas brtsams te bsang gtor bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor byen gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang sngags bzlas so/ /de nas bdag nyid rgyan gyis brgyan pa khyams su 'dug ste/ dang por bdag med pa nas sgrub pa'i thabs las 'byung ba bzhin du/ gtso bo'i sku bskyed cing ye shes sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par byas la rgyas gdab ste/ dbang bskur la dkyil 'khor de sngags dang phyag rgyas blang ba la/ sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gang yin pa'i cho ga gsum kyis 7bskyed la/ kha sbyar kyi sbyor ba bsams la phab ste gnyis su med par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid dkyil 'khor lan gsum du bskor zhing lhag pa dang ma tshang ba zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ rje btsun 33—915

gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa dang / sngags kyi phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la me tog dbul lo/ /de nas rdo rje 'jigs byed du byas la dbus su 'dug nas sgo dbye'o/ /yang na bar 'dir lha'i rnal 'byor byas la/ bum pa dang yo byad rnams nang du gzhug go/ /bum pa rnams la bzlas pa byas la gnas su gzhag 1go/ /de nas mchod pa byas la bdag nyid dbang dang dam tshig can du bya ba'i phyir/ rje btsun gyis 2mchod pa byas pas dbang dang / dam tshig dang ldan par bsam mo/ /de nas mchod pa la sogs pa byen gyis brlabs la/de nas sgo phye la sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs la/ nam mkha' la byon pa la bgegs bskrad pa la sogs pa byas la dgug gzhug bya ste/ rgyas gdab pa dang dbang bsgur ba dang mchod yon la sogs pa phul la/ mchod pa lnga dang nyi shu la sogs pas mchod la/ rje btsun gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod do/ /rje btsun gyi sngags kyi phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa zul/ gsol ba btab la de nas 'byung po dang chos skyong rnams la gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin du gtor ma byin la/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'gram du sbyin sreg rgyas par bya'o/ /dus 'di ru phyag rgya dang glu la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas lha la phyag byas la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yi/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams ni 'jug par bgyi/ /de nas gang zag gi rim pas zhu phul la bslab 4pa'i gzhi mu/lnga dang ldan pa'i slob ma gang yang rung ba'i rgyan dang ldan par bya ste4/ yol ba'i phyi rol du bla ma la gsol ba gdab bo spyo//dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /33—916

dam tshig de nyid sprul yodu gsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la gsol2 / /de nas slob ma la/ rdo rje bsrung ba bzlas pa yis / /stod g.yogs smad g.yogs bskon byas la/ /sgo srung gi 9sngags bzlas la g.yogs te/ me tog thogs te phyag bzhi 'tshal/ /bshags dang rjes su yi rang dang / /bsgul ba dang ni gsol ba bya/ /slob dpon 'dod na 'di skad brjod/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa gsolathu/ /thub pa nyi ma ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni 6bdag la gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yi/ /slob dpon dpang du gnas pa la//sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba/ /mi ldog pa yi 'khor lo 'byor/ /thar pa'i rang bzhin grong khyer che/ /gsang ba chen por 'jug par bgyi/ /gsang ba thams cad bsdus par ni/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug 'gyur/ /mi ldog pa yi dbang bskur ba/ /skal ba chen po bdag la gsol7/ /mtshan rnams kun kyis rgyas btab 8cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yid 'ong ma/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la gsol/ /dbang chen po ni rmad byung ba/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la gsol/ /de nas bla mas lha rnams la/ che ge shezhes bya bye'adi nyid ni/ /byang chub chen po 'di nyid ni / /dam tshig mchog dang gsang ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /yang ni bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs pa yi / /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin pa ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam//de yang 'tshal zhes brjod par bya/ /de nas bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di 33—9/7

ni sangs rgyas rigs dag la/ /dam tshig brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu dzophyag rgya yang / /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar kyis/ /byang chub sems gang rdo rje che/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon dag ༷ kyang gzung bar bkyi/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i — —rigs dag pa'i / /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams—/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang byu nus bkyicho/ /gzhan yang bcu bzhi 'di dag ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spang zhing zhedor bar mi bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i thong bar shes par bya / /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin du bzlas — par bya/ /gal te nyams na rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad ⑦mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /'dod pas 2log par mi spyod cing / /brdzun 3 du smra bar — snami bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /chang ni yang dag spang bar bya/ /sems can gdul lngaphyir ma gtogs par/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su skyong 8/ /theg pa dman pa 'dod mi bya/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang / /33—918

rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba la/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya'o/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dag /mtshan ma bgom lkupar mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /des/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gsol/ /gtso bos 2ji ltar bka' sprul pa/ /de dag bdag ni kyebagyid par 'tshal/ /de nas sdom pa gzung bar thubarjod/ /sdom pa mi 'dod gang zag la/ /'jug pa tsam zhig ni 5bya'o / /dbang bskur ba phyoni mi bya'o/ /bo bye tsit+ta ut+pā da ya thumi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed nas su/ /de yi snying gar snying pos ni/ /rdo rje rab tu gzhag ༄snyepar bya/ /su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho badz+ra sirnyi ya thā su khaṃ/ dang po'i sangs rgyas byin gyis rlobs/ /mchod pas mchod de yon blangs nas/ /las kyi bum pas dbang bskur ro/ /sems mas bcings te sgo bzhir gzhug /de nas shar sgor 'dug byas la/ /dus 'di nyid du khyod nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas rigs su chud pas na/ /nga yi rdo rje ye shes spyin / /sangs rgyas rigs su 'grub par gsungs/ /gang zhig 'di nyid ma mthong ba'i/ /mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /bag med smras na nyams par 'gyur / /de bas nan tan smra bar bya'o/ /snying gar rdo rje gtugs la smra'o/ /de nas rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ /'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig ste/ /'ga' la smras na glad (pa 'gas/ /tsan+dan gur gum la sogs pa'i/ /mna' chu byin la 'di skad brjod/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed—/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'grub/ /'thung zhig rdo rje'i chu la / 'thung / /oṃ badz+ra ya tha /5 hūṃ/ mna' bor ro/ /de nas 'di skad smras te/33—919

dus 'di nyid nas bu khyod kyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyis/ /nga yis tshoji ltar bka' stsal te/ /khyod kyis skyo ba med par gyis/ /gang yang nga la ma mos min / /de bzhin mos par ma byas na/ /bdud kyis bcom nas myos par 'go—/ /de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis/ /de nas/ yi ge brgya pa mnyam gzhag bstan byas la/ /bdag lus gang yin snod kyi sgo phye ste/ /snying la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i dbus su/ blta/ /sngags kyi bdag po yi ge a gzugs dmar//brjod pas yang dag pas g.yo ba lta bu'i2/ /slob ma'i lus 'di sgo nas dbye bar bya/ /zhugs nas rdo rje byams pa'i snying la gnas/ /ma lus kun la kun du gang nas su/ /rkang pa g.yon pas g.yas pa mnan nas su/ /sngags pas slob ma'i rkang pa de la dbab/ /kun du dril bu'i sgras ni yang dag dkrol/ /lag pa pad+ma 'dab ma'i phyag rgya bca'/ /mi bskyod rin chen la sogs bde gshegs rnams/ /rang gi phyogs rtogs las byung 'di phab pas/ /legs phab gyur par rang nyid lus la blta/ /gang zhig des kyang babs par ma gyur na//lag pa g.yas pas til gyi sa bon gzhag4 /dbus su yi ge hūṃ yang rnam 3bkod do/ /rdo rje 'od 'bar bar ni rnam par bsam/ /g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub phyag rgyar 6bcas pa yi7/ /bslang bar byas la sdig pa bsreg par bya/ /lus ni thal bar byas pa rnam dag pa/ /bsod nams lus la sngags kyis dgang sdo/ /ye shes dbab pa nyid du bsam/ /rdzas bzhin dbab pa nyid du rab tu 'gyur/ /de nas babs par gyur pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi rtags gsum 'byung / /gar dang gar gyi lan /dang ni/ /glu dang glu len yang dag bya/ /brtan par byas la 'di skad brjod/ /'di ltar bdag gi slob ma 'di/ /dkyil 'khor du 33—920

ni legs btsud nas/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /'di yi bsod nams ci 'dra bar/ /de bzhin du ni 'bab par 'gyur/ /'dis ni dngos grub gang grub dang / /rigs rnams nyubhe gang gi snod gyur dang / /bsod nams mthu ni gang yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir —ni de bzhin 'gyur/ /pra t+t+waṃts+tsha badz+ra ho /phreng ba bor te ltas ④rnams blta/ /gal te bcom ldan dbu la babs/ /dbu yi gtsug tor 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhabs la babs na sngags rnams 'grub/ /stod dang smad dang bar du babs/ /dngos grub rab 'bring gsum du shes/ /lha yi gzugs las ring du gyuraphye/ /de la dngos grub rim pas 6'grub/ /mchod pa'i 'gram pa tshun chad nas/ /de yi de rigs 7de yin te/ /me tog btang ste de yi rigs/ /lha gnyis kyi phyani bar dag tu/ /babs na gang du nye ba yin/ /gal te dkyil 'khor las thal na/ /lan gsum bar du bskyar 9du gzhug /de las 6rgal na re thag chad/ /de nas phreng ba blangs te 'di skad do 1//sems ni stobs chen 'di long shig 8 /oṃ pra ti kṛ d+dhā s+t+waṃ mi saṃ satwa ma hā ba la/brjod la mgo la bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas mig gis ci mthong dri/ /dkar po mchog ni dngos grub la/ /ser po don 'byung dngos grub ste/ /dmar po thugs rje chags pa'o/ /nag po mngon spyod las su bshad/ /sna tshogs dngos grub thams cad do/ /gdong g.yogs bgrol te/ rdo rje chags pa deng —khyod kyi / /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /rdo rje'i mumig ni bla na med/ /te badz+ra pā byu/ gdong g.yogs bkrol la dkyil 'khor bstan/ /shar phyogs sgo nas lcags kyu ma'o/ /lho phyogs nas zhags pa ser po/ /nub phyogs nas lcags sgrog dmar skya'o/ /byang sgo nas dril bu ljang gu'o/ /shar khyams nas 33—921

rim pas/ byams pa dkar po'o/ /'jam dpal/ spos kyi glang po/ ye shes tog /lho'i khyams la rim pas/ zla 'od/hūṃ bzang skyong / blo gros rgya mtsho/ spobs pa brtsegs pa bzhi sgu mdog ser po/ nub kyi khyams la/mthu chen thob / ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan kun 'joms/ dra ba can gyi 'od sku mdog dmar po/ byang gi khyams la/ zla 'od gzhon nu/ 'od dpag med/ nam mkha' mdzod/ sgrib pa kun sel sku mdog lngang gu'o/ /grwa la shar lhor bdug pa ma 4dkar mo/ lho nub tu me tog ma ser mo/ nub byang du mar me ma 5dmar skya/ byang shar du byug pa ma ljang gu/ shar gyi 'khor lo la rim pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ rgyal po ser ba/ chags pa dmar ba/ legs pa ljang gu'o/ /lho'i 'khor lo la rim pas rdo rje rin chen ser ba/ gzi brjid dmar ba/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan sngo ba/ rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po/ nub kyi 'khor lo la 6rdo rje chos dkar dmar/ rdo rje rnon po sngo ba/rdo rje rgyu ser ba/ rdo rje smra ba dmar ba'o/ /byang gi 'khor lo la rdo rje las khra bo / rdo rje srung ba ser ba/ rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po/ rdo rje khu tshur ser po / gru chad la/ shar lhor sgeg mo dkar mo/ lho nub tu phreng ba ma ser modz+wa/ nub byang du glu ma dkar dmar/ byang shar grwa la gar ma ljang gu/de nas 'khor lo'i shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po/ rin chen 'byung ldan snye 7ser ba/snang ba mtha' yas dmar ba/ don yod grub pa ljang gu'o/ /mtshams kyi 'khor lo la/ rdo rje sems ma 9 dkar ba/ rin chen ma sngo bsangs ma/chos ma dmar mo/ las ma ljang gu'o/ /dbus su rnam par snang mdzad dkar ba / dang po'i 1 sangs rgyas sku mdog sna tshogs pa'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' 33—922

dkar—/ de ni dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o/ /kha cig 'dir rnam dag gsum ston te mi 'thad do/ /de nas dbang bskur te/ sgrub pa dang / slob dpon no/ /de la grub ①pa ni/ de nas shar ngos zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 27la/slob ma yi dam du bskyed pa la byin gyis brlabs la/ las kyi bum pas dbang bskur la mchod pa dang / bkra shis brjod cing gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas mchod la/ bum pa'i dbang bskur shete/ oṃ na mo mañju shrī badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes ④pas dbang bskur te/ rigs kyis dbu brgyan par bya'o/ /de nas dbu rgyan stong thunyid sngon du 'gro bas yig 'bru las zhwalhar bskyed la/de bzhin bcug la slob ma'i mgo la bskon la/ oṃ rat+na ku la mu ku ṭa a bhe ṣiñca/zhes pas dbu rgyan )dar dpyang ⑪dang bcas pas dbang 9bsgur ro/ /de nas rdo rje stong pa nyid las 'od dpag med du bskyed la ye shes bcug la/ de gyur pa las rdo rjer gyur te/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring rjod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab bsgrub ༄ daphyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni rjod kyis long / /oṃ badz+ra a ti pa ti two 17a bhe ṣiñca m+bi satiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ de nas dril bu yang a mo ka si bskyed la/ ye shes bcug pas dril bur gyur pa de byen te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ/ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta/ zhes pas byin 1 snye no / /de nas rdo rje dril bu spyi bor bzung la mi 5dbang rnam snang chos kyi ngo bo sbyin / oṃ na ⑩ ma a bhe ṣiñca/ zhes pas byin te/ lha gang la babs pa'i ming sbyin no/ /de nas mchod pa rnams kyis mchod la/ sngags dang phyag rgya'i ye shes blang ba dang / mchod pa dang brtul zhugs kyi dbang sbyin sal/ slob mas thal mo bskor te/ bla ma la yon dbul — /ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /rig 33—923

pa'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas slob dpon du 'os pa'i slob mas yon phul la/gsol ba gdab ste/ bdag dang gzhan don byed pa yi/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang byin —1snapas/ /thugs rje'i bdag pos gsol rngute zhu'o/ /de nas slob ma rje btsun rnam par snang mdzad bskyed la/ dbang rtags shar ngos su gru bzhi pa rngu sgo nub tu bltas pa chotshon sna lngas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad bris la/ de'i steng du/seng ge bla re 5dang dar dang gdugs/ me tog gi phreng ba dang rgyal mtshan la sogs trerol mo'i cha byed glu gar sogs/ de ltar brgyan pa'i slob ma rnams la/rnam rgyal bum pa nas bzung ste/ sgo'i bar du dbang bskur ro/ /'jam dbyangs sku gzugs nas bzung ste/ oṃ mañju shrī ma hā musu kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥt+t+waṃ baṃ hoḥ / su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas slob dpon chen por gyur/ bkra shis brjod de/ shes rab yan lag 'dus pa'i ral gri las byung ba/ /byang chub sems kyi 'jam dbyangs byang chub de dbang bskur/ /'jam dbyangs lha tshogs rnams kyis legs gsung —snyegang yin pa/ /de 1bheni dbang bskur mchog la dus kun bkra shis shog /'grub na lha kun la sbyar ro/ /byang sems rdo rje la sogs dkyil 'khor la 'jug cing / /srid pa'i snying po rnam grol sgeg mo la sogs pa/ /bde byed rab mchog legs par glu blangs pa yi bkra shis gang / /di ring khyod kyi dbang mchog 'di la bkra shis shog /shin tu zhi ba'i mdzad pa phul byung ma lus pas/ /sems can bde gshegs rtogs 'dzin dbang bskur ba//dpag 1 med lha'i tshogs kyis lolegs gsung 1/bkra shis gang / /de muni khyod kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /dpal ldan khams gsum rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor rab mchog la/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal mchog dbang bskur ba//33—924

byedalha yi tshogs kyis btud de dbang bskur gang / /de tshuni khyed kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /'gro ba sna tshogs 'dul phyir phyag na pad+ma bsnams/ /rdzogs pa'i rin chen cod pan bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ /pad+ma'i 'dod chags 2 legs gsung ③bkra shis gang / /de ④ni khyed kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /nam mkha'i snying po nor bu rin chen 'byor pas nyams dga' ba'i / /don rnams kun grub phyabade byin dbang bskur chen po la/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs mdzad legs gsung tre bkra shis gang / /de zuni khyed kyi dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /de nas dbu rgyan dang rdo rje dang dril bu dang rdo rje dbang bskur byin la/ me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ de nas dam tshig la sogs pa'i dngos grub 3 byin te/ rdo rje byin la de kho na nyid bstan te/thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po thams cad bdag /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ho las dril bur bskyed la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror 'dod/ /rtag par blo khyod kyis gzung ba yin/ /rgyal ba'i byang chub mchog rab kyi/ /srid pa'i ngo bo nyid ⑩bdag mdzod/ /phyag rgya chen pos gzhag shārmā la/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /de bas dam tshig srung bar gyis/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten bya bzhin/ /rang gi lha yi spyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /sku yi dam tshig go/ /de nas mchod pa rnams kyis mchod la/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur te/ dkyil 'khor dang lha rnams dang slob dpon la brlabs te/33—925

dkyil 'khor ni mi mnyam mad she par zur bzhi ste/ dran dang dbang po'i sgo bzhi dang / /bsam gtan rnams ni rta babs bzhi/ /ting 'dzin kha khyer shes par bya/ /kha khyer la brten rdo rje'i mchog /gzugs rnams lha mos mchod pa yin—/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rngubakram pa yang / /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'i/ /gdul bya bskyod pa sna tshogs mchog /dar 'phan dril bu sgogs pa yin/ /me long ye shes rtag me tog༄ de /byang chub yan lag me tog phreng / /dra ba dra phyed rin chen mchog /nyi ma zla bar yang dag bshad/ /kun grub mi zad bde ba ste/ /bde ba chen po zhes grags so/ /de yi nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi—/ /ka ba dkyil 'khor dra ba yin/ /dngos grub bde ba kun ster ba/ /rnam thar brgyad po de nyid yin/ /theg pa chen po'i byang chub sems/ /'di des 4'khor lo bskor bar 3ni/ /rdo rje'i thig gis yongs bskor zhing / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas na/ /'khor lo rnams dang ldan pa yin/ /gang du 'jug pa tsam gyis na shi/ /mi mtshungs pa dang mi ldog pa/ /bde ba chen po rab sgrub phyir/ /de dag dang por yang dag 'gyur/ /de nas lha'i rnam par dag pa ni/ rang rig pa'i sgyu ma gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid lha lnga bcu rtsa gsum yin te/ de yang gzugs dang gti mug dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes / spyi'i cha nas 'jam dpal rnam par snang mdzad do/ /'di la sku gsum du brtsi'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / zhe sdang rnam par dag pa shaṃme long lta bu'i ye shes ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /tshor ba'i phung po dang ser sna dag pas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /nga rgyal gyi sgrib pa 'du shes kyi phung po dang 'dod chags dag pa1/ so sor rtog pa'i ye 33—926

shes ni snang ba mtha' yas so/ /sgrib pa dang / 'du byed kyi ①phung po dang /khro ba dag pa bya ba nan tan don yod grub pa'o/ /dang ②por 'dzin pa la sogs bzhi bkag pa'i rnam thar bzhi'o/ /mi bskyod pa'i me long lta bu'i ye shes des—/ dgag bya nang dang phyi dang ①/ phyi dang nang snod bcud du zhen pa bkag pa'i rig pa'i cha me long lta bu'i me long / me long lta bu'i mnyam pa nyid/me long lta bu'i so sor rtog pa/ me long lta bu'i bya ba nan tan no/ /shar kyi 'khor lo ser po bzhi'o/ /de bzhin stong pa'i cha bzhi byang chub sems dpa' bzhi'o—/ /des 'gre'o/ /dgag bya bkag ④pa'i rim pa'o/ /ye shes phyasems dpa' la/ stong pa'i cha nas byang chub sems dpa'o/ /ser sna dag pa sbyin pa ste sgeg mo'o/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa spangs pa phreng ba ma/ 'khor ba spangs pa glu mkhan ma/ /phrag dog spangs pa gar mkhan ma/ /brnab sems spangs pa me tog ma/ /shes rab 'chal pa spangs pa bdug spos ma/ /log pa'i smon lam spangs pa mar me ma/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / phung po'i bdud spangs pa dad pa'i stobs lcags kyu ma/ 'dod pa'i sgrib pa dang /nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom pa brtson 'grus kyi stobs sgo ba zhags pa ma/las kyi sgrib pa dang 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom pa thodran pa'i stobs sgo ba be+egs sgog ma/ skye ba'i sgrib pa dang / lha'i bu'i bdud spangs pa / dze+eting nge 'dzin gyi stobs sgo ba dril bu'o ( / /lha'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /de nas slob dpon ḍa rnam par dag pa rnams kyang ji ltar bslab pa'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'o—/ /mchod pa gser thur thogs la/ ji ltar mig mkhan mkhas pa yis/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal nyu1ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab 33—927

rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal1/ /o badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lo tho / me long blangs la/ chos kyi dbyings nyid bstan te/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med / /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa④/ /de ltar chos rnams ༄5shes nas su/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos⑪ / /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ /de nas dril bu dgrol te/ chos rnams nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /dzasnanam mkha' dang mnyam spyor ba yis/ /kun kyang byemanyam pa nyid du gsal/ /a zhes pas (rte dril bu'i snying po sbyin no/ /de nas ta thā mnyes par gyis zhes pa dang ho zhes pas gzhu byin la/ phyogs bzhi steng 'og tu 'phan 11du gzhug go/ /yang me long bstan la/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin gyi1 / /bu khyod kyi ni snying la gnas/ /me long 'dzin pa oṃ mañju shrī a/rkang pa'i bar du 'khor lo bzhag la/ lag par dung byin la/ de ring 'jig rten thams cad 1 la/ /skyob pa rnams kyis ⑩'khor lo skor/skye/ /chos kyi dung ni blang slomed pa/ /kun du ma lus gang bar gyis/ /som nyi yid gnyis mi bya zhing / /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ /gsang sngags spyad pa'i tshul gyi mchog /'jig rten 'di la rab tu sgrogs/ /de ltar byas na ⑩sangs rgyas la/ /phan thogs 1/drin du gzo bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu srung bar byed/ /'khor lo dang po 'di byin yang / /'jig rten kun la khyad par du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du rdo rje dang 33—928

khro bo dang / pad+ma dang nor bu'i 'khor lo bskor zhes lharjes su gnang ba byen no//de nas gzengs bstod la lung bstan te/ oṃ nga yis ④khyod la lung bstan yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa kun du rab sgrub phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton④/ /rdo rje che ge mo bhur bhu swa/ zhes pas gzengs bstod pyede/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur bcings la/ g.yon pas chos gos 'dzin pa ltar byas la brjod do/ /ngan song phyir mi ldog ces bya'o//de nas gsang ba'i ye shes bslab ste/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ /khyod kyis gye nam yang ma byed cig /ma hā klus ma ya ha na phaṭa/ de lha'i byesngags byin la/phyag rgya bzhi yang babe+eb par bya'o/ /de nas khyod kyis mi mkhas pa'i gang zag la sngags dang phyag rgya ma ston cig /de yi spyad na som nyi thos bye/ /gnyis ka ngan song nyid du lhung / /der khas blangs la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /lag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sidha badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e hūṃṣa t+t+waṃ dha /hūṃr ya mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ de nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyings ⑫kyi rjes 'gro ba/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub rdo rje rgyal bas gsung ⑫/ /dril bu byin rkyeno/ /rjes gnang mthar thug sbyin to⑫ / /slob ma rgyan dang ldan pa latshe/ /spyi bor gdugs bzung thal sbyar nas/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bskor du gzhug /gdugs dang bcas pas bskor phyogs su/ /spyi bos 7btud de phyag 'tshal gzhug /slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags/ /sngags dang rgyud ni 'dzin par 33—929

༄༅/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs gsang ba'i sgon ma jes bya ba/1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma saṃ gī ti gu h+ya sā dha na pra dī pa nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs gsang ba'i sgon ma zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la dang por bsnyen pa ni/ gnas dben par 'dug ste/ rnal 'byor pas khrus dang / bsrung ba dang / gos brje ba dang / byug pas byugs te/ gnas dang stan bsangs te 'dug nas/rang rdo rje 'chang du mos pa'i snying gar nyi ma/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/de'i lte ba la hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas gnas bsrungs te/ mchod pa byen gyis brlabs la/ rdo rje 'khor los zhing sprul nas/ bdag dang 'byel par byas 2 la / tshogs bsags ri par bya'o/ /tshogs bsags sngupa ni/ phyag 'tshal zhing bdag spro ba bskyed pa dang / mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang /33—937

bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba dang / bdag 'bul tshob dang /dngos grub blang ba dang / 'dud kyis bstod pa dang / bsngo ba'o/ /lha rnams kyis drin lan gyi tshul du tshur bstod pa'o/ /de dag ni dang po spyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas sdom pa bzung / de nas 'khor lo bdag la bsdu/ stong par bsgoms 4ye shes kyi lus su ldang / de nas mngon par byang chub pa lnga bsgom mo/ /de dag ni yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bsgom mo/ /de dag ni gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin to // de nas khang bu'i dbus su/ seng ge dang pad+ma'i steng du/ a las rdo rje 'chang du bskyed de/ sgu mdog dkar po zhal bzhi pa/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas so/ /de dag ni dang po'i sangs rgyas bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' la dmigs te/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa mtshan ma bzang po ma byung gi bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /de dag ni thun mong gi bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du/ ro la bsnyen pa zhag lnga bya ste/ kun rig gi sngags bzlas pa'i spos chus bkru/ de nas bgegs bskrad pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba la sogs pa bden pa bdar la/ tshe 'das pa 'di la gson gyi dus su brnyas byed cing / gshin gyi dus su gegs byed pa'i 4bgegs dang log 'dren gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad skad cig kyang ma gnas par dengs shig ces byas la yungs kar brdeg cing / sngags khro bo'i snying po/ oṃ ya mān+ta 5ka hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas so/ /de nas shes pa 33—938

dgug pa ni/ gong gi bden pa bdar ⑨la tshe 'das pa ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod/'di nas shi ba'i dus byas nas/ ngan song gsum la sogs pa 'gro ba gang na gnas kyang rung skad cig gis 'dir khugs par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bid 27sarba pā paṃ ā kar+ṣa ya hūṃ dzaḥ.a ṇi sum̐ 5 tri pre du dza/ zhes brjod cing snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas kyang bkug ④ par bsam mo/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bstems la gzhag 5 go/ /de nas yang dug gzhom pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / kun rig gi sngags kyis bkrus la/ ro byin gyis brlabs khyete/ rang gi lha ru bsgomasatsu / yi ge a spyi bor bsams nas/ 'od 'phros pas ye shes lnga yis gang bar bsam mo/ /de nas rang thu.a'i spro bsdu'o/ /de nas rang gi mig la a ā zhes bya ba dgod/ de bzhin du rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /sa la yang i yī u u e e khro au dgod par bya'o/ /yid la saṃ aḥdagod par bya'o / /lte ba dang / snying ga dang / mgrin pa dang / mtshog 9mar 'khor lo bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de ni sngon du bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas ro sta gon la gnas pa ni/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su khri dar gyis bgab — pa'i steng du bzhag ste/ slob dpon smyung bar gnas pas gong du bstan pa bzhin du tshogs bsags tshoskyupa'i cho ga byas la/ de nas dbang bskur ba'i phyir tshig 'dis gsol ba gdab pa'o⑫/ /de nas phyag byas spos thogs la/ spyan drang tshig skye 'di brjod par bya'o/ /kye dbang bskur nges te —bla na med/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol / /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/ /'di la phan gdags don ched du / /gnas 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /'di la dbang ni sprul du 33—939

gsol—/ /zhes brjod la/ dang po'i sbyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / las rgyal mchog rnams bsgoms la/ sku'i phreng ba'i sngags kyis lha rnams bsal nyubya'o/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur la dam tshig la gzhag 2par bya'o/ /de nas zhag lngar ro'i lhag pa'i lha'i snying po 'am/ sku'i phreng ba'i sngags kyi ( bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar 4khru gang dor bar zhi ba'i thab khung byas la/ til nag po la sdeg pa'i gzugs brnyan byas te/ spyig pa sbyong thuba'i sbyin sreg zhag gcig bya'o / /de nas dkyil 'khor bri ba'i ched du 'dud nyi shus bstod par bya'o/ /de nas gsol ba gdab byas nas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas nam mkha' la/ /mngon sum 'dra bar gang bar bsgoms 6/ /de dag ni shi ba sta gon la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de dag ni khyad par gyi bsnyen pa'o/ /de dag ni sngon du bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas zhag bdun kyi nang par sbyin sreg chen po bya'o ṭ+wāṃ/ /slob mas gsol ba gdab pa dang / slob ma yongs su gzung 3ba'i cho ga byas la/de nas dang po sa'i cho ga bya ste/ dang po sa brtag pa ni/ sa'i phyogs brtag pa dang / mtshan nyid brtag pa dang / tshad brtag pa'o/ /babe+eng ba ni/snang ba dang / mi snang ba'o/ /sbyang ba ni/ las tsudang / sngags so/ /gzung ba ni / sems kyi dbang gis gzung ba dang / rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi ting nge 'dzin kyis gzung ba'o/ /byin gyis brlab pa ni rdo rje rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis so/ /bsrung 11ba ni rdo rje phur pa la sogs pas tshabya'o/ /de dag ni sa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /sta gon la yang / dang po lha sta gon la gnas pa ni/dri'i thig le byas la der dam tshig pa bskyed nas/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan 33—940

drang zhing bsrel tūl mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod do/ /bum pa ni grangs tshang bar dze+ebasags la/ rgyan dang yo byad dang ldan par byas nas/ nang gzhal yas khang du bsgoms nas/ der dam tshig pa bskyed la/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drang zhing bsrel (/nas mchod de bzlas pa byas la gzhag go/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa ni 'jug pa rnams bsags ⑤la bya'o/ /de yang dgu ste/tshig gis dag par bya ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa dang / byin gyis brlab pa dang / mchod pa dang / so shing sbyin pa dang / srung 4 skud gdags pa dang / ku sha sbyin pa dang / zab mo'i chos bshad pa'o/ /de nas lha kha sbyar la gshegs su gsol te nyal bar bya'o/ /de nas nang par rmi lam dri bar bya'o/ /de dag ni sta gon gyi ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas thig gdab par bya'o/ /thig la bcu gcig ste/ rgyu dang / 'khal 7mkhan dang / tshad dang / byen gyis brlab pa dang / dbye ba dang / nges tshig dang / gdab pa'i gnas dang / 'debs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /gdab pa'i thabs dang / cho ga nyams pa'i nyes pa dang / bgegs bsal bas so/ /gdab pa'i thabs ni/ dang po tshangs pa'i thig /de nas logs thig /de nas zur thig /de bzhin du cha dang / cha bran dang / skor thig dang / sgo thig yan chad btab la/ pho brang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyir 8snarol du rtsibs bcu drug /de'i phyi rol du lha'i snam bu'i thig gdab bo/ /de dag ni thig gi ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas tshon dgye bar bya'o/ /de la bcu gnyis te/ rgyu dang / 'thag pa'i mkhan po dang / tshad dang / byin gyis brlab pa dang / dbye ba dang / nges tshig dang / dgye ba'i gnas dang /33—941

'gyed mkhan dang / dgye ba'i thabs dang / cho ga nyams pa'i nyes pa dang /bar chad kyi bgegs bsal ba'o/ /dgye ba'i thabs ni/ 'khor lo kun ser bo—/ lte ba dkar po/ shar sngon po/ lho ser po/ nub dmar po/ byang ljang gu'o/ /pañca ra ga ni/ nang du dkar po/ de'i phyi rol sngon po/ de nas ser po/ de nas dmar po/ kun gyi phyi rol ljang gu'o/ /de nas phyag rgya dgod pa ni/ 'khor lo'i lte ba la rdo rje 'dzin chen po/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa tshol/ rgyal ba rigs bzhi/ yum bzhi ste brgyad bri'o/ /rtsibs bcu drug po la sems dpa' bcu drug bri'o/ /grwa la mchod pa brgyad bri'o/ /snam bu la bskal pa bzang po bri'o/ /sgo bzhir srung ma bzhi bri bar bya'o/ /de dag ni tshon gyi ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas sngar bsnyen par 7byas pa'i ro de bsreg khang du drang ste/ pur legs par bcas la ——der bcug nas shing rta la sogs pas drangs nas/ zhar la bgegs bzlog pa dang / dug sbyang ④ba'i tshigs bcad slur 5len zhing rol mo la sogs pas drangs la/ bsreg khang la sngags mkhan dang bcas pas bskor treb lan gsum byas la/ shar phyogs nas gzhug par bya'o/ /nus na gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang dbang yang bskur bar bya'o/ /de dag byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan dang yo byad rdzogs par bkod nas/ lhag chad bskang ba la sogs pa byas nas slob dpon rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ting nge 'dzin du 'jug par bya'o/ /de dag ni slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas dam tshig gi 'khor lo bsgoms ⑦ pa ni/ kha sbyar yang bsal la gzugs brnyan dang bsres te/ cho ga yan lag gsum gyis kyedam tshig gi lha rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs 33—942

la / mdun kyi nam mkha' la bstod pa bya/ de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbazhis dgug gzhug bcing ba byas la/ ting nge 'dzin dang / byin gyis brlab pa dang /dbang bskur ba dang / mchod pa phul la bstod pa bya'o/ /de nas mthong ba nang gi 'jug pa bya'o/ /de dag ① ni lha bsgom zhing mchod pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa rngul zhes me sbar la pra brtag par bya'o/ /pra legs na me'i bye dbus su 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bskyed la de zhu ba las drang srong chen po me lha zhi ba la ④ ba ka zhes bya ba/ zhi zhing dkar po dbu gcig pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ mig gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po na be+er dkarathu/ gnyis pa na mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang po na phreng ba/gnyis pa na gun+dhe'u/ gos dang rgyan dkar po/ mchod phyir thogs dkar potso /yan lag thams cad nas rdo rje dkar po 'byung ba mngon sum dang 'dra bar bsgom mo/ /de nas 'thor spu'athung dang bsang ba bya ⑨la/ mtshan nyid med pa'i me byespyan drang bar bya ste/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'bar ba'i nang du gshegs su gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po spros la/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥzhes brjod do/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ bya ba la sogs pas bstod do/ /de nas nang du dgug gzhug bcing nyumedabang du bya'o/ /de nas badz+ra sarnyi ⑫zhes brjod do/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par bya/ byin gyis brlab dbang bskur/ de nas oṃ ha na sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod la dam tshig la gzhag tshu par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra 33—943

brnya 1zhes brjod la las 'di mdzod cig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas mchod pa'i yan lag gis mchod/ de nas bstod pa bya'o/ /de nas bsreg rdzas rnams dbul te/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis bsangs la/ me lha'i lce dang gzar bu'i kha la lha'i sa bon bkod nasas/ pus mo'i bar du lag pa bzhag nas/ dang po mar gyi dgang blugs gsum zhal cung zad gdangs par dbul lo/ /oṃ agha ye ha bya ka 4bya ba ha ne+e di byā di byā 57bye pa ye shāsnya ku ru swā hā/ zhes dbul lo/ /bgegs kyi mtshan ma yang shes par bya'o/ /yang bsang 6gtor byas la/ mar gyi dgang blugs bdun dbul lo/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ sngad ha na swā hā/ til gyi'o4/ /oṃ sarba saṃ pa de 9 swā hā/ zho'i'o/ /oṃ sarba bhasmi ku ru swā hā/ ut+pa la'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā 11yu ṣe swā hā/ dur ba'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras ma chag pa'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a pra 12ti ha ta badzā ya swā hā/ ku sha'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ 'bras kyi lag pan gyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ma le puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ mngar gsum dang dkar gsum nyu gyi'o/ /oṃ ma hā be+e tregā ya swā hā/ nas kyi'o/ /o ma hā pa lā saya swā hā/ sran ma sha'i'os/ /oṃ badz+ra gha 7sma re swā hā/ go'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a dz+nyā /na swā hā/ yam shā shing dang / drur ba'i myu gu'i'o —3/ /oṃ bo bye z-ik+ṣu ya swā hā/ byang chub kyi shing la sogs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ra ta /ya swā hā/n+ya gro dha'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ya ka ra swā hā/ a mra'i'o/ /lan grangs ci nus dbul lo/ /de nas bstod pa bya/ de dag ni me lha'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bsang 5gtor byas la/ de nas me lha'i snying gar gzhal yas khang bsgoms la / gzugs brnyan kyi dkyil 'khor nas bsreg khang du me tog gi ri mo'am/dus gcig tu spyan drang zhing dbul lo/ /spyan drang ba ni/ hūṃ ma lus sems 33byed94(1

can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas ma lus 'joms mdzad pa—/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /de nas bstod pa dang / de nas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/ oṃ badz+ra sarnyi baṃ zhes brjod/ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil dbul/ phyag rgyas gdab/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas byin gyis brlab/ sems dpa' 7rnams gnas bzhir yum bzhis brlab/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams rin po che'i cod pan /kyedar dpyangs kyis ri —dbang bskur/ sems dpa' ④rnams rigs lnga'i cod pan gyis dbang bsgur ro/ /de nas mchod pa rnam pa lnga la sogs pas mchod/ de nas bsang bab dang / 'thor 'thung byas la gong ma ltar 'urdzas sngags sam/yang na spyi sngags sam/ lha'i sngags kyis dbul lo/ /de nas bsang hūṃb dang 'thor 'thung byin la/ mar kyi dgang blugs phul la 'dud nyi shus bstod pa bya'o//yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes phyag rgya bkrol la bskyed pa snying gar bsdu/spyan drangs pa gshegs su gsol te/ 'gro ba 'di dag kun gyi dpung / /sems dpa' 1chen po brtan mdzod la/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang gshegs par kye mdzad du gsol/ /de nas bsang gtor byas la/slar yang me thab tu bsams la/ mchod yon la sogs ༄ nabyin la/ rdzas lhag ma kun sbyin sreg byas/1/ tha mar yang / dgang blugs dang 'thor 'thung phul la / 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /phyag rgya dgram par byas la/ snga ma bzhin gshegs su gsol te/ oṃ aXhūṃ muḥ/ zhes brjod la/khro bo ti rirnyi ri'i phyag rgya bcings/ gyen du bgrol la gshegs su gsol/33—945
