rgo byas pa yin/ /dbang dang dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /yid dga' ba yi gnas dag tu/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /yi ge a ni rnam shā bsams nas/ /de yi 'od kyis bla ma dang / /bde gshegs sras dang bcas pa rnams/ /mdun du mngon sum lta bur dmigs//lus ngag yid kyis yang dag par/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo rgya chen 'dod pa thams cad kyis/ /sangs rgyas kun la mchod par bgyid— / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems kun la/ / sdig pa byethams cad so sor bshags/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems bskyed pa'i/ /dge ba kun la rjes / yi rang / /mngon sangs rgyas nas mi ring ba'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa ni/ /bskor phyir bdag gis bskul bar 'tshal/ /yongs su mya ngan 'da' bzhed pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ /bskal pa rab mang bzhugs par ni/ /sangs rgyas kun la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang yang bdag gi khyamachod pa rnam drug dang / /dge ba bzhin 6byas de dag thams cad ni/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid thob phyir/ /bdag gis chos bzhin yongs su bgyi/ /chos la dbang bskur sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi/ /e ma sems can bla med bsgral ba'i ‘phyir/ /bdag gis thams cad mkhyen pa thob gyur cig /bdag nyid dngos po 'bul lags kyis5/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyis/ /ji ltar bzhed pa mdzad pa'i phyir/ /bdag lus so sor bzhes su gsol/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyisarngu/ /khyad 'phags lam ni bdag gis bsten / /de nas ye shes rnam lnga yi/ /gzugs brnyan tsam la rab dmigs 33—949

la / /rang bzhin gyis ni rnam dag pa/ /rang bzhin gyis ni byin kyis brlab//oṃ shu n+ya tā lkudz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kolhahaṃ/ nam mkha' lta bur rab dmigs la//yi ge rja (3las byung ba yi/ /stong gsum tshad dang mnyam pa yi/ /mchod rten bde gshegs gzhal yas ni5/ /rim pa drug dang ldan par bsgom/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs par bsam/ /dbus kyi snying po'i pho brang du/ /dbus su seng ge'i gdan nyid de/ /gzhan yang rim pa ji bzhin bsam/ /de yi dbus ma'i gdan thog tu/ /a las bskyed pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /mdog dkar ral pa'i thor tshugs cecan/ /zhi ba rgyan spangs byang chub mchog /kun du zhal gyis chornam par mdzes/ /de thugs dhīḥlas bskyed pa yi/ /gdong lnga zur phud lnga pa me tog thod/ /g.yas pa bzhi na ral gri ste/ /g.yon bzhi shes rab puste bsnams/ /rgyan dang na bza' gzhon nu'i tshul/ /thugs kar a las byung ba yi/ /'khor lo rim pa bzhi dang ldan/ /ji ltar gsang sngags dgod pa ni/ /'khor lo'i cho ga mthong ba yisa'u/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas/ thugs kar bsam/ /lte bar dza.a las byung ba yi/ /ye shes sems dpa' zhal drug pa/ /ut+pal dmar dang 1sngon po ni/ /po tis mtshan pa bsnams pa'o/ /gzhon nu'i rgyan rnguldan thugs kar ni/ /zla ba'i steng du a dkar ༄ —bsam/ /de las so sor 'phros pa yis/ /rim bzhin thams cad snang byas nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' 11mnyam sems can gyi/ /ma rig mun pa bsal byas nas/ /slar 'dus rim bzhin rang nyid kyi/ /yi ge'i nang du 'dus par blta⑫/ /de nas sngags kyi 'khor lo yi/ /mtshan brjod rim par bklag lhomipa yang 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa dang po nas brtsams nas/ /33—950

don chen yi ge dam pa'i bar/ /rang gis 7snade nyid brjod pa yin/ /khong nas 'byung khye ba skye ba med/ /tshig kun rab tu gsal bar byed/ /de mthar thug pa yum bzhi yin/ /mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che/ /zhes pa dang por brtsams byas nas/ /chags pa thams cad sel bar byed/ /de dag mthar ni rigs lnga ste/ /bde gshegs yab dang yum rnams kyang / /mtshan gyi don la rab dmigs te/ /mnyam par bzhag nas mtshan brjod ni/ /rim bzhin klog pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rang gi de nyid yi ge las/ /rim bzhin spro zhing bsdu ba yis/ /rang rang gdan la dgod par bya/ /'dod pa chen po bde ba che / /zhes pa dang por brtsams nas ni/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po mig 'phrul can//de yi mthar thug sems dpa' ni/ /bcu drug 'khor lo rab tu dgod/ /yi ge a las bskyed pa dang / /sems can don byas slar 'dus te/ /rang gi gdan la dgod par byas zu/ /sbyin bdag chen po gtso bo ste/ /zhes pa dang por brtsams byas nas/ /smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho'i bar/ /phyi nang lha mo bskyed par bya/ /byams chen rang bzhin dpag tu med/ /de bzhin theg chen tshul gnas par/ /yi ge a las bskyed pa yi/ /bskal byebazang phyi rol rim bzhin du/ /'khor lo gsum la dgod par bya/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji srid bsgoms phya pa'i mthar thug pa/ /tshigs bcad bcu bzhi dag gis ni/ /mtshan gyi don rnams bstan pa yin/ /'od zer 'phro zhing bsdu ba dang / /gzugs su gyur nas lhar gnas pa/ /pho brang snying po'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /rim gnyis chos dbyings ye shes kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dgod pa bstan par byas༄ / /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /zhes pa dang por 33—951

brtsams byas nas/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che/ /mthar thug oṃ gyi 7rnam par spro/ /gti mug spyod pa dag byas te/ /be+er 'dus rim pa gnyis pa las/ /rnam par snang mdzad tshul gyis ni/ /mtshan gyi don rnams 5grangs bzhin du/ /phyogs bzhi dag nas bzhugs pa yin/ /tshigs bcad nyi shu rtsa lnga ru/ /tshig rkang gcig gis ma tshang ba/ /'di yi don la dmigs shing dgod/ /de nas rim pa gsum pa ru/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /tshul nas rab tu bstod pa ni/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /ces pa dang por brtsams nas ni/ /sgra dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog /ces pa yi ni thumathar thug par/ /hūṃ gi rnam par spro zhing basbu/ /mi bskyod sngupa yi rnam par dgod/ /tshig rkang gcig gis lhag pa yi/ /tshigs bcad bcu yis phyogs bzhi ru/ /gsang sngags bdun cu rtsa gcig spros/ /zhe sdang btul nas rnam par gnas/ /de nas rim pa bzhi pa choni/ /yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid/ /ces pa dang por brtsams nas ni9/ /ye shes me lce 'od 'bar gsal/ /de mthar thug pa spro bsdu ste/ /snang ba mtha' yas rnam pa yis/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu rnam par gnas / /so sor kun rtog ye shes ni/ /tweḥyi rnam par spro basbu ste/ /'dod chags rnam par dag byas la/ /tshigs bcad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi7 / /mtshan don gzhung las byung ba bzhin/ /phyogs bzhi rnam par bgos thupa'o/ /de nas rim pa lnga pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag gis bshad par bya/ /'dod pa'i don grub dam pa ste/ /zhes pa dang por brtsams /7byas nas/ /nor bu chen po rin chen tog /de mthar thug pa mnyam nyid kyi/ /ye shes tshigs bcad nyi shu gnyis/ /'od zer 'phros shing 'dus pa yis/ /ser sna can ni 33—952

rnam bcom zhing / /mtshan gyi don ni grangs bzhin du/ /rin chen 'byung ldan tshul du gnas/ /t+t+waṃ shesnagi rnam par 'phro zhing 'du/ /de nas rim pa drug pa'o/ /don grub dkyil 'khor dgod pa yang / /tshigs bcad bco lnga'i mtshan don ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rngurtogs bya ba/ /zhes pa dang por brtsams byas nas/ /'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /de yi mthar thug mtshan rnams ni/ /a yi rnam par spro zhing bsdu/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi/ /'gro ba phrag dog rnam sbyangs te/ /don grub rnam par rim bzhin dgod/ /de lta bu yi tshul nyid kyis/ /'od zer spro zhing bsdus nas su/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad ni/ /gang gi 'od zer reg gyur pa/ /de yi sangs rgyas rnams su 'gyur—/ /sangs rgyas kun la reg 'gyur zhing / /bsdu zhing bdag dang mnyam par sbyar/ /dkyil 'khor de dag thams cad kyang / /mdog dang gdan dang phyag rgya rnams/ /de bzhin dang po'i sangs rgyas dang 1/ /'khor lo la sogs rim pa yang / /ji ltar grags pa bzhin du dgod/ /de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥyis/ /ye shes 'khor lo rnams bkug cing / /bdag dang mnyam par sbyar byas nas/ /rang bzhin mchod pa'i sprin tshogs bstems(4/ /bsdus pa'i sgo nas bstod pa yang / /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /ces pa dang por brtsams byas nas/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /ces pa'i tshigs bcad bzhi bzhi yis/ /dkyil 'khor lnga la bsdus te bstod/ /de nas mtshan kyi yon tan ni/ /lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'chang / /zhes pa dang por brtsams byas nas / /chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur zhes pa/ /yon tan sgo nas bstod pa yin/ /lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'chang / /zhes pa lnga yis rnam de phye la/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yi 33—953

yon tan ni/ /rim pa bzhin du mkhas pas dbye/ /de yis tshigs bcad mtshan rnams ni/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yi yon tan grags/ /oṃ sarba dharmā 7 zhes pa nas/ /dz+nyā na gar+bha āḥ zheyi bar/ /sku yi phreng ba'i sngags kyis thuni/ /de la brtan zhing rab gnas par/ /sngags kyi sgo nas bstod pa yin/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /zhes pa dang por brtsams byas nas/ /sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis bshad/ /de yi mthar thug ④bsdus pa yiphye/ /sgo nas yang dag ston pa yin / /6de ltar gang zhig sgom byed cing / /ngag gi 'khor lo rnam 'phros te/ /rnam gsum don la dmigs pa yis/ /ring por mi thogs 'dul dbang gis/ /yon tan gzhung sogs thams cad kyang / /ma lus de yis thob par 'gyur/ /sa mchog bcu gnyis rab bgrod nas/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /thun bzhi'am ni thun gsum gyis④/ /mtshan ma brtan po byung gi bar/ /de ni rgyun du bklag bye par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dbang bsgur dang / /zhi sogs las rnams bsam rngupar bya/ /gzhan yang shi la phan pa dang / /cho ga'i bye brag ma lus kun/ /cho ga chen por mthong bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i rim pa rkuyang / /rim bzhin yi ge a las te/ /de nas thig le dmigs pa med/ /sgyu ma'i tshul du spyod lam brtag /dam pa'i gzhung lugs gsal mod kyi/ /bsdus la dga' ba'i ngor byas nas/ /bdag 'dras brtsams trepar mi 'os te/ /khab len dbang gis cho lcags bsdu /1bzhin—/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la mos pa yin/ /rang dbang med par rtsom ཿpa la/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bzod par mdzod/ /de las bdag gis dge ba gang thob des/ /'gro ba rnams kyi mudon rtogs zhi gyur nas/ /bdag 33—954

sogs 'jam pa'i ⑨dbyangs dang 'dra gyur te/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can gol bar shog /'phags pa mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'khor lo'i rim pa/ bla ma dam pa'i cho ga chen po'i gzhung rnams las/ 'gor gyi cho ga yid bzhin nor bu jes bya ba/ cha sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī maṇ+ḍa la bi dhi shiṣ+ṭha 3ma ṇi nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /sprul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang / /ye shes sku nyid la btud nas/ /'jam dbyangs kyis khyab dkyil 'khor ni/ /bsdus dang dbye ba'i bye brag gis/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /cho ga'i rim pa bshad par bya/ /dang po re zhig rnal 'byor pas/ /'gro ba 'dun ri pa'i bsam pa yis/ /yid dga' ba yi sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /sgyu ma'i lus kyi snying ga ru/ /rang gi sa bon bsams nas su/ /'od 'phro ba 7yi sbyor ba dang / /dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /rang gi 'khor lo sprul par bya/ /phyag lnga bya 33—957

ba'i spyor ba dang / /mchod pa rnam pa lnga yis mchod/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba las gsungs ltar/ /gsum pa skyabs 'gro la sogs bya/ /de rjes bstod pas mnyes bya ba/ /thun mong dang ni de ma yin/ /thun mong rnam pa gnyis yin te//dang po mdo nyid ji bzhin pa/ /'chad pa'i 'dud pa nyi shu'o/ /thun mong min par rang gi'o/ /nyi shu pa yi rnam pa yang / /mchog gi dang po sku gsum 'chang / /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag nyid de de bzhin nyid / /stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ /zab cing rgya che'i sgra sgrogs ༄1pa/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong pa nyid dga' 'dod chags blo/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags la sogs spangs/ /srid pa'i dga' ba chen po pa/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med/ /gsang sngags las byung yi ge med/ /gsang sngags don kun skyed pa'o 2sna sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sems can kun la shas cher chags/ /nam mkha' lta bur chags pa med/ /sems can kun gyi yid la 'jug /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /'dod pa'i don grub dam pa ste/ /ngan song thams cad rnam spyong ba/ /mgon po sems can kun gyi mchog /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ha ha hi hi 'jigs par sgrogs/ /rdo rje gad mo cher sgrogs pa/ /gad mo chen mo gad rgyangs can/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /gom pa'i stabs kyis gar byed pa/ /dpal ldan lag pa brgyas gang la/ /nam mkha' khyab par gar byed pa/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /33—958

tshig kun rab tu gsal ba ste①/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /tshig gi dbang phyug smra ba che/ /smra ba'i skyes mchog smra ba'i rgyal/ /smra ba'i dam pa mchog gi gnas/ /sangs rgyas bzhad pa khyod la 'dud/ /tshig la dbang ba tshig mtha' yas/ /tshig bden pa dang bden par smra/ /bden pa bzhi ni tsaston pa po/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs che ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs la gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rig pa/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /mya ngan 'das shing mya ngan 'das/ /legs par mya ngan 'das dang nye/ /bde sdug sel ba mthar rngugyur pa/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas / /theg pa chen po'i tshul gyi mchog /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che / /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /5nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba / /shes rab ye shes me bo 5 che/ /'od chen rnam par snang bar byed/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /dang po sangs rgyas rgyu med pa/ /ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po don grub pa/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po dga' bas dga'/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po mig 'phrul can/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /gom pa'i stabs kyis gar byed pa/ /dpal ldan lag pa brgyas gang la/ /nam mkha' khyab par gar byed pa/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud—/ /dngos po kun kyi rang bzhin mchog /dngos po kun kyi rang bzhin 'dzin—/ /skye med chos de sna tshogs ston/ /thams cad thams cad khrod la 'dud / /ye shes snang ba lam me ba⑥/ /'gro ba'i mar me ye shes sgron/ /33—959

gzi brjid chen po 'od gsal ba/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sngags pa rdo rje dril 'chang ba/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di yis bstod/ /rab tu mos pas gus byed na/ /'jam pa'i 1sna rdo rje ngo bor 'gyur/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang //sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi kye— / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum / /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spong ngo / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgye/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po pazi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re ji bzhin dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i phyarigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang thu gsang ba'i theg pa gsum / /dam pa'i chos kyang gzung bar bkyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bkyi/ /mchod pa'i las rnams ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun kyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis dz+wasdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma rgal ba rnams bsgral / bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs phyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod9/ /de ltar sdom pa 'dzin byed na/ /bdag nyid 33—960

snod du rung bar 'gyur/ /de nas sa bon 'od kyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor rang gi sa bon gzhug /de las ye shes me 'bar bas/ /rnam smin phung po bsregs pa yis①/ /skad cig gis ni sgyu 'drar 'gyur/ /de nas snying rje skyed ṭupa ni/ /sbug bsngal chos dang dmigs med snepas/ /byang chub rnam pa lnga bsgom geste/ /gzugs brnyan gyi ni ye shes la/ /sdug bsngal rnams ni snang ba ni/ /de las 'don pa'i bsam pa ni/ /sdug bsngal la dmigs snying rje'o/ /bdag stong sems can chos rnams kun/ /stong pa nyid du rab sbyor bas/ /kun kyi stong pa las 'jug pa/ /chos dmigs snying rje mnyam nyid do/ /de yang ma skyes pa'i phyir stong par shes pa ni/ /so sor rtog pa shes pa las sems can thams cad dgod bsam pa/ /dmigs med shes rab so sor rtog /sems can don ni rtog med lasabye/ /nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /gang dang gang 'dod snang byed pa⑥ / /dmigs med snying rje bya grub pa'o/ /bdag dang gzhan sogs rtog pa rnams/ /slar zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /gang la chags dang rnam bral kyeba'i/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam par bsgomasakye //de dag ni tshogs gnyis kyi spyoyongs su ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas nam mkha' stong pa la/ /rgyu ⑫byung 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /t+t+waṃ ni 'jigs pa bsgom byas te/ /'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa las/ /hūṃ bcu 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs su/ /khro bo bcu gcig skad cig sgogs/ /hūṃ mdzad gnod tsho1mdzes gtsug tor dang / /gshin rje gshed dang gzhan mi thub/ /rta mgrin dang ni bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /'dod rgyal mi g.yo mgon po dang / /dbyug sngon can dang stobs po che/ /zhal gsum phyag drug 33—961

zhabs gnyis par/ /bskyed la de nyid rnam 'phrul ba'i/ /bgegs bcu bkug ① par bka' bsgo bas/ /bkug ste zhabs 'og phur bus gdab/ /rdo rje gsang sngags brjod bya bas/ /skad cig gis ni bgegs med 'gyur/ /hūṃ mdzad thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu/ /'phros pas dra ba gur dang ni/ /ra ba gnyis dang sa gzhi dang / /rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsgom par bya/ /phyogs mtshams dkyil 'khor bcings pa yitsa / /phyis kyang 'jug par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas zhi ba'i bsam pa yi1 / /kun du bzang por hūṃ mdzad rgyur/ /de las chos kyi 'byung gnas bsam / /dbus su hūṃ las gzhal yas khang / /spyi dang thun mong khyad par ni/ /rim pa bzhin du shes par bya/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs kyis ni rnam par brgyan//dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /grwa dang sgo yi mtshams rnams su/ /zla ba phyed la gnas pa yi/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim thig gdab bo/ /de yi rim pa'i nang bzhugs 5nas/ /dkyil 'khor phyi ma dang mtshungs paratsho/ /mtshan nyid thams cad shes bya ste/ /ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa ru/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba ni/ /kun gyi thun 7mong yin par 'dod/ /bsdus dang so so'i mtshan nyid ni/ /phyi nas 'byung ba las shes bya/ /dbus su saṃ gi tai 8hūṃ i las/ hūṃ gnyis ldan las 9byung ba'i gdan / /ming las mtshon te shes par bya/ /a las zla ba'i steng du bsam/ /de dag ni steng gi ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas sa bon las bskyed 4 pa/ /a las rnam par snang mdzad che/ /mdog dkar zhal bzhi phyag gnyis pa/ /mnyam gzhag pa 'am byang chub mchog /rna 11rgyan la sogs spangs pa ni/ /rtag 33—962

pa'i sangs rgyas bsgom pa'o/ /thugs kar pad+ma gnas pa las/ /byāḥdzo las dang po'i 3 sangs rgyas ni/ /zhal lnga byis pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /phyag brgyad g.yas bzhis ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon bzhis shes rab po ti 'dzin/ /dang po'i bye sangs rgyas thun mong pa'o/ /sangs rgyas de yi thugs ka ru/ /a las gyur pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs drug pa la mu khyud bzhi/ /lte bar a las 'od 'phros pas/ /don byas 'dus pa'i sngags su 'gyur cho/ /lte bar a ste mu khyud gnyis—/ /nang ma'i mu khyud la dgod pa/ /oṃ sarba dharmā a bhā thu ba/ bi shud+dhā badz+ra a ā saṃ aḥ/ phyi rol du ni dgod pa ni/ /rtsibs bcas sam ni sku rtsibs med par/ /dbyangs yig bcu gnyis dgod par bya/ /de yi phyi rim rtsibs drug la/ /gsang sngags rgyal po drug ldan pa/ /dang po'i rtsibs la dgod bya ba3/ /oṃ badz+ra tre+ekyā ya te nā zum/ gnyis pa'i rtsibs la dgod bya ba/ /oṃ duḥkha ts+tsha da ya te nā (ma/ gsum pa'i rtsibs la dgod bya ba/ /oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na murta ye ya te nā tso ma / bzhi pa la ni bsam bya ba/ /oṃ dz+nyā na kā ya ya te nā /3ma/ lnga pa la ni bsam bya ba/ /oṃ wā gī shwa ra 3ya te nā shāgam/ drug pa la ni bsam bya ba/ /a ra pa tsa na ⑪ya te nā thum/ 'khor lo mu khyud gsum sapa la/ /ye shes sems dpa'i sku yi sngags/ /a ā sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ dīḥbha ga bān⑫/ dz+nyā na mūrti rmyewā gī shwa ra/ ma hā wa phyo tsa sarba dharmā/ ga ga na/a mā la su pa ri shudhe dharmā dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha ā bye ཿ/ 'khor lo mu khyud bzhi pa la/ /ka sogs k+ṣa la thug par dgod/ /shes rab 'khor lo'i ting 'dzin to/ /de yi lte ba'i a las ni/ /gnyis su med pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /zhal drug pa la phyag drug pa/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs dang yi ge'i zhal/ /dkar dmar sngo 33—963

dang dkar ljang dkar/ /phyis kyang so sor bya ba yin/ /ut+pal sngon ⑨dmar dang po gnyis/ /mda' dang gzhu ni gnyis pa gnyis/ /mnyam par gzhag ra pas gsum pa gnyis/ /sku ni dung ltar dkar ba'o/ /thugs kar zla ba sa bon no/ /rnam snang chen po zhes bya ba'irngu/ /dang po spyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis//sgyu 'phrul dra bas byang chub pa'o/ /so sor dbye ba'i sbyor ba yang / /dbus su rang gi gdan stengs su/ /dī zihūṃ a a oṃ a las/ /pad+ma gar dang hūṃ byed dang / /rnam snang rta mchog rdo rje nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go rims bzhin/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis te/ /ting 'dzin bdud 'dul byang chub mchog /skyabs mdzad mchog sbyin 'akying bcas pas/ /'on kyang khyad par yod pa'o/ /pad+ma rdo rje rdo rje dang / /rdo rje sna tshogs rin chen dang / /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa ste/ /mdog ni bsdus pa'i zhal gyis te/ /dang po sangs rgyas dhīḥdakar las //sngar gyi kun byu thun mong gisaphyo / /'jam dpal dag tu thams cad mchog /de yi thugs kar shes rab kyi/ /'khor lo sa bon rnams la bskyed/ /rtsibs brgyad yin te rnam snang gi/ /rtsibs bcu pa muni yin par 'dod/ /mu khyud bzhi sogs snga ma bzhin/ /yi ge gyur pas sngags rnams ni/ /rtsibs la dgod pa'i sngags rnams ni/ /ye shes sems dpa'i ming can du/ /bsdus kye/pa'i sngags rnams phye ba'o/ /kha dog sngar bzhin shes par bya/ /shes rab 'khor lo 9bsgom par bya/ /lte ba rnams su sa bon gye skye/ /spro bsdu las grub ye shes sems/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /dmar po la sogs kha dog drug /rdo rje rnon po sdug bsngal gcod/ /shes rab ye shes ye shes sku/ /ngag dbang phyug dang pa tsa'i mtha'/ /ral gri kun gyi g.yas pa ste/ /rang mtshan g.yon na 33—964

'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' bsgom kyipa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ /bsdus dang phye ba'i bye brag gis/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa/ /go rims 2bzhin du shes par bya/ /bsdus pa rnam pa gsum yin te/ /rnam snang gnyis dang rdo rje sems/ /de gsum gtso bo gang rung ngam/ /yang na rang bzhin gcig yin pas/ /gcig tu bsdus pas shes par bya/ /thugs bsdus pa la 'jam pa'i ④dbyangs/ /so so 3la ni sngar bzhin 'dod/ /de yi thugs la sa bon rnams6/ /spros pas 3rang rang dkyil 'khor 'byung / /las byas 'dus nas dkyil 'khor du/ /'og tu 'chad pa'i rim pas gnas/ /dbus dkar shar sngo lho ser zhing / /nub dmar byang gi ljang gu ru/ /kha dog la sogs shes par byaphya7 / /kun gyi dbus kyi mtshan ma ste//'og kyang khro bo'i rdo rje dang / /rin chen pad+ma sna tshogs mtshan/ /nyams dang de dang 'dra bar ram/ /yang na 'grel par bshad pa bzhin/ /ming dang zhal mdog mtshan ma sogs/ /tha dad par ni shes par bya/ /gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis ni tsu / /sna tshogs gzugs 'dzin nor bu bzhin/ /so so rang rang sa bon las/ /rang rigs ⑫thams cad sprul byas nas/ /'dod chags can sogs gdul byas nas/ /'dus nas dkyil 'khor la zhugs pa/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog yin par 'dod/ /rjes kyi las rgyal ting 'dzin ni/ /'od zer spro bsdus shā3'gro ba sbyor/ /kun gyi phrin las mthun pas ni/ /khyad par dbye ba ma bshad do/ /sprul pa byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ /rang gi gtso bo'i sbyor ba yis/ /lag ngar gnyis ni rdo rje bcing / /se gol rdeb phyacing sngags brjod pas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /de tshe sangs rgyas 33—965

thams cad ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs bcas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'dus par 'gyur/ /sngar bzhin bstod pas bstod nas su/ /lcags kyu la sogs rnal 'byor kyis/ /dgug pa la sogs pa byas nas/ /sgo bcad bsrung ba rdzogs pas 'grub/ /gtso bo'i tshidam tshig mchog bcings pa/ /snying gar hūṃ las rdo rje bsam/ /dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes gtso bo'i sngags kyis rjes 'gro ba'o/ /lce la pad+ma bsam bya ste/ /gtso bo'i snosnying po bkod byas pas//chos kyi phyag rgya gsung sgrub 1po/ /gtso bo'i ④las kyi phyag rgya bcing / /spyi bor rdo rje kun dngos bsam/ /las kyi phyag rgya phrin las 'grub/ /ye shes sems dpa'i snying ga ru/ /rang gi mtshan ma bsam byas nas/ /skyephyag rgya chen po bcings pas 'uni/ /phrin las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rigs kyi dbu rgyan bsams nas ni/ /mchod dang mnyam nyid la sogs bstod/ /de nas bzlas brjod bya ba ni/ /shes rab 'khor lo'i sngags rnams las/ /'od zer de 'dra 'jig rten du/ /'gro ba'i don byas der 'dus thim/ /dang po'i bzlas 3pa yin par 'dod/ /yang na numatshan mchog brjod pa ni/ /gnyis pa yin te der yang gnyis/ /bsdus la kun te phye ba la/ /dum bu drug tu gdon byas nasgosna/ /phan yon drug tu rgyud bzhin 'gyur/ /bsdus pa'i man ngag 'di yin te/ /rnam snang che dang rnam snang dang / /rdo rje sems la kyemado gnyis te/ /snying las mtshan rnams thon byas nas/ /sku yi grangs kyis 'jig rten du/ /chags can gti mug can don byas/ /'dus te dbyangs nas gsal byed la/ /thim pas 'od kyi 'khor lor 'gyur/ /dbus kyi cha la gnas pa'o/ /shar sogs mi bskyod la sogs pa/ /rang rang mtshan gyi gnas skabs su/ /sngags 33—966

don rigs kyi lhar 'phros te/ /zhe sdang can sogs dbang byas nas/ /'dus te rang gi 'khor lo ru/ /sngags la 'dus te sngar bzhin no/ /so so rang rang mtshan gyis so/ /dang po'i ming gi spyor bas so/ /phyi snyenas sngags ni nus tshad bzlas / /gal te gtong bar 'dod na yang / /sngar bzhin mchod bstod sngon 'gro bas/ /lhag chad nyes pa zhi ba dang / /bzod pa gsol dang gsal ba dang / /sngar bcings dam tshig phyag rgya dgrol/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub sprul dro/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad par rigs/ /sprul pa'i 'od kyis mider bsdus la/ /stong pa'i nga rgyal brtan bsgoms na④/ /bsrung thub dam pa yin par 'dod/ /spyod lam bzhi yi dus su yang / /'jam pa'i rdo rje ⑥nga rgyal 'chang / /yid la yang ni sbyar bar bya/ /snying po'i ting 'dzin sbyar ba'o/ /de ltar bsnyen par byas nas ni/ /gang 'dod las ni rdzogs 'dod pas/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs las rnams bya/ /grong la sogs pa'i phyogs bdun ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis spang bar bya/ /yon tan kun dang yongs ldan pa'i/ /byang shar mtshams ni yongs su gzung ④/ /sems la nus pa dang ldan na/ /gang du yid dang mthun par bya/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i sa phyogs su/ /drag dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis/ /sa ni sbyang ba 'grub par bya//gyo mo gseg shem thal ba dang / /rus pa phub ma la sogs grub/ /bsal bas gnod pa med par 'gyur/ /dbus su sa ni brkos byas la/ /dag pa'i chu yis bkang byas la/ /me tog dkar po bzung /(/byas la/ /shar du gom pa brgya phyin nas/ /log ste dngos grub brtag pya par bya/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal sngon 33—967

'gro bas/ /bye ser las byung lha mo la/ /bslang ba gzhung dang mthun par bya/ /sa yi dbus su ting 'dzin gsum/ /snga ma bzhin du bsgom bya ste/ /'on kyang khyad par dbye ba yod/ /rten gyi 'khor lo rdzogs byas lahūṃ/ /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag gi gson pa 'bras bur bcas2/ /lha dang dam tshig mnyam 'gyur bar/ /gyur par bdag nyid som nyi med/ /byang chub sems dang sems gcig pas/ /mi ldog — par ni bdag gyur te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su ni/ /deng bdag skye bar ④the tshom med/ /deng bdag nyi ma dam pa ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /deng bdag 'dus pa'i mchog yin no/ /spos snod lag tu thogs nas ni/ /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub 'di ni stsal du gsol/ /de nas ting 'dzin gsum pa ni/ /snga ma bzhin du shes par bya/ /de nas gtso bo'i sbyor ldan pas/ /lag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i/ /nga rgyal 'dzin pas sngar bzhin bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor lo che/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bshad du gsol/ /de ltar bstod pa'i tshig gsan nas/ /phyogs rnams kun du phyag byas nas/ /nga ni rang nyid rdo rje can/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje bdag rang gis/ /nga ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /stobs chen sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid / /bdag po rdo rje chen po'i bdag /byin gyis brlab pa mi 'dor ro/ /mig dang rkang pa byin brlabs nas/ /dkyil 'khor steng du bdag byas la/ /33—968

deng /1shig ces ni brjod byas la/ /g.yas brkyang la sogs 'dug stangs kyis/ /bgegs kyi tshogs ni gzhom par bya/ /de nas phur bus gdab pa yis27/ /'og gi bgegs ni bzlog par 'gyur/ /de nas skyang nul byas nas ni/ /spos kyi dkyil 'khor bya ba ni/ /bdag po'i gnas su gru bzhi ste/ /lhag ma'i gnas su zlum po ru/ /rang rang gi ni snying po 'am/ /sgu yi gsang sngags zlos pas so/ /de nas bum pa bya ba yang / /rnam par rgyal ba la sogs pa/ /rtsa ba nag po ra ri med/ /rang gi mtshan mas mtshan bcas pa'o/ /'bras chags lcug mas la brgyan nas/ /ras zung gis ni mgul pa bcings/ /'bru sna rin chen sna lnga dang / /snying po lnga dang ldan par bya/ /dri zhim chu yis rab bkang la/ /steng du mchod yon chu bzhag la/ /rang gi chos kyi sa bon las/ /rang gi lha ru brtags ④nas ni/ /bsdu dang bstod dang dgug pa dang / /rgyas gdab la sogs sngar bzhin bya/ /de nas dam tshig phyag rgya yis/ /bzung 5ste sgu yi sngags bzlas la/ /mchod yon phul la gnas su gzhag5 /lag bzangs zhus pa'i rgyud gsungs pa'i/ /cho gas gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i cho ga yis/ /sbyin sreg gis ni mnyes par bya/ /gson po'i sheslob ma'ang lha gnas bya/ /'khor bzhi rnams kyi nang nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor cho gas rjes bzung shebs/ /rang la babe+eb par shin tu ldan/ /theg pa che la rab tu mos/ /blo dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor gzhug /gzhan dag rjes su gzung mi bya/ /de nas slob mas phyag byas te/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas// /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid sprul tsodu gsol/ /sdom 33—969

pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol1/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par mdzod/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /tshul chen snod ni khyod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul kyi mchog /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyis kyegasang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /skyob pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de phyir kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis gyeblo gros 'di gyis shig /de nas slob mas brjod bya ba/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /spyig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /bsod nams kun la rjes 5rkyeyi rang / /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bgyi/ /sems can thams cad mgron du gnyer//'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sa ma ya a/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ sa ma ya ho/ /badz+ra satwa ya thā su khaṃ/ snying ga la sogs par byin rlabs pya/ /a shwat+tha la sogs pa'i shing / /sor ni bcu gnyis me tog bcas/ /byin nas kha dang so yang brud/ /rtse nas bcem ste 3dor ba dang / /hub gsum chu yang sbyin par bya/ /dpung pa g.yon par srung skud bcing / /ku sha byin la rmi lam brtag /nga la nang par smros zhes bsgo/ /'jig rten na ni kun mkhyen rnams//u dus+thā sdora'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags kyi ni tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas 33—970

kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis ①mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /gang dag spyod pa'i mchog 'di latsa / /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo bas/ /de dag kun ni 'khor ba'i rgyun/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung bden pa bcad④/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis④7// /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed④/ /gang gis sangs rgyas sras bcas pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung nas skyob bzhin par/ /sang ni rab tu 'dor bcas nas/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams 'dir /tre ni 'dod pas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa⑦/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs par gyur pa yin/ /zhes bstan par bya'o/ /snyan gsan dbab pa rgyud ⑤bzhin bya/ /tho rangs dus su langs nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor steng du sngar bzhin bzhag /sku yi gsang sngags bzlas pa yibye/ /dri yis dkyil 'khor byugs byas la/ /sar pa legs par bsgril ba la/ /kha dog lnga ni legs gyur nas/ /ye shes lnga las sangs rgyas lngar/ /byin kyis brlab pa byas nas ni/ /bcom ldan dkyil 'khor thig gdab phyir/ /rdo rje'i thig ni bdag la gsol/ /btang ba bsdus te bkang nas hūṃni/ /legs par bsgril te mchod cing bzlas/ /sgrub pa'i grogs kyi spyolag gtad la/ /dkyil 'khor brtags te tshad bcal ⑫nas/ /phyi nas thig ni gdab par bya/ /nub nas shar du tshangs thig gdab/ /lho nas byang du'ang de bzhin no/ /byang dang lho dang shar nub dang / /rlung dang dbang ldan phyogs bltas nas/ /dbang po chu dang nor gshin rje/ /zur thig gnyis dang gdab byas nas/ /33—971

ngos bzhi ༄stesna dkyil 'khor bzhin du 'gyur/ /so so'ang cha chen bcu drug tu/ /so sor rnam par phye bar bya/ /dbang po'i ③phyogs nas bcal ④bya ste/ /cha dang po yi mtha' gnyis nas/ /bzhi cha gnyis ni gdab par bya/ /gnyis pa mnyam po bzhi ru'o/ /gsum pa phyed kyi phyed ma gnyis/ /bzhi pa dang po'i tshad dang mtshungs/ /cha ni bcu drug ④dag tu 'gyur/ /gdugs dang 'khor lo pad+ma dang / /rim pa bzhi dang nam mkha' brgyad/ /dgu dang bcu gcig bcu gsum pa/ /de gsum lnga lngar bgo bar bya/ / ya phubs ⑤'gram dang logs su 'gyur/ /de kun ring thung cha gnyis pa/ /bcu dang bcu gnyis gnyis pa ni/ /logs su gcig 'das gcig gis ni/ /bzhi cha logs te de yang yin/ /cha phyed 'das ni phyed kyi phyed/ /nang ma lngar ⑥byas khyud du 'dod// de nang 3cha chen lha snam rkyeyang / /cha phyed gnyis byas phyi ma la/ /mtha' gnyis nas ni bzhi cha gdab/ /gdugs dang pad+ma 'khor lo'o/ /gnyis pa'i nang ma bzhi ru bya/ /skas la sogs pa lta bur 'gyur/ /de yi nang gi cha chen po / /de yang gnyis gnyis shā byas nas su/ /phyi ma gnyis byas de yi nang / /sngar byas ya phubs 31yin par 'dod/ /nang gi cha chen de yi ni/ /bzhi cha gnyis su byas pa las/ /mtha' gnyis dag tu byas pa yang / /lnga char byas pas 'gram dang ni/ /ngos su gyur te de kun yang / /cha gnyis nas ni ring ba med / /khyud dang logs ni rang gi tshad/ /phyi las dpag tshepas nang gi tshad/ /phyed tshad gnyis kyi thubazhi char 'gyur/ /phyogs gsum yang ni des shes bya/ /kun gyi thun mong yin par 'dod/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor dbye ba rnguyang / /bsdus pas gnyis te dbye ba drug /mkhas pas ⑩so sor shes byas te/ /33—972

basbus pas 'dod nga/ brtsam par bya/ /cha ①chen rnam pa bzhir gnas pa'i/ /re re'ang bzhi bzhir byas nas ni/ /tshangs pa'i thig las logs de ru/ /drug pa spyi yi ka bar 'gyur/ /bcu bcu las ni mchog rnams 'dod/ /cha phyed pas ni zlum thig gis/ /bskor te cha phyed phyir bor ba'i/ /cha phyed par ni bskor byas pas/ /nang gi mu khyud dag tu 'gyur/ /dbus dang phyogs bzhi brgyad rnams ni/ /gnyis gnyis su ni byas pa yis/ /bcu drug dag tu 'gyur ba yinaskye/ /dkyil 'khor lnga po kun gyi ni/ /rta babs sgo la sogs pa yidzu/ /phye ba bzhir te cheder shes bya/ /kun gyi phrang gnas lugs dang ni/ /rdo rje dbyings dang khams gsum ⑤rgyal/ /don grub 'gro 'dul las kyi rigs/ /de nyid 'dus pa rgyud kyi rtse/ /'di ru bya zhes mkhas pas 'dod/ /yang na thun mong min pa ste/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte bar bcas/ /ka ba brgyad dang rtsibs rten bcas/ /de yi phyir ⑥rim rtsibs bcu drug /rtsibs rnams rten dang bcas par bri/ /zur brgyad dkyil 'khor rnams dang ni/ /lha yi snam bu'i phyogs bzhin du/ /'khor lo pertsibs dang rtsibs rten dang / /lte bar bcas pa'i 3thig gdab bya/ /phyir yang rdo rje me 'od bskor/ /so sor phye ba'i dkyil 'khor yang / /sngar bzhin rnam pa gnyis shes bya/ /thig gdab pa yi rim pa'o/ /de nas tshon gyi las bshad de/ /sngo ser dmar po ljang gu dang / /dkar po rnams la (rim bzhin du/ /hūṃ t+t+waṃ ⑪s+thāḥ.a ā las ni/ /mi bskyod rin 1gedabang tshe dpag med/ /gdon mi za dang rtag pa bskyed/ /mig gi 'bar ba'i ⑫lcags kyu yis/ /rang bzhin gnas pa kun nas ni/ /'dres pas ro gcig gyur bsams nas/ /bzlas pa bya ste dge ba brtsamashān/ /dang 33—973

por rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas brtsams nas ༄nye/ dgye/ /phyi nas kun du slob mas so/ /shar phyogs su ni sngon po che/ /lho na ⑤ser dang yang dag ldan/ /nub ni pad+ma rā ga ste—/ /byang du ljang gu yin par 'dod/ /dbus kyi sa yi cha nyid ①ni/ /shel ltar dkar ba bla na med/ /sngon po rdo rje rtse rang bzhin/ /gnyis pa gser /4 la dmigs pa ste/ /pad+ma chags pa'i ngo bo gzhanakhye / /de bzhin gzhan ni margad de/ /dkar po nang du shes bya ste/ /'di ni tshon gyi rim par grags/ /de nas lha rnams dgod pa yang / /dkyil 'khor lnga yi dbus su ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya 'dzin/ /seng ge yi ni gdan la bzhugs/ /yang na dbus ma dang po la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dgod par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud/ /yang na rnam snang chen po'o/ /lnga po kun gyi shar phyogs su/ /mi bskyod glang po la gnas shing / /bdud 'dul rdo rje bsnams shing sngoskyo/ /kun gyi lho yi phyogs su ni/ /rin chen dbang gis 7rta la bcibs/ /mchog sbyin rin chen bsnams shing ser/ /dkyil 'khor kun kyi nub phyogs su/ /tshe dpag med pa rma bya bcibs/ /ting 'dzin pad+ma bsnams shing dmar/ /lnga po kun gyi byang phyogs su/ /gdon mi za ba mkha' lding bcibs/ /skyabs mdzad sna tshogs bsnams shing ljang / /rdo rje 'degs pa sngon 'gro bas/ /snying po brjod cing bri bar bya/ /de nyid 'dus pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /lnga la rang gi 'khor gyis bskor/ /yang na 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu drug /rigs kyi mdog ltar dgod par bya/ /rdo rje sems ma rin chen chos/ /las mchog mas te dpal ldan ma/ /mtshams kyi 'khor lo'i 33—974

rtsibs la dgod/ /bzhi yi mtshams bzhi po las ni/ /me mtshams 'khor lo'i rtsibs lnga ni/ /shar sngo lho ser nub dmar zhing / /byang du ljang zhing dbus dkar la / /rigs lnga'i sgeg mo rnam lnga ni/ /dbus su de bzhin gshegs rigs dkar/ /rdo rje shar du sngon po ste/ /lho ru rin chen ser mo'o①/ /nub du pad+ma dmar mo ste/ /byang du las ma ljang ba'o④/ /de bzhin lho nub phreng ba dang / /nub byang glu ma dbang ldan du/ /las ma la sogs de bzhin no/ /phyi yi lha rnams mtshams su ni/ /bdug pa la sogs de bzhin dgod/ /byams pa yang ni rigs lnga'i lnga①/ /'khor lo lag na de bzhin te/ /rigs kyi mdog gi ④dbye bar bya/ /'khor dang gtso bo phyogs sogs ni/ /khā se ⑪ la sogs bshad pa bzhin/ /bskal bzang gzhan yang de bzhin no/ /sgo rnams kun gyi nang du yang / /sgo srung bzhi yang lnga lnga ru/ /gtso bo 'khor yang sngar bzhin brtag /phyag mtshan la sogs dbye ba ni/ /rgyud las ji skad gsung bzhin bya/ /'khor lo bcu tshan gsum dang gsum/ /brgya dang pya brgyad cu rtsa lnga ru/ /mkhas pas bsgrims te bri 3bar bya/ /de ltar phyag rgya chen po 'am/ /yang na lag pa'i phyag rgyar bcas/ /yang na mtshan ma dgod pa 'am 3 yang na yi ge dgod pa 'am/ /yang na gdan kyi mtshan ma 'am/ /gal te 'byor pa med na yang / /phyag rgyas yongs su bsgrub ste ⑨bsam/ /dkyil 'khor bdun ⑩du brtag pa'o/ /so sor phye la'ang de bzhin te⑪/ /rang rang gi ni dkyil 'khor bzhin / /de nas phyi dro'i thun dus su/ /khrus dang rgyan ni rab rdzogs pas/ /rdo rje dril bu rab bskul bas/ /dkyil 'khor lan bdun bskor byas pas/ /lhag pa 1 gang yin 'dor bar 'gyur/ /mkhas pas ma tshang yongs skong mdzad/ /'grub 'gyur smad par mi bya'o/ /lcags kyu la sogs rnal 'byor kyi ⑫ / /steng du 33—975

bteg pa dgug pa dang / /gzhug cing dbang du bya ba'o①/ /de nas bum pa bya ba yang / /rtsa ba nag po ra ri kye med/ /mgrin par ras mchog gis brgyan pa/ /'bru sna rin chen sna lnga dang / /snying po lnga dang ldan par bya①/ /dri zhim chu yis yongs bkang ba/ / bsgrub ste gerang gi gnas su dbul/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dbus su rgo—/ /ting 'dzin gsum po sngon bzhin bsgom⑤/ /ye shes sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis—/ /mchod pa nyid dang gtor ma dang / /sbyin sreg ci nus pa yis mchod/ /bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga yang / /slob ma 'jug pa'i tshul gyis bya/ /de nas slob ma 'jug pa yang / /gson dang shi ba'i las yin te/ /re zhig gnang ⑥ba nod par bya/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi tsub ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub ches spu / /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /slob ma gang yin 'jug par 'tshal / /de nas slob ma thams cad kyis/ /gson pa zhes bya'i '-irtekhyad par te/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon nyid ni bdag la dgongs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lam bstan pa/ /skyob pa chen po bdag 'tshal lo⑪ / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum song la bdag skyabs mchi/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal bu tshur gshegs shig theg chen gyi/ /lam chen snod ni khyod yin te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da kye ltar bzhugs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de dag kun gyis ⑫gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas snye/ /'jig rten spyod pa rjes 'jug phyir/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo kros 'di gyis shig /de nas rgyun bshags byed du gzhug ste/ yol ba'i mtha' ru 33—976

gnas pa las/ /gdong la ①gos kyis g.yogs pa yis/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /bsod nams kun la rjes shu yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni bdag gis thumagron du gnyer/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces brjod du gzhug go/ /de nas oṃ su ra ta s+t+waṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ ④badz+ra sid+dhi ya thā ⑤su khaṃ/ zhes pas sems ni bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas che ge zhes bya ba 'di nyid ni/ byang chub sems ni yongs bzung 4 nas/ /dam tshig mchog dang gsang ba yi/ /'khor lo 'di ni 'jug par 'dod/ /de nas slob ma la bsgrags dze+epa/ /sdom pa thams cad dbog pa ni/ /nus pa'i nyams la dpag ste 3sbyin/ /slob mas yang ni de bzhin gzung / /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs rigs zhugs/ /tshul 'di gzhan la ma brjod cig /gal te smras par gyur na ⑨ni/ /'jam pa'i rgyal po rab khros nas/ /bdun rgyud rigs dang bcas par bzlog /de nas 'og tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra u da kas chu blud hūṃdo/ /gal te gsang na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi chu yis 'grub/ /deng ⑩nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal po nga yin gyisatshe/ /brnyas mi bya zhing mnyan par gyis⑫ / /ye shes dag pa dpog pa dang / /brtan pa'ang gzhung bla bzhin bya ba ste/ /phreng ba dor dang bcing ba dang / /gdong g.yogs bkrol 8 zhing dkyil 'khor bstan/ /bla ma brgyud pa shes par gyis⑫/ /'jug pa rdzogs nas dbang bskur ba/ /lhar bskyed chu dang cod pan dang / /rdo rje dril bu ming dang ni//brtul zhugs rjes gnang gzengs bstod dang / /lung bstan dbugs dbyung la sogs pa/ /cho ga mthong bas shes par bya/ /gson po'i las ni yongs rdzogs nas//33—977

gal te shi la phan 'dogs na/ /ro 'am rus pa gos la ni/ /sku yi sngags kyis kye btab pa yi/ /chu mchog gis ni bkru dang gtor/ /de nas de la gnas pa yi rjo/ /gnod pa'i bgegs rnams bsal ba ni/ /shin tu khros pa'i 'jam dpal du/ /bdag nyid rab tu bsams nas ni/ /gshin rje gshed dam bdud rtsi yi kye / /gsang sngags drag po 4rab bzlas pa'i/ /yungs kar rdo rjer bsams nas ni/ /de la lan gsum rab tu brab/ /de nas de yi bgegs bral la/ /snying ga'i 'dod pa'i rgyal po yis/ /bar do'i shes pa dgug par bya/ /a la sogs pa'i sa bon gyis / /ye shes sems dpa' phyarab bskyed la/ /sems bskyed sdom bzung la sogs dang / /dkyil 'khor du ni gzhug pa rnams/ /gson po'i tshul bzhin byas nas su/ /dbang bskur ba yang rim bzhin bya/ /rnam par dag pa de yi ni/ /lte ba snying ga shog ma dang / /spyi bo rnams ni rim bzhin du/ /shes rab 'khor lo gdags bya ste/ /lte bar shes rab 'khor lo ni/ /mu khyud bzhi dang rtsibs bcu gnyis / /mu khyud bzhi la sngags bzhi dzani/ /sngar bzhin dgod par shes par bya/ /rtsibs la'ang dbyangs yig bcu gnyis te/ /lte bar a yig bsam pa'o/ /snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo yang / /de bzhin bsam pa byas nas ni/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /de yi lus kun khyab par bsam/ /de la sogs pa'i gzugs rten nisnye/ /sbyin sreg tu ni dbul bar bya/ /de yang / thabs 3dang dgang gzar blugs gzar rdzas/ /shing dang sgrub pa po dang snod/ /rdzas bsang ༄ —dgod dang me blang dang / /bsang gtor dang ni me sbar dang / /ku sha dgram dang gnas pa dang / /me bskyed pa dang spyan drang sogs/ /srung /—1skud bcing dang mchod pa dang / /zhabs bsil sgrub dang dbang bskur dang / /dam tshig bsgo tshedang mchod yon dang //33—978

bsang gtor 'thor 'thung sreg lhablugs dang / /me bsang brtag dang dgang blugs dang / /kun bsregs 3bsang dang lha dgod dang / /bsdus dang bstod dang dgug pa dang / /sngon bzhin phyag rgyas dbang bskur dang / /mchod dang mchod yon 'thor 'thung bsang / /dgang blugs cig shos bhe las bsgul dang / /lha rnams gzi byin bskyed pa dang / /me lha dgang blugs mchod yon bcas/ /bsang gtor sogs dang gshegs gsol ba/ /cho ga ji ltar mthong ba yi/ /gang na las kyi cho ga med/ /de ni spyi pyayi cho ga las/ /rgyas pa'i cho ga sngags pas bstan/ /de shes pa la nyes pa bral/ /de ltar byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor sngon bzhin mchod pa dang / /yi ge brgya pa brjod pa dang / /bzod pa gsol dang bsngo ba dang / /phyag rgya dgrol ba'i rim pa bya/ /oṃ khyod kyis ⑤sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsolagye//sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis khyab pa'i/ /bsdus dang rgyas pa'i cho ga ni/ /thun mong thun mong min par sbyar/ /nongs pa klumakhas rnams bzod par mdzod / /gsang bar 'os pa sba ba'i phyir/ /bsdus dang rgyas pa'i cho ga byas/ /'di las dge ba ci thob pa/ /'gro kun 'jam pa'i dbyangs thob shog /'phags pa 'jam dpal rigs bsdus pa dang phye ba'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba slob dpon zla bzangs grags pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// ///tsu kha che'i spumakhan po paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā dz+nyā na dang / lo tsā treb dge slong tshul khrims gzhon nus bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o7// //33—979

'khor spyan drang ste—lku/ /phyag dang mchod pa bya ba ni/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dhū pe 2pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra gan+dhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ne+e wi t+ya smu dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes mchod pa sngon du song nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang /btang snyoms bsgom par bya'o/ /a bha 4ba swa bha ba bi shudha badz+ra tsagru ye.a ā saṃ aḥ / zhes bya bas stong pa nyid du bsgom mo/ /de nas stong pa'i ting 6'dzin las / /dang po a yi rang bzhin las/ /'od 'phros hūṃ las rdo rje ni/ /khro zhal drug ldan me dpung ldan/ /bum pa'i nang du mchod rten ni/ /rin chen lnga las grub pa bskyed/ /chos sgu la brten gzugs sku ni/ /e las byung ba'i bum pa'i nang / /kha dog dkar po bskyed par bya/ /de nang rgyu gyi 'phro 'du las / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /'khor lo rtsibs 8bzhi tshom bu lnga/ /bcu drug 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i/ /dbus su seng ge gti mug gdan/ /shar du glang chen zhe sdang gdan/ /lhor ni rta ste nga rgyal gdan/ /nub tu rma bya chags pa'i gdan/ /byang du shang shang phrag dog steḍa/ /lnga yi bdag nyid bcom pa'i gdan / /zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa ste/ /gzhan yang de bzhin zla ba'o/ /dang po 11dbyangs yig rang bzhin las/ /gti mug blo ste tshul khrims mchog /chos dbyings rang bzhin zhi ba'i sku/ /dbus su rnam par bsam par bya/ /33—984

'di ltar sangs rgyas skye med pa'i/ /zhal lnga phyag brgyad pad+ma'i steng / /'di ltar sangs rgyas skye med pa'i/ /'dab bzhi a ra pa tsa na/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas skye med pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mthing ga ste/ /thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i bar/ /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'o//rdo rje skyil krung bcas par bsgom/ /zhe sdang chen po bzod pa'i bdag /me long rang bzhin mthing ka ste/ /brtan pa'i rtags can mi bskyod pa/ /cung zhig khros pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ /chags pa chen po sbyin pa'i bdag /mnyam pa'i rang bzhin ser po khye ste/ /chags pa chen po'i 3rang bzhin gyis/ /mnyam pa yi ni tshul gyis bzhugs/ /bsam gtan rang bzhin 'dod pa'i bdag/so sor kun rtog dmar po ste/ /'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin gyi / /bsam gtan gyi ni tshul gyis bzhugs/ /skyob pa'i rang bzhin phrag dog selaje// /bya ba nan tan ⑤sna tshogs mdog /phrag dog chen po'i rang bzhin bdag /phrin las kyi ni tshul gyis bzhugs/ /don chen stong pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /me long ye shes mthing ka ste/ /rdo rje bsnams pa 'gying bag can/ /pad+ma zla ba'i steng na bzhugs/ /brjod pa bral bas mtshan ma med/ /mnyam nyid ye shes mthing ka ste/ /rin chen bsnams pa 'gying bag can/ /pad+ma zla ba'i steng na bzhugs—/ /brjod pa 'byung ba smon pa med/ /so sor kun rtog dmar po ste//pad+ma bsnams pa 'gying bag can/ /pad+ma zla ba'i steng na bzhugs/ /chos dang chos can de bzhin nyid/ /bya ba sgrub pa sna tshogs dag /rgya gram bsnams shing 'gying bag can/ /pad+ma zla ba'i steng na bzhugs/ /byang chub mchog gi 'dod pa'i bdag /sku mdog mthing ga chen po ste/ /shes rab chen po'i sku 33—985

'chang ba/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng tū/ /bde ba mchog gi rang bzhin gyi② //sgu mdog ser po'i sgu 'chang ba/ /byams pa'i rang bzhin lcags kyu 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /dga' ba'i mchog gi rang bzhin gyi/ /sku mdog dmar po sgra yi kyibadag /dbyer med thugs kyi mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /mgu ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyicho/ /sku mdog ljang gu'i mdog can thute/ /phrag dog spangs pa mgu ba'i bdag /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /gzugs kyi che skuba'i bdag nyid can/ /sku mdog gser dang 'dra ba ste/ /dbul ba sel mdzad rin chen 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /kha dog shin tu gsal ba yi/ /sku mdog ban+d+ra klul yi mdog /gnyen po mthar 'dzin nyi ma 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /mtshan thos pas ni snyan pa ste/ /ljang gu sna yi rnam shes sku/ /snyan pa yis ni tog 8 'dzin pa'i/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /snying po 'dus pas mi bzad mdzod / /sku ni mthing ga'i mdog can te/ /'gyod pa med pas so /kyephreng 'dzin—/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /shes rab kyis ni rnam par 'byed/ /sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /chags pa med pas pad+ma 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /nyon mongs pa yi 'dzin pas bcings/ /sku mdog ljang gu 'od dang ldan/ /nyon mongs gcod byed ral gri 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /snang ba bzhin du gsal bar rtogs/ /mthing ka lce yi rnam shes sku/ /gzhan yang ltos pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /rtog pas rang 'dra de rtog nyu7byed/ /sku mdog gser bsregs 'dra ba'i sku/ /smra bar byed pa'i lce bsnams shing / /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /33—986

mkhas pas gnyen po sna tshogs brten/ /ljang gu'i mdog can mdzes pa'i sku/ /sbyor ba'i bdag nyid rgya gram 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin don kun 'grub/ /sku mdog mthing ka chen po ste/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i mche ba 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /byams dang snying rje dga' bas dga'/ /sku mdog gser 'dra mdzes pa'i sku/ /dman pa'i lus grol go cha 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /'bras bu chos sku sgyu ma'i sgu//mig 'phrul sprul pa mthing ga'i mdog /rang bzhin don grub khu tshur phyag /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam brgyan cing / /bzhi bzhis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /sbyin pa'i bdag nyid sgeg mo gtso/ /sku mdog dkar mo me long 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /shar lho mtshams su bsam par bya/ /tshul khrims bdag nyid phreng ba ma/ /sku mdog ser mo phreng ba 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /lho nub mtshams su bsam par bya//bzod pa'i bdag nyid glu ma ni/ /sku mdog dmar mo pi wang 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /nub byang mtshams su bsam par bya/ /brtson 'grus bdag nyid gar ma ni/ /sku mdog ljang gu gar ma ste/ /rdo rje skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /byang shar mtshams su bsam par bya/༄kyi/ /dang po'i dbyangs yig las byung ba'i/ /shes rab dkyil 'khor bskyed byas nas/ /'khor lo bcu drug dag la ni/ /thabs kyi dkyil 'khor de bzhin no/ /byams chen rang bzhin dpag med pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa ni/ /sku mdog dmar ser gudhe nyabasnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /snying rje shes rab mchog gi sku/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal ni/ /ljang ser phyag 33—987

na at+pal bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /dga' ba'i shes rab blo chen ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos glang po/ /mthing ga phyag na spos phor 'dzin/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /mkhas pa btang snyoms thabs che ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' ye shes tog /dkar po phyag na tog bsnams te/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /rdzu 'phrul snying rje'i stobs dang ldan/ /sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtsho ni/ /gser mdog phyag na rin po che/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /shugs chen byams pa'i stobs dang ldan/ /sems dpa' blo gros mi zad lkupa/ /gser mdog phyag na rin chen 'dzin/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs dga' ba'i bdag /byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong ni/ /mdog sngon bye phyag na spos kyi shing / /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /bdag gzhan sde 'joms btang snyoms bdag /byang chub sems dpa' spobs brtsegs ni/ /mthing ga'i mdog can pu ste 1bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng //srid pa'i ri 'joms dga' ba ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob/ /mdog dmar phyag na pad+ma bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /sra zhing mkhregs pa btang snyoms sku/ /byang chub sems dpa' ngan song 'dren/ /dmar ser phyag na lcags kyu 'dzin/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /drag po chen po byams pa'i sku/ /byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan 'joms/ /dung mdog phyag na ral gri bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /snying rdzas 'jigs 4pa che las skyob/ /byang chub sems dpa' dra ba can/ /mdog dkar phyag na dra ba bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /33—988

mgon po'i rigs te btang snyoms sku/ /sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nu ni/ /dkar ser phyag na zla ba bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /dga' ba'i byin brlabs che ba'i mchog /byang chub sems dpa' 'od dpag med—/ /mdog dkar phyag na lcags kyu bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /byang chub snying rje'i lam gyi bdag /sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po ni/ /sku mdog ljang khu ral gri 'dzin/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /theg chen byams pa chen po'i bdag /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i mdzod/ /mthing ka rin chen zur brgyad sgrom/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /bsam gtan gyi ni bdag nyid de/ /dri yi lha mo bdug pa ma/ /mthing ka'i 1 mdog can spos phor 'dzin/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i bdag /mdzes pa'i me tog lha mo ni/ /dkar mo phyag na me tog 'dzin/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /thabs kyi shes rab pha rol phyin/ /mdzes pa'i dri yi lha mo ni/ /dmar mo phyag na dri chab bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /smon lam gsal ba'i pha rol phyin/ /ro dang ldan pa'i zhal zas ma/ /ljang gu phyag na ro mchog bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng / /ye shes snyeng rje chen po yi/ /khros pa'i lha mo lcags kyu ma/ /mthing ka phyag na lcags kyu 'dzin / /khros/ pa'i tshul kyis zla ba'i steng / /byams pa'i pha rol phyin pa'i stobs / /khros pa'i lha mo zhags pa ma/ /ser mo phyag na zhags pa bsnams/ /khros pa'i tshul gyis zla ba'i steng / /dga' ba'i pha rol phyin pa'i stobs/ /khros pa'i lha mo lcags sgrog ma/ /dmar mo phyag na lcags sgrog bsnams/ /33—989

khros pa'i tshul gyis zla ba'i steng / /ye shes zad med btang snyoms bdag /khros pa'i lha mo dril bu ma/ /ljang gu'i mdog can dril bu ma/ /khros pa'i tshul kyis zla ba'i steng / /dang po'i dbyangs yig rang bzhin las/ /lha rnams de ltar bskyed par bya'o⑦/ /oṃ pra kṛ ta pa ri shudhe sarba dharmā ya du ②ta/ sarba ta thā ga tā shudz+nyā na kā ya mañju shrī pa ri shudhi tā4// mu pā da ye ta ⑤a/ zhes spyan drang bar bya'o/ /a ā i yī u u e e o skyogasaṃ a / sbri meto z-i di pedz+nyā na thortiphya/ra haṃ busgo bud+dhā māṃ/ rngu dh+wa spuwarnyi ni/ oṃ badz+ra dīkyā⑩/ duḥkhats+tsha da/ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na sprurta ye skya/ dz+nyā na kā 7ya/ wā gī tsashwa ra/ a ra pa tsa nā ④ya te na maḥ ⑪ /zhes phyag btsal 7bar bya'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes bya bas gnyis su med par bstem par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā 7dz+dza da ya ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ byāḥbha ga bān dz+nyā na mūrti a/ zhes bya bas zla ba'i steng du sa bon gsum gyis byin gyis lke brlab par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ sarba dharma 7ga ga na/ a ma bye la su pa ri shudha dharma ⑥dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha ā ༷ཿ/ zhes bya bas dbang bskur te/ rigs rnams kyis mtshon ༷ rte pa'o/ /de nas bsgom pa rab tu brtsams sna / /ma yengs gsal bar byas te bsgom thu/ /a ra pa tsa na a zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas mtshan gyi sngags brjod par bya'o/ /mtshan ⑫rnams bsdus nas gtso bo la zhu ste kun du zhal rnam par snang mdzad du'o/ /gzhan du ni gtso bo zhu ba dang rjes kyi gtso bo zhu ba'o/ /gti mug can sbyangs nas/pradz+nyā dz+nyā na sprurte 7a zhes bya bas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes sems dpa' las byung ba'i skur gsal bar byas te mtshan brjod par bya'o/ /zhe sdang can sbyangs nas duḥkhats+tsha da zhes bya bas me long lta bu'i ye shes sems dpa' las byung ba'i skur 33—990

gsal te mtshan brjod par bya'o/ /'dod chags can sbyangs nas oṃ badz+ra tīkyā 1zhes bya bas so sor kun du ④rtog pa'i ye shes sems dpa' las byung ba'i ①skur gsal te mtshan brjod par bya'o/ /nga rgyal can sbyangs nas oṃ wā gī ④shwa ra zhes bya bas rgyamanyam pa nyid kyi ye shes sems dpa' las byung ba'i skur gsal te mtshan brjod par bya'o/ /phrag dog can sbyangs nas dz+nyā na kā ya zhes bya bas bya ba grub du pa'i ye shes sems dpa' las byung ba'i skur gsal te mtshan brjod par bya'o / /de ltar longs sku dang sprul sku'i sngags brjod nas bstod pa ni/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /ces bya bas stong pa nyid de dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa dang /rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'o/ /yum bzhis chos sgu la bstod pa'o/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ces bya bas nang stong pa nyid dang 3phyi stong pa nyid dang phyi nang stong pa nyid dang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi sgo nas shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis chos sku la bstod pa'o/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ces bya bas chen po stong pa nyid dang don dam pa stong pa nyid dang 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid de lho'i 5phyogs kyi sems dpas chos sku la bstod pa'o/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud//sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /33—991

ye shes las byung khyod la ①'dud/ /ces bya bas mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang rang bzhin stong pa nyid de nub phyogs kyi sems dpas chos sku la bstod pa'o//sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /ces bya bas chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid de byang phyogs kyi sems dpas shuchos sku la bstod pa'o/ /a bhā ba swa bhā ba bi shudha badz+ra tsak+ṣu saṃ acho/ zhes bya bas bzlas pa bstan nas gtor ma gtang bar bya'o/ /de nas spyod lam gyis gnas par bya'o/ /bdag gis bla ma'i gdams pa la brten nas/ rgyud don dbang po rdo rje'i tshig don sbyar/ /mkha' 'gro'i rjes su 'brangs nas de brtsams pas/ /'gro kun ye shes sems dpa' rtogs par shog /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs u rgyan gyi slob dpon shrī a wa dhū ༄ltat+t+waṃ pa chen pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā shrī mi tra dang / bod kyi lo tsā 6ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //33—992

1506༄༅/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma saṃ gī ti no pi ka /bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs / 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa/ /gdong lnga gtsug phud lnga dang ldan / /gsang sngags rgyal po drug ldan 'dud/ /dang por sngags 2pas dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan par byas te/ yid dga' ba'i gnas su 'dug la/ tho rangs kar 4kha'i sgo dag par byas la/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du / yi ge sum̐ rnam par bsams la/ 'od zer gyis bla ma dang yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan drangs la/ phyag btsal ba dang / mchod pa dang /rjes su yi rang ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bsgul zhing / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya'o/ /de nas byams 33—995

byedapa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes/ la stong pa nyid bsgoms 1te/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ / sngags 'di'i don la dmigs pas/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsgom mo/ /de nas yi ke dhīḥlas pad+ma'i gdan dmar po bsam zhing / de'i steng du a las zla ba'i gdan rnam par bsams te/ dbus su yi ge sum̐ dmar skya 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phro zhing 'du ba bsam par bya'o/ /de nyid thig ler gyur pa las / /ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po sprin dkar dag pa lta bu rdo rje skyil krung can/ phyag bzhi dang ldan pa g.yas g.yon gnyis na mdzes pa'i ral gris 2'debs shing shes rab kyi puste 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i 'og ma gnyis na mda' dang gzhu nabasnams pa'o/ /gzhon nu'i rgyan can no/ /de ltar rnam par bsgoms te/ āt+ma 4kophohaṃ/ zhes brjod la/ nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ yi ge las byung ba'i pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bzhugs te/ mchod pa'i tshogs kyis rnam par mchod la/ rang dang gnyis su med par bsre bar 5bya'o/ /snying ga 6dang mgrin pa dang dpral ba dang spyi bo rnams su/ rdo rje dang pad+ma dang rin po che dang sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas btab ste/ thugs ka'i spu'od zer kyis nam mkha' khyab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsgul bas lha mo'i tshogs kyis bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bsgur te/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs dang bcas pas dbang bsgur ro/ /de'i thugs kar 8zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du/dīḥyongs su gyur pa las dang po'i sangs rgyas sgu mdog dkar po zhal lnga phyag brgyad pa/ zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ byis pa'i rgyan thams 33—996

cad kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i na bza' can/ g.yas bzhi na mdzes pa'i ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam de'i thugs kar lhashes rab kyi 'khor lo rnam par bsnams te/ lce drug pa kha dog drug dang ldan pa/ mu khyud bzhi yis bskor ba/ lte bar yi ge a dkar po bsams te/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gyi khams thams cad khyab par byas te/ slar 'dus te de nyid la thim pas rtsa ba'i sngags dgod par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba dharmā a bhā ba swa nabhā ba bi shudha badz+ra a ā e aḥ/de'i phyi rol mu khyud la dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu gnyis dgod do/ /de'i phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa ste/ dang po'i rtsibs la oṃ badz+ra t+t+waṃkyā ya te nā ma4/gnyis pa la oṃ duḥkha ts+tsha da ya te nā 5ma/ gsum pa la oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta 6ye ya te nā ④ma/ bzhi pa la oṃ dz+nyā na kā ya ya te nā ma/ lnga pa la oṃ wā gī shwa ra 9ya te nā tshim/ drug pa la oṃ a ra pa tsa nā tsoya te nā 4 ma/ phyi'i mu khyud dang po la ye shes sems dpa'i phreng sngags/ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i te da ya zhes bya ba nas/dz+nyā na gar+bha āḥthuzhes bya ba'i bar du dgod do/ /phyi'i mu khyud tha ma la yi ge ka nas ha'i mthar sagasal byed kyi yi ge dgod do/ /de ltar snying gar bsam zhing /de las 'khor lo de'i dbus su a las bskyed pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' zhal drug pa ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing / in+d+ra dī la'i gtsug phud can/ nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od 'dra bas bskor zhing / zhi ba'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis ut+pa la dmar po dang sngon po/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam gyis mdzes pa g.yas dang g.yon na rim pa bzhin bsnams pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing skyil mo krung gis/ sku 33—997

bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de'i thugs kar hūṃzla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su yi ge a bkod de/ de las 'od zer 'phros shing / 'khor lo'i sngags kyi kha dog ji lta ba bzhin 'od zer 'phros te/ rang dang 'jig rten gyi khams kun khyab par byas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad gsal bar 'gyur zhing / sems can gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas te/ 'od kyis rnyide bzhin gshegs pa thams cad slar basbus nas/ bdag nyid la lan gsum bskor te/snying ga'i sngags dang zla ba dang bcas pa gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i tshul gyis/ bdag med pa brtan por bsgo ma mo / /de lta bu'i tshul gyis sngags kyi bzlas pa rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang sngags bzlas pa dang / mtshan yang dag par brjod pa bklag 1pa yang rim pa des yang dang yang 4du bya'o/ /thun mtshams su ni ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol zhing ji ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa bdag nyid la bsdu bar bya'o/ /bdag nyid kyang mi dmigs pa la lha'i rnal 'byor du langs te/ spyod lam thams cad kyang bden pa gnyis kyi tshul gyis dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma dang /sbyin sreg dang / mchod pa dang / mdo gdon pa la sogs pa mchod rten gyi las dang / sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / lus ngag gi spyod pa thams cad lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas sgyu ma'i tshul gyis sbyar bar bya'o//zas la sogs pa ni rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i bdud rtsi chen por sngags kyis btab la tshim par bya'o/ /phyi'i khrus don du gnyer ba'i tshe yang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rang bzhin rnam par dag pas bkru'o/ /nyal ba'i tshe chos kyi dbyings la snyoms par zhugs pas nyal lo/ /ldang na gzugs kyi sku'i rim pas 33—998

so / /tshul 'di lta bur gang zhig sgom par 1byed pa de ni 'dul ba'i dbang gis de nyid ring por mi thogs par nam mkha'i dkyil na bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /ye shes sems dpa' sprul pa'i 2sku yi sgrub thabs 'di/ /rgyud dang sgeg pa'i rdo rje byang chub mchog ldan dang / /'jam dpal grags pa bla ma'i man ngag rim pa 'di / /gsang ba'i mtshan ldan rdo rje las grub kyis/ /dam pa nyer bsten dan hri badz+ra las/ /byang chub sgyu 'phrul spyor ba'i man ngag 'di/ /rnyed nas 'di la gus phyir bdag gis bris/ /'di yis 'gro kun ye shes sems dpar shog /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs sdogs so// //bsdur mchan/995 )mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sngag/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag pa/ra brjod pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabasngags/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ngathob/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tha996 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgom/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhu rnam/sa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉srasad+ma/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra bsres par/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka 7 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skaba'i/997 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabar/ rte〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi.a bhā ba swa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉ti1/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉na maḥ/5〈〈pe 〉〉ti na/ 〈〈snar 〉〉te na/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lbārta/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sde/ 71132〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sras/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thar/ ྾〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mego/998 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabar/ 3 〈〈snar 〉7)/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabags/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉giyang /999 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra stan/33byed999
