1507༄khya/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī maṇ+ḍa la bi bye kri ta/ bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyab pa'i bdag po ye shes sgu/ /de bzhin nyid dag 2dri med pa'i/ /tshig la smra mkhas brjod pa'i gsung / /khyab bdag sku lnga la bstod de/ /sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad/ /thabs dang shes rab don ldan pa'i / /dad ldan thos pa la brtson dang / /dbang thob gnang 4ba sbyin pa'i phyir/ /dben pa'i gnas kyi bar chad bsal/ /byams sems ldan pas bsnyen pa brtsam/ /slob mas thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas phul nas/ /bdag ni mi shes rang bzhin gyi / /lam gyi dam pa bstan du gsol/ /gsol btab gnang sbyin ched du ni/ /rdzas rnams la sogs gnang ba sbyin/ /byams ldan bsnyen pa la 'jug bya/ /gtso bo la 33—/00/

'bum gzhan la khri/ /oṃ badz+ra ṭīkyā 1 duḥkha ts+tsha da/ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ ye2/ dz+nyā na kā ya bā gī —zhwa ra a ra pa tsa na hūṃ dhīḥ4/ phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma btang 5/ /bsod nams bsags pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i mtshan byung nas/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las brtsam bya/ /dang po sangs rgyas sgur gsal 6la/ /lha mnyes sa bslang sa brtag dang / /nags tshal spang ljongs nyams dga'i gnas/ /sngar byas rang yid dga' bar brtsom7 dri zhim chus gtor me tog dgram/ /de ltar sa brtag de ru ni/ /mchod pa lnga yis lha mo mchod/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha ma khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /bdud kyi sde rnams bcom pa ltar/ /de ltar bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /lan gsum brjod pas sa la thim/ /de yi rtags ni shar la sogs/ /mthon / dman rtags kyis brtag par bya/ /rko ba lto 'phye'i lte rtabar brko/ /dri yi chu yis spangs la bzhag /de nas lag mthil ltar mnyam bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ /sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsam/ /logs dang steng yang de bzhin no/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor lha mchod pas/ /lha rnams khyed ni dpang du gyur/ /bdag gzhan sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ /rin chen sna tshogs dkyil 'khor bri/ /de nas dbu rgyan stod g.yogs dang / / rgyan bgos rdo rje dril thogs nas/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥt+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ / oṃ badz+ra gadhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra be+e bi t+ya —āḥt+t+waṃ/ zhes mchod nga/ lngas mchod/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa/ /sgyu ma sprul pa bdag nyid 33—1002

kyi1 / /'ja' tshon lta bur so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab sgu mnga' ba'i / /dkyil 'khor ldan la 2phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khong nas 'byung ba shes rab thabs/ /shes rab dkyil 'khor bshad du gsol/ /nyon mongs dug rnams sel mdzad pa'i/ /thabs kyi dkyil 'khor bshad du gsol/ /oṃ pradz+nyā maṇ+ḍa la pra be+e ༄ sha /oṃ u pa maṇ+ḍa la pra be+e zusha /de nas phyogs bcu khro bos bsrung / /bka' bsgo 3stang stabs bya bar bshad/ /gur dang bla re la sogs pa / /rak+ṣa'i sngags kyis bsrung bar bya'o/ /ba yi rnam lngas legs 6byugs te / /de steng 7dri yi thig le dang / /me tog tshom bu dgram par bya /tshogs bsags stong nyid bsgoms nas ni/ /rgyu las gzhal yas as lha bskyed/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bya/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas skyed byed yum/ /khong nas 'byung ba skye med bdag /smra bsam brjod med spros bral yum/ /gsang ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod pa chen po gti mug che/ /gti mug ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /ma rig mun sel 'khor lo 'dzin/ /rnam par snang mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod pa chen po zhe sdang che/ /zhe sdang ma lus 'joms mdzad cing / /mkhregs 9shing rdo rje chen po 'chang / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod pa chen po nga rgyal che/ /nga rgyal ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu chen po rka'adzin/ /rin chen 'byung ldan phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che/ /'dod chags ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /sprin dkar dag bzhin pad+ma bsnams/ /snang ba mtha' yas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod pa chen po phrag dog che/ /phrag dog ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /srid pa'i ri bo chen po 'joms/ /phyag 33—/003

'tshal don yod grub la bstod/ /dang po sangs rgyas rgyu med cing / /gdong lnga gtsug phud lnga dang ldan/ /glegs bam ral gri phyag na bsnams/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs/ /nyon mongs mi shes g.yul ngo sel/ /dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul ba/ /shes rab 'khor lo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /ye shes gnyis med gzugs 'chang ba/ /ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can/ /ye shes sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod pa chen po bde chen ldan/ /dga' ba don ldan mgu bar byed/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mtha'/ /shes rab sems dpa' bcu drug bstod/ /sbyin pa'i bdag nyid sgeg mo la/ /tshul khrims bdag nyid phreng ba ma/ /bzod pa'i bdag nyid pi wang ma/ /brtson 'grus bdag nyid gar mkhan 1ma/ /lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shes rab mar me bsam gtan bri2/ /thabs ldan me tog smon lam ro/ /phyag 'tshal lha mo bzhi la bstod/ /sems can don la rab brtson pa'i/ /snying rje chen po blo mchog ldan/ /byams pa la sogs thabs kyi bdag /thabs kyi sems dpa' bcu drug bstod/ /stobs ldan lcags kyu zhags pa ma/ /ye shes lcags sgrog dril bu ma/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid kyi/ /sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas grub pa'i las brtsams nas/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /thal sbyar pus btsugs dril bu gsil/ /spos thogs de ltar gsol ba gdab/ /de nas bsgrub 5pa byas nas ni/ /gsol ba btab pa sngon song nas/ /gsang 33—1004

ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la gdeg—1 /nyi zla'i 2bar du mkha' la gdeg1 /de nas slob ma gzung bar bya/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa'i/ /mgon po chen bo bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de ni stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /dkon mchog gtso 'khor bcas pa dang / /skyabs dang grong mchog 'jug par 'tshal/ /bu tshur lam chen 'dir zhugs pa'i//bu tshur jeg chen rten yin te/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /khrod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /lam 'di la ni brten nas ni/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar 4rnams/ /byang chub shing gi gdan drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen nga/'i 'bras bu thob/ /bdud sde dag kyang 'di yis 3bcom/ /de bas 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis lam 'di bsgrub par kyis6/ /dkyil 'khor lnga dang dkon mchog gsum/ /dus 'di 7rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo slob dpon la/ /dus 'di 8rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /bla rnged dkon mchog dkyil 'khor lha/ /thams cad bdag la dbo/ngas su gsol/ /bdag dus 'di nas gzung byas te/ /tshangs spyod dam tshig sdom pa gzung / /phyogs bcu'i 9nam mkha'i khams bzhugs pa'i/ /bla ma slob dpon yi dam lha/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dam chos rnams la bdag sdig bshags / /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang / /dkyil 'khor chos dang dge 'dun gyi / /yon tan yongs su sgrogs rnams la/ /de la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /bde gshegs mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs/ /phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam lha/ /dkyil 'khor gtso 'khor bcas pa dang / /33—/005

sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /snying po byang chub mchis bar du/ /di ring nyid du skyabs su mchi/ /bdag ni deng du shegazung du gsol/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed ltar/ /de bzhin sems can phan don du/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /rnal 'byor sangs rgyas sdom pa gzung 2 / /rdo rje rin chen khyad par gyi/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sdom pa gzung / /thabs dang shes rab bsam pas ni/ /slob dpon nyid du sdom pa gzung / /rin chen 'dzin pa chen po yi/ /yid du 'ong ba'i dam tshig la/ /nyin re bzhin ni / dus drug tu / /sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin par bya/ /pad+ma 'dzin pa chen po yi4/ /thabs dang shes rab las byung ba'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa yizhe/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sdom pa gzung / /phrin las 'dzin pa chen po yi/ /tshul khrims gsum tsholdan bya ba dang / /rgya che gzhan gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa gzung bar bya/ /de ltar sdom pa rab bzung nas/ /slob ma bsrung bar rab tu bya/ /'bru gsum sngags kyis rab bsrungs nas/ /gnas gsum byin brlabs rab brtan nas/ /mchod pas slob ma brtan 7phyir mchod/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal ba ko tsam / /bshams nas so shing dor bya ni/ /ut+pal pad+ma dri zhim ni/ /sor ni bcu gnyis 'bus ma zos/ /dri dang me tog shin tu bcings/ /shar bltas mi g.yo steng du dor/ /bza' 8zin nas ni mi g.yo dor/ /steng bltas 1mchog thob phyogs su ni/ /so so'i phrin las mtshams su ni/ /dngos grub tha ma 'og gis 7'og /de nas dri ma dag pa'i phyir/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya 33—/006

bā gī 1shwa ra/ ma hā pa tsa bi sho dha sarba pā paṃ rū pa tsit+ta bāka a 72pa ya na t+t+waṃ/bzlas pa'i chu yis lus ngag yid/ /so sor 5dag phyir hub gsum btung / /de nas rgyud ni sbyong ba'i phyir/ /dad dang mi lus thob pa dang / /sangs rgyas 'byung ba shin tu dkon/ /me tog u dusmra phyar bzhin/ /lam bzang rnyed pa de bas kyang / /shin tu sdig pa zad byed pa/ /dkyil 'khor dbang ni thob par dka'o6/ /dbang ldan nus pa thob dka'o/ /de nas oṃ āḥt+t+waṃ ma ni bi 7shudha t+t+waṃ/ sarba pā paṃ bi shun+ta hūṃ/ ku sha 3ribyin brlabs sngas su gzhug /ldang ba'i stobs kyis smon 9lam gdab/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa—/gnyis kyis bsrung nyu1ba'i skud pa bya/ /byin brlabs srog gnas nyid du gdags/ /de nas gtor ma gtang nyu byas nas/ /slob ma seng ge'i nyal thabs nyal/ /rmi lam rtags nyu5ni so sor brtag /rtags bzang spro ba ngan na ni/ /sbyin sreg gzhan gyis chisdig pa spyong snye/ /slob dpon dkyil 'khor nang zhugs 7te/ /slob ma sta gon la gnas pa'o/ /de nas rin chen lnga las byas/ /bum pa kha dog dkar po ste/ /pad steng so so'i mtshan ma dgod4 / /mgul chings 8kha dog so sor bcings/ /'bru dang rin chen lnga dang ni/ /snying po lnga dang spos lnga blugs 7/ /'bras bu can gyi kha rgyan shing / /sbyangs nas de nas dgram par bya / /lha grangs mthun pa'i bum pa dgram/ /bi shudha yi sngags kyis sbyangs/ /bye las rin chen bum pa bskyed/ /nang du so so'i lha rnams bsam/ /dgug gzhug la sogs rdzogs pa dang / /mchod nas bstod cing 'dud kyis ༄ — bstod/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sarba ta thā ga tā 2dṛ da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ s+thāḥ/ bha ga bān dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ ra haṃ busgo bud+dhā dzā/ bā gī shwa ra/ ma hā wa tsa/ sarba dharmā ga ga na 33—1007

a ma la su pa ri shudhe/ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gasgo āḥsna/ oṃ badz+ra tre+ekyā tso.āḥhūṃ/oṃ duḥkha ts+tsha da āḥhūṃ/ oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta ya āḥhūṃ/ oṃ bā gī 4shwa ra āXhūṃ/oṃ dz+nyā na kā ya āḥhūṃ/ oṃ 5a ra pa tsa na a hūṃḥ6/ zhes pas ni rigs so so dang tha mas/ ni las thams cad pa'i bum 7pa byin gyis brlab po/ /de ltar bsgrub pa'i dus su maṇ+ḍal byas la/ me tog go rims ḍaso sor dgram/ /mar rnge mchod pa so so'i grangs// /zin nas ras kyi steng du gzhagaskru /de nas dkyil 'khor las byas te/ /dang por thig gi las bya'o/ /sar pa tshad dang mtshan nyid ldan/ /dri zhim chu dang snod du gzhag31 /bdag nyid shar du 'dug nas ni/ /thig ni ye shes lnga ru bskyed/ /phyogs bcu'i ye shes bkug nas spyo bstem/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so//de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ 1 zhes pas lngasum sgri'/ du bya'os/ /de nas slob mas blangs la dang po mkha' thig glugadab bo —/ /sa yi thig gdab slob dpon nub/ /slob ma shar 'dug tshangs thig gdab/ /slob ma lhor 'dug slob dpon byang / /slob dpon shar lho lho nub ste/ /de bzhin logs thig gdab par bya/ /zur thig de nas cha chen gdab/ /de nas cha chung bcu drug gdab/ /de nas phyi dang nang du dbye 8/ /nang du bcu drug de bzhin dbye/ /phyi dang de bzhin cha yis 9dbye/ /cha rnams dbye ba sgo rgyan te/ /nang gi phyed cha pho brang ste/ /tshom bu lnga ldan pad 'dab bzhi/ /de ltar thig ni so sor gdab/ /ye shes skud pa mchod pa ni/ /ye shes gshegs la dam tshig basbu/ /de nas rdul tshon dgye ba ni/ /rin chen lnga yi phye ma'am/ /yang na 'bras kyi phye mas bri/ /kha dog so/ sor dgram nas ni/ /oṃ hūṃ swā i hā 2 go rims su/ /ma dag bshig 33—/008

nas dag pa bskyed/ /ye shes lnga ni spyan drangs bsnyims ༄1/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes lan bdun bzlas nas ni/ de nas tshon rtsi rim bzhin du/ /dadzus nas brtsams te bri bar bya/ /sgo ni shar nas dbye bar bya'o/ /dang po'i tshon la mchod pa ni/ /yid kyis mchod nas tshig 'di brjod/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnam dag lanya/ /sems can yongs dag zhing 'dir bri/ /nyes pa'i dri ma kun bral phyir/ /rdul tshon ye shes lnga yis bri5 / /dang bo dbus su pad+ma ni/ /sna tshogs shin tu ze 'bru dkar/ /shar gye sna tshogs ze 'bru mthing / /lho yi sna tshogs ze 'bru ser/ /nub tu sna tshogs ze 'bru dmar//byang du sna tshogs ze 'bru ljang / / rdo rje'i 4gdung dang 'dra ba bskor/ /pad+ma nyi mas rab tu bskor/ /de ni nang gi pho brang ngo / /gru chad ljang la sgo bzhi dang / /rta babs la sogs bcas pa'o/ /de yi phyi rol cha chen gcig /rtsibs bcu drug pa'i 'khor lo'o/ /shar mthing lho ser nub dmar po/ /byang ljang gu chad ljang gu ste/ /sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi ldan pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor legs par rab tu bri/ /nam mkha' dang bsre thugs mtshan dgod/ /dbus su sa bon a bris nas/ /phyogs bzhi gzhan gyi don bzhin no/ /dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab bzhi la/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram dang / /gtso bos phyed 5nas mtshan ma so sor sbas/ /shar kyi pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bo la/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mda' gzhu se gol dgod/ /lho yi pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi po la/ /rin chen nyi ma tog dang so phreng dgod/ /nub kyi pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi po la/ /pad+ma 'khor lo ral gri lce dgod do/ /byang gi pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi po la/ /rgya gram mche ba go cha khu tshur dgod/ /gru chad bzhi la nang gi lha mo ni/ /me long phreng ba pi 33—1009

wang chags 1shing dgod/ /de ni nang gi mtshan ma dgod pa'o/ /de nas phyi yi mtshan ma dgod pa ni/ /shar du gubye 2ut+pal spos phor rgyal mtshan no/ /lho ni rin chen 'bar ba spos phor puste'o/ /nub tu pad+ma lcags kyu ral gri bri ba'o/ /byang du zla ba lcags kyu ral gri rin chen sgrom4/ /phyi yi lha mo ༄5dgod pa ni/ /me tog mar me dri dang bshos/ / de dag go rims so sor ni/ /6lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'o/ / lha rnams phyogs skyong rnams kyang dgod/ /ye shes gnyis med bsres la dgod7/ /de nas bla re ba dan sogs/ /bum pa mchod rdzas la sogs dgram/ /de nas rol mos bum pa ni/ /spyan drang bskor byas dgram par bya/ /de nas bdag nyid shar bltas te/ /bde ba'i stan la nyer 'dug nas/ /bgegs rnams yongs su bskrad nas ni/ /rten la mchod dang spyig bshags dang / /byang chub tu bdag sems bskyed bya/ /stong nyid snga gas kyis stong nyid bsgom/ /de nas hūṃ las rdo rje bsgom/ /khro zhal drug ldan bum par ni/ /bye las chos sku nam mkhar ldan/ /gru gsum nam mkhar bye bsams nas/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi tshom bu bzhi/ /thabs dang shes rab dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /de nas tshom bu lnga la ni/ /seng ge glang chen rta dang ni/ /rma bya shang shang a las bakhyed/ /pad+ma'i steng du rang sems a/ /de las rnam par snang mdzad ni/ /zhi ba mdog dkar zhal bzhi pa/ /phyag rgya byang chub mchog gi sgu'o/ /thugs kar dang po'i rusangs rgyas so/ /shes rab 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi ste/ /de steng ye shes sems dpa'o/ /phyag rgyas 9ral gri puste ste/ /gzhan ni so so'i phyag mtshan no/ /mthing ka 7ser po dmar dang ljang / /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las/ /sa gnon mchog sbyin ting 'dzin skyabs sbyin 11te/ /33—1010

—de bzhin yum gyi mdog dang phyag mtshan so so'o/ /mthing ga 1ser po margad 3ljang gu ste/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mda' gzhu se gol ni/ /so so'i phyag mtshan legs par bsnams pa'o༄ pa/ /sems dpa' rgyal po chags pa legs pa'o/ /gser mdog dmar dang ljang gu mthon ka'i 4mdog /rin chen nyi ma tog dang sor phreng bsnams/ /rin chen nyi ma tog dang bzhad pa'i dpal/ /so so'i rgyan ldan sku ni mdzes pa'o/ /dmar dang ljang gu mthing ga 5gser bsregs mdog /ma chags sems gcod sems rgyud gsal bar smra/ /kha dog so sor 6 gsal zhing ma 'dres 'dzin/ /pad+ma ral gri 'khor lo lce rnams dz+waso/ /ljang gu mthing ga gser bsregs margad mdog /las dang gnod sbyin go cha khu tshur dang / /rgya gram mche 8ba go cha khu tshur te/ /bzhugs tshul zla ba'i gdan la legs par bzhugs / /sgeg dang rin chen phreng dang khegru ma gar/ /dkar dang ser dang dmar dang ljang gu dang / /me long phreng dang pi wang chags shing bsnams/ /pad steng rgyan ldan sgeg pas bzhugs pa'o/ /byams pa 'jam dpal 1 spos kyi glang po tog /dmar po ljang ser mthing ga dkar ba ste/ /gubye rta1ut+pal spos phor rin chen tog1 /so so'i phyag mtshan ma 'dres bsnams pa'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho blo gros mi zad rta —bzang skyong spobs pa brtsegs/ /gser 7dang gser bsregs in+d+ra ṣ+ṭṛ la mthon saka chen po'i mdog /rin chen rin chen 'bar ba spos phor puste bsnams/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung zla ba'i steng na bzhugs shing mdzes / /mthu chen thob dang ngan song 'dren dang mya ngan dra ba can gyi 'od/ /dmar dang pad+ma rā ga dung mdog shin tu dkar dang ut+pal mdog /pad+ma lcags kyu ral gri dra ba bsnamasal/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i rgyan 'dzin sgu dang ldan/ /zla 33—/01 1

'od gzhon nu thugs rje'i stobs dang nam mkha'i snying po nam mkha'i mdzod/ /zla ba lcags kyu dang ni ral gri 'bar ba rin chen sgrom ni g.yas g.yon 'dzin/ /dkar ser dkar dang ljang gu mthing ka'i mdog /sku mdog shin tu gsal bas ma 'dres gsal/ /bdug pa me tog dri dang ro/ /mthing ka dkar dang dmar po ljang / /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgog dril/ /mthing ka ser dmar ljang gu'o/ /de ltar dam tshig lha bskyed nas/ /thugs kar 2mtshan ma rab tu gsal/ /pra kṛ ti pa ri shudhe sarba dharmā ya du ta sarba ta thā ga tā —dz+nyā na kā ya/mañju shrī pa ri shud+dhi tā mu pā dā ye ta a/ yongs su dag pa'i ye shes so/ /zhing nas ma lus spyan drang ngo / /dkyil 'khor rim bzhin ye shes rim bzhin du spyan drang ngo / /spri to 4z-i di dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ 5ra haṃ busgo bud+dhā māṃ / rngu dh+wa wat+t+waṃ māṃ 7zhes pas sku bzhi la phyag bya'o/ /de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs snabastim zhing byin gyis brlab 9pa ni/ oṃ hūṃ dītsoḥzhes pas so/ /da ni dbang bsgur te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ sarba dharmā/ ga ga na a mā la 1 su pa ri shud+dhā dharmā dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha ā1 ཿ/ de ni slob dpon 'jug pa'o / / de nas slob ma 'jug pa ni/ /ras kyis gdong ni bkab nas su/ /las kyi rdo rje 2lam bstan nas/ /shar sgor slob ma 'dug stangs ni/ /thal spyor kagus pa'i tshul gyis 'dug /de nas gsol ba gdab bya stesne/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sgu/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /dkyil 'khor gtso 'khor bcas la yang / /bdag ni rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /thar pa chen po'i gong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes brjod la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ de nas slob dpon kyis gsol ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa 33—1012

kun gyi gnas/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i grong mchog tu/ /bdag gis khyed ni gzhug par bya/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /gong gi sngags kyis 1dkyil 'khor gyi 2lha la phyag byed du gzhug /de nas sdom pa'i cho ga sbyin pa ni/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /gsum la skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong / /sdom pa rtag tu gzung bar bya/ /thabs ni rdo rje shes rab dril/ /thabs dang shes rab sdom pa gzung 4/ /de ni rdo rje rigs kyi mchog /sdom pa de ni gzung sabar bya/ /nyin re bzhin nam dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /sdom pa rtag tu gzung 5ba'o/ /phyi nang gsang ba 7jeg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung ༄ / /pad+ma'i rigs mchog chen po ste/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba gzung / /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa dang / /mchod sbyin las kyang ci nus bya/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po yi/ /sdom pa dag kyang gzung spyobar bya/ /da ni khyod kyis 'di kyis shig /las rnams su la smra mi bya/ /'di ni sems can dmyal ba'i chu/ /'di las 'das na brlag par 'gyur/ /o a mṛ ta hūṃ t+t+waṃ hūṃ pañca hri/ zhes pas lan gsum sbyin no/ /da ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo slob dpon nus pa dang ldan pas slob ma shā nyid la bsnyims nas bsrung sa/ phrin las rnam bzhi'i kha dog brtag /sbi to z-i di dz+nyā na sprut+t+waṃ a/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs de nas me tog dor byas nas/ /spyan ni legs par dbye bar bya/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po ltar/ /de bzhin du ni saspyan dbye'o/ /oṃ a bhā ba swa bhā ba bi shudhe badz+ra tsak+ṣu a ā i aḥbastod slopa bzhin spyan dbye'o/ /gdong g.yogs phud la 'di skad do/ /dkyil 'khor 33—10/3

dam pa 'di la ltos/ /da ni dang ba rab tu bskyedasna/ /sdig pa thams cad zhi ba dang / /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'di las 'byung / /de phyir 'di la nan tan gyis/ /dkyil 'khor lha dang sngags bsgrub 2byos/ /zhes byas nas/rang gi gu h+ya na ma dang / /yi dam lha rnams gsal bar bstan/ /lha rnams phung po khams su bshad/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rab tu bshad/ /gru bzhi tshad med bzhi dang ni/ /sgo bzhi dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ /rta babs yang dag spong ba bzhi/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pa yang ñca/ /yang dag spong ba 6bzhi pa'o/ /ka ba brgyad ni 'phags lam brgyad/ /tshom bu lnga ldan pha rol phyin/ /rdo rje'i gdung ni shes rab bo/ /'khor lo chos kyi 'khor lo ste/ /stong pa bcu drug phyi yang ngo / /de nas maṇ+ḍal byas nas ni/ /yo byad rdzas kyis 7bla ma mchod/ /de rjes dbang ni rab bskur phyir/ /sgo lhor sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng 3/ /slob ma blo ldan de steng gzhag /bdag nyid dkyil 'khor rab gsal bas/ /las kyi khro bo'i 1 sprul pa spro/ /bdud rtsi chu yis bsrung bar gtor/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ khaṃ / oṃ kā la rū 1rkapa t+t+waṃ dīḥ/ bar chod bgegs rnams bsal nas ni/ /dra ba gur gyis bsrung ba dang / /khro bo drug gis bsrung ba 1rtal/ /rim pa bzhin du dbang bskur ro/ /bum pa'i chu rnams thams cad kun/ /gtso bo'i bum par kun bsdus nas/ /bdag nyid lha yi skur gsal bas/ /slob ma byin brlab bya ba'i phyir/ /de nas bum pa blang 2nas ni/ /slob ma'i mgo la rab gtugs te/ /oṃ a bhe ṣiñca saṃ hūṃ/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs pa la/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ duḥkha ts+tsha da hūṃ/ de nas dbu rgyan ni/23—101 4

༄༅/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/tu ༄yi/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī sā dha na 1nā ma/ bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /rigs gsum bdag po ye shes sku/ /rje btsun 'jam dpal phyag 'tshal te/ /de nyid rjes dran cho ga bshad/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lugs nyid kyis/ /gang zhig yang dag mngon dbang bskur/ /rjes gnang thob pa'i sgrub pa po/ /dang snye'adir yid la gnas dag tu/ /bde ba'i stan la nyer 'dug ste/ /gshin rje'i dgra'am zhal drug la/ /khro bo'i rgyal pos bsrung bar bya/ oṃ dhī she kā la rū pa hūṃ kha hūṃ swā hā/ ltolteḥya mān+ta ka hūṃ/ de nas gshin rje gshed po'i sngags/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis/ mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag mchod/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi yang bsgom/ /de nas chos kun dngos med par/ /rang gi 33—1039

blo yi 1 rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ pra kṛ ta pa ri shudhaḥhūṃ/ sarba dharmā ya du nuta/sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya/ mañju shrī pa ri shud+dhi ta mu pa dā ya ༄ti/ de nas thams cad stong pa las/ /paṃ 5las byung ba pad+ma las/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor a las byung / /de dbus yi ge a dkar las bskyed 6pa/ /rnam snang sache mchog zhi ba sku mdog dkar/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mnyam par 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas seng ge'i gdan bzhugs bdag nyid bsgom/ /de yi thugs kar d+dhāḥ las byung ba yi/ /pad+ma'i sangs rgyas rnam par bsam par bya/ /gdong lnga gtsug phud lnga dang ldan/ /zur phud lnga pa me tog thod/ /dang po'i 9 sangs rgyas de yi thugs kar yang / /shes rab 'khor lo nyes kun sel ba bsgom/ /pad+mar gyur pa 'khor lo de dbus su/ /ye shes sems dpa' rnam par bsgom par bya/ /sbri to z-i di 11dz+nyā na mūrti 7ra haṃ/ busgo bud+dhā māṃ/ rgya dh+wa /༷ brti dzā—/zhes bya ba dang / lte ba dang bcas mu khyud nang ma gnyis/ /de nas rtsibs rnams rim par ldan pa la/ /de nas yang ni phyi yi mu khyud gnyis/ /de la rtsa ba'i sngags ྾sogs rim bzhin dgod/ /ye shes sems dpa' pad+ma zla bar gnas / /de steng rdo rje skyil krung legs bzhugs pa/ /phyag gnyis ting 'dzin phyag rgya ut+pal mtshan/ /de steng shes rab pustis gnyis ka labargyan/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes/ /sen mo'i 'od ni shas cher dmar/ /cod pan bzang po mthon 7ka'i rtse/ /skra mchog mthon shāka chen po can/ /nor bu chen po 'od 1 chags dpal/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /zhes bya'o / /oṃ sarba dharmā ཿa bhā ba — / swa bhā ba / bi shudhe badz+ra a ā saṃ aḥ/nang gi mu khyud mchog la'o/ /a ā i yī u spru e i o au i aḥ/ phyi rol ma 33—/040

la'o / /de nas 'khor lo rtsibs drug la shar nas brtsams te sngags kyi rgyal po drug drug go/ /a ā sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da huya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ s+thāḥ3 /bha ga bānatshu / dz+nyā na mūrti wā gī ④shwa ra/ ma hā wa spri tsa sarba dharmā ṭug ga na/ma/ ma 0༄la su pa ri shudha/ dharma ④dh+wa tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āpeḥ/ mu khyud phyi rol ma la'o//de'i phyi rol ka la sogs pa'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dgug byepa la sogs pa'o/ /oṃ ā1ཿhūṃ—/ de nas mngon par dbang bskur te mi bskyod pas ni dbu brgyan pa'o//ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros te slar bsdu bar bya'o / /dngos po thams cad kyi de kho na lhag par rtogs pas chos thams cad la yang 'jam pa'i dpal du byed cing / 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' dang / mnyam par sbyor zhing sngags kyi tshig gi ming dag gdon no/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ/ slar yang khro bo gnyis gang yang rung bas bsrung skyol langs te/ phyi rol tu a kā ro la sogs pas gtor ma sbyin no/ /'di ltar dus gsum du ste/ rnal 'byor gyi dus ma yin par ni 'jam pa'i dpal gyi sngags gang 'dod pa bzlas pa'am/ mchod rten bya zhing bskor ba la sogs pa 7bya'o/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis byas rkepa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po a zwa ka shrī dang / lo tsā sab 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs kyis bsnga zab bam // //tshibadz+ra tīkyā 1 dmar/ duḥkha ts+tsha da sngo/ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta nyu/ye dkar/ dz+nyā na kā 1 ya ljang / wā gī ༄ shwa ra ser/ a ra pa tsa na dkar/ i ti// //33—1041

༄/ /rdo rje 'dze+egs byed kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/hūṃ ༄yo/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra dzhai ra ba sā dha na 3(nā ma/ bod skad du/rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpa'i snye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab tu khros shing gdug pa 'dul/ /ma lus log pa'i bdud 'dul ba/ /zhal dang phyag drug mtshon cha 'dzin/ /ma he'i zhal la phyag 'tshal te / /de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa zhig /bdag gis dran nas brtsam par bya/ /dang por yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bdag nyid khrus byas te stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ oṃ badz+ra bye ra wa dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ/ zhes pas lus bsrungs nas/bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /oṃ a bhā ba swa bhā ba bi shudha badz+ra tsak+ṣu ge.a ā 5e aḥ / zhes bya bas stong pa nyid bsgom 6mo/ /de nas bdag nyid yi ge ar gnas pa las de'i 'od zer kyis tshangs pa dang brgya byen dang 7/ nyi zla'i steng 33—1043

—du a zhu ba ut+pal 'khor los mtshan pa de zhu ba las bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba sku mdog mthing nag g.yas na rdo rje g.yon na ut+pal 'dzin pa/gzhon nu'i cha lugs la rgyan gyis brgyan par tshobasam mo/ /de'i thugs ka na nyi ma la hūṃ gnas pa can du bsams te/ hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra rgyun mi 'chad par byung bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ /tshur hūṃ la thim pas//zhe sdang gi skur gyur pa ni/ /zhal drug phyag rnam pa drug dang ldan pa/ stobs che ba/ ma he'i zhal can/ sku mdog mthing nag /mi mgo brgya'i do shal can / zhabs brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa/ phyag drug g.yas g.yon gyi dang po keng rus kyi dbyug pa dang rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi bar pa —na mda' gzhu dang ral gri/ tha ma na sna tshogs rdo rje dang mdung bsnams pa'o/ /de las tshad rnged pa bzhi'i khro bo 'phro ba can no/ /zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum 4du bzhugs pa bsgoms/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ bsams la/ spyan drangs pa khul sogs pa rdzogs pa dang gsang sngags bzlas pa ni/ oṃ tweḥbyeḥblu kri 3tā na na hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ duḥkha ts+tsha da hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa bzlas par bya'o / /de nas mtshan kyi sgo nas bstod do/ /gtor ma btang trenas gshegs su gsol te 9snaldang bar bya'o/ /bdag gis dge ba 'di byas pas/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs slob dpon a shwa 1༷ ka shrīs mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta dharma /1shrī mi tra dang / lo tsā ⑫ba chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// / /33byed1044

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba li bi byeḥri3 / bod skad du/ gtor ma'i cho ga /'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'chang / /dpag bsam shing chen rgyas 'dra ste/ /bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog /sems can kun don byed la 'dud/ /gtor ma'i rim pa bshad par bya/ /dang por lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i sngags pas rin po che'i snod mdzes pa'i nang du kha zas kyi 'byor pa dri dang kha dog 4dang ldan pa sna tshogs bcug la/ gtor ma'i nang du yi ge a las yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'bar ba zla ba'i steng du rnam par bsams la/ de las bdud rtsi'i 5 chu rgyun dang /'dod pa'i yon tan gyis 6rnam par spras pas snod dang bcud chos kyi dbyings khyab par bsam zhing bsgom pa ni/ yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'chang / /khyab dag 7rin chen kun gyi mchog /ces bya'o/ /bdag nyid kyi snying ga'i dhīḥ833—1052

'a/sa / dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa ste/ bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog /ces bya ba ni/ dpag bsam gyi shing nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i 'bras bu smin pa bdud rtsi rnam par 'dzag pas gtor ma'i rgyun rgyas par bsam mo/ /thugs ka'i —1'od zer gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dbab ste gnyis su med par bsam mo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da 2ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ s+thāḥ— —bha ga bān 4dz+nyā na mūrti bā gī 5shwa ra ma hā wa tsa sarba dharmā ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shudhe dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āḥ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bya bas 6byin gyis brlab bo/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid las skyes/ /'jig rten gsum na gzhon lus gcig /ces bya ba ni/ de nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa dang / khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bkug ste/ de dag thams cad snying gar yi ge a bkod pa'i 'od zer gyis rnam par sbyangs te/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal du bsam mo/ /gsum sel mtha' yas grol gsum thob/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba ni yi ge gsum gyis byen gyis brlabs la/ dngos sam yid kyis 7lus dpag tu med par 8sprul la mchod do/ /nam mkha'i mtha' la longs spyod cing / /sems can kun yid tshim par byed/ /ces bya ba ni/ der ljags kyi 'od zer kyis bdud rtsi'i rgyun la zhugs te/ kun gyi yid tshim par dmigs shing 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyis tshim par bya'o/ /de nas/ chos kyi sbyin bdag chen po ste/ /mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas/ /zhes bya ba'i phreng ba'i sngags dang / a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya rkanut+pan+da tāta na/ oṃ āḥhūṃ / zhes pa dang tshigs su bcad pa'i bstod pas chos kyi sbyin pa bya'o/ /33—1053

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /shes rab kyis ni de thob shog /byang chub chen por bsngo 7zhing smon lam rgya chen po gdab/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ/zhes pas gshegs su gsol thu/ pha rol phyin dang rgyud rnams ma lus dang / /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kyis ༄ —)/ /kun gyi bdag nyid khyab par thugs la gnas/ /ye shes lus can mtshan don rgya che ba/ /sna tshogs tshul las bstod kyis di ring bdag gis 'dir/ /dam pa'i gdams ngag nyer bstan rnal 'byor lam du sbyar/ /'di la dge ba dri med gang thob des/ /bdag sogs 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' 'drar gyur cig /'jam dpal 4mgon po'i gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1༷52 1ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉g.yo//gtor ma'i cho ga bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mo bi ti/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ra/ rtse〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesan/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉6/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadag ri sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉khi'i dhi/1༷53 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉khi'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉hri dā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉hri dā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉kre dha/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamarti wa gi/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sras/ oṃ hūṃ trī/ zhes pas/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/ re〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha// 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bos/ khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phros/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhacha ṇ+ḍaṃ at+yā/ mu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉twad/1༷54 1〈〈snar 〉〉snga/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7lo// — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉chu/ pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'i/33byed/054

1517༄7/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi spyod lam gyi cho ga—nye༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī tsar+ya 2marga bi byeḥ1/ bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi spyod lam gyi cho ga /'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab pa'i 4don ldan bde gshegs chos nyid 5sku/ /thugs rje rang 'byung 6ye shes sgu lnga'i bdag /gnyis med don ldan spros med bdag nyid can/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba la brten nas/ /sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ /gdams ngag bsgrub 7pa'i rim pa cig /legs par btus te bshad par bya/ /lam kyi yan lag brgyad tshul rig /yang dag sangs rgyas lam rig go/ /rigs dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dbang thob dam tshig ldan par bya/ /de nyid 'dod pa'i gnas btsal nas/ /de mdun maṇ+ḍal legs par bya/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /cho ga shes rab me tog bkram / /rja las gzhal yas khang bskyed do/ /gshin rje gshed dam rdo rje gur/ /33—1056

me ri la sogs bsrung ba bya/kye/ /bar chad zhi byed gtor ma dang / /dang por khrus byas gos rgyan gdags/ /stan bde ba la 'dug byas te/ /tshad med bzhi la sogs pa bya/ /oṃ a 5bhā ba swa bhā ba bi shudha badz+ra tsak+ṣu bye.a ā e aḥ/ zhes pas so/ /dhīḥ cholas dang po bdag nyid bskyed/ /dgug pa la sogs 5gsang sngags ni/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa dang / byin brlabs dbang bskur mi bskyod pa'o/ /de 6ni bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /khrus ni dang po bum pa stong / /stong pa nyid las a de bskyed3/ /nang du bdud rtsi'i thu'od kyis dgang / /ye shes bdud rtsi dbab cing bstem/ /dang por sgo lnga'i rnam shes bkru/ /ye shes sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 9kyis/ /bag chags dri ma dag gyur cig /de ni khrus kyi cho ga'o/ /bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor bstan pa —7 ni/ /sa bon yig 'bru'i rnam pa dang / / dhīḥbadz+ra ṭīkyākhye/ duḥkhats+tsha da/ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta snyeye/ dz+nyā na kā /5 ya bā gī ⑪shwa ra/ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ⑪/ ye shes sems dpa' bhezla ba'i gdan bcas thugs kar 7ro/ /phyag mtshan ral gri'i shānayu ba dhīḥ'i /(yig 'bru dang bcas pa'o/ /bzlas pa'i'o/ /gtor ma a las rin chen 'bru lnga bcud/ /as bskyed yid bzhin nor bu can/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dpag bsam las/ /mgron ni 'jam dpal rang bzhin no/ /zas ni mi dmigs stong pa las/ /paṃ las pad+ma a las nor bu'o/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dgug hūṃ bstem mo/ /de nas rang nyid lhar gsal bas/ /thugs ka'i rdusnyelha mchod mnyes par bsgom/ /de nas zas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang por zhe/byams dang snying rje dang / /ldan pas lus ngag byin brlab po—/ /de nas spyan drang phyag bstod bya/ /mchod cing sdig bshags rjes yi rang / /33—1057

chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bsgul 3 dang / /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba gdab/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la sogs bya'o/ /de nas stong pa'i ting 'dzin bsgom/ /de nas a las chos 'byung ni/ /dkar po gru gsum 'bar ldan pa/ /de nas pad+ma zla steng du/ /dhī37 ཿlas dang po'i zusangs rgyas bskyed/ /dgug dang dbab sogs rdzogs pa dang / /bstod pa'i tshul du gdon pa'o/ /nyal dang 'gro ba ༄5'dug pa dang / /gzhan yang bskor ba bya ba ni/ /mya ngan 'das par bzhugs pa dang / /de nas thon pa lta bu dang / /pha rol phyin pa 6drug bden 7 bzhi/ /sāts+tsha zhe 'debs dang klog dang bshad97/ /kha dog dri ⑫dang spyod dus su/ /'jam dpal sku dang 'bral mi bya rta/ /sgyu ma lta bus gnas par bya'o/ /sdug bsngal can dag mthong gyur na / /byams sems ldan pas dge ba tibasngo/ /rnal 'byor mi gtsang 'dor ba kun//bdud rtsir byin brlab 12gnyis med bstim/ /'byung po yi dwags kun la sbyin/ /tshim par byas la gshegs su gsol/ /dpe med gcig cig ngamathong ba la 7/ /bde dang snyug bsngal du mar snang / /sems kyi rnam 'gyur brtan pa yin/ /zhes spyod lam gyi rim pa'o/ /bsgom pa'i rim pa bstan 7pa ni/ /mtshan ma dang bcas mtshan med pa'o/ /mtshan ma sku dang yig 'bru dang / /phyag mtshan la ni dmigs pa'o / /mtshan ma med pa bstan pa ni/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu ste/ /zhes pa ni/ shes rab 'khor lo thabs dang shes rab gnyis med 7la dmigs pa'o/ /yang na/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'chang / /zhes pas tshogs bsags pa'o/ /rnam par gnon zhes pa ni bsod nams kyis bsod nams ma yin /shāganon/ ye shes te nam mkha' dang 'dra bas mkha' ltar mtha' med do/ /gsum rig ste sku'i bskyed pa'o/ /'bras bu mngon par shes pa lnga phra man bcu drug go/ /gnas pa rtsa/33—/038

g.yo ba rlung / bgrod pa byang chub ste/ byang chub sems dpa' )sems dpa' 3che/ /zhes pa dang / rdzu 'phrul chen po zhes pa'o/ /de yang mtha' yang dag par stong pa ste/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mtha'/ /de las de nyid de chos sku'o/ /gzhan rig pa ste/ longs sku dang sprul sgu'o/ /dpe byad ces pa dang / gtso bo zhes pa gnyis kyi don to/ /de ni 4bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag rgyud 'grel la brten nas/ /dri ma med pa'i dge ba gang brtsams pa/ /des ni dge ba gang thob des/ /'gro kun 'jam dbyangs thob par shog /rgya gar gyi mkhan po a sho ka shrīs byemadzad pa rdzogs so// //shākya'i dge slong chos kyi bzang pos dro cemo dha ra dang nye ba'i rtsar zhus te bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1༷56 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄༄/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi spyo da lam gyi cho ga bzhugs so// 3bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉1/ ༄ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staba'i/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lbāng / dza〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgru ba/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa/1༷57 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsakra/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhi/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa'i/ khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lkes/ dz+wa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsi/ —/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)sa byin brlabs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gibastan pa// 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhi badz+ra tikyā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉marta/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag /〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉giḥ/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabar/ /8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gri/ 1(〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhiḥ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoragron/ rdu1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanagu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skaba'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge /1༷58 /— 〈〈pe 〉thaskur/ 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉dhi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ya/ 4〈〈pe 〉7rdzogs/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉33byed/059

)518༄za/ /'jam dpal rdo rje'i bum pa'i cho galku༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra mañju shrī gha tra bi dhiḥ2/ bod skad du/ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i bum pa'i cho ga /'phags pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub pa po la phan gdags zhing —/ /nyon mongs dri ma kun dag phyir / /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gang zag la/ /bum pa'i cho ga bshad par bya/ /dang por mtshan nyid ldan gnas su/ /sa slong sbyong snguzhing maṇ+ḍal bya/ /thig gdab tshon no byen gyis brlab/ /tshom bu lnga ldan 'khor lo bcu drug ldan/ /gru chad bzhi ldan sgo bzhi rta babs ldan/ /'khor lo bcu drug gru chad bzhi dang ldan/ /pañca rat+na 'dod yon snam bu dang / /rin chen pha gu sgo bzhi rta babs bri/ /rin chen bdun las byas pa'i mchod pa'i rten/ /gdugs dang ba dan cod pan dril bus brgyan/ /gser dang dngul dang zangs dang lcags las byas/ /bum pa kha dog lnga dang ldan pa'o / /rin chen sna lnga 'bru sna lnga dang ni/ /sman lnga dri lnga dkar la sogs pa'i 33—1061

rdzas / /bdud rtsi'i chus bkang 3kha rgyan 'bras bu can/ /mgul chings gzungs thag bum pa'i rigs dang sbyar/ /so so'i lha yi 2gdan du gnyis po dgod/ /dang por bla ma dkon mchog spyan drang ste/ /phyag mchod sdig bshags yi rang bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' lus dbul dge rtsa ༷bsngo/ /tshad med bzhi ldan byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /stong pa'i ting 4'dzin sngags kyis kun nas bskul/ /de nas gur dang dra ba'i steng du ni/ /hūṃ las rdo rje bye zhelas mchod rten ni/ /dhī las chos 'byung a las rdo rje'o/ /de steng rgyu 3las gzhal yas khang pa'o/ /gdan lnga zla ba'i gdan ni so sor gsal/ /yi ge a las rnal 'byor rnam gsum bsgom/ /dam tshig 'khor lo a las sku bskyed 3do/ /ye shes 'khor lo dgug cing bstim par bya/ /sgu gsum byin brlabs dbang bskur nyid kyis 9mtshan/ /thabs dang shes rab bum pa rab tu don/ /thabs dang shes rab 'od zer bdud rtsi dbab/ /mchod rten rnams ni lha yi rang bzhin gsal/ /so so'i thabs dang shes rab ma lus ldan/ /thugs ka'i a las rgyud ni gdon par bya/ /de las dad pa'i zhe sangs rgyas 'dud bstod bya/ /de yi thugs 'od mchod pa rnam lngas mchod/ /bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog /rnam par dag pa bdag med chos/ /yang dag ye shes zla 'od bzang / /brtson chen sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /rdo rje'i gdan ni ma lus ldan/ /ye shes sku rnams ma lus 'chang / /nyon mongs khams rnams dag pa'i bdag /las kyi khams rnams zad byed cing / /chu bo rgya mtsho kun las brgal 1rta/ /nyon mongs nye ba kun nyon mongs/ /bag chags bcas pa gtan tu spangs/ /zhes so/ /lung dang man ngag la 1)brten nas/ /bdag gis 'di 'dra'i phan gdags cho ga brtsams / /dge ba'i rtsa ba dri med gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jam dpal rdo rje thob 33—/062

༄ / /ye shes sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ dz+nyā na satwa sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ ye shes sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun rang bzhin ye shes sems dpa' yi2/ /ma lus bde gshegs kun gyis mtshan gyur pa/ /rdo rje 'chang chen kun gyi rdo rje'i 4glu/ /zab cing rgya che byang chub sems dpa' nyon/ /byang chub sems bskyed lhag pa'i sgu ru bsgom/ /sgyu ma rten 'brel rnam gsum sbyor ba la/ /ma lus gnyis med mkha' khyab 'khor lo bsgom5/ /ma gyes mi 'gag rnam gsum sgyu ma ni/ /shes rab mig gis gsal bar blta bar bya/ /sgyu ma brag ca 6nam mkha' las byung bzhin/ /yongs su shes nas ma zhen sems kyis 7bklag /rnal 'byor lam chen gsang sngags 'di yin te/ /ji ltar dngos rnams mkha' la gnas pa bzhin/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor phyag rgya che 33— /064

'a/ gnas/ /don ni mi shes dka' ba'i 1las gzhan gyis/ /'khor 2ba'i grong gsum dag las de mi g.yo/ /de lta'i don shes rang bzhin nyes pa spangs/ /spo/sa kyi glang pos ke te dug zos bzhin/ /nyes pa'i tshogs bcom 4gzhung tshogs yon tan ldan/ /'gag pa med pa'i chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /thugs kyi gsang mdzod gtsug gi rin po che/ /rang bzhin 'gro kun chos rnams ma lus bcad/ /rgyud don dbang po rdo rje'i tshig tu gnas/ /mkha' 'gro'i rjes 'brangs 5nye bar bsdus pa yin/ /slob dpon gnyis su med pa'i sbas pas mdzad pa'o6// //bsdur mchan/1༷64 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod ska da du smos pa lta ra bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snga / /'jam dpa/la ye shes sems dpa/'i sgrub thabs slo ba dpon gnyis med sbas pa/sa mdzad pa/ bzhugs so/ / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7rdo rje'i/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉ā+o ma// 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ca/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mjes sems kyi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/khas//1༷65 1〈〈pe 〉〉dag pa/'i/ 〈〈snar 〉ra/ dag nga/'i/ 2〈〈snar 〉sngarakhyor/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yong// 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacoms/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thabrang / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉ra rdzogs so//33byed/065

152༷sngag /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa sgrub pa'i thabs 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā ma saṃ gī ti sā dha māṃ2/ bod skad du/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig grusgrub pa pos sngar langs te/ kha la sogs pa dag par byas la/bsam gtan gyi khang par rab tu zhugs te/ bde ba'i stan la nye bar gnas nas/snying gar 4pad+ma dang zla ba la dmar zhing dkar ba'i sum̐ bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas 'od zer gyi tshogs lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis bkug ༄5pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'od 'byung ba'i mdog dang zhal dang phyag mtshan dang gdan dang nye bar ldan pa mdun du rnam par bsgom ste6/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi me tog dang bdug pa la sogs pas yang dag par mchod la/ de'i mdun du sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa 7bya zhing / byams pa la sogs pa tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid mngon du byas te/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badza swa bhā ba āt+ma 33—1067

ko3haṃ / zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas nam mkha' la hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa sa bon dang bcas pa rnam par bsgoms la/de'i 'od zer kyis ji lta ba'i spyor bas/ rdo rje'i ra ba dang rdo rje'i gur dang sa 'og kun rdo rje'i sa gzhir dmigs la/ rdo rje yang 'od zer du kun nas rdo rje'i ra ba las phyi rol du phyogs bcing ba la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis nye bar gnas par blta'o1/ /de'i rjes su rdo rje'i nang du dhīḥdamar po yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma'o / /pad+ma'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du dmar zhing dkar ba'i sum̐ las sangs rgyas mang po spro ba dang basbu ba'i rnam par bsgoms la / de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dmar zhing dkar ba nga/d+ma dang zla ba'i steng na rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal dang po dmar po g.yas sngon po g.yon dkar po zhes bya ba'i zhal gsum pa bsgom par bya'o/ /phyag bzhi ji lta ba'i spyor bas shes rab kyi puste dang / ral gri dang / gzhu dang /mda' dang ldan pa'o/ /rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus rnam par mdzes pa/ gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i bdag nyid du bsams la/ snyeng gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yon pa dril bu dku la brten cing 'chang ba/ g.yas na rang gi snying gar 'degs par byed pa'i sbyor bas rdo rje 'chang ba'o/ /de bzhin du smin mtshams su rin chen rdo rje sems ma phyag gnyis kyis spyi bor me tog gi phreng ba bcing 2zhing gnas pa'o/ /mgrin par pad+ma rdo rje dmar zhing dkar ba/ g.yon pa pad+ma'i sdong bu 'gying bag dang bcas pa bzung ba/ g.yas pa de'i 'dab ma kha 'byed cing sngon bzhin du nye bar gnas 32— /068

pa'o / /spyi bor las kyi rdo rje zu7mdog ljang gu rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis bdag nyid kyi spyi bor 'chang ba de kho na bzhin du nye bar gnas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā 4be+e sha hoḥ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du go rims ji lta bar ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang /dbang du bya'o/ /rdo rje'i khu tshur gnyis bcings te sdigs mdzub dang mje'u chung lcags sgrog tu byas shing sprad pa bkan te rang gi kha ru nye bar gzhag 5pa ni rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ste/ ar+gha 6dang / zhal 7bsel dang / me tog dang / bdug spos la sogs pas yang dag par mchod la skad cig gis rang gi lus la gzhug nga/ra bya'o/ /de'i rjes su de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur ba sngon du 'gro bas mi baspyod pa'i bdag nyid kyi rnam pas dbu brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ sarba dharmāḥ.a bhā ba swa bhā ba bi shud+dhi9/ badz+ra a ā saṃ aḥ/ pra kṛ ti pa ri shudha sarba dharmaḥya du ta/ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya mañju shrī pa ri shud+dhi te rka/ mu pa da 12ye ti a ā/ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya ha ra ha ra / oṃ hūṃ twe—ཿbha ga bān 7dz+nyā na mūrti bā gī 7shwa ra ma hā wa tsa sarba dharmā ga ga na/ a ma 7la su pa ri shudha dhan+d+ra dh+wa tu dz+nyā na gar+bha ā ཿ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis dang po dang rab dang tha mar byin gyis brlab pa sngon du 'gro bas rje btsun gyi mtshan yang par brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas nyi ma re re zhing so so'i thun mtshams su lan gsum mam gcig tu skyil krung ma bshig pas mnyam par gzhag pas bklag par bya'o / /de ltar ji srid sgrub pa'i mtshan ma ma mthong gi bar du bklag 25par bya'o / /de'i rjes su rgyud ji lta ba bzhin du dngos grub kyi thabs la rjes su 33—1069

1521༄༅/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ri1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā ma saṃ gī ti sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du/mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub pa pos dang por re zhig 2snga bar langs la 1kha la sogs pa gtsang bar byas nas bsam gtan gyi khang par rab tu zhugs nas bde ba'i stan la rdo rje'i 4skyil krung gis nye bar 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba la muḥyig dmar ser bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i 'od kyi tshogs lcags kyu'i rnam pa rnams kyis bkug ste/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul mdun du bsgoms te/ de'i mdun du me tog dang bdug spos la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod nas5/sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byas nas byams pa la sogs pa tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid du mngon sum du byas nas/33—/07/

oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā āt+ma 1kolhahaṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis 2byen gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas nam mkhar hūṃ gi yi ges rdo rje rtse lnga pa sa bon dang bcas pa bsgom mo/ /de'i 'od rnams kyis ji ltar rigs par rdo rje'i ra ba dang rdo rje'i dra ba dang rdo rje'i sa gzhis bdud 'joms par dmigs te/ rdo rje'i 'od kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang ra ba las phyi rol phyogs dang phyogs bral gyi gzugs kyis gnas par blta'o/ /de nas bar ma chad par rdo rje'i ra ba'i nang du pad+ma'i steng du oṃ gyi 5yi ges zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du muḥ'i 6yi ge kha dog dmar ser la ma lus pa'i sangs rgyas spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rnam pa bsgom par bya'o / /de yongs su gyur pa las spre rje btsun 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser nga/d+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rdo rje'i 8 skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal dang po dmar ba/ g.yas sngo ba/ g.yon dkar ba/ des na zhal gsum pa/ phyag bzhi ngo/ ji ltar rigs par shes rab ral gri dang / puste dang / mda' dang /gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rin po che'i cod pan can/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus rnam par mdzes pa/ gzhon nu gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems ma sku mdog dkar mo g.yon na dril bu dang g.yas na rdo rje bzung ste rang gi thugs kar babe+eng nas spyor ba'o/ /sngar bzhin mdzod spur gnas pa'i rin chen rdo rje ma sku mdog ser mo phyag gnyis kyis dbu la me tog gi phreng ba 'ching ba can no/ /mgrin par pad+ma rdo rje ma sku mdog dmar ser g.yon na snying po dang bcas pa'i pad+ma/g.yas kyis de'i 'dab ma kha 'byed pa 9sngar bzhin gnas pa'o/ /spyi bor las 33—— /072

kyi rdo rje ma sku mdog ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rang gi spyi bor rdo rje rtse gsum 'dzin nga/ de ltar gnas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā 1be sha hoḥ2/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams kyis pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du ji lta ba'i rim pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug pa dang /gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang / dbang du bya'o / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te 4sdigs mdzub dang mthe'u 5chung dag lu gu rgyud ltar byas pa'i rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya gan rkyal du bya'o/ /rang gi kha la gzhag 6la mchod yon dang zhabs bsil la sogs pa rnams kyis legs par mchod la skad cig la gzhug par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 7dbang bsgur te/sngar bzhin mi bskyod pa spyi bor bdag nyid kyis bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ sadze+e dharmā bhā wa 8swa bhā ba bi shudhe badz+ra a ā saṃ aḥ/ pra kṛ ti pa ri shudha sat+tha dhadz+re ya du / ta sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā 7ya mañju shrī pa ri shubye tā mu pa 1 dā ye ti a āḥ/sat+tha ta thā ga ta z-i da ya ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ s+thā ཿbha ga bān dz+nyā na mūrti bā gī shwa ra ma hā wa tsa sadze+e dhadz+re 5ga ga na a ma la su sapa ri shudha dhārma 7dhā tu dz+nyā na gasgo s+dza/zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis dang po dang bar dang tha mar byin gyes brlabs la sngar ltar rje btsun mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 8nyin re bzhin thun gsum du lan gsum mam lan gcig mngon par dga' ba'i mthar thug pa phan yon dang bcas pa bklag 1par bya'o/ /de ltar ji srid bklags pa de srid du grub pa'i rtags mthong ngo / /de ma thag tu ji lta ba'i sngags kyis grub pa'i tshul rjes su gnas so/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs mkhas pa chen po pra bhā ka ras mdzad pa sdogs so// //33—/073

1522༄khya/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa jes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā ma saṃ gī ti sā dha rna2/ bod skad du/mtshan yang dag par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur nga/ la phyag 'tshal lo/ /re zhig rdodang por sgrub pa po snga bar langs te/gdong la sogs pa dag par byas te/ sgom pa'i khang par zhugs 4te/ bde ba'i stan la skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar zla ba dang pad+ma la muḥyig dmar ser bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas de'i 'od zer gyi phung po lcags kyu'i rnam pas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bcom ldan 'das kha dog dang zhal dang phyag dang gdan dang bcas pa bkug ste/ mdun du bsam par bya'o/ /de la yid la bya ba'i me tog dang bdug pa la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/ mdun du sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa thams cad bya ste/ byams pa la sogs pa tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par byas la/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid mngon 33——/076

—du byas te sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma 1kophohaṃ/ de nas nam mkha' la hūṃ yig las rdo rje rtse lnga pa sa bon dang bcas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i steng du a yig la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/de'i 'od zer rnams kyis rdo rje'i 3ra ba dang / rdo rje'i gur dang / rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa bsgom par bya'o/ /rdo rje yang 'od zer du gyur nas rdo rje ra ba'i phyi ngos su phyogs bcings pa nal sogs pa'i gzugs su gnas par blta'o/ /de'i rjes la rdo rje ra ba'i nang du dīḥyig las nga/d+ma de'i steng du a yig las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du muḥyig dmar ser sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa spro ba dang bsdu ba byed par 4bsams la de yo/ngas su gyur pa las rje btsun 'jam dpal dmar ser pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ shes rab kyi puste dang ral gri dang gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ gzhon pa gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis brgyan nga/ra bdag nyid bsam mo/ /snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems ma dkar mo g.yon pas 5dril bu dkur brten 6pa/ g.yas pas 7snying gar bstod pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa'o / /dpral bar de bzhin du yang dag par gnas pa'i rin chen rdo rje sems ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis spyi bor me tog gi phreng ba 'ching ba'o/ /mgren par pad+ma'i rdo rje ma dmar ser g.yon 'gying bag gi tshul gyis 8pad+ma'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyis de'i 'dab ma 'byed pa sngar bzhin du gnas par blta bar /bya'o/ /spyi bor las kyi rdo rje ma ljang gu rdo rje rtse gsum lag pa gnyis kyis 33—/077

spyi bor 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du yang dag par bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥ1/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā 3be+e sha hoḥ/zhes bya ba 'di rnams kyi sngags kyis pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du go rims /༄ bzhin du ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang /dbang du byas te/ rdo rje khu tshur bcangs te mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung gnyis lcags sgrog tu byas te/ rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya sprad pa 4gan rkyal du byas pas rang gi snying gar bzhag pas yon chab dang / /zhal lhabasil dang / me tog dang spos la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod la/ de ma thag tu rang gi lus la gzhug par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba sngon du song bas bdag nyid kyi spyi bor mi bskyod pa bsams la/oṃ sadze+e dhadz+re 6a bhā ba swa bhā ba bi shudhe badz+ra a ā saṃ aḥ/ pra kṛ ti pa ri shudha sarba dhas+thā ya du kyeta sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya mañju shrī pa ri shudhi tā mu pā dā ye ti a āḥ/ sarba ta thā ga tā tri tso7da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ s+thāḥbha ga bān dz+nyā na mūrti bā gī 1 snashwa ra ma hā wa tsa sarba dhas+thā ga ga na a ma rta1la su pa ri shudha dhan+d+ra jo tu dz+nyā na gar+bha ā1rtaḥ/ zhes pa'i sngags 'dis dang po dang tha ma dang dbus su byin gyes brlab pa sngon du song bas/ rje btsun 1/yang dag par brjod pa rtag tu thun mtshams su lan gsum mam du ma yang rung / rdo rje'i sbyiskyil mo krung bcas te mnyam par gzhag pas bklag 7par bya'o/ /'di ji srid du bklags ⑩pa de srid du grub pa'i mtshan ma rnams mthong ngo / /de lta bas na sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //dar ma grags kyis rang 'gyur byas/ /de yis bsod nams gang thob des/ /33—1078

1523༄༅/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa klog pa'i man ngagalha༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā ma saṃ gī ti bā kyesnatsa no pa de shaṃ/ bod skad du / mtshan yang dag par shebarjod pa klog pa'i man ngag 5 /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gang yang rung bar khrus dag par byas la/ bsam gtan kyi khang par stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar pad zla'i 5steng du yi ge muskuḥdamar ser bsgom mo/ /de las 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros pas 'og nas 'chad pa'i sku mdog phyag mtshan dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa 'jam dpal spyan drangs la/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas par bya/ /tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ 'di dag snying rje'i sa bon no/ /shes rab kyi sa bon byin gyis brlab dza7pa'i sngags swa bhā ba brjod la/ nam mkha' lta bu'i stong pa nyid la yun ring du gnas par bya'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las yi ge hūṃ mthing nag bsam zhing de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la zla ba'i 32—1080

steng du hūṃ gnas par hūṃbasam/ de 'od du zhu ba las logs rnams la rdo rje'i ra ba / steng du dra ba/ 'og tu gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin du yod pa/ rdo rje'i 'od kyis ra ba'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams bcing ngo /'di ni srung ba'i 'khor lo ste phyi rol gyi rngu'od kyis bgegs sreg par byed la nang gi rdo rjes 'bigs pa la sogs pas/ ra ba'i nang du bgegs kyis mi thar bar bsamapakye—/ de nas rdo rje'i ④nang du byāḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma de'i steng du a 5 yongs su gyur pa las zla ba de'i steng du yi ge muḥ ne+edamar ser cig ④bsam/ de las 'od zer rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbyibs 7snacan dpag tu med pa 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad la reg pas de dag kyang 'jam dbyangs su gyur nas tshur 'dus pas mu(she ཿla thim par bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ phyag bzhi pa zhal gsum pa'i zhal g.yas nag po g.yon dkar po dbus dmar po spyan gnyis gnyis yod pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/gnyis pa na mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na puste/ gnyis pa na ( gzhu bsnams pa/ dbu la rin po che'i thor tshugs yod pa/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis mnga' ba/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas mdzes pa/ shin tu gzhon sha dang bcas pa'i sku 'od kyi phung po rab tu 'bar bar bsgom mo/ /de'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du rdo rje sems ma dkar mo phyag g.yon pa dril bu dkur brten pa g.yas kyis rdo rje thugs kar bsnams pa/mdzod sru la rin chen rdo rje ma sgu mdog ser mo phyag gnyis kyis dbu la me tog gi phreng ba 'dogs pa/ mgrin par pad+ma rdo rje ma sgu mdog dmar ser phyag g.yon 33—1081

gyis rtepad+ma kha zum pa'i yu ba nas bzung zhing g.yas kyis zhe rgyas par mdzad pa/skra mtshams su las kyi rdo rje ma sku mdog ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis sherdo rje dpral bar brten 4 par bsgom mo/ /de nas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros nas ngag tu oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ zhes brjod la ye shes sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs te mchod pas mnyes par byas la oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ/ zhes brjod pas dgug /oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ zhes pas gzhugane+e /oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/zhes pas tha mi dad par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ā trebe+e sha hoḥ/ zhes pas dgyes par bsam mo/ /yang 'od zer 'phros te rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la sangs rgyas rnams kyi phyag tu rin po che'i bum pa bsnams te spyi bo nas bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas nang du zag med kyi bde ba chen po skyes/phyir chu lhag ma yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa sku mdog nag po rigs kyi tsudabu brgyan no/ /de nas rdo rje khu tshur dang rdo rje'i phyag rgya bya/ 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas snying ga dang mgrin pa dang dpral bar reg go/ /de dag tshar nas gzhung klog pa la 'jug par bya ste/ phan yon dang bcas te 'don na legs/ med kyang rung ste/ thog mar zhabs kyi sngags tshar gcig 'don8bhe/ dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i rjes la sngags tshar gcig /mjug tu tshar gcig ste/ mtshan brjod tshar re la sngags lan gsum gsum 'don9/ mtshan brjod klog pa'i man ngag kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //33—1082

1524sngag /rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa'i rim pas bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal sgrub pa'i thabs she — ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo sha ti ā kā ra bhi bo bye kra ma na bha ga bān mañju shrī sā dha rna / bod skad du/ rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa'i rim pas bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dang de yis —theg pa yis/ /thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /theg pa gabyug gis gebadag nyid can/ /dpal ldan de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /shin tu dad pa'i ro gcig pa/ /mi g.yo dus kyi rtogs 6bya ba/ /bdag nyid chen po gang yin pa/ /su zhig de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dad pa'i khyad par ma rtogs kyang / /chags pa'i dbang gis sems can bzhin/ /'dod chags la sogs la gnas kyang / /gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi don byed mgon / /kun du don byed ltos 3med par/ /skyob pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /33—1084

de yi stobs kyis da ltar bdag /'jam dpal gnyis su med pa yi/ /rnam pa nyi shus mngon rtogs pa/ /sems can don du bshad par bya/ /dang por langs nas rnal 'byor ni/ /rang gi lha yi nga rgyal can/ /rnam dag cho ga bzhin byas nas/ /mchod pa dman 6ma basbu bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra bi ga hūṃ/ dri ma yang ni bsal bar bya/ /oṃ sa man+ta ༄ 7 ba rik+ṣa gu h+ya tsa ra rngutsa ra hūṃ/ de yi rjes la skyang nul bya/ /oṃ nirma ni sho dha hūṃ/ drir bcas chu yi thigs pa yis /skyob pa la yang maṇ+ḍal bya/ /oṃ ma hā maṇ+ḍa la rnyihūṃ/ sngar nyid langs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /'jam pa'i stan la gnas par bya/ /oṃ a mu ka pad+mo bha surnya ra dha re 5maṇ+ḍal la ṣ+yohūṃ/ snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas mthong nas 'dud par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta pra ṇa me na badz+ra ban+da ne+ergo ka ro mi/ sna tshogs mchod cing de dag la/ /dang por phyag 'tshal gzhan yang bya/ /de nas skal dang ldan pa ni/ /sprul zhing rnam par mchod par bya/ /nyes pa byas pa'i mchod pa yis/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs bya/ /bdag gis bgyis dang bgyid sprul gang / /chung ngu'am ni tshad med pa/ /gang yang rjes su yi rang ba/ /de dag skyob pas gshegs par mdzod/ /bdag gis 'jug par bya ba yis/ /de dag sems can rang nyid kyi3/ /las la 'jug pa de dag gis/ /byas pa rnams la legs zhes gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su gsol/ /de bzhin chos kyi dkon mchog la/ /sangs rgyas kyis 9 gang gdul ba byapya / /blo chen mgon po de la yang / /sdug bsngal rgal 11bar dka' ba ni/ /gzhan gyi bdag gis bzod mi nus/ /de 8na de nyid sel bar byed—/ /bdag ni 'jig rten mgon por shog /sems can bla ma sangs rgyas 33—1085

dang / /byang chub sems dpa' de ci bzhin/ /de bzhin slob ma rjes mthun ma//bdag gis ri1lam la 'jug par bya/ /gang yang bdag gi dge ba'i cha/ /dri med gnas par gyur pa ni/ /de yis sems can gyi don du/ /rgyun du rjes su mthun par shog /oṃ ma hā sarba pā paṃ kā ya bāka tsit+ta sa ma na sartu tai ༄ — ra ga bye sha mū ha da ma da ma na a bhe ṣi ta yo krit+t+waṃ 4taste ka le shaṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa5/sarba pā paṃ sgo ṭa ya me swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ pra hi dhi na ya me swā hā/pya oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā nā māt+ma dz+wa bha baṃ nir+ya ta yā mi༄8/ sarba ta thā ga ta pra ti kṛt+tha na swa mi / rma swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu h+ye dz+nyā ⑫ na saṃ bha ra a nu mu da tsoye swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa man+ta bha dra ma hā badz+ra sa ma yi ma hā bo bye dzistot+pā rda ut+pā da yā ra mi swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sha na sa bye 1lha sarba satā māṃ/ sarba sibye saṃ sa t+ya na ti sarba ta thā ga tash+tsa a de sha na tis/ oṃ sarba shudhe ཿsat+tha dhas+thāḥrkeswa bhā ba shurnyophohaṃdz+wa / sems can 'di dag bde bar shog /sdug bsngal kun yang sel bar shog /de dag bde bas bdag nyid tshim/ /'di dag nyon mongs bral bar shog /rang bzhin med dang gtsang la sogs/ /mtshan ma med dang yid mi 'byung / /'di dag thams cad de yi phyir/ /bdag gis gang las rnam par 'khrul/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā 18dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba yas 1 kophohaṃ/ de nas rgyal ba'i bka' lung gis/ /zla ba gnyis su mthong bar bya/ /de yang bstan nas gcig 'gyur zhing / /de yi bdag nyid du gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam nyid du/ /blo gros chen pos gzhug — par bya/ /oṃ bo bye tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi / oṃ dz+nyā na ra sme be+e sre dza hūṃ/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha rtasta badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ spa — ra ṇa badz+ra/ oṃ saṃ hā ra na badz+ra/ oṃ dz+nyā na badz+ra/ oṃ san+d+ra ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na badz+ra/33—1086

oṃ badz+ra a 1kolhahaṃ/ oṃ ya thā ④sarba ta thā ga ta ta thā ④a haṃ/ de nas gzhan don byed pa'i phyir/ /slar yang 'di ltar bsgom par bya/ /khro bo'i gzugs ni 'chang ba yis/ /snying gar pad+ma nyi hūṃ las/ /khro bo bcu yis bgegs kyi gtso/ /lus ngag yid gsum phur bus gdab/ /phyi rol rdo rje ra ba sogs/ /rnam par sprul pa byas nas ni/ /hūṃ yig gnyis kyi ③ dbus gnas pa'i/ /'og tu yo baṃ ram̐ dag las/ /rlung dang chu dang me dag ni/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid rim pas bsgom/ /tshe mkha' la rgyu yig las byung ba'i/ /rtag pa'i yan lag las skyes pa/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi byutshogs kyis ni/ /gang ba'i snod kyi bdag nyid gyur / /hūṃ gnyis dbus su baṃ yig las/ /sku yi rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /brtan zhing sra bar gyur pa yi/ /gser gyi dkyil 'khor nyid du gyuradz+wa / /ngos gnyis rnam pa'i hūṃ yig dang / /sum̐ las skyes pa'i ldun po'i steng / /zlo 3/las gyur pa dpal dang ldan/ /gzhal yas khang brtsegs bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus su sna tshogs pa'i/ /chu skyes steng du seng ge'i gdan/ /der ni dbyangs yig dang po las/ /kun da'i 9'od ldan rnam snang mdzad/ /bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /zhal bzhi mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can/ /de yi mdun du mi bskyod pa/ /rdo rje /⑩ dril bu dang ldan pa'i/ /glang po'i steng du zla ba la/ /nam mkha'i mdog can bsam par bya/ /lho ru rdo rje nyi ma yang / /rta yi steng du zla ba la/ /rin chen dril bu dang ldan pa/ /gser gyi mdog ni rnam par bsam/ /nub tu pad+ma gar dbang yang / /rma bya'i steng gi zla ba la/ /pad+ma'i dril bu dang bcas pa/ /pad+ma rā nyu ga'i mdog can bsam/ /byang gi phyogs su rta mchog kyang / /mkha' lding gser mu'od la gnas pa'i/ /sna 33—1087

tshogs rdo rje dril bu mdzes/ /sna tshogs pa yi mdog can bsgom/ /de dag gi yang thugs kar ni/ /dang por nyusangs rgyas bsgom bya ste/ /dpal ldan zhal lnga phyag brgyad pa/ /añja ༄2/na yi sgu mdog 'chang / /ngo mtshar drag po sgeg pa dang / /dgod dang bcas pa'i zhal mnga' ④ba/ /g.yas g.yon ral gri pusti dag /bdag nyid chen pos bzhi bzhi bsnams/ /'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sems can rnams ni tshim par byed/ /re re'i thugs kar 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs bcu gnyis la dbyangs yig ldan/ /phyi rol kā ④li nang na yang / /oṃ sarba dharmā'i phyesngags su bcas/ /thams cad la yang khyad med par / de steng shes rab 'khor lo ste/ /phyi rol a ā sogs kyis mtshan/ /nang gi mu khyud ā lir 6ldan/ /khyad par gtso bo'i 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs drug gsang sngags drug dang ldan/ /gzhan dag gi yang rang rang mtshan/ /oṃ dang ya te na mar bcas/ /na ma rtsibs ⑦ gcig la bsdongs pyanas/ /lhag ma yi ge'i grangs bzhin brtsigs/ /gnyis med 'jam dpal gtso bo ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /rang rigs phyag rgya can gnyis gnyis/ /ut+pa la dang puste 'chang / /gzhan dag la yang khyad med par/ /ral gri g.yas pa la mtshan no/ /g.yon pas rdo rje rin chen dang / /chu skyes sna tshogs rdor dril 'chang / /de yang gnyis pa lnga pa dang / /dang po bzhi pa ye shes sku/ /kun kyang gzhon nu'i rgyan dang ldan/ /kun+da'i kha dog gzugs 'chang ba rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po ste/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bu 'chang / /rgyal po ser po lcags kyu 'chang / /chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu can/ /legs pa ljang gu legs sbyin pa/ /mi bskyod pa yi 'khor du gnas/ /rin chen dril 'chang rin 33—1088

chen ser/ /nyi ma nyi bzhin g.yas nyi 'dzin/ /ljang gu tog ni rgyal mtshan 'dzin / /g.yon pa gdan la gnyis ka yang / /bzhad pa dkar po so phreng 'dzin / /snga ma bzhin du g.yon pa yis/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i 'khor du gnas / /chos dmar pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin/ /rnon po ral gri puste dkar/ /'khor lo ser po 'khor lo 'dzin/ /smra ba ljang gu ljags 'dzin pa/ /gnyis ka g.yon pa gdan la brten/ /pad+ma gar gyi 'khor du gnas/ /las ni ljang gu rgya gram gyis/ /bsrung ba ser po go cha can/ /gnod sbyin nag po mche ba 'dzin / /khu tshur ser po khu tshur 'dzin/ /don yod grub pa'i 'khor du gnasaske/ /de ltar 'khor lo chen po ni/ /bsams nas rim rngubazhin mchod par bya/ /mchod pa'i rim pa dkyil 'khor kyi/ /cho ga nyid las shes par bya/ /snying po dang ni nye snying po/ /rgyal ba kun kyang mnyes par bya/ /lhag ma kun gyis bzlas rngupa'i sngags/ /yi ge gsum po shes par bya/ /gzhan dag rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 1bcas/ /rang rang gnas su bsams cenas ni/ /de yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ /ci rigs pa ltani sbyang bar bya/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa'i dus su yang / /mtshan brjod dang ni bstod pa yis/ /rgyal ba 'khor bcas bstod nas ni/ /dus gsum du tshe don mtshan bya/ /rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan so ma shrīs mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā dz+nyā na dang / lo tsā 9ba gzhon nu 'od kyis bsgyur / / //33—1089
