de 'jam dpal dkyil 'khor ni/ /yang dag lta bas 'jug pa bshad/ /de la rnal 'byor tshangs gnas la/ /gnas dang gsum la skyabs gnas dang / /sems bskyed pa yi stobs kyis ni/ /ngang gis /hūṃsdom pa la gnas dang / /rmi lam lta bur rtogs pa las/ /sems gnyis dge ba mi rtog 2nor/ /shin tu bde ba'ang rtogs pa dang / /the tshom med dang chags med dang / /dngos po lnga la mkhas pa dang / /pha rol phyin tshol mngon dga' ba / /de las gzhan pa'i ngo bo ni/ /yon tan ldan pa mkhas pa yin/ /yid ches pa yi khyad par gyis / /byang chub sems ni phul byung dang / /thabs dang shes rab gnyis me+ed dang / /mos pa yang dag ldan pa dang / /ji bzhin dbang ni thob pa dang //bla ma sems can bsnyen 4pa dang / /ltung ba sna tshogs spang ba'i phyir/ /gus pa'i blo yis skal bar 5ldan/ /de nyid rnam bcu rtag tu ni/ /yid la byed pa mngon gzhol pa/ /sngags dang rgyud dang de nyid shes/ /sgrub byed thub pa'i dbang por brjod/ /dkyil 'khor las la 'jug 'dod pas/ /'bad pas bsnyen pa la gnas bya/ /dang por bsnyen pa ma byas par/ /lha rnams byen gyis rlob mi 'gyur/ /yid dang 7mthun pa'i gnas rnams su/ /snying ga'i pad+ma'i zla ba la/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i oṃ yig dgod/ /rang sems dag pa'i nam mkha' la/ /rdzogs sangs sras dang bla mar bcas/ /yang dag bltas la phyag 'tshal dang / /dad pa rgyas pa'i yid kyis kyang / /'khor lo mchod pas dang por mchod/ /de la sngags brjod sngon song ba'i/ /dang po'i mgon la phyab/ bzhi bya/ /chu gtsang ba yi rnam pa dang / /snod rgyas pa yang dbul bar bya/ /me tog dang ni bdug pa dang / /mar me dri yis mchod par bya/ /de las 33—/138

gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /me tog spos dang mar me dri/ /rgyan gyi rang bzhin mchod pa ni/ /rin chen bzhi ni dbul bar bya/ /bzhad dang sgeg dang dga' ba dang / /rtse 'jo'i bye brag bde ba dang / /dpag bsam shing dang gos kyi shing / /shing dang bcas pa de rnams dbul/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab de bzhin du/ /ji ltar rang sngags bzlas pa dang / /phyag rgya yis ni dbul bar bya/ /ngan par byas pa sun phyung nas/ /de rnams mdun du bshags par bya/ /g.yo med pa yi sems kyis kyang / /gzhan gyi bsod nams rjes yi rang / /dkon mchog gsum la brten stobs kyis/ /gnas pa gang las 'jig rmyepa 'byung / /de nas rang gzhan don gyi phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /sems bskyed pa dang mthun par ni/ /blo ldan lam la gnas par bgyi/ /dge ba rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir/ /smon lam dag kyang gdon par bya/ /sems can kun la brten nas ni/ / tshangs pa'i — gnas ni yongs su bsgom/ /rang bzhin med dang dge la sogs/ /bral phyir mtshan ma med pa dang / /yid mi 'jug ces bya ba yis༄ / /shes rab ting 'dzin gsum la 'jug /ji ltar rang sngags bzlas pa yi4/ /byin gyis brlab trepa'i bya bar ldan/ /mthong ba'i lam byin sdogs sangs kyis/ /bu la sogs pa bstan pa yin/ /sdogs sangs rgyas dag skugis bstan pas/ /phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ /skyob pa ji ltar bdag la ni/ /bstan pa yang dag bshad du gsol/ /rang bzhin sgrub 3 pa bzlas pa yi 7/ /rang gi sems ni bsgom par gyis/ /slar 9gsol zla ba'i gzugs lta bu/ /mthong ngo zhes ni gsol ba dang / /sems bskyed ces ni bya 33—1139

ba yi/ /dang por phyag 'tshal ldan pa dang / /dbus su byang chub yang dag ldan / /sems bskyed pa ni brtan 1pa las/ /bde ba bskyed pa'i rjes la ni/ /zla ba'i gzugs ni mthong ngo zhes/ /gsol bas brtan par gyis shig ces/ /gsungs pa de ni brtan pa yin/ /oṃ dz+nyā na raṣ+pe bi sri dza hūṃ/ rnam pa sna tshogs 'od zer gyis/ /sems can byang chub la bkod nas/ /de dag gcig pur gyur pa las/ /rdo rje rtogs par mngon par 'dod/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ oṃ spa ra ṇa badz+ra/ oṃ saṃ ha ra na badz+ra/ oṃ dz+nyā na badz+ra/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na badz+ra / rdo rje dbyings zhes yang dang yang / /zhes ni bdag nyid dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra āt+ma kolhahaṃ/ brtser ldan 'gro la phan pa dag /gyur phyir byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes ni gsol btab skad cig la/ /de dag rab tu bzhugs 2nas ni/ /de yi bdag nyid rang nyid gyur/ /o sarba ta thā ga tā ta tha ༄ a haṃ/ rdo rje rin chen sogs mnyam nyid/ /rnam pa kun du 'od gsal ba/ /chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byung ba'i/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas zhes bstod do/ /de nas gzhan don byed pa'i phyir/ /slar yang 'di ltar bsgom par bya/ /khro bo'i gzugs ni 'chang ba yis/ /snying gar pad+ma nyi hūṃ las/ /khro bo bcu po bgegs kyi gtso/ /lus ngag yid gsum phur bus gdab/ /phyi rol rdo rje ra 4ba dang / /dra ba la sogs rnam bsgoms 5nas/ /yi ge hūṃ gnyis dbus gnas pa'i/ /'og tu yo baṃ ram̐ dag las/ /rlung chu me yi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /de nyid rig pas de ltar bya/ /mkha' la bye yig las byung ba/ /rtag pa'i yan lag las byung ba'i/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni yongs gang bas/ /snod ni de yi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /hūṃ yig gnyis su baṃ las ni/ /sgu yi rdo rje 33—1140

yang dag 'byung / /gnas pa mkhrang bar ༄1gyur pa las/ /gser gyi dkyil 'khor nyid du 'gyur/ /hūṃ yig ngos gnyis ldan pa yi/ /dbus su sum̐ las lhun po ste/ /de ru bye —las byung ba yi/ /dpal ldan gzhal yas khang brtsegs bsam / /phyi dang nang du sgo bzhi dang / /gru bzhi stegs bur yang dag ldan//dra ba dra phyed phreng ba dang / /dril bu me long gis gsal ba'o/ /ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa dang / /nam mkha' bla res snang ba yin/ /'og gi sa gzhi mtho ba dang / /yangs pa rnam par mdzes pa yin/ /de dbus byāḥlas sna tshogs pa'i/ /chu skyes nyi mar seng ge'i gdan/ /dang po'i 4dbyangs las byung ba yi/ /rgyal ba rnam snang sku mdog dkar/ /'khor lo dril bu phyag na bsnams/ /nyi ma la bzhugs bsgom par bya/ /de yang snying gar sna tshogs pa'i/ /pad+ma nyi ma dhīḥlas byung / /dang po'i sangs rgyas mig sman mdog /zhal lnga phyag ni brgyad dang ldan/ /g.yas brtsams ser po dmar po dang / /ljang gu dkar po pad+ma'i zhal / /nam mkha' 'dra ba'i ral gri dang / /shes rab puste bzhi bzhi ni/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag rnams kyis/ /sgeg dang bcas pas bsnams pa yin/ /oṃ sarba dharmā a 9bhā ba/ nang gi mu khyud dag la dgod/ /phyi rol ka la sogs bkod pa/ /sgeg dang mdzes par snang ba yin/ /snying gar srid pa'i 'khor lo ni / /rten 'brel bcu gnyis ston pa'o/ /de yi lte ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs bcu pa yis brgyan pa yin/ /oṃ pra dz+nyā la sogs pa yi/ /gti mug sel bar byed pa yis/ /lhag ma nye snying sngags phyed kyis/ /nang gi mu khyud rnam par bskor/ /mu khyud ā li 7bcu gnyis kyis/ /'khor lo 'di yang rnam par gsal / /zla ba gzhon nu ltar 'jam pa/ /gzhon nu sgeg pa'i cha byad can/ /33—1141

sna tshogs kyis ni rtse bran dang / /gdong lnga zur phud lnga dang ldan/ /dpung rgyan do shal yan lag mdzes/ /dpal 'phro ba yi zhabs gdub spras/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa/ /shin tu dbugs 'byin byed pa yin/ /gang zhig shes rab ye shes sku/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gdan la bzhugs/ /dang po'i dbyangs las byung ba yi/ /dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs zhes dran bya/ /seng ge'i gdan la gser kyi mdog /phyi rol shar sogs phyogs dgod pa/ /nyi mar rdo rje'i 1skyil krung bzhugs/ /rin chen cod pan gyis mdzes pa/ /g.yas kyi 'od zer bcas 'khor lo/ /g.yon pa gdan la brten pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sogs ming can/ /'khor los sgyur ba brgyad shes bya/ /de la rig pa'i lha mo bzhi/ /de yi mtshams bzhir rdushes bya ste/ /rdo rje sems ma sku mdog sngo/ /phyag gis pad+ma rdor dril bsnams/ /rin chen sems ma gser gyi mdog /rin chen dril bu nye bar mdzes/ /chos kyi sems ma gur gum mdog /pad+ma dril bus mtshan pa yin/ /las kyi sems ma ljang gu ste/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams mdzes dang / /'gro ba sdud par byed pa yi/ /g.yon pa snang ba chen po yin/ /shar du rdo rje hūṃ mdzad ni/ /mdog nag rnam rgyal phyag rgya dang / /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgyar ldan/ /'jigs rung sa bon hūṃ las byung / /glang po'i gdan la gnas pa dang / /khro dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /lho ru rdo rje nyi ma ni/ /t+t+waṃ 1byung rmad byung rta yi gdan/ /yid bzhin nor bus /4ma lus pa'i//dbul ba sel bar byed pa dang / /dril bu'i 5sgra yis sems can la/ /dpal rnams 'gugs par byed pa yin/ /pad+ma gar dbang sgu mdog dmar/ /nub tu rma bya'i gdan la bzhugs/ /chu skyes dril bu bsnams pa dang / /lta gyis 533—1 /42

baṃ la mngon shāphyogs byed/ /byang du rta mchog sku mdog lngang / /nam mkha' lding gi gdan la bzhugs/ /a byung sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /dril bu'i sgra yis phyogs kun khyab/ /saṃ gi baṃ saṃ ghi sa bon rnams/ /oṃ hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ byetweḥldan pa las/ /gdan 'di dag ni go rims bzhin/ /mkhas pas grangs bzhin shes par bya/ /zla ba'i gdan gnas 'di rnams kyi/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas gong ma bzhin/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo tshangs pa ste/ /snga ma las khyad med phyir ro/ /zhi ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ /mi bskyod sogs rigs rim bzhin du/ /oṃ duḥkha ts+tsha da la sogs dgod/ /rigs ni ji ltar de na gnas/ /na ma zhes bya rtsibs gcig 1la/ /mkhas pas kun la shes par bya/ /sdug bsngal gcod pa rdo rje dang / /rin po che ni gsung dbang phyug /rdo rje rnon po pad+ma dang / /ye shes sku can zhes bya ba/ /sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon pa la/ /g.yas pa ral gri khyad par med / /kun kyang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zla ba ltar 'jam cha byad can//dang po'i dbyangs byung bzlas pa yang / /snying po nye snying rim pa bzhin/ /de la lnga po rim bzhin du/ /snying po dang ni nye snying po/ /oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na sprurta ye nā sngum / oṃ duḥkha ts+tsha da ya te nā 5 ma/ oṃ bā gī hūṃshwa ra ya te nā ④ma/ o badz+ra tīspyo zu ya te nā kyem/ oṃ dz+nyā na kā ya ya te nā ⑪ma/ nye ba'i snying po thun mong ste//o sarba dharmā a spyobhā ba swa bhā ba bi shudhe badz+ra a ā saṃ aḥ/ pra kṛ ta pa ri shudheskru /sarba dharmā ya/ du ta sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya mañju shrī pa ri shurnyi ta mu pā dā mi ye ti a aXthusarba ta thā ga ta z-i mud ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ tweḥbha ga bān rdzudz+nyā na mūrti bā gī nyubhe shwa ra ma hā wa shāne+e tsa sarba dharmā ga ga na a ma nyu la su pa ri shudha dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gasgo ā — ཿ/ 'di rnams kyang ni rim bzhin du/ /shar la sogs par 33—1143

bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sogs dbye bas/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams 1bcu drug /rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar/ /rdo rje dril bu bsnams par 'dod/ /rdo rje rgyal po gser gyi mdog /phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags kyu bsnams/ /chags pa pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /mda' dang gzhu ni bsnams pa yin/ /rdo rje legs pa sgu mdog ljang / /phyag gnyis legs so sbyin pa'o/ / rin chen btso ma gser gyi mdog /༄ rin po che dang dril bu bsnams / /rdo rje gzi brjid nyi ma'i mdog /g.yas pa nyi ma'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /rdo rje dpal ni margad mdog /g.yas na rgyal mtshan bsnams pa yin / /bzhad pa kun+da zla ba'i mdog /g.yas pa so yi phreng ba bsnams/ /'di gsum pa 4yi g.yon pa ni/ /skyil krung gdan la brten nas so/ /chos ni pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /g.yon pa pad+ma dmar po bsnams/ /g.yas pas rnam par 'byed pa yin/ /de ni rgyas par byed pa yin/ /rnon po bdud rtsi 'od zer mdog /ral gri dang 5ni puste bsnams/ /rgyu dang smra ba g.yas pa na/ /'khor lo dang 6ni lce bsnams pa/ /bdag nyid mdzes pa g.yon pa yi/ /phyag gi 7pad+ma gdan la brten/ /las ni sngo ljang sna tshogs pa'i/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bu bsnams/ /bsrung ba gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ /phyag gnyis go cha 'bar ba'o/ /gnod sbyin mig sman nag bo'i mdog /phyag gnyis mche ba rnam par mdzes/ /khu tshur rmad byung mdzes pa'i mdog /phan tshun khu tshur rdo rje 'dzin/ /bdag po rnam pa bzhi yi phyir/ /bzhi bzhi ru ni dran par bya/ /lha mo bcu bcu 'di rnams kyi9/ /'khor du yang dag dran par bya/ /skyil krung phyed mar ldan pa yi/ /rang rang bdag po'i mdog bzhin no/ /sbyin dang tshul 33—1 144

khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan de bzhin shes rab dang / /smon lam ye shes zhes hūṃbya ba/ /'bras bu'i 2gnas kyi pha rol phyin/ /rdo rje dril bu yang dag ldan/ /mdog ༄ —dkar rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /'khor du de dag gnas pa yin/ /de nyid lam gyi ngo bor ni/ /bdud la lcags kyu 'debs pa gzhan / /ser po rdo rje rgyal po yi/ /'khor du de dag gnas pa yin/ /de nyid rnam par dag ngo bor/ /mda' dang gzhu yis rnam brgyan pa/ /mdog dmar rdo rje chags pa ni/ /thams cad dkyil 'khor yongs su bskor/ /gzhan don ngo bor gnas de nyid/ /phyag gnyis legs pa sbyin 4pa dang / /sku mdog ljang khu'i 'khor rnams kyis/ /rdo rje legs pa bskor ba'o/ /rab tu dga' dang dri ma med/ /gsum pa de bzhin 'od byed dang / /'od 'phro sbyang dka' de bzhin du/ /mngon gyur ring song mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ /sku mdog ser po sa'abras bdag nyid/ /dar dpyangs bcing ba'i tshul gnas pa/ /rdo rje rin chen 'khor du gnas/ /de nyid lam gyi 6grangs kyis 7ni/ /nyi ma'i mdog can nyi ma bsnams/ /rdo rje nyi ma nyid bzhin du/ /rjes su byed par gnas pa yin/ /sdug bsngal dang ni kun 'byung dang / /'gog dang lam dang de bzhin du/ /chos shes rjes su shes pa dang / /kun rdzob shes dang de bzhin du/ /don dam de bzhin mi skye ba/ /zad pa shes pa'i ye shes ni/ /rang bzhin phun sum tshogs dge ba'i/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan bsnams pa dang / /mdog ljang rdo rje rgyal mtshan gye/ /phun sum tshogs pa bsgom par bya/ /gzhan don phun sum bdag nyid kyi/ /de bzhin zla ba'i 'od zer mdog /rdo rje bzhad pa la brten pa/ /so yi phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /33—1 /45

phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /bden pa rten 'byel thub pa yi/ /gnas dang gnas min bdag po dang / /dus gsum bden pa rnam pa bzhi/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas dge ba/ /rdo rje chos kyi 'khor du bsgom/ /don dang phyag g.yon pad+ma ni/ /bsnams nas g.yas pas 'byed par mdzad/ /gcig dang rgyu dang za ba dang / /byed pa dang ni dbang sgyur dang / /bdag po'i don dang brtag pa dang / /nyon mongs pa dang dag pa'i gnas/ /rnal 'byor can dang ma grol grol7/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa skye ba nyid/ /de dag gcod pa'i sku mdog gnag༄2 /phyag na pusnyi bsnams pa dang / /nyon mongs gcod pa'i ral gri bsnams/ /rdo rje rnon po'i 'khor du brjod/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan/ /shes rab de bzhin sha yi spyan/ /lha dang shes rab chos dang ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan dang dbang po yi/ /rdo rje 'khor lo sku mdog ser/ /lha mo 'khor lo bsnams pas chobaskor/ /gnas dang gnas min rnam smin dang / /mos pa dang ni sna tshogs khams/ /dbang po kun 'gro'i 5lam dag dang / /nyon mongs rnam par sbyang ba dang / /sngon gnas rjes dran skye 'chi dang / /zag pa zad pa nyid kyang de/ /rdo rje smra ba zangs kyi mdog /phyag gis lce bsnams 'khor gyis bskor/ /nam mkha' rnam shes mtha' yas dang 6/ /de las gzhan pa'i zil gnon brgyad/ /rdo rje las zuni sku mdog ljang / /sna tshogs rdor dril thogs pas bskor/ /'byung ba rnam pa bzhi po dang / /sngon po ser po dkar dmar dang / /nam mkha' de bzhin sems dang ni/ /zad par rnam dag ldan pa yi 5/ /bsrung ba ser po go cha bsnams / /rtsa ba'i mtshan nyid de kho na/ /phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid dang / /33—1146

'bras bu rgyu yi de kho na/ /phra ba dang ni rags pa dang / /grags dang rnam par dag yul dang / /sdud dang dbye ba'i mtshan nyid dang / /mkhas de kho na rnam bcu ni/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog nag /phyag gnyis mche ba bsnams pa'o / /tshe dang sems dang yo byad dang / /las dang skye ba mos pa dang / /smon lam dang ni rdzu 'phrul dang / /ye shes la 2sna ni dbang ba dang / /rdo rje khu tshur sku mdog dkar/ /phyag gnyis khu tshur bsnams pa'o/ /so so'i 3snagatso bo'i sngags kyis bskyed/ /rang rang sngags kyis mchod pa dang / /rdo rje'i rnyi skyil krung phyed kyis ni/ /'di dag rim bzhin gnas pa yin/ /'di ltar bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs pa ni/ /ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du thob/ /dngos grub gzhan ni smos ci dgos/ /'di rnams kyi ni grwa bzhi ru/ /mkhas pas sgeg mo la sogs bsgom/ /sgeg mo mdog dkar rdo rje bsnams/ /phreng ba ma ni gser gyi mdog /rin chen phreng ba bsnams pa yin/ /glu ma sku mdog dmar mo saste/ /pi wang rdeb pa'i mchog yin no/ /gar ma rdo rje ljang gu ni/ /rtse gcig bsnams nas gar mdzad do/ /spos dang me tog mar me dri/ /de rnams rjes la dran par bgyi/ /spos khang me tog snod dang ni/ /mar me yi ni mchod sdong dang / /dri yi dung chos rim bzhin no/ /'di rnams kha dog sgeg sogs bzhin/ /lcags kyu dang ni zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog dril bu zhes grags pa/ /dkar po ser po dmar po ljang / /shar la sogs pa'i sgo la bstan6/ /ming dang mthun par 7phyag mtshan gnas/ /phyi rol bskal pa 3bzang po ni/ /shar la sogs par she bsgom par bya/ /rnam pa bzhi yi dbye ba yi/ /de dag bcu drug yang dag 33—1147

dgodasne / /rang gi bdag po'i rjes mthun par/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan mdzes pa yin/ /yang na gzhan du phyag mtshan rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du bsam par bya/ /de la mgon po byams pa ni/ /phyag na klu shing bsnams pa yin / /'jam dpal ral gri puste dang 2/ /ji ltar rim bzhin mtshan pa 7yin / /spos kyi glang po spos chu yi/ /dri yi dung chos char 'be+ebs pa'i/ /thod 4dang bcas pa'i cod pan ni/ /ye shes tog ni bsgrings 5nas bsnams/ /bzang skyong ba ni nam mkha' 6mdzod/ /bslang nas dz+wamatshan par byed pa'o/ /blo gos rgya mtsho yid bzhin nor/ /phyag gi pad+ma mdzes pa yin/ /dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang / /blo gros mi zad 8phyag g.yon na/ /pusti kyematshan pa'i pad+ma ni/ /spobs pa brtsegs pa de bzhin du/ /phyag na ral gri bsnams pa yin/ /mthu chen thob pa ral gri bsnams/ /ngan song kun 'dren rgyal mtshan no/ /mya ngan mun pa nges 'joms ni/ /dpal be+e'u g.yung drung 'khyel pa ni/ /dra ba can gyi 'od rnams so/ /zla 'od gzhon nu zhes bya ba/ /zla tshes g.yer ka rgyal mtshan mdzes11/ /'od dpag med pa puste dang / /ral gri rin chen mdzod 'dzin pa/ /nam mkha'i snying por shes par byas/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ral gri ni/ /bsnams pa sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes 'dod do/ /'di rnams phyi yi sgo skyong dag /sngar ni ji skad smos pa bzhin/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i rjes la ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas/ /de nyid gsum gyi yi ge yi/ /rnal 'byor rig pas byin brlab 1 bya / /de la rim pa 'di yin te/ /spyan drang sngon 'gro phyag 'tshal te/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa da ban+da 7na ka ro mi/ e ma kun du bzang po yi/ /byang 33—/ /48

chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo yi/ /dbus na de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes/ /de nas 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhugs nas/ /byung nas kyirang rang rigs pa ni/ /byen gyis brlab pa mdzad pa yin/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rgya chen gdod nas skye ba med/ /rdul phran thams cad ji snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu gyur/ /de nyid gsum gye byin rlabs 5dang / /'khor lo'i bdag nyid dbang bskur nas/ /rang bzhin dag par bsgom par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhe ṣe ka sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ de ltar ting 'dzin gsum dang ni / /mkhas pas cho ga byas nas ni/ /de nas rang lha'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /mchod pa yang dag brtsam par bya/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya ldan g.yo bas/ /ar+gha'i snod ni bzang ba dang 7 / /g.yas pa ba dan gsum dang ni/ /de nyid gsum gyes bsam par bya/ /de nas mkhas pas me tog gsol8/ /de yi chu yis bsang bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra 9 puṣ+pe hūṃ/ o badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūṃ/ o badz+ra a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ / ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta 1oṃ āḥhūṃ / phyag 'tshal rdo rje ldan pa yi/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya ba 7dang / se gol brdabs la dgug pa dang / /phyag byas nas ni ar+gha / dbul/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be+e sha āḥ/zhus nas yi ge gsum gyis ni/ /byin gyis brlabs 5la dbang bskur ro/ /de nas sngar bshad rim pa yis/ /mchod pa rnams kyis mchod pa dang / /de las gzhan pa'i rig —ma ni/ /bcu drug gis ni mchod bstod bya/ /dkyil 'khor rnam gsum phyag mtshan dang / /ji srid thig le'i rim pa dang / /snang 33—1 1 49

ba la sogs rim pa yisasna/ /spros pa thams cad zhi ba dang / /stong nyid sogs rim thob pa yi/ /rnal 'byor lhan skyes mdzes pa yin / /de ltar goms pa 'jug pa rnams/ /mi shes chu bo ma lus pa/ /bskams shing sems kyi zla ba ni/ /shar ba skal ba bzang po yin/ /spro thudang bsdu ba'i rim pa yis//ji srid sgrub pa mi skyo'i bar/ /de ltar yang dang yang du bya/ /langs nas sangs rgyas spyan drangs nas/ /de nas gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /de la rdo rje sems 5dpa' ni/ /'khor los sgyur bar 'dod pa las/ /a las byung zhing sku mdog dkar/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bu bsnams/ /thugs kar dang po sangs rgyas ni/ /sngar ni ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ /de la mya ngan 'das 'khor lo/ /a ra la sogs yi ger ldan/ /de steng a ra pa tsa na/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /'di yi nye ba'i snying po ni/ /sngar ni bstan zin gang yin pa'o/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na ya te nā 6ma/ sngags kun rigs kyi bdag nyid kyi/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po yang / /zhal bzhi sku mdog dung 'dra zhing / /bsam gtan phyag rgyar ldan pa'o/ /dang po'i )sangs rgyas thugs ka ru/ /zhi ba'i 'khor lo 'di rnams kyang / /rtsibs drug pa la rigs 5drug gis/ /yongs su bskor bar ldan pa'o/ /de la gnyis med 'jam pa'i dpal/ /mdog dkar zhal drug a las byung / /phyag gnyis ral gri puste bsnams/ /gnyis kyis ut+pal bsnams pa dang / /gnyis ni ting 'dzin phyag rgya ni/ /yang dag snang ba snang ba che/ /'di dag so so'i snying po ni/ /sgrub pa'i thabs las gsal bar bstan/ /bshad pa'i 'khor lo bdag nyid ni/ /lha rnams nyi shur mnyam pa la/ /gcig gi bdag nyid chen po ni/ /blo chen rnams kyis mchod par bya/ /33—//50

rdo rje hūṃ mdzad gtso bo yis/ /'khor los sgyur tshobar 'dod pa la/ /'di rnams rang gi ngo bo ni/ /kho bos sngar ni bstan zin to/ /'on kyang 'di yi khyad par ni/ /da ni rab tu bshad par bya/ /mda' dang gzhu ni 'gengs pa dang / /rnam rgyal phyag rgya rdor dril dang / /ral gri rdo rje zhags pa dang / /lcags kyu dang ni lcags sgrog bsnams/ /lha chen u ma mnan pa ni/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad ces brjod do/ /'di yi rin chen hūṃ mdzad ni/ /phyag drug rnam rgyal phyag rgya med/ /zhal drug zhal ni re re la/ /srun ni gsum gsum ldan pa'o/ /'di yi 2pad+ma'i hūṃ mdzad ni/ /mche gcigs ha la ha lar ldan/ /'di yi las kyi hūṃ mdzad ni/ /rnam rgyal rang gi phyag rgyar ldan/ /be+egs kyu zhags pa ral gri dang / /gtun shing lhag ma phyag na bsnams/ /gang yang rdo rje rin chen ni//'khor los sgyur bar 'dod pa la/ /ser po rin chen kyis mtshan pa/ /kun kyang rin chen cod pan can/ /de la rnam snang sngar bshad bzhin/ /don kun grub pa mi bskyod pa/ /rdo rje bsnams nas sa gnon no/ /rin chen gtsug phud snga ma bzhin/ /rin chen pad+ma sku mdog ser/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgyas ldan pa dang / /lo las byung ba'i sa bon ni/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pad+ma la/ /g.yas pa bkod nas g.yon pa la/ /bsam gtan dang po'i bar du gnon/ /rin chen don yod don yod do/ /rdo rje'i tshig ni thams cad la/ /rang ming rin chen sgra dang ni/ /yang dag ldan pa'i sku yin no/ /rin chen rdo rje'i rdor tshig la/ /khro gnyer ldan par shes par bya/ /g.yon pas rdo rje gnon pa dang //g.yas pas 'dod pa gnon pa'o/ /rdo rje rin chen nyi ma 'od/ /rin chen dpal ni rgyal mtshan brjod/ /gang yang pad+ma gar dbang phyug /'alo/ ra los 33—1151

sgyur bar 'dod pa la/ /rdo rje'i gnas su pad+ma'i tshig /lha gzhan kun la shes par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs la pad+ma'i tshig /sngon song rnam par snang mdzad brjod / /rin chen rin chen gtsug phud dang / /pad+ma gar gyi dbang la yang / /ting 'dzin sgra yi sngon du ni/ /pad+ma zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /pad+ma nges pa'i dbang phyug ni/ /pad+ma'i don yod grub pa yin/ /gzhan gyi khyad par 'di dag kyang / /nor bus byas pa'i rin po che/ /nyi ma nyi ma'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /dpal ni zla ba'i ngang pa las/ /gnas pa ku mu ta la ni/ /zla bas mtshan pa'i gdugs bsnams pa'o/ /bzhad pa la ni zhal bcu gcig /pad+ma'i sgrol ma brgya byin mdog /pad+ma'i 'khor lo khyab 'jug 'dra/ /smra ba tshangs pa'i rjes su byed/ /las ni gzhon nu lta bu ste/ /de las gzhan pa khyad par med/ /rta mchog gsu/ma gyi bdag nyid dam/ /rnam pa lnga'am rnam pa gcig /sngon po gsum gyi bdag nyid ni/ /ral gri mda' gzhu ut+pal bsnams/ /'di yi lha mo gnyis po ni/ /g.yas na sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams/ /de la gtsang ma sgu mdog dkar/ /pad+ma sngon pos rnam par mdzes/ /dag ma pad+ma rā ga'i 1mdog /pad+ma dmar pos rnam par mdzes/ /'di yi nang gi skye mched rnams/ /sa snying la sogs byin gyis rlobasarte/ /phyi yi skye mched rnams la ni/ /gzugs rdo rje sogs byin brlabs pa'o/ /g.yon pas 'dod pa'i 'jig rten gnon/ /g.yas pas mnan pa bsam gtan yin/ /rta skad 'tsher ba phyogs kyi zhal/ /bsam gtan dang po'i bar du reg /lnga yi bdag nyid snga ma bzhin/ /yang na 'od dpag med pa bzhin/ /puste dang ni ral gri dang / /mda' gzhu bsnams pa yid 'phrog pa'o/ /tshangs pa brgya byin khyab 'jug ni/ /pa ba sangs dang 33—1 152

skar ma'i dgra/ /zhabs kyis nyupad+ma bskor ba yis/ /grong khyer sum rtseg thupa gnon pa/ /'phrog pa'i lha mo rnams kyang ni/ /'di dag 'khyud nas bzhugs pa'o/ /rta yi gdong can thams cad kyang / /'khor kun yongs su shes par bya/ /de ltar zla gcig zla drug gam/ /lo gcig mtshan ma thob bar du / /de srid bsnyen pa byas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor las la 'jug par bya/ /gtsug lag khang la sogs pa yi/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /tshad ldan tsha sgo 4med par ni/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bya/ /rgyal pos khru ni brgya lnga 5bcu/ /blon po chen pos nyi shu lnga/ /tshong dpon ded dpon nyi shu'am phyed//sgrub pos bcu gnyis sam de'i phyed/ /der ni mngon spyod sbyin sreg dang / /zhi ba yi ni sbyin sreg dag /byas nas sa ni sbyang bar bya/ /yongs su gzung 'u bar bya ba yin/ /der ni dkyil 'khor yongs sprul nas/ /gong du ji skad bshad pa bzhin 3/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs sngon song nas/ /mchod pa yongs su rgyas par bya/ /de nas sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gis/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bstod nas/ /sa yi lha mo spyan drangs la/ /sna tshogs mchod pas mchod nas ni/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyibye / /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyes—/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa lashe/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya'i seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar byas te bye dkyil 'khor bri/ /mig gnyis nyi zla rkang mthil ni/ /rdo rje rgya gram byin brlabs nas/ /zhal nas hūṃ gi sgra sgrogs shing / /yongs su bskyod pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /phyogs rnams rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / /rdo rje ra ba dra ba 11bsam/ /lag gnyis rdo rje dril ldan dang 6/ /33—1153

g.yas pa rdo rje bsnun pa yishe/ /tshul gyis bgegs la bka' bsgo dang / /phur bus btab pa la sogs bya/ /de nas de nyid dris byugs la/ /lha yi gnas su tsan+dan la2/ /sogs pa'i dri yi thig le dang / /me tog sna tshogs dgram par bya/ /de rjes nam mkha' la gnas pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams bkug nas ni/ /mchod pa lnga dang brgyad rnams kyang / /mchod nas 'di ltar brjod par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ / rig sngags ༄/rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag la brtse bar gyur nas ni/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang ba mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gsang sngags lha gzhan gang bzhugs dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang du lha yi spyan mnga' ba/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par 5mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming / /'di 4zhes bya ba ci nus kyis3 / /cho ga bzhin du 'bri lags na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes ni lan gsum brjod pa yis/ /lha rnams lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas 'og nas 'chad pa yi/ /bum pa mtshan nyid ldan pa dang / /'bru la sogs pa thams cad dang / /bcas pa lhag par gnas par bya/ /gzhan yang sbyin sreg cho ga dang / /gtor ma shin tu rgya chen po / /slob ma lhag par gnas pa dang / /rim pa bzhin du shes par bya/ /33—1/54

de la khrus byas gtsang ma yite / /gos gon nas ni slob ma yis5 thal mo me tog bcas pa dang / /phyag byas nas ni 'di skad brjod/ /dga' chen khrod bdag ston pa bas —/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pacho/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid sprul du gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum 3dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po /༅bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /bu tshur shog cig theg chen po/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga 'di/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar bzhugs pa'i mgon po rnams/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa dag /de dag kun gyis ⑦gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mnyam med brnyes3/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med pa/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom—/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gos 'di gyis shig /de nas cho ga'i yan lag kun/ /byas la byin gyis brlab pa dang / /mchod nas a shwat+tha sogs pa'i/ /so shing ku sha srung skud sbyin(kye/ /rig sngags ldan pa'i srad bu ni/ /tshad dang ldan par bkal 7ba dang / /phan tshun legs par bsgril / kyeb yis/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor thig gdab bo/ /oṃ a spyo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥ phyasga ra sga ra a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā ཿar+yan+ta a (—/nu pra bish+ka sarba dharmā hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tra ma ti ⑪ kra ma hūṃ/ shar nub byang dang lho phyogs 33—1 155

dang / /mngon par bltas la tshangs thig gnyis/ /me dang gnod sbyin dbang ldan dang / /gshin rje mngon par phyogs pa dang / /rlung dang gshin rje bden bral dang / /gnod sbyin phyogs su kha bltas la/ /shar dang nub tu thig gdab bo1/ /me dang bden bral srin po dang / /dbang po rlung dang dbang ldan dang / /rlung gi phyogs su kha bltas la/ /go rims bzhin du lho byang gi/ /thig gnyis de bzhin gdab par bya/ /slob dpon slob ma bskor phyogs su/ /'gro zhing me dang rlung mtshams dang / /bden bral dbang ldan mtshams su ni/ /gnas nas thig gnyis gdab par bya/ /gsar pa las ni bkal menas kyang / /tshad dang mthun par mdzad ༄ pa yi/ /thig ni mkhas pas ci nus kyis4/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni thig gdab bo/ /gru bzhir bya zhing sgo bzhi dang / /rta babs bzhi yis mdzes byas la/ /thig bzhi dang ni ldan gyur pa / /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /grwa yi phyogs ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen spras par ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim thig gdab bo/ /de yi rim pa'i nang zhugs la/ /'khor lo 'dra ba'i rdo rje yihūṃ/ /thig gis yongs su bskor bya zhing / /ka ba brgyad kyis mdzes byas la/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid dmigs la/ /shes rab can kyis thig gdab bo/ /shar dang nub dang byang dang lhor/ /thig bzhi btab pas dkyil 'khor brgyad/ /de ltar lung dang bla ma yi/ /gdams ngag dag la brten nas ni/ /cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i thig gdab bo/ /oṃ tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes ni lan gsum mngon bzlas pa'i/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bcas pa dang / /byin gyis brlabs nas tshon rtsi ni/ /cho 33—1156

ga bzhin du bri bar bya/ /sngon po rdo rje rtse rang bzhin/ /gnyis pa gser la dmigs pa ste/ /pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin gzhan/ /de bzhin gzhan ni margad 'dra / /dkar po snabhenang du shes bya ste/ /de ni tshon gyi rim pa ju bshad/ /shar phyogs su ni sngon po ste/ /lhor ni ser bo dang ldan pa/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste/ /byang ni ljang gur yang dag ldan/ /dbus kyi sa yi cha nyid ni/ /shel ltar dkar ba bla na med/ /rtag tu rdo rje dril 'chang zhing / /rab mnyam gzhag pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /lha rnams rang rang gnas su ni/ /gzugs dang phyag rgya sogs pa yi/ /kha dog dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis1/ /bris nas sngon gsungs mchod pa rnams/ /rgya chen po yis mchod bya zhing / /gzhan yang zhal zas sna tshogs dang / /'dod yon lnga dang rin chen dang / /gos kyi bye brag sna tshogs dang / /rta dang glang po'i tshogs kyis mchod/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bum pa rnams/ /mgrin par ras dkris tsu ta lasnye/ /sogs pa ltalo mar bcas pa yi6/ /shing gi kha rgyan thurin chen dang / /'bru dang sman lnga dri zhim pa'i/ /spos chu me tog la sogs pas/ /rab tu bkang nas rang rigs kyi / /mtshan mas mtshan nas bum pa la/ /rang rang rigs kyi lhar bskyed nas/ /ye shes sems dpa' gzhug (pa dang / /mchod pa la sogs byin brlabs nas/ /cho ga bzhin du gnas par bya/ /'bras chan nas chan snum khur sogs/ /bza' 7ba shin tu rgya chen po/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /gtor ma shin tu rgya chen gtang 11/ /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab khebazangs lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bdag 33—1 157

gis shepus mo sa la btsugs nas su/ /thal sbyar khyed rnams la ni gsol 'debs kyis / /bu smad bcas shing g.yog 2'khor bcas pa rnams/ /gnas nas phan gdags slad nas ④'dir spyon zhigathu /'byung po gang dag ri rab steng 6gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu yi mdo rnams dang / /rin chen gnas na lhag par gang gnas dang / /mtsho dang rdzing dang lteng ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu sil ma dag na gang gnas 77 dang / /grong dang grong khyer phyugs lhas stong pa dang / /khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang / /gtsug lag khang dang grong khyer gnas dag gam/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres dang ni/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo dang ni 'dun byes dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes shing go bar gyur nas su / /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug pa dang / /bstod tsu7dang gtor ma mar me gus phul bsaskru/ /'di dag bzhes te btung zhing bsnams nas su/ /las 1 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /shar phyogs rdo rje can de lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs po sha33—1158

chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa tshosteng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gsang ba'i tshogs 'dus pa/ /so so so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas kyang/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun ༄2dang / /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs cig tu/ /me tog dri dang byug pa gtor mar bcas/ /'di dag btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang ni/ /mngon spyod kyi ni dbye ba yis / /thab khung mchod rdzas rnal 'byor dang / /'dug stangs tshul bzhin shes par bya/ /de la re zhig zhi ba ni/ /sa gzhi dkar po thab khung ni/ /zlum po'i chur ni khru gang dang / /zabs su khru ni phyed kyi tshad/ /sor bzhi dor la dpangs thusu ni/ /sor bzhi stod la sor bzhi smad/ /phyi rol kun nas gru bzhi pa5/ /cho ga bzhin du bri bar bya/ /u dus+thā 6ra pa la sha /a mra blag 7 sha kang smra rgya/ /a shwat+tha snal sogs pa yi/ /yam shing sor ni bcu gnyis dang //nas zho 'o ma 'bras yos dang / /til dang drur 9ba ku sha sngo/ / sā lu 7'bras chen me tog dkar/ /spos dang sbrang rtsi mar la sogs/ /srog chags med pa'i mchod sbyin shing / /dgon pa'i lci ba 'o ma shing / /gos dkar gon nas snying rje'i sems/ /rnal 'byor pad+ma'i 'dug stangs so/ /rang gi sa bon las byung ba / /las dang rjes mthun bha ba ka /rdo rje rtse gsum phreng ba dang / /dbyug pa gun+dhe 11'dzin bsams nas/ /ye shes me lha dgug pa dang / /gzhug dang bcing dang dbang byas nas/ /phyag rgya bzhis gdab dbang bsgur ba/ /oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca sabhasmi ku ru sarba/ de nas mchod yon sngon song ba'i/ /las 33—1159

dang rjes su mthun pa yi/ /mchod pa lnga dang sgeg mo sogs/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ /de rjes gsang sngags 'di dag gis/ /mar gyi dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ /bgegs ni yod med brtag par bya/ /oṃ a na la ma hā byu 1ta dz+wa la ya sarba duṭ+wān 2hūṃ phaṭa/ 'bar ba'i me la yam shing ste/ /de nas mar dang de 'og til/ /de nas 'bras chan la sogs pa'o/ /cho ga 'di ni mdor bsdu ba'o / /de nas me yi dbus nyid du/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams dmigs pa dang / /ye shes sems dpa' bcug nas ni/ /mchod pa yongs su rgyas par bya/ /me la bsang gtor 'thor 'thung dang / /dgang blugs dang ni mchod pa dag /byas nas 'dod pa'i dngos grub phyir/ /gsol ba btab la gshegs su gsol/ /de nas dge bsnyen dge tshul dang / /dge slong sdom pa 'dzin pa yi/ /slob ma dag la cho ga bzhin/ /rim bzhin gzhug cing dbang bskur ro/ /stod g.yogs smad g.yogs ldan pa dang / /lag na me tog bcas 4pa dang / /phyag 'tshal gsol ba gdab pa dang / /bshags pa la sogs byas nas ni/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa gsol/ /thub pa nyi ma ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /slob dpon dpang du gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba/ /mi ldog 'khor lo'i 'byor par ldan/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /gsang ba chen por 'jug par bgyi/ /gsang ba'i rigs mchog thams cad du/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug mdzod/ /mi ldog pa yi dbang bskur ba/ /skal ba chen po bdag la stsol5/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis 6rgyas btab cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas 33—/ /60

kun gyi yid 'ong ba/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol1 / /dbang bskur ba ni rmad byung che/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid 2 phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol1/ /che ge zhes bya 4'di nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing / /dam tshig sdom dang gsang ba yi/ /'khor lo 'di la gzhug par 'tshal/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed 'dod dam/ /'tshal zhes brjod la 'di skad ces/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar gyis/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar gyis 5/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams6/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa 7gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang gzung 8bar bgyi/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar gyis7/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni 11bgyid par 'tshal/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla 33byed/ /61

med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /la sogs tshig ni brjod nas ni / /oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā 1da yā mi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /su ra ta 2 sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho badz+ra sid+dhi ya thā su khaṃ/ rdo rje lcags kyu sogs sngags kyis/ /dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang byas nas/ /deng khyod ces bya la sogs 4dang / / nam mkha'i 5snying po brjod par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi6/ /snying la yang dag zhugs 7par 'gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭha9 / de nas ye shes dbab pa dang / /me tog dor dang gdong g.yogs ni/ /bgrol nas dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /de nas chu dang cod pan dang / /rdo rje'i bdag po ming dang ni/ /brtul zhugs rjes gnang la sogs pa/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyin par bya/ /de nas slob dpon la ni yon / /rjes su mthun par dbul byas la/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi 'khor lo rnams / /ma lus par ni gshegs su gsol/ /lung dang bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gdams ngag rjes 'brangs nas/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi snying por gyur pa 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga tshul bzhin byas las bdag gi dge ba ni/ /thob pa gang des 'gro kun 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i 1 zhal mthong shog /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /slob dpon so ma shrīs rkamadzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gye mkhan po ma hā dz+nyā na dang / lo tsā shā ba dge slong gzhon nu 'od kyis bsgyur zhing gtan la phab pa'o// //

bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1453)33wa 1166

༄ / /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī nā ma saṃ gī ti sarba maṇ+ḍal sto tra3 /bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa/ phyi dang nang dang de'i nang na/ /sgu gsum ༄ bdag nyid la bzhugs pa/ /snying rje shes rab rjes zhugs pa/ /gzhon nu khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam kun rnam par byang chub dang / /rnam kun dri ma med pa dang / /chos rnams kun la gnas pa dang / /chos kun gcig tu ston pa dang / /rnam kun tshul la 'jug pa dang / /rnam kun tshul la gnas pa dang / /rnam pa kun gyi don tshul gcig4 /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgeg dang bzhad dang mi sbug dang / /drag po'i ngo mtshar nyams bab/ga nyid/ /nyon mongs gcod dang shes rab can/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas khyod la 'dud/ /srid dang zhi ba spangs pa dang / /srid dang zhi 33—1 /67

—bar bzhugs par 1mdzad/ /zla ba gzhon nu ltar mdzes pa/ /chos sgu de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams thams cad stong nyid kyi/ /srog tu khyod ni bzhugs 2 pa yin/ /mtshan ma la yang mtshan ma med/ /dbang phyug che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod mi bzhugs na spros 'di la/ /ji ltar yang ni smon pa yin//khyed 'dir rjes su zhugs na ni/ /'di la smon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thog ma bar dang mthar /dge ba/ /'di ni rang nyid 'od gsal ba/ /phrin las rjes su 'jug pa yin/ /sna tshogs ston la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lta ba rtog dag las 'tsho ba/ /rtsol dang dran dang ting 'dzin gyi/ /'phags pa'i yan lag 'khor lo mdzes/ /'khor los sgyur la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang bzhin gyis ni kun rdzob dang / /sems can rnams kyi bsdu ba dang / /dge ba dri med snang ba dang / /smin byed de la phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /zang zing mi 'jigs sbyin byed dang / /byams pa sbyin byed mchog dang ni/ /chos sbyin chos kyi dbang phyug gi/ /chen po de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong dag gi rani/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par 'gro/ /nyon mongs gcod 6pa'i shes rab kyi/ /ral gri bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems can khams ni mgu ba dang / /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa chen pos gnon/ /bstan pa so so rang rig gi7/ /skyob pa'i mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /go cha chen po bgos pa dang / /'jug pa che la gnas pa dang / /so sor rtog par 8byed pa dang / /bya ba nan tan de la bstod/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab stobs chen dang / /thabs dang smon lam ye shes kyi9 / /pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /brgya dang drug cu'i grangs kyis nyu ni/ /33—/ /68

dpal gyi byang chub 'gro ba'i gtso/ /gang zhig gcig tsho/kyang rnam bcu drug /'dod chags che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byams pa'i ya lad bgos pa dang / /shes rab go cha bgos pa dang / /snying rje chen po blo ldan dang / /ye shes tog la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bzang po'i lam la sems can rnams/ /'jog ༄pecing skyob par byed pa dang / /zab pa'i blo dang rgya mtsho bzhin/ /mi zad /༄ — blo yi gter la 'dud/ /dbyer med spobs pa dag gis ni/ /stobs kyi pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /bgrod dka'i ngan song chen po las/ /kun du 'dren la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mya ngan mun pa nges 5'joms dang / /dra ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam kun bdud rtsir 'dzag pa yi/ /zla ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'od dpag med dang sprin med pa'i/ /nam mkha'i snying po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgrib pa thams cad sel ba la/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan/ /shes rab kyis ni rjes bsrungs pa/ /srung ba med kyang 'od dag ni/ /gnon pa rmad byung rgyal la 'dud/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid kyi/ /la lar rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /nyon mongs shes bya spangs pa yi6/ /la lar rnam par snang mdzad dang / /la lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang / /la lar pad+ma gar dbang phyug /la lar rdo rje nyi ma ni/ /rgya chen rmad byung chen bo 7mdzes/ /gcig gi bdag nyid rta mchog dang / /la lar gsum gyi bdag nyid dang / /gang zhig rnam lnga'i sna tshogs pa'i/ /skyob pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med 'byung ba'i chos nyid phyir/ /'khor los sgyur gyi rigs 'dzin pa/ /gcig kyang sna tshogs bdag nyid kyi/ /rnam par snang mdzad che la 'dud/ /mtshan 33—1169

brjod dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /bstod pas bsod nams gang skyes pa/ /dge ba 'di yis sems can rnams/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'grub par rngu shog /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa/ /slob dpon so ma shrīs sa༄mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā dz+nyā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu 'od kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1167 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /'phags pa/ 'jam dpa/la gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa bzhugs so// shā〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltan+d+ra/ / —ra〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kusung / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅ga1168 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mthugs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thar/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tha/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tes/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyod/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉kyis/ tso〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byu grangs kyi/1169 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉cis 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorajig 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7tu/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉sel/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesas/117༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉7pa ra/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyo/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bots+tsha/
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1454)

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba lo bi 2bye/ bod skad du/ gtor ma'i cho ga /'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'chang / /dpag bsam shing chen rgyas 'dra ste/ /bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog /sems can kun don byed la 'dud/ /gtor ma'i rim pa bshad par bya/ /dang po lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i sngags pas rin po che'i snod mdzes pa'i nang du kha zas kyi 'byor pa dri dang kha dog dang ldan pa sna tshogs bcug la/ gtor ma'i nang du yi ge a las yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'bar ba zla ba'i steng du rnam par bsams la/ de las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan gyis rnam par spras pas snod dang bcud chos kyi dbyings khyab par bsam zhing bsgom pa ni/ yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'chang / /khyab bdag rin chen kun gyi gdugs/ /zhes bya'o/ /33—1 172

bdag nyid kyi snying ga'i dhīsnaḥlas/ dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa ste/ /bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog /ces bya ba ni dpag bsam gyi shing nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba'i 'bras bu smin pa bdud rtsi rnam par 'dzag pa'o/ /gtor ma'i rgyud rgyas par bsam mo/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes bdud rtsi dbab ste gnyis su med par bsam mo//a ā sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūṃ hrī3 ཿbha ga bān dz+nyā na mūrti bā gī jeshwa ra ma hā wa tsa sarba dharmā ga ga 5na a ma la su pa ri shud+dhā dharmā 6dhā tu oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab pa'o7/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid la 8skyes/ /'jig rten gsum yang gzhon lus gcig /ces bya ba ni de nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis yang dag pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa dang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bkug ste/ de dag thams cad snying gar yi ge a bkod pa'i 'od zer gyis rnam par sbyangs te/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal du bsam mo/ /gsum sel mtha' yas grol gsum thob9/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba ni yi ge gsum gyis byen gyis brlabs la/ dngos sam yid kyis lus dpag med sprul la mchod do/ /nam mkha'i mtha' la longs spyod cing / /sems can kun yid tshim par byed/ /de ltar ljags kyi 'od zer gyis bdud rtsi'i rgyun la zhugs te/ kun kyang tshim par dmigs shing 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyis tshim par bya'o/ /de nas/chos kyi sbyin bdag chen po ste/ /mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas/ /zhes pas phreng ba'i sngags dang / a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhadrwa rde/ ār+yan rka nut+pan+da tāta1 / oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa'i bstod pas 33—/ /73

chos kyi sbyin pa bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /shes rab kyis ni de thob shog /byang chub chen por bsngo zhing smon lam rgya chen por gdab / oṃ āḥhūṃ 1zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ pha rol phyin dang rgyud rnams ma lus dang / /bder 2gshegs rgyal ba'i 1dkyil 'khor ma lus kyi/ /kun gye gtso bor khyab pas thugs la gnas/ /ye shes lus can mtshan don rgya che bas/ /sna tshogs tshul can bstod kyis deng 'dir bdag gis 'dir/ /dam pa'i gdams ngag nyer bstan rnal 'byor lam dang sbyar/ /sbyar ba 'di la dge ba gang yod 'dis/ /bdag sogs 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' 'drar 3'gyur shog /gtor ma'i cho ga 5rdzogs so// //33—/ 174

1529༄༅/ /dpal thams cad gsang ba'i bshad sbyar gsang ba'i sgon ma/1 ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sarba ra ha gya ni ban+dha 2ra ha pra dī po nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal thams cad gsang ba'i bshad sbyar gsang ba'i sgron ma /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor rgyud du gsang byas pa/ /rang gi sku gsung thugs dngos sna tshogs pa/ /thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud ni de brten nas/ /gsang ba'i sgon ma bshad sbyar brtsam par bya / /lus 4kyi tshogs rgyas par gyur pa rnams ni sbyin pa la sogs pa dka' ba'i spyod pa rnams kyis yun ring por byang chub par 'dod pa rnams la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spro ba 5bskyed pa'i phyir/ mi rnams kyi 6lus ni phyag dar kyi phung po dang mtshungs pa yin gyi/ sems ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu dang mtshungs pa yin no zhes bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ 'byung lnga nyid kyis zhes bya ba la sogs/ pa gsungs pa 7yin te/ 'byung ba zhes bya ba ni nyon mongs 33byed/ /76

nga/ dang las kyis bskyed pa sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi rgyur gyur pa sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha'i khams te lnga po nyid kyis so/ /nges pa ni brtag 1mi dgos pa'o/ /mthong ba dag ces bya ba ni tshad mar grub pa'o/ /mi rnams kyi lus de lta bu yin du zin kyang sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /ci zhig byas pas she na/ rang sems rab tu bsgoms 2pa ste rab kyi mthar thug nga/ra bsgoms pas so/ /ji ltar bsgoms pas she na/ dngos der bsgoms pas zhes bya ba ste dngos po der 'gyur ba'i phyir te sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba'i phyir / dngos po gang sems kyi de kho na nyid sgom pa gang yin pas so/ /nges par zhes bya ba ni gdon mi za bar sangs rgyas te de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro//sems kyi che ba'i bdag nyid gzhan dag kyang bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ rang shes gsang ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rang gi ye shes te rang gi 4sems nyid ni dpal gyi yon tan dang ldan pas na sangs rgyas rnams kyang rab tu 'dud cing phyag 'tshal bar mdzad do/ /rang gi sems ji lta bu zhe na/ gsang ba zhes bya ba ste 'jig rten las 'das pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dam pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad las mchog tu khyad par du 5gyur pa'i phyir ro / /de'i 6ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas ye shes bla med de / /zhes 7bya ba gsungs te/ gang gi phyir rang gi sems nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla na med pa'i ye shes yin pas so/ /dris pa gnyis su snang ba nyid kyis 'khrul cing /kun nas nyon mongs pa'i so so'i 8skye bo'i sems te/ ji ltar sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin zhe na/ gnyis med gnyis kyi tshul can te/ /9zhes bya ba gsungs te / de ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yin te/ gnyis su snang ba stong pa nyid kyi 33—/ /77

rang gi ngo bor gyur par yang dag par rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu yin du zin kyang gnyis kyi tshul can te zhes bya ba ste/ brdzun teyin du zin kyang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i tshul du so sor snang ba'i phyir/ de ni mi bden pa yin/glo bur gyi 'khrul pa can yin 2gyi/ de ni rang bzhin gyis gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yin pas/ rang bzhin gyis sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin no/ /de lta bu'i ye shes nyid la ni sangs rgyas rnams kyang rab tu 'dud byepar mdzad de/chos kyi sku la sogs pas gtso bor gyur pa'o zhes bya ba'i tshul gyis so/ /de bas na rang 4sems nyid la phyag 'tshal ba yin te/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba ni rtag par rab tu 'dud ces bya ba ste/ 'di ni khyad par du 'phags pa nyid du gsungs pa yin te/ 'dis ni shin tu myur du byang chub ma thob cing bskal pa grangs med pa gsum mam/ mang por karab tu 'dud do zhes bya ba'i don to/ /yang dag par phyag 'tshal ba rnams ni myur ba nyid du byang chub rtogs pas yang phyag 'tshal bar mi byed do zhes bya bar 6dgongs so/ /de nyid kyi dbang du mdzad nas gang yang zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ chos thams cad dmigs pa la rang gi sems ni gnyis su snang ba nub par gyur pa ྅ni bdag med pa ste rgyu nyid kyi spyor ba'o/ /de las yang dag par byung ba ni yang dag par shes pas sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor byung ba ste/ 'bras bu 'di kho na nyid kyi sbyor ba la gnas pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i de kho na nyid dbyer med pa'i ye shes ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te smra bsam las 'das pa'o/ /de las byung ba ni 'di dag ma lus pa 7rdzogs par gyur pa yin pas na/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ /zhes bya ba 9ste/ de'i 'og tu/ sdug dang mi 33—1 178

sdug rnam spangs pa/ /zhes bya ba ste/ sdug pa ni thob par bya ba'i chos rnams so—/ /mi sdug pa ni spang bar bya ba'i chos rnams te de ma lus pa rnam par spangs pa ni thob 1 dang spangs pa mthar thug pa'i bdag nyid thob 3pa'o/ /de ltar gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa gang yin pa de ni ci la yang phyag ni mi 'tshal lo zhes bya ba ste/ bya ba byas pa'i sgrub pa la sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dag par phyag 'tshal ba de nyid gsal bar mdzad cing de nyid la 'jig rten rnams nges par sbyar ba'i phyir/ ma skyes pa ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rang gi shes pa ste/ rang gi sems gnyis su snang ba dang bral ba'i tshul gyis sngar ma skyes pa snyede'i tshul du bskyed la/ skyes par gyur pa'i pha rol te/ /rjes la sangs rgyas kyi rteskur ni zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi rnam par rtag tu zhes bya ba rtag pa nyid kyis bsgom par bya ste/ phyag 'tshal ba de la rang nyid de nyid la rang gi lus dang ngag dang yid kyis zhugs par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de la lus kyis ltarab tu zhugs pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sku las tha dad pa'i rang gi lus mi dmigs pa'o/ /tshig gis rab tu zhugs pa ni sangs rgyas ni bdag go zhes smra'o/ /'di gnyis las gzhan du yid mi g.yeng ba ni sems kyis dzi rab tu 'jug pa'o/ /lus la sogs pa'i rab tu 'jug pa 'di nyid ni de'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyis tsophyag 'tshal ba'i mchog yin te/ myur ba nyid du 8 byang chub sgrub par byed pa yin no zhes bya bar dgongs so/ /'dir yang sangs rgyas kyi sgras byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa rnams kyang gzung /ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdus pa nyid ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa'i tshul gyis rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la bsgom par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /33—1179

rnal 'byor 'di la ni 1'di'i skal ba dang ldan pa ma yin no zhe na/ rnal 'byor pa dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ 'dir rnal 'byor ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes so/ /de nyid ni sngar bshad pa'i tshul gyis rtag tu yod pa yin pas na rnal 'byor pa ste/ sems can thams cad do/ /gal te thams cad rnal 'byor pa yin na/ 'dir skal ba med pa ni 'ga' yang med pas 'khor bar ga la 'khor bar 'gyur zhe na/ de'i phyir nyon mongs zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ ni zhes bya ba'i sgra ni dga' 2ba'i don te/ nyon mongs pa dang bag chags kyis sun phyung bas 'gro ba de dang der 'khor bar gyur pa'o/ /lus can zhes bya ba ni lus thob pa rnams so/ /rgyu gang gis nyon mongs pa dang bag chags kyis lus 'thob ce na/ de'i phyir sdug dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ sdug pa ni gnas dang longs spyod la sogs pa'o/ /mi sdug pa ni de dag gis rnam par 'byed pa'i khyad par la yongs su rtogs pa'o/ /de las ni bag chags te/ de nas yang sbug pa dang mi sdug pa ni 5rnam par 'byed pa'o / /de nas de 6gnyis thob pa dang spang bar 7srid par skye la/ des ni lus 'thob pa yin no/ /dris pa lha'i lus dang ldan pa rnams dga' ba'i tshal la sogs par 'khor ba na/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba tsuni ci zhig yod/ji ltar na 'khor ba yin zhe na/ sdug bsngal zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/'di ni nyon mongs pa dang las las byung ba'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i lus dang longs spyod dang gnas rnams ni/ gang gis spyod pa dang gang la spyod pa dang /gang du spyod pa ste/ de ni lus dang lhan cig 'byung bas rkan lus 'byung ba'o/ /gang sems dang sems las byung ba'i tshogs de nyid ni sdug bsngal lo/ /de skad 33—/ /80

du / gang zhig zag bcas nyer len pa'i/ /phung po de dag thabs bcas kyang / /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'jig rten dang / /lha 1gnas srid pa'ang de dag yin/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yin na go/ 'jig rten rnams sbug bsngal ba 2yin na ji ltar thar bar 'gyur zhe na/ sems de zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ sbug bsngal de gnon cing shes pa'i 'gro ba ni sems kyis so sor rtogs shing yongs su shes par 1brten pa ni rtogs pa yin te/ gdams pa'i rtsa ba yin no/ /de bas na gdams pa po ni 'khor ba las sgrol bar byed pa yin no/ /de su zhig yin zhe na/ rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ thams cad du thogs 4pa med cing shin tu rnam par dag la rtag pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi tshul can yin pas na/ khyab pa rnam par snang mdzad pas na rnam par snang mdzad do/ /rnam pa thams cad du chos kyi longs spyod skyed sapar mdzad pas na rgyal ba'o/ /rnam pa thams cad du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pas na mgon po ste ngo bo nyid dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa'i 6sgu dang rim bzhin du sbyar ro/ /de ltar dang po'i tshig ni bstan pa yin la 'og ma gsum ni bshad pa yin te/ sangs rgyas thams cad ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de7/ de rnams kyi ro gcig pa ni 8bsdus pa zhes bya ste/ de ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi don yin no/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams te/ de nyid sangs rgyas rnams la logs 9shig tu byas nas bshad pa yin te/ 'dis na/ sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs 'gyur ba/ /zhes bya ste/ 'di ni rgyal ba'i don yin no/ /sangs rgyas 'khor ba sgrol ba po/ /zhes bya ba ni mgon po'i don yin no/ /dris pa bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyi 33—/ 18/

don gyi mthar byon pa yin nam/ 'on te gzhan dag kyang sgol bar mdzad pa yin nam/ 'on te ltos par mi mdzad pa yin zhe na/ de'i phyir sems can kun la zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ sems can kun la phan pa de nyid ni don yin te 'dod pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la thugs rje 'byung ba gang yin pa de nyid ni nyams pa ༄)yin te/ rab kyi mthar thug pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de dang yang dag par ldan pa ni rtag tu bcas pa ste/ de bas na btang snyoms med pa yin no zhes bya bar dgongs so/ /gdams pa bstan par bya ba'i 2phyir rgyu'i zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ shin tu myur ba dang shin tu bde bar byang chub sgrub par byed pa'i sbyor ba ni rgyu'i de kho na nyid do/ /de'i mnyam par sbyor ba ni snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /de las gang du zhes bya ba ni bstan pa de'i gong du zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'bras bu'i de nyid ni sangs rgyas kyi sku'o/ /de ston pa ni de'i sbyor ba ston par mdzad pa'o/ /ci bcom ldan 'das de gzhan dag kyang ston par mdzad dam zhe na/ 'bad de zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te / 'bras bu'i de nyid yang dag 3zhugs/ /zhes bya ba ni rgyu dang 'bras bu mi phyed pa'i ye shes la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs pa la yang dag par zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni rgyu'i de kho na nyid mi 'dod de/ bya ba byas pa nyid rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir slar 'dod par mi byed do/ /de bas na thun mtshams su gnyis pa la sogs par ni 'bras bu'i rnal 'byor nyid bya'i/ 1 rgyu'i rnal 'byor ni so sor rab tu sgom 6pa yin la sngar grub pa'i rim gyis 'bras bu'i de kho na nyid la yang dag par zhugs par gyur na/ de nyid gal te yang 'dod par gyur na ci 'gyur zhe na/ gang du zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ gnas skabs gang 33—1182

du 'dod pa skyes par gyur pa de nyid 'khor ba'i bag chags yin zhing dngos grub kyi gegs 21su gyur pa yin te/ slar srid pa'i rgyu yin no zhes bya ba'i don to3sna/ /de bas na 'bras bu'i de kho na nyid la yang dag par zhugs pas ni d+ngha snadangos grub kyi mthar thug pa bstan par bya'o zhes bya bar dgongs te/ 'di ni gdams pa gsungs pa yin no/ /'dir dris pa gal te 'go ba'i don la grogs su spumadzad pa yin na/sa/ de'i tshe des 9nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ⑦sgom pa ci'i phyir ma gsungs she na/ yid la 'dod pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ yid la 'dod pa ni sems can rnams kyi 'dod pa ste des na sgom kyepa sna tshogs pa bcom ldan 'das kyis lkuyongs su rtogs shing khye gsungs pa yin no/ /gang las she na/theg pa de'i nang nas gdams pa gcig skyepa nyid bstan pa ni gang zhig ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ yang zhes bya ba'i sgra ⑫ni khyad par gyi don to/ /bshad ma thag pa'i sgom pa gcig gis rnal 'byor gyi de kho na nyid thams cad dang 'brel par gnas pa gcig po skyede nyid ni rnal 'byor 'byung ba'o/ / des na ྾gdams pa gcig pa nyid sayin no / / 7da ni gtso bo ston te/ de yang rnal 'byor nyid las sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ma lus pa ⑪ 'thob par 'byung ba 'di yin pas na rnal 'byor 'byung ba ste/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'i bsgom pa gang yin pa de las ni sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'thob pa yod pa ma yin no/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo la spyod pa'i sgom pa las ni de 'byung ba yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang rnal 'byor 'di dang 'dra ba ma yin te/ de 15ci'i phyir zhe na/ bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du dka' ba'i spyod pa yongs su 33—1183

rdzogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu po de rnams las 'byung ba yin te gdams pa bstan 1pa'o/ /gdams pa bstan pa bshad pa ni/ sangs rgyas rjes dran zhes bya ba la sogs pa yin te/ rjes su dran pa gnyis kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su dze+egs pa las/ rkang gnyis te 2lha dang mi de rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa yang dag par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur pa'o/ /bha gar liṅga zhes bya ba ni zla ba dang mtshan ma'o/ /rab tu gzhag 4ces bya ba ni legs par bsgom 5pa'o / /sangs rgyas skur zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi skur bsgom pa ste / /bsgom pa 'di nyid ni 6sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa des sangs rgyas sprin zhes bya ba bsnyus nas byon pa'i rgyal ba thams cad rnam par bsgom par bya zhing / mngon par sdogs par byang chub bstan par bya ba'i phyir rang gi snying gar gzhug — par bya'o/ /de nas snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rjer bsam par bya ste/ de yang / sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos kun ni/ /snying ga'i rdo rje rnam par bsam/ /zhes rdo rje rtse mo las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di rgo sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'o / / chos rjes su dran pa bstan pa'i phyir / bha gar liṅga zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te bshad ma thag pa'i tshul du snying ga'i zla bar rdo rje bsam 9pa'o/ /rdo rje chos ni zhes bya ba ni dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi snying po rnams so/ /chos kyi sprin zhes bya ba ni dkyil 'khor 7 rnams kyi'o/ /char rab 'be+ebs zhes bya ba ni snying ga'i rdo rje nyid las rnam par bsgom zhing brjod pa dang spro ba bya ba'o/ /'dir liṅga zhes gang la bya zhe na/mtshan ma liṅga zhes bshad de/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ 'dir mtshan ma nyid la liṅga zhes bshad kyi gzhan dag ni ma yin no/ /mtshan ma de yang ji lta bu zhe 33—/ /8 /

na / phyag rgya'i mtshan ma rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ ting nge 'dzin brtan pa'i khyad par gyi ngo bo nyid du gyur pas phyag rgya nyid la mtshan ma zhes bshad de/ de ni lha'i de kho na nyid ston par byed pa yin pas na phyag rgya'i mtshan ma ste/ de yang dpal rdo rje rtse mo las liṅga'i mtshan ma zhes bshad de/mtshan skyes blo ldan yin par 'dod/ /byang chub sems ni jeg chen po/ /'di ni liṅga zhes byar grags1/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /rnam pa bzhi zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi mtshan ma dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan ma dang / lha mo'i mtshan ma dang / khro bo rnams kyi mtshan 2/ma'o/ /sangs rgyas smon ༄ pa ni nye bar mtshon pa tsam du zad do/ /yang na rnam par dbye bas de rnam dbye'i chodangos su ni 5'di dag thams cad sangs rgyas yin te gzhan du na byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la 'bras bu'i de kho na nyid bsgom 6pa med par 'gyur ro/ /'dir bha ga zhes gang la bya zhe na/ 'joms pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te 'dir 'joms pas na bha ga zhes bya'o/ /de nyid gang zhe na/ nyon mongs 'joms pa dam pa yin/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te / gang nyon mongs pa 'jig cing 'joms pa 7mchog dam pa ste/ de yang rnam par rtog pa'i bye brag rnams ni nyon mongs pa yin la/ de nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis 'joms pa ni dman pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni nyon mongs pa can dang / nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'di thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgrib pa yin pas na nyon mongs pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rnam par rtog pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'o zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de bas 33—/ 185

na nyon mongs pa thams cad 'joms pa'i zag pa med pa'i ye shes gang yin pa de ni 'dir bha ga yin te/ ji skad du dpal rdo rje rtse mo las kyang / gang zhig nyon mongs nges 'joms pa/ /'joms pas bha ga zhes bshad de/ /shes rab nyon mongs de gsod pas/ /de bas shes rab bha gar bshad/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /don 'di nyid kyis na byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid la 'dir bha ga zhes bshad do/ /de'i de kho na nyid ni byang chub kyi sems yin pas de bstan par bya ba'i phyir sems can kun gyi zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rang gi sems ni bha ga yin par sbyar ro/ /ji lta bu'i rang gi sems she na/ chos ni basbus pa yin zhes bya ba gsungs te/ chos rnams ma lus pa 'dzin pa po yin pa ste chos thams cad la dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gzhan yang ji lta bu zhe na/ bsad na zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ gal te zhes bya ba ni lhag ma'o/ /de yang gang rang nyid shi ba ni bsad pa'o/ /bsad pa de ci zhig yin zhe na/ sems can kun gyi dngos po kun/ /zhes bya ba 7ste/ lus dang gnas dang longs spyod dang sems dang sems las byung bar chos kyi bsdu bas bsdus pa'o/ /ci byeltar bsad ce na/chos bdag med pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ chos thams cad mi bden par yongs su brtags pa'i dmigs pas gnyis su gzung ba'i ngo bo'i bye brag tu snang ba nub par gyur pas/ gnyis su med pa'i rnam par shes pa tsam gyi tshul gyis snang ba'i bdag nyid can sdig pa med cing ro mnyam par gyur pa ni chos bdag med pa ste/ rnal 'byor de la rang gi sems mnyam par gzhag kyipa ste / de bsad na rang nyid 'chi bar 'gyur te/ rang nyid kyis kyang lus 33—sde186

dang gnas dang longs spyod la sogs pa gnyis su snang ba'i ngo bo nyid nub pa'i phyir gnyis su med pa yang rang snang ba'i bdag nyid can dang / sems can thams cad kyi snang ba'i bdag nyid can ro gcig pa nyid yin te/ 'dir yang chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid dang / sems can thams cad kyi bdag nyid mnyam pa nyid gang gi tshe mi dmigs par gyur pa'i ye shes des rim pa bzhin du mi dmigs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje dang / 'di dag gnyis ka'i mtshan nyid can byang chub kyi sems ni shes rab kyi ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par rtog pa'i sa bon 'byen par byed pa yin pas na/ nyon mongs pa 'joms par byed pa yin te/de ni bha ga'i de kho na nyid do/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs ltar na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te de ni 'dir phyag rgyar 2byas pa yin no/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid dang / sems can thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid dang 27/dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa yin pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor de'i don te/ dmigs pa'i ye shes kyi tshul yang dag pa'i snang ba'i rang bzhin yin pa'i don yin no/ /liṅga'i phyag rgya'i gzugs kyang mtshan ma rnam pa bzhi yin par gsungs la/ de'i de kho na nyid ni mdor na byang chub kyi spyod pa ma lus pa'i rjes su 'gro ba yin pas/ byang chub kyi sems brtan par gyur pa yin te/de bstan pa ni rang gi sems nyid ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rang gi sems nyid sdogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes bya ba ni byang chub kyi sems nyid kyis shes bya thams cad yang dag par rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de nyid rtogs par bya ba yang —yin te/ de nyid kyis shes bya thams cad bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsad bya ba zhes bya ba ni gsad 5pa dang 'gog pa dang mya ngan las 33—1187

—'das pa dang spangs pa zhes bya ba ni rnam grangs yin no/ /rang gi sems nyid gzung ste sgrib pa'i sa bon thams cad dgag pa yin gyi/ thams cad du chad pa ni ma yin no/ /sems nyid ni byang chub kyi sems zhes bya bar bshad de sgrib pa rnams nges par 'gog par byed do/ /de lta bu'i ye shes dang spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyis na 'tshang rgya ba 'di byang chub kyi sems nyid yin no/ /de ltar spyod pa yongs su bsdus pa ni liṅga'i de kho na nyid do/ /de ltar rjes su dran pa gnyis kyis bha ga dang liṅga bshad pa yin te lhag ma ni go sla'o/ /de la sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu spyor ba mdor bsdus nas bstan pa yin la/ de byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa'i rdo rje dang zla ba nyid kyi tshorim gyis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ni rnam pa lnga ste/ zla ba la zla ba dang /rdo rje la rdo rje dang sku ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dang rnam pa lnga'o/ /bsgom pa 'di dang ci 'dod nga/ra bzlas pa'i rang bzhin 2grub pa'i sngags lnga po dpal de kho na nyid basbus pa dang rdo rje rtse mo dang zla gsang thig le dang gsang ba'i mdzod las rgya cher gsungs pa yin no/ /bsgom pa'i 'bras bu yang zla gsang thig le dang gsang ba'i mdzod dag las gsungs pas de brjod par bya ste/ de nas bsam gtan gyi phyag rgyas gnas la/ chos thams cad bdag med pa'i mnyam pa nyid bsam par bya/ phyi dang nang du bcas pa 'di dag thams cad ni sems dang sems las byung ba yin gyi/ sems dang sems las byung ba las tha dad pa gzhan dag yod pa ma yin no zhes yid la nges par bsams la chos thams cad ni gdod ma nas ma skyes pa nyid 4yin pa'i phyir/ skye ba med cing rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyid yin no zhes yid la brjod do/ /chos thams cad bdag med 33—1 188

pa nyid kyis na gnyis su med cing stong pa nyid kyi mnyam pa nyid du de bsam par bya'o / /ji ltar bsam par bya zhe na/ chos thams cad la dmigs pa'i sems brtan par byas dzol/ de rnams kyi gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam pas basbus pa'i bye brag tha dad pa bsal nas gnyis su med pa'i stong pa nyid du snang ba'i bdag nyid can sdig pa med par mthong ba 'di ni de rnams kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mthong ba yin te/ de la dmigs pa ni mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i ngo bo nyid de/ 'di'i rab tu spyor ba ni yang dag pa nyid la rab tu blta ba'o1/ /de'i ngo bo nyid ni phyin ci ma log pa nyid du nges pa yin pas de bstan pa ni thams cad ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa yin te/'di ni zhes bya ba'i 4ting nge 'dzin gye dmigs pa'i phyi dang nang gi dmigs pa'o/ /thams cad ces bya ba ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pa nyid kyis so sor snang zhing sems kyis brtags pa rnams so/ /de ltar na gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gnyis po 'di dag ni yang dag pa ma yin par kun du brtags pa ste/ yang dag pa ma yin pa kun du brtags pa'i sems nyid ni kun du brtags pa dang / gzhan dbang dag bstan par gyur pa las/ yang dag par so sor rtog 5pa mthong ba ni go rims bzhin du med pa dang / med bzhin du snang ba nyid kyis na 6yongs su grub pa'i ngo bo nyid gnyis su med pa'i stong pa rnam par shes pa tsam nyid de/de'i yang dag par so sor rtog par bstan pa'i phyir/ dngos po med pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ sems ni rnam par shes pa ste de las tha dad cing lhag pa'i gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gzhan dag yod pa ma yin te/ gnyis pos stong pa'i rnam par shes pa ni don dam pa yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de 33—/ /89

ltar yid kyis brjod ces bya ba nges par byas nas so/ /gang gis she na/yid kyis te yid kyis brjod nas de'i 'og tu bsam par bya'o zhes snga ma dang —1 sbyar ro/ /mnyam pa nyid du mthong ba'i rjes la mnyam pa nyid du nges par bya bar bstan pa ni/ skye ba med pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa yin te/ chos thams cad gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis skye ba med pa nyid yin no/ /de byu lam gyis 4 yongs su sbyangs pas skye ba med pa yin nam zhe na/ de ma yin pa'i phyir gzod thu7nas skye ba med pa zhes bya ba gsungs te/ gnyis po ni rtag tu mnyam pa nyid yin pas na ngo bo nyid des gdod ma nyid nas skye ba med pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba zhes pa 6ni rang bzhin gyis de kho na nyid ces bshad cing dri ma med ces bshad pas/ gnyis su rtog pa'i dri ma rnams ni rtsa ba mi brtan 3pa nyid yin pas na glo bur du 'ongs pa yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nas oṃ tsit+ta pra ti bi t+t+waṃ ka ro mi zhes phra bar bzlas pas dang por zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du blta'o/ /de'i de kho na nyid ni kun nas nyon mongs pa'i sa bon gyi gzhir gyur pa nyid kyis na/ sngar kun gzhi zhes bshad pa'i sems de'i de yongs su zad pas zag pa med pa'i chos kyi sa bon gyi gzhir gyur pa rteganas yongs su gyur pa zag pa med pa'i dbyings gnas med pa bshad pa ⑩shin tu rnam par dag pa ste/ dag pa de nyid ni zla ba'i don yin no/ /tshogs yongs su rdzogs pas sangs —1rgyas pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad a la sogs pa'i gzugs zla ba dang shel lta bur dkar ba'i tshul gyis 'dir rab tu zhugs te/a ā i yī u spru ṛ dzā mu'-i shā e i o au saṃ aḥ/ de'i steng du oṃ bo bye tsit+ta ut+pā da yā 1 mi zhes phra bar bzlas la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis par bsgom par 33—1 190

bya'o / /'dir yang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams ka la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du zhugs kyete/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ṭa ṭha ḍa bhā ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/'di'i de kho na nyid ni bha ga zhes bshad pa byang chub kyi sems kun du bzang po'i sems bskyed pa'o/ /de'i steng du tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes phra bar bzlas pa las bdag nyid rdo rje dkar po 'od zer dang bcas par bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i de kho na nyid ni byang chub kyi spyod pa bsdus pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan par gyur pa'o / /de'i 'og tu oṃ badz+ra ā — byekolhahaṃ/ zhes phra bar bzlas nas rdo rje de nyid las rdo rje dbyings rnams kyis nam mkha' khyab par spro ba dang bsdu ba bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i de kho na nyid ni chos kyi sku 'thob pa'o/ /de'i 'og tu oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta ta thā a haṃ/ zhes phra bar bzlas pas zla ba gnyis dang rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las / rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa sangs rgyas kyi skur bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i de kho na nyid thurnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'thob pa yin no/ /de yang rdo rje rtse mo las/sku yi gsang ba de bzhin spyod/ /spyod yul thugs su chud pa ste/ /lnga po de dag kun gyi spyi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam bdag nyid/ /mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /ces gsungs pa dang /dpal mchog dang po las kyang / de bzhin du mngon par byang chub pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rang sems so sor rtog ④pa las/ byang chub sems mchog rdo rje nyid/ /de nyid de yi sangs rgyas nyid/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas bsgom sapas so /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar na dang po'i rnam pa bzhi ni rgyu'i de kho na nyid 33—1191

la lnga po rteni 'bras bu'i de kho na nyid yin no/ /dris pa/ 'bras bu ni rgyu la rag las pa yin pas na rgyu'i spyor ba nyid bya'i 'bras bu'i sbyor bas ci zhig bya zhe na / de'i phyir spyor dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ sbyor ba nyid ni sangs rgyas kyi rnal 'byor du gyur pa nyid de/ de dang gang yang dag par 'brel pa med par ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud nalas kyang dngos po 'byung bar ma gsungs te/de yang 'di las byung bas na srid pa ste — ༷rgyu'o/ /dngos po de nyid du 'byung bas na/ srid pa gang du 'byung 'gyur ba/ /zhes bya'o/ /la las ni/ srid pa ru ni 'byung 'gyur ba/ /zhes zer te gnyis ka yang rnal 'byor rgyud gang du yang rgyu'i sbyor ba 'ba' zhig las 'byung cho ba ma yin zhes ston to zhes bya ba'i don to / /'o na ji ltar 'byung zhe na/ gang tshe zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te / gang gi tshe sangs rgyas su gyur par sgom shepa'i bsgom bzhin pa la bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi tshul dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ sangs rgyas bdag ces bya ba ste/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas yin no zhes bstan pa'i nges pa bsgom pa ste/ de'i tshe ni spyor ldan zhes pa rnal 'byor pa sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don te/ de'i tshe rnal 'byor des byang chub sgrub pa nyid yin no zhes bya bar dgongs te/ de yang sangs rgyas nyid sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ni sangs rgyas 6rnal 'byor te/ gang yang rgyu'i rnal 'byor nyid kyis 'tshang rgya ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul dang bya ba'i rgyud la sogs pa las bshad pa ste/ de ni dus shin tu ring bas 7'byung ba yin no/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams su ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sbyor ba la sogs pas theg pa chen bo mtha' dag bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir shin tu myur ba nyid du byang chub thob pa yin no/ /de bas na ting nge 33—1 192

'dzin zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa yin tedzo// mdor basbus pa zhes bya ba dus mdor bsdus pas 'tshang rgya ba gang yin pa de ni ting nge 'dzin ye shes las byung ba zhes bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin ni mngon par byang chub pa lnga'i ting nge 'dze+en to / /ye shes ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te de gnyis las 'di yang dag par byung zhing skyes pa yin pas de skad ces bya'o/ /phyir zhes bya ba ni gang gi phyir te de'i phyir ro zhes shes par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor zhes bya ba la sogs pas ni nye bar bsdus snyepa yin te/ gang 'di dpal de kho na nyid bsdus pa las/rdo rje sems dpa'i 5ting nge 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos nyid yin/ /'di ni sangs rgyas sangs rgyas nyid/ /gzhan du sangs rgyas 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de'i don gang yin zhe na/ don 'di yin te mngon par byang chub pa rnam pa lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim gyis ting nge 'dzin gsum bsgoms la phyis rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin kyis yun ring du gnas par bya ste/ rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i rdo rje la sems mnyam par gzhag 4nas/ji srid 'dod kyi bar du gnas par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sbyor ba bstan pa'o / /༄zhe'abras bu'i sbyor ba la yang dag par zhugs pa zhes sgogasungs pa de la yang dag par zhugs pa ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang /ngo bo nyid kyi ye shes so/ /de las gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bstan par bya ba'i phyir phra mo'i zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa yin te/ rang gi sems nyid chos thams cad dmigs pa na spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad nub par gyur pas gnyis su med par snang ba'i bdag nyid kyis/ sems can thams cad kyi sems dang sems las byung ba ro gcig par gyur pa gang yin pa de/ dag pa'i 33—/ 193

bdag nyid gang gis ji lta ba bzhin du mthong ba ni dang po mthong ba lkuste/ de'i 'og tu rang gi sems de stug par gyur pa ste zla ba dang rdo rje dang sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i dngos po ji lta ba bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyang gang las she na/dngos dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ gang gi phyir dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i khyad par du bsgom pa de la chos thams cad la dmigs pa'i phra bar gyur pa ni dngos po med pa'i khyad par ro/ /phra bar gyur pa de'i 'og tu stug por gyur pa ni dngos po'i khyad par te de lta bu'i dngos po dang / dngos po med pa'i khyad par sgom pa kun du brtags pa yin zhes bya ba ste/ rnal 'byor kyi rgyud rnams su bsgom pa ༄ rnam par gzhag pa yin no/ /de dag kyang gang las she na/ dngos po zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ dngos po 'ba' zhig ni bsgom pa ma yin te/ rnam pa bzhi po la sangs rgyas kyi sku skyes pa yin du zin kyang / rang bzhin gyi sku las shin tu dman pa yin pa'i phyir dngos po med pa ni phra ba'i dngos po ste/ sgom pa de yang bsgom pa ma yin te bsgoms kyang bsgom 5pa ma yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ /ji ltar sgom 'upa yin zhe na/des don dam pa thumathong ba'i phyir ro/ /ji ltar bsgom pa ma yin zhe na/mngon par byang chub pa lnga bsgoms pa'i 'og tu shin tu myur bar byang chub 8 'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas ci zhig ce na/ bsgom pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ phra ba'i dngos po bsgoms ( pas ni don dam pa mthong ba'i phyir ro / /de nas de'i 'og tu zla ba dang rdo rje la sogs pa'i dngos po sgom 0pa ste/dngos po de nyurtabasgoms pas rang gi sems yongs su sbyang ba ste/ yongs su dag pa'i las dag pa'i gnas skabs so/ /de bas na murgyu dang 'bras bu ni rang gi 33—1194

sems nyid las gzhan nyum yin no zhes nges par byas pa gang yin pa de ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes so/ /gal te rgyu dang 'bras bu rang gi sems nyid yin na / de'i tshe de nyid ni de'i rig pa yin pas rnal 'byor pa de sangs rgyas par mi 'gyur te/ de thams cad mkhyen na bdag nyid dang gdul bya rnams kyi sems kyi spyod pa mi shes pas ji ltar sangs rgyas pa yin zhe na/ de'i phyir sangs rgyas zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ sangs rgyas te thams cad mkhyen pa ni yul ma yin zhing gzung bar bya ba ma yin pas na sangs rgyas kyi yul lo/ /sems can ni gdul bya rnams te de rnams ni gzung bar bya ba ma yin pas de skad ces bya'o—/ /gal te de ④gzung bar gyur na ni de'i tshe de la gnyis kyi rtog pa yod nga sa 'khrul bar 'gyur 1gyi 'tshang rgya bar ni mi 'gyur ro/ /'o na ji ltar sangs rgyas par 'gyur zhe na/ rang gi rī sems rtogs pas zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rang gi sems nyid kyi chos thams cad ro gcig par jertogs pas rang rig pa tsam gyi 'khrul pa dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas te zhes bya ba ni byang chub cing thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /nye bar bsdu ba'i phyir gnyis med sbyor ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la mnyam par gzhag ⑨pa'i ni gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /ting nge 'dzin be+e 'bras bu'i sbyor ba'o/ /de'i ye shes ni yongs su shes pa ste/ de kho na nyid nges par brtag pa'o/ /de'i don brtag pa ni bskyed pa'o/ /rgyu'i de nyid ji ltar zhes bya ba ni yongs su dag pa'i sems kyi ngo bo nyid mthong ba gang yin pa'o/ /de nyid yin zhes bya ba ni mthong ba zhes bya ba dang sbyar ro/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bstan pa'o / /④ ngo bo nyid kyi ye shes bstan par bya ba'i 7phyir/ rgyu'i 33—1195
