a pā ya tūbarnya na ⑤mo tsa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a pā ya ga ti bha ga wān bi nā —sha ni hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod la nang du byon pa dang / gnyis su med par bya ba dang /bcing ba dang mnyes par byas nas mchod pa la sogs pa 3bya'o/ /de nas mtshan trem skyes te zhes bya ba ni 'od zer dang / /mi las 'das pa'i dri la sogs pa mthong nas so/ /mgu nas ni zhes bya ba ni/ bdag gis 3nges par slob ma smin par byed nus so zhes bsams te yid spro ba byas nas so/ /thog ma tha ma med par zhes bya ba ni/ dang po dang bar ma dang tha mar bye brag med par ro/ /mngon sum mthong zhes bya ba ni/ dbang po'i mngon sum dang 'dra bar lha rnams gsal bar bltas te/ sems rtse gcig tu bya (snazhes bya ba'i don to / /slob dpon kha cig na re/ thog ma bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa nas/ tha ma hūṃshin tu phyi rol gyi lha rnams kyi bar du byon pa'i tshe bye brag med par mthong bar 'gyur te/ 'di nyid mtshan ma skyes zhes bya ba yin la/ de ltar mthong bas mgu nas ni mchod pa bya ba ste/ de ltar yang lha chen po dgu'i dkyil 'khor las/ de nas byon pa mthong ba dang / /dga' ba chen pos mchod par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar sngon 1 bzhin du phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab ste mchod pa bya'o/ /'dis nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 15la 'og min nas spyan drang ba bstem zhing / des kyebris pa la thim par bya ba ni man ngag go/ /da ni mchod pa ston par bzhed nas ar+ghaṃ ( mchog phul zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ 'dir mchod yon gyi mtshan nyid 'phags pa rab tu grub par byed pa las gsungs pa/ gser dang dngul dang zangs ma dang / /rdo ba dang ni shing gi 'am/ /kham sa'am yodung ngam nya phyis sam/ /de bzhin lo ma'i snod 33—1571

kyang rung / /zhi dang rgyas dang drag spyod dang / /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma yikye//las dang dngos grub dag la ni/ /rigs pa'i snod rnams sbyar bar bya/ /kha dog yon tan bshad pa las/ /gzhan dang gzhan yang ci rigs pa'i/ /snod rnams ji ltar 'dod pa ru/ /mchod yon phyir ni rab tu sbyar/ /zhi ba'i mchod yon nas dang bcas/ /til dang bcas pa rgyas pa la/ /thams cad dang ni 'gal ba'i phyir/ /ko tra bar bcas drag spyod la/ /zhi ba'i mchod yon 'o ma can/ /rgyas pa la ni zho can no/ /ba yi gcin nam yang na khrag /drag shul spyod pa'i don du shis/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma dang / /las rnams kun la 'bras yos shis/ /spos dang me tog ku sha til/ /chu rnams bye brag rnged par bshad/ /zangs kyi snod ni mchod yon phyir/ /las rnamayokun la rab tu shis/ /'di dag bdag gis ma 'byor gyis/ /bdag la bzod par mdzod ces nas/ /yang na ci 'byor pas kyang rung / /zhes pa las zhi ba la bsngags 2pa'i mchod yon ni/ 'dir ar+ghaṃ lkumachog ste de phul bas mchod pa lhag ma rnams bya/ glegs bam la la las ar+ghaṃ ngamachog brtags zhes bye'adon te/de yang snga ma lta bu zhi ba'i mchod yon ni mchog tu brtag bye par bya ba'am rung ba zhes bya ba'o3/ /gsang ba —la sogs pa zhes bya ba la/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni sgeg mo la sogs pa bzhi ste/ 'di dag gi shesnying po'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba mchod par bya ba'i phyi rol gyi lha rnams ma yin pas so/ /sogs zhes bya ba ni rdo rje me tog la sogs pa bzhi bsdu ba'o rngu/ /de ltar mchod pa gus 1— mchod nas/ /mnyam med mi g.yo zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod pa'i phyir/dbyangs kyis shā5snyan pa'i bstod rmyepa dang / /zhes bya ba smos te/ rol mo'i cha 33—1572

byad dam pa dang sbyar ba drug ldan la sogs pa'i ros bstod (par bya ste/ ji skad du zla ba gsang ba'i thig le'i rgyud las/ pi wang gling bu ya mtshan sgra snyan gyi rte //glu blangs dngos grub rgya chen thob rngupar byed/ /ji snyed yid du 'ong ba'i glu dag ni / /'jig rten grags pa'i bden pa'i bde ba dag /bden pa'i sgra yis bskyed pa rnams bsgyur ba/ /de dag mthun pa'i dbyangs 'dis sgrub par byed/ /sha ta pa dang sha dza' dbyangs/ /glu ru blangs pas pad+mo saganas/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ / yid kyis byin rlabs 'udag pa dang / /'di yis byin rlabs skubade ba rnams/ /sbyor ba 'di yi spyor ba yis/ /'dod byed thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas/ lha yi gtso bo thams cad la/ /ras ni zung re dbul bar bya/ /sems dpa' chen po phal rnams la/ /ya re phul bar rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes gsungs pa'am/ yang na lha thams cad la ras zung 'u 'bul ba'am/ ma 'byor na re re 'am/ de yang ma 'byor na thams cad la zung gcig gam/ rab tu 'byor pa dman na thams cad la gcig dang / 'byor pa yod na ba lang dang rta dang / rnga mo dang ra byelug la sogs pa'i khyu rab tu brtags pa dang / rin po che'i tshogs dang / bza' ba dang bca' ba dang / bldag pa dang / btung ba gya nom pa mang po dang / dril bu g.yer ka btags pa'i rta babs rngo dri zhim po dang /rin po che bdun dang / nye ba'i rin po che bdun dang / bkra shis kyi rdzas bcu drug dag kyang rab tu yid du 'thad pa 'bul bar ston pa ni/ lha rdzas dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces gsungs pa'o/ /de la mchod pa'i cho ga ni bya ba'i rgyud kyi dbang du mdzad de/ 'phags pa rab tu grub par byed pa 33—13 73

las / thal sbyar mchod yon blos mchod dang / /cho ga'i yan lag nyid dang bzhi / /ji ltar rigs pa nye bar sbyar/ /zhes gsungs la/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang du mdzad 1 de/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa las/mchod pa rnam bzhir shes bya ste/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi thal sbyar dang / /de bzhin byams dang snying rje dang / /me tog bdug spos 'jig rten pa'i/ /sor mo las byung me tog rnams/ /skyob pa kun la dbul bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so//rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dag tu ni/ mchod pa rab tu mang po dag mibastan te/ lha mo ku ru kul+le 'byung ba las ni/ me tog la sogs pa mchod pa bco brgyad gsungs so/ /'phags pa de kho na nyid 'dus par nirngu / mchod pa phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang rab tu gsang ba rnams bstan te/ de bas na mchod pa rnams ni sgrub pa po'i bsam pa'i dbang gis rab tu mang mod kyi/ 'dir thu ni mchod pa dgu yan chad dang bcas pa'o/ /de yang ji skad snyebashad pa'i yon chab thogs te/ e bye hi bha ga wān thuni ha waste na sa ya me tsa ma ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha kyesaṃ pū dza nir dza byu pra sid+dhi 3me/ ā ha ra ā peha ra sarba bir+ya dha ra pū dze te swā hā zhes bya ba'am/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ⑫āḥhūṃ zhes pas dbul lo/ /mchod yon ni sgrub pa po'i spyi bor bzung ste dbul lo/ /me tog la sogs pa yang snying ga'am lte ba'i thad kar bzung ste dbul lo/ /de yang dang po phyag bzhi byas la/ de nas mchod yon dbul te/ de nas bdug pa dang me tog dang mar me dang dri rnams sarba dharma swa bhā wa shudha zhes bya ba rab tu dag par mos par byas la/ rab tu mang zhing mchog tu bya ba dang / ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin du 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ sarba a pā shā3 ya bi sho dha ni dharma tā dhū pa ya de kyehūṃ 33—1574

phaṭa—/ oṃ sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni pube+e bi lo ka ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a pā tsho ya bi sho dha ni dz+nyā nā lo ka ka ri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a pā ya ga ti garnya ā sha ni garnya ba pya ti hūṃ phaṭa ces phyebya ba rnams snyim pa byed pa las gyen du 'thor ba dang /de nyid las mthe 'ubong gnyis gyen du bsnyams 3༄nas mdun du 'dzin pa dang /de nyid las dung dang 'dra bar byas pa'i phyag rgya rnams bcings te phul bas/rab tu rgyas par tshim par bsam mo/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa bya ste/rang gi dam tshig sems dpa'i rnal 'byor du rab tu gsal bar byas la/ rdo rje'i gar gyi nubya ba rdo rje'i khu tshur gnyis dku g.yas g.yon gnyis su sgeg pa'i tshul gyis bzhag la/ byang chub kyi sems yid la byed cing de la rab tu dga' bas spyi bos g.yon du cung zad btud de/ oṃ badz+ra lā gye/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su sasgra hakhye/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta ⑩ram̐/ oṃ shā1badz+ra dharma gā /—2ya ne+e/ oṃ thubadz+ra karma ka rodzha be zhes glur blang ngo / /de nas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis bdag nyid kyi ⑩spyi bor phreng ba 'dzin pa'i tshul du byas la/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bdag dang sems can thams cad la 'byung bar smon pas/ /oṃ badz+ra mā le zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod do/ /de nas 'gro ba thams cad la mdo sde zab mo la sogs pa bshad pa 'byung ba yid la smon pas/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rang gi kha nas tshig 'thon pa ltar byas te/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod do/ /de nas yang rdo rje gar gyi tshul gyis ⑩thal mo spyi bor sbyar te/ 'gro ba la nges pa'i tshig tu chos ston pa dang / spyod lam sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don la mkhas par gyur cig ces smos 7pas/ oṃ badz+ra 1 ti 7zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod par bya'o/ /yang na de dag gi phyag rgya bstan pas de dag nyid kyis de dag nyid 33—1575

—la rang rang gi mchod par 1mos par bya'o/ /yang na dang po yon chab phul la/de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa brjod de/ gsang ba'i mchod pa de dag gi yon tan yang / 'phags pa de kho na nyid bsdus pa las/ rdo rje 'jo ma snye byas nas kyang / /rdo rje phreng ba 'ching byed byung / /de nas rdo rje glur blangs la/ /rdo rje gar gyis mchod byas nas/ /'dod pa'i dga' ba dbang bskur mchod/ /glu dang gar gyi bde ba las/ /bde ba gzhan ni yod min te/ /de phyir gsang mchod 'di bla med/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de nas bdug pa la sogs pas mchod pa yang rung ngo / /de nas oṃ badz+ra ba ṭa hūṃ zhes brjod pas ras phul la snyim pa mdzes pa rab tu brkyang ba'i phyag rgyas bshos rnams/ oṃ a kā ro zhes bya ba la sogs pas dbul lo/ /sngar bshad pa'i yon chab ni rdo rje thal mo brkyang ba las gung mo gnyis nang du bcug pas dbul lo/ /oṃ sarba bid pu gar pu ra a brta ya ho zhes 'don cing nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcings la rta babs la sogs pa dbul lo/ /gal te mchod pa rnams dngos su ma 'byor na/de'i tshe mchod pa'i gzugs brnyan rnams gro ga la sogs pa la bris te/ dngos yin par lhag par mos par mchod yon tsam du dbul lo/ /de ltar ni 'phags pa rab tu grub par byed pa las/ che ge mo 'di bzhes shig ces/ /rdzas kyi ming nas phyung ste dbul4/ /ma 'byor na yang gzugs brnyan rnams/ /byas nas mchod yon dbul bar bya/ /sngags dang mchod pa phul ba yi/ /cho ga thams cad tshogs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du mchod pa ji ltar 'byor pa tsam yid kyis 5mchod pa dang bcas nas mchod pa yang de nyid 6las/ rnam pa kun la mkhas pa yis3/ /rtag tu ci 'byor pas kyang 33—1576

rung / /yid kyi mchod pa khyad par can/ /yang dag nyid du brtsam par bya/ /chos kyi thog mar yid 'gro zhes/ /thub pa chen pos bka' sprul to/ /yid ni rab tu mnyam gzhag nas/ /cho ga lhag ma bya bar bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing / mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dag pa'i chos nyid can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub nges par sprul mdzad pa/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa'i thugs rje'i 2tshoshugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'go ba'i don sgrub phyarab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pas / /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu snye rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral bar shin tu yongs rdzogs pa'i / /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes 'gyur 5dang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yod 'umi 'gyur/ /e ma'o shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang na go 'phang )mchog brnyes pa/ /khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pa/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la sprul/ /zhes glus bstod cing / nus na 'phags pa de kho na nyid 'dus pa'i rtsa ba dang / phyi ma raphyi ma'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rje btsun 33—1577

rnam par snang mdzad kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dbyangs su blangs pas bstod cing mnyes par bya/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje yin na/ rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod do/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa brjod do/ /sgrub 1pa'i grogs mchog dkyil 'khor du bzhag la/ phyi rol du gtor ma rab tu rgyas pa 'chad par byed pas sbyin no/ /de nas nang du 'ongs pa bdag nyid 'jug pa bstan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje 'dzin ma ༄ zhugs nas ni//me tog thogs te sgo phyogs 'dug /ces gsungs pa yang 'dir drangs te/sems dpa' rdo rje ma'i phyag rgyas me tog gi kyephreng ba bzung ④bar bya ba mdun du bzhag la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta pra ṇa 3 me na badz+ra ban+da rgo 4 ka ro mi zhes brjod cing / dkyil 'khor la yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyag lan gsum byas la phreng ba de blangs te/ dkyil 'khor la ④lan bdun bskor bas/yang phyag snga ma ltar byas la/ me tog de bdag po la phul te blangs la rang gi spyi bor gdags so/ /de nas puste'i phyag rgya dang a zhes pa stong gis bdag gam gzhan la phab la/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed bye—pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /pho brang dkyil 'khor snying po 'dir/ /bdag gis (slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /zhes bka' mnos nas/ bdag dang gzhan des smin par mdzad par bsams la/ slob dpon du bdag por gyur pa las/ sdom pa dang dbang ma lus pa blo yis blangs te/ de nas/ chags 3chen las byung de kho na/ /'khor lo'ang gzugs brnyan dag dang ⑪mtshungs/ /oṃ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyu rab grub mdzod/ /kun mchog 33—1578

dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa'ang khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyis 3rjes su mnyes3sna/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa — kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol hūṃ ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug che sogs phyag rgya yis/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pas/ rdo rje snyems sa bdag bdag mdzod cig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing / /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi pha yin te/ /chags pa'i mchog ste dam tshig mchog /thabs shes bdag nyid dkyil 'khor te/ /ye shes yin pa'i bden gang gis/ /bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor kun/ /gzugs brnyan gsal ba'i slob ma yis/ /spyon dang bral bar kun mthong shog /ces bya ba rnams kyi 3de kho na nyid bden pa dang /dam tshig gsum gyi glu dang / yang de kho na dang bden pa bsgrags 3so/ /gal te zhag du mar dkyil 'khor kyi las byed pa'i tshe na/ gnas skabs der dge 'dun la mchod ston gsol ba dang / chos smra bar 8mchod par bya ste/ ji skad du rnam par snang mdzad mngon par sdogs par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/slob ma de bos bsgo ba ni/ / 'di ni /bsod nams zhing yin zhes/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /skyob skrupa rnams ni kun gyis 4gsungs/ /rnam dag yon tan rgyas pa yi/ /dge 'dun la ni kun gyis kiphul/ /dge 'dun la phul 'bras bu che/ /skyes bu mkhas pa gang zhig gis/ /dge 'dun la ni yon 33—1579

phul na/ /longs spyod chen po mi zad 3pa/ /'jig rten 'thad par skye bar 'gyur / /de bas thams cad mthun par ni/ /sems la dga' ba bskyed nas su/ /sangs rgyas bsngags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /ci nus pas ni mchod ston bya/ /zhes gsungs la bya ba'i rgyud gzhan dag las kyang / /de nas bla ma'i 5ci 'byor pas/ /'phags pa dge 'dun mchod ston gsol/ /yang na slob ma byed du gzhug /gal te mi 'byor par gyur na/ /dge 'dun gyis phyeni bskos pa yin/ /dge slong dag la mchod ston gsol/ /yang na sangs rgyas mchod pa'am/ /dge 'dun dag la yon yang dbul/ /zhes gsungs sokhye// /phyogs bzhir chos klog bzhi bzhag nas/ /de la shar gyi phyogs su ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa gzhag7 /byang gi phyogs su gzhag she pa ni/ /gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde yin/ /nub kyi phyogs su gzhag pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i mdo/ /jeg pa chen po sdong po byebakod/ /lho yi phyogs su bzhag nas su/ /gus par de dag mchod par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ gal te dkyil 'khor gyi las kyi dus tha ma zhag gsum du byed na de dag 'jug pa'i nyi ma snga dro bya'o/ /yang na chos bsgrags pas bsrung ba rmyeni/ phyi'i sa sbyang ba nas bzung ste/ dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i bar du bya'o/ /de nas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar slob ma gzhug 1par bya'o/ /de ltar slob dpon 7dkyil 'khor bsgrub par byas nas gtor ma sbyin pa'i phyir/ de nas shā5 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma bya/ /sems can bkres shing skom la gdung rkeb dang / /phyogs la gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag /de yi gtor ma rjes su mthun par bya/ /zhes smos te/ de yang dang po ni bza' ba dang btung ba mang pos mi'i 'gro ba 33—/580

ji ltar nus pa tshim par bya ste/ khyad par du ni khye'u dang bu mo gzhon nu 'khrig pa bsten mi nus pa rnams tshim par bya'o/ /de nas 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma la sogs pa bya ste/ gtor ma'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ da ni gtor ma rgyas pa'i cho ga bdag gis 'dir brjod par bya ste/ ji skad du bshad pa'i gtor ma shing rta gang la'ang nyung zad kyang rung ste/ ji ltar 'byor pa phyi 1sna rol du khyer la 37bsgrub pa'i grogs mchog dkyil 'khor du gzhag ste/ slob dpon bdag nyid kyis sbyin no/ /dang por sgrub 4pa pos 'phags pa bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags lan bdun gyis bsrungs techo/ de nas gtor ma der mar me dang me tog dang /bdug pa dang byug pa dang bshos rnams btsal 6la lag tu spos thogs te/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs la/ yid don la bsdus te tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod do/ /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzangs lus srul dzapo/ /dri za sri na po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas rnams la/ /bdag ni pus mo sa la btsugs nas su/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyis/ /gsan nas phan gdags phyir ni 'dir spyon cig /'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyem rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu yi 9mdo rnams dang / /rin chen gnas na lhag pa 7gang gnas dang / /mtsho dang rjeng dang lteng ༅ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu gsel ma can na gang gnas dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang / /khang stong dang ni lha yi khang pa 33—/581

dang / /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas dag dang kye/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen byes dang ni/ /rgyal po'i thudakor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang mdun khang dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan ༄ —gnas dag dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog rnams la gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes shing go bar gyur nas su/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus phul ba/ /'di dag bzhes te btung zhing bsnams su gsol/ /las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces brjod la gtor te/ de phyogs kyi gtor ma bya'o/ /de yang / de ltar gdon la mchod pa byas nas su/ /de dag phyogs skyong rnams la mchod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /snga ma ltar pus mo btsugs ④te/ spos snod thogs la/dbang po 'byung po'i gdon dang bcas pa yis/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje srin po chu bdag dang / /rlung dang lus ngan 'byung po gdon dang bcas/ /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang / /ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams la//rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang / /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang / /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs cig tu/ /me tog dri dang byug pa gtor ma bcas / /'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang / bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces pas so/ /de nas bstod pa yang 33—1582

bya ste/ /dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg lkubya za ba'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /phyogs mtshams gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gshin rje be+e con thogs pa'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /bdag gis /—gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /sna tshogs gdon kyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /bden pa bsrung ba gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon dang bcas pa la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /tshig srung gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /rlung gi gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod pa bgyid de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to ༄ 7thogs/ /nor srung gdon gye bdag po ste/ /byang phyogs gdon dang bcas pa la/ /mchod pa bkyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po gdon kyi bdag /dbang ldan phyogs kyi gdon bcas la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'og gi klu ste sa yi lha/ /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po ste/ /dam tshig shes pa'i gdon bcas la//mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /steng gi lha tshogs thams cad dang pya/ /zla ba nyi ma gza' rngu/chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa 'ul/ /mchod pa bgyed cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /de ltar gtor ma phul ba'i yon tan ni 'phags thu/pa dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa'i rgyud las/ de ltar gang zhig 33—1583

byedamatshan mo rgyu ba la1/ /gtor ma gtong ba'i las rnams byed pa de/ /dngos grub shin tu myur zhing gegs zukyang med/ /yid du 'ong ba'i 'dod pa'ang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gtor ma de dag rang rang gi phyogs su gtor te/ spos chu lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du blugs la mig gis rngubaltas te / bdud rtsi 'khyel pa ngalan bdun bzlas pas rang gi spyi bor blugs pas bsangs 5te/ dkyil 'khor du 'gro khubar bya'o/ /yang na tshul 'dis gtor ma sbyin te—/ de nas phyi rol byung nas su/ /mnyam par gzhag ñjupas gtor ma spyin / /'bras yos til dang chur bcas shing / /'bras chan dang ni me tog bcas—/ /sran chen dag kyang mang du blugasashe/ /snum dang lo ma dag dang bcas / /de ltar slob ma slob dbon gyi zu/ /lag pa gnyis kyis blangs nas su/ /dga' zhing phyogs rnams kun du gtor/ /bdug spos mchod yon bcas pa sbyin//dang po hūṃdabang ldan phyogs song nas/ /cho ga bzhin du gtor ma bya/ /dbang dang ldan pa gzhu can ni/ /tshogs dang bcas la sbyin par bya/ /de nas dbang po'i tshogs bcas la/ /gsang sngags zhes shārke/pas sbyin par bya/ /sngags pa gtor ma la mkhas pas/ /me yi phyogs su gtor ma sbyin/ /de nas gshin rje'i phyogs dag tu/ /sngags pa mkhas pas sbyin par bya/ /de nas bden bral tshogs bcas la/ /gsang sngags zhes 12pas sbyin par bya/ /chu yi phyogs su klu rnams ni/ /bdag por bcas la de bzhin du/ /tsun+di ⑫ gnas la gnas pa yi//sngags rigs —pas ni tshul bzhin sbyin/ /de nas rlung gi phyogs song nas/ /rlung gi phyogs dang bcas pa la/ /rang gi ming nas smos nas su/ /sngags pas gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /byang gi phyogs su song nas ni/ /dngos grub 32—1584

dam pa 'dod byas la/ /yid ni rab tu dang bcas nasate/ /gnod sbyin rnams la gtor ma sbyin/ /srin po rnams dang sha za dang / /'byung po sha rjen za ba dang / /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs la/ /mkhas pas gtor ma gtong byebar bya/ /blo las sgogang dang gang dran pa/ /de na gnas pa'i sems can ni/ /ljon shing gel pa la gnas pa/ /de dang de la rab tu sbyin/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs su ru dra ya ④swā hā/ dbang po'i phyogs su ṣa kra ye swā hā/ me'i phyogs su agha ye swā hā/ gshin rje'i phyogs su ba ya bai ya 5swa ta ye swā hā/ srin po'i phyogs su rāk+ṣa ⑥sa a bye pa ta ye swā hā/ chu'i phyogs su me ka da sha na ye swā hā/rlung gi phyogs su ba ya be+e swā hā/ lus ngan gyi phyogs su yak+ṣa bir+ya dha ra 7ya swā hā/srin po rnams la kre ka re swā hā/ sha za rnams la pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ 'byung po rnams la gung gung swā hā/ kun du gtor ma byin nas ni/ /lag pa legs par bkrus nas su/ /nye reg tshul bzhin byas nas ni/ /de nas nang du 'jug par bya/ /zhes so/ /yang na 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma phyi rol du khyer la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma rde ar+ya /rmyenut+pan+da tāta oṃ s+dzahūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes sgra chen po lan gsum brjod la/ 'gro ba thams cad la bsngos te gtor ro/ /yang na lugs 'dis gtor ma sbyin te/ dang por maṇ+ḍal zlum po khru gang yan chad bcu phyogs brgyad du byed du bcug la/ maṇ+ḍal re re'i steng du gtor ma sngar bshad r+shapa bzhag la/ de nas dang por spyan drang ste1nye/ de nas dam tshig bstan cing mchod yon phul te/ dri dang me tog dang bdug pa dang / mar me dang byug ⑩pa phul la a kā ro zhes bya ba la sogs par snyeshar phyogs nas brtsams te gsum gtor la/ yang mchod yon la sogs pa phul te 33—1585

slar gtang ngo / /de la sngags dang phyag rgya 'di rnams yin te/ shar phyogs su kha bltas te/ rkang pa g.yas pa brkyang ⑫ba'i tshul gyis 'dug nas/ lag pa g.yon pa 2snardo rje'i phyag rgya la/ g.yas pa tshirdo rje'i phyag rgya sta ④zur logs su bzhag ste/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mo be+egs kyus spyan 6drang ba ni brgya byin spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de la mdzub mo lcags kyur ma byas pa ni/ brgya byin gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /rkang pa g.yon — tshobarkyang ba'i tshul gyis 'dug la/spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las/ mdzub mo brkyang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas 'di'i sngags ni na mo badz+ra sa tsa di shi badz+ra pā ṇi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ me'i phyogs su kha bltas nas/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo zlum por bkug stetsu /gung mo'i tshigs gsum par btsugs la/ mthe bo ñcasnalag mthil du gzhag tso pa ni me lha spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /dgug pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bong ngos la mdzub mo btsugs pa ni/ me lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid la mdzub mo mje bo'i ngos la btsugs te phyir drag /bye tu brkyang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o / /de'i sngags ni asne a 1dze+eha ka pa li dz+wa la dz+wa la/ da ha ni khi tho li bi rū 1 pāk+ṣa swā hā/ gshin rje'i phyogs su bltas nas snyim pa mdun du bzhag ste/sor mo phan tshun bsnol la khu tshur bcangs nas/ srin lag gnyis bsgrengs te gshibs la g.yabs te/ nang du gzhug ⑫pa ni gshin rje dgug pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /srin lag gnyis phyi rol du shin tu gshibs 14te bsgrengs la snying gar gzhag r+sha5pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /'di nyid salas srin lag sbyar ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni sa ma ya swā hā/ bden bral gyi phyogs su rkang pa mnyam par 'dug la/ lag pa g.yas kyi khu tshur bcangs pa las/ mdzub mo dang 33—1586

gung mo ral gri 'dra bar gshibs la bsgreng ste gzhagathusna /lag pa g.yon pa'ang de ltar byas te sta zur phyogs su bzhag la g.yon pa'i mdzub mo bkug ste g.yab pa ni bden bral dgug pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las lag pa g.yon pa sta zur phyogs su ral gri 'dra bar gzhag zu7pa ni bden bral gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o//dgug pa'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo brkyang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni sarba bhudhe rmyeb ya ka /ya ku ru swā hā/ chu lha'i phyogs su rkang pa mnyam par ༄5'dug la/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la mthe bo thudang /mdzub mo gabyug tu sbyar la/ zhags mig ltar byas te g.yon pa'i khu tshur yang de ltar byas la snying gar bzhag ste/ g.yon pa'i mdzub mo lcags kyu 'dra bar byas pa ni dgug pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid la g.yon pa'i mdzub hūṃ7mo khu tshur gye tshul du bzhag pa las zhags mig ltar byas pa ni chu lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo slar btang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o / / sngags ni ti ti ba ti ti ti shi khi tu li bi rū pāk+ṣa ḍasnaya swā hā/ rlung lha'i phyogs su bltas te 'dug la/ lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs te/ gung mo bsgreng ba'i tshigs dang mdzub mo bsgreng ba'i thor to 1 —btsugs la lag pa g.yas pa de bzhin du byas te/ sta zur logs su gzhag 11cing mthe bong 15bsgul ba ni rlung lha spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mje bo 1)snga ma bzhin du gzhag ༷pa ni rlung lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las mje bong brkyang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni oṃ swa sa kha kha kha khu khu khu swā hā/lus ngan la mngon du bltas te 'dug nas lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar la rdo rje bcing ba nang du bzlog ste/ mthe'u chung gnyis gshibs sal brkyang / de'i 33—1587

rgyab tu srin lag gnyis so sor bzhag nas gung mo gnyis de ltar bkug ste g.yab pa ni lus ngan spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las gung mo gnyis nang du rdo rje bcing ba'i tshul du gzhag 1pa ni/ lus ngan gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o / /'gugs pa'i phyag rgya las gung mo gnyis brkyang ba ni thube+er btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni ku bi ༄ rā ya swā hā/ dbang ldan gyi phyogs su bltas te 'dug la/ lag pa thal mo gcig tu sbyar ba byas la/ srin lag dang mthe'u 4chung nang du bkug ste bsnol/ gung mo gshibs sate bsgreng ba'i rgyab logs su mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje 'dra bar bya/ mthe bong gnyis bar du gshibs te bzhag 6la / de nyid la mdzub mo gnyis phan tshun rtse mo sprad nas nang du g.yab pa ni dbang ldan dgug pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las snga ma ltar mdzub mo rdo rje'i tshul du gzhag pa ni dbang ldan kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /dgug pa'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo brkyang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni rdzu rdzu shi ba swā hā/g.yon brkyang ba'i gnas pas 'dug pas/ lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar te bzhag la/ steng du bltas te mdzub mo gnyis kyi lcags kyus tshangs pa la sogs pa dgug par bya'o/ /de nyid las snga ma ltar gzhag chopa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o//dgug pa'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni 'di yin te a dar ya pra ha ma ne+e 97 swā hā/ srur+ya gra ha a pa —bye pa ta ye swā hā/ tsan+d+ra ya nak+ṣa tra 13a bye pa ta ye swā hā/ rkang pa mnyam par gnas ⑪pas 'dug la/ lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar te sor mo rnams par mtshams med par rtse mor phan tshun sbyar te/ mthe bo zlum por byas la 'og tu bltas te sa'i lha mo la sogs pa mdzub mo lcags kyu lta bur bkug pa ni 'og gi lha dgug pa'i 33—1588

phyag rgya'o/ /dgug pa'i phyag rgya las snga ma bzhin du mdzub mo gzhag 3pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /mdzub mo gnyis btang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni a bye pa ti bh+yaḥposwā hā/ a su re bh+yaḥ swā hā/ na 4ge bh+yaḥ shāswā hā/ de nas rang rang gi 67sngags de 7nyid kyis 'thor 'thung phul la/ bdag dang slob ma'i tshogs su bcas pa la bgegs med par mdzod cig /las dang dngos grub rnams bdag cag la sprul cig ces brjod cing slar gtang ngo / /de ltar bdag gis ༄t+t+waṃrgya cher bkod pa'i gtor ma 'di dag ni gang dga' bas slob ma dbang bskur 1ba dang / ro yongs su sbyang ba la sogs pa'i tshe sbyin no/ /de nas sngags pas bla med byang chub kyi gnas su slob ma yongs su smin par bya zhes bya ba la sogs pa la ⑪slob ma sta gon la gnas pa ston te/ de nas zhes bya ba ni don gyis 1na bum pa sta gon la gnas ma thag tu'am slob ma smin par bya ba'i dbang du byas pa zhes so/ /sngags pas zhes bya ba ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyes so/ /bla tshamed byang chub ces bya ba ni/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o / /de nyid 'khor ba ji srid du gnas par bya bas na gnas su'o/ /slob ma zhes bya ba ni bla ma la gus pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /smin / par bya zhes bya ba rnguni dngos grub kyi myu gu 'byin nus par byas muzhes pa'o/ /ji ltar bya zhe lan/ 'gro la phan phyir myur du byang chub par/ /de dag byang chub sems mchog bskyed du gzhug / muces smos so/ /slob ma sta gon la gnas par bya ba ni / 'phags pa dkyil 'khor spyi'i bya ba las kyang / de nas 18slob ma legs brtags nas/ /sta gon gnas la tshul bzhin du/ /de yi nub mo ci ge nus par/ /de bzhin sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug /gtsang ma'i gos dkar 33—1589

bgos hūṃpa yis/ /slob ma de lta bu dag ni/ /shar phyogs kha bltas 'khod pa la/ /sta gon gnas pa brtsam snyepar bya/ /dang por gsum la skyabs su btang / /de nas bla mas byang chub sems/ /ma bskyed pa ni bskyed par bya/ /bskyed pa dag kyang dran par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de la 'di slob ma sta gon la gnas pa'i rim pa rgyas pa ④'di yin te/ dang por slob ma legs par brtags pa smyung 3ba la gnas pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su shar du blta bar rgan pa'i rim gyis dgod de/ lag na me tog thogs pa rnams la slob dpon gyis chos bstan te/ de ltar yang / yid dga' spro chen kyebyas pa gzo/ /ngar 'dzin mi 'byed rigs mtho zhing / /yon tan dang ldan dad dang bcas/ /gzugs dang kha dog lang tshor ldan/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsang ba ni/ /sgrub pa don gnyer mngon brtson pa'am/ /gzugs ngan yon tan med pa'am/ /dman pa 'am ni lhag par bya/ /rang gi bslab dang legs ldan zhing / /jeg chen la dga'i bdag nyid can/ /'khor ni rnam pa bzhi char 3la'ang / /dkyil 'khor cho ga rjes su gnang / /kha cig gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer gzhan༄ / /'jig rten pha rol gnyer ba yi/ /dad pa mang du byed pa 'di/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya'i/ /'di yi 'bras bu 'dod pas min/ /'di la 'dod par gyur pa yis/ /'jig rten pha rol don mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer pa'i/ /skyes bu de yi 'bras bu rgyas/ /zhes so/ /de nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ci nus kyis bshad do/ /de nas de bzhin 33—1590

gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma la dbang bcu gsum bsgur la/ de dag slob ma'i lus la bsdu'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams kyis bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni bdag la dgongs/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la stsol—/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum de ni bdag la stsol / /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal—/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab par 7bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gcig tsog tsog por (1 byas te/ de'i ming nas brjod la thams cad gzengs bstod par bya ste/ spyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi — / /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag de bstan bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa dag /de dag kun gyis khugasang sngags kyi/ /cho ga mchog bzang 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /'jig rten mthun 'jug thugs chud nas/ /'khor lo bskor te mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di kyis shig /ces pa dang gzhan rab tu rgya cher brjod de/ snying rjer gyur pa'i yid kyis ni/ /de ltar lan mang gzengs bstod de/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de nas slob ma rnams 33—1591

dkyil thu'akhor gyi lha rnams la phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa kye yan lag bdun byas la/ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /ma bsgral ba ni bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba ni grol bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgodabye/ /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /'di ni/ 'gro la phan phyir myur du byang chub par/ /de dag byang chub sems mchog bskyed du gzhug5 /ces bya'o/ /de nas/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes lhayi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /6 zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /'di ni byang chub smon lam gdab/ /ces bya ba dang / brtul zhugs gnas zhes bya'o/ /de nas dpral ba dang / mgrin pa dang snying gar thal mo sbyar bas/ slob ma'i gnas de gsum du bzhag la/oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba ā ba ra shā 3ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇa sheni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tshin+da tshin+da sarba ā ba ra rja (ni hūṃ phaṭa ces sabya ba'i rim pa sbyar te lan bdun brjod la/ rdo rjes kyang reg par byas la me tog dang / bdug pa 1— dang / dri dang / mar me dang spyi bo dang mdun du rang re'i sngags kyis sbyin / de nas byin gyis brlab ces bya'o/ /de nas so shing dor ba dang dri chu sbyin te/ /ji skad du/ so shing u dusmra ra dang / /a shwat+tha kyoni rma med pa/ /ha cang mi phra mi sbom zhing / /sor grangs bcu gnyis tshad du byas/ /spos kyi chus ni legs par bkru/ /skud pa dag gis rnam par bkris/) / /spos kyis bkru zhing bdug pas bdugasamu/ /lag pas bran zhing bzlas 'ipa ni/ /rigs 33—1592

kyi snying po mang du bzlas/ /yang na lan bdun bzlas par bya/ /slob ma rnams kyi grangs las ni/ /so shing la sogs bsags kyipar bya/ /so shing mgo zhabs gcig byas nas/ /rtse mo nas ni bca' bar bya/ /de nas bdag dang slob ma dang / /gnas bsrung ba yang brtan byas nas/ /lha rnams thams cad legs mchod de/ /zhes pa dang yang gsungs pa/ slob ma mthun zhing tshogs pa rnams/ /byang phyogs su ni kha bltas shing / /thal mo sbyar te 'khod pa la/ /so shing go rims du snabazhin du sbyin/ /slob ma shar du kha bltas te/ /mi smra bar ni so shing bca'/ /bca' ba zin nas mi dga' shing / /phan tshun du yang mi dor ro/ /so shing mdun du drang por dorarngu/ /de tshe bdag la lta thub dang / /rtse mo gyen du bsgreng gyur na/ /des ni dngos grub mchog ces bya/ /de bzhin shar du bltas na ni/ /de yi dngos grub 'bring du bshad/ /mtshams dang byang du kha bltas na/ /'jig rten gyi ni rig sngags 'grubacho/ /so shing bor ba brgya zhig la/ /gal te thur du kha bltas na/ /des ni nges par sa 'og gi/ /dngos grub thob par gdon mi za/ /zhes te/ gal te ba lang ko ba tsam du lan gsum ma babs na/ de la dbang ni mi bskur ro/ /slob ma nye reg byas nas ni/ /snga ma bzhin du 'khod pa la/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags kyis//spos chu bla mas blud pa ni/ /re re la yang btung ba skuyi/ /khror bar blugs la lan gsum blud/ /der ni 'thungs nas langs nas ni/ /phyi rol du ni kha bkru bya/ /zhes te/ 'dir ni oṃ s+thāmu ཿsu bi shudhe dharma sarba pā paṃ 37ni bi sho dha ya swā hā/ sarba bi kālpa ni rnguya hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags so6/ /de nas bdud rtsi 'khyel pa bzlas pa'i nyu1 ku sha stan ⑩dang sngas su phyin la/ de bzlas pa'i srad bu mdud 33—1593

pa bdun tebor ba2/ /dpung pa g.yas par gdags so/ /de nas/'phags pa sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /ku sha lag tu gtad — —nas su/ /g.yas su skud pa bcings nas ni/ /4zhes gsungs pa ste/ dor ba bca' ba byas nas ni / /zhes smos pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po yi ge brgya pa lan mang du bzlas nas de dag brtan par bya'o/ /de nas chos bshad par bya ste/zab cing rgya che'i chos bsgrags la/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ kun mkhyen rnams ni 'jig rten du/ /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sdig pa bgyis snyepar gyur pa gang / /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba/ /mthong bas 'byung bar gyur 6lags na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci 'tshal/ /skyob 3pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang dag spyad pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo ba / /3'di dag gis 1ni ngan 'go'i rgyun/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu gcad1 / /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med sna1de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyi 2ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur / /theg pa chen po cher 'byung rdo1—ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan / /khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang 'byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /33—1594

yod dang med las rnam par 'das/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med/ /zab mo rtog ge thams cad kyis/ /rab tu mi rtog lkuganas med pa3sna/ /spros pa kun dang bral ba ste/ /spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa/ /las dang bya ba la sogs bral—/ /bden pa gnyis la gnas pa yi/ /theg pa rab kyi mchog 'di ni/ /tshul la gnas na thob par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de nas slob ma slob dpon du 'os pas/ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa sprul/ /zhes bya ba'i bar du khyad par gyi sdom pa gsol ba btab la/ slob dpon gyis de rnams la rmi lam ji ltar mthong ba nga la nang par zlos 1shig ces brjod do/ /de nas rmi lam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ 'dod chags bral dang ldan pa'i chos/ /slob ma rnams la bshad nas ni/ /ku sha bting ba'i sa la ni/ /shar phyogs kha bltas nyal du gzhug /de nas nang par nam langs nas/ /rmi lam ci mthong dri bar bya/ /mthong na bzang ngam mi bzang ngam/ /the tshom med par bshad par bya/ /rmi lam rgyas pa mthong na ni/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin/ /mchod rten dang ni sku gzugs mthong / /de la mchod pa rtsom pa dang / /dge slong dag la chos nyan tam/ /yang na gzhan la nyan kyang rung / /chos ni rnam par dpyod sgopa dang / /de bzhin glegs bam klog pa dang / /rmi lam dge 'dun mthong ba dang / /yang na dge slong gabyug pu mthong / /de dang 'grogs shing gtam zer dang / /yang na dge slong dngos por gyur/ /gtsug lag khang dag mthong ba dang / /de bzhin dge slong ma dag mthong / /rgyal ba'i sras rnams mthong ba dang / /de bzhin pha ma bla ma dang / /mdza' bo rnams 5 ni sna tshogs rnamasaphyo/ /rmi lam dag tu mthong na ni/ /rigs rnams 33—1595

dang ni dngos grub thob/ /de bzhin babe+eb nyupa 'dzin pa dang / /kan a+yo dga' rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /'bab chu rnams dang rgya mtsho dang / /ri dang glang po che dag kyang / /mthong na yang ni bzang bar bsgrags/ /rgyal mdog dang ni mthong na yang dzu/ /bde gshegs spyod dang ldan pa yi/ /dka' thub dang ni bram ze dang / /phyug po skyes bu dam pa dang / /ba lang rta dang glang po dang / /seng ge dang ni ri dwags kyang ④/ /rmi lam du ni mthong na shis/ /bkra shis pa yi bya rnams dang / /gser dag dang ni gter rnams dang / /rin po che dang dngul rnams dang / /nor ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /mdor na 'byung khungs rnam pa dang / /mtshon cha rnams dang 'bru rnams dang / /'bras bu rnams dang me tog dang / /rgyan ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /kha zas dang ni gos rnams dang / /byis pa dang ni gzhon nu dang / /bud med gzugs ni bzang po dag /rmi lam du ni mthong ba bzang / /yang na thob cing reg pa smra/ /rmi lam na ni dbang bskur dang / /rgyal por gyur cing cho 'byor pa dang / /dmag dpon du ni gyur pa dang / /g.yul las rgyal zhing dgra gsod dang / /gnyen dang lhan cig 'grogs pa dang / /lha rnams kyang ni mthong ba dang / /theg pa dang ni shing rta zhon/ /de bzhin ri dang khang thog tre'adzeg /ngo mtshar rnam pa sna tshogs kyang / /rmi lam du 3ni mthong na dge/ /yam shing me la sbyin sreg byed/ /bya ba bzang po dag la 'bad/ /chu la rkyal zhing pha rol brgal87/ /rkun po dag ni tshar gcod dang / /stobs 'gyed pa las rgyal ba dang / /gyad stangs rdob cing 'gying ba dang / /rtsed mo sna tshogs rmi ba dang / /de bzhin mthu rtsal gzi byin che/ /bkra shis rnams ni thams 33—1596

cad kyang / /mthong na rab tu dge bar bshad/ /gsang sngags cho ga nyan pa dang / /dga' ston dge ba mthong ba dang / /sgrub skyel brtson zhing bsngags thupa dang / /sgrub pa po rnams mthong ba dang / /de la sogs pa'i lha (kye/rnams ni//dge ba rnam pa du ma dag /blo yis rnam par dpyad sanas ni/ /de nas bzlog ⑥ pa spang bar bya/ / dge ba ghuyi ni ltas byernams ni/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma la/ /dge ba rnams ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /mi dge ba rgo mi 'grub bo / /mi dge ba dag shes nas su/ /de dag mkhas pas spang bar bya/ /gsang sngags dngos grub gsum 'grub pa/ /rab dang 'bring dang tha ma'o /mi dge ba la zhi ba yi/ /sbyin sreg zhi ba'i gsang sngags kyis/ /ba yi mar las brgya rtsa brgyad/ /cho ga bzhin du zhi bar 1snabya/ /zhes gsungs pa ste/ de ltar rmi lam bshad nas de'i 'og tu bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis de dag bsrung ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar thams cad nyal bar bya ba ni tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la mi bya bar glo g.yas pa phab ste'o/ /de nas nang par rmi lam gyi tshul shes/ par byas te bhe/ 'dod pa'i rgyal pos dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su phyogs skyong ba rnams bkug ste/ oṃ badz+ra shī li zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags kyi phur pas gdab bo/ /'dis don gyis drangs /1pa'i sta gon la gnas pa gzhan ni re zhig snyadang po nyi ma shar ba'i dus su/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri zhim pos tetrī maṇ+ḍal khru gang yan chad 6byas la/ sngon bzhin du sa'i lha la mchod pa dang tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis gsol ba btab la sa'i lha de nyid du yang thim par bya'o/ /de nas rtsa ba'i lha rnams kyi nang du dri zhim pa'i jig le byas la der lha rnams bsnyims te sa/ mchod pa dang bstod pa dang 33—1597

bskor ba byas la gsol ba zi1gdab par bya'o/ /ji skad du/ sa gzhi steng du byug spos kyis/ /dkyil 'khor sor grangs bcu gnyis bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni rig ⑤sngags kyis/ /lag pas brab zucing lan bdun bzlas/ /de nas gtso bo'i lha rnams ni/ /ming gis yid la bsams nas su/ /byug spos me tog la sogs pas/ /snying po ci rigs mchod par bya/ /lha bshos dag kyang dbul bar bya/ /bdug spos mngon par bsngags 5 pa'ang dbul/ /der ni mchod pa yang byas nas/ /bdug spos lag tu thogs nas ni/ /blo gros can gyis lha rnams la/ /gus par gsol ba gdab par bya/ /gang gi dkyil 'khor yin pa'i sngags/ /de la thog /༄ltamar gdags par gsol/ /de yi go rims sbyar ba yi 6 / /lha rnams kun la gdags par gsol/ /'di zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das / / rig sngags thurgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni brtse bar gyur nas su/ /slob ma rnams la brtse sgro ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir / /sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la / /de nas gnang (ba mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas mgon po brtser ldan pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gang yang gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyob pa'i 11lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang yang lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs pa mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi ming ni 'di zhes bya/ /sang muni gdugs la dkyil 'khor ni/ /bzang po ming ni 'di zhes bgyi/ /yo byad ci yod pas 'dri kan/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar mudagongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /33—1598

byin gyis rlob tshobhe pa mdzad du gsol/ /de skad lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /bsam pa thag pas phyag byas te༄ bye/ /bstod pa'i tshig kyang brjod nas su/ /de nas slar ni gshegs su gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bur bya'o/ /de nas bum pa rnams sngon du bstan pa ( ltar ram/ yang na 'di dag ni rang gi sems snang ba tsam mo zhes mos ñcapas/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rang rang gi (zhe yi ge las mtshan ma skyodang de las skur grub cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bzhugs nas bum par gyur par byas la/ grangs dang po'i mtshan ma dang 'byel ghu par gzhag dzu pa'ang rung ste/ bum pa ni rab tu ma rnyed na rnam par rgyal ba dang las thams cad pa gnyis kyis byas la/ rnam par rgyal ba yang 'dir lha thams cad kyi bdag nyid yin la rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas su gzhag spugo/ /de la kha cig na re/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du ni/ sa'i lha sta gon la gnas pa med do zer te/ 'di ni bla ma'i lung tha dad pas nges pa med do/ /sta gon la ⑫ gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /da ni sdom gnas zhes bya ba la sogs pa slob ma 'jug pa ston te/ sdom ni 'dir thun mong gi sdom pa la gnas pa ste/ khyad par gyi sdom pa ni gdod dbog par bya ba yin pas so/ /de yang legs par sta gon la gnas pa'i slob ma de dag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug kye pa'i tshul ni/ sta gon la gnas pa'i phyi de nang par dri'i thig le'i lha rnams la mchod pa dgus mchod nas nam mkha' la bteg la/ sngar bshad pa ltar nang dang phyi'i thig gdab ⑫la/ tshon bkye ste khrus byas la dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad bkod nas bum par bcug ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi bsgrub skyepa byas la/ sngon bzhin du phyi rol du gtor ma sbyin te nang du bdag nyid zhugs la/ de nas yol bas bcad pas 33—1599

slob ma re re nas bos la/ 'jug pa'i rim pa bya ste/ bla mas slob ma gcig pu ni/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur bya/ /mkhas pas cig car ①slob ma gnyis/ /dbang bskur bar ni yongs mi bya/ /gnyis sam gsum mam bzhi yang rung / /thams cad so sor bya ba ni/ /yo byad sar pa gzhan rnams kyis//dbang bskur ba yi bla mas bya/ /rig zhesngags dbang ni thob pa la/ /bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor dbang bskur bya/ /dbang bskur ba yi cho ga dang / /bsgrub pa'i cho ga'ang de bzhin sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pas 'jug pa ni dbang bskur ba'i dang po nyid du gyur pas so/ /de ltar bos la/ las kyi bum nga/'i chu mchod yon gyi snod du blugs pa ku sha'i bam pos bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bsrung ngo / /de ltar yang slob ma re re nas bkug ste/ bsang gtor snga ma bzhin byas nas/ /byug spos la sogs byin nas kyang / /snying pos mngon par bsngags nas ni/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dar la sogs pas mig gnyis g.yogs nas ni zhes bya ba ni/ las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags kyis//btab pa'i gos kyis gdong g.yogs te/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin mas dpal gyi pad+mor lag gnyis bya/ /me tog rin chen la sogs de brgyan la//zhes bya ba ni de nyid las sngar bstan pa'i phyag rgya la/ me tog dag ni bzhag nas su/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bdag pos sngags/ /phyag rgyar bcas pas spyi bor gzhag4 /gsang sngags lan gsum bzlas par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o / /de la rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcing ba'i 3sngags ni/ oṃ badzā dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ zhes bya ba'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis bu khyod su yin khyod gang la dga' zhes dri'o/ /slob mas kyang / bdag ni skal ba bzang po ste/ /sangs 33—/600

rgyas nyid du gyur la dga'o/ /zhes smra'o/ /de nas sa ma ye hūṃ zhes lan gsum bzlas te/ yan lag bdun sngon du ①byas nas byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de nas deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs par gyur gyis khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gsang ba chen po 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba su la'ang ma smra shig 1ces brjod la/ oṃ badz+ra pra be sha hūṃ badz+ra hūṃ zhes brjod la yol ba bsal te/ 'di ni rgyud kyi dang por/rab zhi kha nas sngags brjod gzhug par bya/ /zhes bya ba ste/ rab zhi zhes bya ba ni 5slob ma nges pa'o/ /de nas/ nga yis ④di ring de bzhin gshegs/ /kun gyi rigs su khyod bcug gis/ /gang gis shes na de bzhin gshegs/ /kun gyi dngos grub thob byed na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos te/ /de phyir rdo rje ye shes bskyedaphye/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i/ /mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ /brjod pa tsam gyis dam tshig nyams par byas par 'gyur ro zhes brjod la rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ 'di phyakhyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas ni/ /bdun 7rgyud rigs rnams brlog zupar mdzad/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya byehūṃ phaṭa ces brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje dral ba'i phyag rgyas slob ma'i snying ga'i bu ga phye la slob mas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya z-i pa 7da ya me pra be sha dṛ bye nyu tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ zhes lan gsum brjod la/sgob dpon gyi snying ga'i ye shes kyi sku dang ye shes sems dpa' las de dang 'dra ba'i tshul 'thon te/ slob ma'i snying gar gnas par bsams la bu ga med par bsams te/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la kun du gnas par mdzad / /ci ste dam tshig 'das nas ni/ /de ma thag tu bkas nas bzhud/ /33—1601

ces brjod do/ /de nas dri zhim po'i chu la o badzod da ka ṭhaḥ⑫ zhes lan mang du bzlas te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs byen dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi chu 'dis sgo 'grub / /ces brjod la blud do/ /de bas/ de nas gsang sngags mkhas pa yis/ /sngags 'dis 5dam tshig sbyin par bya/ /zhes bya ba dang / de nas 'dis dam tshig bsgrag par bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /de nas deng phan chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyisathu/ gang ngas smras pa'i bya ba de khyod kyis byos shig gal te ma byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re zhes brjod do/ /de nas/ che ge zhes bya 'di nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin pa/ /dam tshig mchog dang gsang ba yi/ /'khor lo 'dir 4ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes rigs thams cad la bsgrags la / /7gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin pa snyeni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /des kyang 'tshal zhes brjod par bya/ /de nas de bas rtag tu zhes bya ba nas/ bdag nyid de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba'i bar du khyad par gyi sdom pa thun mong pa phog la/ de nas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa'i slob dpon du 'os pa la sbyin te dbab pa'i cho gas gdab rngubo/ /de la dbab pa'i cho ga ni rang dang slob ma'i ⑫snying ga sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgyas phye la rang gi snying ga nas yi ge a byung ste/ slob ma'i snying ga la gnas pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i sgong 11skyes la yid kyis bzhag la/ de'i 'od kyis lus thams cad kun du gang bar bsams temu/ sarba ta thā ga ta a byeṣ+ṭha de na two1 / badz+ra satwa me a bi sha 33—1602

du zhes brjod do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis ti rīrnyi lkuri'i phyag rgya myur du bcings la/ 'di ni rdo rje dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'ang yin par grags—/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med narngu/ /de ring nyid du 'bab par shog /ces slob mas brjod do/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra ā /rdube+e sha a aḥ4 zhes bcu nas bzung ste/ nyi shu'am/ sum cu'am/ bzhi bcu'am/ lnga bcu'am/ drug cu'am / bdun cu'am/ brgyad cu'am/ dgu bcu'am/ brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du bzlas nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dmar po kun du 'khrugs pas yongs su gang bar bsams na nges par 'be+ebs so/ /gal te ma babs na/ rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya dril bu dang bcas pa bcings la/ rkang pa g.yon pas de'i rkang pa g.yas pa mnan nas de nyid la dbab par bya ba'i phyir/ steng gi nam mkha'i phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi steng na shekhros pa'i yig hūṃ gi kye'od zer kyis gnon 3par mdzad pa dang / 'og nas kyang rdo rje rlung gi dkyil 'khor yi ge hūṃ las 'degs par gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa la sogs par bzhugs rmesnapas/ hūṃ t+t+waṃ dhīḥ1a zhes bya ba ⑩rang gi sa bon gyi 'od kyi khutshogs yang dag par 'be+ebs par mdzad par bsam nyu zhing /hūṃ ā 1)be sha aḥ⑫ zhes lan brgya zlos shing de la dbab par bya'o/ /gal te shin tu sdig pa chen pos 'bab par ma gyur na sdig pa dral muba'i phyag rgyas sdig pa dral bar bya'o/ /de nas/ yam nyu shing dmar 18po rnams kyi me/ /re sbar rdo rje khro bo'i me/ /mnyam par gzhag pas shā(snyoms zhugs la/ /til bsregs pas ni sdig bsregs shing / /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā / — ya swā hā zhes bya ba ni hūṃ/lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du til nag po las sdig pa'i gzugs brnyan byas la 33—1603

dbus su hūṃ bsam 2pa'i mdzub mo dang mthe bos sbyin sreg ༄ bhebya'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg ༄ gi thab khung las byung ba'i 'bar ba'i phreng ba kun du 'khrugs pa'i rdo rje'i zulus la babs thupas sdig pa rnams bsreg par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas yang rdo rje 'bebs pa'i phyag rgya de bzhin du bcings pa/ dbab pa byas na 6 nges par 'be+ebs par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bus kyang ma phebs na/ de la dbang mi bskur ro/ /babs na skad cig ma de nyid la mngon par shes pa lnga la sogs pa rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gal te babs pa de 'bar bar 'gyur la mude mi 'dod na/ de'i spyi bor ri rab dang dbang chen dang rdo rje dang yi ge a dang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad rnams kha dog ser por bsam mo de nas nges par babs pas kyen/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra haṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pa glur blangs la/ phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i lan gyis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas brtan par byas la lce la rdo rje bsams te/ zlo tshohi badz+ra zhes brjod na/'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar gyi dngos po rnams ⑪don dang ldan par ma lus par smra'o/ /dgongs 11pa yongs su rdzogs nas ni bzhud par gyur te/ 'di ni dbab pa'i cho ga'o/ /1rtade nas dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ slob mas yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i cho ga byas la/ a sa me tri sa me ma ⑩hā sa ma ye swā hā zhes pa phyag rgya dang ldan par byas la bdag dam tshig can du mos par bya'o / /rdo rje 'dzin ma zhes pa tenas gzhug par bya zhes bya ba'i bar te/ de nas slob dpon gyis bden pa bsgrags te/ bdag la bden pa'i byin brlabs pa / /bdag gis phyaslob ma dkyil 'khor du/ /legs par btsud par gyur pas ni/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag /'di yi bsod nams ci 'dra las/ /33—1604

de bzhin du ni 'bab par 'gyur/ /'dis ni grub pa gang 'grub dang lku/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu ni ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin 'gyur/ /de skad brjod nas de 'og tu/ /sgo yi phyogs su de bzhag nas/ /de nas me tog 'thor du gzhug /ces gsungs pas so/ /de nas sngags 'dis me tog dor bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugs brtser 5dgongs nas ni/ /'gro la phan pa'i gtso mchog gis/ /sman par dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ pra ti kṛt+na thuhūṃ zhes pas dor ro/ /me tog rin chen la sogs pas/ /gang la bab pa rigs kyi lha/ /gtso bo'i rigs de bsgrubs na ni/ dngos grub myur du 3the tshom sed/ /ces bya ba ni ji skad du/ gang du me tog babs 'gyur batre//de ni de yi rigs kyi lha/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de la me tog dor ba'i tshul rgyas pa la ni/ ji skad du/ dngos grub rab 'bring rnam gsum ni/ /me tog bab dz+wapa rnams la 5brtag /lha rnams kyi ni khyad par ni/ /gnas kyi khyad par las kyang brtag /gang tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyishe/ /dbu la me tog babs gyur na/ /de tshe gtsug tor mdzod spu — dag /grub par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /spyan la sogs pa'i sngags rnams kyang / /zhal du babs na 'grub par 'gyur/ /stod du babs 4 mi/na mchog rnams 'grub/ /rked par babs na 'bring rnams 'grub/ /ro smad phyogs su bab ⑩pa ni/ /dngos grub phal rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /bar gyi dku la babs na ni/ /snying po la sogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /smad du babs par gyur na ni/ /mngag gzhug la sogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /rim pa de dag thams cad ni/ /pad+ma rdo rje 'dzin 33—1605

rigs la/ /go rims shebhebazhin du shes byas la/ /de bzhin lha rnams gzhan la yang / /dngos grub rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /gal te lha yi gzugs dag las//ring du me tog lhung gyur na/ /de yis gedangos grub yun ring grub/ /nye na dngos grub myur du 'grub/ /gsang sngags rnams ni mchod pa dag /gang du bkram pa tshun chad ni/ /de yi nye 'khor de yin te/ /me tog der lhung de yi rigs—/ /lha gnyis kyi ni bar dag tu/ /gal te me tog lhung gyur na/ /gal te nye bar gyur pa ni/ /de ni de yi yin par bshad/ /gal te dkyil 'khor 'das 1nas su/ /la la'i me tog lhung gyur na/ /de la dngos grub phal 'grub cing / /'di ni dad pa'ang rab tu chud/ /gal te me tog dor ba dgar ba'i ri mo la babs 3na/ /zhi ba byas nas de nas gdod/ /nan tan bskyed de 'dor du gzhug /de tshe the tshom gyur na ni/ /mkhas pas bzlas te dor mi bya/ /der ni gar yang nges med pas/ /des ni dngos grub thob mi 'gyur / /gnyis kyi bar du mnyam pa dang / /don med phyi rol ltung na ni/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg yebyas nas ni/ /de nas me tog 'dor du gzhug /snying por me tog babs na ni/ /rtag tu don med mi 'gyur na/ /srad pyabu dag gis kru cho ga bzhin/ /de yi nye 'khor ༄sheshes par bya/ /rigs 1gsum la yang cho ga bzhin / /dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum du brtag⑫ /⑪ji ltar grags pa'i tshul dag las/ /gtso bo rnams kyi rigs kyis bskyed/ /gal te me tog dor ba dag/mchod pa'i steng du bab — byegyur na/ /de ni rgyas pa'i sgrub pa dag /khyad par du ni shes par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor gye ni bdag po la/ /gang gi me tog bab ⑫gyur na/ /de ni de yi las rnams kun/ /myur du 'grub cing mchog tu gyur/ /33—1606

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la ni/ /gang gi me tog babs na ni/ /de la rigs gsum gsang sngags kun/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /pad+ma la ni rigs gnyis 'grub/ /rdo rje 'dzin la rang rig snanyid/ /gal te gnyis las 'das nas su/ /gang gi gsum pa la babs 3na/ /dkyil 'khor de nas dbyung bar bya/ /yang na dkyil 'khor gzhan du gzhug /de la sogs pa'i rnam pa yis zu/ /me tog rnams ni dor ba las/ /bdag gi mdun du mang 4thong ba/ /de la zhi ba brtsam par bya/ /sbyin sreg gis ni zhi byas nas/ /der ni slar yang 'dor 5du gzhug /lan gsum spogs 4te bor na yang / /gal te legs par ma babs 3na/ /re thag bcad tresnade be+er btang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de nas sngar 6snayon kyis lag pa bkang ste zhes gsungs pa'o/ /yon gebla ma la dbul te/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha skyebadz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod pa'o7/ /lhag pa'i kyelha'i dbang gi ngo bo me tog de slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag snaste/ sems dpa' stobs chen po/ 'di khyod bzhes shig brjod pa'o/ /de nas/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson pa ste/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed par mdzad/ /rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra tsakyu a ta ya snyeti zhes brjod cing / gdong g.yogs dgrol lo/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bgrol 7nas ni/ /slob ma de la 'di skad bsgo/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di lta 2 ltos/ /da ni ridad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'byor pa thams cad mngon du 'gyur ༄ snye/ /rten dang dngos grub thams cad kyang / /khyod la mngon du phyogs gyur gyis/ /dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs/spyo/ /gsang 33—1607

sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes so/ /de nas slob mas 1dkyil 'khor la phyag gsum byas la bskor ba gsum byas te/ rang gi lha la me tog snyim pa gsum dbul lo/ /de nas slob dpon gyis de'i sngags lan bdun me tog la bzlas te/ slob ma'i lag tu byin la slob mas kyang lan bdun de'i sngags bzlas te/ lha khyod bdag gis mnos so zhes lan gsum bzlas so/ /di nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ste/ mtha' ma nas 3brtsams la dkyil 'khor ༄ bstan te/ 4de nas de la dkyil 'khor ni/ /rab tu rgyas pa bstan par bya/ /phyag rgya chen bo dag kyang bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i slob ma gzhug pa'i cho ga ste—/ the tshom la sogs mi bya ste/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gyi dam tshig rnams ni go sla bas ma phye'o/ /bdag gi de nyid dang ni 5sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba la/ bdag gi de kho na nyid ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes te de tsam la 6'dir bdag tu gdags par 7zad do/ /sngags zhes bya ba 3ni de kho na zhes tshig lhag ma can du byas te/ 'dod pa'i lha rang bzhin gyis grub pa rnams so / /sogs zhes bya ba ni mngon par byang chub pa'am/ sems dpa' 'byung ba'i rim pas bdag nyid lhar byas pa lha'i de kho na nyid do/ /de bas na 'dir ye shes dbab pa dang / mngon par byang chub pa dag tshoni bdag gi de kho na nyid yin la/ mngon par 7byang chub pa bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa ni lha'i de kho na nyid yin no/ /de bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ de kho na nyid gsum po 'di la yang yid gnyis la sogs pa dang smad par mi bya'o zhes bya ba'o1 / /mos pa brtan dang ldan pas dam bcas nas/ /zhes bya ba ni/ mos pa dang ldan pa nyid brtan pa ste/ mos pa ni mi 'phrogs pa'i las can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /33—1608

de yang dam bcas nas dbang bskur na mos pa med pa dad pa tsam gyis 'jug pa rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de bas 'phags pa de kho na nyid 'dus pa las/de nas gsang ba thob 7rtepa yin pas/ /de las dang por mna' 'di'i snying po 27brjod par bya ste kyizhes gsungs pa4/ de nyid kyi 5rgya cher bshad pa las kyang /gsang ba thub pa yin par zhes bya ba ni/ gsang bar bya ba'i don gang yin pa 6 srog gi phyir yang su la'ang mi smra ba 7ste/ de lta bu'i brtan pa dang ldan pa'i sems can ni gsang ba thub pa 8zhes bya'o/ /de la dang por mna'i snying po brjod par bya ste zhes bya ba ni 'di skad ston te/ de lta bu'i sems can la yang gya tshom du bstan par mi bya'i/ mna' yang bsgrags te bstan par bya'o shezhes bshad do/ /de bas na gsang ba bla na med pa'i lam 'di ni rab tu yang 'bad pas 0brtags shing bstan par byas la sbyin no/ /de bas na/ gsang ba zla ba'i thig le las/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ /gsang ba yi ni dkyil 'khor 'di/ /ci ste rmongs pas smras byas na 11/ /slob dpon gyi ni dam tshig nyams/ /myur du zla ba phyed tshun chad/ /bstan pas rnam par 'jog par 'gyur/ /dang por dam tshig gzhag 1 bya ste/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /gzhan du byas na dpa' bo 1 rnams/ /dmyal bar bskal pa grangs med smin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas dbang bskur bar bya ste/dkyil 'khor chen po'i nub tu bar du khru dos chod par dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor spe)chen po'i snying po'i phyed kyi tshad la lte ba'i lha'i mtshan ma bkod pa 5/me'i 'od kyi bar du rdzogs par byas pa der/ khri'am khri'u la stan bzang po r+ṣa bting bar slob ma rgyan ma lus pas 7brgyan la bzhag ste12/ rgyal ba dang bkra 33—1609

shis pa byas la dbang bskur ro/ /de ltar yang / slob ma la dzosnal brtags pa dag /gal te dbang bskur 'dod pa la/ /dbang bskur ba yi dkyil 'khor ni / /phye ma dkar pos bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor dag dang rjes mthun par/ /stegs bu gru bzhir byas nas su/ /de yi dbus su tshon 5sna lngas/ /pad+ma yongs su rdzogs par bri/ /bkra shis la sogs mtshan ma rnams/ /der ni ji ltar 'dod pa bri/ /bkra shis phyir ni gang bstan 3pa/ /yang na dngos su dgod jepar bya/ /zhes gsungs la/ yang gsungs pa/ slob ma dbang bskur 'os rigs 5nas/ /cho ga 'dis 6ni nan tan du/ /dbang bskur ba yi cho ga bya/ /las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /btab pa'i stan ni gsar gzhag kyeste/ /bkra shis la sogs kun byas nas/ /bsrung ba nan tan cher bya ste/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sngags zlos shing / /gdugs ni dkar po bzang po la/ /me tog phreng ba bzang pos brgyan/ /ras phran dkar po 5'phyangs pa gcig /spyi bo'i steng du gzung bar bya/ /slob mas yon ni cher 'bul 9 zhing / /bla ma bsnyen bkur byas pa dag /stan de la ni bzhag nas su/ /sngags kyis 7skyon bsal bkra shis bya/rta/ /bdug spos legs par sbyar ba yis/ /bdug pa khro bo'i rgyal pos bdug /rnga yab la sogs dag kyang gzung mu/ /rnga ma'i bsil yab bdug spos dang / /zho dang 'o ma gos kyis bkang / /'di rnams kun kyang bshams te dgod/ /de bzhin bum pa bzhi rnams dgod/ /glu dang sil snyan rnga sgra bsgrags/ /shin tu bkra shis tshigs bcad khyebasgrags/ /de bzhin bkra shis sached du brjod/ /cho ga rgyas pa phrebyas nas ni/ /de la sogs par 'dod 1 byas nas/ /yid kyis dkyil 'khor lha kun la/ /mkhas pas gsol ba btab 33—1610

nas ni/ /bum pa bzlas brjod brgya byas pa/ /de ni legs par blangs nas su//dkyil 'khor dal bus lan gsum bskor/ /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags kun 'don cing / /blo dang ldan pas dbang bskur bya/ /de nas phyag rgya bcings nas su/ /gsang sngags zlos kyesnashing spyi bos ༄2gtugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ste/ 'dir sdom pa gang yang mi 'dzin pa de ni/ 'jug pa tsam bya'i dbang gang yang mi bskur ro/ /thun mong gi sdom pa 'dzin pa la ni gsang ba'i dbang gi mthar thug 4pa bsgur la khyad par gyi sdom pa 'dzin pa la ni thabs dang shes rab kyi dbang gi bar du bskur zhing / dbang dam pa de thob pa'i bya ba yang lung de nyid las gsungs pa/ de ltar dbang bskur byas nas ni/ /de ltar 3sar pa'i gos rnams bskon⑪/ /me tog dri la sogs pas mchod/ /mchod phyir thogs 7dang gdu bur bcas/ /de nas bla ma bdag nyid kyis/ /de yi spyi bor gdugs kyang bzung / /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bskor du gzhug /gdugs dang bcas par sgo phyogs su/ /spyi bos rebatud de phyag 'tshal gzhug /slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags/ /gsang sngags rgyud ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /mkhan pos de skad smras nas su/ /gdugs bzhag nas ni slob ma de/ /lag pas legs par blang bar bya/ /de nas 'di skad bsgo bar bya/ /da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kyang ni kun gyis bkur/ /sems can rnams la brtse ba'i 9phyir/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /nan tan bskyed de bri bar byos/ /sgrub pa po yang rgyud la sbyor/ /zhes so/ /de nas rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin te/hūṃ las byung ba krerdo rje 'dod pa'i rgyal pos lha rnams bstems pa 'di 1 sbyin te/33—/6/1

'di mi/ sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lhalag na gnas/ /khyod kyis 2kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /de slob mas lag tu bzung la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sidhi zu badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣas+t+waṃ sadha ra ya mi hi 6hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /ces brjod do/ /de nas ā)ཿlas byung ba'i dril bu 'dod pa'i rgyal pos sangs rgyas thams cad bstems pa 'di sbyin nobye/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab sgra yi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /ces pas so / /des bzung la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dgashe /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa mchog ni byed pa yin/ /zhes pas gsil 1 lo/ /de nas/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bsrungs11/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dod par ni brten bzhin du/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /rang dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni/ /mkhas mchog 'dug par 'gyur ba'i 7tshe/ /de srid mtshungs med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i thabs bsod nams byin rlabs 1 kyis bsgrubs thupa/ /dngos grub kun gyi dbang phyug 'grub/ /sems can don rnams brtan par byed/ /yid kyi gzugs ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya dam tshig yin par bshad/ /gang phyir gzugs kun brtan gyur pamu/ /33—sde6/2

de nas phyag rgya rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes pas phyag rgya'i dam tshig sbyin no/ /de nas tshul ji lta ba dang ldan pas/ oṃ 'dir 3ni ngas khyod lung bstan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton2 / /kye rdo rje zhes bya de bzhin gshegs/ /grub pa srid pa gsum kyi bdag /'di yis lung bstan byas pa yis/ /sngags pa 'gro ba kun bdag yin/ /zhes pas lung bstan to/ /yan lag de dag ni gsang ba'i dbang gi bar du thob pa la bya zhing / de nas dbang dam pa thob pa'am ma yin yang rab tu snod du rung ba la dbugs 'byung ste/ mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /mthong ba dang rgo zhugs gyur pas/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol bar/ /khyed rnams deng nyid legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la rgo/ /slar khyed 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi gsod pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyed 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub 5pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /dam tshig sdom pa grub pa 'di/ /rtag tu khyod kyis bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /dam pa rtag pa'i dka' yin no/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i phyag rgya gang / /byang chub sems ni gtang 6mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos ni nam du yang / /dor ba dag tu mi bya'o / /mi shes pa 'am rmongs pa yis/ /rnam par dbye ba bya ba min/ /bdag nyid yongs su spangs nas su/ /dka' thub kyis 7ni mi gdungs shing / /ci bde bar ni rab tu gzung ru/ /'di ni ma byon sdogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje 33—1613

dril bu'i phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang yongs su mi 'dor zhing / /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas kun mtshungs bla ma ni/ /slob pa'i dpon la gong smad 1pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun smad pas2/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob 'gyur te/ /rims dang gdon dang yams nad dang / /nyer 'tshe chom rkun la sogs pas/ /bla ma'i zhabs la smod pa yi/ /rmongs chen de ni gsod par byed/ /rgyal po'i /kyegyod dang me dang sbrul/ /rkun po gichu dang mkha' 'gro dang / /bgegs dang log )3'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas sems dmyal ltung bar 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon bla ma che/ /dge ba rab tu mi spyoms par tre / /nam yang be+ed par mi bya'o/ /bla ma de la gus pas yon/ /rjes su mthun par dbul bar bya/ /des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyin chad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsgrubs— // /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs rnams mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /de phul bsod nams tshogs yin pas/ /tshogs las byang chub bla shemed pa'o/ /de phul sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu phul ba nyid du 'gyur/ /gang phyir 'di ni legs gnas pas/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /dam tshig lha rnams kun mnyam par/ /gnas par gyur par the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pa/ /kun gyis snatshe ldan dbang bskur te/ /khams gsum rgyal po'i srid che yis/ /rgyal po bdag po brtan pa yinarnga / /de ni bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ /khyed rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /deng nyid thob par the 33byed/614

tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi bzad bde skyid bsten par gyis/ /'gro ba myur du bde ba 'dod pa thams cad la / /rdo rje sems dpa' dang mtshungs rtag par rtogs /rmye par 'gyur/ /zhes pas so/ /de nas chos bstan par bya ba ni/ snying po bsnyen pa sogs grags pas—/ /phyag rgya che la gnas bya zhing / /dam tshig 'dod chags gzugs sogs pas/ /gsang sngags bzang po bzlas par bya/ /rang lhag lha yi sbyor ba yis / /rang rig de yi rang bzhin kyi ṭ+wā/ /phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa yis/ /gzhan dang rang la'ang mchod par bya/ /dka' thub smyung ba bud med rnams/ /bsten pas grub ༄ par mi 'gyur te/ /mi snang mngon shes mkha' spyod kyi / /dngos grub lus sems dag las byung / /de bas sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /sngags kyi spyad mchog spyod pa rnams/ /'dod pa kun la nyer bsten / thucing / /chos kyi yi ge mchog brnyes yin/ /zhes pas so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid ni/ dkyil 'khor ye shes snang ba ste/ /gru bzhi byams sogs bzhi thig ni/ /chos rjes dran pa lta 'ungan spangs/ /ngo tsha khrel yod dang dbang sogs / /ra bar bshad de rnam thar sgo/ /yang dag spong bzhi rta babs te3//dran bzhi khyams byete rdzu 'phrul rkang / /bzhi po sgo khyud byang chub lam/ /me tog phreng ba lam gnyis ni/ /dra ba dra ba byephyed bshad cing / /de bzhin gshegs lam rnga mo gos/ /rtse dril gsung rab yan lag ston/ /ka ba 'phags lam bum pa tshogs/ /gdung sel smin byed nyi zla ste/ /pad+ma ma muchags chos 'khor lo/ /rdo rje ra ba me 'od ni/ /gdug pa srung ba yin par shes/ /zhes pas so/ /lha'i de kho na 11ni bdag bsgrub pa la 'jug par shes par bya ste/33—1615

phyi rol dang ni shin tu phyi rol gyi lha rnams la ni/ de kho na phye ste ma gsungs so/ /de ltar gzhung gzhan la brten pas dbang gi bya ba spyir bstan nas/ da ni rang gi gzhung gi dbang bstan pa'i phyir1/ sarba bid kyis ༄thuji ltar dbang bskur te//zhes bya ba ni/ sarba bid bcus yungs kar dkar po gser gyi snod du gnas pa la mang du bzlas te slob ma'i spyi bor byin pas/ de'i 'od zer gyis lus khyab pas ma rig pa dang bral te/ ye shes bzhi thob par bsam mo/ /'di ni thams cad rig pa'i dbang ma rig pa 'joms pa ste dang po'o/ /bum pa la sogs ji snyed mang thogs sapar/ /bcu po rnams kyis ci dgar dbang bcu bsgur / /zhes bya ba ni brdungs pa'am brkos pa'am / bris pa'i dbu rgyan la / zla ba'i steng du sa bon lnga bo bye 5hūṃ s+t+waṃ dz+rī khaṃ zhes pa las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga po ji ltar dga' ba'i mdog dang dbyibs can rang rang gi rigs kyi mtshan ma las byung ba rnams la/ de dang 'dra ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bstims 6la/ ji skad gsungs pa'i sngags lngas byin gyis brlabs te/dbu 7rgyan du gyur par bsams la/ slob ma'i mgo la bcing ngo / /de nas sngar ji ltar byen gyis brlabs pa'i bum pa la sogs pa rnams las brtsams te/rang rang gi sngags brjod pa'am/ bum pa lnga'am gcig las med na ji ltar bstan pa'i sngags kyis — snabya ste/ dbu rgyan gyi gnas lngar bum pa'i chu cung zad blugs shing btung ba 9yang bya'o/ /bum pas kyang reg par bya ste/ kha cig na re bum pa ji snyed yod kyang bum pa rnams mi bteg gi/ mchod yon kyi snod du chu basbus la des sngags lnga zlos shing dbang bskur ro zhes zer te/ 'di la yang bla ma'i lung gis ma gnang ba med do/ /de nas rin po che'am me tog gi phreng ba 733—16/6

zla ba dang / t+t+waṃ kyelas byung ba'i rin po che de la/ de dang 'dra ba mang po bstims 2te mthar phreng bar byas la rang gi sngags bzlas pas sbyin no/ /de yang dbus kyi cha bas dma' ba tsam du bcing ngo / /de nas dar dkar po sngon bstan pa lta bu zla ba dang t+t+waṃ bye las rin chen tog tu bskyed la/ de dang 'dra ba rnams bstims byate/ mjug tu dar nyid du gyur pas dbu rgyan kyi rtsa ba nas lan mang du phyasngags zlos shing bcings la/ rna ltag gnyis su mdud pa sor bzhi bzhi tsam gyen du drangs la/ rtse mo 'phyang bas sta zur gnyis nas byin par slebs pa tsam du 'phyang du gzhug go/ /de nas rigs lnga'i las kyi phyag rgya slob ma'i spyi gtsug dang / mtshogs / ma dang rna ltag g.yas pa dang ltag pa dang /rna ltag g.yon pa dag tu reg cing rang rang gi sngags bzlas so/ /de nas slob dpon kyis thu rdo rje dril bu slob ma'i mgo la bzhag ste/ lha gang la me tog babs pa de'i mtshan ma dang kye rdo rje zhes bya bas drangs la rang gi sngags rjes su bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas sna tshogs rdo rje zla ba dang khaṃ las byung ba'i don yod grub pa la de dang 'dra ba rnams bstems kyete/ mjug 9tu gyur pa las byung ba rang gi sngags kyis slob ma'i lag tu sbyin no/ /de nas rin po che sna bdun thogs la pha rol phyin pa rtags 7'byung 'khor lo yin te glang po mngon par shes pa mchog /ye shes rdzu 'phrul rta ste chags med 'gro ba shes rab nor bu dam pa yin/ /spyod pa btsun mo bzang mo bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi bo khyim bdag dam pa'o/ /thabs la shin tu mkhas pa blon po yin te mkhas pa de dag 'khor los sgyur/ /zhes 'phags pa sdong pos (1/bkod pa las gsungs pa'i yon tan rnams thob par bya ba'i phyir/ slob ma'i lag tu rang rang gi sngags kyis sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas 33—1617

'khor lo rkang pa'i bar du'o—1—/ /dung g.yas kyi lag tu'o/ /dril bu dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'am rgyud 'di nyid kyi glegs bam lag pa g.yon du byin la rang gi sngags brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje dbyings dbang la sogs pa'i lha mo lnga'i phyag rgya bcings te slob ma'i snying ga dang mgrin pa dang dpral ba dang mtshogs ma dang spyi gtsug tu rig pa la rang rang gi sngags brjod do/ /de nas ༄ sangs rgyas lnga'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya slob ma'i gnas lngar bcings la rang rang gi sngags brjod do/ /de la dbang bcu gcig nyid la/ ji ltar na dbang bcu 1bskur zhes gsungs she na/ bden mod kyi 'on kyang 'khor los sgyur ba gnyis so so 4yin du zin kyang 'khor los sgyur ba zhes bya bar gcig pas bsdus te gcig tu bstan pas bcu'o/ /kha cig na re 'khor los sgyur ba'i sngags gong ma ni/ rgyal po dbang bskur ba rin po che bdun po phal pa'i sngags yin te gnas ma yin par sngags bstan pa'i skabs su zhar las 5bstan pa ste/ de ltar na dbang bcu zhes zer ro/ /kha cig na re bcu la sogs pa ni bcu'o zhes zer ro/ /de nas lag tu dril 6dang rdo rje sbyin/ /zhes bya ba ni hūṃ dang snya las byung ba'i rdo rje dang dril bu rang rang gi sngags bzlas pa slob ma'i lag tu byen la/ tshigs su bcad pa lngas rjes su gnang ba sbyin te/ rang rang gi sngags bzlas so/ /'di ni phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang ste/ dbang 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu ba dang / byang chub rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bla ma'i lung gis/ dbang /por byas la gnang ba sbyin pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /kha cig na re tshig 'di ni rdo rje brtul zhugs ston pa'o zhes zer ro/ /ci dngos grub 'dod pa'i sngags 'ba' zhig dbang bsgur ram snyam pa 9la/ 'khor lo la 33—/618

sogs rmye rin chen bdun thogs te/ /mi yi dbang phyug 'khor lo thogs pa dang / /sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /zhes gsungs te/khams kyi rgyal pos 'khor los sgyur ba thob par bya ba'i phyir yang slob dpon gyis rin chen sna bdun gyi gzugs brnyan thogs la/ dang po rnam rgyal bum pa thogs pa grudang bkra shis brjod do/ /de nas bum pa bzang pos dbang bsgur ba'i khrus byas la/ de yi 'og tu rin po che sna bdun dang / nye ba'i rin po che sna bdun ni zilham dang / ral gri dang pags pa dang khyem dang / skyed mos tshal dang / gos dang / stan rnams dang / dpal be'u dang / pad+ma dang / nya dang / dung dang / bum pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / 'khor lo dang / yang yungs kar dang / zho dang / rtsa rūrlu 5dang / li khri dang / me long dang / shing bil ba'i 'bras bu dang gi wang dag kyang sbyin te 'jig rten na bkra shis par grags pa rnams so/ /der yang bkra shis brgyad pa 'don zhing 6/ 'dir gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang mchod pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa byas nas 'jig rten pa'i dbang 'di dag bskur gyi gzhan du ni ma yin pas na 'di la yang sdig pa gzhom phyir zhes gsungs so/ /kha cig na re tshig 'di ni dbang bcu bskur zhes pa'i rjes su sbyor ro zhes zer ro/ /'dis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang gi skabs su/ kha cig na re 'phags pa de kho na nyid bsdus pa las/ de'i 'og tu dbang bcu gnyis rnams sbyin no zhes zer ro/ /'di las ni sgrub par byed pa med de 'di ni 3lugs gzhan kho na yin pas so/ /rgyud rnams las rang rang gi lugs kyi dbang bskur ba mi 'dra ba rab tu mang ba 33—1619

'byung ba yang gcig tu mthun par bya dgos par 'gyur la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud du yang phyi ma'i rgyud du gsungs pa'i dbang rab tu mang po bsnan pa yin par yang gsungs so/ /'dir hūṃdabang dang po ni sangs rgyas kyi sa'i chos yid la byed pa'i rgyu rnyidang / de'i rgyu rgyud la yod par mtshon pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni de thob ba'i rgyu tshogs gnyis la sbyor ba'o/ /gsum pa ni tshogs sogs pa be+e 'gro ba'i spyi bos bkur — ba'o zhes bsngags pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni tshogs sogs pa rnams mi zhum par bya ba dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /lnga pa dz+wani ma zhum pa de rgyal ba'i phrin las byed par ston pa'o/ /drug pa ni yan lag de dag gis bdag nges par mtshan 'di zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs par 'gyur ro zhes yid ches par byed pa'o/ /bdun pas ni sangs rgyas su gyur nas rdzu 'phrul dang kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul gyis gdul bya gdul bar mtshan pa'o/ /brgyad pas ni rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis 'dul bar byed pas mtshan 'upa'o/ /dgu pas ni bla na med pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen po ni de nyid yin no zhes 'jig rten gyi rgyal srid la sred pa chad par byed pa'o/ /bcu pas ni mtha' gnyis su 7 ma lhung ba'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la gnas par ston pa'o/ /bcu gcig pas ni de'i tshe gsang ba gsum bsam gyis mi khyab par shes par byed pa'o//bcu gnyis pas ni slob pa dang mi slob pa'i dus kun du thabs dang shes rab tu 'byel par bstan pa ste/ des na 'di dag tsam kyis don yongs su rdzogs pa yin pas lugs gzhan gyis 'di gang du yang drang bar mi bya'o/ /dbang ji snyed pa de dag yongs su mi nyams pa ni lhag pa'i lha yin pas na/ rgyud gang du yang dbang lhag ma rnams kyi rten du gyur pa dang 8lhag pa'i lha'i dbang me tog gi phreng 33—1620
